### docs/copilot-documentation/imported/root/server.md

```md
<!--
source: server.md (repo root)
imported: 2025-12-08
note: moved from repo root during doc cleanup
-->

# FireUX Server System

## Overview

- All server code runs under Nitro (Nuxt 4) and exposes lightweight HTTP endpoints that sit in front of Firebase Admin, Google APIs, and Stripe.
- Each app project may host its own `/server` directory for bespoke endpoints. The shared `fireux-core` and `fireux-places` packages ship reusable runtime handlers that Nuxt apps auto-mount under `/api/*` when the module is installed.
- Firebase Admin bootstrap lives both in app space (`projects/fireux/fireux-app/server/api/firebase-admin.ts`) and in shared modules via `fireux-core/src/runtime/server/utils/getAdmin.ts`. Both hydrate admin apps using either inline JSON (`FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT`) or split env vars plus optional storage bucket normalization.

## Source Layout

### App-level server (`projects/fireux/fireux-app/server`)

| File                       | Route / Purpose                                                                                                                                                     |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `api/docs-manifest.get.ts` | Returns the Content manifest generated by `~/utils/docsManifest.server`, powering the `/docs` experience.                                                           |
| `api/firebase-admin.ts`    | Local helper file (not an HTTP route) that exposes `getFirebaseAdminApp`/`getFirestoreDb` helpers for other handlers until the shared module is adopted everywhere. |

### Core runtime module (`packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/server`)

| File                                    | Route / Purpose                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| --------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `utils/getAdmin.ts`                     | Singleton initializer (same contract as the app helper) plus storage bucket normalization.                                                                                                           |
| `api/app/env-check.ts`                  | Comprehensive environment + brand asset validator. Ensures required client/server env vars exist, inspects service-account availability, and validates brand images on disk (dimensions + presence). |
| `api/proxy/image.get.ts`                | Sanitized image proxy that fetches remote images with basic protocol validation, returning them with cache headers.                                                                                  |
| `api/inject-trace.post.ts`              | Server-side sink for client diagnostics. Accepts structured logs/errors and prints them to the server console for observability.                                                                     |
| `api/firestore/update-document.post.ts` | Generic Firestore writer. Initializes Firebase Admin dynamically, accepts `{ collection, documentId, data, merge }`, and performs the write (supports ping/pong tracing).                            |
| `api/notifications.get.ts`              | Stub endpoint that currently returns an empty array (placeholder for future notification feeds).                                                                                                     |
| `api/stripe/create-product.post.ts`     | Creates a product plus optional prices in Stripe, then notifies `/api/stripe/update-firestore` (not yet in repo) if available. Guarded by `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY`/SDK presence.                          |
| `stripe/version.ts`                     | Central Stripe API version constant (`2025-08-27.basil`) shared by the Stripe handlers.                                                                                                              |

### Places extension module (`packages/extensions/fireux-places/src/runtime/server`)

| File                             | Route / Purpose                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| -------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `utils/places-api-key.ts`        | Helper that resolves the Google Places API key from runtimeConfig, public Firebase config, or environment.                                                                                      |
| `api/places/autocomplete.get.ts` | Thin proxy over Google Places Autocomplete with IP-based in-memory rate limiting. Returns up to four structured predictions near a default Bern, CH lat/long unless overridden by query params. |
| `api/places/details.get.ts`      | Fetches a detailed place record (business metadata, address, etc.) for a given `place_id` via the same API key resolver.                                                                        |
| `api/places/logo.get.ts`         | Best-effort logo resolver: crawls the business homepage, scores favicon/logo candidates, and falls back to Clearbit → Unavatar → Google S2 → Picsum placeholders.                               |

## Execution Model

- When a Nuxt app installs `fireux-core` or `fireux-places`, Nuxt auto-registers the exported server handlers, so any FireUX tenant automatically gains `/api/app/*`, `/api/firestore/*`, `/api/stripe/*`, and `/api/places/*` routes without copying files.
- The FireUX app project currently hosts bespoke routes (`/api/registry`, `/api/docs/*`) that are only compiled into that project’s deployment. Other tenant apps can add their own `/server` directory following the same Nitro conventions.
- Firebase Admin bootstrap is intentionally duplicated: module consumers call `getAdmin()` from `fireux-core`, while the FireUX app’s local helpers exist to unblock routes before the shared package is published. Consider consolidating them later.

## Operational Notes

- Environment contracts: service-account access via either `FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT` (JSON), split keys + `FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY`, or `GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS`. Stripe handlers require `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` and the `stripe` npm dependency.
- Brand assets validated by `env-check` must live under `public/img/core/brand` (FireUX default) or `public/img/ecosystem/*` for tenant packages.
- To add a new server route, place a `.ts` file under `server/api` (app scope) or `src/runtime/server/api` inside a shared package. Nitro automatically maps `*.get.ts`, `*.post.ts`, etc., to HTTP verbs.

```

```md
<!--
source: stack-proposal.md (repo root)
imported: 2025-12-08
note: moved from repo root during doc cleanup
-->

# Stack Normalization Proposal

## Goals

- Give every Firestore domain (User, App, Agent, Professional, Chef, Supplier, Job, future Location/Task) the same mental model.
- Reduce folder sprawl while keeping IO, business logic, and UI helpers logically separated.
- Document the delta between shared behavior and domain-specific quirks so STABLE_README duplication is unnecessary.

## Proposed Layout

```
packages/.../composables/firestore/{core|profiles}/X/
├─ useX.ts            # single public entry point
├─ README.md          # optional "diff" notes vs. the base stack
├─ data/
│  ├─ fetch.ts        # useXFetch, useXCollection, hydration wiring
│  ├─ ensure.ts       # core/app ensure helpers
│  └─ mutations.ts    # low-level core/app writers (replaces scattered mutations/*)
├─ actions/
│  ├─ update.ts       # useXUpdate, orchestrates data/mutations
│  ├─ delete.ts       # useXDelete or other destructive flows
│  └─ create.ts       # optional creator/quick-create helpers
├─ state/
│  ├─ computed.ts     # derived flags (isInitialized, hasOverlay, etc.)
│  └─ interface.ts    # pill/cell/profile builders used by UI
└─ internal/
   ├─ ensureHelpers.ts
   └─ forms/
      └─ formatting.ts  # sanitizers/validators specific to the domain
```

### Why these four packs?

- **data/** keeps all Firestore reads and writes together so it is obvious what touches the DB. It collapses the old `main/`, `core/`, `app/`, and `mutations/` folders into a single surface.
- **actions/** exposes business workflows (update, delete, create) that can be safely imported by pages or orchestrators. Actions only call into `data/*`.
- **state/** remains UI-focused and can be consumed by components or `useX.ts`.
- **internal/** hosts helpers that should never leak outside the domain.

## Root Responsibilities

| File        | Purpose                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `useX.ts`   | Public facade that wires `data/fetch`, `actions/update`, and `state/*` together. Pages import this and nothing else.                                                                      |
| `README.md` | Optional, only documents differences from the canonical App stack (e.g., "Agent overlays tenant data" or "Job has editor-only helpers"). If no difference, omit the file to reduce noise. |

## Migration Plan

1. **Author Base README (App stack).** Document the canonical rules once inside the App domain. Other domains either omit README or link back with a bullet list of deviations.
2. **Refactor User/App folders first.**
   - Move current `main/*` fetchers into `data/fetch.ts`.
   - Relocate ensure helpers to `data/ensure.ts`.
   - Merge `useCoreXUpdate`/`useAppXUpdate` into `data/mutations.ts` and update imports.
   - Create `actions/update.ts` that wraps the mutations surface. Repeat for delete/create where applicable.
3. **Repeat for profile domains (Agent, Professional, Chef, Supplier).** These stacks already share 80% of their files, so it becomes mostly moving modules and updating import paths.
4. **Bring Jobs onto the same layout.** Current `main/` modules map cleanly to `data/` and `actions/`.
5. **Scaffold future domains (Location, Task) with empty packs.** This preserves the pattern even if implementations are postponed.
6. **Update all `useX.ts` facades** to reference the new locations and re-export the public API (fetch, collection, update, delete, computed, interface) from a single place.
7. **Clean up legacy paths.** Remove unused folders (`core/`, `mutations/`, `utils/`) once the imports are updated.

## Open Questions

1. **Do we want per-domain README diffs or a single table in `/copilot-documentation/`?** The proposal assumes optional lightweight readmes inside each stack plus a central reference.
2. **Should `actions/*` export individual composables (e.g., `useAgentUpdate`) or a single object (e.g., `agentActions`)?** Current code favors composables; we can keep that convention.
3. **How do we version these moves for downstream packages?** We will need a short migration note in `copilot-documentation/temporary-reports/` once the new layout lands.

## Next Steps

1. Review and confirm the folder bundle strategy.
2. If accepted, schedule the User/App refactor as the pilot change.
3. After pilot validation, create a tracking issue for migrating every remaining domain with checkboxes (Agent, Professional, Chef, Supplier, Job, Location, Task).

```

# Firestore Core User Stack

`````

packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/
├─ useUser.ts # auth-aware orchestrator composing everything below
├─ main/
│ ├─ useUserFetch.ts # subscribes to /users/{uid} and /apps/{appId}/users/{uid}

├─ mutations/
│ ├─ useCoreUserUpdate.ts # CoreUser writes (display name, avatar, tags, ecosystem notifications)
│ ├─ useAppUserUpdate.ts # AppUser writes (role, tenant notifications)

└─ utils/

- Flesh out additional CoreUser/AppUser packs (details/tags/notifications, membership, etc.).
- Introduce explicit notification services once the shared API stabilizes.

# Firestore Core App Stack

```

packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/app/
├─ useApp.ts # orchestrator that composes fetch, state, ensures, mutations
├─ main/
│ ├─ useAppFetch.ts # subscribes to /apps/{appId}
│ └─ useAppCollection.ts # shared collection helper for admin/dev views
├─ core/

├─ mutations/

### docs/copilot-documentation/liturature.md

```md
# FIReUX Ecosystem — Literature

FIReUX is a modular SaaS framework that powers multi-tenant apps such as **Misebox** (hospitality professionals) and **Cleanbox** (cleaning workforce).
The system is composed of:

- **Core (`packages/core/fireux-core`)** — shared composables, auth, Firestore helpers, Stripe, PWA, CI.
- **Extensions** — optional feature sets:
  - `fireux-jobs`: jobs, applications, contracts, ratings.
  - `fireux-places`: business locations, verification, linking.
- **Tenants** — vertical modules built on core:
  - `fireux-misebox`
  - `fireux-cleanbox`
  - `fireux-fireux` (default tenant)
- **Projects / Apps** — deployable front-ends:
  - Misebox App + Niederhorn example
  - Cleanbox App + Richie’s Reinigung example
  - FireUX App (marketing + docs portal)

### Guiding Principles

1. **Modular first** – every feature lives in its smallest possible package.
2. **Tenant-aware** – core handles auth, data, billing; tenants define branding + flags.
3. **Composable** – every data model exposes `useX()` composables.
4. **Ship-ready** – each app must run without backend edits once environment vars are filled.

### Feature Families

| Domain   | Features                                   |
| -------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| Core     | Auth, Firestore, Stripe, PWA, CI, Docs     |
| Jobs     | Postings, Applications, Contracts, Ratings |
| Places   | Search, Verification, Map, Linking         |
| Misebox  | Profiles, Recipes, Suppliers, Prep Plans   |
| Cleanbox | Crews, QA, Billing, Clients                |
| FireUX   | Governance, Marketplace, Scaffolding       |

```

### docs/copilot-documentation/model-interface.md

```md
# Model & Interface Reference

This guide consolidates the current FireUX data models that power app users, shared profiles, and the Jobs/Agent domain. Use it as a quick map when wiring composables or UI helpers.

## Core User Models (`packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/models/core/user.model.ts`)

### `User`

- Represents the canonical Firestore user document.
- Key identity fields: `id`, `display_name`, `avatar`, optional `handle`, `email`, `bio`.
- Membership arrays (`profiles`, `userOf`, `adminOf`) describe global and tenant roles.
- System metadata: `created_at`, `updated_at`.
- Tenant overlay info (`role`, `appUser`) and optional `notifications` bucket.

### `AppUser`

- Tenant-scoped overlay stored alongside the core user.
- Tracks `role`, `creator_id`, timestamps, and tenant-specific notifications.

### `UserCard` namespace

- UI projections used by console components.
- `UserCard.Card` is the canonical UI payload produced by `useUserInterface().card()`.
- Cards are presentational-only; business logic (CTA, badge decoration, permissions) lives in callers.

## Shared Profile Contract (`packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/models/core/profile.model.ts`)

### `Profile`

- Minimal shape applied to every domain profile (Chef, Supplier, Agent, Professional, etc.).
- Fields: `id`, `user` (partial `User`), `domain`, `title`, `subtitle`, `badges`, `created_at`, `updated_at`.
- Allows the core Firestore composables to treat all profile types uniformly.

### `ProfileConfig`

- Describes how a domain hooks into shared profile tooling.
- Keys: `id`, `collectionName`, `profileType`, plus optional CTA/nav labels/icons.
- Passed to composables like `useProfile`, `useProfileCollection`, and ensure/update helpers.

## Agent Domain Models (`packages/extensions/fireux-jobs/src/runtime/models/profiles/Agent/Agent.model.ts`)

### `AgentCoreProfile`

- Global agent profile stored in `/{collectionName}/{id}`.
- Fields: `id`, timestamps, and current domain attributes (`tagline`, `badges`).
- Narrower than the generic `Profile`, but still compatible through the `AgentProfile` alias.

### `AgentAppProfile`

- Placeholder for tenant-specific agent properties (e.g., local visibility, app tags).
- Not populated yet, but reserved for per-app overrides.

### `Agent`

- Hydrated object returned by `useAgent()`: `{ user, core, app }`.
- `user` comes from the core `User` record, while `core`/`app` come from the Firestore profile refs.

### `AgentProfile`

- Alias pointing to `AgentCoreProfile` to keep legacy imports working while the domain is simplified.

### `AgentCard` namespace (`useAgentInterface.ts`)

- UI-facing `AgentCard.Card` payload emitted by `useAgentInterface().card()`.
- Follows the same canonical card DTO shape used by App/User.
- `useAgentInterface()` should also expose `searchText(raw)` (or `searchText(target?)`) so collection managers can filter via the interface rather than guessing fields.

## Core App Model (`packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/models/core/app.model.ts`)

### `App`

- Canonical Firestore document describing an app/tenant.
- Identity/display: `app_name`, optional `app_short_name`, `slug`, brand assets (`avatar_url`, `logo_url`, `wordmark_url`).
- Scope/governance: `role`, `ecosystem`, ownership metadata (`creator_id`, `admin_ids`, `join_requests`).
- Ops metadata: `status`, `description`, optional `social_links`, timestamps (`created_at`, `updated_at`).

### `AppCard.Card`

- Produced by `useAppInterface().card()` in:
	`packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/app/utils/view/useAppInterface.ts`
- Model files remain Firestore schema-only; projection/mapping happens in the interface composable.
- Canonical card DTO shape:
	`id`, `to`, `avatar`, `title`, `subtitle`, `badges`, `line1`, `line2`, `line3`
- Badges are caller-owned: interfaces default to `badges: []`.

### `useAppInterface`

- Accepts an `App` ref (or lazy target) and builds the `AppCard.Card` payload.
- Strict: throws when required inputs are missing.
- No badge decisions: returns `badges: []` and lets the caller decorate based on context.

## How They Fit Together

1. **Config** — Each domain exposes a `ProfileConfig` (e.g., `agentConfig`). The shared profile composables use this to fetch global/app documents and hydrate `ProfileRefs`.
2. **Profile refs → domain types** — Domains type their refs (`AgentProfile`) and optionally extend the shape with extra fields. Core utilities dont need to know the specifics.
3. **User overlay** — `useProfileCollection` enriches every profile entry with the canonical `User` (`profile.user`). This lets downstream helpers (like `resolveAgentPill`) access avatar/name data without issuing extra queries.
4. **Hydrated models** — Domain composables (e.g., `useAgent`) build a richer object (`Agent`) by combining the core user, core profile, and app overlay. This is the hand-off point for UI helpers, mutations, and previews.

Keep this file updated as new domains or fields land so everyone knows where the source of truth lives.

## Proposed Simplifications (Short-Term Guardrails)

To keep the stack maintainable while Agent and other profile domains are still forming, adopt the following interim rules:

1. **Unify UI projections** – For every domain, expose a single `XCard.Card` payload (same DTO fields) that powers Pill/Cell/Preview/Profile views. Components control density; interfaces control mapping.

2. **No interface logic in model files** – Model files should declare TypeScript interfaces/types only. Helper logic (resolvers, formatters, route builders) must live inside composables (e.g., `useAgentInterface.ts`). This keeps data contracts and UI behavior separate and makes future schema changes easier.

3. **Explicit ownership per profile** – Each domain profile should always reference its owning user via `profile.user` (partial `User`) and the canonical `userId`. When tenants add overlays, ensure we store the creator/admin context (`creator_id`, `app_id`) on the app profile so we can trace provenance without inference.

4. **Minimum fields per profile** – Until the domain matures, keep core profiles limited to `id`, `tagline` (or `title`), `badges`, and timestamps. Any experimental fields should live in app overlays to avoid migrations.

5. **Document the contract** – For every domain added to this file, include: (a) where the Firestore core doc lives, (b) whether an app overlay exists, (c) which composable hydrates the full object, and (d) which components/composables own the UI projections.

Once the domain requirements solidify, we can revisit richer per-view interfaces, but these guardrails keep things predictable while we “hold the fort.”

```

### docs/copilot-documentation/object-entity-canon.md

```md
# Object / Entity Canon (Firestore)

This doc defines the **repo-wide canon** for FireUX “objects/entities” stored in Firestore.

See also:

- Entity organism (components) canon: `docs/architecture/canon.md`

## 1) Canon paths

- **Model (shape-only):**
  - `src/runtime/models/<thing>.model.ts`

- **Composable facade (public entry):**
  - `src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/<thing>/use<Thing>s.ts`

## 2) Canon folder layout (inside each object)

- `fetch/` — reads (collection + single)
- `mutations/` — create/update/delete
- `utils/` — optional helpers (formatting/validation)
- `utils/view/` — optional interface helpers (pill/cell/profile)
- `state/` — optional local draft state for forms (only when needed)

## 3) Naming rules

- Folder names: **lowercase, singular**
  - Examples: `objects/company`, `objects/blog`, `objects/product`, `objects/kitchen`

- Facade file: `use<Thing>s.ts` (pluralized facade)
  - Exported function name should match the facade: `useCompanies`, `useProducts`, etc.

## 4) Model rules

- Models are **shape-only**.
- Do **not** put view models (pill/cell/profile) inside models.
  - Those belong in `utils/view/use<Thing>Interface.ts`.

## 5) Firestore access engine

- **Default engine for FireUX objects/entities:** `useFirestoreManager()` (or the granular `useFirestoreRead/Create/Update/Delete`).
- **VueFire-direct** (`useFirestore/useCollection/useDocument`) is allowed only as a temporary ecosystem prototype and should be migrated when touched.

## 6) ID strategy

- Default: **Firestore auto-ID** (unless the object has a real external ID, e.g. Google Places).
- If a package must generate an ID, document why and make it consistent.

```

# Getting Started

Follow these steps to run FireUX locally and browse docs at `/docs`.

## Prerequisites

- Node 18+
- `pnpm` installed globally (`npm i -g pnpm`)

## Install dependencies

```sh
pnpm install
```

## Run the FireUX app (with docs)

```sh
pnpm dev:fireux
```

- Open http://localhost:3000/docs to view this documentation via Nuxt Content.

## Next steps

- Learn the architecture: `architecture/`
- Build things: `guide/`

# Creating Apps

## 1) Prerequisites

- Node 18+, `pnpm` installed
- Firebase project and env vars available

## 2) Install deps

```sh
pnpm install
```

## 3) Pick a dev target

- FireUX app: `pnpm dev:fireux`
- All apps: `pnpm dev:all-extended`

## 4) Configure env

- Create `.env.local` from `templates/.env.app.template` and fill values.

## 5) Run

Start the dev server (see commands above) and open the target port (default 3000 for FireUX).

## 6) Next

- Review profiles model: `profiles.md`
- Learn architecture basics: `../architecture/`

### docs/guide/profiles.md

```md
---
title: Profiles
description: How profiles work across identity, data contracts, and UI.
---

# Profiles Guide

## Model

- Profiles capture identity + tenant context; treat them as required inputs.
- Keep the profile contract stable; avoid ad-hoc fields in UI.

## Data contracts

- Validate at the edge (Firestore/HTTP) and keep typed objects internally.
- Prefer composables for read/write instead of inline queries.

## UI integration

- Render loading/empty/error explicitly; never silently fall back to email/displayName.
- Derive display values via shared helpers, not per-component logic.

## Next

- See architecture canon for pattern guardrails: `../architecture/canon.md`

```

### eslint.config.js

```js
import tsParser from '@typescript-eslint/parser'
import vueParser from 'vue-eslint-parser'
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'

const __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))

const baseRestrictedImportPatterns = [
  {
    group: ['fireux-core/src/*', 'fireux-core/src/**'],
    message:
      'Do not import internal source files from fireux-core; use exported runtime modules instead.',
  },
  {
    group: [
      // Outside a package, never deep-relative into other packages; use the package name.
      '../**/packages/*/*/*',
      '../**/packages/*/*/**',
      './**/packages/*/*/*',
      './**/packages/*/*/**',
      // Also forbid "root-ish" specifiers like "packages/core/...".
      'packages/*/*/*',
      'packages/*/*/**',
    ],
    message:
      'Do not deep-relative import into other workspace packages; import via the package name instead (e.g. fireux-core/runtime/*).',
  },
]

const makeNoRestrictedImportsRule = ({
  patterns = baseRestrictedImportPatterns,
  paths = [],
} = {}) => [
  'error',
  {
    ...(paths.length ? { paths } : {}),
    ...(patterns.length ? { patterns } : {}),
  },
]

const getPackages = () => {
  const roots = ['core', 'ecosystem', 'extensions']
  const result = []

  for (const root of roots) {
    const rootDir = path.join(__dirname, 'packages', root)
    if (!fs.existsSync(rootDir)) continue

    const children = fs
      .readdirSync(rootDir, { withFileTypes: true })
      .filter((d) => d.isDirectory())
      .map((d) => d.name)

    for (const child of children) {
      const pkgDir = path.join(rootDir, child)
      const pkgJsonPath = path.join(pkgDir, 'package.json')
      if (!fs.existsSync(pkgJsonPath)) continue

      try {
        const pkgJson = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(pkgJsonPath, 'utf8'))
        const name = pkgJson?.name
        if (!name || typeof name !== 'string') continue
        result.push({
          name,
          dir: `packages/${root}/${child}`,
        })
      } catch {
        // Ignore invalid package.json files
      }
    }
  }

  return result
}

const makeSelfImportBanPatterns = (pkgName) => [
  ...baseRestrictedImportPatterns,
  {
    group: [pkgName, `${pkgName}/*`, `${pkgName}/**`],
    message: `Self-imports are forbidden inside ${pkgName}; use relative imports instead.`,
  },
]

const makeInternalAliasBanPatterns = (aliasPrefix) => [
  {
    group: [aliasPrefix, `${aliasPrefix}/*`, `${aliasPrefix}/**`],
    message:
      'Internal path aliases are package-scoped; outside the package, import via the package name instead.',
  },
]

export default [
  {
    ignores: [
      'node_modules/**',
      'dist/**',
      '**/dist/**',
      'build/**',
      '.nuxt/**',
      '.output/**',
      '**/.output/**',
      'coverage/**',
    ],
  },
  // Disallow auto-importing models via addImportsDir in config files
  {
    files: ['**/src/config/**/*.ts'],
    rules: {
      'no-restricted-syntax': [
        'error',
        {
          selector:
            "CallExpression[callee.name='addImportsDir'] Literal[value='runtime/models'], CallExpression[callee.name='addImportsDir'] Literal[value='./runtime/models'], CallExpression[callee.name='addImportsDir'] Literal[value='../runtime/models']",
          message:
            'addImportsDir(runtime/models) is disallowed; models are explicit imports only via #*-models/*.',
        },
      ],
    },
  },
  // Vue SFCs
  {
    files: ['**/*.vue'],
    languageOptions: {
      ecmaVersion: 2022,
      sourceType: 'module',
      parser: vueParser,
      parserOptions: {
        parser: tsParser,
        extraFileExtensions: ['.vue'],
        ecmaVersion: 2022,
        sourceType: 'module',
        project: false,
      },
    },
    rules: {
      'no-console': 'off',
      'no-debugger': 'warn',
      'no-restricted-imports': makeNoRestrictedImportsRule(),
    },
  },
  // TS/JS files
  {
    files: ['**/*.{js,ts}'],
    languageOptions: {
      ecmaVersion: 2022,
      sourceType: 'module',
      parser: tsParser,
      parserOptions: {
        ecmaVersion: 2022,
        sourceType: 'module',
        project: false,
      },
    },
    rules: {
      'no-console': 'off',
      'no-debugger': 'warn',
      'no-restricted-imports': makeNoRestrictedImportsRule(),
    },
  },

  // Ban self-imports inside each workspace package (prevents drift back to "from '<pkg>/*'" internally)
  ...getPackages().map(({ name, dir }) => ({
    files: [`${dir}/**/*.{js,ts,vue}`],
    rules: {
      'no-restricted-imports': makeNoRestrictedImportsRule({
        patterns: makeSelfImportBanPatterns(name),
      }),
    },
  })),

  // Ban use of internal aliases outside each package (outside must use package imports)
  ...getPackages().map(({ name, dir }) => ({
    files: ['**/*.{js,ts,vue}'],
    ignores: [`${dir}/**`],
    rules: {
      'no-restricted-imports': makeNoRestrictedImportsRule({
        patterns: [...baseRestrictedImportPatterns, ...makeInternalAliasBanPatterns(`#${name}`)],
      }),
    },
  })),

  // Special-case: fireux-core exports additional internal aliases that must remain package-scoped
  {
    files: ['**/*.{js,ts,vue}'],
    ignores: ['packages/core/fireux-core/**'],
    rules: {
      'no-restricted-imports': makeNoRestrictedImportsRule({
        patterns: [
          ...baseRestrictedImportPatterns,
          ...makeInternalAliasBanPatterns('#fireux-core-runtime'),
          ...makeInternalAliasBanPatterns('#fireux-core-composables'),
          ...makeInternalAliasBanPatterns('#fireux-core-models'),
        ],
      }),
    },
  },

  // fireux-products: forbid relative Firestore manager imports; use fireux-core runtime path
  // (placed after global + package rules so it actually applies)
```

### mirror/README.md

```md
## What a cleared mirror looks like

After clearing, your `mirror/mirror.txt` should look like:

	# Live mirror list (source of truth for generated symlinks in mirror/)
	#
	# How to use:
	# 1) Add/remove repo-relative file paths (or directories) below.
	# 2) Run: node scripts/mirror-sync.mjs
	#
	# Rules:
	# - One repo-relative path per line (file OR directory).
	# - Directories are expanded recursively into files.
	# - Lines starting with # are ignored.
	# - Do not hand-edit symlinks in mirror/; re-run the sync.
	# - To “clear the mirror”, remove all non-comment lines and re-run the sync.
    
	# (empty)

And your `mirror/` directory should contain only:

	mirror/README.md
	mirror/mirror.txt

No other files or symlinks should remain after a successful clear.

# Mirror

`mirror/` is a *flat*, generated workspace of symlinks for the files you want to keep “in view” during a task.

## Quick use

1. Edit `mirror/mirror.txt` (add/remove paths).
2. Regenerate: `node scripts/mirror-sync.mjs`.
3. Work from the symlinks in `mirror/` (but edit the real sources under `packages/**`).

## Rules (the “mirror contract”)

- **Source of truth:** `mirror/mirror.txt`.
- **Generated output:** everything in `mirror/` *except* `mirror/README.md` and `mirror/mirror.txt`.
- **Safe to delete:** generated symlinks only. Don’t delete the README or list file as part of normal workflow.
- **Flat only:** no subfolders under `mirror/` (symlinks must live in the `mirror/` root).
- **Never hand-edit symlinks:** don’t create/rename/delete symlinks manually; run the sync script instead.


## What goes in `mirror/mirror.txt`

- One repo-relative path per line.
- You can list a file or a directory.
	- If you list a directory, the sync script will include files under it (recursively).
- Lines starting with `#` are comments.
- **To set a custom symlink name:** add `# your-name.ts` after the path. Example:

			packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/app/utils/view/useAppInterface.ts # app-interface.ts

	This will create a symlink named `app-interface.ts` in `mirror/`.

# Mirror (quick)

Purpose: a simple, flat workspace of symlinks for files you want to "peek" during work.

Quick commands
- Reset the mirror (remove symlinks + clear the list):

```sh
find mirror -type l ! -name 'README.md' ! -name 'mirror.txt' -delete && \
awk '/^[[:space:]]*#/ || /^[[:space:]]*$/ {print}' mirror/mirror.txt > mirror/mirror.txt.tmp && mv mirror/mirror.txt.tmp mirror/mirror.txt
```

- Generate symlinks from the list:

```sh
node scripts/mirror-sync.mjs
```

How to use
- Edit `mirror/mirror.txt`: add one repo-relative path per line (files or directories).
- Run `node scripts/mirror-sync.mjs` to populate `mirror/`.
- Work from the symlinks in `mirror/`; edit the original files in-place in the repo.

Mirror rules
- `mirror/mirror.txt` is the single source-of-truth (one path per non-comment line).
- Lines starting with `#` are comments.
- On reset, the filepaths (non-comment lines) are removed — only header/comments remain.
- To set a custom symlink name, append `# custom-name.ext` to a path on the same line.

Alignment notes (Company + Kitchen overlays)
- Company/Kitchen documents are overlays bound to a Place id.
- Overlay docs must include the shared place snapshot fields:
	id, name, formatted_address, lat, lng, place_image, search_term, search_term_normalized.
- Overlay docs may add domain fields, but no optionals (empty string = unset).
- Create/System must create from Place confirmation with a minimal write.

Examples
- Add a file:

```
packages/extensions/fireux-places/src/runtime/models/place.model.ts
```

- Add a file with a custom symlink name:

```
packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/useAppInterface.ts # app-interface.ts
```

That's it — keep `mirror/mirror.txt` as the list of paths you want visible, and use the reset command when you want a fresh starting point.

```

### packages/core/fireux-core/README.md

```md
# fireux-core

Core runtime and primitives for FireUX.

This package is the reference implementation for FireUX conventions:
- opinionated repository and app structure
- shared runtime composables and models
- shared utilities used by ecosystems, extensions, and apps

## Structure
- src/ — all authored source code
- registry.json — package metadata used by FireUX tooling

## Notes

```ts
// FILE: packages/core/fireux-core/config/app/fireux.config.ts
import type { NuxtConfig } from 'nuxt/schema'

import { configNitroFirebase } from './nitro'
import { configPwa } from './pwa'
import { setRuntime } from './runtime'
import { configViteWorkspace } from './vite'

export type FireuxAppConfig = {
  ecosystem: string
  id: string
  name: string
  shortName: string
  /** Optional app thumbnail path/URL (defaults to /img/app/thumbnail.png). */
  appThumbnail?: string
  /** Optional app logo path/URL (preferred). Defaults to /img/app/logo.png. */
  appLogo?: string
  role: 'global' | 'tenant'
  modules?: NonNullable<NuxtConfig['modules']>
}

function moduleName(entry: unknown): string | undefined {
  if (typeof entry === 'string') return entry
  if (Array.isArray(entry) && typeof entry[0] === 'string') return entry[0]
  return undefined
}

function isValidJsIdentifier(value: string): boolean {
  return /^[A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$]*$/.test(value)
}

function toValidJsIdentifier(value: string): string {
  const trimmed = value.trim()
  if (!trimmed) return 'server'
  if (isValidJsIdentifier(trimmed)) return trimmed

  const parts = trimmed
    .split(/[^A-Za-z0-9]+/)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .map((p) => p.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g, ''))
    .filter(Boolean)

  let out = parts
    .map((p, i) => {
      const lower = p.toLowerCase()
      if (i === 0) return lower
      return lower.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + lower.slice(1)
    })
    .join('')

  if (!out) out = 'server'
  if (!/^[A-Za-z_$]/.test(out)) out = `_${out}`
  out = out.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_$]/g, '_')

  return out
}

function defaultNitroFirebaseRegion(ecosystem: string): string {
  switch (ecosystem) {
    case 'misebox':
      return 'europe-west6'
    default:
      // FireUX + Cleanbox use Firestore multi-region eur3; eur3 is not a
      // deployable Cloud Functions region, so we default to a nearby region.
      return 'europe-west1'
  }
}

function reqEnv(name: string): string {
  const value = process.env[name]
  if (typeof value !== 'string' || !value.trim()) {
    const isCi =
      process.env.CI === 'true' ||
      process.env.CI === '1' ||
      process.env.GITHUB_ACTIONS === 'true'

    // During CI (especially on `pnpm install` → `postinstall` → `nuxi prepare`),
    // we don't require full runtime envs yet.
    if (isCi) {
      if (name === 'APP_DOMAIN') return 'localhost'
      if (name === 'NUXT_FIREBASE_APP_ID') return 'ci'
    }

    throw new Error(`[fireux] Missing required env var: ${name}`)
  }
  return value.trim()
}

function optEnv(name: string): string | undefined {
  const value = process.env[name]
  if (typeof value !== 'string') return undefined
  const trimmed = value.trim()
  return trimmed ? trimmed : undefined
}

export function defineFireuxConfig(app: FireuxAppConfig): NuxtConfig {
  const nuxt: NuxtConfig = {}

  // Ensure responsive breakpoints behave correctly on mobile.
  // Without an explicit viewport meta tag, browsers may render using a
  // desktop-sized viewport (making the console sidebar appear "always on").
  const head: any = ((nuxt as any).app ||= {}).head ||= {}
  const meta: any[] = (head.meta ||= [])
  const hasViewport = meta.some((m) => m?.name === 'viewport')
  if (!hasViewport) {
    meta.push({ name: 'viewport', content: 'width=device-width, initial-scale=1' })
  }

  // Align Nitro defaults with our current baseline.
  // Prevents runtime fallback warnings during dev.
  ;(nuxt as any).compatibilityDate = '2025-12-22'
  ;(nuxt.nitro as any) = {
    ...((nuxt.nitro as any) || {}),
    compatibilityDate: '2025-12-22',
  }

  nuxt.srcDir = 'app'
  // Keep Nuxt build output inside the allowed app tree.
  // FireUX project apps forbid L1 build artifacts like `.nuxt`.
  nuxt.buildDir = 'app/.nuxt'
  nuxt.imports = { dirs: ['composables/**', 'utils/**'] }

  nuxt.modules = [
    '@nuxt/eslint',
    '@nuxt/ui',
    '@nuxt/icon',
    '@nuxt/content',
    `fireux-${app.ecosystem}`,
    // VueFire/Firebase wiring lives in fireux-nuxtfire.
    'fireux-nuxtfire',
    'fireux-core',
    '@vite-pwa/nuxt',
    ...(app.modules || []),
  ]

  // Prefer Node's built-in SQLite (Node >= 22.5) to avoid native addon deps.
  // Nuxt Content will otherwise default to better-sqlite3 in Node.
  ;(nuxt as any).content = {
    ...((nuxt as any).content || {}),
    experimental: {
      ...(((nuxt as any).content || {}).experimental || {}),
      sqliteConnector: 'native',
    },
  }

  nuxt.css = [
    'fireux-core/runtime/assets/styles/main.css',
    'fireux-core/runtime/assets/styles/main.scss',
  ]

  const envDomain = reqEnv('APP_DOMAIN')
  const envPin = optEnv('DEVELOPER_PIN')
  const envFirebaseAppId = reqEnv('NUXT_FIREBASE_APP_ID')
  const envFirebaseMeasurementId = optEnv('NUXT_FIREBASE_MEASUREMENT_ID')
  setRuntime(nuxt, {
    app: {
      id: app.id,
      name: app.name,
      shortName: app.shortName,
      appThumbnail: app.appThumbnail || '/img/app/thumbnail.png',
      appLogo: app.appLogo || '/img/app/logo.png',
      domain: envDomain,
      role: app.role,
      ecosystem: app.ecosystem,
      modules: (nuxt.modules || []).map(moduleName).filter(Boolean) as readonly string[],
    },

    firebaseApp: {
      appId: envFirebaseAppId,
      ...(envFirebaseMeasurementId ? { measurementId: envFirebaseMeasurementId } : {}),
    },

    private: {
      developerPin: envPin,
    },
  })

  configPwa(nuxt, {
    name: app.name,
    shortName: app.shortName,
    themeColor: '#000000',
    backgroundColor: '#000000',
    lang: 'en',
  })

  configNitroFirebase(nuxt, {
    serverFunctionName: toValidJsIdentifier(app.id),
    region: process.env.NITRO_FIREBASE_REGION || defaultNitroFirebaseRegion(app.ecosystem),
  })

  configViteWorkspace(nuxt)

  return nuxt
}

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/config/app/nitro.ts

```ts
// packages/core/fireux-core/src/config/nitro.ts
import type { NuxtConfig } from 'nuxt/schema'

export type FireUXNitroConfig = {
  serverFunctionName: string
  region: string
}

export function configNitroFirebase(nuxt: NuxtConfig, c: FireUXNitroConfig) {
  // TS-safe local handles (NuxtConfig's type won't reliably narrow on mutation)
  const nitro = ((nuxt.nitro ||= {}) as any)

  const isDev =
    process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' || process.env.NUXT_DEV === 'true'

  if (isDev) {
    nitro.preset = 'node-server'
  } else {
    nitro.preset = 'firebase'

    // Firebase preset options are not fully represented in Nuxt's TS union,
    // so we intentionally set this via `any` to match runtime behaviour.
    nitro.firebase = {
      gen: 2,
      nodeVersion: '22',
      serverFunctionName: c.serverFunctionName,
      region: c.region,
    }
  }

  nitro.externals ||= {}
  nitro.externals.external ||= []

  nitro.externals.external.push(
    'firebase-admin',
    'firebase-functions',
    '@google-cloud/firestore',
    '@google-cloud/storage'
  )
}

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/config/app/pwa.ts

```ts
// packages/core/fireux-core/src/config/pwa.ts
import type { NuxtConfig } from 'nuxt/schema'

export type FireUXPwaConfig = {
  name: string
  shortName: string
  themeColor: string
  backgroundColor: string
  lang: string
}

export function configPwa(nuxt: NuxtConfig, c: FireUXPwaConfig) {
  nuxt.modules ||= []
  nuxt.modules.push([
    '@vite-pwa/nuxt',
    {
      registerType: 'autoUpdate',
      injectRegister: 'auto',
      workbox: { navigateFallback: '/' },
      manifest: {
        name: c.name,
        short_name: c.shortName,
        scope: '/',
        start_url: '/',
        display: 'standalone',
        background_color: c.backgroundColor,
        theme_color: c.themeColor,
        lang: c.lang,
        icons: [
          { src: '/img/app/pwa/icon-192.png', sizes: '192x192', type: 'image/png' },
          { src: '/img/app/pwa/icon-512.png', sizes: '512x512', type: 'image/png' },
        ],
      },
    },
  ])

  const app = (nuxt.app ||= {} as any)
  const head = (app.head ||= {} as any)
  head.meta ||= []
  head.link ||= []

  head.meta.push(
    { name: 'theme-color', content: c.themeColor },
    { name: 'apple-mobile-web-app-capable', content: 'yes' },
    { name: 'apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style', content: 'black-translucent' },
    { name: 'mobile-web-app-capable', content: 'yes' }
  )

  head.link.push(
    { rel: 'manifest', href: '/manifest.webmanifest' },
    { rel: 'icon', href: '/favicon.ico' },
    { rel: 'apple-touch-icon', sizes: '180x180', href: '/img/app/pwa/icon-192.png' }
  )
}

function ensure(nuxt) {
  const root = nuxt?.options ?? nuxt
  const runtime = (root.runtimeConfig ||= {})
  const pub = (runtime.public ||= {})
  return { runtime, pub }
}

export function setRuntime(nuxt, s) {
  const { runtime, pub } = ensure(nuxt)

  if (s.app) pub.fireux = { ...(pub.fireux || {}), ...s.app }
  if (s.firebaseEcosystem)
    pub.firebaseEcosystem = {
      ...(pub.firebaseEcosystem || {}),
      ...s.firebaseEcosystem,
    }
  if (s.firebaseApp)
    pub.firebaseApp = { ...(pub.firebaseApp || {}), ...s.firebaseApp }
  if (s.private) runtime.fireux = { ...(runtime.fireux || {}), ...s.private }
}

export function setRuntimeApp(nuxt, c) {
  setRuntime(nuxt, { app: c })
}

export function setRuntimeFirebaseEcosystem(nuxt, c) {
  setRuntime(nuxt, { firebaseEcosystem: c })
}

export function setRuntimeFirebaseApp(nuxt, c) {
  setRuntime(nuxt, { firebaseApp: c })
}

export function setRuntimePrivate(nuxt, c) {
  setRuntime(nuxt, { private: c })
}

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/config/app/runtime.ts

```ts
// FILE: packages/core/fireux-core/config/app/runtime.ts
import type { NuxtConfig } from 'nuxt/schema'

export type RuntimeApp = {
  id: string
  name: string
  shortName: string
  /** Optional app thumbnail path/URL (e.g. /img/app/thumbnail.png). */
  appThumbnail?: string
  /** Optional app logo path/URL (preferred over appThumbnail for listings). */
  appLogo?: string
  domain: string
  role: 'global' | 'tenant'
  ecosystem: string
  modules: readonly string[]
}

export type RuntimeFirebaseEcosystem = {
  id: string
  name: string
  description: string
  firebase: {
    apiKey: string
    authDomain: string
    projectId: string
    storageBucket: string
    messagingSenderId: string
  }
}

export type RuntimeFirebaseApp = {
  appId: string
  measurementId?: string
}

export type RuntimePrivate = {
  developerPin?: string
}

export type RuntimeShape = {
  app?: Partial<RuntimeApp>
  firebaseEcosystem?: Partial<RuntimeFirebaseEcosystem>
  firebaseApp?: Partial<RuntimeFirebaseApp>
  private?: Partial<RuntimePrivate>
}

// Supports BOTH:
// - NuxtConfig object (nuxt.config.ts time)  -> nuxt.runtimeConfig
// - Nuxt instance (module setup time)        -> nuxt.options.runtimeConfig
function ensure(nuxt: any) {
  const root = (nuxt?.options ?? nuxt) as any
  const runtime = (root.runtimeConfig ||= {} as any)
  const pub = (runtime.public ||= {} as any)
  return { runtime, pub }
}

export function setRuntime(nuxt: NuxtConfig | any, s: RuntimeShape) {
  const { runtime, pub } = ensure(nuxt)

  if (s.app) pub.fireux = { ...(pub.fireux || {}), ...s.app }
  if (s.firebaseEcosystem)
    pub.firebaseEcosystem = {
      ...(pub.firebaseEcosystem || {}),
      ...s.firebaseEcosystem,
    }
  if (s.firebaseApp)
    pub.firebaseApp = { ...(pub.firebaseApp || {}), ...s.firebaseApp }
  if (s.private) runtime.fireux = { ...(runtime.fireux || {}), ...s.private }
}

export function setRuntimeApp(nuxt: NuxtConfig | any, c: Partial<RuntimeApp>) {
  setRuntime(nuxt, { app: c })
}

export function setRuntimeFirebaseEcosystem(
  nuxt: NuxtConfig | any,
  c: Partial<RuntimeFirebaseEcosystem>
) {
  setRuntime(nuxt, { firebaseEcosystem: c })
}

export function setRuntimeFirebaseApp(
  nuxt: NuxtConfig | any,
  c: Partial<RuntimeFirebaseApp>
) {
  setRuntime(nuxt, { firebaseApp: c })
}

export function setRuntimePrivate(
  nuxt: NuxtConfig | any,
  c: Partial<RuntimePrivate>
) {
  setRuntime(nuxt, { private: c })
}

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/config/app/vite.ts

```ts
// packages/core/fireux-core/src/config/vite.ts
import { existsSync } from 'node:fs'
import { dirname, resolve } from 'node:path'
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
import type { NuxtConfig } from 'nuxt/schema'

export function configViteWorkspace(nuxt: NuxtConfig) {
  const currentDir = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))

  let cursor = currentDir
  let workspaceRoot = currentDir

  for (let i = 0; i < 10; i += 1) {
    if (
      existsSync(resolve(cursor, 'pnpm-workspace.yaml')) ||
      existsSync(resolve(cursor, '.git'))
    ) {
      workspaceRoot = cursor
      break
    }
    const parent = resolve(cursor, '..')
    if (parent === cursor) break
    cursor = parent
  }

  // NuxtConfig typing doesn't fully narrow nested Vite config objects,
  // so we write via a local mutable "any" view to avoid TS18048 noise.
  const n = nuxt as NuxtConfig & { vite?: any }

  n.vite = n.vite || {}
  n.vite.server = n.vite.server || {}
  n.vite.server.fs = n.vite.server.fs || {}
  n.vite.server.fs.allow = n.vite.server.fs.allow || []

  if (!n.vite.server.fs.allow.includes(workspaceRoot)) {
    n.vite.server.fs.allow.push(workspaceRoot)
  }
}

```mjs
import { addComponent, addComponentsDir, addImportsDir } from '@nuxt/kit'
import { existsSync, readdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join, relative } from 'node:path'

export function registerComponentsDir(resolver, relativePath, options = {}) {
  const dir = resolver.resolve(relativePath)
  if (!existsSync(dir)) return null

  const config = {
    path: dir,
    pattern: options.pattern ?? '**/*.vue',
    global: options.global ?? false,
    pathPrefix: options.pathPrefix ?? true,
  }

  if (options.prefix) config.prefix = options.prefix
  if (typeof options.priority === 'number') config.priority = options.priority

  addComponentsDir(config)
  return dir
}

export function registerLayoutsDir(resolver) {
  return registerComponentsDir(resolver, './runtime/layouts', {
    pattern: '**/*.vue',
    global: false,
    pathPrefix: true,
  })
}

export function registerComposablesDir(resolver) {
  const dir = resolver.resolve('./runtime/composables')
  if (!existsSync(dir)) return null
  addImportsDir(dir)
  return dir
}

function toPascalCase(value) {
  return value
    .split(/[\/]/g)
    .map((segment) =>
      segment
        .split(/[-_]/g)
        .map((part) => (part ? part[0].toUpperCase() + part.slice(1) : ''))
        .join('')
    )
    .join('')
}

function walkVueFiles(dir, acc = []) {
  for (const entry of readdirSync(dir)) {
    const fullPath = join(dir, entry)
    const stat = statSync(fullPath)
    if (stat.isDirectory()) {
      walkVueFiles(fullPath, acc)
    } else if (fullPath.endsWith('.vue')) {
      acc.push(fullPath)
    }
  }
  return acc
}

export function registerComponentAliases(
  resolver,
  relativePath,
  prefix,
  options = {}
) {
  if (!prefix) return null

  const dir = resolver.resolve(relativePath)
  if (!existsSync(dir)) return null

  const files = walkVueFiles(dir)
  for (const filePath of files) {
    const rel = relative(dir, filePath).replace(/\.vue$/i, '')
    const name = `${prefix}${toPascalCase(rel)}`
    addComponent({ name, filePath, global: options.global ?? true })
  }

  return dir
}

import {
  addComponent,
  addComponentsDir,
  addImportsDir,
  type Resolver,
} from '@nuxt/kit'
import { existsSync, readdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join, relative } from 'node:path'

type ComponentsDirOptions = {
  pattern?: string
  global?: boolean
  pathPrefix?: boolean
  prefix?: string
  priority?: number
}

export function registerComponentsDir(
  resolver: Resolver,
  relativePath: string,
  options: ComponentsDirOptions = {}
) {
  const dir = resolver.resolve(relativePath)
  if (!existsSync(dir)) return null

  const config: Parameters<typeof addComponentsDir>[0] = {
    path: dir,
    pattern: options.pattern ?? '**/*.vue',
    global: options.global ?? false,
    pathPrefix: options.pathPrefix ?? true,
  }

  if (options.prefix) config.prefix = options.prefix
  if (typeof options.priority === 'number') config.priority = options.priority

  addComponentsDir(config)
  return dir
}

export function registerLayoutsDir(resolver: Resolver) {
  return registerComponentsDir(resolver, './runtime/layouts', {
    pattern: '**/*.vue',
    global: false,
    pathPrefix: true,
  })
}

export function registerComposablesDir(resolver: Resolver) {
  const dir = resolver.resolve('./runtime/composables')
  if (!existsSync(dir)) return null
  addImportsDir(dir)
  return dir
}

function toPascalCase(value: string) {
  return value
    .split(/[\/]/g)
    .map((segment) =>
      segment
        .split(/[-_]/g)
        .map((part) => (part ? part[0].toUpperCase() + part.slice(1) : ''))
        .join('')
    )
    .join('')
}

function walkVueFiles(dir: string, acc: string[] = []) {
  for (const entry of readdirSync(dir)) {
    const fullPath = join(dir, entry)
    const stat = statSync(fullPath)
    if (stat.isDirectory()) {
      walkVueFiles(fullPath, acc)
    } else if (fullPath.endsWith('.vue')) {
      acc.push(fullPath)
    }
  }
  return acc
}

export function registerComponentAliases(
  resolver: Resolver,
  relativePath: string,
  prefix: string,
  options: { global?: boolean } = {}
) {
  if (!prefix) return null

  const dir = resolver.resolve(relativePath)
  if (!existsSync(dir)) return null

  const files = walkVueFiles(dir)
  for (const filePath of files) {
    const rel = relative(dir, filePath).replace(/\.vue$/i, '')
    const name = `${prefix}${toPascalCase(rel)}`
    addComponent({ name, filePath, global: options.global ?? true })
  }

  return dir
}

export function configureRuntimeDefaults(
  nuxt,
  key,
  defaults = { enabled: true },
  options = {}
) {
  if (!key) return
  const rc = (nuxt.options.runtimeConfig ||= {})
  const pub = (rc.public ||= {})
  if (!pub.fireux) pub.fireux = {}
  const ns = pub.fireux

  if (options.merge) {
    const current = ns[key]
    if (current && typeof current === 'object' && !Array.isArray(current)) {
      ns[key] = { ...defaults, ...current }
      return
    }
  }

  ns[key] ||= { ...defaults }
}

type RuntimeConfigRoot = Record<string, any>

type RuntimeDefaultsOptions = {
  merge?: boolean
}

export function configureRuntimeDefaults(
  nuxt: any,
  key: string,
  defaults: Record<string, any> = { enabled: true },
  options: RuntimeDefaultsOptions = {}
) {
  if (!key) return
  const rc: RuntimeConfigRoot = (nuxt.options.runtimeConfig ||= {})
  const pub = (rc.public ||= {}) as RuntimeConfigRoot
  if (!pub.fireux) pub.fireux = {}
  const ns = pub.fireux as RuntimeConfigRoot

  if (options.merge) {
    const current = ns[key]
    if (current && typeof current === 'object' && !Array.isArray(current)) {
      ns[key] = { ...defaults, ...current }
      return
    }
  }

  ns[key] ||= { ...defaults }
}

  const rc = nuxt.options.runtimeConfig || (nuxt.options.runtimeConfig = {})

export function exposeRuntimeAlias(nuxt, aliasKey, runtimeDir) {
  if (!aliasKey || !runtimeDir) return

  nuxt.options.alias ||= {}
  nuxt.options.alias[aliasKey] = runtimeDir

  nuxt.hook('nitro:config', (nitroConfig) => {
    nitroConfig.alias ||= {}
    nitroConfig.alias[aliasKey] = runtimeDir
  })
}

export function ensureRuntimeLayerFromPath(nuxt, runtimeDir) {
  if (!runtimeDir) return null

  const currentLayers = nuxt.options.layers
  if (!currentLayers) {
    nuxt.options.layers = [runtimeDir]
  } else if (Array.isArray(currentLayers)) {
    if (!currentLayers.includes(runtimeDir)) currentLayers.push(runtimeDir)
  } else if (typeof currentLayers === 'string') {
    if (currentLayers !== runtimeDir) {
      nuxt.options.layers = [currentLayers, runtimeDir]
    }
  }

  const current = nuxt.options.extends
  if (!current) {
    nuxt.options.extends = []
  } else if (!Array.isArray(current)) {
    nuxt.options.extends = [current]
  }
  const ext = nuxt.options.extends

  const already = ext.some((entry) =>
    Array.isArray(entry) ? entry[0] === runtimeDir : entry === runtimeDir
  )

  if (!already) {
    ext.push([
      runtimeDir,
      {
        config: {
          rootDir: runtimeDir,
          srcDir: runtimeDir,
          dir: { pages: 'pages', layouts: 'layouts', middleware: 'middleware' },
        },
      },
    ])
  }

  const options = nuxt.options
  const internalLayers = (options._layers ||= [])
  const hasInternal = internalLayers.some((entry) => {
    if (typeof entry === 'string') return entry === runtimeDir
    return entry?.cwd === runtimeDir || entry?.src === runtimeDir
  })
  if (!hasInternal) {
    internalLayers.push({
      cwd: runtimeDir,
      src: runtimeDir,
      config: {
        rootDir: runtimeDir,
        srcDir: runtimeDir,
        dir: { pages: 'pages', layouts: 'layouts', middleware: 'middleware' },
      },
    })
  }

  return runtimeDir
}

export function ensureRuntimeLayer(resolver, nuxt) {
  const runtimeDir = resolver.resolve('./runtime')
  if (!runtimeDir) return null
  return ensureRuntimeLayerFromPath(nuxt, runtimeDir)
}

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/config/module/runtime-layer.ts

```ts
import type { Resolver } from '@nuxt/kit'
import type { Nuxt } from 'nuxt/schema'

type RuntimeConfigRoot = Record<string, any>
type PublicRuntimeConfig = Record<string, any>

// Nuxt 4 public "extends" entry type (string or [src, { config }])
type LayerEntry = string | [string, { config?: Record<string, any> }]

export function ensureRuntimeConfigBuckets(nuxt: Nuxt, key: string) {
  if (!key) return
  const rc = (nuxt.options.runtimeConfig as unknown as RuntimeConfigRoot) ||
    ((nuxt.options.runtimeConfig = {} as any) as RuntimeConfigRoot)

  rc[key] ||= {}

  const pub = ((rc.public ||= {}) as PublicRuntimeConfig)
  pub[key] ||= {}
}

export function exposeRuntimeAlias(
  nuxt: Nuxt,
  aliasKey: string,
  runtimeDir: string
) {
  if (!aliasKey || !runtimeDir) return

  nuxt.options.alias ||= {}
  nuxt.options.alias[aliasKey] = runtimeDir

  nuxt.hook('nitro:config', (nitroConfig: any) => {
    nitroConfig.alias ||= {}
    nitroConfig.alias[aliasKey] = runtimeDir
  })
}

export function ensureRuntimeLayerFromPath(nuxt: Nuxt, runtimeDir: string) {
  if (!runtimeDir) return null

  const currentLayers = (nuxt.options as any).layers
  if (!currentLayers) {
    ;(nuxt.options as any).layers = [runtimeDir]
  } else if (Array.isArray(currentLayers)) {
    if (!currentLayers.includes(runtimeDir)) currentLayers.push(runtimeDir)
  } else if (typeof currentLayers === 'string') {
    if (currentLayers !== runtimeDir) {
      ;(nuxt.options as any).layers = [currentLayers, runtimeDir]
    }
  }

  const current = nuxt.options.extends
  if (!current) {
    nuxt.options.extends = []
  } else if (!Array.isArray(current)) {
    nuxt.options.extends = [current]
  }
  const ext = nuxt.options.extends as LayerEntry[]

  const already = ext.some((entry) =>
    Array.isArray(entry) ? entry[0] === runtimeDir : entry === runtimeDir
  )

  if (!already) {
    ext.push([
      runtimeDir,
      {
        config: {
          rootDir: runtimeDir,
          srcDir: runtimeDir,
          dir: { pages: 'pages', layouts: 'layouts', middleware: 'middleware' },
        },
      },
    ])
  }

  const options = nuxt.options as Record<string, any>
  const internalLayers: Array<
    string | { cwd?: string; src?: string; config?: Record<string, any> }
  > = (options._layers ||= [])
  const hasInternal = internalLayers.some((entry) => {
    if (typeof entry === 'string') return entry === runtimeDir
    return entry?.cwd === runtimeDir || entry?.src === runtimeDir
  })
  if (!hasInternal) {
    internalLayers.push({
      cwd: runtimeDir,
      src: runtimeDir,
      config: {
        rootDir: runtimeDir,
        srcDir: runtimeDir,
        dir: { pages: 'pages', layouts: 'layouts', middleware: 'middleware' },
      },
    })
  }

  return runtimeDir
}

export function ensureRuntimeLayer(resolver: Resolver, nuxt: Nuxt) {
  const runtimeDir = resolver.resolve('./runtime')
  if (!runtimeDir) return null
  return ensureRuntimeLayerFromPath(nuxt, runtimeDir)
}

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/module.ts

```ts
// FILE: packages/core/fireux-core/src/module.ts
import { createResolver, defineNuxtModule } from '@nuxt/kit'
import { configurePlugins } from './config/module/plugins-config'
import { configurePages } from './config/module/pages-config'
import { configureLayouts } from './config/module/layouts-config'
import { configureComponents } from './config/module/components-config'
import { configureComposables } from './config/module/composables-config'
import { configureAssets } from './config/module/assets-config'
import { configureAliases } from './config/module/aliases-config'

export default defineNuxtModule({
  meta: {
    name: 'fireux-core',
    version: '0.1.0',
  },

  setup(_options, nuxt) {
    const resolver = createResolver(import.meta.url)

    // runtime alias
    nuxt.options.alias = nuxt.options.alias || {}
    nuxt.options.alias['fireux-core/runtime'] = resolver.resolve('./runtime')

    // ✅ inject runtime plugins into consuming apps
    configurePlugins(resolver)

    // ✅ expose fireux-core runtime as a Nuxt layer (pages/layouts/middleware)
    configurePages(resolver, nuxt as any)
    configureLayouts(resolver)
    configureComponents(resolver)
    configureComposables(resolver)
    configureAssets(resolver, nuxt as any)
    configureAliases(resolver, nuxt as any)
  },
})

    <ClientOnly>

        prevent-close

const router = useRouter()

  ? useApp()
  : ({
      isResolved: computed(() => false),
      isInitialized: computed(() => true),
    } as const)

const showOnboardingModal = computed(
  () => isResolved.value && !isInitialized.value
)

}

              {{ profileLabel }}
            </UBadge>

          />

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { useUser } from '../../../composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/useUser'

const { currentUser, card, isLoading } = useUser()

const profileComplete = computed<number | null>(() => {
  if (isLoading.value) return null

  const current = currentUser.value
  if (!current) return 0

  const checks = [
    Boolean((current.display_name ?? '').trim()),
    Boolean((current.handle ?? '').trim()),
    Boolean((current.bio ?? '').trim()),
    Boolean((current.avatar ?? '').trim()),
  ]

  const total = checks.length
  const done = checks.filter(Boolean).length
  return Math.round((done / total) * 100)
})

const pill = computed(() => {
  if (isLoading.value) return null
  const user = currentUser.value
  if (!user) return null
  return card(user)
})

const showProfileCompletedness = computed(() => {
  return profileComplete.value == null || profileComplete.value < 100
})

const profileLabel = computed(() => {
  if (profileComplete.value == null) return '—'
  return `${profileComplete.value}%`
})

const wrapperFor = (pill: { to?: string | null } | null) => (pill?.to ? 'NuxtLink' : 'div')
const wrapperPropsFor = (pill: { to?: string | null } | null) => (pill?.to ? { to: pill.to } : {})
</script>

```vue

          No apps yet.
        </p>

      <div class="flex">
        <UButton to="/apps" label="Browse apps" color="neutral" size="sm" />
      </div>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { useAvatarProxy } from '../../../composables/fireux/app/ui/useAvatarProxy'
import { useUser } from '../../../composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/useUser'
import { useFirestoreRead } from '../../../composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreRead'
import type { AppModel } from '../../../models/core/app.model'

const { user, pending } = useUser()
const { getProxiedAvatarUrl } = useAvatarProxy()
const { firestoreFetchCollection } = useFirestoreRead()
const appsRef = firestoreFetchCollection<AppModel>('apps')

type UserAppsValue = Record<string, unknown> | Array<unknown> | null

const userApps = computed<UserAppsValue>(() => {
  const anyUser = user.value as unknown as Record<string, unknown> | null
  const raw = anyUser?.['apps']

  if (!raw) return null
  if (Array.isArray(raw)) return raw
  if (typeof raw === 'object') return raw as Record<string, unknown>
  return null
})

const initials = (value: string) =>
  value
    .split(/\s+/g)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0]?.toUpperCase())
    .join('')

const appInitials = (app: AppModel) => {
  const label =
    (app.app_short_name ?? '').trim() ||
    (app.app_name ?? '').trim() ||
    (app.id ?? '').trim()
  return label ? initials(label) : ''
}

const userAppLogoUrl = (app: AppModel): string => {
  const appsValue = userApps.value
  if (!appsValue) return ''

  const appId = (app.id ?? '').toString().trim()
  if (!appId) return ''

  let entry: any = null
  if (Array.isArray(appsValue)) {
    entry = (appsValue as any[]).find((candidate) => {
      const id =
        candidate?.id ??
        candidate?.app_id ??
        candidate?.appId ??
        candidate?.appID ??
        ''
      return (id ?? '').toString().trim() === appId
    })
  } else {
    entry = (appsValue as Record<string, any>)[appId]
  }

  const rawUrl =
    (typeof entry?.media?.thumbnail_url === 'string' && entry.media.thumbnail_url) ||
    (typeof entry?.media?.logo_url === 'string' && entry.media.logo_url) ||
    (typeof entry?.media?.wordmark_light_url === 'string' && entry.media.wordmark_light_url) ||
    (typeof entry?.media?.wordmark_dark_url === 'string' && entry.media.wordmark_dark_url) ||
    (typeof (entry as any)?.thumbnail_url === 'string' && (entry as any).thumbnail_url) ||
    (typeof entry?.avatar_url === 'string' && entry.avatar_url) ||
    (typeof entry?.logo_url === 'string' && entry.logo_url) ||
    (typeof entry?.wordmark_light_url === 'string' && entry.wordmark_light_url) ||
    (typeof entry?.wordmark_dark_url === 'string' && entry.wordmark_dark_url) ||
    (typeof entry?.icon_url === 'string' && entry.icon_url) ||
    (typeof entry?.avatarUrl === 'string' && entry.avatarUrl) ||
    (typeof entry?.logoUrl === 'string' && entry.logoUrl) ||
    (typeof entry?.wordmarkLightUrl === 'string' && entry.wordmarkLightUrl) ||
    (typeof entry?.wordmarkDarkUrl === 'string' && entry.wordmarkDarkUrl) ||
    (typeof entry?.wordmarkUrl === 'string' && entry.wordmarkUrl) ||
    (typeof entry?.iconUrl === 'string' && entry.iconUrl) ||
    (typeof entry?.avatar === 'string' && entry.avatar) ||
    (typeof entry?.logo === 'string' && entry.logo) ||
    (typeof entry?.wordmark === 'string' && entry.wordmark) ||
    (typeof entry?.icon === 'string' && entry.icon) ||
    ''

  return rawUrl.trim()
}

const appIds = computed(() => {
  const ids: string[] = []

  const appsValue = userApps.value
  if (Array.isArray(appsValue)) {
    for (const entry of appsValue as any[]) {
      if (typeof entry === 'string') {
        const v = entry.trim()
        if (v) ids.push(v)
        continue
      }
      const v = (entry?.id ?? entry?.app_id ?? entry?.appId ?? '').toString().trim()
      if (v) ids.push(v)
    }
  } else if (appsValue && typeof appsValue === 'object') {
    ids.push(...Object.keys(appsValue).map((k) => k.trim()).filter(Boolean))
  }

  const anyUser = user.value as any
  ids.push(...(((anyUser?.userOf ?? []) as any[]) || []).map((v) => (v ?? '').toString().trim()))
  ids.push(...(((anyUser?.adminOf ?? []) as any[]) || []).map((v) => (v ?? '').toString().trim()))

  return Array.from(new Set(ids.filter(Boolean)))
})

const apps = computed<AppModel[]>(() => {
  if (!appIds.value.length) return []
  const idSet = new Set(appIds.value)
  return (appsRef.value ?? [])
    .filter((app): app is App => Boolean(app?.id) && idSet.has(app.id))
    .slice()
    .sort((a, b) => (a.app_name || '').localeCompare(b.app_name || ''))
})

const avatarSrc = (app: AppModel) => {
  const raw =
    userAppLogoUrl(app) ||
    (app as any)?.media?.thumbnail_url ||
    (app as any)?.media?.logo_url ||
    (app as any)?.media?.wordmark_light_url ||
    (app as any)?.media?.wordmark_dark_url ||
    (app as any).avatar_url ||
    (app as any).logo_url ||
    (app as any).wordmark_light_url ||
    (app as any).wordmark_dark_url ||
    ''
  return getProxiedAvatarUrl(raw)
}

const appsPending = computed(() => appsRef.value === undefined)
const isLoading = computed(
  () => Boolean(pending.value) || Boolean(appsPending.value) || user.value === undefined
)
</script>

  <UCard variant="subtle">
    <template #header>

        <span class="font-mono">app users</span>: {{ bindingAppUsersCount }} ·
        <span class="font-mono">admin_ids</span>: {{ bindingAdminIdsCount }}

<script setup lang="ts">
import { collection, doc, getDoc, getDocs } from 'firebase/firestore'
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue'
import { useFirestore } from 'vuefire'
import { useFireUXConfig } from '../../composables/fireux/app/FireUXConfig'
import type { AppModel } from '../../models/core/app.model'
import type { AppUser, User } from '../../models/core/user.model'

const props = withDefaults(

  { app: null, apps: null }
)

const { appId: configAppId, isTenant } = useFireUXConfig()

const bindingAdminIdsCount = ref(0)

const resolveAppList = () => {
  const appList = Array.isArray(props.apps) && props.apps.length

  if (!checkAll.value) {

  const targets = resolveAppList().filter((app): app is AppModel => Boolean(app?.id))
  if (!targets.length) return

  bindingPending.value = true

  const missingUserOf: string[] = []
  const missingAdminOf: string[] = []
  const adminMissingAppUser: string[] = []
  const adminRoleMismatch: string[] = []

  bindingAppUsersCount.value = 0
  bindingAdminIdsCount.value = 0

  const appUsersByApp = new Map<string, AppUser[]>()
  const userIds = new Set<string>()

  for (const app of targets) {
    const appId = app.id
    const adminIds = Array.isArray(app.admin_ids) ? app.admin_ids : []
    bindingAdminIdsCount.value += adminIds.length

    const snap = await getDocs(collection(db, 'apps', appId, 'users'))
    const users = snap.docs.map((docSnap) => ({
      id: docSnap.id,
      ...(docSnap.data() as AppUser),
    }))

    appUsersByApp.set(appId, users)
    bindingAppUsersCount.value += users.length
    users.forEach((u) => userIds.add(u.id))
  }

  const coreUsers = new Map<string, User | null>()
  await Promise.all(
    Array.from(userIds).map(async (id) => {
      try {
        const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'users', id) as any)
        coreUsers.set(id, snap.exists() ? (snap.data() as User) : null)
      } catch {
        coreUsers.set(id, null)
      }
    })
  )

  for (const app of targets) {
    const appId = app.id
    const appUsers = appUsersByApp.get(appId) ?? []
    const adminIds = Array.isArray(app.admin_ids) ? app.admin_ids : []

```vue
<template>
  <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs text-gray-600">
    <span class="font-medium">Drift:</span>

    <UButton
      size="xs"
      :variant="driftKind === 'missing' ? 'solid' : 'ghost'"
      color="primary"
      @click="$emit('update:drift-kind', 'missing')"
    >
      Missing
    </UButton>

    <UButton
      size="xs"
      :variant="driftKind === 'extra' ? 'solid' : 'ghost'"
      color="primary"
      @click="$emit('update:drift-kind', 'extra')"
    >
      Extra
    </UButton>

    <span class="font-medium ml-2">
      Filter {{ driftKind }}:
    </span>

    <UButton
      v-for="option in filterOptions"
      :key="option.value"
      size="xs"
      :variant="selectedField === option.value ? 'solid' : 'ghost'"
      color="primary"
      @click="$emit('update:selected-field', option.value)"
    >
      {{ option.label }}
    </UButton>

    <UButton
      size="xs"
      variant="outline"
      :disabled="copyDisabled || copying"
      :icon="copying ? 'i-heroicons-arrow-path' : (copyIcon || 'i-heroicons-clipboard-document-check')"
      @click="handleCopy"
    >
      {{ copying ? 'Copying…' : (copyLabel || 'Copy filtered drift') }}
    </UButton>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDevClipboard } from '../../composables/dev/useDevClipboard'
import { useDevDriftCopyMeta } from '../../composables/dev/useDevDriftCopyMeta'

defineOptions({ name: 'DriftToolbar' })

type DriftKind = 'missing' | 'extra'

interface FilterOption {
  label: string
  value: string
}

interface Props {
  driftKind: DriftKind
  selectedField: string
  filterOptions: FilterOption[]
  copyPayload?: unknown
  copyLabel?: string
  copyIcon?: string
  copyDisabled?: boolean
}

const props = defineProps<Props>()
const emit = defineEmits<{
  (event: 'update:drift-kind', value: DriftKind): void
  (event: 'update:selected-field', value: string): void
  (event: 'copy'): void
}>()

const { copyJSON, copying } = useDevClipboard()
const { migration } = useDevDriftCopyMeta()

const buildCopyPayload = () => {
  if (!props.copyPayload || typeof props.copyPayload !== 'object') return props.copyPayload
  const payload = props.copyPayload as Record<string, unknown>
  if (payload.migration) return payload
  return {
    ...payload,
    migration,
  }
}

const handleCopy = async () => {
  const payload = buildCopyPayload()
  if (payload !== undefined) {
    await copyJSON(payload, {
      label: props.copyLabel || 'Copy filtered drift',
    })
  }
  emit('copy')
}
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import { useDevClipboard } from '../../composables/dev/useDevClipboard'

defineOptions({ name: 'Json' })

interface JsonPanelProps {
  data: unknown
  title?: string
  defaultOpen?: boolean
  hideWhenEmpty?: boolean
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<JsonPanelProps>(), {
  title: 'JSON',
  defaultOpen: false,
  hideWhenEmpty: true,
})

const expanded = ref(props.defaultOpen)
const isEmpty = computed(() => {
  const value = props.data as any
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return true
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.length === 0
  if (typeof value === 'object') return Object.keys(value).length === 0
  if (typeof value === 'string') return value.length === 0
  return false
})

const shouldRender = computed(() => !props.hideWhenEmpty || !isEmpty.value)
const jsonString = computed(() => {
  try {
    return JSON.stringify(props.data, null, 2)
  } catch {
    return '[Json] Unable to stringify data'
  }
})

const lastCopyResult = ref<'idle' | 'copied' | 'failed'>('idle')
const copyLabel = computed(() => {
  if (copying.value) return 'Copying…'
  if (lastCopyResult.value === 'copied') return 'Copied'
  if (lastCopyResult.value === 'failed') return 'Copy failed'
  return 'Copy JSON'
})

const { copyJSON, copying } = useDevClipboard()

const onCopy = async () => {
  const ok = await copyJSON(props.data, {
    label: props.title,
  })

  lastCopyResult.value = ok ? 'copied' : 'failed'
  window.setTimeout(() => {
    lastCopyResult.value = 'idle'
  }, 1200)
}
</script>

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/components/dev/Model.vue

```vue
<template>
  <UCard>
    <template #header>
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div>{{ title }}</div>
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
          <UButton
            size="xs"
            :disabled="copying"
            :icon="copying ? 'i-heroicons-arrow-path' : 'i-lucide-braces'"
            @click="copyShape"
          >
            {{ copying ? 'Copying…' : 'Copy shape' }}
          </UButton>
        </div>
      </div>
    </template>

    <UTree :nested="true" color="primary" :items="items" />
  </UCard>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, provide, ref } from 'vue'
import { useDevClipboard } from '../../composables/dev/useDevClipboard'

defineOptions({ name: 'Model' })

type ShapeNode = {
  key: string
  type: string
  children?: ShapeNode[]
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    model: Record<string, unknown>
    title?: string
  }>(),
  {
    title: 'Model shape',
  }
)

const isPlainObject = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> => {
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return false
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return false
  return Object.prototype.toString.call(value) === '[object Object]'
}

const toType = (key: string, value: unknown): string => {
  if (isPlainObject(value) && Object.keys(value).length === 0 && /(^|_)at$|_at$|^created_at$|^updated_at$/i.test(key)) {
    return 'FirebaseTimestamp'
  }
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return 'array'
  if (value === null) return 'null'
  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    return value.startsWith('enum:') ? value : 'string'
  }
  if (typeof value === 'number') return 'number'
  if (typeof value === 'boolean') return 'boolean'
  if (isPlainObject(value)) return 'object'
  return typeof value
}

const buildNodes = (model: Record<string, unknown>): ShapeNode[] =>
  Object.keys(model).map((key) => {
    const value = model[key]
    const type = toType(key, value)
    const children = isPlainObject(value) && Object.keys(value).length
      ? buildNodes(value)
      : undefined
    return { key, type, children }
  })

const nodes = computed(() => buildNodes(props.model))

const toTreeItems = (list: ShapeNode[], prefix = ''): any[] =>
  list.map((node) => {
    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${node.key}` : node.key
    const hasChildren = Boolean(node.children?.length)
    return {
      id: path,
      label: `${node.key}: ${typeLabel(node.type)}`,
      icon: hasChildren ? 'i-lucide-braces' : undefined,
      children: hasChildren ? toTreeItems(node.children ?? [], path) : undefined,
    }
  })

const items = computed(() => toTreeItems(nodes.value))

const expandAllSignal = ref(0)
const expandAllFlag = ref(true)

provide('devModel_expandAllFlag', expandAllFlag)
provide('devModel_expandAllSignal', expandAllSignal)

const { copyJSON, copying } = useDevClipboard()

const copyShape = async () => {
  const payload = items.value
  await copyJSON(payload, { label: `${props.title} (tree)` })
}

const typeLabel = (value: string) =>
  value.startsWith('enum:')
    ? `enum (${value.slice('enum:'.length).split('|').join(' | ')})`
    : value === 'FirebaseTimestamp'
    ? 'FirebaseTimestamp'
    : value

</script>

<style scoped>
</style>

```vue
<template>
  <div class="landing-effect">
    <div
      v-for="n in particleCount"
      :key="n"
      class="effect-particle"
      :class="effectClass"
    >
      <!-- For code particles, add content -->
      <span v-if="effectType === 'code'" class="code-symbol">{{
        getRandomSymbol()
      }}</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onMounted } from 'vue'

// Use runtimeConfig so this works in server-render without importing #build/app.config
const runtimeConfig = useRuntimeConfig()

// Map effect type based on primary color
const effectType = computed(() => {
  const primaryColor =
    runtimeConfig.public?.primaryColor /* from fireux createFireuxConfig */ ||
    'yellow'
  switch (primaryColor) {
    case 'green':
      return 'bubbles'
    case 'blue':
      return 'steam'
    case 'yellow':
      return 'code'
    default:
      return 'stars'
  }
})

// Particle count based on effect type
const particleCount = computed(() => {
  switch (effectType.value) {
    case 'bubbles':
      return 20
    case 'steam':
      return 15
    case 'code':
      return 25
    default:
      return 50
  }
})

// Class based on effect type
const effectClass = computed(() => {
  switch (effectType.value) {
    case 'bubbles':
      return 'bubble-particle'
    case 'steam':
      return 'steam-particle'
    case 'code':
      return 'code-particle'
    default:
      return 'star-particle'
  }
})

// Code symbols for FireUX
const codeSymbols = [
  '<',
  '>',
  '{',
  '}',
  '(',
  ')',
  '[',
  ']',
  '=',
  '+',
  '-',
  '*',
  '/',
  ';',
  ':',
  '.',
  ',',
  '!',
  '?',
  '#',
  '$',
  '%',
  '&',
]
const getRandomSymbol = () =>
  codeSymbols[Math.floor(Math.random() * codeSymbols.length)]

onMounted(() => {
  // Effects are purely cosmetic; no extra runtime hooks required.
})
</script>
