```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from '#imports'
import { formatTimeAgo } from '@vueuse/core'
import { collection, orderBy, query } from 'firebase/firestore'
import { useCollection, useFirestore } from 'vuefire'
import { useAuth } from '../../../composables/fireux/firebase/useAuth'
import type { UserNotification } from '../../../models/core/user.model'

// Use v-model:open from parent instead of a global console store
const open = defineModel<boolean>('open', { default: false })

const db = useFirestore()
const { uid } = useAuth()

const notificationsQuery = computed(() => {
  if (!uid.value) return null
  const ref = collection(db, 'users', uid.value, 'notifications')
  return query(ref, orderBy('created_at', 'desc'))
})

const { data: notifications } = useCollection<UserNotification>(
  notificationsQuery as any
)
</script>

<template>
  <USlideover v-model:open="open" title="Notifications">
    <template #body>
      <div
        v-for="notification in notifications"
        :key="`${notification.created_at}:${notification.scope}:${notification.message}`"
        class="px-3 py-2.5 rounded-md hover:bg-elevated/50 flex items-center gap-3 relative -mx-3 first:-mt-3 last:-mb-3"
      >
        <UChip color="error" :show="!notification.read" inset />

        <div class="text-sm flex-1">
          <p class="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span class="text-highlighted font-medium">
              {{ notification.scope === 'app' ? 'App' : 'Ecosystem' }}
            </span>

            <time
              :datetime="notification.created_at"
              class="text-muted text-xs"
              v-text="formatTimeAgo(new Date(notification.created_at))"
            />
          </p>

          <p class="text-dimmed">
            {{ notification.message }}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </template>
  </USlideover>
</template>
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/components/layouts/console/ProfilesMenu.vue

```vue
<!-- packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/components/layouts/console/ProfilesMenu.vue -->
<template>
  <UDropdownMenu
    v-if="menu.length"
    :items="dropdownItems"
    :content="{ align: 'center', collisionPadding: 12 }"
    :ui="{
      content: collapsed ? 'w-40' : 'w-(--reka-dropdown-menu-trigger-width)',
    }"
  >
    <UButton
      :label="collapsed ? undefined : selected?.label || 'Profiles'"
      :icon="selected?.icon || 'i-lucide-users'"
      :trailing-icon="collapsed ? undefined : 'i-lucide-chevrons-up-down'"
      color="neutral"
      variant="ghost"
      block
      :square="collapsed"
      class="data-[state=open]:bg-elevated"
      :class="[!collapsed && 'py-2']"
      :ui="{ trailingIcon: 'text-dimmed' }"
      :disabled="!menu.length"
    />
  </UDropdownMenu>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed, watch } from 'vue'
import { useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { useState } from '#imports'
import type { DropdownMenuItem } from '@nuxt/ui'
import { useConsoleNav } from '../../../composables/fireux/app/routing/presets'
import { useUser } from '../../../composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/useUser'

defineOptions({ name: 'LayoutsConsoleProfilesMenu' })
defineProps<{ collapsed?: boolean }>()

const { desktop } = useConsoleNav()
const { user } = useUser()
const router = useRouter()
const activeProfileState = useState<string | null>(
  'fireux-console-profile',
  () => null
)

const profiles = computed(() =>
  desktop.value.filter((i) => i.group === 'profiles')
)

const menu = computed(() => {
  const active = user.value?.profiles ?? []
  return profiles.value.filter(
    (i) => !i.profileId || active.includes(i.profileId)
  )
})

type MenuItem = { label: string; icon?: string; to: string; profileId?: string }
const selected = ref<MenuItem | null>(null)

const syncWithProfileState = () => {
  if (!menu.value.length) {
    selected.value = null
    if (activeProfileState.value !== null) {
      activeProfileState.value = null
    }
    return
  }

  if (activeProfileState.value) {
    const match = menu.value.find(
      (item) => item.profileId === activeProfileState.value
    )
    if (match) {
      selected.value = match
      return
    }
  }

  const fallback = menu.value[0]
  selected.value = fallback
  if (fallback?.profileId && activeProfileState.value !== fallback.profileId) {
    activeProfileState.value = fallback.profileId
  }
}

watch([menu, activeProfileState], syncWithProfileState, { immediate: true })

const dropdownItems = computed<DropdownMenuItem[][]>(() => [
  menu.value.map((p) => ({
    label: p.label,
    icon: p.icon,
    onSelect: () => {
      selected.value = p
      activeProfileState.value = p.profileId ?? null
      router.push(p.to)
    },
  })),
])
</script>
```

```vue
<template>
  <div class="flex flex-col gap-2 w-full">
    <UNavigationMenu
      :collapsed="collapsed"
      :items="actionItems"
      orientation="vertical"
    />

    <NuxtLink
      v-if="compactProfile && collapsed && pillUser"
      to="/console/user-profile"
      class="w-full flex justify-center"
      aria-label="View profile"
    >
      <UAvatar
          :src="pillUser.avatarUrl || undefined"
          :alt="pillUser.displayName || 'User'"
        :text="avatarFallback"
        size="sm"
      />
    </NuxtLink>

    <component
      :is="wrapperFor(pillUser)"
      v-else-if="pillUser"
      v-bind="wrapperPropsFor(pillUser)"
      class="w-full"
    >
      <OrganismsUserCardsPill v-bind="pillUser" class="w-full" />
    </component>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import { useFireUXConfig } from '../../../composables/fireux/app/FireUXConfig'
import { useAuth } from '../../../composables/fireux/firebase/useAuth'
import { useUser } from '../../../composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/useUser'
import type { UserCard } from '../../../composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/utils/view/useUserInterface'

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    collapsed: boolean
    compactProfile?: boolean
  }>(),
  {
    compactProfile: false,
  }
)

const fireux = useFireUXConfig()
const { isAuthenticated, signOutUser } = useAuth()
const { currentUser, card, isLoading } = useUser()

const signOutLoading = ref(false)

const pillUser = computed((): UserCard.Card | undefined => {
  if (isLoading.value) return undefined
  const user = currentUser.value
  if (!user) return undefined
  return card(user)
})

const avatarFallback = computed(() => {
  const displayName = pillUser.value?.displayName ?? ''
  const trimmed = typeof displayName === 'string' ? displayName.trim() : ''
  if (!trimmed) return 'U'
  return trimmed
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0]?.toUpperCase())
    .join('')
})

const handleSignOut = async () => {
  if (signOutLoading.value) return
  signOutLoading.value = true
  try {
    await signOutUser()
  } finally {
    signOutLoading.value = false
  }
}

const actionItems = computed(() => {
  const items: any[] = [
    {
      // TODO: replace with final deploy target (domain) when available from config/runtime.
      label: fireux.appName.toLowerCase(),
      icon: 'i-lucide-house',
      to: '/',
    },
  ]

  if (isAuthenticated.value) {
    items.push({
      label: 'Sign out',
      icon: 'i-lucide-log-out',
      disabled: signOutLoading.value,
      onSelect: handleSignOut,
    })
  }

  return items
})

const compactProfile = computed(() => props.compactProfile)

const wrapperFor = (item: UserCard.Card | undefined) => (item?.to ? 'NuxtLink' : 'div')
const wrapperPropsFor = (item: UserCard.Card | undefined) => (item?.to ? { to: item.to } : {})
</script>
```

```vue
<template>
  <section
    v-if="shouldRender"
    class="footer-admins"
    aria-labelledby="footer-admins-title"
  >
    <div class="footer-admins__header">
      <p id="footer-admins-title" class="footer-admins__label">Admin team</p>
      <p v-if="appName || app?.app_name" class="footer-admins__context">
        Managing {{ appName || app?.app_name }}
      </p>
    </div>

    <div v-if="isLoading" class="footer-admins__loading">
      <USkeleton v-for="n in 2" :key="n" class="footer-admins__skeleton" />
    </div>

    <div v-else-if="adminCards.length" class="footer-admins__grid">
      <component
        :is="wrapperFor(admin.card)"
        v-for="admin in adminCards"
        :key="admin.key"
        v-bind="wrapperPropsFor(admin.card)"
        class="block"
      >
        <OrganismsUserCardsPill v-bind="admin.card" />
      </component>
    </div>

    <p v-else class="footer-admins__empty">No admins assigned yet.</p>
  </section>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { useFireUXConfig } from '../../../composables/fireux/app/FireUXConfig'
import { useAppUsers } from '../../../composables/fireux/firestore/core/app/fetch/useAppUsers'
import { useApp } from '../../../composables/fireux/firestore/core/app/useApp'
import { useUserCollection } from '../../../composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/fetch/useUserCollection'
import type { UserCard } from '../../../composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/utils/view/useUserInterface'
import { useUserInterface } from '../../../composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/utils/view/useUserInterface'

const { app } = useApp()
const { users, pending } = useAppUsers()
const { fulfilled } = useUserCollection()
const { card } = useUserInterface()
const { appName } = useFireUXConfig()

const adminMemberships = computed(() =>
  (users.value ?? []).filter(
    (record) =>
      typeof record?.role === 'string' &&
      record.role.trim().toLowerCase() === 'admin'
  )
)

const adminEntries = computed(() =>
  (fulfilled?.value ?? []).filter(
    (entry) => entry.appUser?.role?.trim().toLowerCase() === 'admin'
  )
)

const adminCards = computed(() =>
  adminEntries.value.map((record, index) => {
    const payload = card(record as any)
    const displayName = payload.displayName
    const enriched: UserCard.Card = {
      ...payload,
      displayName,
      badges: ['Admin'],
    }

    return { key: record.id || `${index}`, card: enriched }
  })
)

const isLoading = computed(
  () => Boolean(pending.value) && Boolean(adminMemberships.value.length)
)

const shouldRender = computed(
  () => isLoading.value || Boolean(adminCards.value.length)
)

const wrapperFor = (card: UserCard.Card) => (card.to ? 'NuxtLink' : 'div')
const wrapperPropsFor = (card: UserCard.Card) => (card.to ? { to: card.to } : {})
</script>
```

```vue
const { desktop, mobile } = useDefaultNav()

const desktopItems = computed(() =>
  Array.isArray(desktop.value) ? desktop.value.filter(Boolean) : []
)
const mobileItems = computed(() =>
  Array.isArray(mobile.value) ? mobile.value.filter(Boolean) : []
)

const navDisabled = ref(false)

onErrorCaptured((error: unknown) => {
  if (!import.meta.dev) return false
  const msg = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
  navDisabled.value = true
  console.warn('[fireux] Header render failed; disabling nav:', msg)
  return false
})

/** Auth (degrade gracefully: default to signed out) */
const auth = import.meta.client ? useAuth() : null

const isAuthenticated = computed(() => auth?.isAuthenticated?.value ?? false)

const signOut = async () => {
  if (!auth?.signOutUser) return
  await auth.signOutUser()
}

const { getProxiedAvatarUrl } = useAvatarProxy()

// `LayoutsDefaultHeader` runs on server too (even though template is wrapped in <ClientOnly>).
// Guard user access to client only to avoid pulling Firebase on SSR.
const userApi = import.meta.client ? useUser() : null
const userRef = userApi?.user ?? computed(() => null)

const avatarSrc = computed(() => {
  const raw = userRef.value?.avatar
  const normalized = typeof raw === 'string' ? raw.trim() : ''
  const proxied = getProxiedAvatarUrl(normalized || undefined)
  return proxied || undefined
})

const initials = computed(() => {
  const displayName = (userRef.value?.display_name ?? '').trim()
  const handle = (userRef.value?.handle ?? '').trim()
  const base = displayName || handle
  if (!base) return 'A'

  const parts = base.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean)
  if (parts.length >= 2) {
    return `${parts[0][0] ?? ''}${parts[1][0] ?? ''}`.toUpperCase() || 'A'
  }

  return base.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase() || 'A'
})

const accountMenuItems = computed(() => [
  [
    {
      label: 'Account',
      icon: 'i-lucide-user',
      to: '/users',
    },
  ],
  [{ label: 'Console', icon: 'i-lucide-terminal', to: '/console' }],
  [
    {
      label: 'Sign out',
      icon: 'i-lucide-log-out',
      onSelect: async () => await signOut(),
    },
  ],
])
</script>
```

```vue
<template>
  <UCard :class="cardClass">
    <div v-if="isBanner" class="fx-state-banner" :class="bannerClass">
      <p class="fx-state-banner__title">
        <slot name="title">{{ resolvedTitle }}</slot>
      </p>
      <p v-if="showBannerDescription" class="fx-state-banner__description">
        <slot name="description">
          {{ bannerDescription }}
        </slot>
      </p>
      <slot v-if="hasDefaultSlot" />
    </div>

    <div v-else class="fx-state-card__content">
      <UIcon
        v-if="showSpinner"
        name="i-lucide-loader-2"
        class="fx-state-card__spinner"
      />
      <UIcon v-else-if="icon" :name="icon" class="fx-state-card__icon" />
      <p class="fx-state-card__title">
        <slot name="title">{{ resolvedTitle }}</slot>
      </p>
      <p v-if="showDescription" class="fx-state-card__description">
        <slot name="description">
          {{ showSpinner ? loadingDescription : resolvedDescription }}
        </slot>
      </p>
      <slot />
    </div>
  </UCard>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useSlots } from 'vue'

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    entity?: string
    kind?: 'document' | 'collection'
    title?: string
    description?: string
    icon?: string | null
    loading?: boolean
    layout?: 'card' | 'banner'
    uppercase?: boolean
  }>(),
  {
    kind: 'collection',
    icon: 'i-lucide-search-x',
    title: '',
    description: '',
    loading: false,
    layout: 'card',
  }
)

const slots = useSlots()

const capitalize = (value: string) =>
  value.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + value.slice(1)

const isBanner = computed(() => props.layout === 'banner')
const showSpinner = computed(() => props.loading)
const hasDescriptionSlot = computed(() => Boolean(slots.description))
const hasDefaultSlot = computed(() => Boolean(slots.default))

const defaultEntity = computed(() => props.entity?.trim().toLowerCase() ?? '')

const loadingTitle = computed(() => {
  const target = defaultEntity.value
  if (!target) return 'Loading…'
  return `Loading ${target}`
})

const resolvedTitle = computed(() => {
  if (showSpinner.value && !props.title) return loadingTitle.value
  if (props.title) return props.title
  const name = props.entity?.trim()
  if (!name)
    return props.kind === 'document' ? 'Item not found' : 'Nothing here yet'
  const pretty = capitalize(name)
  return props.kind === 'document'
    ? `${pretty} not found`
    : `No ${name.toLowerCase()} yet`
})

const resolvedDescription = computed(() => {
  if (props.description) return props.description
  return props.kind === 'document'
    ? 'We could not load the requested record.'
    : 'Once records are added, they will display here.'
})

const loadingDescription = computed(() =>
  props.kind === 'document'
    ? 'Hang tight while we look that up.'
    : 'Fetching the latest entries…'
)

const showDescription = computed(
  () =>
    (resolvedDescription.value && !showSpinner.value) ||
    hasDescriptionSlot.value ||
    showSpinner.value
)

const bannerDescription = computed(() =>
  showSpinner.value ? loadingDescription.value : resolvedDescription.value
)

const showBannerDescription = computed(
  () => Boolean(bannerDescription.value) || hasDescriptionSlot.value
)

const shouldUppercase = computed(() => props.uppercase ?? isBanner.value)

const cardClass = computed(() =>
  isBanner.value
    ? 'fx-state-card fx-state-card--banner'
    : 'fx-state-card fx-state-card--standard'
)

const bannerClass = computed(() => ({
  'fx-state-banner--loading': showSpinner.value,
  'fx-state-banner--uppercase': shouldUppercase.value,
}))
</script>

<style scoped>

  width: 100%;
}

  padding: 3rem 0;
  text-align: center;
}

.fx-state-card__content {

}

}

.fx-state-card__icon {

}

.fx-state-card__title {
  font-size: 0.95rem;

  color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.85);
}

.fx-state-card__description {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.9);
}

.fx-state-banner {
  padding: 1.5rem;

}
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/components/molecules/forms/ArrayOfStrings.vue

```vue
<template>
  <div class="form-field">
    <!-- Top Controls -->
    <MoleculesFormsTop
      :label="label"
      :is-editing="isEditing"
      :has-data="hasData"
      :error-message="errorMessage"
      @start-editing="startEditing"
      @check="checkButtonClicked"
      @cancel="cancelEditing"
      @delete="deleteButtonClicked"
    />

    <!-- Display Mode -->
    <div v-if="!isEditing" class="display">
      <span>{{ formattedValue }}</span>
    </div>

    <!-- Edit Mode -->
    <div v-else class="editing">
      <div v-for="(_, index) in localValue" :key="index" class="input-group">
        <UInput
          v-model="localValue[index]"
          :placeholder="itemPlaceholder"
          class="w-full"
        />
        <UIcon
          name="i-lucide-x-circle"
          class="cursor-pointer"
          @click="removeItem(index)"
        />
      </div>
      <div class="input-group add-group">
        <UInput
          v-model="newItem"
          :placeholder="newItemPlaceholder"
          class="w-full"
          @keyup.enter="addItem"
        />
        <UIcon
          name="i-lucide-plus-circle"
          class="cursor-pointer"
          @click="addItem"
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed, watch } from 'vue'
import type { PropType } from 'vue'

const props = defineProps({
  label: { type: String as PropType<string>, required: true },
  modelValue: { type: Array as PropType<string[]>, default: () => [] },
  itemPlaceholder: { type: String as PropType<string>, default: 'Item' },
  newItemPlaceholder: {
    type: String as PropType<string>,
    default: 'Add new item',
  },
})

const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'update:modelValue', value: string[]): void }>()

const isEditing = ref(false)
const localValue = ref<string[]>([...props.modelValue])
const newItem = ref('')
const errorMessage = ref('')

const hasData = computed(() => localValue.value.length > 0)
const formattedValue = computed(() => localValue.value.join(' | '))

watch(
  () => props.modelValue,
  (v: string[]) => {
    localValue.value = [...v]
  },
  { immediate: true }
)

function startEditing() {
  errorMessage.value = ''
  localValue.value = [...props.modelValue]
  isEditing.value = true
}

function cancelEditing() {
  localValue.value = [...props.modelValue]
  isEditing.value = false
}

function checkButtonClicked() {
  emit('update:modelValue', [...localValue.value])
  console.log('[ArrayOfStrings] Updated:', localValue.value)
  isEditing.value = false
}

function deleteButtonClicked() {
  localValue.value = []
  emit('update:modelValue', [])
  console.log('[ArrayOfStrings] Cleared')
  isEditing.value = false
}

function addItem() {
  const trimmed = newItem.value.trim()
  if (!trimmed) {
    errorMessage.value = 'Item cannot be empty.'
    return
  }
  if (!localValue.value.includes(trimmed)) {
    localValue.value.push(trimmed)
  }
  newItem.value = ''
}

function removeItem(index: number | string) {
  localValue.value.splice(Number(index), 1)
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.input-group {
  margin-bottom: var(--space-1);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-1);
}

.add-group {
  margin-top: var(--space-1);
}
</style>

```

```vue
<template>
  <div class="form-field">
    <!-- Top Controls (shared component for editing actions) -->
    <MoleculesFormsTop
      :label="label"
      :is-editing="isEditing"
      :has-data="hasData"
      :error-message="errorMessage"
      @start-editing="startEditing"
      @check="checkButtonClicked"
      @cancel="cancelEditing"
      @delete="deleteButtonClicked"
    />

    <!-- Display Mode: show joined items -->
    <div v-if="!isEditing" class="display">
      <span>{{ formattedValue }}</span>
    </div>

    <!-- Edit Mode: list each item with an input and a remove icon; plus an extra input to add a new item -->
    <div v-else class="editing">
      <div v-for="(item, index) in localValue" :key="index" class="input-group">
        <UInput
          v-model="localValue[index]"
          :placeholder="itemPlaceholder"
          class="w-full"
        />
        <UIcon
          name="i-lucide-x-circle"
          class="cursor-pointer"
          @click="removeItem(index)"
        />
      </div>
      <div class="input-group add-group">
        <UInput
          v-model="newItem"
          :placeholder="newItemPlaceholder"
          class="w-full"
        />
        <UIcon
          name="i-lucide-plus-circle"
          class="cursor-pointer"
          @click="addItem"
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed, watch } from 'vue'
import type { PropType } from 'vue'

const props = defineProps({
  label: { type: String, default: '' },
  firebaseValue: { type: Array as PropType<string[]>, default: () => [] },
  itemPlaceholder: { type: String, default: 'Item' },
  newItemPlaceholder: { type: String, default: 'Add new item' },
  updateFunction: { type: Function, default: () => {} },
})

const isEditing = ref(false)
const localValue = ref<string[]>([...props.firebaseValue])
const newItem = ref('')
const errorMessage = ref('')

const hasData = computed(() => localValue.value.length > 0)
const formattedValue = computed(() => localValue.value.join(' | '))

watch(
  () => props.firebaseValue,
  (newVal: string[]) => {
    localValue.value = [...newVal]
  },
  { immediate: true }
)

function startEditing() {
  errorMessage.value = ''
  localValue.value = [...props.firebaseValue]
  isEditing.value = true
}

function cancelEditing() {
  localValue.value = [...props.firebaseValue]
  isEditing.value = false
}

async function checkButtonClicked() {
  try {
    await props.updateFunction([...localValue.value])
    console.log('[ArrayOfStrings] Updated:', localValue.value)
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[ArrayOfStrings] Update error:', error)
    errorMessage.value = 'Failed to update field.'
  } finally {
    isEditing.value = false
  }
}

function addItem() {
  const trimmed = newItem.value.trim()
  if (!trimmed) {
    errorMessage.value = 'Item cannot be empty.'
    return
  }
  localValue.value.push(trimmed)
  newItem.value = ''
}

function removeItem(index: number | string) {
  localValue.value.splice(Number(index), 1)
}

async function deleteButtonClicked() {
  localValue.value = []
  try {
    await props.updateFunction([])
    console.log('[ArrayOfStrings] Cleared:', localValue.value)
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[ArrayOfStrings] Delete error:', error)
    errorMessage.value = 'Failed to clear field.'
  } finally {
    isEditing.value = false
  }
}
</script>

<style lang="scss">
.input-group {
  margin-bottom: var(--space-1);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-1);
}

.add-group {
  margin-top: var(--space-1);
}
</style>
```

```vue
<template>
  <div class="form-field">
    <!-- Use the existing Top component with proper namespace -->
    <MoleculesFormsTop
      :label="label"
      :is-editing="isEditing"
      :has-data="firebaseValue !== null && firebaseValue !== undefined"
      :error-message="errorMessage"
      :disabled="disabled"
      :disabled-message="disabledMessage"
      @start-editing="startEditing"
      @check="saveChanges"
      @cancel="cancelEditing"
      @delete="deleteValue"
    />

    <!-- Display mode -->
    <div v-if="!isEditing" class="display">
      <span class="text-gray-700">{{ displayValue }}</span>
    </div>

    <!-- Edit mode -->
    <div v-else class="editing">
      <div class="flex items-center space-x-2">
        <UCheckbox
          v-model="localValue"
          :label="checkboxLabel"
          class="flex-1"
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed, watch } from 'vue'

// Props
const props = defineProps({
  label: {
    type: String,
    required: true,
  },
  firebaseValue: {
    type: Boolean,
    default: null,
  },
  updateFunction: {
    type: Function,
    required: true,
  },
  checkboxLabel: {
    type: String,
    default: 'Enabled',
  },
  disabled: {
    type: Boolean,
    default: false,
  },
  disabledMessage: {
    type: String,
    default: '',
  },
  validationFunction: {
    type: Function,
    default: null,
  },
  formattingFunction: {
    type: Function,
    default: null,
  },
})

// State
const isEditing = ref(false)
const localValue = ref(props.firebaseValue || false)
const errorMessage = ref('')

// Computed
const displayValue = computed(() => {
  if (props.firebaseValue === null || props.firebaseValue === undefined) {
    return 'Not set'
  }
  return props.firebaseValue ? 'Yes' : 'No'
})

// Watch for prop changes
watch(
  () => props.firebaseValue,
  (newValue: boolean | null) => {
    if (!isEditing.value) {
      localValue.value = newValue || false
    }
  }
)

// Methods
const startEditing = () => {
  if (props.disabled) return
  localValue.value = props.firebaseValue || false
  isEditing.value = true
  errorMessage.value = ''
}

const cancelEditing = () => {
  localValue.value = props.firebaseValue || false
  isEditing.value = false
  errorMessage.value = ''
}

const deleteValue = async () => {
  try {
    await props.updateFunction(null)
    isEditing.value = false
    errorMessage.value = ''
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error deleting checkbox value:', error)
    errorMessage.value = 'Failed to delete value'
  }
}

const saveChanges = async () => {
  try {
    errorMessage.value = ''

    // Validate if validation function provided
    if (props.validationFunction) {
      const validationResult = props.validationFunction(localValue.value)
      if (!validationResult.isValid) {
        errorMessage.value = validationResult.message
        return
      }
    }

    // Format if formatting function provided
    let valueToSave = localValue.value
    if (props.formattingFunction) {
      valueToSave = props.formattingFunction(localValue.value)
    }

    // Update in Firebase
    await props.updateFunction(valueToSave)
    isEditing.value = false
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error saving checkbox value:', error)
    errorMessage.value = 'Failed to save changes'
  }
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.form-field {
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.display {
  padding: 0.5rem 0;
}

.editing {
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
}
</style>
```

```vue
<template>
  <!-- Settings-style row: label on the left, content on the right -->
  <UFormField
    :label="label"
    :error="errorMessage || undefined"
    class="flex max-sm:flex-col justify-between items-start gap-4"
  >
    <div class="w-full flex flex-col gap-3">
      <!-- Keep the existing Top actions but hide duplicated label -->
      <MoleculesFormsTop
        :label="''"
        :is-editing="isEditing"
        :has-data="!!props.firebaseValue"
        :error-message="errorMessage"
        @start-editing="startEditing"
        @check="saveChanges"
        @cancel="cancelEditing"
        @delete="deleteValue"
      />

      <!-- Display mode -->
      <div v-if="!isEditing" class="display">
        <div
          class="w-full rounded-md border border-[var(--ui-border)] bg-[var(--ui-bg-muted)] px-3 py-2 text-sm text-default"
        >
          <span class="break-words">{{ displayValue }}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Edit mode -->
      <div v-else class="editing">
        <!-- Text Area -->
        <UTextarea
          v-if="type === 'textarea'"
          v-model="localValue"
          :placeholder="placeholder"
          class="w-full"
          :rows="rows || 4"
          :maxlength="maxlength || 500"
          @keyup.ctrl.enter="saveChanges"
          @keyup.esc="cancelEditing"
        />

        <!-- Regular Input -->
        <UInput
          v-else
          v-model="localValue"
          :placeholder="placeholder"
          class="w-full"
          :type="inputType"
          @input="handleInput"
          @keyup.enter="saveChanges"
          @keyup.esc="cancelEditing"
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  </UFormField>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed, watchEffect } from 'vue'

const props = defineProps({
  label: { type: String, default: '' },
  firebaseValue: { type: String, default: '' },
  placeholder: { type: String, default: '' },
  updateFunction: { type: Function, required: true },
  deleteFunction: { type: Function, default: () => {} },
  type: { type: String, default: 'text' }, // 'text', 'textarea', 'phone', 'email', etc.
  rows: { type: Number, default: 4 },
  maxlength: { type: Number, default: 500 },
  validationFunction: { type: Function, default: null },
  formattingFunction: { type: Function, default: null },
})

// Local reactive state
const isEditing = ref(false)
const localValue = ref('')
const errorMessage = ref('')

// Computed input type
const inputType = computed(() => {
  switch (props.type) {
    case 'phone':
      return 'tel'
    case 'email':
      return 'email'
    case 'textarea':
      return 'text'
    default:
      return 'text'
  }
})

// Watch for prop changes to update local value
watchEffect(() => {
  localValue.value = props.firebaseValue || ''
})

// Computed display value
const displayValue = computed(() => {
  return localValue.value || props.placeholder || 'Not set'
})

// Handle input with phone formatting if needed
const handleInput = () => {
  if (props.type === 'phone') {
    formatPhone()
  }
}

// Phone formatting logic
const formatPhone = () => {
  if (props.type !== 'phone') return

  // Remove all non-digits and clamp to 10 digits
  let cleaned = localValue.value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 10)

  // Format as (XXX) XXX-XXXX
  if (cleaned.length >= 6) {
    cleaned = cleaned.replace(/(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{4})/, '($1) $2-$3')
  } else if (cleaned.length >= 3) {
    cleaned = cleaned.replace(/(\d{3})(\d{0,3})/, '($1) $2')
  }

  localValue.value = cleaned
}

// Methods
const startEditing = () => {
  isEditing.value = true
  errorMessage.value = ''
}

const cancelEditing = () => {
  localValue.value = props.firebaseValue || ''
  isEditing.value = false
  errorMessage.value = ''
}

const deleteValue = async () => {
  try {
    await props.updateFunction('')
    localValue.value = ''
    errorMessage.value = ''
  } catch (error) {
    errorMessage.value =
      error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Error deleting value'
  }
}

const saveChanges = async () => {
  try {
    errorMessage.value = ''
    const trimmedValue = (localValue.value || '').trim()

    // Validate if validation function provided
    if (props.validationFunction) {
      const result = props.validationFunction(trimmedValue)
      if (!result?.isValid) {
        errorMessage.value = result?.message || 'Invalid value'
        return
      }
    }

    // Apply formatting if provided
    const valueToSave = props.formattingFunction
      ? props.formattingFunction(trimmedValue)
      : trimmedValue

    await props.updateFunction(valueToSave)
    isEditing.value = false
    errorMessage.value = ''
  } catch (error) {
    errorMessage.value =
      error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Error saving changes'
  }
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.display {
  padding: var(--space-3) 0;
  min-height: var(--space-10);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
}

.editing {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-3);
}
</style>
```

```vue
  // Parent-provided handler to process selected file (e.g., upload then update URL)
  updateFunction?: (file: File) => unknown
}>()

function onFileChange(e: Event) {
  const input = e.target as HTMLInputElement | null
  const file = input?.files?.[0]
  if (!file) return
  if (props.updateFunction) props.updateFunction(file)
  // reset input so same file can be picked again if desired
  if (input) input.value = ''
}
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/components/molecules/forms/firestore/ListActions.vue

```vue
<!-- packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/components/molecules/forms/firestore/ListActions.vue -->
<template>
  <div class="space-y-3">
    <div
      v-for="item in items"
      :key="item.id"
      class="flex items-center justify-between gap-3"
    >
      <component
        :is="item.to ? 'NuxtLink' : 'div'"
        v-bind="item.to ? { to: item.to } : {}"
        class="list-pill"
      >
        <UAvatar
          :src="item.avatar || undefined"
          :text="initialsFor(item)"
          :alt="item.title"
          size="sm"
          class="list-pill__avatar"
        />

        <div class="list-pill__text">
          <span class="list-pill__title">{{ item.title }}</span>
          <span v-if="item.subtitle" class="list-pill__subtitle">
            {{ item.subtitle }}
          </span>
        </div>
      </component>

      <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
        <template v-if="actionApprove || actionReject">
          <UButton
            v-if="actionApprove"
            type="button"
            size="xs"
            color="primary"
            icon="i-lucide-check"
            :aria-label="approveLabel"
            :title="approveLabel"
            :loading="isBusy(item.id)"
            :disabled="isBusy(item.id)"
            @click="() => handleApprove(item.id)"
          />

          <UButton
            v-if="actionReject"
            type="button"
            size="xs"
            color="neutral"
            variant="soft"
            icon="i-lucide-x"
            :aria-label="rejectLabel"
            :title="rejectLabel"
            :loading="isBusy(item.id)"
            :disabled="isBusy(item.id)"
            @click="() => handleReject(item.id)"
          />
        </template>

        <template v-else-if="actionToggle && getToggleState">
          <USwitch
            :model-value="safeToggleState(item.id)"
            :disabled="isBusy(item.id)"
            :aria-label="toggleLabel"
            :title="toggleLabel"
            @update:model-value="handleToggle(item.id, Boolean($event))"
          />
        </template>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div v-if="!items?.length" class="text-sm text-gray-500">
      {{ emptyText }}
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive, toRefs, type Ref } from 'vue'
/**
 * Generic pill list with optional actions.
 * Supports approve/reject buttons or a boolean toggle per item.
 */
type ListItem = {
  id: string
  title: string
  subtitle?: string | null
  avatar?: string | null
  initials?: string | null
  to?: string | null
}

type ActionHandler = (id: string) => void | Promise<void>
type ToggleGetter = (id: string) => boolean
type ToggleHandler = (id: string, next: boolean) => void | Promise<void>

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    items: ListItem[]
    actionApprove?: ActionHandler
    actionReject?: ActionHandler
    approveLabel?: string
    rejectLabel?: string
    getToggleState?: ToggleGetter
    actionToggle?: ToggleHandler
    toggleLabel?: string
    emptyText?: string
  }>(),
  {
    items: () => [],
    approveLabel: 'Approve',
    rejectLabel: 'Reject',
    toggleLabel: 'Toggle',
    emptyText: 'Nothing to review.',
  }
)

// Expose props for template usage
const {
  items,
  actionApprove,
  actionReject,
  approveLabel,
  rejectLabel,
  getToggleState,
  actionToggle,
  toggleLabel,
  emptyText,
} = toRefs(props)

const busyMap = reactive<Record<string, boolean>>({})

const isBusy = (id: string) => Boolean(busyMap[id])

const safeToggleState = (id: string) => {
  const getter = getToggleState.value
  if (!getter) return false
  try {
    return Boolean(getter(id))
  } catch {
    return false
  }
}

const initialsFor = (item: ListItem): string => {
  const base = (item.initials || item.title || '').trim()
  if (!base) return '·'
  if (base.length === 1) return base.toUpperCase()
  const parts = base.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean)
  if (!parts.length) return base.charAt(0).toUpperCase()
  if (parts.length === 1) return parts[0].charAt(0).toUpperCase()
  const first = parts[0]?.charAt(0) ?? ''
  const last = parts.at(-1)?.charAt(0) ?? ''
  return `${first}${last}`.toUpperCase()
}

async function runAction(action: Ref<ActionHandler | undefined>, id: string) {
  const fn = action.value
  if (!fn || isBusy(id)) return
  busyMap[id] = true
  try {
    await fn(id)
  } finally {
    delete busyMap[id]
  }
}

async function runToggle(
  action: Ref<ToggleHandler | undefined>,
  id: string,
  next: boolean
) {
  const fn = action.value
  if (!fn || isBusy(id)) return
  busyMap[id] = true
  try {
    await fn(id, next)
  } finally {
    delete busyMap[id]
  }
}

const handleApprove = (id: string) => runAction(actionApprove, id)
const handleReject = (id: string) => runAction(actionReject, id)
const handleToggle = (id: string, next: boolean) =>
  runToggle(actionToggle, id, next)

defineOptions({ name: 'MoleculesFormsFirestoreListActions' })
</script>
```

```vue
      @check="saveChanges"
      @cancel="cancelEditing"
      @delete="deleteValue"
    />

    <div v-if="!isEditing" class="display">
      <span v-if="Object.keys(localValue).length" class="text-gray-700">

          {{ value
          }}<span v-if="key !== Object.keys(localValue).slice(-1)[0]">, </span>
        </span>
        <span v-else>{{ joinedValue }}</span>
      </span>
      <span v-else class="text-gray-700">{{ placeholder || 'Not set' }}</span>
    </div>

    <!-- Edit Mode -->
    <div v-else class="editing">
      <div
        v-for="key in Object.keys(placeholders)"
        :key="key"
        class="input-group"
      >
        <UInput
          v-model="localValue[key]"
          :placeholder="placeholders[key]"
          class="w-full mb-2"
          @keyup.enter="saveChanges"
          @keyup.esc="cancelEditing"
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue'
import type { PropType } from 'vue'

type StringMap = Record<string, string>

const props = defineProps({
  label: { type: String, default: '' },
  firebaseValue: { type: Object as PropType<StringMap>, default: () => ({}) },
  placeholder: { type: String, default: '' },
  updateFunction: { type: Function, required: true },
  deleteFunction: { type: Function, default: () => {} },
  placeholders: { type: Object as PropType<StringMap>, required: true },
  commas: { type: Boolean, default: true },
})

// Local reactive state
const isEditing = ref(false)
const localValue = ref<StringMap>({})
const errorMessage = ref('')

const joinedValue = computed(() =>
  Object.values(localValue.value)
    .filter((v) => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length > 0)
    .join(' ')
)

// Watch for prop changes to update local value
watch(
  () => props.firebaseValue,
  (newValue: StringMap) => {
    if (!isEditing.value) {
      localValue.value = newValue ? { ...newValue } : {}
    }
  },
  { immediate: true, deep: true }
)

// Editing handlers
function startEditing() {
  localValue.value = props.firebaseValue ? { ...props.firebaseValue } : {}
  errorMessage.value = ''
  isEditing.value = true
}

function cancelEditing() {
  localValue.value = props.firebaseValue ? { ...props.firebaseValue } : {}
  errorMessage.value = ''
  isEditing.value = false
}

async function saveChanges() {
  try {
    await props.updateFunction(localValue.value)
    errorMessage.value = ''
    isEditing.value = false
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error saving multi-field:', error)
    errorMessage.value = 'Failed to save changes'
  }
}

async function deleteValue() {
  try {
    await props.updateFunction({})
    localValue.value = {}
    errorMessage.value = ''
    isEditing.value = false
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error deleting multi-field:', error)
    errorMessage.value = 'Failed to delete value'
  }
}
</script>
```

```vue
<template>
  <div class="form-field">
    <!-- Use the existing Top component with proper namespace -->
    <MoleculesFormsTop
      :label="label"
      :is-editing="isEditing"
      :has-data="!!props.firebaseValue"
      :error-message="errorMessage"
      :disabled="disabled"
      :disabled-message="disabledMessage"
      @start-editing="startEditing"
      @check="saveChanges"
      @cancel="cancelEditing"
      @delete="deleteValue"
    />

    <!-- Display mode -->
    <div v-if="!isEditing" class="display">
      <span class="text-gray-700">{{ displayValue }}</span>
    </div>

    <!-- Edit mode -->
    <div v-else class="editing">
      <UInputMenu
        v-model="localValue"
        :items="normalizedOptions"
        value-key="value"
        label-key="label"
        open-on-click
        :placeholder="placeholder"
        class="w-full"
      />
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed, watch } from 'vue'

type SelectOption = string | { label: string; value: string }

// Props
const props = defineProps({
  label: {
    type: String,
    required: true,
  },
  firebaseValue: {
    type: String,
    default: '',
  },
  options: {
    type: Array as any,
    required: true,
  },
  updateFunction: {
    type: Function,
    required: true,
  },
  placeholder: {
    type: String,
    default: 'Select an option',
  },
  disabled: {
    type: Boolean,
    default: false,
  },
  disabledMessage: {
    type: String,
    default: '',
  },
  validationFunction: {
    type: Function,
    default: null,
  },
  formattingFunction: {
    type: Function,
    default: null,
  },
})

// State
const isEditing = ref(false)
const localValue = ref(props.firebaseValue || '')
const errorMessage = ref('')

const normalizedOptions = computed(() => {
  const source = (props.options ?? []) as SelectOption[]
  return source.map((opt) => (typeof opt === 'string' ? { label: opt, value: opt } : opt))
})

// Computed
const displayValue = computed(() => {
  if (!props.firebaseValue) {
    return 'Not set'
  }

  const option = normalizedOptions.value.find((opt) => opt.value === props.firebaseValue)
  if (option) return option.label

  return props.firebaseValue
})

// Watch for prop changes
watch(
  () => props.firebaseValue,
  (newValue: string) => {
    if (!isEditing.value) {
      localValue.value = newValue || ''
    }
  }
)

// Methods
const startEditing = () => {
  if (props.disabled) return
  localValue.value = props.firebaseValue || ''
  isEditing.value = true
  errorMessage.value = ''
}

const cancelEditing = () => {
  localValue.value = props.firebaseValue || ''
  isEditing.value = false
  errorMessage.value = ''
}

const deleteValue = async () => {
  try {
    await props.updateFunction('')
    isEditing.value = false
    errorMessage.value = ''
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error deleting select value:', error)
    errorMessage.value = 'Failed to delete value'
  }
}

const saveChanges = async () => {
  try {
    errorMessage.value = ''

    // Validate if validation function provided
    if (props.validationFunction) {
      const validationResult = props.validationFunction(localValue.value)
      if (!validationResult.isValid) {
        errorMessage.value = validationResult.message
        return
      }
    }

    // Format if formatting function provided
    let valueToSave = localValue.value
    if (props.formattingFunction) {
      valueToSave = props.formattingFunction(localValue.value)
    }

    // Update in Firebase
    await props.updateFunction(valueToSave)
    isEditing.value = false
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error saving select value:', error)
    errorMessage.value = 'Failed to save changes'
  }
}
</script>

  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.display {
  padding: 0.5rem 0;
}

.editing {
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
}
</style>
```

```vue
          @keydown.enter="emit('enter')"
          @keydown.esc="emit('esc')"
        />
      </div>

      <UInput
        v-else
        :id="id"
        :model-value="modelValue"

        class="w-full"
        @update:model-value="(v: unknown) => emit('update:modelValue', String(v ?? ''))"

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue'

const props = defineProps<{
  id: string
  label: string
  icon: string
  isEditing: boolean
  modelValue: string
  displayValue?: string
  placeholder?: string
  leading?: string
}>()

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'update:modelValue', value: string): void
  (e: 'enter'): void
  (e: 'esc'): void
}>()

const computedPlaceholder = computed(() => props.placeholder ?? '')
const leading = computed(() => (props.leading ?? '').trim())
const displayText = computed(() => (props.displayValue ?? props.modelValue ?? '').trim())

function onInput(e: Event) {
  const target = e.target as HTMLInputElement | null
  emit('update:modelValue', target?.value ?? '')
}

function toHref(value: string): string {
  const trimmed = (value || '').trim()
  if (!trimmed) return ''
  if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(trimmed)) return trimmed
  return `https://${trimmed}`
}
</script>
```

```vue
  {
    platform: 'youtube',
    label: 'YouTube',
    icon: 'logos:youtube-icon',
    leading: 'https://youtube.com/',
    base: 'https://youtube.com/',
  },
  {
    platform: 'linkedin',
    label: 'LinkedIn',
    icon: 'skill-icons:linkedin',
    leading: 'https://www.linkedin.com/',
    base: 'https://www.linkedin.com/',
  },
  {
    platform: 'github',
    label: 'GitHub',
    icon: 'skill-icons:github-dark',
    leading: 'https://github.com/',
    base: 'https://github.com/',
  },
  {
    platform: 'facebook',
    label: 'Facebook',
    icon: 'logos:facebook',
    leading: 'https://facebook.com/',
    base: 'https://facebook.com/',
  },
] as const satisfies ReadonlyArray<{
  platform: SocialPlatform
  label: string
  icon: string
  leading: string
  base: string
}>

const platforms = computed(() => socialItems.map((x) => x.platform))

const baseForPlatform = (platform: SocialPlatform): string => {
  return socialItems.find((x) => x.platform === platform)?.base || ''
}

// Computed properties
const hasData = computed(() => {
  const src = props.firebaseValue || {}
  for (const platform of platforms.value) {
    const raw = (src as any)[platform]
    if (typeof raw === 'string' && raw.trim()) return true
  }
  return false
})

function toEditableWebsite(raw: unknown): string {
  const value = typeof raw === 'string' ? raw.trim() : ''
  if (!value) return ''

  if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(value)) {
    try {
      const url = new URL(value)
      return `${url.host}${url.pathname}${url.search}${url.hash}`
    } catch {
      return value
    }
  }

  return value.replace(/^\/+/, '')
}
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/components/molecules/forms/state/ImagePicker.vue

```vue
<template>
  <div class="picker">
    <label :for="id" class="picker-label">{{ label }}</label>

    <!-- Hidden file input -->
    <input
      :id="id"
      ref="inputRef"
      type="file"
      accept="image/*"
      class="hidden-input"
      @change="onSelect"
    />

    <!-- Preview -->
    <div class="image-container" v-if="dataRef">
      <img :src="dataRef" :alt="`${label} preview`" />
    </div>

    <div v-if="dataRef" class="actions">
      <UButton
        icon="i-lucide-image-up"
        variant="solid"
        color="primary"
        size="sm"
        @click="trigger"
      >
        Change
      </UButton>
      <UButton
        icon="i-lucide-x"
        variant="outline"
        color="neutral"
        size="sm"
        @click="clearImage"
      >
        Clear
      </UButton>
    </div>

    <div class="file-info" v-if="fileInfoRef">
      <span class="file-name">{{ fileInfoRef.name }}</span>
      <span class="file-size">{{ fileSizeText }}</span>
      <span v-if="!isValidImage" class="validation-error">
        ⚠️ File too large or invalid type
      </span>
    </div>

    <!-- Upload trigger - only show when no image -->
    <div class="upload-controls" v-if="!dataRef">
      <UButton icon="i-lucide-image-up" variant="subtle" @click="trigger">
        Upload Image
      </UButton>
    </div>

    <!-- Validation message -->
    <div v-if="fileInfoRef && !isValidImage" class="validation-message">
      <UIcon name="i-lucide-alert-triangle" />
      <span>Image processing failed. Please try a different image file.</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
// Try to use Nuxt UI toast if available in app context
const useToastFn = (globalThis as any).useToast as undefined | (() => any)
const toast = useToastFn ? useToastFn() : undefined
import { useStorage } from '@vueuse/core'

const props = defineProps<{
  label: string
  stateKey: string
}>()

// Store both base64 data and file metadata
const dataRef = useStorage<string>(`${props.stateKey}Data`, '')
const fileInfoRef = useStorage<{
  name: string
  size: number
  type: string
  lastModified: number
} | null>(`${props.stateKey}FileInfo`, null)

// Store the actual file in a reactive ref (not persisted)
const currentFile = ref<File | null>(null)
const inputRef = ref<HTMLInputElement | null>(null)
const id = `upload-${props.stateKey}`

// Validation - more lenient since we process images
const isValidImage = computed(() => {
  if (!fileInfoRef.value) return true
  const maxSize = 5 * 1024 * 1024 // 5MB (after processing)
  const validTypes = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp', 'image/gif']
  return (
    fileInfoRef.value.size <= maxSize &&
    validTypes.includes(fileInfoRef.value.type)
  )
})

const fileSizeText = computed(() => {
  if (!fileInfoRef.value) return ''
  const sizeInMB = (fileInfoRef.value.size / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2)
  return `${sizeInMB}MB`
})

// Expose the file for parent components to access
defineExpose({
  getFile: () => currentFile.value,
  getDataUrl: () => dataRef.value,
  getFileInfo: () => fileInfoRef.value,
  clear: clearImage,
})

function trigger() {
  inputRef.value?.click()
}

function clearImage() {
  dataRef.value = ''
  fileInfoRef.value = null
  currentFile.value = null
}

function onSelect(e: Event) {
  const input = e.target as HTMLInputElement
  const file = input.files?.[0]

  if (!file) {
    dataRef.value = ''
    fileInfoRef.value = null
    currentFile.value = null
    return
  }

  // Check if it's an image file
  if (!file.type.startsWith('image/')) {
    console.error('❌ File is not an image')
    if (toast)
      toast.add({
        title: 'Invalid file',
        description: 'Please select an image file',
        icon: 'i-heroicons-exclamation-triangle',
        color: 'amber',
      })
    input.value = ''
    return
  }

  // Process the image (resize and convert)
  processImage(file)
    .then((processedData) => {
      if (processedData) {
        dataRef.value = processedData.dataUrl
        currentFile.value = processedData.file
        fileInfoRef.value = {
          name: file.name,
          size: processedData.file.size,
          type: 'image/jpeg', // Always convert to JPEG
          lastModified: file.lastModified,
        }
        console.log('✅ Image processed successfully:', {
          originalSize: file.size,
          newSize: processedData.file.size,
          compression:
            (((file.size - processedData.file.size) / file.size) * 100).toFixed(
              1
            ) + '%',
        })
      }
    })
    .catch((error) => {
      console.error('❌ Error processing image:', error)
      if (toast)
        toast.add({
          title: 'Processing failed',
          description: 'Please try a different image file',
          icon: 'i-heroicons-x-circle',
          color: 'red',
        })
    })

  // Clear the input so re-selecting the same file triggers change
  input.value = ''
}

// Helper: read a Blob as data URL (flattens nesting)
function readBlobAsDataURL(blob: Blob): Promise<string> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const reader = new FileReader()
    reader.onload = () => {
      if (typeof reader.result === 'string') resolve(reader.result)
      else reject(new Error('Failed to create data URL'))
    }
    reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to read processed file'))
    reader.readAsDataURL(blob)
  })
}

// Image processing function
```

```vue
<template>
  <div class="richtext-wrapper">
    <label class="sr-only" for="richtext-input">Rich text</label>
    <textarea
      id="richtext-input"
      v-model="localValue"
      class="richtext-input"
      rows="6"
    />
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, watch } from 'vue'

const props = defineProps<{ modelValue: string | undefined }>()
const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'update:modelValue', value: string): void
}>()

const localValue = ref(props.modelValue || '')

watch(
  () => props.modelValue,
  (newVal: string | undefined) => {
    if (newVal !== localValue.value) {
      localValue.value = newVal || ''
    }
  }
)

watch(localValue, (val: string) => {
  emit('update:modelValue', val)
})
</script>

<style scoped>
.richtext-wrapper {

}

.richtext-input {

}

}
```

```vue
            placeholder="Search apps…"
            class="w-44"
          />

          <UButton size="xs" variant="ghost" @click="toggleVariant">
            {{ variant === 'pill' ? 'Cells' : 'Pills' }}
          </UButton>

          <UBadge variant="soft">{{ visibleCount }} / {{ totalCount }}</UBadge>
        </div>
      </div>
    </template>

    <OrganismsAppCollectionList
      v-if="cardsFiltered.length"
      :cards="cardsFiltered"
      :variant="variant"
    />

    <p v-else class="section__empty">
      {{ query ? 'No apps match your search.' : 'No apps found.' }}
    </p>

    <div v-if="showDebug" class="pt-3">
      <DevJson
        :title="'Apps (JSON)'"
        :data="debugPayload"
        :default-open="false"
      />
    </div>
  </UCard>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { useAppInterface } from '../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/core/app/utils/view/useAppInterface';
import { useCollectionSearch } from '../../../../composables/shared/useCollectionSearch';
import type { AppModel } from '../../../../models/core/app.model';

const props = defineProps<{ collection?: AppModel[] }>()

const collection = computed(() => props.collection ?? [])
const { card: makeCard, searchText } = useAppInterface()
const {
  query,
  variant,
  toggleVariant,
  cards: cardsFiltered,
  visibleCount,
} = useCollectionSearch<AppModel, ReturnType<typeof makeCard>>({
  items: collection,
  searchText: (app) => searchText(app),
  makeCard: (app) => makeCard(app),
})

const totalCount = computed(() => collection.value.length)
const showDebug = import.meta.dev
const debugPayload = computed(() => ({
  totalApps: collection.value.length,
  apps: collection.value,
}))
</script>
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { doc, getDoc } from 'firebase/firestore'
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue'
import { useFirestore } from 'vuefire'
import { useFireUXConfig } from '../../../../composables/fireux/app/FireUXConfig'
import { useAppUsers } from '../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/core/app/fetch/useAppUsers'
import type { AppModel } from '../../../../models/core/app.model'
import type { User } from '../../../../models/core/user.model'

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{ app?: AppModel | null }>(), { app: null })
const app = computed(() => props.app)

const { appId: configAppId } = useFireUXConfig()
const driftAppId = computed(() => app.value?.id ?? configAppId ?? '')

const { users: appUsers, pending: appUsersPending } = useAppUsers()
const db = useFirestore()
const coreUsers = ref<Map<string, User | null>>(new Map())
const driftPending = ref(false)

const appUserIds = computed(() =>
  (appUsers.value ?? [])
    .map((u) => (u?.id ?? '').trim())
    .filter((id): id is string => Boolean(id))
)

watch(
  appUserIds,
  async (ids) => {
    if (import.meta.server) return
    const appId = driftAppId.value
    if (!appId) return

    driftPending.value = true
    const next = new Map<string, User | null>()

    await Promise.all(
      ids.map(async (id) => {
        try {
          const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'users', id) as any)
          next.set(id, snap.exists() ? (snap.data() as User) : null)
        } catch {
          next.set(id, null)
        }
      })
    )
```

```vue
<template>
  <div class="email-auth">
    <UForm :state="state" class="form" @submit="handleEmailAuth">
      <UInput v-model="state.email" placeholder="Email" block />
      <div class="input-spacing" />
      <UInput
        v-model="state.password"
        type="password"
        placeholder="Password"
        block
      />
      <div v-if="mode === 'auto'" class="switch-container">
        <USwitch
          v-model="isSignUp"
          :label="isSignUp ? 'Signing Up' : 'Signing In'"
        />
      </div>
      <UButton type="submit" block>
        {{ submitLabel }}
      </UButton>
      <UAlert
        v-if="errorMessage"
        class="mt-2"
        color="warning"
        variant="subtle"
        :title="errorTitle"
        :description="errorMessage"
      />
      <p v-if="errorHint" class="hint">
        {{ errorHint }}
        <template v-if="signupLink">
          <NuxtLink :to="signupLink">Create one here</NuxtLink>.
        </template>
      </p>
    </UForm>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { ref, computed, reactive } from 'vue'
import { useAuth } from '../../../composables/fireux/firebase/useAuth'
import { useFireUXConfig } from '../../../composables/fireux/app/FireUXConfig'

const router = useRouter()
const { signInWithEmailPassword, signUpWithEmailPassword } = useAuth()
const { centralSignupUrl } = useFireUXConfig()

const props = defineProps({
  // 'auto' shows a switch; 'sign-in' enforces sign-in only; 'sign-up' enforces sign-up
  mode: { type: String, default: 'auto' },
})

const isSignUp = ref(props.mode === 'sign-up')
const state = reactive({
  email: '',
  password: '',
})

const errorTitle = ref('')
const errorMessage = ref('')
const errorHint = ref('')
const signupLink = computed(() => centralSignupUrl || '')

const submitLabel = computed(() =>
  props.mode === 'sign-in' || (props.mode === 'auto' && !isSignUp.value)
    ? 'Continue'
    : 'Create Account'
)

const handleEmailAuth = async () => {
  errorTitle.value = ''
  errorMessage.value = ''
  errorHint.value = ''

  const doSignUp =
    props.mode === 'sign-up' || (props.mode === 'auto' && isSignUp.value)
  const authMethod = doSignUp
    ? signUpWithEmailPassword
    : signInWithEmailPassword

  const user = await authMethod(state.email, state.password)

  if (user?.uid) {
    console.log('[handleEmailAuth] ✅ Got UID:', user.uid)
    router.push('/')
  } else {
    // Friendly guidance for common cases
    errorTitle.value = doSignUp
      ? 'Account may already exist'
      : 'No account found'
    errorMessage.value = doSignUp
      ? 'Looks like you might already have a Misebox account with this email.'
      : 'We couldn’t find a Misebox account with that email.'
    errorHint.value = doSignUp
      ? 'Try signing in instead.'
      : 'Would you like to create a new Misebox account?'
  }
}
</script>
<style scoped>
.switch-container {
  margin: var(--space-4) 0;
}
.input-spacing {
  margin-bottom: var(--space-3);
}
.hint {
  color: var(--ui-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  margin-top: var(--space-2);
}
</style>

```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/components/organisms/Auth/EmailPanel.vue

```vue
<!-- FILE: packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/components/organisms/Auth/EmailPanel.vue -->
<template>
  <div class="email-panel">
    <p class="status">Sign in or create an account.</p>

    <UForm :state="formState" class="email-form" @submit="handleEmailSubmit">
      <UInput
        v-model="formState.email"
        type="email"
        label="Email"
        placeholder="name@example.com"
        block
      />
      <UInput
        v-model="formState.password"
        type="password"
        :label="passwordLabel"
        :placeholder="passwordPlaceholder"
        :autocomplete="passwordAutocomplete"
        block
      />
      <div class="switch-row">
        <USwitch
          v-model="isSignUp"
          :label="emailModeLabel"
          :disabled="formLoading"
        />
      </div>
      <UButton type="submit" block :loading="formLoading">
        {{ submitLabel }}
      </UButton>
    </UForm>

    <UAlert
      v-if="error"
      class="mt-3"
      color="warning"
      variant="subtle"
      :title="error.title"
      :description="error.description"
    />
    <p v-if="error?.hint" class="hint">{{ error.hint }}</p>
    <p class="legal">
      By signing in, you agree to our
      <NuxtLink to="/legal/terms">Terms of Service</NuxtLink>
      and
      <NuxtLink to="/legal/privacy">Privacy Policy</NuxtLink>.
    </p>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, reactive, ref } from 'vue'
import { useAuth } from '../../../composables/fireux/firebase/useAuth'

type AuthMode = 'sign-in' | 'sign-up'

type AuthError = {
  title: string
  description: string
  hint?: string
} | null

const props = defineProps<{ brandLabel: string }>()

const { signInWithEmailPassword, signUpWithEmailPassword } = useAuth()

const isSignUp = ref(false)
const formLoading = ref(false)
const formState = reactive({
  email: '',
  password: '',
})
const error = ref<AuthError>(null)

const submitLabel = computed(() =>
  isSignUp.value ? 'Create account' : 'Continue'
)
const passwordLabel = computed(() =>
  isSignUp.value ? 'Create password' : 'Password'
)
const passwordPlaceholder = computed(() =>
  isSignUp.value ? 'Enter a new password' : 'Enter your password'
)
const passwordAutocomplete = computed(() =>
  isSignUp.value ? 'new-password' : 'current-password'
)
const emailModeLabel = computed(() =>
  isSignUp.value ? 'Creating a new account' : 'Using an existing account'
)

const setEmailError = (mode: AuthMode) => {
  const brand = props.brandLabel
  error.value =
    mode === 'sign-up'
      ? {
          title: 'Account may already exist',
          description: `Looks like you might already have a ${brand} account with this email.`,
          hint: 'Try signing in instead.',
        }
      : {
          title: 'No account found',
          description: `We could not find a ${brand} account with that email.`,
          hint: 'Toggle "Create a new account" to continue.',
        }
}

const handleEmailSubmit = async (event?: Event) => {
  event?.preventDefault()
  if (formLoading.value) return

  const email = formState.email.trim()
  const password = formState.password

  if (!email || !password) {
    error.value = {
      title: 'Missing information',
      description: 'Enter your email and password to continue.',
    }
    return
  }

  error.value = null
  formLoading.value = true

  const mode: AuthMode = isSignUp.value ? 'sign-up' : 'sign-in'

  const result =
    mode === 'sign-up'
      ? await signUpWithEmailPassword(email, password)
      : await signInWithEmailPassword(email, password)

  formLoading.value = false

  if (result?.uid) return

  setEmailError(mode)
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.email-panel {
  margin-top: 1.5rem;
  text-align: left;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1rem;
  width: 100%;
}

.email-form {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.status {
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}

.switch-row {
  margin: 0.75rem 0 0;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
}

.hint {
  margin-top: 0.25rem;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: #905000;
}

.legal {
  margin-top: 0.25rem;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: #475569;
}

.legal a {
  text-decoration: underline;
}
</style>
```

```vue
}
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/components/organisms/Auth/System.vue

```vue
<!-- FILE: packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/components/organisms/Auth/System.vue -->
<template>
  <section class="auth-card">
    <div class="auth-logo" aria-label="Brand wordmark">
      <AppBrandWordmark
        size="large"
        class="auth-logo__img"
        light-src="/img/app/wordmark-light.png"
        dark-src="/img/app/wordmark-dark.png"
      />
    </div>
    <template v-if="isAuthenticated">
      <div class="signed-in">
        <p class="status">You're signed in.</p>
        <component
          :is="wrapperFor(currentUserPill)"
          v-if="currentUserPill"
          v-bind="wrapperPropsFor(currentUserPill)"
          class="user-pill"
        >
          <OrganismsUserCardsPill v-bind="currentUserPill" />
        </component>
        <div class="auth-actions">
          <UButton block color="primary" @click="goToConsole">
            Go to console
          </UButton>
          <UButton
            block
            variant="ghost"
            :loading="signOutLoading"
            @click="handleSignOut"
          >
            Sign out
          </UButton>
        </div>
      </div>
    </template>
    <template v-else>
      <button
        type="button"
        class="provider-button"
        :disabled="providerLoading"
        :aria-busy="providerLoading"
        aria-label="Continue with Google"
        @click="handleGoogle"
      >
        <img :src="googleLogo" alt="Continue with Google" />
        <span class="sr-only">Continue with Google</span>
      </button>
      <div class="divider">
        <span class="divider-line" />
        <span class="divider-label">or continue with email</span>
        <span class="divider-line" />
      </div>
      <OrganismsAuthEmailPanel :brand-label="ecosystemLabel" />
    </template>
  </section>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, useRouter } from '#imports'
import { useFireUXConfig } from '../../../composables/fireux/app/FireUXConfig'
import { useColorMode } from '../../../composables/fireux/app/useColorMode'
import { useAuth } from '../../../composables/fireux/firebase/useAuth'
import { useUser } from '../../../composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/useUser'

const router = useRouter()
const { authState, signOutUser, signInWithGoogle, isReady } = useAuth()
const isAuthenticated = computed(() => authState.value === 'AUTHENTICATED')
const signOutLoading = ref(false)
const providerLoading = ref(false)

const config = useFireUXConfig()
const ecosystemLabel = config.ecosystem

const colorMode = useColorMode()
const isDarkMode = computed(() => colorMode.value === 'dark')
const googleLogo = computed(() =>
  isDarkMode.value
    ? '/img/core/auth/sign-in-dark.svg'
    : '/img/core/auth/sign-in-light.svg'
)

const { currentUser, card } = useUser()
const currentUserPill = computed(() =>
  currentUser.value ? card(currentUser.value) : null
)

const wrapperFor = (card: ReturnType<typeof card> | null) => (card?.to ? 'NuxtLink' : 'div')
const wrapperPropsFor = (card: ReturnType<typeof card> | null) => (card?.to ? { to: card.to } : {})

const goToConsole = async () => {
  await router.push('/console').catch(() => {})
}

const handleSignOut = async () => {
  if (signOutLoading.value) return
  signOutLoading.value = true
  try {
    await signOutUser('/auth')
  } finally {
    signOutLoading.value = false
  }
}

const handleGoogle = async () => {
  if (import.meta.dev) {
    const href = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.location.href : undefined
    // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
    console.log('[fireux][auth] google click', {
      providerLoading: providerLoading.value,
      isReady: isReady.value,
      authState: authState.value,
      href,
    })
  }
  if (providerLoading.value) return
  providerLoading.value = true
  try {
    const user = await signInWithGoogle()
    if (import.meta.dev) {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
      console.log('[fireux][auth] google result', {
        uid: user?.uid ?? null,
        hasUser: !!user,
      })
    }
    if (user?.uid) {
      await router.push('/console').catch(() => {})
    }
  } finally {
    providerLoading.value = false
  }
}
</script>
```

```vue
<template>
  <UCard class="section">
    <template #header>
      <div class="section__header">
        <div class="section__copy">
          <h2 class="text-base font-semibold">Users</h2>
          <p class="text-xs text-gray-500">

          </p>
        </div>

        <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
          <UInput
            v-model="query"
            size="xs"
            placeholder="Search users…"
            class="w-44"
          />

            {{ variant === 'pill' ? 'Cells' : 'Pills' }}
          </UButton>

          <UBadge variant="soft">{{ visibleCount }} / {{ totalCount }}</UBadge>
        </div>
      </div>
    </template>

    <OrganismsUserCollectionList
      v-if="cardsFiltered.length"
      :cards="cardsFiltered"
      :variant="variant"
    />

      {{ query ? 'No users match your search.' : 'No users found.' }}

    <div v-if="showDebug" class="pt-3">

        :title="'Users (JSON)'"
        :data="debugPayload"

import { computed } from 'vue';
import { useUserInterface } from '../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/utils/view/useUserInterface';

import type { User } from '../../../../models/core/user.model';

const props = defineProps<{ collection?: User[] }>()

const scopeCopy = computed(() => 'Browse users available to this runtime.')

const collection = computed(() => props.collection ?? [])
const { card: makeCard, searchText } = useUserInterface()

const {
  query,
  variant,
  toggleVariant,
  cards: cardsFiltered,
  visibleCount,
} = useCollectionSearch<User, ReturnType<typeof makeCard>>({
  items: collection,
  searchText: (user) => searchText(user),
  makeCard: (user) => makeCard(user),
})

const totalCount = computed(() => collection.value.length)
const showDebug = import.meta.dev
const debugPayload = computed(() => ({
  totalUsers: collection.value.length,
  users: collection.value,
}))
</script>
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/components/organisms/User/Create/System.vue

```vue
<template>
  <UContainer>
    <div class="space-y-4 py-4">
      <div class="space-y-1">
        <h2 class="text-base font-semibold">{{ title }}</h2>
        <p class="text-sm text-gray-500">{{ description }}</p>
      </div>

      <div class="flex">
        <UButton
          v-if="primary.kind === 'link'"
          color="primary"
          size="lg"
          :to="primary.to"
        >
          {{ primary.label }}
        </UButton>

        <UButton
          v-else-if="primary.kind === 'action'"
          color="primary"
          size="lg"
          :loading="primary.loading"
          :disabled="primary.disabled"
          @click="primary.onClick"
        >
          {{ primary.label }}
        </UButton>

        <UButton v-else color="neutral" size="lg" disabled>
          {{ primary.label }}
        </UButton>
      </div>

      <p v-if="error" class="text-sm text-red-600">
        {{ error }}
      </p>
    </div>
  </UContainer>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import { useFireUXConfig } from '../../../../composables/fireux/app/FireUXConfig'
import { useApp } from '../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/core/app/useApp'
import { useUser } from '../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/useUser'

type PrimaryAction =
  | {
      kind: 'link'
      label: string
      to: string
      loading: boolean
      disabled: boolean
    }
  | {
      kind: 'action'
      label: string
      onClick: () => Promise<void>
      loading: boolean
      disabled: boolean
    }
  | {
      kind: 'none'
      label: string
      loading: boolean
      disabled: boolean
    }

const { appId, appName, ecosystem } = useFireUXConfig()
const { cta, ensureUser, core, isLoading, user } = useUser()
const { membership: appMembership } = useApp()

const error = ref<string | null>(null)
const isEnsuring = ref(false)

const uid = computed(() => user.value?.id ?? null)

const ctaKey = computed(() => cta.value?.key ?? 'avatar')
const shouldRender = computed(() => ctaKey.value !== 'avatar')

const isSignIn = computed(() => ctaKey.value === 'sign-in')
const requiresCore = computed(() => ctaKey.value === 'create-core-user')
const requiresApp = computed(() => ctaKey.value === 'join-app')

const appLabel = computed(() => appName ?? 'this workspace')
const ecosystemLabel = computed(() => ecosystem ?? 'FireUX')

const title = computed(() => {
  if (isLoading.value) return 'Loading user'
  if (isSignIn.value) return 'Sign in to continue'
  if (requiresCore.value) return 'Create your core user'
  if (requiresApp.value) return `Join ${appLabel.value}`
  return 'Update your profile'
})

const description = computed(() => {
  if (isLoading.value) return 'Resolving your user record and memberships.'
  if (isSignIn.value)
    return 'Authenticate to load your user details and continue setup.'
  if (requiresCore.value)
    return `Provision your ${ecosystemLabel.value} profile so apps can recognize you.`
  if (requiresApp.value)
    return `Mirror your profile inside ${appLabel.value} to unlock tenant features.`
  return 'Update your profile to keep your information in sync.'
})

const buttonLabel = computed(() => cta.value?.label ?? 'Continue')
const linkTarget = computed(() => (isSignIn.value ? cta.value?.to ?? '/auth' : ''))

const canTriggerAction = computed(() => requiresCore.value || requiresApp.value)

const handleEnsure = async () => {
  if (!canTriggerAction.value || isEnsuring.value) return

  error.value = null
  isEnsuring.value = true

  try {
    if (requiresCore.value || requiresApp.value) {
      await ensureUser()
    }

    if (appId && uid.value && core?.membership && appMembership?.setAdmin) {
      await core.membership.joinApp(appId, 'user')
      await appMembership.setAdmin(uid.value, false)
    }
  } catch (e) {
    const message =
      e instanceof Error
        ? e.message
        : 'Unable to update your profile. Please try again.'
    error.value = message
  } finally {
    isEnsuring.value = false
  }
}

const primary = computed<PrimaryAction>(() => {
  if (isLoading.value) {
    return {
      kind: 'none',
      label: 'Loading…',
      loading: false,
      disabled: true,
    }
  }

  if (!shouldRender.value) {
    return {
      kind: 'none',
      label: buttonLabel.value,
      loading: false,
      disabled: true,
    }
  }

  if (linkTarget.value) {
    return {
      kind: 'link',
      label: buttonLabel.value,
      to: linkTarget.value,
      loading: false,
      disabled: false,
    }
  }

  if (canTriggerAction.value) {
    return {
      kind: 'action',
      label: buttonLabel.value,
      onClick: handleEnsure,
      loading: isEnsuring.value,
      disabled: isEnsuring.value,
    }
  }

  return {
    kind: 'none',
    label: buttonLabel.value,
    loading: false,
    disabled: true,
  }
})
</script>

```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/components/organisms/User/Edit/App.vue

```vue
<!-- FILE: packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/components/organisms/User/Edit/App.vue -->
<template>
  <section class="space-y-2">
    <p class="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-emerald-700">
      App Properties
    </p>

    <ClientOnly>
      <div class="space-y-6">
        <UCard>
          <template #header>
            <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div>
                <h3 class="text-base font-semibold">App Membership</h3>
                <p class="text-xs text-gray-500">
                  Tenant-specific access derived from the current app context.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </template>

          <div v-if="overlay" class="space-y-4">
            <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
              <UBadge size="sm" color="primary" variant="soft">
                {{ overlay.role === 'admin' ? 'Admin' : 'Member' }}
              </UBadge>
              <span class="text-sm text-gray-500">
                Role granted within this tenant
              </span>
            </div>

            <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <div class="text-xs text-gray-600 space-y-1">
                <p>app admins: {{ appAdmins.join(', ') || 'none' }}</p>
                <p>appUser.role: {{ appUserRole }}</p>
                <p>
                  core adminOf: {{ props.user?.adminOf?.join(', ') || 'none' }}
                </p>
              </div>
              <USwitch
                :model-value="isAppAdmin"
                :loading="togglingAdmin"
                label="App admin"
                @update:model-value="handleToggleAdmin"
              />
            </div>

            <div class="text-sm text-gray-600">
              <p>
                App overlay updates are managed by tenant administrators.
                Contact an admin to adjust your role.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div v-else class="text-sm text-gray-500">
            <p>No tenant overlay detected for this user.</p>
          </div>

          <div
            class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-sm text-emerald-900"
          >
            <span>
              Role (local prototype):
              <strong>{{ rolePreview }}</strong>
            </span>
            <UButton size="xs" variant="soft" @click="toggleRolePreview">
              Toggle role (hello ↔ world)
            </UButton>
          </div>
        </UCard>
      </div>
    </ClientOnly>
  </section>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import type { User } from '../../../../models/core/user.model'
import { useUser } from '../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/useUser'
import { useApp } from '../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/core/app/useApp'

const props = defineProps<{ user: User | null }>()

const { appUser } = useUser()
const { app, setAppUserAdmin } = useApp()

const overlay = computed(() => appUser.value ?? null)
const rolePreview = ref<'hello' | 'world'>('hello')
const toggleRolePreview = () => {
  rolePreview.value = rolePreview.value === 'hello' ? 'world' : 'hello'
}

const appAdmins = computed(() =>
  Array.isArray(app.value?.admin_ids)
    ? app.value.admin_ids.filter(
        (id): id is string => typeof id === 'string' && id.length > 0
      )
    : []
)
```

```ts
export type DevHealthStatus = 'pass' | 'warn' | 'fail'

  | 'runtime'
  | 'apps'

  message: string

  hint?: string
  context?: Record<string, unknown>
}

  id: string
  label: string
  description?: string
  status: DevHealthStatus
  summary: string
  issues: DevHealthIssue[]
  scopes?: DevHealthScope[]
  stats?: Record<string, number>
}

export interface DevHealthApi {

  getChecksForScope: (scope: DevHealthScope) => ComputedRef<DevHealthResult[]>
```
