```ts
import type { ComputedRef } from 'vue'
import { computed } from 'vue'
import type { AppModel as AppType } from '../../../models/core/app.model'
import { App as AppModel } from '../../../models/core/app.model'
import type { AppUser, User } from '../../../models/core/user.model'
import { useFireUXConfig } from '../../fireux/app/FireUXConfig'
import { useAppUsers } from '../../fireux/firestore/core/app/fetch/useAppUsers'
import { useApp } from '../../fireux/firestore/core/app/useApp'
import { useUserCollection } from '../../fireux/firestore/core/user/fetch/useUserCollection'
import { useFirestoreRead } from '../../fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreRead'
import type {
    DevHealthApi,
    DevHealthIssue,
    DevHealthResult,
    DevHealthScope,
    DevHealthStatus,
} from './types'

const resolveStatus = (issues: DevHealthIssue[]): DevHealthStatus => {
  if (issues.some((issue) => issue.severity === 'error')) return 'fail'
  if (issues.some((issue) => issue.severity === 'warning')) return 'warn'
  return 'pass'
}

const kindOf = (v: unknown): string => {
  if (v === null) return 'null'
  if (Array.isArray(v)) return 'array'
  return typeof v
}

const isPlainObject = (v: unknown): v is Record<string, unknown> => {
  if (!v || typeof v !== 'object') return false
  if (Array.isArray(v)) return false
  return Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Object]'
}

type DriftIssue = {
  kind: 'missing' | 'extra' | 'type'
  path: string
  expectedType?: string
  actualType?: string
}

const driftCompare = (
  template: unknown,
  data: unknown,
  path = ''
): DriftIssue[] => {
  const issues: DriftIssue[] = []

  const tType = kindOf(template)
  const dType = kindOf(data)

  if (!isPlainObject(template)) {
    if (tType !== dType) {
      issues.push({
        kind: 'type',
        path: path || '(root)',
        expectedType: tType,
        actualType: dType,
      })
    }
    return issues
  }

  if (!isPlainObject(data)) {
    issues.push({
      kind: 'type',
      path: path || '(root)',
      expectedType: 'object',
      actualType: dType,
    })
    return issues
  }

  const tKeys = Object.keys(template)
  const dKeys = Object.keys(data)

  for (const key of tKeys) {
    if (!(key in data)) {
      issues.push({
        kind: 'missing',
        path: path ? `${path}.${key}` : key,
        expectedType: kindOf((template as Record<string, unknown>)[key]),
      })
    }
  }

  for (const key of dKeys) {
    if (!(key in template)) {
      issues.push({
        kind: 'extra',
        path: path ? `${path}.${key}` : key,
        actualType: kindOf((data as Record<string, unknown>)[key]),
      })
    }
  }

  for (const key of tKeys) {
    if (!(key in data)) continue
    const tVal = (template as Record<string, unknown>)[key]
    const dVal = (data as Record<string, unknown>)[key]

    const tt = kindOf(tVal)
    const dt = kindOf(dVal)

    if (isPlainObject(tVal) || isPlainObject(dVal)) {
      issues.push(...driftCompare(tVal, dVal, path ? `${path}.${key}` : key))
      continue
    }

    if (tt !== dt) {
      issues.push({
        kind: 'type',
        path: path ? `${path}.${key}` : key,
        expectedType: tt,
        actualType: dt,
      })
    }
  }

  return issues
}

export function useDevHealth(): DevHealthApi {
  const { appId } = useFireUXConfig()

  // Core data sources reused across scopes
  const { app, pending: appPending } = useApp()
  const { users: appUsers, pending: appUsersPending } = useAppUsers()
  const { firestoreFetchCollection } = useFirestoreRead()
  const rawUsers = firestoreFetchCollection<User>('users')
  const { fulfilled: hydratedAppUsers } = useUserCollection()

  const checks = computed<DevHealthResult[]>(() => {
    const results: DevHealthResult[] = []

    const appValue = app.value as AppType | null | undefined
    const appUsersValue = appUsers.value as AppUser[] | undefined
    const rawUsersValue = rawUsers.value as User[] | undefined
    const hydratedUsers = hydratedAppUsers.value

    // 1) App drift vs template
    {
      const issues: DevHealthIssue[] = []

      if (appPending.value) {
        issues.push({
          id: 'app-loading',
          severity: 'warning',
          message: 'App is still loading.',
        })
      }

      if (!appValue) {
        issues.push({
          id: 'app-missing',
          severity: 'error',
          message: 'App document not loaded.',
          hint: 'Ensure FireUXConfig.appId resolves to a valid /apps/<id> document.',
        })
      } else {
        const drift = driftCompare(AppModel, appValue)

        if (drift.length) {
          issues.push({
            id: 'app-drift',
            severity: 'error',
            message: `App document shape drift: ${drift.length} issue(s).`,
            hint: 'Update /apps/<id> to match the App model template.',
            context: { drift },
          })
        }
      }

      results.push({
        id: 'app-template-drift',
        label: 'App document health',
        description: 'Validates the current app exists and matches the App model template.',
        status: resolveStatus(issues),
        summary: issues.length ? `${issues.length} issue(s)` : 'Template alignment ok.',
        issues,
        scopes: ['apps', 'runtime'],
        stats: {
          driftIssues: (() => {
            const drift = issues.find((issue) => issue.id === 'app-drift')?.context
            const list = (drift as { drift?: unknown })?.drift
            return Array.isArray(list) ? list.length : 0
          })(),
        },
      })
    }

    // 2) Admin alignment (app.admin_ids vs /apps/{id}/users role=admin)
    {
      const issues: DevHealthIssue[] = []
      const adminIds = new Set<string>(appValue?.admin_ids ?? [])
      const adminMembers = (appUsersValue ?? []).filter(
        (member) => member?.role === 'admin' && member?.id
      )
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/dev/useDevClipboard.ts

```ts
import { ref } from 'vue'

interface ToastApi {
  add: (options: {
    title?: string
    description?: string
    icon?: string
    color?: string
    timeout?: number
  }) => void
}

interface CopyOptions {
  label?: string
  success?: string
  error?: string
}

function resolveToast(): ToastApi | undefined {
  const useToastFn = (globalThis as any).useToast as
    | undefined
    | (() => ToastApi)

  if (typeof useToastFn === 'function') {
    try {
      return useToastFn()
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn('useDevClipboard: failed to resolve toast instance', error)
    }
  }

  return undefined
}

function writeToClipboardLegacy(text: string): boolean {
  if (!text) {
    return false
  }

  if (typeof document === 'undefined') {
    return false
  }

  try {
    const textarea = document.createElement('textarea')
    textarea.value = text
    textarea.setAttribute('readonly', 'true')

    textarea.style.position = 'fixed'
    textarea.style.top = '0'
    textarea.style.left = '0'
    textarea.style.width = '1px'
    textarea.style.height = '1px'
    textarea.style.opacity = '0'
    textarea.style.pointerEvents = 'none'

    document.body.appendChild(textarea)

    const activeElement = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null
    textarea.focus()
    textarea.select()

    const ok = document.execCommand('copy')

    textarea.remove()
    activeElement?.focus?.()

    return ok
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('useDevClipboard: legacy copy failed', error)
    return false
  }
}

function createSafeJsonReplacer() {
  const seen = new WeakSet<object>()

  return (_key: string, value: unknown) => {
    if (typeof value === 'bigint') {
      return value.toString()
    }

    if (value && typeof value === 'object') {
      const obj = value as object
      if (seen.has(obj)) {
        return '[Circular]'
      }
      seen.add(obj)
    }

    return value
  }
}

async function writeToClipboard(text: string): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!text) {
    return false
  }

  const hasClipboardApi =
    typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && Boolean(navigator.clipboard)

  if (hasClipboardApi) {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text)
      return true
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('useDevClipboard: failed to write to clipboard', error)
    }
  } else {
    console.warn('useDevClipboard: navigator.clipboard unavailable')
  }

  return writeToClipboardLegacy(text)
}

export function useDevClipboard() {
  const copying = ref(false)
  const toast = resolveToast()

  const copyText = async (text: string, options: CopyOptions = {}) => {
    if (!text) {
      toast?.add({
        title: options.error ?? 'Nothing to copy',
        description: options.label,
        icon: 'i-lucide-alert-circle',
        color: 'yellow',
      })
      return false
    }

    if (copying.value) {
      return false
    }

    copying.value = true

    const success = await writeToClipboard(text)

    copying.value = false

    if (success) {
      toast?.add({
        title: options.success ?? 'Copied to clipboard',
        description: options.label,
        icon: 'i-lucide-clipboard-check',
        color: 'green',
      })
    } else {
      toast?.add({
        title: options.error ?? 'Copy failed',
        description: 'Unable to access the clipboard',
        icon: 'i-lucide-x-circle',
        color: 'red',
      })
    }

    return success
  }

  const copyJSON = async (value: unknown, options: CopyOptions = {}) => {
    let payload = ''

    if (typeof value === 'string') {
      payload = value
    } else {
      try {
        payload = JSON.stringify(value, createSafeJsonReplacer(), 2) ?? ''
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('useDevClipboard: failed to stringify JSON payload', error)
        payload = ''
      }
    }

    return copyText(payload, {
      label: options.label ?? 'JSON copied to clipboard',
      success: options.success,
      error: options.error,
    })
  }

  return {
    copying,
    copyText,
    copyJSON,
  }
}
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/dev/useDevDriftFilter.ts

```ts
import { computed, ref, watch, type ComputedRef } from 'vue'
import {
    humanizeDriftPath,
    resolveDriftFromModel,
    type DriftKind,
    type ModelDrift,
} from './useModelDrift'

type WithOptionalId = { id?: string | null | undefined }

type DevDriftFieldOption = {
  key: string
  count: number
  label: string
}

type DevDriftFilterOption = {
  label: string
  value: string
}

export function useDevDriftFilter<T extends WithOptionalId>(params: {
  collection: ComputedRef<T[]>
  runtimeModel: Record<string, unknown>
}) {
  const driftKind = ref<DriftKind>('missing')
  const selectedField = ref<string>('')

  const setDriftKind = (kind: DriftKind) => {
    driftKind.value = kind
  }

  watch(driftKind, () => {
    selectedField.value = ''
  })

  const driftById = computed(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, ModelDrift>()
    for (const doc of params.collection.value) {
      const id = doc?.id
      if (!id) continue
      const drift = resolveDriftFromModel(
        params.runtimeModel,
        doc as unknown as Record<string, unknown>
      )
      map.set(id, drift)
    }
    return map
  })

  const fieldOptions = computed<DevDriftFieldOption[]>(() => {
    const counts = new Map<string, number>()
    for (const drift of driftById.value.values()) {
      const list = driftKind.value === 'missing' ? drift.missing : drift.extra
      for (const field of list) counts.set(field, (counts.get(field) ?? 0) + 1)
    }

    return [...counts.entries()]
      .map(([key, count]) => ({
        key,
        count,
        label: `${humanizeDriftPath(key)} (${count})`,
      }))
      .sort((a, b) => a.label.localeCompare(b.label))
  })

  const filterOptions = computed<DevDriftFilterOption[]>(() => [
    { label: 'All', value: '' },
    ...fieldOptions.value.map((o) => ({ label: o.label, value: o.key })),
  ])

  const filteredCollection = computed<T[]>(() => {
    if (!selectedField.value) return params.collection.value

    return params.collection.value.filter((doc) => {
      const id = doc?.id
      if (!id) return false
      const drift = driftById.value.get(id)
      if (!drift) return false
      const list = driftKind.value === 'missing' ? drift.missing : drift.extra
      return list.includes(selectedField.value)
    })
  })

  return {
    driftKind,
    setDriftKind,
    selectedField,
    driftById,
    fieldOptions,
    filterOptions,
    filteredCollection,
  }
}
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/dev/useModelDrift.ts

```ts
export type DriftKind = 'missing' | 'extra'

export type ModelDrift = {
  missing: string[]
  extra: string[]
}

export const isPlainObject = (v: unknown): v is Record<string, unknown> => {
  if (!v || typeof v !== 'object') return false
  if (Array.isArray(v)) return false
  return Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Object]'
}

export const kindOf = (v: unknown): string => {
  if (v === null) return 'null'
  if (Array.isArray(v)) return 'array'
  return typeof v
}

const parseEnum = (value: unknown): string[] | null => {
  if (typeof value !== 'string') return null
  if (!value.startsWith('enum:')) return null
  const list = value
    .slice('enum:'.length)
    .split('|')
    .map((v) => v.trim())
    .filter(Boolean)
  return list.length ? list : null
}

export const isMissingValue = (modelValue: unknown, dataValue: unknown): boolean => {
  if (typeof modelValue === 'string') return typeof dataValue !== 'string'
  if (Array.isArray(modelValue)) return !Array.isArray(dataValue)
  if (typeof modelValue === 'number') return typeof dataValue !== 'number'
  if (isPlainObject(modelValue)) return !isPlainObject(dataValue)
  return false
}

export const resolveDriftFromModel = (
  model: Record<string, unknown>,
  data: Record<string, unknown> | undefined,
  basePath = ''
): ModelDrift => {
  const missing: string[] = []
  const extra: string[] = []

  const dataObj = isPlainObject(data) ? data : {}

  for (const key of Object.keys(model)) {
    const modelValue = model[key]
    const dataValue = dataObj[key]
    const path = basePath ? `${basePath}.${key}` : key

    const enumValues = parseEnum(modelValue)
    if (enumValues) {
      if (typeof dataValue !== 'string' || !enumValues.includes(dataValue)) {
        const actual = typeof dataValue === 'string' ? dataValue : kindOf(dataValue)
        missing.push(`${path} (enum:${enumValues.join('|')}; got ${actual})`)
      }
      continue
    }

    if (isPlainObject(modelValue)) {
      // Treat empty objects in the model as leaf nodes.
      // This is especially useful for timestamp-like fields (e.g., {} as FirebaseTimestamp)
      // where we want to validate presence but ignore internal keys.
      if (Object.keys(modelValue).length === 0) {
        if (isMissingValue(modelValue, dataValue)) {
          missing.push(`${path} (${kindOf(modelValue)})`)
        }
        continue
      }

      const nested = resolveDriftFromModel(
        modelValue,
        isPlainObject(dataValue) ? (dataValue as Record<string, unknown>) : undefined,
        path
      )
      missing.push(...nested.missing)
      extra.push(...nested.extra)
      continue
    }

    if (isMissingValue(modelValue, dataValue)) {
      // Allow aliasing between legacy `created_by` and new `creator_id`.
      if (
        (key === 'created_by' && typeof dataObj['creator_id'] === 'string') ||
        (key === 'creator_id' && typeof dataObj['created_by'] === 'string')
      ) {
        continue
      }

      // If the model expects a timestamp-like empty object, tolerate common
      // canonical timestamp fields present on the data (created_at/updated_at)
      if (
        isPlainObject(modelValue) &&
        Object.keys(modelValue).length === 0 &&
        (dataObj['created_at'] !== undefined || dataObj['updated_at'] !== undefined)
      ) {
        continue
      }

      missing.push(`${path} (${kindOf(modelValue)})`)
    }
  }

  for (const key of Object.keys(dataObj)) {
    // Ignore known opt-in client-side timestamp fields and stamp metadata
    // These fields are added by stamping modes (time/pinpoint) and should not
    // be treated as drift when the canonical model doesn't include them.
    const IGNORE_EXTRA_TIMESTAMP = /^(created_at(?:_ms)?|updated_at(?:_ms)?|stamp_mode)$/
    if (IGNORE_EXTRA_TIMESTAMP.test(key)) continue

    if (key in model) continue
    const path = basePath ? `${basePath}.${key}` : key
    extra.push(`${path} (${kindOf(dataObj[key])})`)
  }

  return { missing, extra }
}

export const humanizeDriftPath = (path: string) =>
  path
    .split(' (')[0]
    .split('.')
    .map((p) => p.replace(/_/g, ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, (c) => c.toUpperCase()))
    .join(' · ')
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/app/FireUXConfig.ts

```ts
import { useRuntimeConfig } from '#imports'

export type FireUXRole = 'global' | 'tenant'

export interface FireUXConfig {
  devMode: boolean
  role: FireUXRole

  ecosystem: string
  appId: string
  appName: string
  appShortName: string

  // TODO: make `siteUrl` available via runtime config (final deploy target/domain).
  modules: string[]

  appThumbnail?: string
  appLogo?: string

  primaryColor?: string
  neutralColor?: string
  secondaryColor?: string

  centralSignupUrl?: string
  globalAppId?: string
  developerPin?: string

  // derived
  isTenant: boolean
  isGlobal: boolean
}

type AnyRecord = Record<string, unknown>

const FIREUX_CACHE_KEY = '__FIREUX_CONFIG'

function isNonEmptyString(v: unknown): v is string {
  return typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length > 0
}

function reqString(src: AnyRecord, key: string): string {
  const v = src[key]
  if (!isNonEmptyString(v)) {
    throw new Error(
      `[fireux] runtimeConfig.public.fireux.${key} must be a non-empty string.`
    )
  }
  return v.trim()
}

function optString(src: AnyRecord, key: string): string | undefined {
  const v = src[key]
  if (!isNonEmptyString(v)) return undefined
  return v.trim()
}

function toStringArray(v: unknown): string[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(v)) return []
  return v
    .map((e) => (typeof e === 'string' ? e.trim() : String(e ?? '').trim()))
    .filter(Boolean)
}

function reqRole(src: AnyRecord): FireUXRole {
  const raw = reqString(src, 'role').toLowerCase()
  if (raw !== 'global' && raw !== 'tenant') {
    throw new Error(
      `[fireux] runtimeConfig.public.fireux.role must be "global" or "tenant".`
    )
  }
  return raw
}

function buildConfig(): Readonly<FireUXConfig> {
  const pub = (useRuntimeConfig().public ?? {}) as AnyRecord
  const fireux = (pub.fireux ?? {}) as AnyRecord

  const devMode = import.meta.dev
  const role = reqRole(fireux)

  const cfg: FireUXConfig = {
    devMode,
    role,

    ecosystem: reqString(fireux, 'ecosystem'),
    appId: reqString(fireux, 'id'),
    appName: reqString(fireux, 'name'),
    appShortName: reqString(fireux, 'shortName'),

    modules: toStringArray(fireux.modules),

    appThumbnail: optString(fireux, 'appThumbnail'),
    appLogo: optString(fireux, 'appLogo'),

    primaryColor: optString(fireux, 'primaryColor'),
    neutralColor: optString(fireux, 'neutralColor'),
    secondaryColor: optString(fireux, 'secondaryColor'),

    centralSignupUrl: optString(fireux, 'centralSignupUrl'),
    globalAppId: optString(fireux, 'globalAppId'),
    developerPin: optString(fireux, 'developerPin'),

    isTenant: role === 'tenant',
    isGlobal: role === 'global',
  }

  return Object.freeze(cfg)
}

/**
 * Central accessor:
 * - On client, reuses a cached config (set by plugin OR computed here)
 * - On server, builds from runtime config
 * - Returns a frozen object with derived flags
 */
export function useFireUXConfig(): Readonly<FireUXConfig> {
  const g = globalThis as any

  // Client cache (fast path)
  if (import.meta.client && g?.[FIREUX_CACHE_KEY]) {
    return g[FIREUX_CACHE_KEY] as Readonly<FireUXConfig>
  }

  const cfg = buildConfig()

  // Populate cache on client so all calls share the same frozen object.
  if (import.meta.client) {
    g[FIREUX_CACHE_KEY] = cfg
  }

  return cfg
}

```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/app/forms/useEditableStringField.ts

```ts
import { computed, getCurrentInstance, ref, watch } from 'vue'

export type ValidationResult = {
  isValid: boolean
  message?: string
}

export type ValidationFn = ((value: string) => ValidationResult) | null

export type FormattingFn = ((value: string) => string) | null

export type UpdateFn = (value: string) => unknown | Promise<unknown>

type Options = {
  label?: string
  firebaseValue?: string | number | null
  placeholder?: string
  type?: string
  maxlength?: number
  rows?: number
  id?: string
  disabled?: boolean
  disabledMessage?: string
  validationFunction?: ValidationFn
  formattingFunction?: FormattingFn
  updateFunction: UpdateFn
  emitUpdated?: (value: string) => void
}

const toStringValue = (value?: string | number | null) => {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return ''
  return String(value)
}

const slugify = (value: string) =>
  value
    .toLowerCase()
    .replaceAll(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
    .replaceAll(/(^-|-$)/g, '')

export function useEditableStringField(options: Options) {
  const isEditing = ref(false)
  const draft = ref('')
  const optimisticValue = ref<string | null>(null)
  const saving = ref(false)
  const errorMessage = ref('')

  const isTextarea = computed(() => options.type === 'textarea')

  const disabled = computed(() => Boolean(options.disabled))
  const disabledMessage = computed(() => (options.disabledMessage || '').trim())

  const instance = getCurrentInstance()
  const instanceId = instance?.uid ?? 0

  const inputId = computed(() => {
    if (options.id) return options.id
    const labelSlug = options.label ? slugify(options.label) : 'field'
    return `simple-field-${labelSlug}-${instanceId}`
  })

  const inputType = computed(() => {
    if (isTextarea.value) return 'text'
    const type = options.type || 'text'
    if (['email', 'tel', 'number', 'password', 'url'].includes(type)) return type
    return 'text'
  })

  watch(
    () => options.firebaseValue,
    (next) => {
      if (!isEditing.value) {
        const nextValue = toStringValue(next)
        draft.value = nextValue
        optimisticValue.value = null
      }
    },
    { immediate: true }
  )

  const effectiveValue = computed(() =>
    optimisticValue.value !== null
      ? optimisticValue.value
      : toStringValue(options.firebaseValue)
  )

  const displayValue = computed(() => {
    const raw = effectiveValue.value.trim()
    if (raw.length) return raw
    if (options.placeholder?.length) return options.placeholder
    return 'Not set'
  })

  function startEditing() {
    if (disabled.value) return
    draft.value = toStringValue(options.firebaseValue)
    isEditing.value = true
    errorMessage.value = ''
  }

  function cancel() {
    draft.value = toStringValue(options.firebaseValue)
    isEditing.value = false
    errorMessage.value = ''
  }

  async function clear() {
    if (saving.value) return
    if (disabled.value) return

    saving.value = true
    errorMessage.value = ''
    try {
      await options.updateFunction('')
      options.emitUpdated?.('')
      isEditing.value = false
      optimisticValue.value = ''
      draft.value = ''
    } catch (error) {
      errorMessage.value = (error as Error)?.message || 'Error clearing value.'
    } finally {
      saving.value = false
    }
  }

  function saveOnEnter(event: KeyboardEvent) {
    if (!isTextarea.value) {
      save()
      return
    }

    if (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey) {
      event.preventDefault()
      save()
    }
  }

  async function save() {
    if (saving.value) return

    errorMessage.value = ''
    const trimmed = (draft.value || '').trim()

    if (options.validationFunction) {
      try {
        const result = options.validationFunction(trimmed)
        if (!result?.isValid) {
          errorMessage.value = result?.message || 'Invalid value'
          return
        }
      } catch {
        errorMessage.value = 'Validation failed.'
        return
      }
    }

    const valueToSave = options.formattingFunction
      ? options.formattingFunction(trimmed)
      : trimmed

    saving.value = true
    try {
      await options.updateFunction(valueToSave)
      options.emitUpdated?.(valueToSave)
      optimisticValue.value = valueToSave
      draft.value = valueToSave
      isEditing.value = false
    } catch (error) {
      errorMessage.value = (error as Error)?.message || 'Error saving value.'
    } finally {
      saving.value = false
    }
  }

  return {
    isEditing,
    draft,
    saving,
    errorMessage,
    disabled,
    disabledMessage,
    isTextarea,
    inputId,
    inputType,
    effectiveValue,
    displayValue,
    startEditing,
    cancel,
    clear,
    save,
    saveOnEnter,
  }
}
```

```ts
import type { NavMeta } from '../../../../../types/nav'

// Macro is provided by Nuxt runtime; declare optional shape for package builds.
declare const definePageMeta:
  | ((meta: Record<string, unknown>) => void)
  | undefined

type DefineNavOptions = NavMeta & {
  requiresAuth?: boolean
  roles?: string[]
  tenant?: string
}

function normaliseLayouts(value: NavMeta['layouts']): string[] | undefined {
  if (!value || value.length === 0) return undefined
  return value
}

export function defineNav(meta: DefineNavOptions) {
  const { requiresAuth, roles, tenant, ...navMeta } = meta
  const layouts = normaliseLayouts(navMeta.layouts)

  // Skip when the macro is unavailable (e.g. package-level tsc)
  if (typeof definePageMeta !== 'function') return

  definePageMeta({
    nav: {
      group: navMeta.group ?? 'Other',
      order: navMeta.order ?? 999,
      desktop: navMeta.desktop ?? false,
      mobile: navMeta.mobile ?? false,
      ...navMeta,
      ...(layouts ? { layouts } : {}),
    },
    requiresAuth: requiresAuth ?? false,
    roles: roles ?? [],
    tenant,
  })
}
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/app/ui/nav/useNav.ts

```ts
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { useRouter, type RouteRecordNormalized } from 'vue-router'
import { useFireUXConfig } from '../../FireUXConfig'
import type { NavItem, NavMeta } from '../../../../../../types/nav'

const DEFAULT_LAYOUT = 'default'
const DEFAULT_ORDER = 999

type TargetLayouts = string | string[]

type RouteMetaLike = {
  nav?: NavMeta
  requiresAuth?: boolean
  roles?: unknown
  tenant?: unknown
  title?: unknown
}

function toArray<T>(value: T | T[] | undefined): T[] {
  if (value === undefined) return []
  return Array.isArray(value) ? value : [value]
}

function ensureLayouts(targetLayouts: TargetLayouts): string[] {
  const arr = toArray(targetLayouts)
  if (arr.length === 0) return [DEFAULT_LAYOUT]
  return arr
}

function isNavMeta(value: unknown): value is NavMeta {
  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null
}

function normaliseOrder(value: unknown): number {
  if (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value)) return value
  if (typeof value === 'string' && value.trim().length > 0) {
    const parsed = Number.parseInt(value, 10)
    if (Number.isFinite(parsed)) return parsed
  }
  return DEFAULT_ORDER
}

function resolveLayouts(nav: NavMeta): string[] {
  const declared = toArray(nav.layouts)
  return declared.length === 0 ? [DEFAULT_LAYOUT] : declared
}

function resolvePath(route: RouteRecordNormalized): string {
  if (typeof route.path === 'string' && route.path.length > 0) return route.path
  return String(route.name ?? '')
}

function resolveLabel(
  route: RouteRecordNormalized,
  nav: NavMeta,
  fallback: string
): string {
  if (typeof nav.label === 'string' && nav.label.trim().length > 0) {
    return nav.label
  }
  const metaTitle = (route.meta as RouteMetaLike)?.title
  if (typeof metaTitle === 'string' && metaTitle.trim().length > 0) {
    return metaTitle
  }
  if (typeof route.name === 'string' && route.name.trim().length > 0) {
    return route.name
  }
  return fallback
}

function normaliseRoles(value: unknown): string[] | undefined {
  if (value === undefined) return undefined
  return toArray(value as string | string[] | undefined).filter(
    (role): role is string => typeof role === 'string' && role.length > 0
  )
}

function buildNavItem(
  route: RouteRecordNormalized,
  nav: NavMeta,
  targetLayouts: string[]
): NavItem | null {
  const layouts = resolveLayouts(nav)
  if (!layouts.some((layout) => targetLayouts.includes(layout))) return null

  const to = resolvePath(route)
  const label = resolveLabel(route, nav, to)

  return {
    key:
      typeof nav.key === 'string' && nav.key.length > 0 ? nav.key : undefined,
    label,
    icon: typeof nav.icon === 'string' ? nav.icon : undefined,
    to,
    group: typeof nav.group === 'string' ? nav.group : undefined,
    profileId: typeof nav.profileId === 'string' ? nav.profileId : undefined,
    order: normaliseOrder(nav.order),
    desktop: nav.desktop !== false,
    mobile: nav.mobile !== false,
    layouts,
    requiresAuth: Boolean((route.meta as RouteMetaLike).requiresAuth),
    roles: normaliseRoles((route.meta as RouteMetaLike).roles),
    tenant:
      typeof (route.meta as RouteMetaLike).tenant === 'string'
        ? ((route.meta as RouteMetaLike).tenant as string)
        : undefined,
  }
}

function includeTenant(
  item: NavItem,
  fireux: ReturnType<typeof useFireUXConfig>
) {
  if (!item.tenant) return true
  if (item.tenant === 'tenant') return fireux.isTenant
  if (item.tenant === 'global') return fireux.isGlobal
  return true
}

export function useNav(targetLayouts: TargetLayouts = [DEFAULT_LAYOUT]) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const wanted = ensureLayouts(targetLayouts)
  const fireux = useFireUXConfig()

  const items = computed<NavItem[]>(() => {
    const seen = new Set<string>()
    const result: NavItem[] = []

    for (const route of router.getRoutes()) {
      if ((route as any)?.aliasOf) continue

      const meta = route.meta as RouteMetaLike
      if (!isNavMeta(meta.nav)) continue

      const item = buildNavItem(route, meta.nav, wanted)
      if (!item) continue

      const dedupeKey = item.key ?? item.to ?? item.label
      if (seen.has(dedupeKey)) continue
      seen.add(dedupeKey)

      result.push(item)
    }

    return result
      .filter((item) => includeTenant(item, fireux))
      .sort((a, b) => {
        if (a.order !== b.order) return a.order - b.order
        return a.label.localeCompare(b.label)
      })
  })

  const desktop = computed(() => items.value.filter((item) => item.desktop))
  const mobile = computed(() => items.value.filter((item) => item.mobile))

  return { items, desktop, mobile }
}

```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/app/ui/useAvatarProxy.ts

```ts
import { computed, toValue } from 'vue'
import type { Ref, ComputedRef } from 'vue'

/**
 * Utility to proxy Google avatar URLs through our server (avoids CORS issues).
 */
export function useAvatarProxy() {
  function getProxiedAvatarUrl(avatarUrl: string | null | undefined): string {
    if (!avatarUrl) return ''
    if (
      avatarUrl.includes('googleusercontent.com') ||
      avatarUrl.includes('google.com/') ||
      avatarUrl.includes('googleapis.com') ||
      avatarUrl.includes('gstatic.com')
    ) {
      return `/api/proxy/image?url=${encodeURIComponent(avatarUrl)}`
    }
    return avatarUrl
  }

  function useProxiedAvatar(
    avatarUrl:
      | Ref<string | null | undefined>
      | ComputedRef<string | null | undefined>
  ) {
    return computed(() => getProxiedAvatarUrl(toValue(avatarUrl)))
  }

  return {
    getProxiedAvatarUrl,
    useProxiedAvatar,
  }
}
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/app/ui/useBreadcrumbs.ts

```ts
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { useRoute, type RouteLocationMatched } from 'vue-router'

export function useBreadcrumbs() {
  const route = useRoute()

  return computed(() => {
    if (route.path === '/') return []

    const homeIcon = 'i-lucide-home'
    const defaultIcon = 'i-lucide-link'

    const links = [{ label: 'Home', icon: homeIcon, to: '/' }]

    const lastMatch: RouteLocationMatched | undefined =
      route.matched[route.matched.length - 1]

    const currentLabel =
      (lastMatch?.meta as any)?.breadcrumb ||
      route.name ||
      lastMatch?.name ||
      route.path

    links.push({
      label: String(currentLabel || ''),
      icon: defaultIcon,
      to: route.path,
    })

    return links
  })
}
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/app/ui/useEditHandler.ts

```ts
import type { Ref } from 'vue'
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { useToastify } from './useToastify'

interface EditHandlerOptions {
  debounceTime?: number
  delay?: number
}

type SaveStatus = '' | 'saving' | 'saved' | 'error'
type UpdateFunction = (data: Record<string, any>) => Promise<void>

interface EditHandlerReturn {
  saveField: (label: string, field: string, newValue: any) => Promise<void>
  autoSave: (label: string, field: string, value: any) => void
  saveStatus: Ref<SaveStatus>
}


export function useEditHandler(
  updateFunction: UpdateFunction,
  options: EditHandlerOptions = {}
): EditHandlerReturn {
  const toast = useToastify()
  const saveStatus = ref<SaveStatus>('')

  function simpleDebounce<T extends (...args: any[]) => void>(
    fn: T,
    wait: number
  ): T {
    let timeout: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null
    return ((...args: any[]) => {
      if (timeout) clearTimeout(timeout)
      timeout = setTimeout(() => fn(...args), wait)
    }) as T
  }

  const debouncedSave = simpleDebounce(
    async (label: string, field: string, value: any) => {
      try {
        saveStatus.value = 'saving'
        if (typeof updateFunction !== 'function') {
          throw new Error('updateFunction is not a valid function.')
        }
        await updateFunction({ [field]: value })
        saveStatus.value = 'saved'
        toast.success(`${label} updated successfully`)
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (saveStatus.value === 'saved') saveStatus.value = ''
        }, options.delay ?? 2000)
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(`Error saving ${label}:`, error)
        saveStatus.value = 'error'
        toast.error(`Failed to update ${label}`)
      }
    },
    options.debounceTime ?? 800
  )

  async function saveField(
    label: string,
    field: string,
    newValue: any
  ): Promise<void> {
    try {
      saveStatus.value = 'saving'
      if (typeof updateFunction !== 'function') {
        throw new Error('updateFunction is not a valid function.')
      }
      await updateFunction({ [field]: newValue })
      saveStatus.value = 'saved'
      toast.success(`${label} updated successfully`)
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error(`Failed to update ${label}`)
      throw error
    }
  }

  function autoSave(label: string, field: string, value: any): void {
    debouncedSave(label, field, value)
  }

  return { saveField, autoSave, saveStatus }
}

```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/app/ui/useSocialLinks.ts

```ts
// FILE: packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/app/ui/useSocialLinks.ts

type SocialPlatform =
  | 'website'
  | 'email'
  | 'twitter'
  | 'linkedin'
  | 'github'
  | 'instagram'
  | 'facebook'
  | 'youtube'
  | (string & {})

export type SocialLinks = Partial<Record<SocialPlatform, string>>

export type SocialLinkItem = {
  platform: string
  url: string
  icon: string
}

const ICONS: Record<string, string> = {
  website: 'heroicons:globe-alt',
  email: 'heroicons:envelope',
  twitter: 'simple-icons:x',
  linkedin: 'skill-icons:linkedin',
  github: 'skill-icons:github-dark',
  instagram: 'skill-icons:instagram',
  facebook: 'logos:facebook',
  youtube: 'logos:youtube-icon',
}

const BASE: Record<string, string> = {
  website: 'http://',
  email: 'mailto:',
  twitter: 'https://x.com/',
  linkedin: 'https://www.linkedin.com/',
  github: 'https://github.com/',
  instagram: 'https://instagram.com/',
  facebook: 'https://facebook.com/',
  youtube: 'https://youtube.com/',
}

function toSocialUrl(platform: string, value: string): string {
  const trimmed = (value ?? '').trim()
  if (!trimmed) return ''
  if (platform === 'email') {
    if (/^mailto:/i.test(trimmed)) return trimmed
    // Allow plain email values.
    if (/@/.test(trimmed) && !/^https?:\/\//i.test(trimmed)) return `mailto:${trimmed}`
  }
  if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(trimmed)) return trimmed

  const prefix = BASE[platform] || ''
  const suffix = trimmed.replace(/^\/+/, '')
  return `${prefix}${suffix}`
}

function iconForPlatform(platform: string): string {
  return ICONS[platform] || 'heroicons:link'
}

export function useSocialLinks() {
  function toItems(socialLinks: SocialLinks | null | undefined): SocialLinkItem[] {
    const socials = socialLinks || {}
    return Object.entries(socials)
      .map(([platform, raw]) => {
        const url = toSocialUrl(platform, String(raw ?? ''))
        if (!url) return null
        return { platform, url, icon: iconForPlatform(platform) }
      })
      .filter((x): x is SocialLinkItem => Boolean(x))
  }

  return { toItems }
}

```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/app/ui/useToastify.ts

```ts
import { useToast } from '#imports'

const TOAST_TIMEOUT = 3000

type ToastApi = {
  add?: (options: {
    title?: string
    description?: string
    color?: string
    timeout?: number
  }) => void
  success?: (message: string, options?: { timeout?: number }) => void
  error?: (message: string, options?: { timeout?: number }) => void
  warn?: (message: string, options?: { timeout?: number }) => void
}

type ToastCaller = (message: string) => void

type Toastify = {
  success: ToastCaller
  error: ToastCaller
  warn: ToastCaller
  add: (options: { title?: string; description?: string; color?: string }) => void
  withToast: <T extends unknown[]>(
    fn: (...args: T) => Promise<unknown>,
    messages: { ok: string; fail: string }
  ) => (...args: T) => Promise<unknown>
}

function resolveToast(): ToastApi | null {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    try {
      return useToast()
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn('[useToastify] Failed to resolve useToast()', error)
    }
  }

  return null
}

async function copyToClipboard(message: string) {
  if (!message) return
  if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.clipboard?.writeText) {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(message)
    return
  }

  if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
    const textarea = document.createElement('textarea')
    textarea.value = message
    textarea.style.position = 'fixed'
    textarea.style.opacity = '0'
    document.body.appendChild(textarea)
    textarea.select()
    document.execCommand('copy')
    document.body.removeChild(textarea)
  }
}

function buildToastOptions(type: 'success' | 'error' | 'warn', message: string) {
  let color = 'warning'
  let title = 'Notice'
  if (type === 'success') {
    color = 'success'
    title = 'Success'
  } else if (type === 'error') {
    color = 'error'
    title = 'Error'
  }

  return {
    title,
    description: message,
    color,
    timeout: TOAST_TIMEOUT,
    actions: [
      {
        label: 'Copy',
        click: () => copyToClipboard(message),
      },
    ],
  }
}

function buildCustomToastOptions(options: {
  title?: string
  description?: string
  color?: string
}) {
  const message = options.description || options.title || ''
  return {
    title: options.title,
    description: options.description,
    color: options.color,
    timeout: TOAST_TIMEOUT,
    actions: message
      ? [
          {
            label: 'Copy',
            click: () => copyToClipboard(message),
          },
        ]
      : undefined,
  }
}

function callWithFallback(
  toast: ToastApi | null,
  type: 'success' | 'error' | 'warn',
  message: string
) {
  if (!message) return
  const fallback = () => {
    let prefix = '⚠️'
    let logger: (...args: any[]) => void = console.warn

    if (type === 'success') {
      prefix = '✅'
      logger = console.log
    } else if (type === 'error') {
      prefix = '❌'
      logger = console.error
    }

    logger(`${prefix} ${message}`)
  }

  if (!toast) {
    fallback()
    return
  }

  if (typeof toast.add === 'function') {
    toast.add(buildToastOptions(type, message))
    return
  }

  fallback()
}

export function useToastify(): Toastify {
  const toast = resolveToast()

  const success: ToastCaller = (message) =>
    callWithFallback(toast, 'success', message)
  const error: ToastCaller = (message) =>
    callWithFallback(toast, 'error', message)
  const warn: ToastCaller = (message) =>
    callWithFallback(toast, 'warn', message)

  const withToast =
    <T extends unknown[]>(
      fn: (...args: T) => Promise<unknown>,
      messages: { ok: string; fail: string }
    ) =>
    async (...args: T) => {
      try {
        await fn(...args)
        if (messages.ok) success(messages.ok)
      } catch (err) {
        const detail = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Please try again.'
        const prefix = messages.fail ? `${messages.fail}: ` : ''
        error(`${prefix}${detail}`)
        throw err
      }
    }

  return {
    success,
    error,
    warn,
    add: (options) => {
      if (!toast || typeof toast.add !== 'function') {
        const message = options.description || options.title || ''
        if (message) console.log(`🔔 ${message}`)
        return
      }
      toast.add(buildCustomToastOptions(options))
    },
    withToast,
  }
}
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/app/useColorMode.ts

```ts
import { useState, watch } from '#imports'

export type FireUXColorMode = 'system' | 'light' | 'dark'
export type FireUXResolvedColorMode = 'light' | 'dark'

let clientSetupDone = false
let resolvedObserverSetupDone = false

function readStoredMode(): FireUXColorMode | null {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem('fireux:color-mode')
    if (raw === 'system' || raw === 'light' || raw === 'dark') return raw
    return null
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

function writeStoredMode(mode: FireUXColorMode) {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem('fireux:color-mode', mode)
  } catch {
    // ignore
  }
}

function resolveMode(mode: FireUXColorMode): FireUXResolvedColorMode {
  if (mode === 'dark') return 'dark'
  if (mode === 'light') return 'light'

  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof window.matchMedia !== 'function') {
    return 'light'
  }

  return window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches
    ? 'dark'
    : 'light'
}

function applyMode(mode: FireUXColorMode, resolvedState?: { value: FireUXResolvedColorMode }) {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return

  const resolved = resolveMode(mode)
  if (resolvedState) resolvedState.value = resolved
  document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark', resolved === 'dark')
}

export function useResolvedColorMode() {
  const resolved = useState<FireUXResolvedColorMode>(
    'fireux-core:resolved-color-mode',
    () => 'light'
  )

  // Keep resolved mode in sync with whatever is actually applied to the DOM.
  // This is important because some UIs (Nuxt UI, browser extensions, etc.)
  // may toggle the `dark` class without touching our `useColorMode()` state.
  if (import.meta.client && !resolvedObserverSetupDone) {
    resolvedObserverSetupDone = true

    const syncFromDom = () => {
      resolved.value = document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark')
        ? 'dark'
        : 'light'
    }

    // Seed from current DOM state.
    syncFromDom()

    // Observe class changes on <html> to reflect theme toggles.
    try {
      const observer = new MutationObserver(() => syncFromDom())
      observer.observe(document.documentElement, {
        attributes: true,
        attributeFilter: ['class'],
      })
    } catch {
      // ignore (very old browsers)
    }
  }

  return resolved
}

/**
 * Minimal `useColorMode()` implementation for this repo.
 *
 * Nuxt UI components and FireUX runtime code expect a `Ref`-like return
 * where `.value` is one of: 'system' | 'light' | 'dark'.
 */
export function useColorMode() {
  const mode = useState<FireUXColorMode>('fireux-core:color-mode', () => 'system')
  const resolved = useResolvedColorMode()

  if (import.meta.client && !clientSetupDone) {
    clientSetupDone = true

    const stored = readStoredMode()
    if (stored) mode.value = stored

    // Ensure the current mode is applied immediately.
    applyMode(mode.value, resolved)

    const media = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)')
    const handleMedia = () => {
      if (mode.value === 'system') applyMode(mode.value, resolved)
    }

    // keep in sync when OS theme changes
    media.addEventListener?.('change', handleMedia)

    watch(
      mode,
      (next: FireUXColorMode) => {
        writeStoredMode(next)
        applyMode(next, resolved)
      },
      { immediate: true }
    )
  }

  return mode
}
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/app/utils/useAppOnboarding.ts

```ts
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue'
import type { Ref } from 'vue'
import { useFireUXConfig } from '../FireUXConfig'
import { useUser } from '../../firestore/core/user/useUser'
import { useAppEnsure } from '../../firestore/core/app/mutations/useAppEnsure'
import type { EnvCheckResponse } from '../../../../../types/app/onboarding'
import { useAppEnvCheck } from './useAppEnvCheck'
import { useImageStorage } from '../../firebase/useImageStorage'
import { useFirestoreUpdate } from '../../firestore/operations/useFirestoreUpdate'
import { deleteField } from 'firebase/firestore'
import {
  appImageFirestoreField,
  appImageStoragePath,
  type AppImageKind,
} from '../../firestore/core/app/utils/appMedia'

export interface AppOnboardingState {
  coreUser: Ref<ReturnType<typeof useUser>['coreUser']['value'] | null>
  isUnlocked: Ref<boolean>
  pin: Ref<number[]>
  pinError: Ref<string | null>
  pinLength: Ref<number>
  expectedPin: Ref<string>
  env: Ref<EnvCheckResponse | null>
  envError: Ref<string | null>
  pending: Ref<boolean>
  canProceed: Ref<boolean>
  bypassWarning: Ref<boolean>
  checkPin: () => void
  onRefreshEnv: () => void
  onProceed: () => Promise<void>
}

export function useAppOnboarding(): AppOnboardingState {
  const { developerPin, devMode } = useFireUXConfig()
  const isDev = import.meta.dev

  const expectedPin = computed(() => {
    const raw = typeof developerPin === 'string' ? developerPin.trim() : ''
    const digits = raw.replaceAll(/\D/g, '')
    return digits || '1234'
  })

  const pinLength = computed(() => expectedPin.value.length)

  const { coreUser: coreUserRef } = useUser()
  const coreUser = computed(() => coreUserRef.value ?? null)

  const pin = ref<number[]>([])
  const pinError = ref<string | null>(null)
  const isUnlocked = ref(false)

  const resetPin = () => {
    pin.value = []
  }

  const checkPin = () => {
    const entry = pin.value.join('')
    if (isDev) {
      console.info('[onboarding] checkPin', {
        entry,
        expected: expectedPin.value,
      })
    }
    if (entry === expectedPin.value) {
      isUnlocked.value = true
      pinError.value = null
    } else {
      pinError.value = 'Incorrect PIN. Try again.'
    }
    resetPin()
  }

  watch(coreUser, (value: typeof coreUser.value) => {
    if (!value) {
      isUnlocked.value = false
      pinError.value = null
      resetPin()
    }
  })

  const { data, pending, error, refresh: refreshEnv } = useAppEnvCheck()

  const env = computed(() => data.value ?? null)
  const envError = computed(() => {
    if (!error.value) return null
    if (error.value instanceof Error) return error.value.message
    return String(error.value)
  })

  const envPending = computed(() => Boolean(pending.value))
  const canProceed = computed(
    () => Boolean(env.value?.isValid) || Boolean(devMode)
  )
  const bypassWarning = computed(() => !env.value?.isValid && Boolean(devMode))

  const { ensureApp } = useAppEnsure()
  const { uploadImage } = useImageStorage()
  const { updateDocument } = useFirestoreUpdate()

  function cacheBust(url: string): string {
    const stamp = Date.now().toString(36)
    return url.includes('?') ? `${url}&v=${stamp}` : `${url}?v=${stamp}`
  }

  const syncNewAppImages = async (appId: string) => {
    // Only sync when env-check says local assets are present/valid.
    // This keeps the onboarding flow safe when devMode bypass is used.
    if (!env.value?.isValid) return

    const uploads: Array<{ kind: AppImageKind; localPath: string }> = [
      { kind: 'logo', localPath: '/img/app/logo.png' },
      { kind: 'wordmarkLight', localPath: '/img/app/wordmark-light.png' },
      { kind: 'wordmarkDark', localPath: '/img/app/wordmark-dark.png' },
      { kind: 'thumbnail', localPath: '/img/app/thumbnail.png' },
    ]

    const patch: Record<string, string> = {}
    for (const item of uploads) {
      const storagePath = appImageStoragePath(appId, item.kind)
      const field = appImageFirestoreField(item.kind)
      const url = await uploadImage(storagePath, item.localPath)
      patch[field] = cacheBust(url)
    }

    await updateDocument('apps', appId, {
      ...patch,
      // Ensure no legacy wordmark field can linger.
      wordmark_url: deleteField(),
      // Ensure legacy thumbnail field is removed.
      avatar_url: '',
    })
  }

  const onRefreshEnv = () => {
    void refreshEnv()
  }

  const onProceed = async () => {
    if (!canProceed.value) return
    try {
      const ensured = await ensureApp()
      console.log('[proceed] ensureApp result', ensured)

      // For newly-created apps, push the canonical local brand assets to Storage
      // and persist the corresponding URLs in Firestore.
      if (ensured?.created) {
        await syncNewAppImages(ensured.id)
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('[proceed] ensureApp failed', e)
    }
  }

  return {
    coreUser,
    isUnlocked,
    pin,
    pinError,
    pinLength,
    env,
    envError,
    pending: envPending,
    canProceed,
    bypassWarning,
    expectedPin,
    checkPin,
    onRefreshEnv,
    onProceed,
  }
}
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firebase/useAuth.ts

```ts
// FILE: packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/firebase/useAuth.ts
import { getApps } from 'firebase/app'
import {
    createUserWithEmailAndPassword,
    getAuth,
    GoogleAuthProvider,
    onAuthStateChanged,
    signInWithEmailAndPassword,
    signInWithPopup,
    signOut,
    type Auth,
    type User,
} from 'firebase/auth'
import { computed, onMounted, ref, watch, type Ref } from 'vue'
import { useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { useCurrentUser, useFirebaseAuth } from 'vuefire'
import { useUserEnsure } from '../firestore/core/user/mutations/useUserEnsure'

export type AuthUser = {
  uid?: string | null
  isAnonymous?: boolean
  email?: string | null
  displayName?: string | null
  photoURL?: string | null
}

function tryBindVueFire() {
  // These can throw if VueFire Auth hasn't been installed yet.
  // (In FireUX apps, `fireux-nuxtfire` should ensure this is ready.)
  const auth = useFirebaseAuth()
  const currentUser = useCurrentUser() as Ref<User | null>
  return { auth, currentUser }
}

export function useAuth() {
  const router = (() => {
    if (!import.meta.client) return null
    try {
      return useRouter()
    } catch {
      return null
    }
  })()

  // “stable” refs we always return (never throw)
  const auth = ref<Auth | null>(null)
  const currentUser = ref<User | null>(null) as Ref<User | null>
  const isReady = ref(false)
  const hasAuthState = ref(false)
  const lastBindError = ref<unknown>(null)

  let authStateUnsubscribe: (() => void) | null = null

  const armAuthStateResolution = () => {
    if (!import.meta.client) return
    if (hasAuthState.value) return
    if (authStateUnsubscribe) return

    const authInstance: Auth | null = auth.value || (getApps().length ? getAuth() : null)
    if (!authInstance) return

    // Resolve exactly once: this flips true when Firebase has finished
    // determining the initial auth state (signed-in or signed-out).
    authStateUnsubscribe = onAuthStateChanged(
      authInstance,
      (u) => {
        currentUser.value = u
        hasAuthState.value = true
        authStateUnsubscribe?.()
        authStateUnsubscribe = null
      },
      (e) => {
        lastBindError.value = e
        hasAuthState.value = true
        authStateUnsubscribe?.()
        authStateUnsubscribe = null
      }
    )
  }

  const shouldDebug = () => {
    if (!import.meta.dev || !import.meta.client) return false
    try {
      return window.location.pathname.startsWith('/auth')
    } catch {
      return false
    }
  }

  const bind = () => {
    try {
      const bound = tryBindVueFire()
      auth.value = bound.auth
      currentUser.value = bound.currentUser.value
      // keep it live
      watch(
        bound.currentUser,
        (v: User | null) => (currentUser.value = v),
        { immediate: true }
      )
      isReady.value = true
      armAuthStateResolution()
      lastBindError.value = null

      if (shouldDebug()) {
        // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
        console.log('[fireux][auth] vuefire bound', {
          hasAuth: !!auth.value,
          uid: currentUser.value?.uid ?? null,
        })
      }

      return true
    } catch (e) {
      auth.value = null
      currentUser.value = null
      isReady.value = false
      hasAuthState.value = false
      lastBindError.value = e

      if (shouldDebug()) {
        // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
        console.warn('[fireux][auth] vuefire bind failed', e)
      }

      return false
    }
  }

  // first attempt (works when vuefire is already installed)
  bind()

  // retry after mount (covers “installed a moment later” cases)
  if (import.meta.client) {
    onMounted(() => {
      if (!isReady.value) bind()
      armAuthStateResolution()
    })
  }

  const uid = computed<string | null>(() => currentUser.value?.uid ?? null)
  const isAuthenticated = computed(() => !!uid.value)
  const authState = computed(() =>
    currentUser.value && !currentUser.value.isAnonymous
      ? 'AUTHENTICATED'
      : 'NOT_AUTHENTICATED'
  )

  if (import.meta.client) {
    watch(
      authState,
      (next: string) => {
        if (!shouldDebug()) return
        // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
        console.log('[fireux][auth] state', {
          state: next,
          uid: uid.value,
          isReady: isReady.value,
        })
      },
      { immediate: true }
    )
  }

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Ensure FireUX user document exists (client-only)
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  // IMPORTANT: composables like `useRouter()` / `useNuxtApp()` must be called
  // while a component instance exists (i.e. during setup). We create the
  // user-ensure composable once here, then call its methods later.
  const userEnsure = import.meta.client ? useUserEnsure() : null

  const ensuring = ref(false)
  const lastEnsuredUid = ref<string | null>(null)

  const ensureOnce = async (nextUid: string | null) => {
    if (!import.meta.client) return
    if (!nextUid) return
    if (!isReady.value) return
    if (ensuring.value) return
    if (lastEnsuredUid.value === nextUid) return
    if (!userEnsure) return

    ensuring.value = true
    try {
      await userEnsure.ensureUser()
      lastEnsuredUid.value = nextUid
    } finally {
      ensuring.value = false
    }
  }

  if (import.meta.client) {
    watch(uid, (nextUid: string | null) => void ensureOnce(nextUid), {
      immediate: true,
    })
  }

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Auth actions (no-op safely until ready)
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firebase/useImageStorage.ts

```ts
import { useRuntimeConfig } from '#imports'
import {
  getDownloadURL,
  getStorage,
  ref as storageRef,
  uploadBytes,
} from 'firebase/storage'
import type { RuntimeConfig } from 'nuxt/schema'
import { useFirebaseStorage } from 'vuefire'

function getDefaultImageUrl(
  path: string = '/img/core/defaults/default-thumbnail.png'
): string {
  return path
}

/**
 * Image Storage
 * - Accepts a Blob or URL (URL is fetched via /api/proxy/image)
 * - Uploads to Firebase Storage
 * - Returns the download URL
 */
export function useImageStorage() {
  const runtimeConfig = useRuntimeConfig() as RuntimeConfig
  const storage = resolveStorageBucket(useFirebaseStorage(), runtimeConfig)
  const debug = (...args: unknown[]) => {
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') {
      console.log('[useImageStorage]', ...args)
    }
  }

  const proxiedUrl = (url: string) =>
    url.startsWith('/')
      ? url
      : `/api/proxy/image?url=${encodeURIComponent(url)}`

  async function fetchAsBlob(url: string): Promise<Blob> {
    const proxied = proxiedUrl(url)
    debug('fetchAsBlob:start', { url, proxied })
    const res = await fetch(proxied, { cache: 'no-store' })
    if (!res.ok) {
      throw new Error(
        `[useImageStorage] fetch failed ${res.status} ${res.statusText}`
      )
    }
    const blob = await res.blob()
    debug('fetchAsBlob:success', { url, size: blob.size, type: blob.type })
    return blob
  }

  async function toBlob(source: Blob | string): Promise<Blob> {
    if (source instanceof Blob) {
      debug('toBlob:input-blob', { size: source.size, type: source.type })
      return source
    }
    debug('toBlob:fetch', { source })
    return fetchAsBlob(source)
  }

  async function uploadBlobToStorage(
    blob: Blob,
    path: string
  ): Promise<string> {
    const bucket = getStorage()?.app?.options?.storageBucket
    const fileRef = storageRef(storage, path)
    debug('upload', { bucket, path, size: blob.size, type: blob.type })

    await uploadBytes(fileRef, blob, { contentType: blob.type })
    const url = await getDownloadURL(fileRef)
    debug('upload:success', { path, url })
    return url
  }

  /**
   * Upload an image to Firebase Storage
   * @param path   Storage path (e.g. "users/{uid}/avatar")
   * @param source Blob or URL (required)
   */
  async function uploadImage(
    path: string,
    source: Blob | string
  ): Promise<string> {
    if (!path || !source) {
      throw new Error('[useImageStorage] path and source are required')
    }
    debug('uploadImage:start', { path, sourceType: typeof source })
    const blob = await toBlob(source)
    debug('uploadImage:blob-ready', { path, size: blob.size, type: blob.type })
    return uploadBlobToStorage(blob, path)
  }

  async function uploadFromUrl(path: string, url: string): Promise<string> {
    debug('uploadFromUrl:start', { path, url })
    const blob = await fetchAsBlob(url)
    return uploadBlobToStorage(blob, path)
  }

  async function getDownloadUrlForPath(path: string): Promise<string> {
    if (!path) {
      throw new Error('[useImageStorage] path is required for download lookup')
    }
    const fileRef = storageRef(storage, path)
    return getDownloadURL(fileRef)
  }

  return {
    uploadImage,
    uploadFromUrl,
    getDefaultImageUrl,
    getDownloadUrlForPath,
  }
}

function resolveStorageBucket(
  storage: ReturnType<typeof useFirebaseStorage>,
  runtimeConfig: RuntimeConfig
) {
  try {
    const rawBucket =
      (runtimeConfig?.public as any)?.firebaseEcosystem?.firebase
        ?.storageBucket ??
      (runtimeConfig?.public as any)?.firebaseConfig?.storageBucket ??
      storage.app.options.storageBucket

    const normalized = normalizeBucketName(rawBucket)
    if (!normalized || normalized === storage.app.options.storageBucket) {
      return storage
    }

    const resolved = getStorage(storage.app, `gs://${normalized}`)
    if (import.meta.dev) {
      console.log('[useImageStorage] remapped storage bucket', {
        from: storage.app.options.storageBucket,
        to: normalized,
      })
    }
    return resolved
  } catch (error) {
    if (import.meta.dev) {
      console.warn('[useImageStorage] failed to resolve custom bucket', error)
    }
    return storage
  }
}

function normalizeBucketName(bucket?: string | null): string | undefined {
  if (!bucket) return undefined
  let trimmed = bucket.trim()
  if (!trimmed) return undefined
  if (trimmed.startsWith('gs://')) {
    trimmed = trimmed.slice(5)
  }
  return trimmed
}
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firebase/useRequireUser.ts

```ts
import type { User as FirebaseUser } from 'firebase/auth'
import { getApps } from 'firebase/app'
import { getAuth, onAuthStateChanged } from 'firebase/auth'

/**
 * Waits for a signed-in Firebase user on the client.
 * Throws on SSR or if no user appears within `timeout` ms.
 */
export function useRequireUser(timeout = 5000): Promise<FirebaseUser> {
  if (!import.meta.client) {
    throw new Error('useRequireUser() must be called on the client.')
  }

  if (!getApps().length) {
    throw new Error(
      'Firebase must be initialized before calling useRequireUser().'
    )
  }

  const auth = getAuth()
  const existing = auth.currentUser
  if (existing) return Promise.resolve(existing)

  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const timer = globalThis.setTimeout(() => {
      cleanup()
      reject(new Error('User not authenticated (timeout).'))
    }, timeout)

    const cleanup = () => {
      globalThis.clearTimeout(timer)
      unsubscribe?.()
    }

    const unsubscribe = onAuthStateChanged(
      auth,
      (user) => {
        if (!user) return
        cleanup()
        resolve(user)
      },
      (err) => {
        cleanup()
        reject(err)
      }
    )
  })
}

```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/app/fetch/useAppFetch.ts

```ts
import { doc } from 'firebase/firestore'
import { computed, isRef, ref, type Ref } from 'vue'
import { useDocument, useFirestore } from 'vuefire'
import type { AppModel } from '../../../../../../models/core/app.model'

/**
 * Fetch a single app document by id (accepts raw ids or refs).
 * Returns { app, pending } so callers can debounce UI while refetching.
 */
export function useAppFetch(
  appId: string | null | undefined | Ref<string | null | undefined>
) {
  const db = useFirestore()

  const targetId = computed(() => {
    const value = isRef(appId) ? appId.value : appId
    return value ?? null
  })

  const docRef = computed(() =>
    targetId.value ? (doc(db, 'apps', targetId.value) as any) : null
  )

  const docState = useDocument<AppModel | undefined>(docRef as any) || {
    data: ref<AppModel | undefined>(undefined),
    pending: ref(false),
  }

  const app = docState.data ?? ref<AppModel | undefined>(undefined)
  const pending = docState.pending ?? ref(false)

  return { app, pending }
}
```

```ts
import { computed, type Ref } from 'vue'
import { useFireUXConfig } from '../../../../app/FireUXConfig'
import { useFirestoreRead } from '../../../operations/useFirestoreRead'
import type { AppUser } from '../../../../../../models/core/user.model'

/**
 * Fetch /apps/{appId}/users and expose the raw users collection.
 */
export function useAppUsers() {
  const { appId } = useFireUXConfig()
  const { firestoreFetchCollection } = useFirestoreRead()

  const users = firestoreFetchCollection<AppUser>(`apps/${appId}/users`)
  const pending = computed(() => users.value === undefined)

  return {
    users: users as Ref<AppUser[] | undefined>,
    pending,
  }
}
```

```ts
import { computed, ref, type Ref } from 'vue'
import { useFirestoreRead } from '../../../operations/useFirestoreRead'
import type { AppUser } from '../../../../../../models/core/user.model'

/**
 * Fetch `/apps/{appId}/users` for an explicit app id.
 *
 * This is intentionally separate from `useAppUsers()` so the common runtime-bound
 * composable stays small and readable.
 *
 * NOTE (future): As collections get more complex (e.g. kitchens/recipes/orders),
 * prefer this pattern:
 * - Keep a simple runtime-bound composable (uses `useFireUXConfig()` context)
 * - Add a separate `*ById` composable for cross-app / route-driven surfaces
 * - Keep UI components standalone by letting them enrich from ids when needed
 */
export function useAppUsersByAppId(appId?: string | null | undefined) {
  const { firestoreFetchCollection } = useFirestoreRead()

  if (!appId) {
    const users = ref<AppUser[] | undefined>(undefined) as Ref<AppUser[] | undefined>
    const pending = computed(() => false)
    return { users, pending }
  }

  const users = firestoreFetchCollection<AppUser>(`apps/${appId}/users`)
  const pending = computed(() => users.value === undefined)

  return {
    users: users as Ref<AppUser[] | undefined>,
    pending,
  }
}

```

```ts
// FILE: packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/app/mutations/useAppEnsure.ts

import { doc, getDoc } from 'firebase/firestore'
import { useFireUXConfig } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/app/FireUXConfig'
import { useFirestore } from 'vuefire'
import type { AppModel } from '../../../../../../models/core/app.model'
import { createEmptyAppSocialLinks } from '../../../../../../models/core/app.supporting'
import { useImageStorage } from '../../../../firebase/useImageStorage'
import { useFirestoreCreate } from '../../../operations/useFirestoreCreate'
import { useFirestoreUpdate } from '../../../operations/useFirestoreUpdate'
import {
    appImageFirestoreField,
    appImageStoragePath,
    type AppImageKind,
} from '../utils/appMedia'

type EnsureAppResult = {
  created: boolean
  id: string
}

export function useAppEnsure() {
  const db = useFirestore()
  const { setDocument } = useFirestoreCreate()
  const { updateDocument } = useFirestoreUpdate()
  const { uploadImage } = useImageStorage()

  async function syncNewAppImages(appId: string) {
    const uploads: Array<{ kind: AppImageKind; localPath: string }> = [
      { kind: 'logo', localPath: '/img/app/logo.png' },
      { kind: 'wordmarkLight', localPath: '/img/app/wordmark-light.png' },
      { kind: 'wordmarkDark', localPath: '/img/app/wordmark-dark.png' },
      { kind: 'thumbnail', localPath: '/img/app/thumbnail.png' },
    ]

    const patch: Record<string, string> = {}

    for (const item of uploads) {
      try {
        const storagePath = appImageStoragePath(appId, item.kind)
        const field = appImageFirestoreField(item.kind)
        const url = await uploadImage(storagePath, item.localPath)
        patch[field] = url
      } catch (error) {
        if (import.meta.dev) {
          console.warn('[useAppEnsure] media upload failed', {
            appId,
            kind: item.kind,
            error,
          })
        }
      }
    }

    if (!Object.keys(patch).length) return

    await updateDocument('apps', appId, patch)
  }

  async function ensureApp(): Promise<EnsureAppResult> {
    const fireux = useFireUXConfig()

    const ref = doc(db, 'apps', fireux.appId)
    const snap = await getDoc(ref)

    // Already exists → nothing to do
    if (snap.exists()) {
      return { created: false, id: fireux.appId }
    }

    // NOTE: App creation does NOT imply user membership.
    // User ↔ App binding is handled explicitly elsewhere.

    const payload = {
      id: fireux.appId,
      app_name: fireux.appName,
      app_short_name: fireux.appShortName,
      role: fireux.role,
      ecosystem: fireux.ecosystem,

      join_requests: [],
      admin_ids: [],

      tagline: '',
      description: '',
      short_bio: '',
      long_bio: '',

      social_links: createEmptyAppSocialLinks(),

      derived: {
        user_count: 0,
      },

      media: {
        thumbnail_url: '',
        logo_url: '',
        wordmark_light_url: '',
        wordmark_dark_url: '',
        cover_url: '',
      },
    } as Omit<AppModel, 'created_at' | 'updated_at' | 'creator_id'>

    await setDocument('apps', fireux.appId, payload, {
      creator: true,
    })

    await syncNewAppImages(fireux.appId)

    return { created: true, id: fireux.appId }
  }

  return { ensureApp }
}
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/app/mutations/useAppUpdate.ts

```ts
import { arrayRemove, arrayUnion, deleteField } from 'firebase/firestore'
import type { Ref } from 'vue'
import type { AppModel } from '../../../../../../models/core/app.model'
import type { AppSocialLinks } from '../../../../../../models/core/app.supporting'
import { useFireUXConfig } from '../../../../app/FireUXConfig'
import { useImageStorage } from '../../../../firebase/useImageStorage'
import { useFirestoreUpdate } from '../../../operations/useFirestoreUpdate'
import {
    appImageFirestoreField,
    appImageStoragePath,
    isWordmarkKind,
    type AppImageKind,
} from '../utils/appMedia'

export function useAppUpdate(appRef: Ref<AppModel | null | undefined>) {
  const cfg = useFireUXConfig()
  const { updateDocument } = useFirestoreUpdate()
  const { uploadImage, getDownloadUrlForPath } = useImageStorage()

  const ensureAppId = () => {
    const id = appRef.value?.id ?? cfg.appId
    if (!id) throw new Error('[useAppUpdate] Missing app or app.id')
    return id
  }

  const updateApp = (data: Partial<AppModel> | Record<string, any>) =>
    updateDocument<any>('apps', ensureAppId(), data as any)

  const updateUserMembership = async (
    uid: string,
    membershipRole: 'admin' | 'user'
  ) => {
    const appId = ensureAppId()
    const userId = String(uid ?? '').trim()
    if (!userId) throw new Error('[useAppUpdate] Missing uid')

    await updateDocument('users', userId, {
      userOf: arrayUnion(appId) as unknown as string[],
      adminOf:
        membershipRole === 'admin'
          ? (arrayUnion(appId) as unknown as string[])
          : (arrayRemove(appId) as unknown as string[]),
    })
  }

  const updateAppMembership = async (
    uid: string,
    membershipRole: 'admin' | 'user'
  ) => {
    const userId = String(uid ?? '').trim()
    if (!userId) throw new Error('[useAppUpdate] Missing uid')

    await updateApp({
      admin_ids:
        membershipRole === 'admin'
          ? (arrayUnion(userId) as unknown as App['admin_ids'])
          : (arrayRemove(userId) as unknown as App['admin_ids']),
    })
  }

  const updateAppUserRole = async (
    uid: string,
    membershipRole: 'admin' | 'user'
  ) => {
    const appId = ensureAppId()
    const userId = String(uid ?? '').trim()
    if (!userId) throw new Error('[useAppUpdate] Missing uid')

    await updateDocument(`apps/${appId}/users`, userId, {
      role: membershipRole,
    })
  }

  const text = (raw: unknown, max: number) =>
    String(raw ?? '')
      .trim()
      .slice(0, max)

  const sanitizeInstagram = (raw: string | null | undefined) => {
    const value = text(raw, 2048)
    if (!value) return ''

    const normalised = (() => {
      if (value.startsWith('@'))
        return `https://instagram.com/${value.slice(1)}`
      if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(value)) return value
      return `https://instagram.com/${value}`
    })()

    try {
      const url = new URL(normalised)
      return url.toString()
    } catch {
      throw new Error('Invalid Instagram URL')
    }
  }

  const sanitizeThumbnailUrl = (raw: string | null | undefined) => {
    const value = text(raw, 2048)
    if (!value) return ''
    try {
      const url = new URL(value)
      if (!['http:', 'https:'].includes(url.protocol)) {
        throw new Error('Thumbnail URL must use http or https')
      }
      return url.toString()
    } catch (error) {
      throw new Error(
        error instanceof Error && error.message
          ? error.message
          : 'Invalid thumbnail URL'
      )
    }
  }

  async function updateDescription(description: string) {
    await updateApp({ description: text(description, 500) })
  }

  async function updateTagline(tagline: string) {
    await updateApp({ tagline: text(tagline, 120) })
  }

  async function updateShortBio(shortBio: string) {
    await updateApp({ short_bio: text(shortBio, 240) })
  }

  async function updateLongBio(longBio: string) {
    await updateApp({ long_bio: text(longBio, 4000) })
  }

  async function updateAppName(name: string) {
    await updateApp({ app_name: text(name, 60) })
  }

  async function updateAppShortName(name: string) {
    await updateApp({ app_short_name: text(name, 40) })
  }

  async function updateEcosystem(ecosystem: string) {
    await updateApp({ ecosystem: text(ecosystem, 60) })
  }

  async function updateInstagram(url: string | null) {
    const sanitized = sanitizeInstagram(url)
    await updateApp({
      'social_links.instagram': sanitized,
    })
  }

  async function updateSocialLinks(links: AppSocialLinks) {
    await updateApp({ social_links: links })
  }

  async function updateAvatarUrl(url: string | null) {
    const value = sanitizeThumbnailUrl(url)
    await updateApp({ 'media.thumbnail_url': value })
  }

  async function updateThumbnailUrl(url: string | null) {
    return updateAvatarUrl(url)
  }

  async function uploadAvatar(source: File | Blob) {
    const id = ensureAppId()
    const path = appImageStoragePath(id, 'thumbnail')
    const url = await uploadImage(path, source)
    await updateApp({ 'media.thumbnail_url': cacheBust(url) })
    return url
  }

  async function uploadThumbnail(source: File | Blob) {
    return uploadAvatar(source)
  }

  function cacheBust(url: string): string {
    const stamp = Date.now().toString(36)
    return url.includes('?') ? `${url}&v=${stamp}` : `${url}?v=${stamp}`
  }

  async function refreshImageFromBucket(kind: AppImageKind) {
    const id = ensureAppId()
    const path = appImageStoragePath(id, kind)
    const url = await getDownloadUrlForPath(path)
    const next = cacheBust(url)

    const field = appImageFirestoreField(kind)
    const patch: Record<string, any> = { [field]: next }
    if (isWordmarkKind(kind)) patch.wordmark_url = deleteField()
    await updateApp(patch)
    return next
  }

  async function overwriteImageFromLocal(kind: AppImageKind, localPath: string) {
    if (!localPath || !localPath.startsWith('/')) {
      throw new Error('Local image path must start with /')
    }

    const id = ensureAppId()
    const path = appImageStoragePath(id, kind)
```

```ts
import { useFireUXConfig } from '../../../app/FireUXConfig'
import { useAppFetch } from './fetch/useAppFetch'
import { useAppComputed } from './utils/view/useAppComputed'
import { useAppInterface } from './utils/view/useAppInterface'
import { useAppEnsure } from './mutations/useAppEnsure'
import { useAppUpdate } from './mutations/useAppUpdate'

export type { AppModel } from '../../../../../models/core/app.model'

/**
 * useApp
 * - Fetches and manages the runtime app
 * - Defaults to FireUXConfig.appId
 * - For arbitrary appId, call useAppFetch(appId) directly
 */
export function useApp() {
  const { appId } = useFireUXConfig()
  const { app, pending } = useAppFetch(appId)

  return {
    app,
    pending,
    ...useAppComputed(app, pending),
    ...useAppInterface(app),
    ...useAppEnsure(),
    ...useAppUpdate(app),
  }
}
```
