### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/app/utils/appMedia.ts

```ts
// Canonical app media naming:
// - Storage objects: apps/<appId>/media/{thumbnail|logo|wordmark-light|wordmark-dark}
// - Firestore fields: {media.thumbnail_url|media.logo_url|media.wordmark_light_url|media.wordmark_dark_url}
export type AppImageKind =
  | 'thumbnail'
  | 'logo'
  | 'wordmarkLight'
  | 'wordmarkDark'

type AppImageFirestoreField =
  | 'media.thumbnail_url'
  | 'media.logo_url'
  | 'media.wordmark_light_url'
  | 'media.wordmark_dark_url'

export function appImageStoragePath(appId: string, kind: AppImageKind): string {
  // "Public bucket" convention: a stable object path that can be overwritten.
  // The UI refresh resolves the current download URL and saves it to Firestore.
  switch (kind) {
    case 'thumbnail':
      return `apps/${appId}/media/thumbnail`
    case 'logo':
      return `apps/${appId}/media/logo`
    case 'wordmarkLight':
      return `apps/${appId}/media/wordmark-light`
    case 'wordmarkDark':
      return `apps/${appId}/media/wordmark-dark`
  }
}

export function appImageFirestoreField(kind: AppImageKind): AppImageFirestoreField {
  switch (kind) {
    case 'thumbnail':
      return 'media.thumbnail_url'
    case 'logo':
      return 'media.logo_url'
    case 'wordmarkLight':
      return 'media.wordmark_light_url'
    case 'wordmarkDark':
      return 'media.wordmark_dark_url'
  }
}

export function isWordmarkKind(kind: AppImageKind): boolean {
  return kind === 'wordmarkLight' || kind === 'wordmarkDark'
}

```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/app/utils/useAppJoinRequests.ts

```ts
import { computed, ref, watchEffect, type ComputedRef, type Ref } from 'vue'

import type { AppModel } from '../../../../../../models/core/app.model'
import type { User } from '../../../../../../models/core/user.model'
import type { UserCard } from '../../user/utils/view/useUserInterface'

type JoinRequestItem = {
  id: string
  title: string
  subtitle?: string
  avatar: string
  to: string
}

type HandleJoinRequests = (uid: string, approve: boolean) => Promise<unknown>

type UserRef = ComputedRef<User | null>

type CardBuilder = ComputedRef<(target?: User | null | undefined) => UserCard.Card>

type Options = {
  app: Ref<AppModel | null | undefined>
  handleJoinRequests: HandleJoinRequests
  fetchedUser: (uid: string) => { user: UserRef }
  card: CardBuilder
}

/**
 * Maps `app.join_requests` to pill-friendly list items and exposes approve/reject helpers.
 */
export function useAppJoinRequests({
  app,
  handleJoinRequests,
  fetchedUser,
  card,
}: Options): {
  items: ComputedRef<JoinRequestItem[]>
  approve: (uid: string) => Promise<unknown>
  reject: (uid: string) => Promise<unknown>
} {
  const cache = new Map<string, UserRef>()
  const hidden = new Set<string>()
  const itemsRef = ref<JoinRequestItem[]>([])

  const ensureUserRef = (uid: string): UserRef => {
    let ref = cache.get(uid)
    if (!ref) {
      ref = fetchedUser(uid).user
      cache.set(uid, ref)
    }
    return ref
  }

  const toUniqueIds = (raw: unknown[]): string[] => {
    const trimmed = raw
      .map((entry) => (typeof entry === 'string' ? entry.trim() : ''))
      .filter((uid) => uid.length > 0)

    return Array.from(new Set(trimmed))
  }

  const buildItem = (uid: string): JoinRequestItem => {
    const ref = ensureUserRef(uid)
    const profile = ref.value
    if (!profile) {
      return { id: uid, title: uid, subtitle: '', avatar: '', to: '' }
    }

    const payload = card.value(profile)
    return {
      id: uid,
      title: payload.displayName,
      subtitle: payload.handle,
      avatar: payload.avatarUrl,
      to: payload.to,
    }
  }

  watchEffect(() => {
    const source = app.value?.join_requests
    if (!Array.isArray(source) || source.length === 0) {
      cache.clear()
      hidden.clear()
      itemsRef.value = []
      return
    }

    const ids = toUniqueIds(source)
    const mapped = ids
      .filter((uid) => !hidden.has(uid))
      .map((uid) => buildItem(uid))

    for (const key of Array.from(cache.keys())) {
      if (!ids.includes(key)) cache.delete(key)
    }

    for (const hiddenId of Array.from(hidden)) {
      if (!ids.includes(hiddenId)) hidden.delete(hiddenId)
    }

    itemsRef.value = mapped
  })

  const removeLocal = (uid: string) => {
    hidden.add(uid)
    itemsRef.value = itemsRef.value.filter(
      (item: JoinRequestItem) => item.id !== uid
    )
  }

  const approve = async (uid: string) => {
    removeLocal(uid)
    try {
      await handleJoinRequests(uid, true)
    } catch (error) {
      hidden.delete(uid)
      throw error
    }
  }

  const reject = async (uid: string) => {
    removeLocal(uid)
    try {
      await handleJoinRequests(uid, false)
    } catch (error) {
      hidden.delete(uid)
      throw error
    }
  }

  const items = computed<JoinRequestItem[]>(() => itemsRef.value)

  return { items, approve, reject }
}

export type { JoinRequestItem }

```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/app/utils/validation/useAppFormatting.ts

```ts
import {
  createEmptyAppSocialLinks,
  type AppSocialLinks,
} from '../../../../../../../models/core/app.supporting'

const HTTPS_PROTOCOL_REGEX = /^https?:\/\//

/** Formats app description for storage */
export function formatAppDescription(value: string): string {
  return value.trim()
}

/** Formats admin IDs array for storage */
export function formatAdminIds(adminIds: string[]): string[] {
  return adminIds.map((id) => id.trim()).filter((id) => id.length > 0)
}

/** Formats a single URL for storage */
export function formatUrl(url: string): string {
  const trimmed = url.trim()
  if (trimmed && !HTTPS_PROTOCOL_REGEX.exec(trimmed)) {
    return `https://${trimmed}`
  }
  return trimmed
}

/** Formats social links object for storage */
export function formatSocialLinks(socialLinks: AppSocialLinks): AppSocialLinks {
  const formatted: AppSocialLinks = createEmptyAppSocialLinks()
  const platforms = [
    'website',
    'instagram',
    'twitter',
    'linkedin',
    'github',
    'facebook',
    'youtube',
  ] as const

  for (const platform of platforms) {
    const trimmed = (socialLinks[platform] ?? '').trim()
    formatted[platform] = trimmed ? formatUrl(trimmed) : ''
  }

  // Email is stored as a raw string (not a URL).
  formatted.email = (socialLinks.email ?? '').trim()

  return formatted
}

/** Main formatting function that formats any app field */
export function formatAppField(field: string, value: any): any {
  switch (field) {
    case 'description':
      return formatAppDescription(value)
    case 'admin_ids':
      return formatAdminIds(value)
    case 'social_links':
      return formatSocialLinks(value)
    default:
      return value
  }
}

```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/app/utils/validation/useAppValidation.ts

```ts
import type { AppSocialLinks } from '../../../../../../../models/core/app.supporting'

/** Validates app description field */
export function validateAppDescription(value: string): string | null {
  const trimmedValue = value.trim()
  if (trimmedValue.length > 500)
    return 'Description must be less than 500 characters'
  return null
}

/** Validates admin IDs array */
export function validateAdminIds(adminIds: string[]): string | null {
  if (!Array.isArray(adminIds)) return 'Admin IDs must be an array'
  if (adminIds.length === 0) return 'At least one admin is required'

  for (const id of adminIds) {
    if (typeof id !== 'string' || !id.trim())
      return 'All admin IDs must be non-empty strings'
    if (id.length !== 28)
      return 'Invalid admin ID format (must be 28 characters)'
  }
  return null
}

/** Validates a single URL */
export function validateUrl(url: string, platform: string): string | null {
  if (!url || !url.trim()) return null
  try {
    const urlObj = new URL(url.trim())
    if (!['http:', 'https:'].includes(urlObj.protocol)) {
      return `${platform} URL must use http or https protocol`
    }
    return null
  } catch {
    return `Invalid ${platform} URL format`
  }
}

/** Validates social links object */
export function validateSocialLinks(
  socialLinks: AppSocialLinks
): string | null {
  if (!socialLinks || typeof socialLinks !== 'object') {
    return 'Social links must be an object'
  }

  const platforms = [
    'website',
    'instagram',
    'twitter',
    'linkedin',
    'github',
    'facebook',
    'youtube',
  ] as const

  for (const platform of platforms) {
    const url = socialLinks[platform]
    if (typeof url === 'string' && url.trim()) {
      const validationError = validateUrl(url, platform)
      if (validationError) return validationError
    }
  }

  return null
}

/** Main validation function that validates all app fields */
export function validateAppField(field: string, value: any): string | null {
  switch (field) {
    case 'description':
      return validateAppDescription(value)
    case 'admin_ids':
      return validateAdminIds(value)
    case 'social_links':
      return validateSocialLinks(value)
    default:
      return `Unknown app field: ${field}`
  }
}
```

```ts
import { computed } from 'vue'
import type { Ref } from 'vue'
import type { AppModel } from '../../../../../../../models/core/app.model'

export function useAppComputed(
  app: Ref<AppModel | null | undefined>,
  pending?: Ref<boolean>
) {
  const isPending = computed(() => Boolean(pending?.value))
  const isLoading = computed(() => isPending.value || app.value === undefined)

  const isResolved = computed(() => {
    if (isPending.value) return false
    return app.value !== undefined
  })

  const adminIds = computed(() => {
    const raw = Array.isArray(app.value?.admin_ids)
      ? (app.value?.admin_ids as Array<string | null | undefined>)
      : []

    return Array.from(
      new Set(
        raw
          .map((id) => (typeof id === 'string' ? id.trim() : ''))
          .filter((id) => id.length > 0)
      )
    )
  })

  const isInitialized = computed(() => {
    if (!isResolved.value) return false
    return adminIds.value.length > 0
  })

  return {
    isLoading,
    isResolved,
    isInitialized,
  }
}
```

```ts
import type { Ref } from 'vue'
import type { AppModel } from '../../../../../../../models/core/app.model'
import type { AppSocialLinks } from '../../../../../../../models/core/app.supporting'
import { useResolvedColorMode } from '../../../../../app/useColorMode'

export namespace AppCard {
  export type Card = {
    id: string
    to: string

    // Media (empty string means unset)
    thumbnailUrl: string

    displayName: string
    ecosystem: string
    badges: string[]

    tagline: string
    shortName: string
    role: string
    userCount: number

    description: string
    shortBio: string
    longBio: string

    logoUrl: string
    wordmarkLightUrl: string
    wordmarkDarkUrl: string

    // Always safe to render (empty string if none)
    wordmarkUrl: string

    socialLinks: AppSocialLinks
  }
}

function safeMedia(app: AppModel) {
  return (
    app.media ?? {
      thumbnail_url: '',
      logo_url: '',
      wordmark_light_url: '',
      wordmark_dark_url: '',
      cover_url: '',
    }
  )
}

function safeDerived(app: AppModel) {
  return app.derived ?? { user_count: 0 }
}

export function useAppInterface(appRef?: Ref<AppModel | null | undefined>) {
  const resolvedMode = useResolvedColorMode()

  function resolveWordmarkUrl(app: AppModel): string {
    const media = safeMedia(app)
    return resolvedMode.value === 'dark'
      ? media.wordmark_dark_url
      : media.wordmark_light_url
  }

  function map(app: AppModel): AppCard.Card {
    const media = safeMedia(app)
    const derived = safeDerived(app)

    return {
      id: app.id,
      to: `/apps/${encodeURIComponent(app.id)}`,

      thumbnailUrl: media.thumbnail_url,

      displayName: app.app_name,
      ecosystem: app.ecosystem,
      badges: [],

      tagline: app.tagline,
      shortName: app.app_short_name,
      role: app.role != null ? String(app.role) : '',
      userCount: typeof derived.user_count === 'number' ? derived.user_count : 0,

      description: app.description,
      shortBio: app.short_bio,
      longBio: app.long_bio,

      logoUrl: media.logo_url,
      wordmarkLightUrl: media.wordmark_light_url,
      wordmarkDarkUrl: media.wordmark_dark_url,
      wordmarkUrl: resolveWordmarkUrl(app),

      socialLinks: (app.social_links ?? {}) as AppSocialLinks,
    }
  }

  function card(target?: AppModel | null | undefined): AppCard.Card | null {
    const app = target ?? appRef?.value ?? null
    return app ? map(app) : null
  }

  function searchText(app: AppModel): string {
    return `${app.app_name} ${app.app_short_name} ${app.ecosystem} ${app.id}`
      .toLowerCase()
  }

  return { card, searchText }
}
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/profile/fetch/useProfileCollection.ts

```ts
import { computed, watchEffect } from 'vue'
import { collection } from 'firebase/firestore'
import { useNuxtApp } from '#imports'
import { useFirestore, useCollection } from 'vuefire'
import { useFireUXConfig } from '../../../../app/FireUXConfig'
import type {
  CoreProfileBase,
  ProfileConfig,
} from '../../../../../../models/core/profile.model'
import { useUserCollection } from '../../user/fetch/useUserCollection'
import { useFirestoreRead } from '../../../operations/useFirestoreRead'
import type { Ref } from 'vue'
import type { User } from '../../../../../../models/core/user.model'

type UserSummary = Pick<User, 'id' | 'display_name' | 'avatar'> &
  Partial<Pick<User, 'handle' | 'email'>>

export function useProfileCollection<
  TProfile extends CoreProfileBase = CoreProfileBase
>(config: ProfileConfig) {
  const db = useFirestore()
  const nuxtApp = useNuxtApp()
  const { isTenant, appId } = useFireUXConfig()
  const { firestoreFetchDoc } = useFirestoreRead()

  const idFieldOptions = { idField: 'id' } as Record<string, unknown>

  const globalProfiles = useCollection<TProfile>(
    collection(db, config.collectionName) as any,
    idFieldOptions as any
  )

  const localProfiles =
    isTenant && appId
      ? useCollection<Partial<TProfile>>(
          collection(db, 'apps', appId, config.collectionName) as any,
          idFieldOptions as any
        )
      : null

  const { users } = useUserCollection()
  const coreUserRefs = new Map<string, Ref<User | undefined>>()

  const ensureCoreUserRef = (id?: string | null) => {
    if (!id) return undefined
    if (!coreUserRefs.has(id)) {
      const ref = nuxtApp.runWithContext(() =>
        firestoreFetchDoc<User>('users', id)
      ) as Ref<User | undefined>
      coreUserRefs.set(id, ref)
    }
    return coreUserRefs.get(id)
  }

  const collectProfileUserIds = () => {
    const ids = new Set<string>()
    const appendFrom = (entries?: Array<Partial<TProfile>>) => {
      for (const profile of entries ?? []) {
        if (!profile) continue
        const id = profile.id?.toString().trim()
        if (id) ids.add(id)
      }
    }
    appendFrom(globalProfiles.value as Array<Partial<TProfile>> | undefined)
    if (localProfiles) {
      appendFrom(localProfiles.value as Array<Partial<TProfile>> | undefined)
    }
    return ids
  }

  watchEffect(() => {
    const ids = collectProfileUserIds()
    ids.forEach((id) => {
      ensureCoreUserRef(id)
    })
  })

  const userMap = computed(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, UserSummary>()
    for (const entry of users.value ?? []) {
      if (!entry?.id) continue
      map.set(entry.id, {
        id: entry.id,
        display_name: entry.display_name,
        avatar: entry.avatar,
        handle: entry.handle,
        email: entry.email,
      })
    }
    return map
  })

  const resolveUserForProfile = (profile?: TProfile) => {
    if (!profile) return undefined
    const id = profile.id
    if (!id) return undefined

    const enriched = userMap.value.get(id)
    if (enriched) {
      return { ...enriched }
    }

    const coreUser = coreUserRefs.get(id)?.value
    if (coreUser) {
      return { ...coreUser }
    }

    return undefined
  }

  const attachUser = (
    entries: TProfile[] | null | undefined
  ): Array<TProfile & { user?: User | UserSummary }> => {
    if (!entries?.length) return []
    return entries.map((profile) => {
      const resolvedUser = resolveUserForProfile(profile)
      if (!resolvedUser) return profile
      return {
        ...profile,
        user: resolvedUser as any,
      } as TProfile & { user?: User | UserSummary }
    })
  }

  const globalProfilesWithUser = computed<
    Array<TProfile & { user?: User | UserSummary }>
  >(() =>
    attachUser((globalProfiles.value ?? []) as TProfile[])
  )

  const localProfilesWithUser = localProfiles
    ? computed<Array<TProfile & { user?: User | UserSummary }>>(() =>
        attachUser((localProfiles.value ?? []) as TProfile[])
      )
    : null

  return {
    globalProfiles,
    localProfiles,
    globalProfilesWithUser,
    localProfilesWithUser,
  }
}
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/profile/fetch/useProfileFetch.ts

```ts
// FILE: packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/profile/fetch/useProfileFetch.ts
import { doc } from 'firebase/firestore'
import { useFirestore, useDocument } from 'vuefire'
import { computed, isRef } from 'vue'
import { useFireUXConfig } from '../../../../app/FireUXConfig'
import type { Ref } from 'vue'
import type {
  AppProfileBase,
  CoreProfileBase,
  ProfileConfig,
} from '../../../../../../models/core/profile.model'

/**
 * Minimal profile fetch:
 * - Fires global + app listeners (when path pieces exist)
 * - Returns refs directly (no computed merge)
 */
export type ProfileRefs2<
  TCore extends CoreProfileBase = CoreProfileBase,
  TApp extends AppProfileBase = AppProfileBase,
> = {
  coreProfile: Ref<TCore | undefined | null>
  appProfile: Ref<Partial<TApp> | undefined | null>
}

// Back-compat alias (most call sites only provide the core doc type)
export type ProfileRefs<
  TCore extends CoreProfileBase = CoreProfileBase,
  TApp extends AppProfileBase = AppProfileBase,
> = ProfileRefs2<TCore, TApp>

export function useProfileFetch<
  TCore extends CoreProfileBase = CoreProfileBase,
  TApp extends AppProfileBase = AppProfileBase,
>(
  id: string | null | undefined | Ref<string | null | undefined>,
  config: ProfileConfig
) {
  const db = useFirestore()
  const { isTenant, appId } = useFireUXConfig()

  const uid = computed(() => (isRef(id) ? id.value : id))

  const coreDoc = computed(() =>
    uid.value ? (doc(db, config.collectionName, uid.value) as any) : null
  )

  /**
   * Canon: Tenant profile overlay (domain deltas)
   * - Path: `apps/{appId}/{domainCollection}/{uid}` (e.g. `apps/niederhorn/chefs/{uid}`)
   * - This IS a tenant delta layer for domain profiles (Chef/Agent/Supplier/Professional).
   * - We only read/write it when `isTenant === true` to avoid operator apps (e.g. `misebox-app`)
   *   accidentally behaving like a tenant.
   * - If you need to admin-fetch a specific tenant’s overlay while in ecosystem mode,
   *   do it via an explicit targetAppId/path (not via “current app hydration”).
   */
  const appDoc = computed(() =>
    uid.value && isTenant && appId
      ? (doc(db, 'apps', appId, config.collectionName, uid.value) as any)
      : null
  )

  const { data: coreProfile, pending: corePending } = useDocument<
    TCore | undefined
  >(coreDoc as any)

  const { data: appProfile, pending: appPending } = useDocument<
    Partial<TApp> | undefined
  >(appDoc as any)

  const profile: ProfileRefs<TCore, TApp> = { coreProfile, appProfile }
  const pending = computed(
    () => Boolean(corePending.value) || Boolean(appPending?.value)
  )

  return { profile, pending }
}
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/profile/mutations/useProfileEnsure.ts

```ts
import { arrayUnion, doc, getDoc, serverTimestamp } from 'firebase/firestore'
import { useFirestore } from 'vuefire'
import type { ProfileConfig } from '../../../../../../models/core/profile.model'
import { useFireUXConfig } from '../../../../app/FireUXConfig'
import { useFirestoreManager } from '../../../operations/useFirestoreManager'
import { requireUid } from '../../../utils/useEnsureCommon'

type EnsureResult = {
  createdCore: boolean
  createdApp: boolean
}

/**
 * Minimal profile ensure.
 * - Upserts the core profile document `<collection>/<uid>`
 * - When tenant scoped, also upserts `apps/<appId>/<collection>/<uid>`
 */
export function useProfileEnsure(config: ProfileConfig) {
  const db = useFirestore()
  const { setDocument, updateDocument } = useFirestoreManager()
  const { isTenant, appId } = useFireUXConfig()

  const ensure = async (): Promise<EnsureResult> => {
    const { uid } = await requireUid()

    let createdCore = false
    let createdApp = false

    const coreRef = doc(db, config.collectionName, uid)
    const coreSnapshot = await getDoc(coreRef)
    if (!coreSnapshot.exists()) {
      await setDocument(config.collectionName, uid, {
        id: uid,
        title: '',
        subtitle: '',
        tagline: '',
        tags: [],
        created_at: serverTimestamp(),
        updated_at: serverTimestamp(),
      } as any, { mode: 'time' })
      createdCore = true
    } else {
      // Backfill required fields for older docs.
      const existing = coreSnapshot.data() as any
      const patch: any = {}
      if (typeof existing?.id !== 'string') patch.id = uid
      if (typeof existing?.title !== 'string') patch.title = ''
      if (typeof existing?.subtitle !== 'string') patch.subtitle = ''
      if (typeof existing?.tagline !== 'string') patch.tagline = ''
      if (!Array.isArray(existing?.tags)) patch.tags = []
      if (!existing?.created_at) patch.created_at = serverTimestamp()
      if (!existing?.updated_at) patch.updated_at = serverTimestamp()
      if (Object.keys(patch).length) {
        await updateDocument(config.collectionName, uid, patch)
      }
    }

    if (isTenant && appId) {
      const appCollection = `apps/${appId}/${config.collectionName}`
      const appRef = doc(db, 'apps', appId, config.collectionName, uid)
      const appSnapshot = await getDoc(appRef)
      if (!appSnapshot.exists()) {
        await setDocument(appCollection, uid, {
          id: uid,
          created_at: serverTimestamp(),
          updated_at: serverTimestamp(),
        } as any, { mode: 'time' })
        createdApp = true
      } else {
        const existing = appSnapshot.data() as any
        const patch: any = {}
        if (typeof existing?.id !== 'string') patch.id = uid
        if (!existing?.created_at) patch.created_at = serverTimestamp()
        if (!existing?.updated_at) patch.updated_at = serverTimestamp()
        if (Object.keys(patch).length) {
          await updateDocument(appCollection, uid, patch)
        }
      }
    }

    if (config.id) {
      try {
        await updateDocument('users', uid, {
          profiles: arrayUnion(config.id) as unknown as string[],
        })
      } catch (error) {
        if (import.meta.dev) {
          console.warn('[useProfileEnsure] failed to tag user profile', {
            uid,
            profileId: config.id,
            error,
          })
        }
      }
    }

    return { createdCore, createdApp }
  }

  return { ensure }
}

```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/profile/mutations/useProfileUpdate.ts

```ts
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { useFirestoreUpdate } from '../../../operations/useFirestoreUpdate'
import { useFireUXConfig } from '../../../../app/FireUXConfig'
import type {
  AppProfileBase,
  CoreProfileBase,
  ProfileConfig,
} from '../../../../../../models/core/profile.model'
import type { ProfileRefs } from '../fetch/useProfileFetch'

type UpdateResult = 'success'
type UpdateScope = 'auto' | 'core' | 'app'

export function useProfileUpdate<
  TCore extends CoreProfileBase = CoreProfileBase,
  TApp extends AppProfileBase = AppProfileBase,
>(profileRefs: ProfileRefs<TCore, TApp>, config: ProfileConfig) {
  const { updateDocument } = useFirestoreUpdate()
  const { appId, role } = useFireUXConfig()

  const updating = ref(false)
  const updateError = ref<Error | null>(null)

  const isTenant = role === 'tenant' && !!appId

  const ensureId = (explicit?: string | null) => {
    const trimmed = explicit?.trim()
    if (trimmed) return trimmed

    const coreId = profileRefs.coreProfile.value?.id
    if (coreId) return coreId

    const appIdCandidate = (
      profileRefs.appProfile.value as { id?: string } | null | undefined
    )?.id
    if (appIdCandidate) return appIdCandidate

    throw new Error(
      `[useProfileUpdate] Missing profile id for ${config.collectionName}`
    )
  }

  const updateCoreProfile = async (
    partial: Partial<TCore>,
    explicitId?: string
  ) => {
    const id = ensureId(explicitId)
    await updateDocument(config.collectionName, id, partial)
  }

  const updateAppProfile = async (
    partial: Partial<TApp>,
    explicitId?: string
  ) => {
    if (!appId) {
      throw new Error(
        '[useProfileUpdate] Missing appId for tenant profile update'
      )
    }
    const id = ensureId(explicitId)
    const collection = `apps/${appId}/${config.collectionName}`
    await updateDocument(collection, id, partial)
  }

  const updateProfile = async (
    partial: any,
    options: { scope?: UpdateScope; id?: string } = {}
  ): Promise<UpdateResult> => {
    const { scope = 'auto', id } = options
    updating.value = true
    updateError.value = null

    try {
      if (scope === 'core') {
        await updateCoreProfile(partial, id)
      } else if (scope === 'app') {
        await updateAppProfile(partial, id)
      } else if (isTenant) {
        await updateAppProfile(partial, id)
      } else {
        await updateCoreProfile(partial, id)
      }

      return 'success'
    } catch (error) {
      updateError.value = error as Error
      throw error
    } finally {
      updating.value = false
    }
  }

  return {
    updateProfile,
    updateCoreProfile,
    updateAppProfile,
    updating,
    updateError,
  }
}

```

```ts
import { computed } from 'vue'
import type {
  AppProfileBase,
  CoreProfileBase,
} from '../../../../../../../models/core/profile.model'
import type { ProfileRefs } from '../../fetch/useProfileFetch'

export function useProfileComputed<
  TCore extends CoreProfileBase = CoreProfileBase,
  TApp extends AppProfileBase = AppProfileBase,
>(profileRefs: ProfileRefs<TCore, TApp>) {
  type MergedProfile = Partial<TCore> & Partial<TApp>

  const profile = computed<MergedProfile | null>(() => {
    const core = profileRefs.coreProfile.value
    const overlay = profileRefs.appProfile.value
    if (!core && !overlay) return null

    const base = core ? { ...core } : ({} as Partial<TCore>)
    if (overlay) Object.assign(base, overlay)
    return base as MergedProfile
  })

  return { profile }
}
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/fetch/useUserCollection.ts

```ts
import { computed, watch } from 'vue'
import type { Ref } from 'vue'
import { useNuxtApp } from '#imports'
import { useFirestoreRead } from '../../../operations/useFirestoreRead'
import { useAppUsers } from '../../app/fetch/useAppUsers'
import type {
  User,
  AppUser,
} from '../../../../../../models/core/user.model'

type EnrichedUser = {
  id: string
  display_name: string
  avatar: string
  handle?: string
  email?: string
  profiles?: string[]
  appUser?: AppUser | null
  coreUser?: User | null
}

/**
 * Hydrates `/apps/{appId}/users` entries with their `/users/{id}` records.
 */
export function useUserCollection() {
  const { firestoreFetchDoc } = useFirestoreRead()
  const { users: appUsers, pending } = useAppUsers()

  const nuxtApp = useNuxtApp()
  const userCache = new Map<string, Ref<User | undefined>>()
  const ensureCoreUser = (id?: string | null) => {
    if (!id) return undefined
    if (!userCache.has(id)) {
      const ref = nuxtApp.runWithContext(() =>
        firestoreFetchDoc<User>('users', id)
      ) as Ref<User | undefined>
      userCache.set(id, ref)
    }
    return userCache.get(id)
  }

  watch(
    () => (appUsers.value ?? []).map((member) => member?.id).filter(Boolean),
    (ids: string[]) => {
      ids.forEach((id: string) => ensureCoreUser(id))
    },
    { immediate: true }
  )

  const fulfilled = computed<EnrichedUser[]>(() => {
    const members = appUsers.value ?? []
    if (!members.length) return []

    const enriched: EnrichedUser[] = []
    for (const member of members) {
      const record = ensureCoreUser(member.id)?.value
      if (!record?.id) continue

      enriched.push({
        id: record.id,
        display_name: record.display_name ?? record.id,
        avatar: record.avatar ?? '',
        handle: record.handle,
        email: record.email,
        profiles: record.profiles ?? [],
        appUser: member,
        coreUser: record,
      })
    }
    return enriched
  })

  return {
    fulfilled,
    users: fulfilled,
    pending,
  }
}

```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/fetch/useUserCollectionByAppId.ts

```ts
import { computed, watch, isRef, type Ref } from 'vue'
import { useNuxtApp } from '#imports'
import { useFirestoreRead } from '../../../operations/useFirestoreRead'
import { useAppUsersByAppId } from '../../app/fetch/useAppUsersByAppId'
import type { User, AppUser } from '../../../../../../models/core/user.model'

type EnrichedUser = {
  id: string
  coreUser?: User | null
  appUser?: AppUser | null
}

/**
 * Hydrates `/apps/{appId}/users` entries with their `/users/{id}` records.
 * This version is route/app-driven (not bound to FireUXConfig.appId).
 */
export function useUserCollectionByAppId(
  appId: string | null | undefined | Ref<string | null | undefined>
) {
  const resolvedAppId = computed(() => (isRef(appId) ? appId.value : appId) ?? null)

  const { firestoreFetchDoc } = useFirestoreRead()

  const { users: appUsers, pending } = useAppUsersByAppId(resolvedAppId.value)

  const nuxtApp = useNuxtApp()
  const userCache = new Map<string, Ref<User | undefined>>()

  const ensureCoreUser = (id?: string | null) => {
    if (!id) return undefined
    if (!userCache.has(id)) {
      const ref = nuxtApp.runWithContext(() =>
        firestoreFetchDoc<User>('users', id)
      ) as Ref<User | undefined>
      userCache.set(id, ref)
    }
    return userCache.get(id)
  }

  watch(
    () => (appUsers.value ?? []).map((member) => member?.id).filter(Boolean),
    (ids: string[]) => {
      ids.forEach((id: string) => ensureCoreUser(id))
    },
    { immediate: true }
  )

  const fulfilled = computed<EnrichedUser[]>(() => {
    const members = appUsers.value ?? []
    if (!members.length) return []

    const enriched: EnrichedUser[] = []
    for (const member of members) {
      const record = ensureCoreUser(member.id)?.value
      if (!record?.id) continue

      enriched.push({
        id: record.id,
        coreUser: record,
        appUser: member,
      })
    }

    return enriched
  })

  return {
    users: fulfilled,
    fulfilled,
    pending,
  }
}
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/fetch/useUserFetch.ts

```ts
import { doc } from 'firebase/firestore'
import { useFirestore, useDocument } from 'vuefire'
import { computed, isRef } from 'vue'
import type { Ref } from 'vue'
import { useFireUXConfig } from '../../../../app/FireUXConfig'
import type {
  User,
  AppUser,
} from '../../../../../../models/core/user.model'

function asStringArray(value: unknown): string[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return []
  return value.filter((v): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.length > 0)
}

function normalizeCoreUser(raw: User, fallbackId: string): User {
  const anyRaw = raw as any
  return {
    ...raw,
    id: raw.id ?? fallbackId,
    display_name: (raw as any).display_name ?? raw.id ?? fallbackId,
    avatar: (raw as any).avatar ?? '',
    handle: (raw as any).handle ?? '',
    email: (raw as any).email ?? '',
    bio: (raw as any).bio ?? '',
    profiles: asStringArray(anyRaw.profiles),
    userOf: asStringArray(anyRaw.userOf),
    adminOf: asStringArray(anyRaw.adminOf),
  }
}

export function useUserFetch(
  id: string | null | undefined | Ref<string | null | undefined>
) {
  const { appId } = useFireUXConfig()

  const uid = computed(() => (isRef(id) ? id.value : id))

  // Auth-bound user docs are not reliably available during SSR.
  // Avoid VueFire SSR warnings by only binding Firestore sources on the client.
  if (import.meta.server) {
    const coreUser = computed<User | null | undefined>(() => null)
    const appUser = computed<AppUser | null | undefined>(() => null)
    const user = computed<User | null>(() => null)
    const pending = computed(() => false)
    return { user, coreUser, appUser, pending }
  }

  const db = useFirestore()

  const coreDoc = computed(() =>
    uid.value ? (doc(db, 'users', uid.value) as any) : null
  )

  /**
   * Canon: AppUser membership overlay
   * - Path: `apps/{appId}/users/{uid}`
    * - This is NOT a “tenant profile overlay”. It exists to hold app-scoped role,
    *   permissions, and onboarding state.
   * - Therefore it is valid for any app context (including operator apps like `misebox-app`)
   *   whenever `appId` exists.
   */
  const appDoc = computed(() =>
    uid.value && appId
      ? (doc(db, 'apps', appId, 'users', uid.value) as any)
      : null
  )

  const { data: coreUserRef, pending: corePending } = useDocument<
    User | undefined
  >(coreDoc as any)

  const { data: appUserRef, pending: appPending } = useDocument<
    AppUser | undefined
  >(appDoc as any)

  const coreUser = computed<User | null | undefined>(() => {
    if (corePending.value) return undefined

    const raw = coreUserRef.value
    if (!raw) return null

    const fallbackId = uid.value ?? ''
    return normalizeCoreUser(raw as User, fallbackId)
  })

  const appUser = computed<AppUser | null | undefined>(() => {
    if (!appDoc.value) return null
    if (appPending.value) return undefined
    return appUserRef.value ?? null
  })

  const user = computed<User | null>(() => coreUser.value ?? null)

  const pending = computed(
    () => Boolean(corePending.value) || Boolean(appPending?.value)
  )

  return { user, coreUser, appUser, pending }
}

export type UserRefs = ReturnType<typeof useUserFetch>
```

```ts
import { ref, type Ref } from 'vue'
import type { User } from '../../../../../../models/core/user.model'
import type { UserRefs } from '../fetch/useUserFetch'

type UserSource = Ref<User | null | undefined> | UserRefs | undefined

export function useUserDelete(userRef?: UserSource) {
  const deleting = ref(false)
  const deleteError = ref<Error | null>(null)

  async function deleteUser(id?: string) {
    const resolvedId = (() => {
      if (id) return id
      if (!userRef) return undefined
      const maybeGrouped = userRef as any
      if (maybeGrouped && 'coreUser' in maybeGrouped) {
        return maybeGrouped.coreUser?.value?.id
      }
      return (userRef as Ref<User | null | undefined>).value?.id
    })()

    if (!resolvedId) throw new Error('User id is required')

    deleting.value = true
    deleteError.value = null

    try {
      // Placeholder; real delete not wired yet.
      console.warn('[fireux-core] deleteUser stub – no deletion performed', {
        id: resolvedId,
      })
      return 'not-implemented' as const
    } catch (error: any) {
      deleteError.value =
        error instanceof Error ? error : new Error('Unknown error')
      throw deleteError.value
    } finally {
      deleting.value = false
    }
  }

  return { deleteUser, deleting, deleteError }
}
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/mutations/useUserEnsure.ts

```ts
// Action: ENSURE · Phases: 1–4
import { doc, getDoc } from 'firebase/firestore'
import { useFirestore } from 'vuefire'
import type { AppUser, User } from '../../../../../../models/core/user.model'
import { useFireUXConfig } from '../../../../app/FireUXConfig'
import { useFirestoreCreate } from '../../../operations/useFirestoreCreate'
import { requireUid } from '../../../utils/useEnsureCommon'

export function useUserEnsure() {
  const db = useFirestore()
  const { setDocument } = useFirestoreCreate()

  async function ensureUser(): Promise<{
    createdCore: boolean
    createdApp: boolean
    id: string
  }> {
    const { uid, auth } = await requireUid()
    const { appId } = useFireUXConfig()

    let createdCore = false
    let createdApp = false

    const coreRef = doc(db, 'users', uid)
    const coreSnap = await getDoc(coreRef)
    if (!coreSnap.exists()) {
      const payload = {
        id: uid,
        display_name: auth.displayName ?? auth.email ?? '',
        email: auth.email ?? '',
        avatar: auth.photoURL ?? '',
        handle: '',
        bio: '',
        profiles: [],
        userOf: [],
        adminOf: [],
        notifications: [],
      } as Omit<User, 'created_at' | 'updated_at' | 'creator_id'>

      await setDocument<User>('users', uid, payload as User, {
        creator: 'require',
      } as any)
      createdCore = true
    }

    const appCollection = `apps/${appId}/users`
    const appRef = doc(db, 'apps', appId, 'users', uid)
    const appSnap = await getDoc(appRef)
    if (!appSnap.exists()) {
      const payload = {
        id: uid,
        role: 'user',
        notifications: [],
      } as Omit<AppUser, 'created_at' | 'updated_at' | 'creator_id'>

      await setDocument<AppUser>(appCollection, uid, payload as AppUser, {
        creator: 'require',
      } as any)
      createdApp = true
    }

    return { createdCore, createdApp, id: uid }
  }

  return { ensureUser }
}
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/mutations/useUserUpdate.ts

```ts
import type { UserRefs } from '../fetch/useUserFetch'
import { useCoreUserUpdate } from '../utils/update/useCoreUserUpdate'
import { useAppUserUpdate } from '../utils/update/useAppUserUpdate'
import { useFireUXConfig } from '../../../../app/FireUXConfig'

const loggedInitKeys = new Set<string>()

export function useUserUpdate(user: UserRefs, sourceLabel = 'unspecified') {
  const core = useCoreUserUpdate(user)
  const app = useAppUserUpdate(user)
  const cfg = useFireUXConfig()

  // Canon: both docs use the SAME uid as their document id
  const coreUid = user.coreUser?.value?.id ?? user.user?.value?.id ?? null

  // NOTE: appUser.id is ALSO uid (NOT appId)
  const appUserUid = user.appUser?.value?.id ?? null

  const activeAppId = cfg.isTenant ? cfg.appId : cfg.globalAppId

  if (cfg.devMode) {
    if (coreUid && appUserUid && coreUid !== appUserUid) {
      throw new Error(
        `[useUserUpdate] core uid (${coreUid}) != appUser uid (${appUserUid}); source=${sourceLabel}`
      )
    }
  }

  // During initial boot it is normal for user/app context to be unavailable.
  // Only log once when fully initialized, and only in dev.
  if (cfg.devMode && coreUid && activeAppId) {
    const key = `${sourceLabel}:${coreUid}:${activeAppId}`
    if (!loggedInitKeys.has(key)) {
      loggedInitKeys.add(key)
      console.info('[useUserUpdate] initialized', {
        uid: coreUid,
        appId: activeAppId,
        source: sourceLabel,
      })
    }
  }

  return {
    core,
    app,
  }
}
```

```ts
import { useAuth } from '../../../firebase/useAuth'
import { useUserFetch } from './fetch/useUserFetch'
import { useUserComputed } from './utils/view/useUserComputed'
import { useUserEnsure } from './mutations/useUserEnsure'
import { useUserUpdate } from './mutations/useUserUpdate'
import { useUserDelete } from './mutations/useUserDelete'
import { useUserInterface } from './utils/view/useUserInterface'

export type { User } from '../../../../../models/core/user.model'

/**
 * useUser
 * - Resolves both coreUser (global) and appUser (tenant overlay)
 * - Defaults to the authenticated Firebase UID
 * - For arbitrary UID, call useUserFetch(uid) directly
 */
export function useUser() {
  const { uid } = useAuth()
  const refs = useUserFetch(uid)
  const { user, coreUser, appUser, pending } = refs

  return {
    user,
    coreUser,
    appUser,
    pending,
    ...useUserComputed(refs, pending),
    ...useUserInterface(user),
    ...useUserEnsure(),
    ...useUserUpdate(refs, 'useUser'),
    ...useUserDelete(refs),
  }
}
```

```ts
import {
  arrayRemove,
  arrayUnion,
  doc,
  getDoc,
  increment,
  serverTimestamp,
  writeBatch,
  type DocumentSnapshot,
} from 'firebase/firestore'
import { useFirestore } from 'vuefire'

import type { FirebaseTimestamp } from '../../../../../../../types/firebase'
import type {
  AppUser,
  User,
} from '../../../../../../models/core/user.model'
import type { NotificationScope, UserNotification } from '../../../../../../models/core/user.supporting'
import { useRequireUser } from '../../../../firebase/useRequireUser'
import { useFirestoreManager } from '../../../operations/useFirestoreManager'

export type EnsureCoreOptions = {
  displayName?: string
  email?: string
  avatar?: string | null
  ecosystemName?: string
}

export type EnsureCoreResult = {
  created: boolean
  snapshot?: DocumentSnapshot<User>
  displayName: string
}

export async function ensureCoreUserDocument(
  uid: string,
  options: EnsureCoreOptions = {}
): Promise<EnsureCoreResult> {
  const db = useFirestore()
  const ref = doc(db, 'users', uid)
  const snapshot = await getDoc(ref)

  if (snapshot.exists()) {
    const data = snapshot.data() as User | undefined
    const existingName = data?.display_name
    if (!existingName) {
      throw new Error('[ensureCoreUserDocument] Existing user missing display_name')
    }

    // Backfill canon-required fields for older documents.
    const patch: Partial<User> = {}
    if (typeof (data as any)?.avatar !== 'string') patch.avatar = ''
    if (typeof (data as any)?.handle !== 'string') patch.handle = makeHandle(existingName, uid)
    if (typeof (data as any)?.email !== 'string') patch.email = options.email ?? ''
    if (typeof (data as any)?.bio !== 'string') patch.bio = ''
    if (!Array.isArray((data as any)?.profiles)) patch.profiles = []
    if (!Array.isArray((data as any)?.userOf)) patch.userOf = []
    if (!Array.isArray((data as any)?.adminOf)) patch.adminOf = []
    if (!Array.isArray((data as any)?.notifications)) patch.notifications = []
    if (!(data as any)?.created_at) (patch as any).created_at = serverTimestamp()
    if (!(data as any)?.updated_at) (patch as any).updated_at = serverTimestamp()

    if (Object.keys(patch).length) {
      const { updateDocument } = useFirestoreManager()
      await updateDocument<User>('users', uid, patch as any)
    }

    return {
      created: false,
      snapshot: snapshot as DocumentSnapshot<User>,
      displayName: existingName,
    }
  }

  const displayName = options.displayName
  if (!displayName) {
    throw new Error('[ensureCoreUserDocument] Missing displayName')
  }
  const email = options.email
  if (!email) {
    throw new Error('[ensureCoreUserDocument] Missing email')
  }
  // EnsureCore is responsible for creating the core document, but should not
  // create membership side effects (like notifications) by default.
  const payload: User = {
    id: uid,
    display_name: displayName,
    avatar: options.avatar ?? '',
    handle: makeHandle(displayName, uid),
    email,
    bio: '',
    profiles: [],
    userOf: [],
    adminOf: [],
    notifications: [],
    created_at: serverTimestamp() as unknown as FirebaseTimestamp,
    updated_at: serverTimestamp() as unknown as FirebaseTimestamp,
  }

  const { setDocument } = useFirestoreManager()
  await setDocument<User>('users', uid, payload, { mode: 'date' })

  return { created: true, displayName }
}

export type EnsureMembershipResult = { created: boolean }

export async function ensureUserAppMembership(
  appId: string,
  uid: string,
  membershipRole: 'admin' | 'user'
): Promise<EnsureMembershipResult> {
  await useRequireUser()
  const db = useFirestore()

  const appUserRef = doc(db, 'apps', appId, 'users', uid)
  const appRef = doc(db, 'apps', appId)
  const userRef = doc(db, 'users', uid)

  const [appUserSnap, userSnap] = await Promise.all([
    getDoc(appUserRef),
    getDoc(userRef),
  ])

  if (!userSnap.exists()) {
    throw new Error(
      `[ensureUserAppMembership] Missing core user doc for uid=${uid}; call ensureCoreUserDocument first`
    )
  }

  const created = !appUserSnap.exists()
  const batch = writeBatch(db)

  // 1) Canonical membership overlay
  if (appUserSnap.exists()) {
    const current = appUserSnap.data() as AppUser | undefined
    if (current?.role !== membershipRole) {
      batch.update(appUserRef, {
        role: membershipRole,
        updated_at: serverTimestamp(),
      })
    }
  } else {
    batch.set(
      appUserRef,
      {
        id: uid,
        role: membershipRole,
        notifications: [],
        created_at: serverTimestamp(),
        updated_at: serverTimestamp(),
      } as any,
      { merge: false }
    )
  }

  // 2) App mirrors
  if (created) {
    batch.update(appRef, {
      'derived.user_count': increment(1),
      updated_at: serverTimestamp(),
    })
  }

  // Keep all admin mirrors in sync with the app-scoped role.
  // Canon: AppUser.role (apps/{appId}/users/{uid})
  // Mirrors: apps/{appId}.admin_ids[], users/{uid}.adminOf[]
  batch.update(appRef, {
    admin_ids: (membershipRole === 'admin'
      ? arrayUnion(uid)
      : arrayRemove(uid)) as unknown as App['admin_ids'],
    updated_at: serverTimestamp(),
  })

  // 3) Core user mirrors (and ensure core user exists)
  const membershipUpdates: any = {
    userOf: arrayUnion(appId) as unknown as string[],
    adminOf: (membershipRole === 'admin'
      ? arrayUnion(appId)
      : arrayRemove(appId)) as unknown as string[],
    updated_at: serverTimestamp(),
  }

  batch.update(userRef, membershipUpdates as any)

  await batch.commit()
  return { created }
}

export type RemoveMembershipResult = { removed: boolean }

export async function removeUserAppMembership(
  appId: string,
  uid: string
): Promise<RemoveMembershipResult> {
  await useRequireUser()
  const db = useFirestore()

  const appUserRef = doc(db, 'apps', appId, 'users', uid)
  const appRef = doc(db, 'apps', appId)
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/utils/update/useAppUserUpdate.ts

```ts
import {
    addDoc,
    arrayRemove,
    arrayUnion,
    collection,
    doc,
    getDoc,
    increment,
} from 'firebase/firestore'
import { useFirestore } from 'vuefire'
import type { UserNotification } from '../../../../../../../models/core/user.supporting'
import { useFireUXConfig } from '../../../../../app/FireUXConfig'
import { useFirestoreDelete } from '../../../../operations/useFirestoreDelete'
import { useFirestoreUpdate } from '../../../../operations/useFirestoreUpdate'
import type { UserRefs } from '../../fetch/useUserFetch'
import { createUserNotification } from '../ensureHelpers'

type AppMembershipActions = {
  /** Single, canonical role toggle (admin <-> user). */
  setAdmin: (makeAdmin: boolean) => Promise<void>

  /** Leaves the current app (removes membership overlay + mirrors). */
  leave: () => Promise<void>
}

type AppNotificationActions = {
  /** Writes non-membership notifications. */
  push: (message: string) => Promise<UserNotification>
}

export function useAppUserUpdate(user: UserRefs) {
  const cfg = useFireUXConfig()
  const db = useFirestore()
  const { updateDocument } = useFirestoreUpdate()
  const { deleteDocument } = useFirestoreDelete()

  const requireContext = () => {
    const uid = user.coreUser?.value?.id ?? user.user?.value?.id
    if (!uid) throw new Error('[useAppUserUpdate] Missing core user uid')

    const appId = cfg.appId
    if (!appId) throw new Error('[useAppUserUpdate] Missing appId')

    return { uid, appId }
  }

  const membership: AppMembershipActions = {
    setAdmin: async (makeAdmin) => {
      const { uid, appId } = requireContext()
      const role = makeAdmin ? 'admin' : 'user'

      await updateDocument(`apps/${appId}/users`, uid, { role })

      await updateDocument('apps', appId, {
        admin_ids: makeAdmin
          ? (arrayUnion(uid) as unknown as string[])
          : (arrayRemove(uid) as unknown as string[]),
      })

      await updateDocument('users', uid, {
        userOf: arrayUnion(appId) as unknown as string[],
        adminOf: makeAdmin
          ? (arrayUnion(appId) as unknown as string[])
          : (arrayRemove(appId) as unknown as string[]),
      })
    },
    leave: async () => {
      const { uid, appId } = requireContext()

      const appUserRef = doc(db, 'apps', appId, 'users', uid)
      const appUserSnap = await getDoc(appUserRef)
      const existed = appUserSnap.exists()

      await deleteDocument(`apps/${appId}/users`, uid)

      await updateDocument('apps', appId, {
        admin_ids: arrayRemove(uid) as unknown as string[],
        ...(existed ? { 'derived.user_count': increment(-1) } : {}),
      })

      await updateDocument('users', uid, {
        userOf: arrayRemove(appId) as unknown as string[],
        adminOf: arrayRemove(appId) as unknown as string[],
      })
    },
  }

  const notifications: AppNotificationActions = {
    push: async (message) => {
      const { uid, appId } = requireContext()

      const notification: UserNotification = createUserNotification({
        message,
        scope: 'app',
        appId,
      })

      await addDoc(collection(db, 'users', uid, 'notifications'), notification)

      return notification
    },
  }

  return {
    membership,
    notifications,
  }
}
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/utils/update/useCoreUserUpdate.ts

```ts
import { addDoc, arrayRemove, arrayUnion, collection } from 'firebase/firestore'
import { useFirestore } from 'vuefire'
import type {
    User,
} from '../../../../../../../models/core/user.model'
import type { UserNotification } from '../../../../../../../models/core/user.supporting'
import { useImageStorage } from '../../../../../firebase/useImageStorage'
import { useFirestoreUpdate } from '../../../../operations/useFirestoreUpdate'
import type { UserRefs } from '../../fetch/useUserFetch'
import { createUserNotification } from '../ensureHelpers'
import { useUserFormattingAndValidation } from '../validation/useUserFormatting'

export function useCoreUserUpdate(user: UserRefs) {
  const { updateDocument } = useFirestoreUpdate()
  const { uploadImage } = useImageStorage()
  const { DisplayName, AvatarUrl, Bio } = useUserFormattingAndValidation()
  const db = useFirestore()

  const core = user.coreUser as { value: User | undefined }

  const requireCoreId = () => {
    const id = core.value?.id
    if (!id) throw new Error('[useCoreUserUpdate] Missing core user id')
    return id
  }

  const updateCore = (data: Partial<User>) =>
    updateDocument<User>('users', requireCoreId(), data)

  const formatAndValidate = <T>(
    formatter: {
      format: (value: any) => T
      validate: (value: T) => { isValid: boolean; message?: string }
    },
    value: unknown,
    fallbackMessage: string
  ) => {
    const formatted = formatter.format(value)
    const validation = formatter.validate(formatted)
    if (!validation.isValid) {
      throw new Error(validation.message || fallbackMessage)
    }
    return formatted
  }

  const profile = {
    rename: async (displayName: string) => {
      const formatted = formatAndValidate(
        DisplayName,
        displayName,
        'Invalid display name'
      )
      await updateCore({ display_name: formatted })
    },
    setAvatarUrl: async (url: string | null) => {
      const formatted = formatAndValidate(
        AvatarUrl,
        url ?? '',
        'Invalid avatar URL'
      )
      await updateCore({ avatar: formatted || '' })
    },
    uploadAvatar: async (source: File | Blob) => {
      const id = requireCoreId()
      const path = `users/${id}/avatar/current`
      const url = await uploadImage(path, source)
      await updateCore({ avatar: url })
      return url
    },
    setBio: async (bio: string) => {
      const formatted = formatAndValidate(Bio, bio ?? '', 'Invalid bio')
      await updateCore({ bio: formatted || '' })
    },
  }

  const normalizeTagId = (value: string) => {
    const trimmed = (value ?? '').trim()
    return trimmed || null
  }

  const tags = {
    add: async (tagId: string) => {
      const normalized = normalizeTagId(tagId)
      if (!normalized) return
      await updateCore({
        profiles: arrayUnion(normalized) as unknown as string[],
      })
    },
    remove: async (tagId: string) => {
      const normalized = normalizeTagId(tagId)
      if (!normalized) return
      await updateCore({
        profiles: arrayRemove(normalized) as unknown as string[],
      })
    },
  }

  const notifications = {
    push: async (message: string) => {
      const id = requireCoreId()
      const notification: UserNotification = createUserNotification({
        message,
        scope: 'ecosystem',
      })

      await addDoc(collection(db, 'users', id, 'notifications'), notification)
      return notification
    },
  }

  const membership = {
    joinApp: async (appId: string, role: 'admin' | 'user' = 'user') => {
      const normalized = String(appId ?? '').trim()
      if (!normalized) return

      await updateCore({
        userOf: arrayUnion(normalized) as unknown as string[],
        adminOf:
          role === 'admin'
            ? (arrayUnion(normalized) as unknown as string[])
            : (arrayRemove(normalized) as unknown as string[]),
      })
    },
    leaveApp: async (appId: string) => {
      const normalized = String(appId ?? '').trim()
      if (!normalized) return

      await updateCore({
        userOf: arrayRemove(normalized) as unknown as string[],
        adminOf: arrayRemove(normalized) as unknown as string[],
      })
    },
  }

  return {
    profile,
    tags,
    notifications,
    membership,
  }
}
```

```ts
// FILE: packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/useUserFormattingAndValidation.ts
const MIN_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH = 2
const MAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH = 60
const MIN_HANDLE_LENGTH = 3
const MAX_HANDLE_LENGTH = 30
const MAX_EMAIL_LENGTH = 254
const EMAIL_REGEX = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/
const MAX_BIO_LENGTH = 280
const MAX_AVATAR_URL_LENGTH = 2048

function validateDisplayName(name: string) {
  const value = (name || '').trim()
  if (!value) return { isValid: false, message: 'Name cannot be empty.' }
  if (value.length < MIN_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH)
    return { isValid: false, message: 'Name is too short.' }
  if (value.length > MAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH)
    return { isValid: false, message: 'Name is too long.' }
  return { isValid: true }
}

function formatDisplayName(name: string) {
  const value = (name || '').trim()
  return value
    .split(/\s+/)
    .map((word) => (word ? word[0].toUpperCase() + word.slice(1) : word))
    .join(' ')
}

function validateHandle(raw: string) {
  const value = String(raw || '').trim()
  if (!value) return { isValid: true }
  const normalized = value.toLowerCase()
  if (normalized.length < MIN_HANDLE_LENGTH)
    return { isValid: false, message: 'Handle too short.' }
  if (normalized.length > MAX_HANDLE_LENGTH)
    return { isValid: false, message: 'Handle too long.' }
  if (!/^[a-z0-9-]+$/.test(normalized)) {
    return {
      isValid: false,
      message: 'Use lowercase letters, numbers, and dashes only.',
    }
  }
  return { isValid: true }
}

function formatHandle(raw: string) {
  let candidate = String(raw || '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
  candidate = candidate.replaceAll(/^@+/g, '')
  candidate = candidate.replaceAll(/\s+/g, '-')
  candidate = candidate.replaceAll(/[^a-z0-9-]/g, '')
  candidate = candidate.replaceAll(/-+/g, '-')
  candidate = candidate.replaceAll(/^-|-$|_/g, '')
  return candidate.slice(0, MAX_HANDLE_LENGTH)
}

function validateEmail(raw: string) {
  const value = (raw || '').trim()
  if (!value) return { isValid: false, message: 'Email cannot be empty.' }
  if (value.length > MAX_EMAIL_LENGTH)
    return { isValid: false, message: 'Email is too long.' }
  if (!EMAIL_REGEX.test(value))
    return { isValid: false, message: 'Enter a valid email address.' }
  return { isValid: true }
}

function formatEmail(raw: string) {
  return (raw || '').trim().toLowerCase()
}

function validateBio(raw: string) {
  const value = typeof raw === 'string' ? raw.trim() : ''
  if (!value) return { isValid: true }
  if (value.length > MAX_BIO_LENGTH) {
    return {
      isValid: false,
      message: `Bio must be ${MAX_BIO_LENGTH} characters or less.`,
    }
  }
  return { isValid: true }
}

function formatBio(raw: string) {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string') return ''
  return raw.replaceAll('\r\n', '\n').trim()
}

function validateAvatarUrl(raw: string | null | undefined) {
  const value = typeof raw === 'string' ? raw.trim() : ''
  if (!value) return { isValid: true }
  if (value.length > MAX_AVATAR_URL_LENGTH) {
    return {
      isValid: false,
      message: 'URL is too long.',
    }
  }

  try {
    const url = new URL(value)
    if (!['http:', 'https:'].includes(url.protocol)) {
      return {
        isValid: false,
        message: 'Use an http or https URL.',
      }
    }
  } catch {
    return {
      isValid: false,
      message: 'Enter a valid URL.',
    }
  }

  return { isValid: true }
}

function formatAvatarUrl(raw: string | null | undefined) {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string') return ''
  return raw.trim()
}

const DisplayName = {
  validate: validateDisplayName,
  format: formatDisplayName,
}

const Handle = {
  validate: validateHandle,
  format: formatHandle,
}

const Email = {
  validate: validateEmail,
  format: formatEmail,
}

const Bio = {
  validate: validateBio,
  format: formatBio,
}

const AvatarUrl = {
  validate: validateAvatarUrl,
  format: formatAvatarUrl,
}

export function useUserFormattingAndValidation() {
  return {
    DisplayName,
    Handle,
    Email,
    Bio,
    AvatarUrl,
  }
}
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/utils/view/useUserComputed.ts

```ts
import { computed } from '#imports'
import { useAuth } from '../../../../../firebase/useAuth'
import { useFireUXConfig } from '../../../../../app/FireUXConfig'
import type {
  User,
  AppUser,
} from '../../../../../../../models/core/user.model'
import type { UserRefs } from '../../fetch/useUserFetch'

type UserCtaKey = 'sign-in' | 'create-core-user' | 'join-app' | 'avatar'

type UserCta = {
  key: UserCtaKey
  label: string
  to: string
}

const CTA_SIGN_IN: UserCta = { key: 'sign-in', label: 'Sign in', to: '/auth' }
const CTA_CREATE_CORE: UserCta = {
  key: 'create-core-user',
  label: 'Create core user',
  to: '',
}
const CTA_JOIN_APP: UserCta = { key: 'join-app', label: 'Join app', to: '' }
const CTA_AVATAR: UserCta = { key: 'avatar', label: '', to: '' }

export function useUserComputed(user: UserRefs, pending?: { value?: boolean }) {
  const coreUser = user.coreUser as { value: User | null | undefined }
  const appUser = user.appUser as { value: AppUser | null | undefined }

  const { uid, isAuthenticated } = useAuth()
  const { isTenant, appId } = useFireUXConfig()

  const isPending = computed(() => Boolean(pending?.value))
  const isLoading = computed(
    () =>
      isPending.value ||
      coreUser.value === undefined ||
      (isTenant && appUser.value === undefined)
  )

  const isResolved = computed(
    () =>
      !isPending.value &&
      coreUser.value !== undefined &&
      (!isTenant || appUser.value !== undefined)
  )
  const hasCoreUser = computed(() => coreUser.value !== null && coreUser.value !== undefined)
  const hasAppUser = computed(() => appUser.value !== null && appUser.value !== undefined)
  const isInitialized = computed(() => {
    if (!isResolved.value) return false
    if (!hasCoreUser.value) return false
    if (isTenant && !hasAppUser.value) return false
    return true
  })
  const currentUser = computed(() => coreUser.value ?? null)

  const isAdmin = computed(() => {
    // If an app-scoped overlay is resolved (even if role is 'user'), treat it as
    // the source of truth for admin UI gating.
    if (appUser.value !== undefined) {
      return appUser.value?.role === 'admin'
    }
    const activeAppId = appId?.trim()
    if (!activeAppId) return false
    return Boolean(coreUser.value?.adminOf?.some((id) => id === activeAppId))
  })

  const cta = computed((): UserCta => {
    if (!isAuthenticated.value || !uid.value) return CTA_SIGN_IN
    if (!isResolved.value) return CTA_AVATAR
    if (!hasCoreUser.value) return CTA_CREATE_CORE
    if (isTenant && !hasAppUser.value) return CTA_JOIN_APP
    return CTA_AVATAR
  })

  const hasProfile = (profileType: string) => {
    const key = (profileType ?? '').trim()
    if (!key) return false

    const profiles = coreUser.value?.profiles
    if (!Array.isArray(profiles)) return false

    return profiles.includes(key)
  }

  return {
    currentUser,
    isLoading,
    isResolved,
    isInitialized,
    isAdmin,
    cta,
    hasProfile,
  }
}
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/utils/view/useUserInterface.ts

```ts
import type { Ref } from 'vue'
import type { User } from '../../../../../../../models/core/user.model'

export namespace UserCard {
  export type Card = {
    id: string
    to: string

    // Media (empty string means unset)
    avatarUrl: string

    displayName: string

    // Public handle (empty string means unset)
    handle: string

    badges: string[]

    // IMPORTANT: do not expose user.email on public UI surfaces.
    bio: string
    profiles: string[]
    appsLabel: string
  }
}

export function useUserInterface(userRef?: Ref<User | null | undefined>) {
  function map(user: User): UserCard.Card {
    const handle = (user.handle ?? '').trim()
    const appCount = user.userOf?.length ?? 0

    return {
      id: user.id,
      to: `/users/${user.id}`,

      avatarUrl: user.avatar,
      displayName: user.display_name,

      handle: handle ? `@${handle}` : '',
      badges: [],

      bio: user.bio,
      profiles: user.profiles ?? [],
      appsLabel: appCount ? `${appCount} apps` : '',
    }
  }

  function card(target?: User | null | undefined): UserCard.Card | null {
    const user = target ?? userRef?.value ?? null
    return user ? map(user) : null
  }

  function searchText(user: User): string {
    return `${user.display_name} ${user.handle} ${user.id}`.toLowerCase()
  }

  return { card, searchText }
}
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreCreate.ts

```ts
import { addDoc, collection, doc, serverTimestamp, setDoc } from 'firebase/firestore'
import { useFirestore } from 'vuefire'
import { useFireUXConfig } from '../../app/FireUXConfig'
import { useRequireUser } from '../../firebase/useRequireUser'

type StampOpts = {
  stamp?: boolean
  creator?: boolean
  app?: boolean
}

type Stamped<T> = T & {
  created_at: ReturnType<typeof serverTimestamp>
  updated_at: ReturnType<typeof serverTimestamp>
  creator_id?: string
}

export async function stampDoc<T>(data: T, opts: StampOpts = {}): Promise<T | Stamped<T>> {
  if (opts.stamp === false) return data

  const base: any = {
    ...(data as any),
    created_at: serverTimestamp(),
    updated_at: serverTimestamp(),
  }

  if (opts.app) {
    const fireux = useFireUXConfig()
    base.app_id = fireux.appId
  }

  if (opts.creator) {
    const user = await useRequireUser()
    base.creator_id = user.uid
  }

  return base as Stamped<T>
}

export function useFirestoreCreate() {
  const db = useFirestore()

  async function createDocument<T>(collectionPath: string, data: T, opts: StampOpts = {}): Promise<string> {
    const ref = collection(db, collectionPath)
    const stamped = await stampDoc(data, opts)
    const docRef = await addDoc(ref, stamped as any)
    return docRef.id
  }

  async function setDocument<T>(collectionPath: string, id: string, data: T, opts: StampOpts = {}): Promise<void> {
    const ref = doc(db, collectionPath, id)
    const stamped = await stampDoc(data, opts)
    await setDoc(ref, stamped as any)
  }

  return { createDocument, setDocument }
}
```

```ts
import { useFirestoreRead } from './useFirestoreRead'
import { useFirestoreCreate } from './useFirestoreCreate'
import { useFirestoreUpdate } from './useFirestoreUpdate'
import { useFirestoreDelete } from './useFirestoreDelete'
import { useFirestoreUtils } from '../utils/useFirestoreUtils'

/**
 * Bundles CRUD helpers and shared utilities for convenience.
 * Downstream code can still import the granular composables when needed.
 */
export function useFirestoreManager() {
  const read = useFirestoreRead()
  const create = useFirestoreCreate()
  const update = useFirestoreUpdate()
  const deletion = useFirestoreDelete()

  return {

    ...create,

    ...utils,
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreRead.ts

```ts
import {
    collection,
    doc,
    endAt,
    limit as fslimit,
    query as fsq,
    getDocs,
    orderBy,
    startAt,
    type DocumentSnapshot,
    type Query,
    type QueryDocumentSnapshot,
} from 'firebase/firestore'
import type { Ref } from 'vue'
import { useCollection, useDocument, useFirestore } from 'vuefire'

/**
 * Unified Firestore read composable for FireUX.
 * Covers single docs, full collections, and common query patterns.
 */
export function useFirestoreRead() {
  const db = useFirestore()

  const attachDocId = <T extends Record<string, any>>(
    record: T | undefined,
    docId: string,
    idField = 'id'
  ): T | undefined => {
    if (!record || typeof record !== 'object') return record
    const current = record[idField]
    const hasId =
      current !== undefined &&
      current !== null &&
      (typeof current !== 'string' || current.trim().length > 0)
    if (hasId) return record
    return { ...record, [idField]: docId }
  }

  /** Run any Firestore Query (reactive) */
  const firestoreQuery = <T>(
    q: Query<T>,
    ssrKey?: string
  ): Ref<T[] | undefined> => {
    const options = ssrKey ? { ssrKey } : undefined
    const { data } = useCollection<T>(q, {
      ...options,
      transform: (docSnap: QueryDocumentSnapshot<T>) => {
        const payload = docSnap.data() as T & Record<string, any>
        return attachDocId(payload, docSnap.id) as T
      },
    } as any)
    return data as Ref<T[] | undefined>
  }

  /** Fetch an entire collection (reactive) */
  const firestoreFetchCollection = <T>(
    collectionPath: string
  ): Ref<T[] | undefined> => {
    const q = fsq(collection(db, collectionPath)) as Query<T>
    return firestoreQuery<T>(q, collectionPath)
  }

  /** Fetch a single document (reactive) */
  const firestoreFetchDoc = <T>(
    collectionPath: string,
    docId: string
  ): Ref<T | undefined> => {
    const ref = doc(db, collectionPath, docId)
    const { data } = useDocument(ref, {
      ssrKey: `${collectionPath}-${docId}`,
      transform: (docSnap: DocumentSnapshot<T>) => {
        const payload = docSnap.data() as (T & Record<string, any>) | undefined
        return attachDocId(payload, docSnap.id) as T | undefined
      },
    } as any)
    return data as Ref<T | undefined>
  }

  /**
   * Convenience prefix search for “starts with” text fields.
   * Requires the field to be indexed and (ideally) lowercased.
   */
  const firestorePrefixSearch = async <T>(
    collectionPath: string,
    field: keyof T & string,
    value: string,
    max = 10
  ): Promise<T[]> => {
    const q = fsq(
      collection(db, collectionPath),
      orderBy(field),
      startAt(value),
      endAt(value + '\uf8ff'),
      fslimit(max)
    )
    const snapshot = await getDocs(q)
    return snapshot.docs.map((docSnap) => docSnap.data() as T)
  }

  return {
    firestoreFetchCollection,
    firestoreFetchDoc,
    firestoreQuery,
    firestorePrefixSearch,
  }
}

```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/utils/useEnsureCommon.ts

```ts
// Shared "ensure" helpers used by user/app/profile ensure flows.
// Lives under firestore/utils (not firebase/) to avoid coupling higher levels to storage internals.

import { useRequireUser } from '../../firebase/useRequireUser'
import { useImageStorage } from '../../firebase/useImageStorage'

export async function requireUid() {
  const auth = await useRequireUser()
  if (!auth?.uid) {
    throw new Error('[ensure] Missing authenticated user')
  }
  return { uid: auth.uid, auth }
}

type AvatarCandidate = {
  source: string
  display: string
}

function resolveStaticAsset(source: string): string | null {
  const trimmed = source.trim()
  if (!trimmed) return null
  if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(trimmed)) return null
  if (trimmed.startsWith('data:')) return null

  // Absolute path served by the app (e.g. /img/foo.png)
  if (trimmed.startsWith('/')) return trimmed

  // Convert ".../public/..." paths to app-root absolute
  const publicMarker = '/public/'
  const idx = trimmed.indexOf(publicMarker)
  if (idx !== -1) {
    const suffix = trimmed.slice(idx + publicMarker.length)
    if (suffix.length > 0) return `/${suffix}`
  }

  return null
}

function isFetchableUrl(source: string): boolean {
  const lower = source.toLowerCase()
  return (
    lower.startsWith('http://') ||
    lower.startsWith('https://') ||
    lower.startsWith('data:') ||
    lower.startsWith('blob:')
  )
}

function normalizeAvatarCandidates(
  inputs: Array<string | null | undefined>,
  fallback: string
): AvatarCandidate[] {
  const seen = new Set<string>()
  const list = [...inputs, fallback]
  const out: AvatarCandidate[] = []

  for (const entry of list) {
    if (typeof entry !== 'string') continue
    const trimmed = entry.trim()
    if (!trimmed) continue

    const staticAsset = resolveStaticAsset(trimmed)
    const candidateSource = staticAsset ?? trimmed

    // Skip non-fetchable relative garbage
    if (!staticAsset && !isFetchableUrl(candidateSource)) continue

    if (seen.has(candidateSource)) continue
    seen.add(candidateSource)

    out.push({ source: candidateSource, display: candidateSource })
  }

  return out
}

/**
 * Picks the first viable avatar candidate and (optionally) uploads it to Firebase Storage.
 * Returns the resulting URL (download URL if uploaded, otherwise original/display URL).
 */
export async function ensureAvatarUrl(
  destPath: string,
  candidates: Array<string | null | undefined>,
  upload = true
): Promise<string> {
  const { uploadImage, getDefaultImageUrl } = useImageStorage()
  const fallback = getDefaultImageUrl()
  const normalized = normalizeAvatarCandidates(candidates, fallback)

  if (!upload) {
    return normalized[0]?.display ?? fallback
  }

  for (const candidate of normalized) {
    try {
      return await uploadImage(destPath, candidate.source)
    } catch (error) {
      if (import.meta.dev) {
        const message =
          error instanceof Error
            ? error.message
            : (() => {
                try {
                  return JSON.stringify(error)
                } catch {
                  return String(error)
                }
              })()
        console.warn('[ensureAvatarUrl] upload failed; trying next', {
          source: candidate.source,
          message,
        })
      }
    }
  }

  return fallback
}

```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/utils/useFirestoreUtils.ts

```ts
import { collection, getDocs, query, where } from 'firebase/firestore'
import { useFirestore } from 'vuefire'
import { useFireUXConfig } from '../../app/FireUXConfig'

/** Build a tenant-aware collection path. */
const resolveCollectionPath = (
  name: string,
  appScoped: boolean,
  appId?: string | null
) => {
  if (appScoped) {
    if (!appId) {
      throw new Error(
        `[firestore/utils] missing appId for tenant path "${name}"`
      )
    }
    return `apps/${appId}/${name}`
  }

  return name
}

export function useFirestoreUtils() {
  const db = useFirestore()
  const { appId } = useFireUXConfig()

  /** Checks whether a field/value pair is unique in an optional tenant scope. */
  const checkUnique = async (
    collectionName: string,
    field: string,
    value: unknown,
    appScoped = true
  ): Promise<boolean> => {
    const colPath = resolveCollectionPath(collectionName, appScoped, appId)
    const colRef = collection(db, colPath)
    const q = query(colRef, where(field, '==', value))
    const snapshot = await getDocs(q)
    return snapshot.empty
  }

  /** Returns a tenant-aware collection path for downstream callers. */
  const getCollectionPath = (name: string, appScoped = true): string =>
    resolveCollectionPath(name, appScoped, appId)

  /** Fetch multiple docs by field match (optionally tenant-scoped). */
  const fetchDocumentsByField = async <T>(
    collectionName: string,
    field: string,
    value: unknown,
    appScoped = true
  ): Promise<T[]> => {
    const colPath = resolveCollectionPath(collectionName, appScoped, appId)
    const colRef = collection(db, colPath)
    const q = query(colRef, where(field, '==', value))
    const snapshot = await getDocs(q)
    return snapshot.docs.map((doc) => doc.data() as T)
  }

  /** Fetch a single doc by field match (optionally tenant-scoped). */
  const firestoreQueryOneByField = async <T>(
    collectionName: string,
    field: string,
    value: unknown,
    appScoped = true
  ): Promise<T | null> => {
    const colPath = resolveCollectionPath(collectionName, appScoped, appId)
    const colRef = collection(db, colPath)
    const q = query(colRef, where(field, '==', value))
    const snapshot = await getDocs(q)
    return snapshot.empty ? null : (snapshot.docs[0].data() as T)
  }

  /** Fetch an entire subcollection under a given parent document. */
  const firestoreFetchSubcollection = async <T>(
    parentCollection: string,
    parentId: string,
    subcollectionName: string
  ): Promise<T[]> => {
    const colPath = `${parentCollection}/${parentId}/${subcollectionName}`
    const colRef = collection(db, colPath)
    const snapshot = await getDocs(colRef)
    return snapshot.docs.map((doc) => doc.data() as T)
  }

  return {
    checkUnique,
    getCollectionPath,
    fetchDocumentsByField,
    firestoreQueryOneByField,
    firestoreFetchSubcollection,
  }
}

```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/utils/useScoped.ts

```ts
import { computed, unref, type ComputedRef, type Ref } from 'vue'
import { useDocument, useFirestore } from 'vuefire'
import {
  doc,
  type DocumentData,
  type DocumentReference,
  type Firestore,
} from 'firebase/firestore'
import { useFireUXConfig } from '../../app/FireUXConfig'
import { useFirestoreRead } from '../operations/useFirestoreRead'

type PathBuilder = (appId: string) => string
export type MaybeRef<T> = T | Ref<T>

export interface ScopedCollectionOptions {
  corePath: string
  appPath: PathBuilder
}

export interface ScopedCollectionState<TCore, TApp> {
  collection: ComputedRef<TCore[] | TApp[]>
  loading: ComputedRef<boolean>
  local: Ref<TApp[] | undefined> | null
  global: Ref<TCore[] | undefined> | null
  context: {
    isTenant: boolean
    appId: string | null | undefined
  }
}

export interface ScopedDocProjectorInput<TCore, TApp> {
  core: TCore | null | undefined
  app: TApp | null | undefined
  isTenant: boolean
  appId: string | null
}

export type ScopedDocProjector<TCore, TApp, TResult> = (
  input: ScopedDocProjectorInput<TCore, TApp>
) => TResult

export interface ScopedDocOptions<TCore, TApp, TResult> {
  id: MaybeRef<string | null | undefined>
  corePath: string
  appPath: PathBuilder
  projector?: ScopedDocProjector<TCore, TApp, TResult>
}

export type ScopedDocValue<TCore, TApp> = TCore | TApp | null

export interface ScopedDocState<TCore, TApp> {
  value: ComputedRef<ScopedDocValue<TCore, TApp>>
  core: ComputedRef<TCore | undefined>
  app: ComputedRef<TApp | undefined>
  loading: ComputedRef<boolean>
  context: {
    isTenant: boolean
    appId: string | null | undefined
  }
}

export function useScopedCollection<TCore, TApp>(
  opts: ScopedCollectionOptions
): ScopedCollectionState<TCore, TApp> {
  const { isTenant, appId } = useFireUXConfig()
  const { firestoreFetchCollection } = useFirestoreRead()

  const local =
    isTenant && appId
      ? firestoreFetchCollection<TApp>(opts.appPath(appId))
      : null

  const global = isTenant
    ? null
    : firestoreFetchCollection<TCore>(opts.corePath)

  const collection = computed<TCore[] | TApp[]>(() => {
    const localValue = local?.value
    if (localValue) return localValue

    const globalValue = global?.value
    if (globalValue) return globalValue

    return [] as TCore[] | TApp[]
  })

  const loading = computed(() => {
    if (local) return local.value === undefined
    if (global) return global.value === undefined
    return false
  })

  return {
    collection,
    loading,
    local,
    global,
    context: { isTenant, appId } as const,
  }
}

export function useScopedDoc<
  TCore,
  TApp,
  TResult = ScopedDocValue<TCore, TApp>
>(opts: ScopedDocOptions<TCore, TApp, TResult>) {
  const { isTenant, appId } = useFireUXConfig()
  const db = useFirestore()

  const idRef = computed(() => {
    const id = unref(opts.id)
    return id && id.length > 0 ? id : null
  })

  const coreRef = computed<DocumentReference<DocumentData> | null>(() => {
    const id = idRef.value
    if (!id) return null
    return doc(db, opts.corePath, id)
  })
  const { data: coreData, pending: corePending } = useDocument(coreRef)
  const core = computed(() => coreData.value as TCore | undefined)

  const appRef = computed<DocumentReference<DocumentData> | null>(() => {
    const id = idRef.value
    if (!id || !isTenant || !appId) return null
    return doc(db, opts.appPath(appId), id)
  })
  const { data: appData, pending: appPending } = useDocument(appRef)
  const app = computed(() => appData.value as TApp | undefined)

  const projector =
    opts.projector ??
    ((payload: ScopedDocProjectorInput<TCore, TApp>) =>
      (payload.isTenant
        ? payload.app ?? null
        : payload.core ?? null) as TResult)

  const value = computed<TResult>(() => {
    const id = idRef.value
    if (!id) return null as TResult

    return projector({
      core: core.value ?? null,
      app: app.value ?? null,
      isTenant,
      appId: appId ?? null,
    })
  })

  const loading = computed(() => {
    if (!idRef.value) return false
    if (corePending?.value) return true
    if (isTenant && appId) return Boolean(appPending?.value)
    return false
  })

  return {
    value,
    loading,
    core,
    app,
    context: { isTenant, appId } as const,
  }
}

export function getScopedDoc<TCore, TApp>(
  db: Firestore,

    const id = uid.value ?? null

  const appDoc = computed(() => appData.value as TApp | undefined)

    if (isTenant && appId) return appDoc.value ?? null
```
