### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/shared/useCardViewToggle.ts

```ts
import { ref, watch, type ComputedRef, type Ref } from 'vue'

type View = 'preview' | 'profile'

type ViewToggleSource = (() => boolean) | Ref<boolean> | ComputedRef<boolean>

type UseCardViewToggleOptions = {
  /** Optional initial view; defaults to `preview`. */
  initialView?: View
}

const asPredicate = (source: ViewToggleSource) => {
  if (typeof source === 'function') return source
  return () => Boolean(source.value)
}

export const useCardViewToggle = (
  hasData: ViewToggleSource,
  options: UseCardViewToggleOptions = {}
) => {
  const view = ref<View>(options.initialView ?? 'preview')

  const toggleView = () => {
    view.value = view.value === 'preview' ? 'profile' : 'preview'
  }

  watch(
    () => Boolean(asPredicate(hasData)()),
    (present) => {
      if (!present) view.value = 'preview'
    }
  )

  return {
    view,
    toggleView,
  }
}

```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/composables/shared/useCollectionSearch.ts

```ts
import { computed, ref, type ComputedRef, type Ref } from 'vue'

type Variant = 'pill' | 'cell'

type Searcher<TRaw> = (item: TRaw) => string

type MakeCard<TRaw, TCard> = (item: TRaw) => TCard | null | undefined

type UseCollectionSearchOptions<TRaw, TCard> = {
  items: Ref<TRaw[] | undefined> | ComputedRef<TRaw[] | undefined>
  searchText: Searcher<TRaw>
  makeCard: MakeCard<TRaw, TCard>
  initialQuery?: string
  initialVariant?: Variant
}

export const useCollectionSearch = <TRaw, TCard>(
  options: UseCollectionSearchOptions<TRaw, TCard>
) => {
  const query = ref(options.initialQuery ?? '')
  const variant = ref<Variant>(options.initialVariant ?? 'pill')

  const toggleVariant = () => {
    variant.value = variant.value === 'pill' ? 'cell' : 'pill'
  }

  const normalizedItems = computed<TRaw[]>(() => options.items.value ?? [])

  const visibleItems = computed<TRaw[]>(() => {
    const q = query.value.trim().toLowerCase()
    if (!q) return normalizedItems.value

    return normalizedItems.value.filter((item) => options.searchText(item).includes(q))
  })

  const visibleCount = computed(() => visibleItems.value.length)

  const cards = computed<TCard[]>(() =>
    visibleItems.value
      .map((item) => options.makeCard(item))
      .filter((card): card is TCard => Boolean(card))
  )

  return {
    query,
    variant,
    toggleVariant,
    normalizedItems,
    visibleItems,
    visibleCount,
    cards,
  }
}
```

```vue
import { ref, computed, watch } from 'vue'
import { useRoute, useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { useState } from '#imports'
import { useConsoleNav } from '../composables/fireux/app/routing/presets'
import { useConsoleNotifications } from '../composables/fireux/app/ui/useConsoleNotifications'
import { useAuth } from '../composables/fireux/firebase/useAuth'
import { useUser } from '../composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/useUser'
import type { NavItem } from '../../types/nav'

)

if (import.meta.client) {
  watch(
    [isReady, hasAuthState, isAuthenticated, lastBindError],
    ([ready, resolved, authed, bindError]: [boolean, boolean, boolean, unknown]) => {
      if (!ready) return
      if (!resolved) return
      if (authed) return
      if (bindError) {
        router.replace('/').catch(() => {})
        return
      }
      router.replace('/auth').catch(() => {})
    },
    { immediate: true }
  )
}

const sortNavItems = (items: NavItem[]) =>
  items.slice().sort((a, b) => {
    if (a.order !== b.order) return a.order - b.order
    return a.label.localeCompare(b.label)
  })

const TOP_PRIORITY = [
  { key: 'console-developer', to: '/console/developer' },
  { key: 'console-app', to: '/console/app' },
  { key: 'console-home', to: '/console' },
  { key: 'console-user-profile', to: '/console/user-profile' },
]

const isTopNavItem = (item: NavItem) =>
  TOP_PRIORITY.some(
    ({ key, to }) => (key && item.key === key) || item.to === to
  )

const topPosition = (item: NavItem) =>
  TOP_PRIORITY.findIndex(
    ({ key, to }) => (key && item.key === key) || item.to === to
  )

const canShowNavItem = (item: NavItem) => {
  if (item.key === 'console-app' || item.to === '/console/app') {
    return isAdmin.value
  }

  if (item.key === 'console-developer' || item.to === '/console/developer') {
    return isDev.value
  }

  return true
}

const baseNav = computed(() =>
  sortNavItems(
    desktop.value
      .filter((i) => i.group !== 'profiles')
      .filter((i) => !i.profileId)
      .filter(canShowNavItem)
  )
)

const routeProfileId = computed(
  () => (route.meta as { nav?: { profileId?: string } }).nav?.profileId ?? null
)

watch(
  routeProfileId,
  (value: string | null) => {
    if (value && activeProfileState.value !== value) {
      activeProfileState.value = value
    }
  },
  { immediate: true }
)

const activeProfileId = computed(() => activeProfileState.value)

const profileExtras = computed(() => {
  const profileId = activeProfileId.value
  if (!profileId) return []
  return sortNavItems(
    desktop.value
      .filter((item) => item.group !== 'profiles')
      .filter((item) => item.profileId === profileId)
  )
})

const topNav = computed(() =>
  baseNav.value
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, provide } from 'vue'

defineOptions({ name: 'docs' })

const { data: navigationRaw } = await useAsyncData(
  'fireux-docs-navigation',
  () => queryCollectionNavigation('fireuxDocs' as never)
)

function withDocsBase(items: any[] = []): any[] {
  return items.map((item) => {
    const path = item._path || item.path || '/'
    const prefixed = path === '/' ? '/docs' : `/docs${path}`
    return {
      ...item,
      _path: prefixed,
      path: prefixed,
      children: item.children ? withDocsBase(item.children) : undefined,
    }
  })
}

const navigation = computed(() => withDocsBase(navigationRaw.value || []))

provide('navigation', navigation)
</script>
```

```ts
  media: {
    thumbnail_url: '',
    logo_url: '',
    wordmark_light_url: '',
    wordmark_dark_url: '',
    cover_url: '',
  } as AppMedia,

  // Stamps
  creator_id: undefined as FireuxStamped['creator_id'],
  created_at: {} as FirebaseTimestamp,

}
```

```ts
import type { FirebaseTimestamp } from '../../../types/firebase'

/**
 * Canonical timestamps present on all Firestore documents.
 */
export interface FireuxTimestamps {
  created_at: FirebaseTimestamp
  updated_at: FirebaseTimestamp
}

 * Optional authored metadata.
 * Creator may be absent for system or migration writes.
 */
export interface FireuxAuthored {
  creator_id?: string
  app_id?: string
}

/**
 * Convenience type used by all persisted models.
 */
export type FireuxStamped = FireuxTimestamps & FireuxAuthored
```

```ts
 * Core profile doc base shape (global truth)

 *
 * Canon notes:
 * - Core profiles are user-owned (creator_id optional; uid is the authority)
 * - `tagline` is now universal (remove duplication from each profile)
 * - `tags` are stored (UI derives badges)

  subtitle: string

 *

}

  /** Lowercase identifier like 'chef', 'supplier', 'agent', 'professional' */
  id: string

  /** Firestore collection name */
  collectionName: string

  /** Human-readable label */

  /** CTA text for UI when profile missing */
  cta: string

  /** Label override for nav/dropdown contexts */
```

```ts
import type { FirebaseTimestamp } from '../../../types/firebase'
import type { FireuxStamped } from './meta.model'
import type { UserNotification } from './user.supporting'

/**
 * Core Firestore user document
 * Path: /users/<userId>
 *
 * Canon rules:
 * - Empty string means unset
 * - Arrays always exist
 * - Runtime object is the single source of truth
 */

// Runtime canonical shape
export const User = {
  id: '',

  display_name: '',
  avatar: '',

  handle: '',
  email: '',
  bio: '',

  profiles: [] as string[],

  userOf: [] as string[],
  adminOf: [] as string[],

  notifications: [] as UserNotification[],

  // Authored (FireuxStamped)
  creator_id: undefined as FireuxStamped['creator_id'],
  created_at: {} as FirebaseTimestamp,
  updated_at: {} as FirebaseTimestamp,
} as const

export type User = {
  [K in keyof typeof User]: (typeof User)[K]
}

/**
 * App-specific user overlay
 * Path: /apps/<appId>/users/<userId>
 */
export const AppUser = {
  id: '',
  role: 'user' as 'user' | 'admin',
  notifications: [] as UserNotification[],
  creator_id: undefined as FireuxStamped['creator_id'],
  created_at: {} as FirebaseTimestamp,
  updated_at: {} as FirebaseTimestamp,
} as const

export type AppUser = {
  [K in keyof typeof AppUser]: (typeof AppUser)[K]
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Avatar Management Utilities
 *
 * Handles avatar logic for CoreUser and AppUser models
 */

/**
 * Avatar storage paths and URL generation
 */
export class AvatarManager {
  /**
   * Generate core user avatar storage path
   */
  static getCoreUserAvatarPath(userId: string): string {
    return `users/${userId}/avatar`
  }

  /**
   * Generate app user avatar storage path
   */
  static getAppUserAvatarPath(appId: string, userId: string): string {
    return `apps/${appId}/users/${userId}/avatar`
  }

  /**
   * Generate Firebase Storage URL
   */
  static generateStorageUrl(bucketName: string, storagePath: string): string {
    return `https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/${bucketName}/o/${encodeURIComponent(
      storagePath
    )}?alt=media`
  }

  /**
   * Check if avatar URL is app-specific (not core user avatar)
   */
  static isAppSpecificAvatar(avatarUrl: string, appId: string): boolean {
    return avatarUrl.includes(`apps/${appId}/users/`)
  }

  /**
   * Check if avatar URL is a core user avatar
   */
  static isCoreUserAvatar(avatarUrl: string): boolean {
    return avatarUrl.includes('users/') && !avatarUrl.includes('apps/')
  }

  /**
   * Check if avatar URL is external (Google, etc.)
   */
  static isExternalAvatar(avatarUrl: string): boolean {
    return !avatarUrl.includes('firebasestorage.googleapis.com')
  }

  /**
   * Get the default avatar for a new AppUser
   * This copies the CoreUser avatar URL
   */
  static getDefaultAppUserAvatar(coreUserAvatar: string): string {
    return coreUserAvatar
  }

  /**
   * Determine avatar strategy for AppUser
   */
  static getAvatarStrategy(
    coreUserAvatar: string,
    currentAppUserAvatar?: string,
    appId?: string
  ): {
    strategy: 'use_core' | 'use_app_specific' | 'use_external'
    shouldCopy: boolean
    description: string
  } {
    // If no current app avatar, use core avatar
    if (!currentAppUserAvatar) {
      return {
        strategy: 'use_core',
        shouldCopy: false,
        description: 'New AppUser - copy CoreUser avatar URL',
      }
    }

    // If current avatar is external, keep it
    if (this.isExternalAvatar(currentAppUserAvatar)) {
      return {
        strategy: 'use_external',
        shouldCopy: false,
        description: 'External avatar (Google, etc.) - no changes needed',
      }
    }

    // If current avatar is app-specific, keep it
    if (appId && this.isAppSpecificAvatar(currentAppUserAvatar, appId)) {
      return {
        strategy: 'use_app_specific',
        shouldCopy: false,
        description: 'App-specific avatar - user has customized for this app',
      }
    }

    // If current avatar is core but different from current core, update
    if (
      this.isCoreUserAvatar(currentAppUserAvatar) &&
      currentAppUserAvatar !== coreUserAvatar
    ) {
      return {
        strategy: 'use_core',
        shouldCopy: false,
        description: 'Update to latest CoreUser avatar',
      }
    }

    // Default: use core avatar
    return {
      strategy: 'use_core',
      shouldCopy: false,
      description: 'Default to CoreUser avatar',
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Avatar operation types for consistency
 */
export type AvatarOperation = {
  type: 'copy_from_core' | 'upload_app_specific' | 'update_url_only'
  sourcePath?: string
  destinationPath?: string
  newUrl: string
  description: string
}

```

```ts
import type { FirebaseTimestamp } from '../../types/firebase'

export type TaskStatus =
  | 'todo'
  | 'in_progress'
  | 'done'
  | 'skipped'
  | 'cancelled'

  label: string
```

```vue
<!-- FILE: packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/pages/apps/[id].vue -->
<template>
  <UPage>
    <UPageHeader :title="pageTitle" :description="pageDescription" />
    <UPageBody class="pagebody">
      <div class="space-y-6">
        <OrganismsAppCardsProfile
          v-if="appProfile"
          v-bind="appProfile"
          :app="currentApp"
        />

        <section id="users">
          <UPageCard
            title="Users"
            :description="usersDescription"
            variant="subtle"
          >
            <div class="space-y-3">
              <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <UButton
                    :to="filterLink('all')"
                    label="All"
                    size="xs"
                    :variant="activeFilter === 'all' ? 'solid' : 'soft'"
                  />
                  <UButton
                    :to="filterLink('admins')"
                    label="Admins"
                    size="xs"
                    :variant="activeFilter === 'admins' ? 'solid' : 'soft'"
                  />
                  <UButton
                    :to="filterLink('users')"
                    label="Users"
                    size="xs"
                    :variant="activeFilter === 'users' ? 'solid' : 'soft'"
                  />
                </div>

                <UBadge variant="subtle" color="neutral" size="xs">
                  {{ visibleCount }} / {{ totalCount }}
                </UBadge>
              </div>

              <div v-if="usersPending" class="text-sm text-dimmed">Loading users…</div>

              <div v-else class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                <component
                  :is="wrapperFor(card)"
                  v-for="card in visibleCards"
                  :key="card.id"
                  v-bind="wrapperPropsFor(card)"
                  class="block"
                >
                  <OrganismsUserCardsPill v-bind="card" />
                </component>

                <span v-if="!visibleCards.length" class="text-sm text-dimmed italic">
                  missing
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </UPageCard>
        </section>
      </div>
    </UPageBody>
  </UPage>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useHead } from '#imports'
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { useRoute } from 'vue-router'
import { useAppFetch } from '../../composables/fireux/firestore/core/app/fetch/useAppFetch'
import { useAppInterface } from '../../composables/fireux/firestore/core/app/utils/view/useAppInterface'
import { useUserCollectionByAppId } from '../../composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/fetch/useUserCollectionByAppId'
import type { UserCard } from '../../composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/utils/view/useUserInterface'
import { useUserInterface } from '../../composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/utils/view/useUserInterface'

const route = useRoute()

const appId = computed(() => {
  const raw = Array.isArray(route.params.id)
    ? route.params.id[0]
    : route.params.id
  return String(raw ?? '').trim() || null
})

const { app: currentApp } = useAppFetch(appId)

const { card } = useAppInterface()

const appProfile = computed(() => (currentApp.value ? card(currentApp.value) : null))

const { users: appUsers, pending: usersPending } = useUserCollectionByAppId(appId)
const { card: userToCardByValue } = useUserInterface()

type UserFilter = 'all' | 'admins' | 'users'

const activeFilter = computed<UserFilter>(() => {
  const raw = route.query.filter
  const value = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw[0] : String(raw ?? '')
  if (value === 'admins' || value === 'users') return value
  return 'all'
})

function filterLink(filter: UserFilter) {
  const query = filter === 'all' ? {} : { filter }
  return { path: `/apps/${appId.value ?? ''}`, hash: '#users', query }
}

const totalCount = computed(() => appUsers.value.length)

const filteredUsers = computed(() => {
  if (activeFilter.value === 'admins') {
    return appUsers.value.filter((u) => u.appUser?.role === 'admin')
  }
  if (activeFilter.value === 'users') {
    return appUsers.value.filter((u) => u.appUser?.role === 'user')
  }
  return appUsers.value
})

const visibleCards = computed<UserCard.Card[]>(() => {
  return filteredUsers.value
    .map((u) => userToCardByValue(u.coreUser ?? null))
    .filter((card): card is UserCard.Card => Boolean(card))
})

const visibleCount = computed(() => visibleCards.value.length)

const usersDescription = computed(() => {
  if (activeFilter.value === 'admins') return 'Admin users for this app.'
  if (activeFilter.value === 'users') return 'Non-admin users for this app.'
  return 'All users for this app.'
})

const appName = computed(() => currentApp.value?.app_name ?? null)
const pageTitle = computed(() => appName.value ?? 'App Details')
const pageDescription = computed(() =>
  appName.value
    ? `Inspect ${appName.value}, its overlays, and related apps.`
    : 'Inspect the selected app, its overlays, and related apps.'
)

const headTitle = computed(() =>
  appName.value ? `${appName.value} · App` : 'App Details'
)

useHead({ title: headTitle })

const wrapperFor = (card: UserCard.Card) => (card.to ? 'NuxtLink' : 'div')
const wrapperPropsFor = (card: UserCard.Card) => (card.to ? { to: card.to } : {})
</script>

```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { definePageMeta, useState } from '#imports'

const toast = useToastify()
const colorMode = useColorMode()

// Preferences (client-only persistence later)
const preferences = useState('fireux-core:console-settings:preferences', () => ({
  language: 'en',
  theme: (colorMode.value || 'system') as 'system' | 'light' | 'dark',
  emailSecurityAlerts: true,
  shareUsageAnalytics: true,
}))

const languageOptions = [
  { label: 'English', value: 'en' },

]

const themeOptions = [
  { label: 'System', value: 'system' },
  { label: 'Light', value: 'light' },

]

const savePreferences = async () => {
  colorMode.value = preferences.value.theme

}
```

```vue
const wrapperPropsFor = (card: { to?: string | null } | null) => (card?.to ? { to: card.to } : {})
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/pages/dev/apps.vue

```vue
<template>
  <UPage>
    <UPageHeader
      title="Dev · Apps"
      description="Model shape for Apps collection."
    />

    <UPageBody class="space-y-6">
      <UCard variant="subtle">
        <div class="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
          Mode:
          <span class="font-mono">
            {{ isTenant ? 'tenant (single app)' : 'global (all apps)' }}
          </span>
        </div>
      </UCard>

      <DevBinding :app="bindingApp" :apps="appCollection" />

      <UCard>
        <DevModel
          :title="'Apps · Model'"
          :model="appModelRuntime"
        />
      </UCard>

      <UCard>
        <template #header>
          <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
            <div class="space-y-3">
              <p class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100">
                Apps collection
              </p>
              <p class="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                Browse apps resolved for this runtime and filter by model drift.
              </p>
              <DevDriftToolbar
                :drift-kind="appsDriftKind"
                :selected-field="appsSelectedField"
                :filter-options="appsFilterOptions"
                :copy-label="'Copy drift · Apps'"
                :copy-payload="appsDriftCopyPayload"
                @update:drift-kind="setAppsDriftKind"
                @update:selected-field="updateAppsSelectedField"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </template>

        <template #footer>
          <DevJson
            :title="'Apps (JSON)'"
            :data="allAppsJsonPayload"
            :default-open="false"
          />
        </template>

        <OrganismsAppCollectionManager :collection="filteredApps" />
      </UCard>
    </UPageBody>
  </UPage>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { definePageMeta } from '#imports'
import { useDevDriftFilter } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/dev/useDevDriftFilter'
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { useFireUXConfig } from '../../composables/fireux/app/FireUXConfig'
import { useAppCollection } from '../../composables/fireux/firestore/core/app/fetch/useAppCollection'
import { useApp } from '../../composables/fireux/firestore/core/app/useApp'
import { App as AppModelRuntime } from '../../models/core/app.model'

definePageMeta({
  layout: 'dev',
  nav: {
    key: 'dev-apps',
    label: 'Apps',
    icon: 'i-lucide-app-window',
    desktop: true,
    group: 'core',
    layouts: ['dev'],
    order: 20,
  },
  title: 'Dev · Apps',
  description: 'Developer view for Apps (collection-first).',
})

const appModelRuntime = AppModelRuntime

const { apps } = useAppCollection()
const { app: activeApp } = useApp()

const { appId: configAppId, isTenant } = useFireUXConfig()
const appCollection = computed(() =>
  isTenant ? (activeApp.value ? [activeApp.value] : []) : apps.value ?? []
)

const bindingAppId = computed(() => configAppId ?? '')
const bindingApp = computed(() =>
  appCollection.value.find((item) => item?.id === bindingAppId.value) ?? null
)


const {
  driftKind: appsDriftKind,
  setDriftKind: setAppsDriftKind,
  selectedField: appsSelectedField,
  driftById: appsDriftById,
  filterOptions: appsFilterOptions,
  filteredCollection: filteredApps,
} = useDevDriftFilter({
  collection: appCollection,
  runtimeModel: appModelRuntime,
})

const allAppsJsonPayload = computed(() => ({
  totalApps: appCollection.value.length,
  apps: appCollection.value,
}))

const filteredAppsDriftPayload = computed(() =>
  filteredApps.value.map((app) => {
    const drift = appsDriftById.value.get(app.id) ?? { missing: [], extra: [] }
    return {
      id: app.id,
      displayName: app.app_name,
      drift,
    }
  })
)

const appsDriftCopyPayload = computed(() => ({
  modelPath: 'packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/models/core/app.model.ts',
  driftKind: appsDriftKind.value,
  selectedField: appsSelectedField.value || null,
  totalApps: filteredApps.value.length,
  apps: filteredAppsDriftPayload.value,
}))

const updateAppsSelectedField = (value: string) => {
  appsSelectedField.value = value
}
</script>

```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/pages/dev/avatars.vue

```vue
<!-- FILE: packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/pages/dev/avatars.vue -->
<template>
  <div class="p-6 space-y-8">
    <header class="space-y-1">
      <h1 class="text-xl font-semibold">Avatar Storage Explorer</h1>
      <p class="text-sm text-gray-500">
        Listing user avatar objects under both <code>core-users/</code> and
        <code>users/</code> so you can confirm the migration.
      </p>
    </header>

    <div v-if="loading" class="text-sm text-gray-500">Loading avatars…</div>
    <div v-else class="space-y-10">
      <section
        v-for="group in avatarGroups"
        :key="group.prefix"
        class="space-y-4"
      >
        <div class="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-4">
          <h2 class="text-lg font-medium">Avatars in {{ group.prefix }}/</h2>
          <span class="text-xs text-gray-500"
            >{{ group.items.length }} user(s)</span
          >
        </div>

        <div class="rounded-xl border bg-background-2 p-4">
          <p class="text-xs text-gray-500 mb-2">
            Copy-ready JSON mapping of id → download URL (null when no avatar
            file is present).
          </p>
          <pre class="text-xs overflow-x-auto whitespace-pre-wrap break-all">{{
            group.json
          }}</pre>
        </div>

        <div
          v-if="group.items.length > 0"
          class="grid gap-6 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-5"
        >
          <div
            v-for="avatar in group.items"
            :key="avatar.path"
            class="flex flex-col items-center border rounded-xl p-3 bg-background-2"
          >
            <img
              v-if="avatar.url"
              :src="avatar.url"
              :alt="avatar.path"
              class="w-20 h-20 object-cover rounded-full border"
            />
            <div
              v-else
              class="w-20 h-20 rounded-full bg-gray-200 flex items-center justify-center"
            >
              <span class="text-gray-400 text-xs">No Image</span>
            </div>
            <p class="mt-2 text-[11px] font-mono break-all text-center">
              {{ avatar.id }} : {{ avatar.url ?? '(no download URL)' }}
            </p>
            <p class="mt-1 text-[10px] text-gray-500 break-all text-center">
              {{ avatar.file }}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <p v-else class="text-sm text-gray-500">No avatar files found.</p>
      </section>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { onMounted, ref } from 'vue'
import {
  getStorage,
  getDownloadURL,
  listAll,
  ref as storageRef,
} from 'firebase/storage'

interface AvatarEntry {
  id: string
  file: string
  path: string
  url: string | null
}

interface AvatarGroup {
  prefix: string
  items: AvatarEntry[]
  json: string
}

const avatarGroups = ref<AvatarGroup[]>([])
const loading = ref(true)

onMounted(async () => {
  try {
    const storage = getStorage()
    const [coreUsers, users] = await Promise.all([
      fetchAvatarGroup(storage, 'core-users'),
      fetchAvatarGroup(storage, 'users'),
    ])

    avatarGroups.value = [coreUsers, users]
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to load avatar listings', error)
    avatarGroups.value = []
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
})

async function fetchAvatarGroup(
  storage: ReturnType<typeof getStorage>,
  prefix: string
): Promise<AvatarGroup> {
  const groupItems: AvatarEntry[] = []
  const prefixRef = storageRef(storage, prefix)
  const listResponse = await listAll(prefixRef)

  await Promise.all(
    listResponse.prefixes.map(async (userRef) => {
      const id = userRef.name
      const userListing = await listAll(userRef)
      const avatarFile = userListing.items.find((item) =>
        item.name.toLowerCase().startsWith('avatar')
      )

      if (!avatarFile) {
        groupItems.push({
          id,
          file: '(missing)',
          path: `${prefix}/${id}/`,
          url: null,
        })
        return
      }

      try {
        const url = await getDownloadURL(avatarFile)
        groupItems.push({
          id,
          file: avatarFile.name,
          path: avatarFile.fullPath,
          url,
        })
      } catch (error) {
        console.warn(
          `Unable to load avatar for ${id} at ${avatarFile.fullPath}`,
          error
        )
        groupItems.push({
          id,
          file: avatarFile.name,
          path: avatarFile.fullPath,
          url: null,
        })
      }
    })
  )

  groupItems.sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id))

  const jsonPayload = Object.fromEntries(
    groupItems.map((item) => [item.id, item.url ?? null])
  )
  const json = JSON.stringify(jsonPayload, null, 2)

  return { prefix, items: groupItems, json }
}
</script>

```

```vue
            <p class="text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
              <span class="font-mono">{{ group.rootDir }}</span>
            </p>
          </div>
        </template>

        <template v-if="group.images.length">
          <ul class="space-y-4">
            <li
              v-for="img in group.images"
              :key="img.urlPath"
              class="dev-image-row"
            >

                <img :src="img.urlPath" :alt="img.urlPath" />
              </div>

              <div class="space-y-1 text-sm">
                <code class="block">{{ img.urlPath }}</code>
                <code class="block text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">{{ img.filePath }}</code>
              </div>
            </li>
          </ul>
        </template>
        <template v-else>
          <p class="text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">

          </p>
        </template>
      </UCard>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { useFirestoreRead } from '../../composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreRead'
import type { AppModel } from '../../models/core/app.model'

type ImageEntry = {
  urlPath: string
  filePath: string
}

type ImageGroup = {
  key: string
  title: string
  rootDir: string
  images: ImageEntry[]
}

const { data } = await useFetch<{ groups: ImageGroup[] }>('/api/dev/images')
const groups = computed(() => data.value?.groups ?? [])

type FirestoreAppImage = { key: string; label: string; url: string }
type FirestoreAppGroup = { id: string; name: string; images: FirestoreAppImage[] }

const appsRef = import.meta.client
  ? useFirestoreRead().firestoreFetchCollection<AppModel>('apps')
  : (null as any)

const firestorePending = computed(() => import.meta.client && appsRef?.value === undefined)

function collectFirestoreImages(
  app: AppModel & Record<string, any>
): FirestoreAppImage[] {
  const entries: FirestoreAppImage[] = []

  const push = (key: string, label: string, value: unknown) => {
    if (typeof value !== 'string') return
    const url = value.trim()
    if (!url) return
    entries.push({ key, label, url })
  }

  // Canonical fields used across the app
  push('media.thumbnail_url', 'Thumbnail (media.thumbnail_url)', (app as any)?.media?.thumbnail_url)
  push('media.logo_url', 'Logo (media.logo_url)', (app as any)?.media?.logo_url)
  push('media.wordmark_light_url', 'Wordmark (light)', (app as any)?.media?.wordmark_light_url)
  push('media.wordmark_dark_url', 'Wordmark (dark)', (app as any)?.media?.wordmark_dark_url)

  // De-dupe by url, keep first label
  const seen = new Set<string>()
  return entries.filter((e) => {
    if (seen.has(e.url)) return false
    seen.add(e.url)
    return true
  })
}

const firestoreAppGroups = computed<FirestoreAppGroup[]>(() => {
  if (!import.meta.client) return []
  const apps = (appsRef?.value ?? []) as Array<AppModel & Record<string, any>>
  return apps
    .map((app) => {
      const images = collectFirestoreImages(app)
      return {
        id: (app.id ?? '').toString(),
        name: (app.app_name ?? app.id ?? 'App').toString().trim() || 'App',
        images,
      }
    })
    .filter((app) => Boolean(app.id) && app.images.length)
    .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name))
})

definePageMeta({
  layout: 'dev',
  nav: {
    key: 'dev-images',
    label: 'Images',
    icon: 'i-lucide-image',
    desktop: true,
    group: 'core',
    layouts: ['dev'],
    order: 40,
  },
  title: 'Dev · Images',
  description: 'Inspect platform assets inherited from fireux-core.',
})
</script>

<style scoped>
.dev-image-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.dev-image-chip {
  width: 80px;
```

```vue
<template>
  <UPage>
    <UPageHeader
      title="Dev · Users"
      description="Model shape for Users collection."
    />

    <UPageBody class="space-y-6">
      <UCard variant="subtle">
        <div class="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
          Mode:
          <span class="font-mono">
            {{ isTenant ? 'tenant (single app)' : 'global (all apps)' }}
          </span>
        </div>
      </UCard>

      <DevBinding :app="bindingApp" :apps="bindingApps" />

      <UCard>
        <DevModel
          :title="'Users · Model'"
          :model="userModelRuntime"
        />
      </UCard>

      <UCard>
        <template #header>
          <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
            <div class="space-y-3">
              <p class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100">
                Users collection
              </p>
              <p class="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                Browse users resolved for this runtime and filter by model drift.
              </p>
              <DevDriftToolbar
                :drift-kind="usersDriftKind"
                :selected-field="usersSelectedField"
                :filter-options="usersFilterOptions"
                :copy-label="'Copy drift · Users'"
                :copy-payload="usersDriftCopyPayload"
                @update:drift-kind="setUsersDriftKind"
                @update:selected-field="updateUsersSelectedField"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </template>

        <template #footer>
          <DevJson
            :title="'Users (JSON)'"
            :data="allUsersJsonPayload"
            :default-open="false"
          />
        </template>

        <OrganismsUserCollectionManager :collection="filteredUsers" />
      </UCard>
    </UPageBody>
  </UPage>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { definePageMeta } from '#imports'
import { useDevDriftFilter } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/dev/useDevDriftFilter'
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { useFireUXConfig } from '../../composables/fireux/app/FireUXConfig'
import { useAppCollection } from '../../composables/fireux/firestore/core/app/fetch/useAppCollection'
import { useApp } from '../../composables/fireux/firestore/core/app/useApp'
import { useGlobalUserCollection } from '../../composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/fetch/useGlobalUserCollection'
import { User as UserModelRuntime } from '../../models/core/user.model'

definePageMeta({
  layout: 'dev',
  nav: {
    key: 'dev-users',
    label: 'Users',
    icon: 'i-lucide-users',
    desktop: true,
    group: 'core',
    layouts: ['dev'],
    order: 30,
  },
  title: 'Dev · Users',
  description: 'Developer view for Users (collection-first).',
})

const userModelRuntime = UserModelRuntime

const { users } = useGlobalUserCollection()

const { apps } = useAppCollection()
const { app: activeApp } = useApp()
const { appId: configAppId, isTenant } = useFireUXConfig()
const bindingApps = computed(() =>
  isTenant ? (activeApp.value ? [activeApp.value] : []) : apps.value ?? []
)
const bindingApp = computed(
  () => bindingApps.value.find((item) => item?.id === configAppId) ?? null
)

const userCollection = computed(() => users.value ?? [])

const {
  driftKind: usersDriftKind,
  setDriftKind: setUsersDriftKind,
  selectedField: usersSelectedField,
  driftById: usersDriftById,
  filterOptions: usersFilterOptions,
  filteredCollection: filteredUsers,
} = useDevDriftFilter({
  collection: userCollection,
  runtimeModel: userModelRuntime,
})

const allUsersJsonPayload = computed(() => ({
  totalUsers: userCollection.value.length,
  users: userCollection.value,
}))

const filteredUsersDriftPayload = computed(() =>
  filteredUsers.value.map((user) => {
    const drift = usersDriftById.value.get(user.id) ?? { missing: [], extra: [] }
    return {
      id: user.id,
      displayName: user.display_name ?? '',
      drift,
    }
  })
)

const usersDriftCopyPayload = computed(() => ({
  modelPath: 'packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/models/core/user.model.ts',
  driftKind: usersDriftKind.value,
  selectedField: usersSelectedField.value || null,
  totalUsers: filteredUsers.value.length,
  users: filteredUsersDriftPayload.value,
}))

const updateUsersSelectedField = (value: string) => {
  usersSelectedField.value = value
}
</script>
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/plugins/firebase.client.ts

```ts
// FILE: packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/plugins/firebase.client.ts
import { defineNuxtPlugin, useRuntimeConfig } from 'nuxt/app'
import { getApps, initializeApp } from 'firebase/app'

function requireNonEmpty(value: unknown, label: string): string {
  if (typeof value === 'string' && value.trim()) return value.trim()
  throw new Error(`[fireux] Missing required Firebase runtime config: ${label}`)
}

export default defineNuxtPlugin(() => {
  const rc = useRuntimeConfig() as any

  const ecosystem = rc.public?.firebaseEcosystem?.firebase
  const firebaseApp = rc.public?.firebaseApp

  const apiKey = requireNonEmpty(
    ecosystem?.apiKey,
    'public.firebaseEcosystem.firebase.apiKey'
  )
  const authDomain = requireNonEmpty(
    ecosystem?.authDomain,
    'public.firebaseEcosystem.firebase.authDomain'
  )
  const projectId = requireNonEmpty(
    ecosystem?.projectId,
    'public.firebaseEcosystem.firebase.projectId'
  )
  const storageBucket = requireNonEmpty(
    ecosystem?.storageBucket,
    'public.firebaseEcosystem.firebase.storageBucket'
  )
  const messagingSenderId = requireNonEmpty(
    ecosystem?.messagingSenderId,
    'public.firebaseEcosystem.firebase.messagingSenderId'
  )
  const appId = requireNonEmpty(
    firebaseApp?.appId,
    'public.firebaseApp.appId (env: NUXT_FIREBASE_APP_ID)'
  )

  // Already initialised
  if (getApps().length) return

  initializeApp({
    apiKey,
    authDomain,
    projectId,
    storageBucket,
    messagingSenderId,
    appId,
    ...(firebaseApp?.measurementId ? { measurementId: firebaseApp.measurementId } : {}),
  })

  // Optional: confirm it ran (dev only)
  if (import.meta.dev) {
    // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
    console.log('[fireux] firebase web app initialised', { appId })
  }
})
```

```ts
// FILE: packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/plugins/fireux-config.client.ts
import { defineNuxtPlugin } from '#imports'
import { useFireUXConfig } from '../composables/fireux/app/FireUXConfig'

const FIREUX_CACHE_KEY = '__FIREUX_CONFIG'

/**
 * Client plugin:
 * - Provides the canonical FireUX config (built from runtimeConfig.public.fireux)
 * - Caches it on global scope to avoid rework
 */
export default defineNuxtPlugin(() => {
  const globalScope = globalThis as Record<string, unknown>
  const cached = globalScope[FIREUX_CACHE_KEY]
  if (cached) {
    return { provide: { fireuxConfig: cached } }
  }

  const cfg = useFireUXConfig()
  globalScope[FIREUX_CACHE_KEY] = cfg
  return { provide: { fireuxConfig: cfg } }
})
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/plugins/inject-trace.client.ts

```ts
import { defineNuxtPlugin } from '#imports'
import type { NuxtApp } from 'nuxt/app'
import type { ComponentPublicInstance } from 'vue'

/**
 * inject-trace.client
 * Dev helper: intercept Vue warns for inject()/Nuxt composables used outside setup
 * and print a focused report with component file and filtered stack lines.
 */
export default defineNuxtPlugin((nuxtApp: NuxtApp) => {
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') return

  // Minimal startup marker (kept concise to avoid client noise)
  console.info(
    '%c[InjectTrace]%c running',
    'color:#ef4444;font-weight:bold',
    'color:inherit'
  )

  const config = nuxtApp.vueApp.config
  const originalWarnHandler = config.warnHandler

  console.info(
    '%c[InjectTrace]%c warnHandler attached',
    'color:#ef4444;font-weight:bold',
    'color:inherit'
  )

  function safeToText(input: unknown): string {
    try {
      if (typeof input === 'string') return input
      if (input instanceof Error) return input.message || String(input)
      if (input == null) return ''
      const t = typeof input
      if (t === 'number' || t === 'boolean' || t === 'bigint')
        return `${input as number | boolean | bigint}`
      if (t === 'symbol')
        return (input as symbol).description ?? (input as symbol).toString()
      if (t === 'object') return JSON.stringify(input)
      return `${input as any}`
    } catch {
      try {
        return `${input as any}`
      } catch {
        return ''
      }
    }
  }

  function forwardToServer(payload: Record<string, unknown>) {
    try {
      const url = '/api/inject-trace'
      const body = JSON.stringify({
        ...payload,
        ts: Date.now(),
        href: typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.location.href : undefined,
        ua: typeof navigator !== 'undefined' ? navigator.userAgent : undefined,
      })
      // Prefer sendBeacon to avoid blocking and to survive unloads
      if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && 'sendBeacon' in navigator) {
        const blob = new Blob([body], { type: 'application/json' })
        ;(navigator as any).sendBeacon(url, blob)
        return
      }
      // Fallback to fetch with keepalive
      void fetch(url, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body,
        keepalive: true,
      }).catch(() => {})
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  }

  config.warnHandler = (
    message: string,
    instance: ComponentPublicInstance | null,
    trace: string
  ) => {
    const msg = String(message ?? '')
    const isInjectWarn = msg.includes('inject() can only be used inside setup')
    const isUseNuxtAppWarn = msg.includes(
      'A composable that requires access to the Nuxt instance'
    )

    if (isInjectWarn || isUseNuxtAppWarn) {
      const comp = (instance ?? {}) as {
        type?: { __file?: string; name?: string }
        __file?: string
        name?: string
      }
      const file = comp?.type?.__file ?? comp?.__file ?? 'unknown-file'
      const name = comp?.type?.name ?? comp?.name ?? 'anonymous-component'

      const err = new Error(msg)
      const stackLines = (err.stack || '').split('\n')
      const filtered = stackLines
        .filter(
          (line) => line.includes('/projects/') || line.includes('/packages/')
        )
        .filter((line) => !line.includes('node_modules'))
      const hint =
        filtered[0]?.trim() ||
        (trace ? String(trace).split('\n')[0] : '') ||
        '(no userland frame)'

      // Forward to server (no client console noise)
      forwardToServer({
        source: 'client-warnHandler',
        kind: isInjectWarn ? 'inject()' : 'nuxt-composable',
        message: msg,
        component: { name, file },
        hint,
        stack: filtered.slice(0, 12),
      })
    }

    if (typeof originalWarnHandler === 'function') {
      originalWarnHandler(message as any, instance as any, trace as any)
    }
  }

  // Fallback: some warnings may bypass warnHandler or another plugin may override it later.
  // Patch console.warn in dev to catch the signature strings and forward them to server.
  const g = globalThis as unknown as {
    __INJECT_TRACE_CONSOLE_PATCHED__?: boolean
  }
  if (!g.__INJECT_TRACE_CONSOLE_PATCHED__) {
    const originalConsoleWarn = console.warn.bind(console)
    console.warn = (...args: unknown[]) => {
      try {
        const text = args.map((a) => safeToText(a)).join(' ')
        const injectSig = 'inject() can only be used inside setup'
        const nuxtSig = 'A composable that requires access to the Nuxt instance'
        const isInjectWarn = text.includes(injectSig)
        const isUseNuxtAppWarn = text.includes(nuxtSig)
        if (isInjectWarn || isUseNuxtAppWarn) {
          const err = new Error(safeToText(args[0]))
          const stackLines = (err.stack || '').split('\n')
          const filtered = stackLines
            .filter(
              (line) =>
                line.includes('/projects/') || line.includes('/packages/')
            )
            .filter((line) => !line.includes('node_modules'))
          const hint = filtered[0]?.trim() || '(no userland frame)'
          forwardToServer({
            source: 'client-console-fallback',
            kind: isInjectWarn ? 'inject()' : 'nuxt-composable',
            message: text,
            hint,
            stack: filtered.slice(0, 12),
          })
        }
      } catch {
        // ignore
      } finally {
        originalConsoleWarn(...(args as any[]))
      }
    }
    g.__INJECT_TRACE_CONSOLE_PATCHED__ = true
  }
})

```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/plugins/inject-trace.server.ts

```ts
import { defineNuxtPlugin } from '#imports'

/**
 * inject-trace.server
 * Server-side tracer for Vue/Nuxt composable misuse that results in warnings/logs.
 * Many of these warnings are emitted on the client, but Nuxt/Nitro may also
 * log related messages server-side. This tracer wraps console.warn/error on the
 * server and prints filtered, actionable frames when we detect the signature messages.
 */
export default defineNuxtPlugin(() => {
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') return

  console.info('[InjectTrace:server] running')

  const g = globalThis as unknown as {
    __INJECT_TRACE_SERVER_PATCHED__?: boolean
  }
  if (g.__INJECT_TRACE_SERVER_PATCHED__) return

  const origWarn = console.warn.bind(console)
  const origError = console.error.bind(console)

  const handle = (_level: 'warn' | 'error', args: unknown[]) => {
    try {
      const text = args.map((a) => String(a)).join(' ')
      const isInjectWarn = text.includes(
        'inject() can only be used inside setup'
      )
      const isUseNuxtAppWarn = text.includes(
        'A composable that requires access to the Nuxt instance'
      )
      if (isInjectWarn || isUseNuxtAppWarn) {
        const err = new Error(String(args[0] ?? ''))
        const stack = (err.stack || '').split('\n')
        const filtered = stack
          .filter(
            (line) => line.includes('/projects/') || line.includes('/packages/')
          )
          .filter((line) => !line.includes('node_modules'))
        const hint = filtered[0]?.trim() || '(no userland frame)'
        console.log(
          `[InjectTrace:server] ${
            isInjectWarn ? 'inject()' : 'nuxt composable'
          } misuse\n` +
            `Message: ${text}\n` +
            `Hint: ${hint}\n` +
            (filtered.length > 1
              ? `Stack:\n${filtered.slice(0, 8).join('\n')}`
              : '')
        )
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  }

  console.warn = (...args: unknown[]) => {
    handle('warn', args)
    origWarn(...(args as any[]))
  }
  console.error = (...args: unknown[]) => {
    handle('error', args)
    origError(...(args as any[]))
  }

  g.__INJECT_TRACE_SERVER_PATCHED__ = true
})

```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/server/api/app/env-check.ts

```ts
// FILE: packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/server/api/app/env-check.ts
import { defineEventHandler, type H3Event } from 'h3'
import {
  join,
  isAbsolute,
  relative,
  resolve as pathResolve,
  dirname,
} from 'node:path'
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import imageSize from 'image-size'
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'

type ISizeCalculationResult = ReturnType<typeof imageSize>

/** Typed shape consumed by the client */
interface EnvVarEntry {
  key: string
  present: boolean
  value?: string
}
interface AdminAuthStatus {
  json: boolean
  splitKeys: {
    FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID: boolean
    FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL: boolean
    FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY: boolean
  }
  file: boolean
  configured: boolean
}
interface BrandAssetCheck {
  name: string
  path: string
  ok: boolean
  reason?: string
  width?: number
  height?: number
}

interface BrandConstraints {
  requiredWidth?: number
  requiredHeight?: number
  minWidth?: number
  minHeight?: number
  minAspect?: number
}

function findRepoRoot(start: string): string {
  let current = start

  for (let i = 0; i < 10; i += 1) {
    if (
      existsSync(join(current, 'pnpm-workspace.yaml')) ||
      existsSync(join(current, '.git'))
    ) {
      return current
    }

    const parent = pathResolve(current, '..')
    if (parent === current) break
    current = parent
  }

  return current
}

function validateBrandDimensions(
  name: string,
  dim: ISizeCalculationResult,
  constraints: BrandConstraints
): string | null {
  const type = dim.type
  if (!type) return 'Unknown file type'

  const isSvg = type === 'svg'
  const isPng = type === 'png'

  const isWordmark = name === 'wordmark' || name.startsWith('wordmark-')

  if (isWordmark && isSvg) return null

  if (!isSvg && !isPng) return 'Must be SVG or PNG'

  if (name === 'thumbnail' || name === 'logo') {
    const { requiredWidth, requiredHeight } = constraints
    if (!requiredWidth || !requiredHeight) return null
    if (dim.width === requiredWidth && dim.height === requiredHeight)
      return null
    return `Must be exactly ${requiredWidth}×${requiredHeight} (got ${dim.width}×${dim.height})`
  }

  if (isWordmark) {
    const minWidth = constraints.minWidth ?? 256
    const minHeight = constraints.minHeight ?? 64
    const minAspect = constraints.minAspect ?? 3
    const width = dim.width ?? 0
    const height = dim.height ?? 0
    if (
      width >= minWidth &&
      height >= minHeight &&
      height > 0 &&
      width / height >= minAspect
    ) {
      return null
    }
    return `Must be ≥${minWidth}×${minHeight} with aspect ≥${minAspect}:1 (got ${width}×${height})`
  }

  return null
}

/**
 * Utility: check if brand image exists and meets expected dimensions.
 */
function checkBrandImage(
  name: string,
  relativePath: string,
  resolveAssetPath: (relative: string) => string | null,
  requiredWidth?: number,
  requiredHeight?: number,
  minWidth?: number,
  minHeight?: number,
  minAspect?: number
): BrandAssetCheck {
  const absPath = resolveAssetPath(relativePath)
  const result: BrandAssetCheck = { name, path: relativePath, ok: false }

  if (!absPath || !existsSync(absPath)) {
    result.reason = `Missing file: /public/${relativePath}`
    return result
  }

  const buf = readFileSync(absPath)
  const dim = imageSize(buf)
  result.width = dim.width
  result.height = dim.height

  const validationError = validateBrandDimensions(name, dim, {
    requiredWidth,
    requiredHeight,
    minWidth,
    minHeight,
    minAspect,
  })

  if (validationError) {
    result.reason = validationError
  } else {
    result.ok = true
  }

  return result
}

function createBrandAssetResolver(
  repoRoot: string,
  ecosystem?: string,
  appNamespace?: string
) {
  const candidates = new Set<string>()
  candidates.add(join(process.cwd(), 'public'))
  candidates.add(join(repoRoot, 'public'))
  candidates.add(
    join(
      repoRoot,
      'packages',
      'core',
      'fireux-core',
      'src',
      'runtime',
      'public'
    )
  )

  const scoped = (ecosystem || '').trim()
  if (scoped) {
    candidates.add(
      join(
        repoRoot,
        'packages',
        'ecosystem',
        `fireux-${scoped}`,
        'src',
        'runtime',
        'public'
      )
    )
    candidates.add(
      join(repoRoot, 'projects', scoped, `${scoped}-app`, 'public')
    )
  }

  const appScoped = (appNamespace || '').trim()
  if (appScoped) {
    candidates.add(
      join(repoRoot, 'projects', appScoped, `${appScoped}`, 'public')
    )
    candidates.add(
      join(repoRoot, 'projects', appScoped, `${appScoped}-app`, 'public')
```

```ts
import { defineEventHandler, setResponseHeaders, type H3Event } from 'h3'
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { useFireUXConfig } from '../../../composables/fireux/app/FireUXConfig'

type PackageInfo = {

  version?: string
}

function readPackageInfo(): PackageInfo {
  try {
    const raw = readFileSync(join(process.cwd(), 'package.json'), 'utf8')
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as { name?: unknown; version?: unknown }
    return {
      name: typeof parsed.name === 'string' ? parsed.name : undefined,
      version: typeof parsed.version === 'string' ? parsed.version : undefined,
    }
  } catch {
    return {}
  }
}

export default defineEventHandler((event: H3Event) => {
  const cfg = useFireUXConfig()
  const pkg = readPackageInfo()

  setResponseHeaders(event, {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8',
    'Cache-Control': 'no-store',
    'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
  })

  return {
    ok: true,
    app: {
      id: cfg.appId,
      name: cfg.appName,
      shortName: cfg.appShortName,
      ecosystem: cfg.ecosystem,
      role: cfg.role,
      modules: cfg.modules,
      logo: cfg.appLogo || cfg.appThumbnail,
      appThumbnail: cfg.appThumbnail,
    },
    package: pkg,
    endpoints: {
      info: '/api/app/info',
      envCheck: '/api/app/env-check',
    },
    now: new Date().toISOString(),
  }
})
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/server/api/dev/images.get.ts

```ts
import { readdir } from 'node:fs/promises'
import path from 'node:path'
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
import { defineEventHandler } from 'h3'
import { useRuntimeConfig } from '#imports'

type ImageEntry = {
  urlPath: string
  filePath: string
}

type ImageGroup = {
  key: string
  title: string
  rootDir: string
  images: ImageEntry[]
}

const isImageFile = (name: string) =>
  /\.(png|jpg|jpeg|webp|svg|ico)$/i.test(name)

async function listImagesUnderPublicDir(publicDir: string): Promise<ImageEntry[]> {
  const imgDir = path.join(publicDir, 'img')

  const results: ImageEntry[] = []

  async function walk(dir: string) {
    let entries: Array<{ name: string; isDirectory: () => boolean }> = []
    try {
      entries = (await readdir(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) as any
    } catch {
      return
    }

    for (const entry of entries) {
      const full = path.join(dir, entry.name)
      if (entry.isDirectory()) {
        await walk(full)
        continue
      }

      if (!isImageFile(entry.name)) continue

      const relFromPublic = path.relative(publicDir, full).split(path.sep).join('/')
      results.push({
        urlPath: `/${relFromPublic}`,
        filePath: full,
      })
    }
  }

  await walk(imgDir)

  results.sort((a, b) => a.urlPath.localeCompare(b.urlPath))
  return results
}

function getCorePublicDir(): string {
  // This file: src/runtime/server/api/dev/images.get.ts
  // Core public: src/runtime/public
  const here = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)
  return path.resolve(path.dirname(here), '../../../public')
}

export default defineEventHandler(async () => {
  const groups: ImageGroup[] = []

  // App public dir (when running inside a project)
  const appPublic = path.join(process.cwd(), 'public')
  groups.push({
    key: 'app',
    title: 'App images',
    rootDir: appPublic,
    images: await listImagesUnderPublicDir(appPublic),
  })

  // fireux-core public dir
  const corePublic = getCorePublicDir()
  groups.push({
    key: 'core',
    title: 'Core images',
    rootDir: corePublic,
    images: await listImagesUnderPublicDir(corePublic),
  })

  // Ecosystem public dirs registered by ecosystem modules (server-only runtimeConfig)
  const config = useRuntimeConfig() as any
  const ecoDirs = (config?.fireuxDev?.ecosystemPublicDirs ?? []) as Array<{
    key?: string
    title?: string
    dir: string
  }>

  for (const [index, eco] of ecoDirs.entries()) {
    groups.push({
      key: eco.key ?? `ecosystem-${index}`,
      title: eco.title ?? 'Ecosystem images',
      rootDir: eco.dir,
      images: await listImagesUnderPublicDir(eco.dir),
    })
  }

  return {
    groups,
  }
})

```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/server/api/firestore/update-document.post.ts

```ts
import { defineEventHandler, readBody, createError, type H3Event } from 'h3'
import { initializeApp, getApps, cert } from 'firebase-admin/app'
import { getFirestore } from 'firebase-admin/firestore'
import { promises as fs } from 'fs'
import { join } from 'path'

// Function to initialize Firebase Admin with dynamic service account
async function initializeFirebaseAdmin() {
  console.log('🔧 [firestore] Starting Firebase Admin initialization...')
  console.log('🔧 [firestore] Current working directory:', process.cwd())
  console.log('🔧 [firestore] Current Firebase apps:', getApps().length)

  // Always try to get existing app first
  const existingApps = getApps()
  if (existingApps.length > 0) {
    console.log(
      '🔧 [firestore] Firebase Admin already initialized, using existing app'
    )
    return existingApps[0] // Return the existing app
  }

  try {
    // Try environment variable first (for production deployment)
    // FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT is the single supported contract (JSON string)
    const envServiceAccount = process.env.FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT
    if (envServiceAccount) {
      console.log(
        '🔧 [firestore] Using service account from environment variable'
      )
      const app = initializeApp({
        credential: cert(JSON.parse(envServiceAccount)),
      })
      console.log('✅ [firestore] Firebase Admin initialized from environment')
      return app
    }

    // For local development, find the service account file relative to the app
    // The server runs from the app directory, so config/service-account.json should be accessible
    const serviceAccountPath = join(
      process.cwd(),
      'config',
      'service-account.json'
    )
    console.log(
      '🔧 [firestore] Looking for service account at:',
      serviceAccountPath
    )

    // Check if file exists
    try {
      await fs.access(serviceAccountPath)
      console.log('✅ [firestore] Service account file found')

      const serviceAccountContent = await fs.readFile(
        serviceAccountPath,
        'utf-8'
      )
      const serviceAccount = JSON.parse(serviceAccountContent)

      console.log(
        '🔧 [firestore] Successfully loaded service account for project:',
        serviceAccount.project_id
      )

      const app = initializeApp({
        credential: cert(serviceAccount),
      })
      console.log('✅ [firestore] Firebase Admin initialized from file')
      return app
    } catch (accessError) {
      console.error(
        '❌ [firestore] Service account file not found at:',
        serviceAccountPath
      )

      // Try alternative paths
      const alternativePaths = [
        join(process.cwd(), '..', 'config', 'service-account.json'),
        join(process.cwd(), '..', '..', 'config', 'service-account.json'),
        join(
          __dirname,
          '..',
          '..',
          '..',
          '..',
          'config',
          'service-account.json'
        ),
      ]

      for (const altPath of alternativePaths) {
        try {
          await fs.access(altPath)
          console.log(
            '✅ [firestore] Found service account at alternative path:',
            altPath
          )
          const serviceAccountContent = await fs.readFile(altPath, 'utf-8')
          const serviceAccount = JSON.parse(serviceAccountContent)

          console.log(
            '🔧 [firestore] Successfully loaded service account for project:',
            serviceAccount.project_id
          )

          const app = initializeApp({
            credential: cert(serviceAccount),
          })
          console.log(
            '✅ [firestore] Firebase Admin initialized from alternative path'
          )
          return app
        } catch (altError) {
          console.log('❌ [firestore] Alternative path not found:', altPath)
        }
      }

      throw new Error(
        `Service account file not found. Tried: ${serviceAccountPath} and alternatives`
      )
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('❌ [firestore] Failed to initialize Firebase Admin:', error)
    throw new Error(
      `Firebase Admin initialization failed: ${
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
      }`
    )
  }
}

export default defineEventHandler(async (event: H3Event) => {
  try {
    console.log('🔧 [update-document] Starting request...')
    console.log('🔧 [update-document] Current Firebase apps:', getApps().length)

    // Initialize Firebase Admin with the correct service account and get the app instance
    const app = await initializeFirebaseAdmin()

    console.log(
      '🔧 [update-document] After initialization, Firebase apps:',
      getApps().length
    )

    const body = await readBody(event)
    console.log('📝 update-document received:', body)

    const { collection, documentId, data, merge = true, ping } = body

    // Handle ping/pong for testing
    if (ping) {
      console.log('🏓 [update-document] Ping received:', ping)
    }

    // Validate required fields
    if (!collection || !documentId || !data) {
      throw createError({
        statusCode: 400,
        statusMessage: 'Missing required fields: collection, documentId, data',
      })
    }

    console.log(`📝 [update-document] Updating ${collection}/${documentId}`)

    // Get Firestore instance from the initialized app
    const db = getFirestore(app as any)

    // Update the document
    const docRef = db.collection(collection).doc(documentId)

    if (merge) {
      await docRef.set(data, { merge: true })
    } else {
      await docRef.set(data)
    }

    console.log(
      `✅ [update-document] Document ${collection}/${documentId} updated successfully`
    )

    return {
      success: true,
      collection,
      documentId,
      message: `Document updated in ${collection}/${documentId}`,
      pong: ping ? `pong-${ping}` : undefined,
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('❌ [update-document] Error:', error)

    const errorMessage =
      error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error occurred'

    throw createError({
      statusCode: 500,
      statusMessage: `Failed to update document: ${errorMessage}`,
    })
  }
})
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/server/api/inject-trace.post.ts

```ts
import {
  defineEventHandler,
  readBody,
  getHeader,
  getRequestURL,
  type H3Event,
} from 'h3'

export default defineEventHandler(async (event: H3Event) => {
  try {
    const body = await readBody(event)
    const ua = body?.ua || getHeader(event, 'user-agent') || 'n/a'
    const href = body?.href || getRequestURL(event).search || ''
    const kind = body?.kind || body?.type || 'unknown'
    const message = body?.message || ''
    const hint = body?.hint || ''
    const stack: string[] = Array.isArray(body?.stack) ? body.stack : []
    const component = body?.component || {}

    // Server-side log with clear block formatting

    console.log('\n[InjectTrace:server] ← client forwarded')

    console.log('Kind:', kind)

    console.log('Message:', message)

    console.log('Component:', component)

    console.log('Hint:', hint)
    if (stack.length) {
      console.log('Stack (first frames):\n' + stack.slice(0, 12).join('\n'))
    }

    console.log('UA:', ua)

    console.log('Href:', href)

    return { ok: true }
  } catch (e: any) {
    console.error('[InjectTrace:server] handler error:', e?.message || e)
    return { ok: false }
  }
})
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/server/api/proxy/image.get.ts

```ts
import {
  defineEventHandler,
  getQuery,
  setResponseHeaders,
  createError,
  send,
  type H3Event,
} from 'h3'

export default defineEventHandler(async (event: H3Event) => {
  const { url } = getQuery(event)

  if (!url || typeof url !== 'string') {
    throw createError({
      statusCode: 400,
      statusMessage: 'Missing or invalid URL parameter',
    })
  }

  // Basic safety: only http(s) URLs
  if (!/^https?:\/\//i.test(url)) {
    throw createError({
      statusCode: 400,
      statusMessage: 'Invalid protocol, must be http/https',
    })
  }

  try {
    const t0 = Date.now()
    const response = await fetch(url, { redirect: 'follow' })

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw createError({
        statusCode: response.status,
        statusMessage: `Failed to fetch image: ${response.statusText}`,
      })
    }

    const imageBuffer = await response.arrayBuffer()
    const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type') || 'image/jpeg'
    const contentLength =
      response.headers.get('content-length') || `${imageBuffer.byteLength}`

    // Dev-time observability
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') {
      console.log('[proxy/image] upstream', {
        url,
        status: response.status,
        ok: response.ok,
        contentType,
        contentLength,
        ms: Date.now() - t0,
      })
    }

    setResponseHeaders(event, {
      'Content-Type': contentType,
      'Cache-Control': 'public, max-age=3600',
      'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
    })

    return send(event, Buffer.from(imageBuffer))
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('[proxy/image] error:', error?.message || error)
    throw createError({
      statusCode: 502,
      statusMessage: 'Image proxy failed',
    })
  }
})
```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/server/utils/getAdmin.ts

```ts
import * as admin from 'firebase-admin'

function readEnv(k: string) {
  const v = process.env[k]
  return v?.trim()?.length ? v : undefined
}

function normalizeStorageBucket(bucket?: string) {
  if (!bucket) return undefined
  // Firebase Web config may provide the new host-style bucket
  // e.g. "fireux-2005.firebasestorage.app". Admin SDK expects
  // the canonical bucket name "fireux-2005.appspot.com".
  if (bucket.endsWith('.firebasestorage.app')) {
    const projectId = bucket.replace(/\.firebasestorage\.app$/, '')
    return `${projectId}.appspot.com`
  }
  return bucket
}

function getServiceAccountFromEnv():
  | { projectId: string; clientEmail: string; privateKey: string }
  | undefined {
  const json = readEnv('FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT')
  if (json) {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(json)
      const projectId = parsed.project_id ?? parsed.projectId
      const clientEmail = parsed.client_email ?? parsed.clientEmail
      const rawKey = parsed.private_key ?? parsed.privateKey
      const privateKey =
        typeof rawKey === 'string' ? rawKey.replace(/\\n/g, '\n') : undefined
      if (projectId && clientEmail && privateKey) {
        return { projectId, clientEmail, privateKey }
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  }
  const projectId = readEnv('FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID')
  const clientEmail = readEnv('FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL')
  const rawKey = readEnv('FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY')
  const privateKey =
    typeof rawKey === 'string' ? rawKey.replace(/\\n/g, '\n') : undefined
  if (projectId && clientEmail && privateKey)
    return { projectId, clientEmail, privateKey }
}

// Guarded singleton accessor for firebase-admin
export function getAdmin() {
  if (!admin.apps.length) {
    try {
      const sa = getServiceAccountFromEnv()
      const storageBucket = normalizeStorageBucket(
        readEnv('FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET')
      )
      if (sa) {
        admin.initializeApp({
          credential: admin.credential.cert({
            projectId: sa.projectId,
            clientEmail: sa.clientEmail,
            privateKey: sa.privateKey,
          }),
          ...(storageBucket ? { storageBucket } : {}),
        })
      } else {
        admin.initializeApp({
          credential: admin.credential.applicationDefault(),
          ...(storageBucket ? { storageBucket } : {}),
        })
      }
    } catch {
      // In case of race during dev HMR, ignore
    }
  }
  return admin
}

```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/utils/fieldMap.ts

```ts
// packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/utils/fieldMap.ts
export type MapDef = Record<string, string>

export interface MapOptions {
  /** drop keys whose value is undefined or null */
  dropNullish?: boolean
}

export function createFieldMapper<
  TUi extends Record<string, any>,
  TFs extends Record<string, any>,
>(map: MapDef) {
  // Passthrough: keys not present in `map` are copied unchanged in both directions.
  const reverse = Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(map).map(([k, v]) => [v, k])
  ) as Record<string, string>

  function toFs(ui: Partial<TUi>, opts: MapOptions = {}): Partial<TFs> {
    const out: Record<string, any> = {}
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(ui ?? {})) {
      if (opts.dropNullish && (v === undefined || v === null)) continue
      const target = (map as Record<string, string>)[k] ?? k
      out[target] = v
    }
    return out as Partial<TFs>
  }

  function fromFs(fs: Partial<TFs>, opts: MapOptions = {}): Partial<TUi> {
    const out: Record<string, any> = {}
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(fs ?? {})) {
      if (opts.dropNullish && (v === undefined || v === null)) continue
      const target = reverse[k] ?? k
      out[target] = v
    }
    return out as Partial<TUi>
  }

  return { toFs, fromFs }
}

```

### packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/utils/formatTimestamp.ts

```ts
import type { Timestamp } from 'firebase/firestore'

export type FirestoreTimestampLike =
  | Timestamp
  | { seconds: number; nanoseconds?: number }
  | { _seconds: number; _nanoseconds?: number }
  | Date
  | string
  | number
  | null
  | undefined

export interface FormatTimestampOptions {
  fallback?: string
  locale?: string
  format?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions
}

const DEFAULT_FORMAT: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions = {
  dateStyle: 'medium',
  timeStyle: 'short',
}

export function coerceFirestoreTimestamp(
  value: FirestoreTimestampLike
): Date | null {
  if (!value && value !== 0) return null

  if (value instanceof Date) return value

  if (typeof value === 'string' || typeof value === 'number') {
    const parsed = new Date(value)
    return Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime()) ? null : parsed
  }

  if (typeof value === 'object') {
    const anyValue = value as any

    if (typeof anyValue.toDate === 'function') {
      try {
        const date = anyValue.toDate()
        return date instanceof Date && !Number.isNaN(date.getTime())
          ? date
          : null
      } catch (
        /* istanbul ignore next: defensive */
        _err
      ) {
        return null
      }
    }

    if (typeof anyValue.seconds === 'number') {
      const seconds = Number(anyValue.seconds)
      const nanos = Number(anyValue.nanoseconds ?? 0)
      return new Date(seconds * 1000 + nanos / 1_000_000)
    }

    if (typeof anyValue._seconds === 'number') {
      const seconds = Number(anyValue._seconds)
      const nanos = Number(anyValue._nanoseconds ?? 0)
      return new Date(seconds * 1000 + nanos / 1_000_000)
    }
  }

  return null
}

export function formatFirestoreTimestamp(
  value: FirestoreTimestampLike,
  options: FormatTimestampOptions = {}
): string | undefined {
  const date = coerceFirestoreTimestamp(value)
  if (!date) return options.fallback

  const formatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(
    options.locale ?? undefined,
    options.format ?? DEFAULT_FORMAT
  )
  return formatter.format(date)
}

```

```ts
  type: 'firestore/timestamp/1.0'
  seconds: number
```

Owned by fireux.

Describe what this module ships, its guardrails, and how consumers should enable it.

   ```ts
   export default defineNuxtConfig({
     modules: ['fireux-ecosystem-controller'],

   ```

```ts
import {
    ensureRuntimeConfigBuckets,
    ensureRuntimeLayerFromPath,
    exposeRuntimeAlias,
} from 'fireux-core/config/module/runtime-layer'
import { addImportsDir, createResolver, defineNuxtModule } from 'nuxt/kit'
import type { } from 'nuxt/schema'


declare module 'nuxt/schema' {
  interface NuxtConfig {
    ecosystemController?: Partial<typeof defaults>
  }
  interface NuxtOptions {
    ecosystemController?: Partial<typeof defaults>
  }
}

const defaults = {
  enabled: true,
}

export default defineNuxtModule({
  meta: {
    name: 'fireux-ecosystem-controller',
    configKey: 'ecosystemController',
    compatibility: { nuxt: '^4.0.0' },
  },
  defaults,
  setup(_options, nuxt) {
    const resolver = createResolver(import.meta.url)
    const runtimeDir = resolver.resolve('./runtime')

    ensureRuntimeConfigBuckets(nuxt, 'ecosystemController')

    // Auto-import runtime composables directory (create files as needed)
    addImportsDir(resolver.resolve('./runtime/composables'))

    // Layer runtime pages (e.g., /apps)
    ensureRuntimeLayerFromPath(nuxt, runtimeDir)

    exposeRuntimeAlias(nuxt, '#fireux-ecosystem-controller', runtimeDir)
  },
})
```

### packages/core/fireux-nuxtfire/README.md

```md
# fireux-nuxtfire

A small bridge module that ensures VueFire is configured early (Nuxt module setup time) and that the Firebase Web SDK is initialised once on the client.

## Contract

- Reads:
  - `runtimeConfig.public.firebaseEcosystem.firebase` (`apiKey`, `authDomain`, `projectId`, optional `storageBucket`, `messagingSenderId`)
  - `runtimeConfig.public.firebaseApp` (optional `appId`, `measurementId`)
- Writes (during module setup):
  - `nuxt.options.vuefire.config`
  - `nuxt.options.vuefire.auth.enabled = true`
- Adds:
  - Client plugin `runtime/plugins/firebase.client.ts`

This module is intended to be installed before `nuxt-vuefire`.

```
