### packages/core/fireux-nuxtfire/src/module.ts

```ts
// FILE: packages/core/fireux-nuxtfire/src/module.ts
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { isAbsolute, join, resolve } from 'node:path'

import { addPlugin, createResolver, defineNuxtModule, installModule } from '@nuxt/kit'

function findMonorepoRoot(startDir: string): string {
  let dir = startDir
  for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
    if (existsSync(join(dir, 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'))) return dir
    const parent = resolve(dir, '..')
    if (parent === dir) break
    dir = parent
  }
  return startDir
}

function pickFirebaseEcosystemId(nuxt: any): string | undefined {
  const runtime = (nuxt?.options?.runtimeConfig ?? {}) as any
  const pub = (runtime.public ?? {}) as any
  const id = pub?.firebaseEcosystem?.id
  return typeof id === 'string' && id.trim() ? id.trim() : undefined
}

function pickEcoServiceAccountFilePath(nuxt: any): string | undefined {
  const ecoId = pickFirebaseEcosystemId(nuxt)
  if (!ecoId) return

  const startDir =
    (typeof nuxt?.options?.rootDir === 'string' && nuxt.options.rootDir) || process.cwd()
  const root = findMonorepoRoot(startDir)

  // Ecosystem packages are typically under `packages/ecosystem/` and may be named:
  // - fireux-cleanbox (already prefixed)
  // - fireux-fireux   (derived from eco id: fireux)
  const candidates = [ecoId]
  if (!ecoId.startsWith('fireux-')) candidates.push(`fireux-${ecoId}`)

  for (const pkgName of candidates) {
    const p = join(
      root,
      'packages',
      'ecosystem',
      pkgName,
      'src',
      'config',
      'firebase',
      'service-account.json'
    )
    if (existsSync(p)) return p
  }
}

function isNonEmptyString(value: unknown): value is string {
  return typeof value === 'string' && value.trim().length > 0
}

function hasServiceAccountPrivateKey(payload: unknown): boolean {
  if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') return false
  const anyPayload = payload as any
  return isNonEmptyString(anyPayload.private_key) || isNonEmptyString(anyPayload.privateKey)
}

function validateServiceAccountJsonString(value: string): boolean {
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(value)
    return hasServiceAccountPrivateKey(parsed)
  } catch {
    return false
  }
}

function tryReadJsonFile(pathLike: string): string | null {
  const candidatePaths = [pathLike]
  if (!isAbsolute(pathLike)) {
    candidatePaths.push(resolve(process.cwd(), pathLike))
  }

  for (const p of candidatePaths) {
    if (!existsSync(p)) continue
    try {
      return readFileSync(p, 'utf8')
    } catch {
      return null
    }
  }

  return null
}

function validateGoogleApplicationCredentials(value: string): boolean {
  const trimmed = value.trim()
  if (!trimmed) return false

  // vuefire supports parsing GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS as inline JSON.
  if (trimmed.startsWith('{')) {
    return validateServiceAccountJsonString(trimmed)
  }

  // Otherwise treat it as a file path.
  const file = tryReadJsonFile(trimmed)
  if (!file) return false
  return validateServiceAccountJsonString(file)
}

function unsetGoogleApplicationCredentials(reason: string) {
  // Avoid crashing nuxt-vuefire SSR plugin when the env var points to a non
  // service-account JSON (e.g. OAuth client/user credentials without private_key).
  if (process.env.GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS) {
    // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
    console.warn('[fireux-nuxtfire] Ignoring GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS:', reason)
    delete process.env.GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  }
}

function ensureGoogleApplicationCredentialsEnv(nuxt: any): boolean {
  // nuxt-vuefire uses GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS to decide whether it can
  // enable its SSR/admin plugins. In FireUX, our canonical contract is
  // FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT (JSON) or FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_FILE (path).
  const existing = process.env.GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  if (typeof existing === 'string' && existing.trim()) {
    if (validateGoogleApplicationCredentials(existing)) return true
    unsetGoogleApplicationCredentials('value is not a Firebase service-account (missing private_key)')
  }

  // First, try to load from the local ecosystem package (dev-friendly).
  // This is intentionally server-only and avoids leaking any credential contents.
  const ecoFile = pickEcoServiceAccountFilePath(nuxt)
  if (ecoFile) {
    if (validateGoogleApplicationCredentials(ecoFile)) {
      process.env.GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS = ecoFile
      return true
    }
  }

  const file = process.env.FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_FILE
  if (typeof file === 'string' && file.trim()) {
    const trimmed = file.trim()
    if (validateGoogleApplicationCredentials(trimmed)) {
      process.env.GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS = trimmed
      return true
    }
  }

  const inline = process.env.FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT
  if (typeof inline === 'string' && inline.trim()) {
    const raw = inline.trim()
    if (raw.startsWith('{')) {
      if (validateGoogleApplicationCredentials(raw)) {
        process.env.GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS = raw
        return true
      }
    }

    // Some environments provide the service account JSON base64-encoded.
    try {
      const decoded = Buffer.from(raw, 'base64').toString('utf8').trim()
      if (decoded.startsWith('{')) {
        if (validateGoogleApplicationCredentials(decoded)) {
          process.env.GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS = decoded
          return true
        }
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  }

  // Support split-key env format (canonical in parts of FireUX).
  const projectId = process.env.FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID?.trim()
  const clientEmail = process.env.FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL?.trim()
  const privateKey = process.env.FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY?.trim()
  if (projectId && clientEmail && privateKey) {
    const payload = JSON.stringify({
      project_id: projectId,
      client_email: clientEmail,
      private_key: privateKey,
    })
    if (validateGoogleApplicationCredentials(payload)) {
      process.env.GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS = payload
      return true
    }
  }

  return false
}

type FirebaseEcosystemConfig = {
  apiKey?: string
  authDomain?: string
  projectId?: string
  storageBucket?: string
  messagingSenderId?: string
}

type FirebaseAppConfig = {
  appId?: string
  measurementId?: string
}

```

### packages/core/fireux-nuxtfire/src/runtime/plugins/firebase-admin-fallback.server.ts

```ts
import { ensureAdminApp } from 'vuefire/server'
import { defineNuxtPlugin, useRequestEvent, useRuntimeConfig } from '#imports'

export default defineNuxtPlugin(() => {
  const event = useRequestEvent()
  const { vuefire } = useRuntimeConfig()

  // In dev, we often run SSR + client auth without a service account.
  // nuxt-vuefire still installs its server auth plugin, which expects an
  // injected `$firebaseAdminApp`. Provide a best-effort admin app so it
  // doesn't crash with "The default Firebase app does not exist".
  const firebaseAdminApp = ensureAdminApp(vuefire?.admin?.options)

  if (event) {
    event.context.firebaseApp = firebaseAdminApp
  }

  return {
    provide: {
      firebaseAdminApp,
    },
  }
})

```

### packages/core/fireux-nuxtfire/src/runtime/plugins/firebase.client.ts

```ts
// FILE: packages/core/fireux-nuxtfire/src/runtime/plugins/firebase.client.ts
import { defineNuxtPlugin, useRuntimeConfig } from '#imports'
import { getApps, initializeApp } from 'firebase/app'

function requireNonEmpty(value: unknown, label: string): string {
  if (typeof value === 'string' && value.trim()) return value.trim()
  throw new Error(`[fireux-nuxtfire] Missing required Firebase runtime config: ${label}`)
}

export default defineNuxtPlugin(() => {
  const rc = useRuntimeConfig() as any

  const ecosystem = rc.public?.firebaseEcosystem?.firebase
  const firebaseApp = rc.public?.firebaseApp

  const apiKey = requireNonEmpty(
    ecosystem?.apiKey,
    'public.firebaseEcosystem.firebase.apiKey'
  )
  const authDomain = requireNonEmpty(
    ecosystem?.authDomain,
    'public.firebaseEcosystem.firebase.authDomain'
  )
  const projectId = requireNonEmpty(
    ecosystem?.projectId,
    'public.firebaseEcosystem.firebase.projectId'
  )
  const storageBucket = requireNonEmpty(
    ecosystem?.storageBucket,
    'public.firebaseEcosystem.firebase.storageBucket'
  )
  const messagingSenderId = requireNonEmpty(
    ecosystem?.messagingSenderId,
    'public.firebaseEcosystem.firebase.messagingSenderId'
  )
  const appId = requireNonEmpty(
    firebaseApp?.appId,
    'public.firebaseApp.appId (env: NUXT_FIREBASE_APP_ID)'
  )

  // Already initialised.
  if (getApps().length) return

  initializeApp({
    apiKey,
    authDomain,
    projectId,
    storageBucket,
    messagingSenderId,
    appId,
    ...(firebaseApp?.measurementId ? { measurementId: firebaseApp.measurementId } : {}),
  })

  if (import.meta.dev) {
    // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
    console.log('[fireux-nuxtfire] firebase web app initialised', {
      projectId,
      authDomain,
      appId,
    })
  }
})

```

import type { Resolver } from '@nuxt/kit';
import type { Nuxt } from '@nuxt/schema';
import { registerComponentsDir } from 'fireux-core/config/module/module-helpers';

/**
 * Register runtime components for this module.
 */
export function configureComponents(resolver: Resolver, nuxt: Nuxt) {
  const componentsDir = registerComponentsDir(resolver, './runtime/components', {
    global: false,
    pathPrefix: true,
    priority: 1,
  })

  if (!componentsDir) return

  ;(nuxt.options.alias ||= {}) as Record<string, string>
  ;(nuxt.options.alias as Record<string, string>)['#fireux-cleanbox-components'] =
    componentsDir
}

### packages/ecosystem/fireux-cleanbox/src/module.ts

```ts
import { addImportsDir, createResolver, defineNuxtModule } from '@nuxt/kit'
import type { Nuxt, NuxtModule } from '@nuxt/schema'
import { setRuntimeFirebaseEcosystem } from 'fireux-core/config/app/runtime'
import { configurePages } from 'fireux-core/config/module/pages-config'
import { existsSync } from 'fs'
import { ecosystemConfig } from './config/firebase/ecosystem.config'
import { configureComponents } from './config/module/components-config'

const module: NuxtModule<Record<string, never>> = defineNuxtModule({
  meta: {
    name: 'fireux-cleanbox',
    version: '0.1.0',
    configKey: 'fireuxCleanbox',
  },
  async setup(_options: Record<string, never>, nuxt: Nuxt) {
    const resolver = createResolver(import.meta.url)

    // Core and any extensions are provided by the app via createFireuxConfig

    // Preferred runtime shape (used by fireux-nuxtfire / nuxt-vuefire config)
    setRuntimeFirebaseEcosystem(nuxt as any, {
      id: ecosystemConfig.id,
      name: ecosystemConfig.name,
      description: ecosystemConfig.description,
      firebase: ecosystemConfig.firebase,
    })

    // Layer runtime pages/layouts/middleware
    configurePages(resolver, nuxt)

    configureComponents(resolver, nuxt)

    // Auto-import composables and models if present
    const composablesDir = resolver.resolve('./runtime/composables')
    if (existsSync(composablesDir)) {
      addImportsDir(composablesDir)
    }

    // NOTE: Do NOT auto-import models.
    // - It creates collisions for common type names (e.g. Pill/Cell/Profile)
    // - Models should be imported explicitly by consumers

    // Serve runtime public assets via Nitro
    const publicDir = resolver.resolve('./runtime/public')
    if (existsSync(publicDir)) {
      const nitro = ((nuxt.options as any).nitro ||= {}) as Record<string, any>
      const publicAssets = (nitro.publicAssets ||= []) as Array<
        string | { baseURL?: string; dir: string; maxAge?: number }
      >

      const already = publicAssets.some((entry) =>
        typeof entry === 'string' ? entry === publicDir : entry?.dir === publicDir
      )
      if (!already) publicAssets.push({ dir: publicDir })

      nuxt.hook('nitro:config', (nitroConfig: any) => {
        nitroConfig.alias ||= {}
        nitroConfig.alias['#fireux-cleanbox-public'] = publicDir
      })

      // Dev tooling: expose ecosystem public dirs for /dev/images scanning
      const rc = ((nuxt.options as any).runtimeConfig ||= {}) as Record<string, any>
      const fireuxDev = (rc.fireuxDev ||= {}) as Record<string, any>
      const ecoDirs = (fireuxDev.ecosystemPublicDirs ||= []) as Array<any>
      const alreadyDev = ecoDirs.some((e) => e?.dir === publicDir)
      if (!alreadyDev) {
        ecoDirs.push({ key: 'cleanbox', title: 'Cleanbox ecosystem images', dir: publicDir })
      }
    }

    nuxt.hook('ready', () => {
      console.log('fireux-cleanbox: module configured')
    })
  },
})

export default module

```

```ts
// FILE: /packages/ecosystem/fireux-cleanbox/src/runtime/composables/fireux/app/utils/effects/useLandingEffect.ts
// Unified landing effect composable for this tenant
export function useLandingEffect() {
  const initializeEffect = (
    effectType: 'stars' | 'bubbles' | 'steam' | 'code'
  ) => {
    const elements = document.querySelectorAll('.effect-particle')

    for (const element of elements) {
      const particleElement = element as HTMLElement

      // Common positioning
      particleElement.style.left = `${Math.random() * 100}%`
      const startingPoint = Math.random() * 100
      particleElement.style.top = `${startingPoint}%`
      const initialYPos = 100 - startingPoint
      particleElement.style.transform = `translateY(${initialYPos}vh)`

      switch (effectType) {
        case 'stars':
          initializeStars(particleElement, startingPoint)
          break
        case 'bubbles':
          initializeBubbles(particleElement, startingPoint)
          break
        case 'steam':
          initializeSteam(particleElement, startingPoint)
          break
        case 'code':
          initializeCode(particleElement, startingPoint)
          break
      }
    }
  }

  const initializeStars = (element: HTMLElement, startingPoint: number) => {
    const size = Math.random() * 1.5 + 1
    element.style.width = `${size}px`
    element.style.height = `${size}px`
    const initialOpacity = Math.random() * 0.4 + 0.1
    element.style.opacity = initialOpacity.toString()
    const twinkleDuration = Math.random() * 3 + 3
    const moveDuration = Math.random() * 340 + 340
    const moveDelay = -(moveDuration * (startingPoint / 100))
    const twinkleDelay = Math.random() * 2
    element.style.animationDelay = `${twinkleDelay}s, ${moveDelay}s`
    element.style.animationDuration = `${twinkleDuration}s, ${moveDuration}s`
    element.addEventListener('animationiteration', () => {
      element.style.top = '100%'
      element.style.transform = `translateY(-100vh)`
    })
  }

  const initializeBubbles = (element: HTMLElement, startingPoint: number) => {
    const size = Math.random() * 20 + 10
    element.style.width = `${size}px`
    element.style.height = `${size}px`
    const initialOpacity = Math.random() * 0.3 + 0.1
    element.style.opacity = initialOpacity.toString()
    const floatDuration = Math.random() * 5 + 8
    const popDuration = Math.random() * 2 + 2
    const sway = Math.random() * 3 + 2
    const floatDelay = -(floatDuration * (startingPoint / 100))
    const popDelay = Math.random() * 3
    const swayDelay = Math.random() * 2
    element.style.animationDelay = `${popDelay}s, ${floatDelay}s, ${swayDelay}s`
    element.style.animationDuration = `${popDuration}s, ${floatDuration}s, ${sway}s`
    element.addEventListener('animationiteration', () => {
      element.style.top = '100%'
      element.style.transform = `translateY(-100vh)`
    })
  }

  const initializeSteam = (element: HTMLElement, startingPoint: number) => {
    const size = Math.random() * 40 + 20
    element.style.width = `${size}px`
    element.style.height = `${size}px`
    const initialOpacity = Math.random() * 0.4 + 0.1
    element.style.opacity = initialOpacity.toString()
    const riseDuration = Math.random() * 6 + 10
    const expandDuration = Math.random() * 4 + 6
    const drift = Math.random() * 8 + 4
    const riseDelay = -(riseDuration * (startingPoint / 100))
    const expandDelay = Math.random() * 3
    const driftDelay = Math.random() * 4
    element.style.animationDelay = `${expandDelay}s, ${riseDelay}s, ${driftDelay}s`
    element.style.animationDuration = `${expandDuration}s, ${riseDuration}s, ${drift}s`
    element.addEventListener('animationiteration', () => {
      element.style.top = '100%'
      element.style.transform = `translateY(-100vh)`
    })
  }

  const initializeCode = (element: HTMLElement, startingPoint: number) => {
    const size = Math.random() * 8 + 12
    element.style.fontSize = `${size}px`
    const initialOpacity = Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.3
    element.style.opacity = initialOpacity.toString()
    const riseDuration = Math.random() * 8 + 15
    const glowDuration = Math.random() * 3 + 2
    const drift = Math.random() * 5 + 4
    const riseDelay = -(riseDuration * (startingPoint / 100))
    const glowDelay = Math.random() * 3
    const driftDelay = Math.random() * 2
    element.style.animationDelay = `${glowDelay}s, ${riseDelay}s, ${driftDelay}s`
    element.style.animationDuration = `${glowDuration}s, ${riseDuration}s, ${drift}s`
    element.addEventListener('animationiteration', () => {
      element.style.top = '100%'
      element.style.transform = `translateY(-100vh)`
    })
  }

  return { initializeEffect }
}

```

### packages/ecosystem/fireux-fireux/README.md

```md
# fireux-fireux

FireUX ecosystem package for FireUX.

This package defines FireUX branding, configuration, and ecosystem-specific wiring used by FireUX apps.

## Structure
- config/ — ecosystem configuration inputs
- src/ — authored source code (runtime + helpers)
- registry.json — ecosystem registry metadata
- tsconfig.json — TypeScript config

## Notes
- Keep Level-1 strict and minimal
- Put implementation inside src/
- Do not commit build output

```

### packages/ecosystem/fireux-fireux/docs/ui-and-design/theming.md

```md
---
title: Theming
description: How to set up per-app themes (Nuxt UI palettes) without breaking shared core styles.
---

# Theming

FireUX theming is **layered**:

1. **Core design system** (shared)
	 - Provided by the `fireux-core` module.
	 - Loaded via Nuxt `css` from:
		 - `fireux-core/runtime/assets/styles/main.css` (Tailwind + Nuxt UI base)
		 - `fireux-core/runtime/assets/styles/main.scss` (additive SCSS)
2. **App theme** (per app or tenant)
	 - Lives in the app under `app/assets/styles/…`
	- Defines the palette variables for your chosen theme token name.
	 - Is appended after core CSS so it can override/extend tokens.

The key rule: **if you set a custom Nuxt UI primary color name, you must define the palette variables for it.**

## The Failure Mode (Common Gotcha)

If you do this in `app/app.config.ts`:

```ts
export default defineAppConfig({
	ui: {
		colors: {
			primary: 'theme',
			neutral: 'slate',
		},
		safelistColors: ['theme'],
	},
})
```

…but you **don’t** define `--ui-color-theme-*` in app CSS, Nuxt UI will try to style components like:

```vue
<UButton color="primary">Sign in</UButton>
```

…using a palette that doesn’t exist.

In practice, the button can still be present in the DOM (cursor changes, clickable area exists) but appear **invisible** because the color tokens resolve to nothing.

## Step-by-step: Create a Custom Theme

### 1) Choose a palette name

Pick a short, lowercase token.

Two valid patterns:

- **Generic palette name** (recommended for consistency): `theme`
- **App-specific palette name** (also valid): `misebox`, `cleanbox`, etc.

The palette name must match the CSS variable prefix `--ui-color-<name>-*`.

### 2) Configure Nuxt UI to use it

In `app/app.config.ts`:

```ts
import { defineAppConfig } from '#imports'

export default defineAppConfig({
	ui: {
		colors: {
			primary: 'theme',
			neutral: 'slate',
		},
		safelistColors: ['theme'],
	},
})
```

### 3) Define the palette variables

Create (or update) `app/assets/styles/main.css`:

```css
@layer base {
	:root {
		--ui-color-theme-50: #f2f4ec;
		--ui-color-theme-100: #e6e9da;
		--ui-color-theme-200: #d5dac1;
		--ui-color-theme-300: #c4cba9;
		--ui-color-theme-400: #b7c196;
		--ui-color-theme-500: #abb684;
		--ui-color-theme-600: #96a074;
		--ui-color-theme-700: #808863;
		--ui-color-theme-800: #666d4f;
		--ui-color-theme-900: #4d523b;

		/* Optional: convenience bridges */
		--ui-primary: var(--ui-color-theme-500);
		--ui-primary-hover: var(--ui-color-theme-600);
		--ui-primary-active: var(--ui-color-theme-700);
	}
}
```

Notes:

- Keep this file **palette + tokens only**.
- Don’t add `@import 'tailwindcss'` or `@import '@nuxt/ui'` here; core already does that.
- Use `@layer base` so token overrides land in the expected cascade.

### 4) Ensure the app theme CSS is loaded

The shared config (`defineFireuxConfig`) already includes the core CSS.

When you add app-level theme CSS, append it in the app’s `nuxt.config.ts`:

```ts
import { defineNuxtConfig } from 'nuxt/config'
import { defineFireuxConfig } from 'fireux-core/config/app/fireux.config'

const base = defineFireuxConfig({
	ecosystem: 'misebox',
	id: 'misebox-app',
	name: 'Misebox',
	shortName: 'Misebox',
	description: '…',
	role: 'global',
})

export default defineNuxtConfig({
	...base,
	css: [...(base.css ?? []), '@/assets/styles/main.css'],
})
```

## Naming: Will `app/assets/styles/main.css` Clash with Core?

No.

- Core uses `fireux-core/runtime/assets/styles/main.css` and `fireux-core/runtime/assets/styles/main.scss`.
- Apps use `@/assets/styles/main.css` (where `@/` points at the app’s `app/` folder).

They are **different files with different paths**. Nuxt loads both; the only important detail is **order**:

- Core CSS first (from `defineFireuxConfig`)
- App theme CSS last (your palette overrides)

Using the same filename (`main.css`) is intentional and consistent with the repo’s convention; it makes it easy to remember “core main.css” vs “app main.css”.

## Quick checklist

- `app/app.config.ts` sets `ui.colors.primary` to a real palette name
- `app/assets/styles/main.css` defines `--ui-color-<name>-50…900`
- `nuxt.config.ts` appends `@/assets/styles/main.css` after core css
- After changing `nuxt.config.ts` `css`, restart dev server

```

import type { Resolver } from '@nuxt/kit';
import type { Nuxt } from '@nuxt/schema';
import { registerComponentsDir } from 'fireux-core/config/module/module-helpers';

/**
 * Register runtime components for this module.
 */
export function configureComponents(resolver: Resolver, nuxt: Nuxt) {
  const componentsDir = registerComponentsDir(resolver, './runtime/components', {
    global: false,
    pathPrefix: true,
    // Ensure ecosystem components override core defaults
    priority: 1,
  })

  if (!componentsDir) return

  ;(nuxt.options.alias ||= {}) as Record<string, string>
  ;(nuxt.options.alias as Record<string, string>)['#fireux-fireux-components'] =
    componentsDir
}

### packages/ecosystem/fireux-fireux/src/module.ts

```ts
// FILE: packages/ecosystem/fireux-fireux/src/module.ts
import { createResolver, defineNuxtModule } from '@nuxt/kit'
import type { Nuxt, NuxtModule } from '@nuxt/schema'

import { setRuntimeFirebaseEcosystem } from 'fireux-core/config/app/runtime'
import { existsSync } from 'fs'
import { ecosystemConfig } from './config/firebase/ecosystem.config'
import { configureComponents } from './config/module/components-config'

const module: NuxtModule<Record<string, never>> = defineNuxtModule({
  meta: {
    name: 'fireux-fireux',
    version: '0.1.0',
  },

  setup(_options: Record<string, never>, nuxt: Nuxt) {
    const resolver = createResolver(import.meta.url)
    const debug = !!process.env.FIREUX_DEBUG_ECOSYSTEM
    if (debug) {
      console.log(
        '[fireux-fireux/module] loaded ecosystemConfig.id',
        ecosystemConfig?.id
      )
      console.log(
        '[fireux-fireux/module] loaded ecosystemConfig.firebase',
        ecosystemConfig?.firebase
      )
    }

    // 🔎 Make the runtime write-shape explicit
    setRuntimeFirebaseEcosystem(nuxt as any, {
      id: ecosystemConfig.id,
      name: ecosystemConfig.name,
      description: ecosystemConfig.description,
      firebase: ecosystemConfig.firebase,
    })

    // 🔎 Confirm it actually landed where we expect
    const pub = (nuxt.options.runtimeConfig as any)?.public
    if (debug) {
      console.log(
        '[fireux-fireux/module] after setRuntimeFirebaseEcosystem public.firebaseEcosystem',
        pub?.firebaseEcosystem
      )
    }

    configureComponents(resolver, nuxt)

    // Serve runtime public assets via Nitro (so /img/ecosystem/* works)
    const publicDir = resolver.resolve('./runtime/public')
    if (existsSync(publicDir)) {
      const nitro = ((nuxt.options as any).nitro ||= {}) as Record<string, any>
      const publicAssets = (nitro.publicAssets ||= []) as Array<
        string | { baseURL?: string; dir: string; maxAge?: number }
      >

      const already = publicAssets.some((entry) =>
        typeof entry === 'string' ? entry === publicDir : entry?.dir === publicDir
      )
      if (!already) publicAssets.push({ dir: publicDir })

      nuxt.hook('nitro:config', (nitroConfig: any) => {
        nitroConfig.alias ||= {}
        nitroConfig.alias['#fireux-fireux-public'] = publicDir
      })

      // Dev tooling: expose ecosystem public dirs for /dev/images scanning
      const rc = ((nuxt.options as any).runtimeConfig ||= {}) as Record<string, any>
      const fireuxDev = (rc.fireuxDev ||= {}) as Record<string, any>
      const ecoDirs = (fireuxDev.ecosystemPublicDirs ||= []) as Array<any>
      const alreadyDev = ecoDirs.some((e) => e?.dir === publicDir)
      if (!alreadyDev) {
        ecoDirs.push({ key: 'fireux', title: 'FireUX ecosystem images', dir: publicDir })
      }
    }
  },
})

export default module
```

```ts
// FILE: /packages/ecosystem/fireux-fireux/src/runtime/composables/fireux/app/utils/effects/useLandingEffect.ts
// Unified landing effect composable for this tenant
export function useLandingEffect() {
  const initializeEffect = (
    effectType: 'stars' | 'bubbles' | 'steam' | 'code'
  ) => {
    const elements = document.querySelectorAll('.effect-particle')

    for (const element of elements) {
      const particleElement = element as HTMLElement

      // Common positioning
      particleElement.style.left = `${Math.random() * 100}%`
      const startingPoint = Math.random() * 100
      particleElement.style.top = `${startingPoint}%`
      const initialYPos = 100 - startingPoint
      particleElement.style.transform = `translateY(${initialYPos}vh)`

      switch (effectType) {
        case 'stars':
          initializeStars(particleElement, startingPoint)
          break
        case 'bubbles':
          initializeBubbles(particleElement, startingPoint)
          break
        case 'steam':
          initializeSteam(particleElement, startingPoint)
          break
        case 'code':
          initializeCode(particleElement, startingPoint)
          break
      }
    }
  }

  const initializeStars = (element: HTMLElement, startingPoint: number) => {
    const size = Math.random() * 1.5 + 1
    element.style.width = `${size}px`
    element.style.height = `${size}px`
    const initialOpacity = Math.random() * 0.4 + 0.1
    element.style.opacity = initialOpacity.toString()
    const twinkleDuration = Math.random() * 3 + 3
    const moveDuration = Math.random() * 340 + 340
    const moveDelay = -(moveDuration * (startingPoint / 100))
    const twinkleDelay = Math.random() * 2
    element.style.animationDelay = `${twinkleDelay}s, ${moveDelay}s`
    element.style.animationDuration = `${twinkleDuration}s, ${moveDuration}s`
    element.addEventListener('animationiteration', () => {
      element.style.top = '100%'
      element.style.transform = `translateY(-100vh)`
    })
  }

  const initializeBubbles = (element: HTMLElement, startingPoint: number) => {
    const size = Math.random() * 20 + 10
    element.style.width = `${size}px`
    element.style.height = `${size}px`
    const initialOpacity = Math.random() * 0.3 + 0.1
    element.style.opacity = initialOpacity.toString()
    const floatDuration = Math.random() * 5 + 8
    const popDuration = Math.random() * 2 + 2
    const sway = Math.random() * 3 + 2
    const floatDelay = -(floatDuration * (startingPoint / 100))
    const popDelay = Math.random() * 3
    const swayDelay = Math.random() * 2
    element.style.animationDelay = `${popDelay}s, ${floatDelay}s, ${swayDelay}s`
    element.style.animationDuration = `${popDuration}s, ${floatDuration}s, ${sway}s`
    element.addEventListener('animationiteration', () => {
      element.style.top = '100%'
      element.style.transform = `translateY(-100vh)`
    })
  }

  const initializeSteam = (element: HTMLElement, startingPoint: number) => {
    const size = Math.random() * 40 + 20
    element.style.width = `${size}px`
    element.style.height = `${size}px`
    const initialOpacity = Math.random() * 0.4 + 0.1
    element.style.opacity = initialOpacity.toString()
    const riseDuration = Math.random() * 6 + 10
    const expandDuration = Math.random() * 4 + 6
    const drift = Math.random() * 8 + 4
    const riseDelay = -(riseDuration * (startingPoint / 100))
    const expandDelay = Math.random() * 3
    const driftDelay = Math.random() * 4
    element.style.animationDelay = `${expandDelay}s, ${riseDelay}s, ${driftDelay}s`
    element.style.animationDuration = `${expandDuration}s, ${riseDuration}s, ${drift}s`
    element.addEventListener('animationiteration', () => {
      element.style.top = '100%'
      element.style.transform = `translateY(-100vh)`
    })
  }

  const initializeCode = (element: HTMLElement, startingPoint: number) => {
    const size = Math.random() * 8 + 12
    element.style.fontSize = `${size}px`
    const initialOpacity = Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.3
    element.style.opacity = initialOpacity.toString()
    const riseDuration = Math.random() * 8 + 15
    const glowDuration = Math.random() * 3 + 2
    const drift = Math.random() * 5 + 4
    const riseDelay = -(riseDuration * (startingPoint / 100))
    const glowDelay = Math.random() * 3
    const driftDelay = Math.random() * 2
    element.style.animationDelay = `${glowDelay}s, ${riseDelay}s, ${driftDelay}s`
    element.style.animationDuration = `${glowDuration}s, ${riseDuration}s, ${drift}s`
    element.addEventListener('animationiteration', () => {
      element.style.top = '100%'
      element.style.transform = `translateY(-100vh)`
    })
  }

  return { initializeEffect }
}

```

```vue
<template>
  <UPage v-if="page">
    <UPageHeader
      :title="page.title"
      :description="page.description"
      :headline="headline"
    >
      <template #links>
        <UButton
          v-for="(link, index) in page.links"
          :key="index"
          v-bind="link"
        />

        <PageHeaderLinks />
      </template>
    </UPageHeader>

    <UPageBody>
      <ContentRenderer v-if="page" :value="page" />

      <USeparator v-if="surround?.length" />

      <UContentSurround :surround="surround" />
    </UPageBody>

    <template v-if="page?.body?.toc?.links?.length" #right>
      <UContentToc :title="toc?.title" :links="page.body?.toc?.links">
        <template v-if="toc?.bottom" #bottom>
          <div
            class="hidden lg:block space-y-6"
            :class="{ '!mt-6': page.body?.toc?.links?.length }"
          >
            <USeparator v-if="page.body?.toc?.links?.length" type="dashed" />

            <UPageLinks :title="toc.bottom.title" :links="links" />
          </div>
        </template>
      </UContentToc>
    </template>
  </UPage>

  <div v-else class="space-y-3">
    <h1 class="text-2xl font-semibold mb-2">Page not found</h1>
    <p class="text-sm text-dimmed">
      We couldn’t find that doc yet. Try going back to the main docs index.
    </p>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { useRoute, useHead } from '#imports'
import { findPageHeadline } from '@nuxt/content/utils'
import type { ContentNavigationItem } from '@nuxt/content'

definePageMeta({
  layout: 'docs',
  title: 'Docs',
  nav: {
    key: 'docs',
    label: 'Docs',
    icon: 'i-lucide-book-open',
    order: 5,
    desktop: true,
    mobile: true,
    layouts: ['default', 'docs'],
  },
})

const route = useRoute()
const { toc } = useAppConfig()
const navigation = inject<Ref<ContentNavigationItem[]>>('navigation')

const sourcePath = computed(() => {
  const stripped = route.path.replace(/^\/docs/, '') || '/'
  return stripped === '' ? '/' : stripped
})

const { data: page } = await useAsyncData(
  `fireux-docs-page-${sourcePath.value}`,
  () =>
    queryContent({ source: 'fireuxDocs' })
      .where({ _path: sourcePath.value })
      .findOne()
)

const { data: surround } = await useAsyncData(
  `fireux-docs-surround-${sourcePath.value}`,
  () =>
    queryContent({ source: 'fireuxDocs' })
      .without(['body'])
      .findSurround(sourcePath.value, { fields: ['description'] })
)

const title = computed(() => page.value?.seo?.title || page.value?.title)
const description = computed(
  () => page.value?.seo?.description || page.value?.description
)

useSeoMeta({
  title,
  ogTitle: title,
  description,
  ogDescription: description,
})

const headline = computed(() =>
  findPageHeadline(navigation?.value, page.value?.path)
)

const links = computed(() => {
  const nextLinks = [] as any[]
  if (toc?.bottom?.edit && page?.value?.stem && page?.value?.extension) {
    nextLinks.push({
      icon: 'i-lucide-external-link',
      label: 'Edit this page',
      to: `${toc.bottom.edit}/${page.value.stem}.${page.value.extension}`,
      target: '_blank',
    })
  }

  return [...nextLinks, ...(toc?.bottom?.links || [])].filter(Boolean)
})

useHead({ title: 'FireUX Docs' })
</script>

```

# fireux-misebox

Misebox ecosystem package for FireUX.

This package defines Misebox branding, configuration, and ecosystem-specific wiring used by apps in the Misebox ecosystem.

## Structure
- config/ — ecosystem configuration inputs
- src/ — authored source code (runtime + helpers)
- registry.json — ecosystem registry metadata
- tsconfig.json — TypeScript config

## Notes
- Keep Level-1 strict and minimal
- Put implementation inside src/
- Do not commit build output

import { addComponentsDir, type Resolver } from '@nuxt/kit';
import type { Nuxt } from '@nuxt/schema';
import { registerComponentsDir } from 'fireux-core/config/module/module-helpers';

/**
 * Register runtime components for this module.
 */
export function configureComponents(resolver: Resolver, nuxt: Nuxt) {
  const componentsDir = registerComponentsDir(resolver, './runtime/components', {
    global: false,
    // Keep path segments in component names to avoid collisions
    // e.g. organisms/entities/Ingredient/Profile.vue -> IngredientProfile
    pathPrefix: true,
    // Ensure ecosystem components override core defaults
    priority: 1,
  })

  if (componentsDir) {
    ;(nuxt.options.alias ||= {}) as Record<string, string>
    ;(nuxt.options.alias as Record<string, string>)['#fireux-misebox-components'] =
      componentsDir
  }

  addComponentsDir({
    path: resolver.resolve('./runtime/components/organisms/Ingredient'),
    global: true,
    pathPrefix: true,
    prefix: 'Ingredient',
  })

  addComponentsDir({
    path: resolver.resolve('./runtime/components/organisms/Recipe'),
    global: true,
    pathPrefix: true,
    prefix: 'Recipe',
  })
}

import { addImportsDir, createResolver, defineNuxtModule } from '@nuxt/kit'
import type { Nuxt, NuxtModule } from '@nuxt/schema'
import { setRuntimeFirebaseEcosystem } from 'fireux-core/config/app/runtime'
import { configurePages } from 'fireux-core/config/module/pages-config'
import { existsSync } from 'fs'
import { ecosystemConfig } from './config/firebase/ecosystem.config'
import { configureComponents } from './config/module/components-config'

const module: NuxtModule<Record<string, never>> = defineNuxtModule({
  meta: {
    name: 'fireux-misebox',
    version: '0.1.0',
    configKey: 'fireuxMisebox',
  },
  async setup(_options: Record<string, never>, nuxt: Nuxt) {
    const resolver = createResolver(import.meta.url)

    // Core and any extensions are provided by the app via createFireuxConfig

    setRuntimeFirebaseEcosystem(nuxt as any, {
      id: ecosystemConfig.id,
      name: ecosystemConfig.name,
      description: ecosystemConfig.description,
      firebase: ecosystemConfig.firebase,
    })

    const rc = ((nuxt.options as any).runtimeConfig ||= {}) as Record<string, any>
    const pub = (rc.public ||= {}) as Record<string, any>
    const fireux = (pub.fireux ||= {}) as Record<string, any>
    const currentPlaces = fireux.places
    const miseboxPlacesDefaults = {
      enabled: true,
      types: ['kitchen', 'company'],
      googleAutocompleteTypeFilters: {
        kitchen: ['restaurant', 'cafe', 'food_truck'],
      },
    }

    fireux.places = currentPlaces && typeof currentPlaces === 'object'
      ? { ...miseboxPlacesDefaults, ...currentPlaces }
      : { ...miseboxPlacesDefaults }

    // Layer runtime pages/layouts/middleware
    configurePages(resolver, nuxt)

    nuxt.hook('pages:extend', (pages: any[]) => {
      for (let i = pages.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
        const page = pages[i]
        const file = typeof page?.file === 'string' ? page.file : ''
        if (file.includes('/fireux-misebox/src/runtime/pages/companies')) {
          pages.splice(i, 1)
        }
      }
    })

    configureComponents(resolver, nuxt)

    // Auto-import composables and models if present
    const composablesDir = resolver.resolve('./runtime/composables')
    if (existsSync(composablesDir)) {
      addImportsDir(composablesDir)
    }

    // NOTE: Do NOT auto-import models.
    // - It creates collisions for common type names (e.g. Pill/Cell/Profile)
    // - Models should be imported explicitly by consumers

    // Serve runtime public assets via Nitro
    const publicDir = resolver.resolve('./runtime/public')
    if (existsSync(publicDir)) {
      const nitro = ((nuxt.options as any).nitro ||= {}) as Record<string, any>
      const publicAssets = (nitro.publicAssets ||= []) as Array<
        string | { baseURL?: string; dir: string; maxAge?: number }
      >

      const already = publicAssets.some((entry) =>
        typeof entry === 'string' ? entry === publicDir : entry?.dir === publicDir
      )
      if (!already) publicAssets.push({ dir: publicDir })
    }

    // Dev tooling: expose ecosystem public dirs for /dev/images scanning
    const fireuxDev = (rc.fireuxDev ||= {}) as Record<string, any>
    const ecoDirs = (fireuxDev.ecosystemPublicDirs ||= []) as Array<any>
    const alreadyDev = ecoDirs.some((e) => e?.dir === publicDir)
    if (!alreadyDev) {
      ecoDirs.push({ key: 'misebox', title: 'Misebox ecosystem images', dir: publicDir })
    }

    nuxt.hook('ready', () => {
      if (process.env.FIREUX_DEBUG_LAYERS) {
        console.log('[fireux-misebox] layers', (nuxt.options as any)._layers)
      }
      // fireux-misebox: module configured
    })
  },
})

export default module

```

<template>
  <div class="places-search">
    <UInput
      v-model="searchQuery"
      placeholder="Search for places…"
      icon="i-heroicons-magnifying-glass"
      size="lg"
      @input="performSearch"
    />

      <UCard
        v-for="place in mergedResults"
        :key="place.place_id || place.id"
        class="mb-2 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-50"
        @click="handleSelectPlace(place)"
      >

          <UAvatar :src="place.image_url" :alt="place.name" size="sm" />
          <div class="flex-1">
            <h3 class="font-medium">{{ place.name }}</h3>
            <p class="text-sm text-gray-600">
              {{ place.formatted_address ?? 'Address not available' }}
            </p>
            <UBadge
              :label="place.source === 'google' ? 'Google Places' : 'Existing'"
              :color="place.source === 'google' ? 'info' : 'success'"
              size="xs"
              class="mt-1"
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </UCard>
    </div>

    <!-- No Results -->
    <div v-else-if="searchQuery && !isSearching" class="no-results mt-4">
      <UCard>
        <div class="text-center py-4">
          <p class="text-gray-500">No places found for "{{ searchQuery }}"</p>
        </div>
      </UCard>
    </div>

    <!-- Loading -->
    <div v-if="isSearching" class="loading mt-4">
      <UCard>
        <div class="text-center py-4">
          <div
            class="animate-spin rounded-full h-6 w-6 border-b-2 border-primary mx-auto"
          ></div>
          <p class="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-2">Searching...</p>
        </div>
      </UCard>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed, watch } from 'vue'

const props = defineProps<{
  placeholder?: string
}>()

const emit = defineEmits<{
  'select-place': [place: any]
}>()

// State
const searchQuery = ref('')
const debouncedSearchQuery = ref('')
const isSearching = ref(false)
const googleResults = ref<any[]>([])
const firestoreResults = ref<any[]>([])

// Debounce search query
let debounceTimeout: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>
watch(searchQuery, (newQuery: string) => {
  clearTimeout(debounceTimeout)
  debounceTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
    debouncedSearchQuery.value = newQuery
    if (newQuery && newQuery.length >= 3) {
      performSearch()
    }
  }, 500)
})

// Mock search for now - in real implementation this would use Google Places API
const mergedResults = computed(() => {
  if (!debouncedSearchQuery.value) return []

  // Mock results for demonstration
  const mockResults = [
    {
      id: 'mock-1',
      name: 'The French Kitchen',
      formatted_address: '123 Main St, City, Country',
      source: 'google',
      place_id: 'mock-place-1',
      image_url: 'https://via.placeholder.com/40',
    },
    {
      id: 'mock-2',
      name: 'Pasta Palace',
      formatted_address: '456 Oak Ave, City, Country',
      source: 'firestore',
      image_url: 'https://via.placeholder.com/40',
    },
  ].filter((place) =>
    place.name.toLowerCase().includes(debouncedSearchQuery.value.toLowerCase())
  )

  return mockResults
})

// Methods
const performSearch = async () => {
  if (!debouncedSearchQuery.value || debouncedSearchQuery.value.length < 3) {
    return
  }

  isSearching.value = true

  try {
    // NOTE: Implement actual Google Places API search
    // NOTE: Implement Firestore kitchen search

    // Mock delay for demo
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1000))
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Search error:', error)
  } finally {
    isSearching.value = false
  }
}

const handleSelectPlace = (place: any) => {
  emit('select-place', place)
  searchQuery.value = ''
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.places-search {
  width: 100%;
}

.results-list {
  max-height: 400px;
  overflow-y: auto;
}
</style>

```vue
<template>
  <UCard :ui="{ body: 'space-y-4' }">
    <template #header>
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div class="font-medium">Ingredients</div>

        <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
          <UButton size="xs" variant="ghost" @click="toggleVariant">
            {{ variant === 'pill' ? 'Cells' : 'Pills' }}
          </UButton>
          <UBadge variant="soft">{{ cards.length }}</UBadge>
        </div>
      </div>
    </template>

    <div v-if="!cards.length" class="text-sm text-dimmed">
      No ingredients yet.
    </div>

    <div v-else>
      <div
        v-if="variant === 'pill'"
        class="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3"
      >
        <component
          :is="wrapperFor(card)"
          v-for="card in cards"
          :key="card.id"
          v-bind="wrapperPropsFor(card)"
          class="block"
        >
          <IngredientCardsPill v-bind="card" />
        </component>
      </div>

      <div v-else class="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
        <component
          :is="wrapperFor(card)"
          v-for="card in cards"
          :key="card.id"
          v-bind="wrapperPropsFor(card)"
          class="block"
        >
          <IngredientCardsCell v-bind="card" />
        </component>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div v-if="showDebug" class="pt-3">
      <DevJson
        :title="'Ingredients (JSON)'"
        :data="debugPayload"
        :default-open="false"
      />
    </div>
  </UCard>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import { useIngredientInterface } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/ingredient/utils/view/useIngredientInterface';
import type { Ingredient } from '../../../../../models/Ingredient.model';

const props = defineProps<{ collection?: Ingredient[] }>()

const collection = computed(() => props.collection ?? [])
const { card: makeCard } = useIngredientInterface()
type IngredientCardShape = NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof makeCard>>
const cards = computed(() =>
  collection.value
    .map((ingredient) => makeCard(ingredient))
    .filter((c): c is NonNullable<typeof c> => Boolean(c))
)
const showDebug = import.meta.dev
const debugPayload = computed(() => ({
  totalIngredients: collection.value.length,
  ingredients: collection.value,
}))

type Variant = 'pill' | 'cell'
const variant = ref<Variant>('cell')
const toggleVariant = () => {
  variant.value = variant.value === 'pill' ? 'cell' : 'pill'
}

const wrapperFor = (card: IngredientCardShape) => (card.to ? 'NuxtLink' : 'div')
const wrapperPropsFor = (card: IngredientCardShape) => (card.to ? { to: card.to } : {})
</script>

<template>
  <div class="ingredient-create-system">
    <!-- Quick Supplier Creation (if enabled) -->
    <SupplierCreateQuick
      v-if="showQuickSupplierCreate"
      @created="handleSupplierCreated"
      @cancel="showQuickSupplierCreate = false"
    />

    <!-- Main Ingredient Creation Form -->
    <form @submit.prevent="handleSubmit" class="ingredient-form">
      <div class="form-row">
        <div class="field ingredient-field">
          <label for="ingredient-name">Ingredient Name</label>
          <input
            id="ingredient-name"
            v-model="ingredientName"
            type="text"
            placeholder="e.g., Organic Tomatoes, Fresh Basil..."
            required
          />
        </div>

        <div class="field supplier-field">
          <label for="supplier-select">Supplier</label>
          <div class="supplier-select-container">
            <select
              id="supplier-select"
              v-model="selectedSupplierId"
              class="supplier-select"
            >
              <option value="">No supplier (generic)</option>
              <option
                v-for="option in supplierOptions.slice(1)"
                :key="option.value"
                :value="option.value"
              >
                {{ option.label }}
              </option>
            </select>
            <button
              type="button"
              @click="showQuickSupplierCreate = true"
              class="btn-new-supplier"
              title="Create new supplier"
            >
              + New
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="form-actions">
        <button
          type="submit"
          :disabled="creating || !ingredientName.trim()"
          class="btn-create"
        >
          {{ creating ? 'Adding...' : 'Add Ingredient' }}
        </button>
      </div>

      <div v-if="createError" class="error-message">
        {{ createError.message }}
      </div>
    </form>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { useIngredientCreate } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/ingredient/useIngredientCreate'
import { useSupplierList } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Supplier/main/useSupplierList'
import SupplierCreateQuick from '../../../profiles/Supplier/Create/QuickCreate.vue'

const { createIngredient, creating, createError } = useIngredientCreate()
const { supplierOptions } = useSupplierList()

// Form state
const ingredientName = ref('')
const selectedSupplierId = ref('')
const showQuickSupplierCreate = ref(false)

// Methods
const handleSubmit = async () => {
  if (!ingredientName.value.trim()) return

  const success = await createIngredient(
    ingredientName.value.trim(),
    selectedSupplierId.value || undefined
  )

  if (success) {
    ingredientName.value = ''
    selectedSupplierId.value = ''
  }
}

const handleSupplierCreated = (supplier: any) => {
  selectedSupplierId.value = supplier.id
  showQuickSupplierCreate.value = false
}
</script>

<style scoped>

        </component>
      </div>

      <div v-else class="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
        <component
          :is="wrapperFor(card)"
          v-for="card in cards"
          :key="card.id"
          v-bind="wrapperPropsFor(card)"
          class="block"
        >
          <RecipeCardsCell v-bind="card" />
        </component>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div v-if="showDebug" class="pt-3">

        :title="'Recipes (JSON)'"
        :data="debugPayload"
        :default-open="false"
      />

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import { useRecipeInterface } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/recipe/utils/view/useRecipeInterface';
import type { Recipe } from '../../../../../models/Recipe.model';

const props = defineProps<{ collection?: Recipe[] }>()

const collection = computed(() => props.collection ?? [])
const { card: makeCard } = useRecipeInterface()
type RecipeCardShape = NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof makeCard>>
const cards = computed(() =>
  collection.value
    .map((recipe) => makeCard(recipe))
    .filter((c): c is NonNullable<typeof c> => Boolean(c))
)
const showDebug = import.meta.dev
const debugPayload = computed(() => ({
  totalRecipes: collection.value.length,
  recipes: collection.value,
}))

type Variant = 'pill' | 'cell'
const variant = ref<Variant>('cell')
const toggleVariant = () => {
  variant.value = variant.value === 'pill' ? 'cell' : 'pill'
}

const wrapperFor = (card: RecipeCardShape) => (card.to ? 'NuxtLink' : 'div')
const wrapperPropsFor = (card: RecipeCardShape) => (card.to ? { to: card.to } : {})
</script>

<template>
	<UPageCTA
		title="Chef profile"
		description="Showcase your culinary strengths so kitchens can match you to the right stations and menus."
		variant="naked"
	>
		<template #default>

				<OrganismsProfilesChefCreateSystem />
			</div>

			<div v-else class="space-y-4">

					<UButton v-if="canToggle" size="xs" variant="ghost" @click="toggleView">
						{{ showCellView ? 'Show pill' : 'Show cell' }}
					</UButton>
				</div>

				<div class="space-y-4">
					<component
						:is="wrapperFor(cell)"
						v-if="showCellCard && cell"
						v-bind="wrapperPropsFor(cell)"
						class="block"
					>
						<OrganismsProfilesChefCardsCell v-bind="cell" />
					</component>
					<component
						:is="wrapperFor(pill)"
						v-else-if="pill"
						v-bind="wrapperPropsFor(pill)"
						class="block"
					>
						<OrganismsProfilesChefCardsPill v-bind="pill" />
					</component>
					<p v-else class="text-sm text-slate-500">No chef profile loaded.</p>
				</div>

	</UPageCTA>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useUser } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/useUser'
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue'
import { useChef } from '../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Chef/useChef'

const { card } = useChef()
const { hasProfile } = useUser()

const hasChefProfile = computed(() => hasProfile('chef'))

const cell = computed(() => card())
const pill = computed(() => card())
const canToggle = computed(() => Boolean(cell.value))
const showCellView = ref(false)
const showCellCard = computed(() => canToggle.value && showCellView.value)
const toggleView = () => {
	if (!canToggle.value) return
	showCellView.value = !showCellView.value
}

watch(canToggle, (enabled: boolean) => {
	if (!enabled) showCellView.value = false
})

const wrapperFor = (card: ReturnType<typeof card> | null) => (card?.to ? 'NuxtLink' : 'div')
const wrapperPropsFor = (card: ReturnType<typeof card> | null) => (card?.to ? { to: card.to } : {})
</script>

              <span v-else class="italic">missing</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div v-if="vm.badges.length" class="flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-1">
          <UBadge
            v-for="badge in vm.badges"
            :key="badge"
            variant="soft"
            color="neutral"
            size="xs"
          >
            {{ badge }}
          </UBadge>
        </div>
      </div>
    </template>

    <div class="space-y-4">
      <div class="space-y-1">
        <div class="text-xs text-dimmed">Bio</div>
        <div class="text-sm">
          <span v-if="vm.line1">{{ vm.line1 }}</span>
          <span v-else class="text-dimmed italic">missing</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="space-y-1">
        <div class="text-xs text-dimmed">Specialties</div>
        <div class="text-sm">
          <span v-if="vm.line2">{{ vm.line2 }}</span>
          <span v-else class="text-dimmed italic">missing</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="space-y-1">
        <div class="text-xs text-dimmed">Locations</div>
        <div class="text-sm">
          <span v-if="vm.line3">{{ vm.line3 }}</span>
          <span v-else class="text-dimmed italic">missing</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </UCard>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { useChef } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Chef/useChef'
import type { ChefCard, ChefCore } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Chef/useChef'

const props = defineProps<{
  title?: string
  subtitle?: string
  avatar?: string | null
  chef?: ChefCore | ChefCard.Card | null
  card?: ChefCard.Card | null
  prop?: string
}>()

const { coreProfile, card: toCard } = useChef()

const isChefCard = (value: unknown): value is ChefCard.Card => {
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return false
  return 'to' in value && 'title' in value && 'badges' in value && 'line1' in value
}

const resolvedCard = computed<ChefCard.Card | null>(() => {
  if (props.card) return props.card

  const supplied = props.chef ?? null
  if (supplied) {
    return isChefCard(supplied) ? supplied : toCard(supplied)
  }

  return coreProfile.value ? toCard(coreProfile.value) : null
})

const vm = computed(() => {
  const card = resolvedCard.value

  const title = props.title ?? card?.title ?? 'Chef'
  const subtitle = props.subtitle ?? (card?.subtitle || undefined)
  const avatar = props.avatar ?? (card?.avatar || null)
  const badges = card?.badges ?? []

  const line1 = String((typeof props.prop === 'string' ? props.prop : card?.line1) ?? '').trim()
  const line2 = String(card?.line2 ?? '').trim()
  const line3 = String(card?.line3 ?? '').trim()

  return { title, subtitle, avatar, badges, line1, line2, line3 }
})
</script>

```

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useFireUXConfig } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/app/FireUXConfig';
import { computed } from 'vue';
import type { ChefCard } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Chef/useChef';

type Variant = 'pill' | 'cell' | 'preview' | 'profile'

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    cards: ChefCard.Card[]
    variant?: Variant
  }>(),
  {
    variant: 'pill',
  }
)

const { devMode } = useFireUXConfig()

const componentForVariant = computed(() => {
  if (props.variant === 'cell') return resolveComponent('OrganismsProfilesChefCardsCell')
  if (props.variant === 'preview') return resolveComponent('OrganismsProfilesChefCardsPreview')
  if (props.variant === 'profile') return resolveComponent('OrganismsProfilesChefCardsProfile')
  return resolveComponent('OrganismsProfilesChefCardsPill')
})

const gridClass = computed(() => {
  if (props.variant === 'pill') return 'grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3'
  return 'grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2'
})

const cardKey = (card: ChefCard.Card) => card.id || card.to || card.title
</script>

<template>
  <UCard class="section">
    <template #header>
      <div class="section__header">
        <div class="section__copy">
          <h2 class="text-base font-semibold">Chefs</h2>
          <p class="text-xs text-gray-500">Browse chefs available to this runtime.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
          <UInput v-model="query" size="xs" placeholder="Search chefs…" class="w-44" />

          <UButton size="xs" variant="ghost" @click="toggleVariant">
            {{ variant === 'pill' ? 'Cells' : 'Pills' }}
          </UButton>

          <UBadge variant="soft">{{ visibleCount }} / {{ totalCount }}</UBadge>
        </div>
      </div>
    </template>

    <OrganismsProfilesChefCollectionList
      v-if="cardsFiltered.length"
      :cards="cardsFiltered"
      :variant="variant"
    />

    <p v-else class="section__empty">No chefs found.</p>

    <div v-if="showDebug" class="pt-3">
      <DevJson
        :title="'Chefs (JSON)'"
        :data="debugPayload"
        :default-open="false"
      />
    </div>
  </UCard>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useCollectionSearch } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/shared/useCollectionSearch';
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { useChef } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Chef/useChef';
import type { ChefCore } from '../../../../../models/profiles/Chef/Chef.model';

type ChefEntry = ChefCore & { user?: unknown }

const props = defineProps<{ collection?: ChefEntry[] }>()

const collection = computed(() => props.collection ?? [])
const { card: makeCard } = useChef()
const searchTextFor = (entry: ChefEntry) => {
  const displayName = (entry as any)?.user?.display_name ?? ''
  const title = (entry as any)?.title ?? ''
  const tagline = (entry as any)?.tagline ?? ''
  const organization = (entry as any)?.organization_name ?? ''
  return `${displayName} ${title} ${tagline} ${organization} ${entry.id ?? ''}`
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
}
const { query, variant, toggleVariant, cards: cardsFiltered, visibleCount } =
  useCollectionSearch<ChefEntry, ReturnType<typeof makeCard>>({
    items: collection,
    searchText: (entry) => searchTextFor(entry),
    makeCard: (entry) => makeCard(entry as ChefCore, (entry as any)?.user ?? null),
  })

const totalCount = computed(() => collection.value.length)
const showDebug = import.meta.dev
const debugPayload = computed(() => ({
  totalChefs: collection.value.length,
  chefs: collection.value,
}))
</script>

<template>
  <ClientOnly>
    <div v-if="chef" class="space-y-6">
      <UCard>
        <div class="space-y-4">
          <MoleculesFormsFirestoreSimpleField
            label="Tagline"
            :firebase-value="tagline"
            placeholder="Ex: Private chef focused on seasonal tasting menus"
            :update-function="handleTagline"
          />

          <MoleculesFormsFirestoreSimpleField
            label="Short Bio"
            type="textarea"
            :rows="3"
            :maxlength="200"
            :firebase-value="chef.bio_short || ''"
            placeholder="Share a quick intro for listings"
            :update-function="handleShortBio"
          />
        </div>
      </UCard>
    </div>

    <MoleculesStateCard v-else entity="chef profile" kind="document" loading />
  </ClientOnly>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue'
import type { ChefCoreProfile } from '../../../../../models/profiles/Chef/Chef.model.ts'
import { useChefUpdate } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Chef/main/useChefUpdate.ts'

const props = defineProps<{ chef: ChefCoreProfile | null }>()

const chef = computed(() => props.chef ?? null)
const { updateTagline, updateBioShort } = useChefUpdate()

const useToastFn = (globalThis as any).useToast as undefined | (() => any)
const toast = useToastFn ? useToastFn() : undefined

const tagline = computed(
  () =>
    chef.value?.tagline ??
    (chef.value as { subtitle?: string | null } | null)?.subtitle ??
    ''
)

const handleTagline = async (value: string) => {
  if (!chef.value) return 'success'
  try {
    await updateTagline(value)
    toast?.add({
      title: 'Tagline updated',
      icon: 'i-heroicons-check-circle',
    })
    return 'success'
  } catch (error) {
    const description =
      error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Please try again.'
    toast?.add({
      title: 'Failed to update tagline',
      description,
      color: 'amber',
      icon: 'i-heroicons-exclamation-triangle',
    })
    throw error
  }
}

const handleShortBio = async (value: string) => {
  if (!chef.value) return 'success'
  try {
    await updateBioShort(value)
    toast?.add({
      title: 'Short bio updated',
      icon: 'i-heroicons-check-circle',
    })
    return 'success'
  } catch (error) {
    const description =
      error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Please try again.'
    toast?.add({
      title: 'Failed to update short bio',
      description,
      color: 'amber',
      icon: 'i-heroicons-exclamation-triangle',
    })
    throw error
  }
}
</script>

  <UCard class="space-y-6">
    <div class="flex items-start gap-4">
      <UAvatar :src="vm.avatar || undefined" :alt="vm.title" size="lg" />

      <div class="min-w-0 flex-1 space-y-2">

          <div class="min-w-0">
            <div class="truncate text-lg font-semibold">{{ vm.title }}</div>
            <div v-if="vm.subtitle" class="truncate text-sm text-dimmed">{{ vm.subtitle }}</div>
          </div>

          <div v-if="vm.badges.length" class="flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-1">
            <UBadge
              v-for="badge in vm.badges"
              :key="badge"
              variant="soft"
              color="neutral"
              size="xs"
            >
              {{ badge }}
            </UBadge>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="text-sm text-dimmed">
          <span v-if="vm.prop">{{ vm.prop }}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="space-y-4">
      <div class="space-y-1">
        <div class="text-xs font-medium text-dimmed">Bio</div>
        <div class="text-sm">
          <span v-if="vm.line1">{{ vm.line1 }}</span>
          <span v-else class="text-dimmed italic">missing</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="space-y-1">
        <div class="text-xs font-medium text-dimmed">Specialties</div>
        <div class="text-sm">
          <span v-if="vm.line2">{{ vm.line2 }}</span>
          <span v-else class="text-dimmed italic">missing</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="space-y-1">
        <div class="text-xs font-medium text-dimmed">Locations</div>
        <div class="text-sm">
          <span v-if="vm.line3">{{ vm.line3 }}</span>
          <span v-else class="text-dimmed italic">missing</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </UCard>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { useSupplier } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Supplier/useSupplier'
import type {
  SupplierCard,
  SupplierProfile,
} from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Supplier/useSupplier'

const props = defineProps<{
  title?: string
  subtitle?: string
  avatar?: string | null
  supplier?: SupplierProfile | SupplierCard.Card | null
  card?: SupplierCard.Card | null
  prop?: string
}>()

const { coreProfile, card: toCard } = useSupplier()

const isSupplierCard = (value: unknown): value is SupplierCard.Card => {
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return false
  return 'to' in value && 'title' in value && 'badges' in value && 'line1' in value
}

const resolvedCard = computed<SupplierCard.Card | null>(() => {
  if (props.card) return props.card

  const supplied = props.supplier ?? null
  if (supplied) {
    return isSupplierCard(supplied) ? supplied : toCard(supplied)
  }

  return coreProfile.value ? toCard(coreProfile.value) : null
})

const vm = computed(() => {
  const card = resolvedCard.value

  const title = props.title ?? card?.title ?? 'Supplier'
  const subtitle = props.subtitle ?? (card?.subtitle || undefined)
  const avatar = props.avatar ?? (card?.avatar || null)
  const badges = card?.badges ?? []

  const prop = typeof props.prop === 'string' ? props.prop : ''

  const line1 = String(card?.line1 ?? '').trim()
  const line2 = String(card?.line2 ?? '').trim()
  const line3 = String(card?.line3 ?? '').trim()

  return { title, subtitle, avatar, badges, prop, line1, line2, line3 }
})
</script>

import { useFireUXConfig } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/app/FireUXConfig';
import { computed } from 'vue';
import type { SupplierCard } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Supplier/useSupplier';

type Variant = 'pill' | 'cell' | 'preview' | 'profile'

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    cards: SupplierCard.Card[]
    variant?: Variant
  }>(),
  {
    variant: 'pill',
  }
)

const { devMode } = useFireUXConfig()

const componentForVariant = computed(() => {
  if (props.variant === 'cell') return resolveComponent('OrganismsProfilesSupplierCardsCell')
  if (props.variant === 'preview') return resolveComponent('OrganismsProfilesSupplierCardsPreview')
  if (props.variant === 'profile') return resolveComponent('OrganismsProfilesSupplierCardsProfile')
  return resolveComponent('OrganismsProfilesSupplierCardsPill')
})

const gridClass = computed(() => {
  if (props.variant === 'pill') return 'grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3'
  return 'grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2'
})

const cardKey = (card: SupplierCard.Card) => card.id || card.to || card.title
</script>

        </div>

        <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
          <UInput v-model="query" size="xs" placeholder="Search suppliers…" class="w-44" />

          <UButton size="xs" variant="ghost" @click="toggleVariant">
            {{ variant === 'pill' ? 'Cells' : 'Pills' }}
          </UButton>

          <UBadge variant="soft">{{ visibleCount }} / {{ totalCount }}</UBadge>
        </div>
      </div>
    </template>

    <OrganismsProfilesSupplierCollectionList
      v-if="cardsFiltered.length"
      :cards="cardsFiltered"
      :variant="variant"
    />

    <p v-else class="section__empty">No suppliers found.</p>

    <div v-if="showDebug" class="pt-3">
      <DevJson
        :title="'Suppliers (JSON)'"
        :data="debugPayload"
        :default-open="false"
      />
    </div>
  </UCard>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useCollectionSearch } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/shared/useCollectionSearch';
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { useSupplier } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Supplier/useSupplier';
import type { SupplierCore } from '../../../../../models/profiles/Supplier/Supplier.model';

type SupplierEntry = SupplierCore & { user?: unknown }

const props = defineProps<{ collection?: SupplierEntry[] }>()

const collection = computed(() => props.collection ?? [])
const { card: makeCard } = useSupplier()
const searchTextFor = (entry: SupplierEntry) => {
  const displayName = (entry as any)?.user?.display_name ?? ''
  const title = (entry as any)?.title ?? ''
  const tagline = (entry as any)?.tagline ?? ''
  return `${displayName} ${title} ${tagline} ${entry.id ?? ''}`
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
}
const { query, variant, toggleVariant, cards: cardsFiltered, visibleCount } =
  useCollectionSearch<SupplierEntry, ReturnType<typeof makeCard>>({
    items: collection,
    searchText: (entry) => searchTextFor(entry),
    makeCard: (entry) => makeCard(entry as SupplierCore, (entry as any)?.user ?? null),
  })

const totalCount = computed(() => collection.value.length)
const showDebug = import.meta.dev
const debugPayload = computed(() => ({
  totalSuppliers: collection.value.length,
  suppliers: collection.value,
}))
</script>

import { useSupplierQuickCreate } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Supplier/main/useSupplierQuickCreate.ts'

  cancel: []
  created: [supplier: any]
}>()

```vue
<template>
  <ClientOnly>
    <div v-if="supplier" class="space-y-6">
      <UCard>
        <div class="space-y-4">
          <MoleculesFormsFirestoreSimpleField
            label="Tagline"
            :firebase-value="tagline"
            placeholder="Summarize your business focus"
            :update-function="handleTagline"
          />

          <MoleculesFormsFirestoreSimpleField
            label="Short Bio"
            type="textarea"
            :rows="3"
            :maxlength="200"
            :firebase-value="supplier.bio_short || ''"
            placeholder="Share a quick intro for listings"
            :update-function="handleShortBio"
          />
        </div>
      </UCard>
    </div>

    <MoleculesStateCard
      v-else
      entity="supplier profile"
      kind="document"
      loading
    />
  </ClientOnly>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue'
import type { SupplierCoreProfile } from '../../../../../models/profiles/Supplier/Supplier.model.ts'
import { useSupplierUpdate } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Supplier/main/useSupplierUpdate.ts'

const props = defineProps<{ supplier: SupplierCoreProfile | null }>()

const supplier = computed(() => props.supplier ?? null)
const { updateTagline, updateBioShort } = useSupplierUpdate()

const useToastFn = (globalThis as any).useToast as undefined | (() => any)
const toast = useToastFn ? useToastFn() : undefined

const tagline = computed(
  () =>
    supplier.value?.tagline ??
    (supplier.value as { subtitle?: string | null } | null)?.subtitle ??
    ''
)

const handleTagline = async (value: string) => {
  if (!supplier.value) return 'success'
  try {
    await updateTagline(value)
    toast?.add({
      title: 'Tagline updated',
      icon: 'i-heroicons-check-circle',
    })
    return 'success'
  } catch (error) {
    const description =
      error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Please try again.'
    toast?.add({
      title: 'Failed to update tagline',
      description,
      color: 'amber',
      icon: 'i-heroicons-exclamation-triangle',
    })
    throw error
  }
}

const handleShortBio = async (value: string) => {
  if (!supplier.value) return 'success'
  try {
    await updateBioShort(value)
    toast?.add({
      title: 'Short bio updated',
      icon: 'i-heroicons-check-circle',
    })
    return 'success'
  } catch (error) {
    const description =
      error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Please try again.'
    toast?.add({
      title: 'Failed to update short bio',
      description,
      color: 'amber',
      icon: 'i-heroicons-exclamation-triangle',
    })
    throw error
  }
}
</script>

<template>

          </UButton>

        <component
          :is="wrapperFor(previewCard)"
          v-if="showCellCard && previewCard"
          v-bind="wrapperPropsFor(previewCard)"
          class="block"
        >
          <OrganismsProfilesSupplierCardsCell :supplier="previewCard" />
        </component>
        <component
          :is="wrapperFor(previewCard)"
          v-else-if="previewCard"
          v-bind="wrapperPropsFor(previewCard)"
          class="block"
        >
          <OrganismsProfilesSupplierCardsPill v-bind="previewCard" />

      <UCard v-else>
        <p class="fx-preview__fallback">Supplier preview unavailable.</p>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import { useSupplier } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Supplier/useSupplier'

const { coreProfile, pending, card } = useSupplier()

const previewCard = computed(() => (coreProfile.value ? card(coreProfile.value) : null))
const isLoading = computed(() => Boolean(pending.value))
const hasPreview = computed(() => Boolean(previewCard.value))

const canToggle = computed(() => Boolean(previewCard.value))
const showCellView = ref(false)
const showCellCard = computed(() => canToggle.value && showCellView.value)

const toggleView = () => {
  if (!canToggle.value) return
  showCellView.value = !showCellView.value
}

const wrapperFor = (card: ReturnType<typeof card> | null) => (card?.to ? 'NuxtLink' : 'div')
const wrapperPropsFor = (card: ReturnType<typeof card> | null) => (card?.to ? { to: card.to } : {})
</script>

### packages/ecosystem/fireux-misebox/src/runtime/composables/fireux/app/routes/useMiseboxConsoleRoutes.ts

```ts
interface RouteLink {
  id: string
  label: string
  icon?: string
  to?: string
  children?: RouteLink[]
}

type HasProfileFn = (profileType: string) => boolean

type JobConsoleRoutesBundle = {
  jobProfileRoutes: RouteLink[]
}

const EMPTY_JOB_CONSOLE_ROUTES: JobConsoleRoutesBundle = {
  jobProfileRoutes: [],
}

async function tryImportJobs() {
  try {
    return await import(
      /* @vite-ignore */ 'fireux-jobs/runtime/composables/fireux/app/routes/useJobConsoleRoutes'
    )
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

const jobsModule = await tryImportJobs()
const getJobConsoleRoutesOptional:
  | null
  | ((hasProfile: HasProfileFn) => JobConsoleRoutesBundle) =
  (jobsModule as any)?.getJobConsoleRoutes ?? null

export function getMiseboxConsoleRoutes(
  hasProfile: (profileType: string) => boolean
) {
  // Get console profile routes from jobs extension
  const jobRoutes = getJobConsoleRoutesOptional
    ? getJobConsoleRoutesOptional(hasProfile)
    : EMPTY_JOB_CONSOLE_ROUTES

  const miseboxProfileRoutes: RouteLink[] = []

  if (hasProfile('chef')) {
    miseboxProfileRoutes.push({
      id: 'chef-profile',
      label: 'Chef Profile',
      icon: 'i-lucide-chef-hat',
      to: '/console/chef-profile',
    })
  }

  if (hasProfile('supplier')) {
    miseboxProfileRoutes.push({
      id: 'supplier-profile',
      label: 'Supplier Profile',
      icon: 'i-lucide-package',
      to: '/console/supplier-profile',
    })
  }

  return {
    // Sidebar/console menu: profiles only
    menuBarLinks: [...miseboxProfileRoutes, ...jobRoutes.jobProfileRoutes],
    // Mobile menu: same set (no public discovery links here)
    mobileLinks: [...miseboxProfileRoutes, ...jobRoutes.jobProfileRoutes],
  }
}

```

### packages/ecosystem/fireux-misebox/src/runtime/composables/fireux/app/routes/useMiseboxDefaultRoutes.ts

```ts
interface RouteLink {
  id: string
  label: string
  icon?: string
  to?: string
  children?: RouteLink[]
}

type HasProfileFn = (profileType: string) => boolean

type JobRoutesBundle = {
  jobRoutes: RouteLink[]
  jobProfileRoutes: RouteLink[]
  jobMobileRoutes: RouteLink[]
}

const EMPTY_JOB_ROUTES: JobRoutesBundle = {
  jobRoutes: [],
  jobProfileRoutes: [],
  jobMobileRoutes: [],
}

async function tryImportJobs() {
  try {
    return await import(
      /* @vite-ignore */ 'fireux-jobs/runtime/composables/fireux/app/routes/useJobRoutes'
    )
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

const jobsModule = await tryImportJobs()
const getJobRoutesOptional: null | ((hasProfile: HasProfileFn) => JobRoutesBundle) =
  (jobsModule as any)?.getJobRoutes ?? null

export function getMiseboxDefaultRoutes(
  hasProfile: (profileType: string) => boolean
) {
  // Get package routes
  const jobRoutes = getJobRoutesOptional
    ? getJobRoutesOptional(hasProfile)
    : EMPTY_JOB_ROUTES

  // Public Misebox routes (default layout header)
  const miseboxRoutes: RouteLink[] = [
    {
      id: 'chefs',
      label: 'Chefs',
      icon: 'i-lucide-chef-hat',
      to: '/chefs',
    },
    {
      id: 'suppliers',
      label: 'Suppliers',
      icon: 'i-lucide-truck',
      to: '/suppliers',
    },
    {
      id: 'recipes',
      label: 'Recipes',
      icon: 'i-lucide-book-open',
      to: '/recipes',
    },
  ]

  const miseboxProfileRoutes: RouteLink[] = []

  // Console shortcuts (only if user has those profiles)
  if (hasProfile('chef')) {
    miseboxProfileRoutes.push({
      id: 'chef-profile',
      label: 'Chef Profile',
      icon: 'i-lucide-chef-hat',
      to: '/console/chef-profile',
    })
  }

  if (hasProfile('supplier')) {
    miseboxProfileRoutes.push({
      id: 'supplier-profile',
      label: 'Supplier Profile',
      icon: 'i-lucide-package',
      to: '/console/supplier-profile',
    })
  }

  return {
    // Desktop header: public discovery + jobs public
    menuBarLinks: [...miseboxRoutes, ...jobRoutes.jobRoutes],
    // Mobile menu: console shortcuts (if any) + filtered public + jobs mobile
    mobileLinks: [
      ...miseboxProfileRoutes,
      ...jobRoutes.jobProfileRoutes,
      ...miseboxRoutes,
      ...jobRoutes.jobMobileRoutes,
    ],
  }
}

### packages/ecosystem/fireux-misebox/src/runtime/composables/fireux/app/routes/useMiseboxDevRoutes.ts

```ts
import { useRuntimeConfig } from '#imports'

async function tryImportJobs() {
  try {
    return await import(
      /* @vite-ignore */ 'fireux-jobs/runtime/composables/fireux/app/routes/useJobRoutes'
    )
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

const hasJobs = Boolean(await tryImportJobs())

export function getMiseboxDevRoutes() {
  const rc = useRuntimeConfig() as any
  const role = rc?.public?.role

  const routes = [
    {
      id: 'dev-misebox',
      label: 'Misebox Global',
      icon: 'i-heroicons-beaker',
      to: '/dev/fireux-misebox',
    },
  ]

  if (hasJobs) {
    routes.push({
      id: 'dev-jobs',
      label: 'Jobs Global',
      icon: 'i-lucide-briefcase',
      to: '/dev/fireux-jobs',
    })
  }

  if (role === 'tenant') {
    routes.push(
      {
        id: 'dev-misebox-tenant',
        label: 'Misebox Tenant',
        icon: 'i-heroicons-home-modern',
        to: '/dev/fireux-misebox-tenant',
      },
    )

    if (hasJobs) {
      routes.push({
        id: 'dev-jobs-tenant',
        label: 'Jobs Tenant',
        icon: 'i-lucide-building-2',
        to: '/dev/fireux-jobs-tenant',
      })
    }
  }

  return { miseboxDevRoutes: routes }
}
