```ts
  try {
    return await import(
      /* @vite-ignore */ 'fireux-jobs/runtime/composables/fireux/app/routes/useJobRoutes'
    )
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

const jobsModule = await tryImportJobs()
const getJobRoutesOptional: null | ((hasProfile: HasProfileFn) => JobRoutesBundle) =
  (jobsModule as any)?.getJobRoutes ?? null

export function useMiseboxRoutes() {
  const { user } = useUser()

  const hasProfile = (profileType: string) => {
    const source = user.value?.profiles
    const profiles = Array.isArray(source) ? source : []
    return profiles.includes(profileType)
  }

  // Public Misebox discovery routes
  const miseboxPublic: RouteLink[] = [
    { id: 'chefs', label: 'Chefs', icon: 'i-lucide-chef-hat', to: '/chefs' },
    {
      id: 'suppliers',
      label: 'Suppliers',
      icon: 'i-lucide-truck',
      to: '/suppliers',
    },
    {
      id: 'recipes',
      label: 'Recipes',
      icon: 'i-lucide-book-open',
      to: '/recipes',
    },
  ]

  const links = computed<RouteLink[]>(() => {
    // Profile shortcuts (console) conditional
    const profileShortcuts: RouteLink[] = []
    if (hasProfile('chef')) {
      profileShortcuts.push({
        id: 'chef-profile',
        label: 'Chef Profile',
        icon: 'i-lucide-chef-hat',
        to: '/console/chef-profile',
      })
    }
    if (hasProfile('supplier')) {
      profileShortcuts.push({
        id: 'supplier-profile',
        label: 'Supplier Profile',
        icon: 'i-lucide-package',
        to: '/console/supplier-profile',
      })
    }

    // Jobs extension routes (public + profile/console flavor)
    const jobs = getJobRoutesOptional
      ? getJobRoutesOptional(hasProfile)
      : EMPTY_JOB_ROUTES

    return [
      ...miseboxPublic,
      ...jobs.jobRoutes,
      ...profileShortcuts,
      ...jobs.jobProfileRoutes,
    ]
  })

  // Pre-filtered subsets for layout consumption
  const MENU_IDS = new Set<string>([
    'chefs',
    'suppliers',
    'recipes',
    'jobs',
    'agents',
    'professionals',
  ])
  const MOBILE_IDS = new Set<string>([
    ...Array.from(MENU_IDS),
    'chef-profile',
    'supplier-profile',
    'agent-profile',
    'professional-profile',
  ])

  const menuLinks = computed<RouteLink[]>(() =>
    links.value.filter((r) => MENU_IDS.has(r.id))
  )
  const mobileLinks = computed<RouteLink[]>(() =>
    links.value.filter((r) => MOBILE_IDS.has(r.id))
  )

  // Ready-to-pass shape for CoreDefault
  const routes = computed(() => ({
    menuBarLinks: menuLinks.value,
    mobileLinks: mobileLinks.value,
  }))

  return { links, menuLinks, mobileLinks, routes }
}
```

```ts
// FILE: /packages/ecosystem/fireux-misebox/src/runtime/composables/fireux/app/utils/effects/useLandingEffect.ts
// Unified landing effect composable for this tenant
export function useLandingEffect() {
  const initializeEffect = (
    effectType: 'stars' | 'bubbles' | 'steam' | 'code'
  ) => {
    const elements = document.querySelectorAll('.effect-particle')

    for (const element of elements) {
      const particleElement = element as HTMLElement

      // Common positioning
      particleElement.style.left = `${Math.random() * 100}%`
      const startingPoint = Math.random() * 100
      particleElement.style.top = `${startingPoint}%`
      const initialYPos = 100 - startingPoint
      particleElement.style.transform = `translateY(${initialYPos}vh)`

      switch (effectType) {
        case 'stars':
          initializeStars(particleElement, startingPoint)
          break
        case 'bubbles':
          initializeBubbles(particleElement, startingPoint)
          break
        case 'steam':
          initializeSteam(particleElement, startingPoint)
          break
        case 'code':
          initializeCode(particleElement, startingPoint)
          break
      }
    }
  }

  const initializeStars = (element: HTMLElement, startingPoint: number) => {
    const size = Math.random() * 1.5 + 1
    element.style.width = `${size}px`
    element.style.height = `${size}px`
    const initialOpacity = Math.random() * 0.4 + 0.1
    element.style.opacity = initialOpacity.toString()
    const twinkleDuration = Math.random() * 3 + 3
    const moveDuration = Math.random() * 340 + 340
    const moveDelay = -(moveDuration * (startingPoint / 100))
    const twinkleDelay = Math.random() * 2
    element.style.animationDelay = `${twinkleDelay}s, ${moveDelay}s`
    element.style.animationDuration = `${twinkleDuration}s, ${moveDuration}s`
    element.addEventListener('animationiteration', () => {
      element.style.top = '100%'
      element.style.transform = `translateY(-100vh)`
    })
  }

  const initializeBubbles = (element: HTMLElement, startingPoint: number) => {
    const size = Math.random() * 20 + 10
    element.style.width = `${size}px`
    element.style.height = `${size}px`
    const initialOpacity = Math.random() * 0.3 + 0.1
    element.style.opacity = initialOpacity.toString()
    const floatDuration = Math.random() * 5 + 8
    const popDuration = Math.random() * 2 + 2
    const sway = Math.random() * 3 + 2
    const floatDelay = -(floatDuration * (startingPoint / 100))
    const popDelay = Math.random() * 3
    const swayDelay = Math.random() * 2
    element.style.animationDelay = `${popDelay}s, ${floatDelay}s, ${swayDelay}s`
    element.style.animationDuration = `${popDuration}s, ${floatDuration}s, ${sway}s`
    element.addEventListener('animationiteration', () => {
      element.style.top = '100%'
      element.style.transform = `translateY(-100vh)`
    })
  }

  const initializeSteam = (element: HTMLElement, startingPoint: number) => {
    const size = Math.random() * 40 + 20
    element.style.width = `${size}px`
    element.style.height = `${size}px`
    const initialOpacity = Math.random() * 0.4 + 0.1
    element.style.opacity = initialOpacity.toString()
    const riseDuration = Math.random() * 6 + 10
    const expandDuration = Math.random() * 4 + 6
    const drift = Math.random() * 8 + 4
    const riseDelay = -(riseDuration * (startingPoint / 100))
    const expandDelay = Math.random() * 3
    const driftDelay = Math.random() * 4
    element.style.animationDelay = `${expandDelay}s, ${riseDelay}s, ${driftDelay}s`
    element.style.animationDuration = `${expandDuration}s, ${riseDuration}s, ${drift}s`
    element.addEventListener('animationiteration', () => {
      element.style.top = '100%'
      element.style.transform = `translateY(-100vh)`
    })
  }

  const initializeCode = (element: HTMLElement, startingPoint: number) => {
    const size = Math.random() * 8 + 12
    element.style.fontSize = `${size}px`
    const initialOpacity = Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.3
    element.style.opacity = initialOpacity.toString()
    const riseDuration = Math.random() * 8 + 15
    const glowDuration = Math.random() * 3 + 2
    const drift = Math.random() * 5 + 4
    const riseDelay = -(riseDuration * (startingPoint / 100))
    const glowDelay = Math.random() * 3
    const driftDelay = Math.random() * 2
    element.style.animationDelay = `${glowDelay}s, ${riseDelay}s, ${driftDelay}s`
    element.style.animationDuration = `${glowDuration}s, ${riseDuration}s, ${drift}s`
    element.addEventListener('animationiteration', () => {
      element.style.top = '100%'
      element.style.transform = `translateY(-100vh)`
    })
  }

  return { initializeEffect }
}
```

```ts
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { useCurrentUser, useFirestore } from 'vuefire'
import { collection, addDoc, serverTimestamp } from 'firebase/firestore'

export function useRecipeCreate() {
  const currentUser = useCurrentUser()
  const db = useFirestore()
  const creating = ref(false)
  const createError = ref<Error | null>(null)

  async function createRecipe(name: string): Promise<string> {
    if (!name) throw new Error('Recipe name required')
    if (!currentUser.value) throw new Error('User not authenticated')

    creating.value = true
    createError.value = null

    try {
      const data = {
        name: name.trim(),
        created_at: serverTimestamp(),
        creator_id: currentUser.value.uid,
      }

      const docRef = await addDoc(collection(db, 'recipes'), data)
      return docRef.id
    } catch (e: any) {
      createError.value =
        e instanceof Error
          ? e
          : new Error(e?.message || 'Failed to create recipe')
      throw createError.value
    } finally {
      creating.value = false
    }
  }

  return { createRecipe, creating, createError }
}
```

```ts
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { useFirestore, useCollection } from 'vuefire'
import { collection, query, orderBy } from 'firebase/firestore'
import { useRecipeCreate } from './useRecipeCreate'
import { useRecipeUpdate } from './useRecipeUpdate'
import { useRecipeDelete } from './useRecipeDelete'

export function useRecipes() {
  const db = useFirestore()
  const colRef = collection(db, 'recipes')
  const q = query(colRef, orderBy('name'))
  const { data, pending, error } = useCollection(q, { ssrKey: 'recipes' })

  // Transform raw firestore data to proper recipe format
  const all = computed(() => {
    if (!data.value || pending.value || error.value) return []
    return data.value.map((raw: any) => ({
      id: raw.id || 'unknown',
      name: raw.name || 'Untitled Recipe',
      ...raw,
    }))
  })

  const create = useRecipeCreate()
  const update = useRecipeUpdate()
  const deleteRecipe = useRecipeDelete()

  return { all, pending, error, ...create, ...update, ...deleteRecipe }
}
```

### packages/ecosystem/fireux-misebox/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/ingredient/useIngredient.ts

```ts
import { collection, doc, orderBy, query } from 'firebase/firestore'
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import { useCollection, useDocument, useFirestore } from 'vuefire'
import { normalizeIngredient } from '../../../../../models/Ingredient.model'
import { useIngredientCreate } from './useIngredientCreate'

// Simple firestore collection fetch - just ingredients
export function useIngredient() {
  try {
    const db = useFirestore()
    if (!db) {
      // Fallback if firestore is not available (SSR)
      return {
        all: ref([]),
        getById: (id: string) => ref(null),
        ...useIngredientCreate(),
      }
    }

    const colRef = collection(db, 'ingredients')
    const q = query(colRef, orderBy('name'))

    const { data, pending, error } = useCollection(q, { ssrKey: 'ingredients' })

    // Transform raw firestore data to normalized ingredient format
    const all = computed(() => {
      if (!data.value || pending.value || error.value) return []
      return data.value.map((raw: any) =>
        normalizeIngredient(raw.id || 'unknown', raw)
      )
    })

    // Get single ingredient by ID
    const getById = (id: string) => {
      const docRef = doc(db, 'ingredients', id)
      const { data: rawData } = useDocument(docRef, {
        ssrKey: `ingredient-${id}`,
      })

      return computed(() => {
        if (!rawData.value) return null
        return normalizeIngredient(id, rawData.value)
      })
    }

    const create = useIngredientCreate()

    return {
      all,
      pending,
      error,
      getById,
      ...create,
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('useIngredient error:', err)
    return {
      all: ref([]),
      pending: ref(false),
      error: ref(err),
      getById: (id: string) => ref(null),
      ...useIngredientCreate(),
    }
  }
}
```

```ts
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { useCurrentUser, useFirestore } from 'vuefire'
import { doc, setDoc, getDoc, serverTimestamp } from 'firebase/firestore'

// Enhanced ingredient create composable with supplier support
export function useIngredientCreate() {
  const currentUser = useCurrentUser()
  const db = useFirestore()

  const creating = ref(false)
  const createError = ref<Error | null>(null)

  // Accept name and optional supplier ID
  async function createIngredient(
    name: string,
    supplierId?: string
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    if (!name) throw new Error('Ingredient name required')
    if (!currentUser.value) throw new Error('User not authenticated')

    creating.value = true
    createError.value = null

    try {
      // Use timestamp + random segment for id (simple, avoids slug logic for now)
      const id = `ing_${Date.now().toString(36)}_${Math.random()
        .toString(36)
        .slice(2, 7)}`

      const data: any = {
        name: name.trim(),
        creator_id: currentUser.value.uid,
        created_at: serverTimestamp(),
      }

      // Add supplier information if provided
      if (supplierId) {
        try {
          const supplierRef = doc(db, 'suppliers', supplierId)
          const supplierDoc = await getDoc(supplierRef)

          if (supplierDoc.exists()) {
            const supplierData = supplierDoc.data()
            data.supplierId = supplierId
            data.supplierInfo = {
              business_name: supplierData.business_name,
              verified: supplierData.verified || false,
            }
          }
        } catch (error) {
          console.warn('Failed to fetch supplier info:', error)
          // Continue creating ingredient without supplier info
        }
      }

      const ingredientRef = doc(db, 'ingredients', id)
      await setDoc(ingredientRef, data)

      console.log(
        '✅ Ingredient created:',
        name,
        supplierId ? `(Supplier: ${data.supplierInfo?.business_name})` : ''
      )
      return true
    } catch (e: any) {
      createError.value =
        e instanceof Error
          ? e
          : new Error(e?.message || 'Failed to create ingredient')
      console.error('❌ Failed to create ingredient:', createError.value)
      return false
    } finally {
      creating.value = false
    }
  }

  return { createIngredient, creating, createError }
}
```

### packages/ecosystem/fireux-misebox/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/ingredient/useIngredientFilters.ts

```ts
import { ref, computed, type Ref } from 'vue'
import type { Ingredient } from '../../../../models/Ingredient.model'

// Ingredient-specific filtering composable
export function useIngredientFilters(ingredients: Ref<Ingredient[]>) {
  const filters = ref({
    search: '',
    category: '',
    allergens: [] as string[],
    organic: false,
    seasonal: false,
    local: false,
  })

  const filteredIngredients = computed(() => {
    if (!ingredients.value) return []

    return ingredients.value.filter((ingredient: Ingredient) => {
      // Filter by search term
      if (filters.value.search) {
        const searchTerm = filters.value.search.toLowerCase()
        const matchesName = ingredient.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm)
        const matchesDescription = ingredient.description
          ?.toLowerCase()
          .includes(searchTerm)
        const matchesTags = ingredient.tags?.some((tag: string) =>
          tag.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm)
        )
        const matchesCategories = ingredient.categories?.some((cat: string) =>
          cat.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm)
        )

        if (
          !matchesName &&
          !matchesDescription &&
          !matchesTags &&
          !matchesCategories
        ) {
          return false
        }
      }

      // Filter by category
      if (filters.value.category) {
        const hasCategory =
          ingredient.category === filters.value.category ||
          ingredient.categories?.includes(filters.value.category)
        if (!hasCategory) return false
      }

      // Filter by allergens (exclude ingredients with selected allergens)
      if (filters.value.allergens.length > 0) {
        const hasAllergen = ingredient.allergens?.some((allergen: string) =>
          filters.value.allergens.includes(allergen)
        )
        if (hasAllergen) return false
      }

      // Filter by organic
      if (filters.value.organic && !ingredient.organic) {
        return false
      }

      // Filter by seasonal
      if (filters.value.seasonal && !ingredient.seasonal) {
        return false
      }

      // Filter by local
      if (filters.value.local && !ingredient.local) {
        return false
      }

      return true
    })
  })

  // Available filter options derived from ingredients
  const availableCategories = computed(() => {
    const categories = new Set<string>()
    ingredients.value?.forEach((ingredient) => {
      if (ingredient.category) categories.add(ingredient.category)
      ingredient.categories?.forEach((cat: string) => categories.add(cat))
    })
    return Array.from(categories).sort()
  })

  const availableAllergens = computed(() => {
    const allergens = new Set<string>()
    ingredients.value?.forEach((ingredient) => {
      ingredient.allergens?.forEach((allergen: string) =>
        allergens.add(allergen)
      )
    })
    return Array.from(allergens).sort()
  })

  // Reset filters
  const resetFilters = () => {
    filters.value = {
      search: '',
      category: '',
      allergens: [],
      organic: false,
      seasonal: false,
      local: false,
    }
  }

  return {
    filters,
    filteredIngredients,
    availableCategories,
    availableAllergens,
    resetFilters,
  }
}

```

### packages/ecosystem/fireux-misebox/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Chef/main/useChefCreate.ts

```ts
// Action: ENSURE · Phases: 1–4
// Sketch: Chef create (core + app, conditional)
// One doc, one action, one name. No wiring yet.

import { doc, getDoc } from 'firebase/firestore'
import { useFireUXConfig } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/app/FireUXConfig'
import { useFirestoreCreate } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreCreate'
import { requireUid } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/utils/useEnsureCommon'
import { useFirestore } from 'vuefire'
import type { ChefApp, ChefCore } from '../../../../../../models/profiles/Chef/Chef.model'
import { chefConfig } from '../../../../../../models/profiles/Chef/Chef.model'

export function useChefCreate() {
  const db = useFirestore()
  const { setDocument } = useFirestoreCreate()

  async function ensureChef(): Promise<{
    createdCore: boolean
    createdApp: boolean
    id: string
  }> {
    const { uid } = await requireUid()
    const { appId, isTenant } = useFireUXConfig()

    let createdCore = false
    let createdApp = false

    const coreRef = doc(db, chefConfig.collectionName, uid)
    const coreSnap = await getDoc(coreRef)
    if (!coreSnap.exists()) {
      const payload = {
        id: uid,
        title: '',
        subtitle: '',
        tagline: '',
        tags: [],
        bio_short: '',
        bio_long: '',
        specialties: [],
        locations: [],
        organization_name: '',
      } satisfies Omit<ChefCore, 'created_at' | 'updated_at' | 'creator_id'>

      await setDocument<ChefCore>(chefConfig.collectionName, uid, payload as ChefCore, {
        creator: 'require',
      })
      createdCore = true
    }

    if (isTenant && appId) {
      const appCollection = `apps/${appId}/${chefConfig.collectionName}`
      const appRef = doc(db, 'apps', appId, chefConfig.collectionName, uid)
      const appSnap = await getDoc(appRef)
      if (!appSnap.exists()) {
        const payload = {
          id: uid,
        } satisfies Omit<ChefApp, 'created_at' | 'updated_at' | 'creator_id'>

        await setDocument<ChefApp>(appCollection, uid, payload as ChefApp, {
          creator: 'require',
        })
        createdApp = true
      }
    }

    return { createdCore, createdApp, id: uid }
  }

  return { ensureChef }
```

```ts
import { deleteDoc, doc } from 'firebase/firestore'
import { useFireUXConfig } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/app/FireUXConfig'
import { useRequireUser } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firebase/useRequireUser'
import type { ProfileRefs } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/profile/fetch/useProfileFetch'
import { useFirestore } from 'vuefire'
import type { ChefCore } from '../../../../../../models/profiles/Chef/Chef.model'

type DeleteScope = 'auto' | 'core' | 'app' | 'both'

export function useChefDelete(_profile: ProfileRefs<ChefCore>) {
  const db = useFirestore()
  const { role, appId } = useFireUXConfig()
  const isTenant = role === 'tenant' && !!appId

  const resolveUid = async (explicitId?: string) => {
    if (explicitId) return explicitId
    const u = await useRequireUser()
    if (!u?.uid) throw new Error('Not authenticated')
    return u.uid
  }

  const deleteAtPath = async (collection: string, id: string) => {
    await deleteDoc(doc(db, collection, id))
  }

  const deleteChef = async (options?: { scope?: DeleteScope; id?: string }) => {
    const scope = options?.scope ?? 'auto'
    const id = await resolveUid(options?.id)

    const shouldDeleteCore =
      scope === 'core' || scope === 'both' || (!isTenant && scope === 'auto')
    if (shouldDeleteCore) {
      await deleteAtPath('chefs', id)
    }

    const deleteAppScope =
      scope === 'app' || scope === 'both' || (isTenant && scope === 'auto')
    if (deleteAppScope) {
      if (!appId) throw new Error('Missing appId for tenant-scoped delete')
      await deleteAtPath(`apps/${appId}/chefs`, id)
    }

    let effectiveScope: DeleteScope = scope
    if (scope === 'auto') {
      effectiveScope = isTenant ? 'app' : 'core'
    }

    return { id, scope: effectiveScope }
  }

  return { deleteChef }
}
```

```ts
import type { ChefCore } from '../../../../../../models/profiles/Chef/Chef.model'

/**
 * useChefUpdate
 * - Split update surface:
 *   - updateCoreProfile: global Chef profile
 *   - updateAppProfile: tenant-scoped Chef profile
 *
 * For now:
 * - accepts only refs (no user cascading)
 * - both implementations are stubs until Firestore integration
 */
export function useChefUpdate(profile?: ProfileRefs<ChefCore> | null) {
  const coreProfile = () => profile?.coreProfile?.value ?? null
  const appProfile = () => profile?.appProfile?.value ?? null

  /**
   * Update the CORE Chef profile
   * - global document (e.g. chefs/{uid})
   */
  const updateCoreProfile = async (
    patch: Partial<ChefCore>
  ): Promise<void> => {
    console.warn(
      '[useChefUpdate] updateCoreProfile stub called with:',
      patch,
      'current coreProfile:',
      coreProfile()
    )
  }

  /**
   * Update the APP (tenant) Chef profile
   * - app-specific document (e.g. apps/{appId}/chefs/{uid})
   */
  const updateAppProfile = async (
    patch: Partial<ChefCore>
  ): Promise<void> => {
    console.warn(
      '[useChefUpdate] updateAppProfile stub called with:',
      patch,
      'current appProfile:',
      appProfile()
    )
  }

  const cleanString = (value: string | null | undefined) => {
    const normalized = typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim() : ''
    return normalized.length ? normalized : ''
  }

  const updateTagline = async (value: string) => {
    await updateCoreProfile({ tagline: cleanString(value) })
  }

  const updateBioShort = async (value: string) => {
    await updateCoreProfile({ bio_short: cleanString(value) })
  }

  return {
    updateCoreProfile,
    updateAppProfile,
    updateTagline,
    updateBioShort,
```

```ts
// FILE: packages/ecosystem/fireux-misebox/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Chef/useChef.ts

import { useProfile } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/profile/useProfile'
import {
    chefConfig,
    type ChefCore,
} from '../../../../../models/profiles/Chef/Chef.model'
import { useChefComputed } from './main/useChefComputed'
import { useChefCreate } from './main/useChefCreate'
import { useChefUpdate } from './main/useChefUpdate'
import type { ChefCard } from './utils/view/useChefInterface'
import { useChefInterface } from './utils/view/useChefInterface'

export type { ChefCard, ChefCore }

/**
 * useChef
 * - Runtime facade for Chef profiles
 * - Exposes:
 *   - raw refs: profile, coreProfile, appProfile, pending
 *   - computed helpers
 *   - UI helpers (pill, cell, profileCore, profileApp)
 *   - update helpers
 */
export function useChef() {
  const { profile: refs, pending } = useProfile<ChefCore>(chefConfig)
  const { coreProfile, appProfile } = refs

  const computed = useChefComputed(refs, pending)
  const ui = useChefInterface(refs)
  const update = useChefUpdate(refs)
  const create = useChefCreate()

  return {
    profile: refs,
    coreProfile,
    appProfile,
    pending,

    ...computed,
    ...ui,
    ...update,
    ...create,
  }
}
```

```ts
import type {
    ChefCore,
} from '../../../../../models/profiles/Chef/Chef.model';

export function useChefValidation() {
  // Validate chef name
  const validateChefName = (
    name: string
  ): { isValid: boolean; error?: string } => {
    if (!name || name.trim().length === 0) {
      return { isValid: false, error: 'Chef name is required' }
    }
    if (name.trim().length < 2) {
      return {
        isValid: false,
        error: 'Chef name must be at least 2 characters long',
      }
    }
    if (name.length > 100) {
      return {
        isValid: false,
        error: 'Chef name must be less than 100 characters',
      }
    }
    return { isValid: true }
  }

  // Validate specialties
  const validateSpecialties = (
    specialties: string[]
  ): { isValid: boolean; error?: string } => {
    if (!specialties || !Array.isArray(specialties)) {
      return { isValid: true } // Optional field
    }
    if (specialties.length > 20) {
      return { isValid: false, error: 'Maximum 20 specialties allowed' }
    }
    for (const specialty of specialties) {
      if (typeof specialty !== 'string' || specialty.trim().length === 0) {
        return {
          isValid: false,
          error: 'All specialties must be non-empty strings',
        }
      }
      if (specialty.length > 50) {
        return {
          isValid: false,
          error: 'Each specialty must be less than 50 characters',
        }
      }
    }
    return { isValid: true }
  }

  // Validate kitchen experience
  const validateKitchenExperience = (
    experience: any[]
  ): { isValid: boolean; error?: string } => {
    if (!experience || !Array.isArray(experience)) {
      return { isValid: true } // Optional field
    }
    if (experience.length > 15) {
      return { isValid: false, error: 'Maximum 15 kitchen experiences allowed' }
    }
    for (const exp of experience) {
      if (!exp.kitchen_name || exp.kitchen_name.trim().length === 0) {
        return {
          isValid: false,
          error: 'Kitchen name is required for experience entries',
        }
      }
      if (!exp.role || exp.role.trim().length === 0) {
        return {
          isValid: false,
          error: 'Role is required for experience entries',
        }
      }
      if (!exp.from_year || !/^\d{4}$/.test(exp.from_year)) {
        return {
          isValid: false,
          error: 'Valid from year (YYYY) is required for experience entries',
        }
      }
    }
    return { isValid: true }
  }

  // Validate certifications
  const validateCertifications = (
    certifications: any[]
  ): { isValid: boolean; error?: string } => {
    if (!certifications || !Array.isArray(certifications)) {
      return { isValid: true } // Optional field
    }
    if (certifications.length > 20) {
      return { isValid: false, error: 'Maximum 20 certifications allowed' }
    }
    for (const cert of certifications) {
      if (!cert.name || cert.name.trim().length === 0) {
        return { isValid: false, error: 'Certification name is required' }
      }
      if (
        !cert.issuing_organization ||
        cert.issuing_organization.trim().length === 0
      ) {
        return {
          isValid: false,
          error: 'Issuing organization is required for certifications',
        }
      }
      if (!cert.year || !/^\d{4}$/.test(cert.year)) {
        return {
          isValid: false,
          error: 'Valid year (YYYY) is required for certifications',
        }
      }
    }
    return { isValid: true }
  }

  // Validate bio
  const validateBio = (
    bio: string,
    type: 'short' | 'long' = 'short'
  ): { isValid: boolean; error?: string } => {
    if (!bio) {
      return { isValid: true } // Optional field
    }
    const maxLength = type === 'short' ? 500 : 2000
    if (bio.length > maxLength) {
      return {
        isValid: false,
        error: `Bio must be less than ${maxLength} characters`,
      }
    }
    return { isValid: true }
  }

  // Validate availability schedule
  const validateAvailability = (
    availability: any
  ): { isValid: boolean; error?: string } => {
    if (!availability) {
      return { isValid: true } // Optional field
    }
    const validDays = [
      'monday',
      'tuesday',
      'wednesday',
      'thursday',
      'friday',
      'saturday',
      'sunday',
    ]
    const timeRegex = /^([01]?\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$/

    for (const day in availability) {
      if (!validDays.includes(day)) {
        return { isValid: false, error: `Invalid day: ${day}` }
      }
      const schedule = availability[day]
      if (schedule.available && (!schedule.start || !schedule.end)) {
        return {
          isValid: false,
          error: `Start and end times required when ${day} is available`,
        }
      }
      if (schedule.start && !timeRegex.test(schedule.start)) {
        return {
          isValid: false,
          error: `Invalid start time format for ${day} (use HH:MM)`,
        }
      }
      if (schedule.end && !timeRegex.test(schedule.end)) {
        return {
          isValid: false,
          error: `Invalid end time format for ${day} (use HH:MM)`,
        }
      }
    }
    return { isValid: true }
  }

  // Validate hourly rates
  const validateHourlyRates = (
    min?: number,
    max?: number
  ): { isValid: boolean; error?: string } => {
    if (min !== undefined && (min < 0 || min > 1000)) {
      return {
        isValid: false,
        error: 'Minimum hourly rate must be between 0 and 1000',
      }
    }
    if (max !== undefined && (max < 0 || max > 1000)) {
      return {
        isValid: false,
        error: 'Maximum hourly rate must be between 0 and 1000',
      }
    }
```

### packages/ecosystem/fireux-misebox/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Chef/utils/view/useChefInterface.ts

```ts
import type { ProfileRefs } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/profile/fetch/useProfileFetch'
import type { User } from 'fireux-core/runtime/models/core/user.model'
import type { Ref } from 'vue'
import { chefConfig, type ChefCore } from '../../../../../../../models/profiles/Chef/Chef.model'

type UserLike = Pick<User, 'display_name' | 'avatar'> &
  Partial<Pick<User, 'id' | 'handle' | 'email'>>

export namespace ChefCard {
  export type Card = {
    id: string
    to: string

    // Media (empty string means unset)
    avatarUrl: string

    // Primary display fields
    displayName: string
    tagline: string

    // Status/label chips
    badges: string[]

    // Summary fields for list views
    bioShort: string
    specialtiesCsv: string
    locationsCsv: string
    organizationName: string
  }
}

export function useChefInterface(
  profile: ProfileRefs<ChefCore>,
  userRef?: Ref<User | null | undefined>
) {
  function safeArray<T>(input: unknown): T[] {
    return Array.isArray(input) ? (input as T[]) : []
  }

  function safeString(input: unknown): string {
    return typeof input === 'string' ? input : ''
  }

  function csv(list: unknown): string {
    return safeArray<string>(list).join(', ')
  }

  function map(p: ChefCore, u?: UserLike | null): ChefCard.Card {
    const tags = safeArray<string>((p as any)?.tags)
    const specialties = (p as any)?.specialties
    const locations = (p as any)?.locations

    const title = safeString((p as any)?.title)
    const subtitle = safeString((p as any)?.subtitle)
    const tagline = safeString((p as any)?.tagline)

    return {
      id: p.id,
      to: `/${chefConfig.collectionName}/${p.id}`,

      avatarUrl: u?.avatar ?? '',

      // Canonical: chef pills are user-hydrated; no legacy profile-name fallbacks.
      displayName: safeString(u?.display_name),

      // Prefer true tagline, else fall back to chef title/subtitle.
      // This makes pills useful even when docs are missing `tagline`.
      tagline: tagline || title || subtitle,
      badges: tags,

      bioShort: safeString((p as any)?.bio_short),
      specialtiesCsv: csv(specialties),
      locationsCsv: csv(locations),
      organizationName: safeString((p as any)?.organization_name),
    }
  }

  function card(
    target?: ChefCore | null | undefined,
    userOverride?: UserLike | null
  ): ChefCard.Card | null {
    const p = target ?? profile.coreProfile.value ?? null
    if (!p) return null
    const u = userOverride ?? userRef?.value ?? null
    return map(p, u)
  }

  function searchText(target?: ChefCore | null | undefined): string {
    const p = target ?? profile.coreProfile.value ?? null
    if (!p) return ''
    const u = userRef?.value ?? null
    const displayName = safeString((u as any)?.display_name)
    const title = safeString((p as any)?.title)
    const tagline = safeString((p as any)?.tagline)
    const org = safeString((p as any)?.organization_name)
    return `${displayName} ${title} ${tagline} ${org} ${p.id}`.toLowerCase()
  }

  return { card, searchText }
}
```

```ts
// Action: ENSURE · Phases: 1–4
// Sketch: Supplier create (core + app, conditional)
// One doc, one action, one name. No wiring yet.

import { doc, getDoc } from 'firebase/firestore'
import { useFireUXConfig } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/app/FireUXConfig'
import { useFirestoreCreate } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreCreate'
import { requireUid } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/utils/useEnsureCommon'
import { useFirestore } from 'vuefire'
import type { SupplierApp, SupplierCore } from '../../../../../../models/profiles/Supplier/Supplier.model'
import { supplierConfig } from '../../../../../../models/profiles/Supplier/Supplier.model'

export function useSupplierCreate() {
  const db = useFirestore()
  const { setDocument } = useFirestoreCreate()

  async function ensureSupplier(): Promise<{
    createdCore: boolean
    createdApp: boolean
    id: string
  }> {
    const { uid } = await requireUid()
    const { appId, isTenant } = useFireUXConfig()

    let createdCore = false
    let createdApp = false

    const coreRef = doc(db, supplierConfig.collectionName, uid)
    const coreSnap = await getDoc(coreRef)
    if (!coreSnap.exists()) {
      const payload = {
        id: uid,
        title: '',
        subtitle: '',
        tagline: '',
        tags: [],
        bio_short: '',
        bio_long: '',
        specialties: [],
        categories: [],
        organization_name: '',
        business_type: '',
        locations: [],
        years_in_business: 0,
        products_offered: [],
        employee_count: 0,
        certifications: [],
        delivery_range: 0,
      } satisfies Omit<SupplierCore, 'created_at' | 'updated_at' | 'creator_id'>

      await setDocument<SupplierCore>(supplierConfig.collectionName, uid, payload as SupplierCore, {
        creator: 'require',
      })
      createdCore = true
    }

    if (isTenant && appId) {
      const appCollection = `apps/${appId}/${supplierConfig.collectionName}`
      const appRef = doc(db, 'apps', appId, supplierConfig.collectionName, uid)
      const appSnap = await getDoc(appRef)
      if (!appSnap.exists()) {
        const payload = {
          id: uid,
        } satisfies Omit<SupplierApp, 'created_at' | 'updated_at' | 'creator_id'>

        await setDocument<SupplierApp>(appCollection, uid, payload as SupplierApp, {
          creator: 'require',
        })
        createdApp = true
      }
    }

    return { createdCore, createdApp, id: uid }
  }

  return { ensureSupplier }
}
```

```ts
import { deleteDoc, doc } from 'firebase/firestore'
import { useFireUXConfig } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/app/FireUXConfig'
import { useRequireUser } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firebase/useRequireUser'
import type { ProfileRefs } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/profile/fetch/useProfileFetch'
import { useFirestore } from 'vuefire'
import type { SupplierCore } from '../../../../../../models/profiles/Supplier/Supplier.model'

type DeleteScope = 'auto' | 'core' | 'app' | 'both'

export function useSupplierDelete(_profile: ProfileRefs<SupplierCore>) {
  const db = useFirestore()
  const { role, appId } = useFireUXConfig()
  const isTenant = role === 'tenant' && !!appId

  const resolveUid = async (explicitId?: string) => {
    if (explicitId) return explicitId
    const u = await useRequireUser()
    if (!u?.uid) throw new Error('Not authenticated')
    return u.uid
  }

  const deleteAtPath = async (collection: string, id: string) => {
    await deleteDoc(doc(db, collection, id))
  }

  const deleteSupplier = async (options?: {
    scope?: DeleteScope
    id?: string
  }) => {
    const scope = options?.scope ?? 'auto'
    const id = await resolveUid(options?.id)

    const shouldDeleteCore =
      scope === 'core' || scope === 'both' || (!isTenant && scope === 'auto')
    if (shouldDeleteCore) {
      await deleteAtPath('suppliers', id)
    }

    const deleteAppScope =
      scope === 'app' || scope === 'both' || (isTenant && scope === 'auto')
    if (deleteAppScope) {
      if (!appId) throw new Error('Missing appId for tenant-scoped delete')
      await deleteAtPath(`apps/${appId}/suppliers`, id)
    }

    let effectiveScope: DeleteScope = scope
    if (scope === 'auto') {
      effectiveScope = isTenant ? 'app' : 'core'
    }

    return { id, scope: effectiveScope }
  }

  return { deleteSupplier }
}
```

```ts
import { ref } from 'vue'

export function useSupplierQuickCreate() {

  const createError = ref<Error | null>(null)
  const createdSupplier = ref<SupplierCore | null>(null)

  const emptyTimestamp: FirebaseTimestamp = { seconds: 0, nanoseconds: 0 }

  const createQuickSupplier = async (name: string) => {

    creating.value = true
    createError.value = null
    try {
      // Simulate create and return minimal supplier object

        title: name,
        subtitle: '',
        creator_id: 'supplier-mock-id',
        created_at: emptyTimestamp,
        updated_at: emptyTimestamp,
        tags: [],

        bio_short: '',
        bio_long: '',

        organization_name: name,
        business_type: '',
        locations: [],
        years_in_business: 0,
        products_offered: [],
        certifications: [],
        delivery_range: 0,
      }
      createdSupplier.value = supplier
      return supplier
    } catch (e: any) {
      createError.value = e instanceof Error ? e : new Error(String(e))
```

```ts
  }

  const updateTagline = async (value: string) => {
    await updateCoreProfile({ tagline: cleanString(value) })
  }

  const updateBioShort = async (value: string) => {
    await updateCoreProfile({ bio_short: cleanString(value) })
  }

  return {
    updateCoreProfile,
    updateAppProfile,
    updateDisplayName,
    updateTagline,
    updateBioShort,
  }
}
```

```ts
// FILE: packages/ecosystem/fireux-misebox/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Supplier/useSupplier.ts

import { useProfile } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/profile/useProfile'
import {
    supplierConfig,
    type SupplierCore,
} from '../../../../../models/profiles/Supplier/Supplier.model'
import { useSupplierComputed } from './main/useSupplierComputed'
import { useSupplierCreate } from './main/useSupplierCreate'
import { useSupplierUpdate } from './main/useSupplierUpdate'
import type { SupplierCard } from './utils/view/useSupplierInterface'
import { useSupplierInterface } from './utils/view/useSupplierInterface'

export type { SupplierCard, SupplierCore as SupplierProfile }

/**
 * useSupplier
 * - Runtime facade for Supplier profiles
 * - Exposes:
 *   - raw refs: profile, coreProfile, appProfile, pending
 *   - computed helpers
 *   - UI helpers (pill etc.) that use coreUser
 *   - update helpers
 */
export function useSupplier() {
  const { profile: refs, pending } = useProfile<SupplierCore>(supplierConfig)
  const { coreProfile, appProfile } = refs

  const computed = useSupplierComputed(refs, pending)
  const ui = useSupplierInterface(refs)
  const update = useSupplierUpdate(refs)
  const create = useSupplierCreate()

  return {
    profile: refs,
    coreProfile,
    appProfile,
    pending,
    ...computed,
    ...ui,
    ...update,
    ...create,
  }
}
```

### packages/ecosystem/fireux-misebox/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Supplier/utils.ts

```ts
import type { SupplierCore } from '../../../../../models/profiles/Supplier/Supplier.model'

export function useSupplierValidation() {
  /** Validate supplier data */
  function validateSupplier(supplier: Partial<SupplierCore>) {
    const errors: string[] = []

    const name =
      (supplier as any).organization_name?.trim?.() ||
      (supplier as any).title?.trim?.() ||
      ''

    if (!name) {
      errors.push('Organization name is required')
    }

    return {
      isValid: errors.length === 0,
      errors,
    }
  }

  /** Validate business hours format */
  function validateBusinessHours(hours: any) {
    const errors: string[] = []
    const validDays = [
      'monday',
      'tuesday',
      'wednesday',
      'thursday',
      'friday',
      'saturday',
      'sunday',
    ]

    for (const day of validDays) {
      if (hours[day]) {
        const dayHours = hours[day]
        if (typeof dayHours.is_open !== 'boolean') {
          errors.push(`${day}: is_open must be a boolean`)
        }
        if (dayHours.is_open) {
          if (!dayHours.open || !dayHours.close) {
            errors.push(
              `${day}: open and close times are required when is_open is true`
            )
          }
          if (dayHours.open && dayHours.close && !isValidTime(dayHours.open)) {
            errors.push(`${day}: invalid open time format`)
          }
          if (dayHours.open && dayHours.close && !isValidTime(dayHours.close)) {
            errors.push(`${day}: invalid close time format`)
          }
        }
      }
    }

    return {
      isValid: errors.length === 0,
      errors,
    }
  }

  /** Helper function to validate email format */
  function isValidEmail(email: string): boolean {
    const emailRegex = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/
    return emailRegex.test(email)
  }

  /** Helper function to validate phone format */
  function isValidPhone(phone: string): boolean {
    const phoneRegex = /^\+?[\d\s\-()]{10,}$/
    return phoneRegex.test(phone)
  }

  /** Helper function to validate URL format */
  function isValidUrl(url: string): boolean {
    try {
      new URL(url)
      return true
    } catch {
      return false
    }
  }

  /** Helper function to validate time format (HH:MM) */
  function isValidTime(time: string): boolean {
    const timeRegex = /^([01]?\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$/
    return timeRegex.test(time)
  }

  return {
    validateSupplier,
    validateBusinessHours,
    isValidEmail,
    isValidPhone,
    isValidUrl,
    isValidTime,
  }
}

```

### packages/ecosystem/fireux-misebox/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Supplier/utils/view/useSupplierInterface.ts

```ts
import type { ProfileRefs } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/profile/fetch/useProfileFetch'
import type { User } from 'fireux-core/runtime/models/core/user.model'
import type { Ref } from 'vue'
import { supplierConfig, type SupplierCore } from '../../../../../../../models/profiles/Supplier/Supplier.model'

type UserLike = Pick<User, 'display_name' | 'avatar'> &
  Partial<Pick<User, 'id' | 'handle' | 'email'>>

export namespace SupplierCard {
  export type Card = {
    id: string
    to: string

    // Media (empty string means unset)
    avatarUrl: string

    // Primary display fields
    displayName: string
    tagline: string

    // Status/label chips
    badges: string[]

    // Summary fields for list views
    bioShort: string
    specialtiesCsv: string
    categoriesCsv: string
    organizationName: string
    locationsLabel: string
  }
}

export function useSupplierInterface(
  profile: ProfileRefs<SupplierCore>,
  userRef?: Ref<User | null | undefined>
) {
  function safeArray<T>(input: unknown): T[] {
    return Array.isArray(input) ? (input as T[]) : []
  }

  function safeString(input: unknown): string {
    return typeof input === 'string' ? input : ''
  }

  function csv(list: unknown): string {
    return safeArray<string>(list).join(', ')
  }

  function locationLabel(list: unknown): string {
    const parsed = safeArray<unknown>(list)
      .map((x: any) => {
        const city = safeString(x?.city)
        const country = safeString(x?.country)
        if (!city && !country) return ''
        return [city, country].filter(Boolean).join(', ')
      })
      .filter(Boolean)

    return parsed.join(' · ')
  }

  function map(p: SupplierCore, u?: UserLike | null): SupplierCard.Card {
    const tags = safeArray<string>((p as any)?.tags)
    const specialties = (p as any)?.specialties
    const categories = (p as any)?.categories
    const locations = (p as any)?.locations

    return {
      id: p.id,
      to: `/${supplierConfig.collectionName}/${p.id}`,

      avatarUrl: u?.avatar ?? '',

      // Canonical: supplier pills are user-hydrated; no profile-title fallback for display name.
      displayName: safeString(u?.display_name),
      tagline: safeString((p as any)?.tagline),
      badges: tags,

      bioShort: safeString((p as any)?.bio_short),
      specialtiesCsv: csv(specialties),
      categoriesCsv: csv(categories),
      organizationName: safeString((p as any)?.organization_name),
      locationsLabel: locationLabel(locations),
    }
  }

  function card(
    target?: SupplierCore | null | undefined,
    userOverride?: UserLike | null
  ): SupplierCard.Card | null {
    const p = target ?? profile.coreProfile.value ?? null
    if (!p) return null
    const u = userOverride ?? userRef?.value ?? null
    return map(p, u)
  }

  function searchText(target?: SupplierCore | null | undefined): string {
    const p = target ?? profile.coreProfile.value ?? null
    if (!p) return ''
    const u = userRef?.value ?? null
    const displayName = safeString((u as any)?.display_name)
    const title = safeString((p as any)?.title)
    const tagline = safeString((p as any)?.tagline)
    const org = safeString((p as any)?.organization_name)
    return `${displayName} ${title} ${tagline} ${org} ${p.id}`.toLowerCase()
  }

  return { card, searchText }
}

```

```ts
// Minimal local copy to avoid cross-package type import
export interface FirestoreObject {
  slug: string
  appId: string
  created_at: string | Date
  updated_at: string | Date
  creator_id: string
}

export interface Recipe extends FirestoreObject {
  // Basic Information
  title: string
  description: string
  chef_id?: string // Optional - can be created by chefs or global recipes
  chef_name?: string // Chef name for display

  // Recipe Details
  cuisine_type: string[]
  difficulty_level: 'Beginner' | 'Intermediate' | 'Advanced' | 'Professional'
  prep_time_minutes: number
  cook_time_minutes: number
  total_time_minutes: number
  servings: number

  // Ingredients & Instructions
  ingredients: RecipeIngredient[]
  instructions: RecipeInstruction[]

  // Nutritional Information (optional)
  nutrition?: RecipeNutrition

  // Media & Presentation
  featured_image?: string
  images: string[]
  video_url?: string

  // Metadata
  tags: string[]
  dietary_restrictions: string[] // e.g., 'vegetarian', 'gluten-free', 'dairy-free'
  allergens: string[] // e.g., 'nuts', 'shellfish', 'eggs'

  // Social Features
  is_public: boolean
  is_featured: boolean
  likes_count: number
  saves_count: number
  views_count: number

  // Business Features
  cost_estimate?: {
    ingredients_cost: number
    labor_cost?: number
    total_cost: number
    currency: string
  }

  // App/Domain Scoping
  parent_app_id?: string // For Niederhorn-specific recipes
  source: 'global' | 'app_specific' // Global MiseBox or app-specific

  // Status
  status: 'draft' | 'published' | 'archived'
  published_at?: string | Date
}

export interface RecipeIngredient {
  name: string
  amount: number
  unit: string
  notes?: string
  category?: string // e.g., 'protein', 'vegetable', 'spice'
  is_optional: boolean
}

export interface RecipeInstruction {

  time_minutes?: number
  temperature?: {

}

    likes_count: 0,
    saves_count: 0,
    views_count: 0,

} as const

>
```

```vue
<template>

    <div class="profile-page">
      <div v-if="loading" class="py-10 text-sm opacity-70">Loading profile…</div>

      <div v-else-if="!profile" class="space-y-2">
        <h1 class="text-lg font-semibold">Profile Not Found</h1>
        <p>The profile you're looking for doesn't exist.</p>
        <NuxtLink to="/chefs" class="text-primary hover:underline">← Back</NuxtLink>
      </div>

      <div v-else class="space-y-4">
        <div v-if="canEdit">
          <UButton
            icon="i-lucide-pencil"
            size="md"
            color="primary"
            variant="solid"
            @click="navigateTo('/console/chef/profile')"
          >
            Edit Profile
          </UButton>
        </div>

        <OrganismsProfilesChefCardsProfile :chef="profile" />
      </div>
    </div>

    <template #fallback>
      <div class="py-10 text-sm opacity-70">Loading profile…</div>
    </template>
  </ClientOnly>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { chefConfig } from '../../models/profiles/Chef/Chef.model.ts'
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { navigateTo, useHead, useRoute, useSeoMeta } from '#imports'
import { useFirestoreRead } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreRead'
import { useUser } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/useUser'

useSeoMeta({
  title: 'Chef Profile',
  description: 'View chef profile',
})

const route = useRoute()
const raw = route.params.id
const docId = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw[0] : String(raw || '')

const { user } = useUser()
const appUser = computed(() => user.value?.appUser)

const { firestoreFetchDoc } = useFirestoreRead()
const rawDoc = docId ? await firestoreFetchDoc(chefConfig.collectionName, docId) : null
const profile = computed<any>(() => (rawDoc as any)?.value ?? rawDoc ?? null)
const loading = computed(() => !rawDoc && !!docId)

const resolveName = (p: any) =>
  p?.display_name ||
  p?.name ||
  p?.title ||
  p?.agency_name ||
  p?.company_name ||
  p?.business_name ||
  p?.professional_name ||
  'Profile'

useHead({
  title: computed(() =>
    profile.value ? `${resolveName(profile.value)} - Chef Profile` : 'Chef Profile'
  ),
})

const canEdit = computed(
  () =>
    !!(
      appUser.value?.id &&
      profile.value?.id &&
      appUser.value.id === profile.value.id
    )
)
</script>
```

```vue
<!-- FILE: packages/ecosystem/fireux-misebox/src/runtime/pages/console/chef/profile.vue -->
<template>
  <UDashboardPanel id="console-chef-profile">
    <template #header>
      <UDashboardNavbar title="Chef Profile">
        <template #leading>
          <UDashboardSidebarCollapse />
        </template>
      </UDashboardNavbar>
    </template>

    <template #body>
      <div class="px-0 py-0 sm:px-4 sm:py-4 lg:px-6 space-y-6">
        <UCard v-if="isProfileLoading">
          <div class="fallback loading">Chef profile data is loading.</div>
        </UCard>

        <UCard v-else-if="!resolvedCoreProfile">
          <div class="fallback">
            <p class="mb-4">Your chef profile hasn’t been created yet.</p>

            <UButton
              :label="chefConfig.cta || 'Create Chef profile'"
              color="neutral"
              :loading="isCreating"
              @click="createProfile"
            />

            <p v-if="createError" class="mt-3 text-sm text-dimmed">
              {{ createError }}
            </p>
          </div>
        </UCard>

        <ClientOnly v-else>
          <LayoutsConsoleProfileEdit class="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-2">
            <template #preview>
              <OrganismsProfilesChefEditPreviewPanel />
            </template>

            <template #core>
              <OrganismsProfilesChefEditCore :chef="resolvedCoreProfile" />
            </template>

            <template v-if="resolvedAppProfile" #app>
              <OrganismsProfilesChefEditApp :chef="resolvedAppProfile" />
            </template>
          </LayoutsConsoleProfileEdit>
        </ClientOnly>
      </div>
    </template>
  </UDashboardPanel>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import LayoutsConsoleProfileEdit from 'fireux-core/runtime/components/layouts/console/ProfileEdit.vue'
import { useChef } from '../../../composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Chef/useChef'
import { useProfileEnsure } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/profile/mutations/useProfileEnsure'
import { chefConfig } from '../../../models/profiles/Chef/Chef.model'

definePageMeta({
  layout: 'console',
  nav: {
    key: 'console-chef-profile',
    label: 'Chef Profile',
    icon: 'i-lucide-chef-hat',
    desktop: true,
    layouts: ['console'],
    group: 'profiles',
    profileId: 'chef',
  },
  requiresAuth: true,
})

const { coreProfile, appProfile } = useChef()

const { ensure } = useProfileEnsure(chefConfig)
const isCreating = ref(false)
const createError = ref<string | null>(null)

const createProfile = async () => {
  if (isCreating.value) return
  isCreating.value = true
  createError.value = null

  try {
    await ensure()
  } catch (error) {
    createError.value = (error as Error)?.message || 'Failed to create profile.'
  } finally {
    isCreating.value = false
  }
}

const isProfileLoading = computed(() => coreProfile.value === undefined)
const resolvedCoreProfile = computed(() => coreProfile.value ?? null)
const resolvedAppProfile = computed(() => appProfile.value ?? null)
</script>

<style scoped>
.fallback {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 1.5rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
}

.loading {
  text-transform: none;
  letter-spacing: normal;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  opacity: 0.7;
}
</style>

```

### packages/ecosystem/fireux-misebox/src/runtime/pages/dev/fireux-misebox.vue

```vue
<template>
  <UPage>
    <UPageHeader
      title="Dev · Misebox"
      description="Model shapes for Chefs and Suppliers."
    />

    <UPageBody class="space-y-6">
      <UCard>
        <DevModel
          :title="'Chefs · Model'"
          :model="chefModelRuntime"
        />
      </UCard>

      <UCard>
        <template #header>
          <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
            <div class="space-y-3">
              <p class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100">
                Chefs collection
              </p>
              <p class="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                Browse chefs resolved for this runtime and filter by model drift.
              </p>
              <DevDriftToolbar
                :drift-kind="chefsDriftKind"
                :selected-field="chefsSelectedField"
                :filter-options="chefsFilterOptions"
                :copy-label="'Copy drift · Chefs'"
                :copy-payload="chefsDriftCopyPayload"
                @update:drift-kind="setChefsDriftKind"
                @update:selected-field="updateChefsSelectedField"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </template>

        <template #footer>
          <DevJson
            :title="'Chefs (JSON)'"
            :data="allChefsJsonPayload"
            :default-open="false"
          />
        </template>

        <OrganismsProfilesChefCollectionManager :collection="filteredChefs" />
      </UCard>

      <UCard>
        <DevModel
          :title="'Suppliers · Model'"
          :model="supplierModelRuntime"
        />
      </UCard>

      <UCard>
        <template #header>
          <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
            <div class="space-y-3">
              <p class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100">
                Suppliers collection
              </p>
              <p class="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                Browse suppliers resolved for this runtime and filter by model drift.
              </p>
              <DevDriftToolbar
                :drift-kind="suppliersDriftKind"
                :selected-field="suppliersSelectedField"
                :filter-options="suppliersFilterOptions"
                :copy-label="'Copy drift · Suppliers'"
                :copy-payload="suppliersDriftCopyPayload"
                @update:drift-kind="setSuppliersDriftKind"
                @update:selected-field="updateSuppliersSelectedField"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </template>

        <template #footer>
          <DevJson
            :title="'Suppliers (JSON)'"
            :data="allSuppliersJsonPayload"
            :default-open="false"
          />
        </template>

        <OrganismsProfilesSupplierCollectionManager :collection="filteredSuppliers" />
      </UCard>
    </UPageBody>
  </UPage>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDevDriftFilter } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/dev/useDevDriftFilter'
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { useChefCollection } from '../../composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Chef/main/useChefCollection'
import { useSupplierCollection } from '../../composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Supplier/main/useSupplierCollection'
import { ChefCore as ChefCoreRuntime } from '../../models/profiles/Chef/Chef.model'
import { SupplierCore as SupplierCoreRuntime } from '../../models/profiles/Supplier/Supplier.model'

definePageMeta({
  layout: 'dev',
  nav: {
    key: 'dev-tenant-misebox',
    label: 'Misebox',
    icon: 'i-lucide-utensils-crossed',
    desktop: true,
    group: 'misebox',
    layouts: ['dev'],
  },
})

const chefModelRuntime = ChefCoreRuntime
const supplierModelRuntime = SupplierCoreRuntime

const { globalChefs, localChefs } = useChefCollection()

const chefsCollection = computed(() => [
  ...(localChefs?.value ?? []),
  ...(globalChefs.value ?? []),
])

const {
  driftKind: chefsDriftKind,
  setDriftKind: setChefsDriftKind,
  selectedField: chefsSelectedField,
  driftById: chefsDriftById,
  filterOptions: chefsFilterOptions,
  filteredCollection: filteredChefs,
} = useDevDriftFilter({
  collection: chefsCollection,
  runtimeModel: chefModelRuntime,
})

const allChefsJsonPayload = computed(() => ({
  totalChefs: chefsCollection.value.length,
  chefs: chefsCollection.value,
}))

const filteredChefsDriftPayload = computed(() =>
  filteredChefs.value.map((entry) => {
    const drift = chefsDriftById.value.get(entry.id) ?? { missing: [], extra: [] }
    return {
      id: entry.id,
      displayName: (entry as any)?.user?.display_name ?? '',
      drift,
    }
  })
)

const chefsDriftCopyPayload = computed(() => ({
  modelPath: 'packages/ecosystem/fireux-misebox/src/runtime/models/profiles/Chef/Chef.model.ts',
  driftKind: chefsDriftKind.value,
  selectedField: chefsSelectedField.value || null,
  totalChefs: chefsCollection.value.length,
  chefs: filteredChefsDriftPayload.value,
}))

const { globalSuppliers, localSuppliers } = useSupplierCollection()

const suppliersCollection = computed(() => [
  ...(localSuppliers?.value ?? []),
  ...(globalSuppliers.value ?? []),
])

const {
  driftKind: suppliersDriftKind,
  setDriftKind: setSuppliersDriftKind,
  selectedField: suppliersSelectedField,
  driftById: suppliersDriftById,
  filterOptions: suppliersFilterOptions,
  filteredCollection: filteredSuppliers,
} = useDevDriftFilter({
  collection: suppliersCollection,
  runtimeModel: supplierModelRuntime,
})

const allSuppliersJsonPayload = computed(() => ({
  totalSuppliers: suppliersCollection.value.length,
  suppliers: suppliersCollection.value,
}))

const filteredSuppliersDriftPayload = computed(() =>
  filteredSuppliers.value.map((entry) => {
    const drift = suppliersDriftById.value.get(entry.id) ?? { missing: [], extra: [] }
    return {
      id: entry.id,
      displayName: (entry as any)?.user?.display_name ?? '',
      drift,
    }
  })
)

const suppliersDriftCopyPayload = computed(() => ({
  modelPath: 'packages/ecosystem/fireux-misebox/src/runtime/models/profiles/Supplier/Supplier.model.ts',
  driftKind: suppliersDriftKind.value,
  selectedField: suppliersSelectedField.value || null,
  totalSuppliers: suppliersCollection.value.length,
  suppliers: filteredSuppliersDriftPayload.value,
```

```vue
                <UIcon name="i-lucide-chef-hat" class="placeholder-icon" />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="recipe-hero-info">
              <div class="recipe-breadcrumb">
                <UButton
                  @click="$router.back()"
                  variant="ghost"
                  icon="i-lucide-arrow-left"
                  size="sm"
                >
                  Back to Recipes
                </UButton>
              </div>

              <h1 class="recipe-title">{{ recipe.title }}</h1>

              <p v-if="recipe.chef_name" class="recipe-chef">
                by <span class="chef-name">{{ recipe.chef_name }}</span>
              </p>

              <p v-if="recipe.description" class="recipe-description">
                {{ recipe.description }}
              </p>

              <div class="recipe-meta-bar">
                <div class="meta-item">
                  <UIcon name="i-lucide-clock" />
                  <span>{{ recipe.total_time_minutes }} min</span>
                </div>
                <div class="meta-item">
                  <UIcon name="i-lucide-trending-up" />
                  <span>{{ recipe.difficulty_level }}</span>
                </div>
                <div class="meta-item">
                  <UIcon name="i-lucide-users" />
                  <span>{{ recipe.servings }} servings</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div class="recipe-actions">
                <UButton color="primary" icon="i-lucide-heart">
                  Save Recipe
                </UButton>
                <UButton variant="outline" icon="i-lucide-share-2">
                  Share
                </UButton>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Recipe Content -->
      <div class="recipe-content">
        <div class="container mx-auto px-4 py-8">
          <div class="recipe-grid">
            <!-- Ingredients -->
            <div class="ingredients-section">
              <h2 class="section-title">Ingredients</h2>
              <div class="ingredients-list">
                <div
                  v-for="ingredient in recipe.ingredients"
                  :key="ingredient.name"
                  class="ingredient-item"
                >
                  <span class="ingredient-amount">
                    {{ ingredient.amount }} {{ ingredient.unit }}
                  </span>
                  <span class="ingredient-name">{{ ingredient.name }}</span>
                  <span v-if="ingredient.notes" class="ingredient-notes">
                    ({{ ingredient.notes }})
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Instructions -->
            <div class="instructions-section">
              <h2 class="section-title">Instructions</h2>
              <div class="instructions-list">
                <div
                  v-for="instruction in recipe.instructions"
                  :key="instruction.step_number"
                  class="instruction-item"
                >
                  <div class="instruction-number">
                    {{ instruction.step_number }}
                  </div>
                  <div class="instruction-content">
                    <p class="instruction-text">
                      {{ instruction.instruction }}
                    </p>
                    <div
                      v-if="instruction.time_minutes"
                      class="instruction-meta"
                    >
                      <UIcon name="i-lucide-clock" />
                      <span>{{ instruction.time_minutes }} minutes</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- Recipe Tags & Info -->
          <div class="recipe-footer">
            <div v-if="recipe.cuisine_type?.length" class="cuisine-tags">
              <h3>Cuisine Types</h3>
              <div class="tag-list">
                <span
                  v-for="cuisine in recipe.cuisine_type"
                  :key="cuisine"
                  class="cuisine-tag"
                >
                  {{ cuisine }}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div
              v-if="recipe.dietary_restrictions?.length"
              class="dietary-info"
            >
              <h3>Dietary Information</h3>
              <div class="tag-list">
                <span
                  v-for="restriction in recipe.dietary_restrictions"
                  :key="restriction"
                  class="dietary-tag"
                >
                  {{ restriction }}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="recipe-source-info">
              <p class="source-label">Source:</p>
              <span :class="['source-badge', `source-${recipe.source}`]">
                {{
                  recipe.source === 'global'
                    ? 'MiseBox Global'
                    : recipe.parent_app_id || 'Local'
                }}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useRecipes } from '../../composables/fireux/firestore/recipe/useRecipes'
import { computed, watchEffect } from 'vue'

definePageMeta({
  title: 'Recipe Details',
})

const route = useRoute()
const recipeSlug = route.params.slug as string

// Get recipes data
const { all: recipes, pending: loading, error } = useRecipes()

// Find the specific recipe
const recipe = computed(() => {
  return recipes.value?.find((r) => r.slug === recipeSlug)
})
```

```vue
import { computed, ref } from '#imports'
import type { RecipeCard } from '../../composables/fireux/firestore/recipe/utils/view/useRecipeInterface'

// Data and state
const searchQuery = ref('')
const showFilters = ref(false)
const showCreateForm = ref(false)
const filters = ref({
  difficulty: '',
  maxTime: '',
  cuisine: '',
})

// Temporary stub - replace with proper recipe composable later
type RecipeStub = {
  slug?: string
  title?: string
  name?: string
  difficulty?: string
  cookTimeMinutes?: number
  prepTimeMinutes?: number
  totalTimeMinutes?: number
  cuisine?: string
  cuisines?: string[]
  ingredients?: string[]
}

type RecipePillCard = Pick<RecipeCard.Card, 'to' | 'avatarUrl' | 'title' | 'subtitle' | 'badges'>

function pillCardForRecipe(recipe: RecipeStub): RecipePillCard {
  const slug = recipe.slug || ''
  const title = recipe.title || recipe.name || 'Recipe'
  const subtitle = recipe.difficulty || ''

  return {
    to: slug ? `/recipes/${slug}` : '#',
    avatarUrl: '',
    title,
    subtitle,
    badges: [],
  }
}

const allAvailableRecipes = ref<RecipeStub[]>([])
const loading = ref(false)
const error = ref<{ message?: string } | null>(null)

const searchRecipes = (query: string) => {
  const q = query.trim().toLowerCase()
  if (!q) return allAvailableRecipes.value

  return allAvailableRecipes.value.filter((recipe: RecipeStub) => {
    const haystack = [
      recipe.title,
      recipe.name,
      recipe.slug,
      recipe.cuisine,
      ...(recipe.cuisines ?? []),
      ...(recipe.ingredients ?? []),
    ]
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join(' ')
      .toLowerCase()

    return haystack.includes(q)
  })
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { supplierConfig } from '../../models/profiles/Supplier/Supplier.model.ts'
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { navigateTo, useHead, useRoute, useSeoMeta } from '#imports'
import { useFirestoreRead } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreRead'
import { useUser } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/useUser'

useSeoMeta({
  title: 'Supplier Profile',
  description: 'View supplier profile',
})

const route = useRoute()
const raw = route.params.id
const docId = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw[0] : String(raw || '')

const { user } = useUser()
const appUser = computed(() => user.value?.appUser)

const { firestoreFetchDoc } = useFirestoreRead()
const rawDoc = docId
  ? await firestoreFetchDoc(supplierConfig.collectionName, docId)
  : null
const profile = computed<any>(() => (rawDoc as any)?.value ?? rawDoc ?? null)
const loading = computed(() => !rawDoc && !!docId)

const resolveName = (p: any) =>
  p?.display_name ||
  p?.name ||
  p?.title ||
  p?.agency_name ||
  p?.company_name ||
  p?.business_name ||
  p?.professional_name ||
  'Profile'

useHead({
  title: computed(() =>
    profile.value
      ? `${resolveName(profile.value)} - Supplier Profile`
      : 'Supplier Profile'
  ),
})

const canEdit = computed(
  () =>
    !!(
      appUser.value?.id &&
      profile.value?.id &&
      appUser.value.id === profile.value.id
    )
)
</script>
```

   ```ts
   export default defineNuxtConfig({
   ```

### packages/extensions/fireux-blogs/src/module.ts

```ts
import {
    ensureRuntimeConfigBuckets,
    ensureRuntimeLayerFromPath,
    exposeRuntimeAlias,
} from 'fireux-core/config/module/runtime-layer'
import {
    addImportsDir,
    createResolver,
    defineNuxtModule,
} from 'nuxt/kit'
import type { Nuxt } from 'nuxt/schema'
import { configureComponents } from './config/module/components-config'
import { configureComposables } from './config/module/composables-config'
import { configureLayouts } from './config/module/layouts-config'
import { configureModels } from './config/module/models-config'
import { configurePages } from './config/module/pages-config'
import { configurePlugins } from './config/module/plugins-config'
import { configureRuntime } from './config/module/runtime-config'

declare module 'nuxt/schema' {
  interface NuxtConfig {
    blogs?: Partial<typeof defaults>
  }
  interface NuxtOptions {
    blogs?: Partial<typeof defaults>
  }
}

const defaults = {
  enabled: true,
}

export default defineNuxtModule({
  meta: {
    name: 'fireux-blogs',
    configKey: 'blogs',
    compatibility: { nuxt: '^4.0.0' },
  },
  defaults,
  setup(_options, nuxt) {
    const resolver = createResolver(import.meta.url)
    const runtimeDir = resolver.resolve('./runtime')

    ensureRuntimeConfigBuckets(nuxt, 'blogs')
    configureRuntime(nuxt, 'blogs')
    configurePlugins(resolver)
    configureComposables(resolver)

    // Auto-import runtime composables directory (create files as needed)
    addImportsDir(resolver.resolve('./runtime/composables'))

    configureComponents(resolver)
    configureLayouts(resolver, nuxt)
    configureModels(resolver)
    configurePages(resolver, nuxt)

    exposeRuntimeAlias(nuxt, '#fireux-blogs', runtimeDir)

    registerBlogPages(nuxt, resolver, runtimeDir)
  },
})

function registerBlogPages(nuxt: Nuxt, resolver: any, runtimeDir: string) {
  ensureRuntimeLayerFromPath(nuxt, runtimeDir)

  const pagesToInject = [
    {
      name: 'fireux-blog-index',
      path: '/blog',
      file: resolver.resolve('./runtime/pages/blog/index.vue'),
    },
    {
      name: 'fireux-blog-slug',
      path: '/blog/:slug',
      file: resolver.resolve('./runtime/pages/blog/[slug].vue'),
    },
  ]

  nuxt.hook('pages:extend', (pages: any[]) => {
    for (const entry of pagesToInject) {
      const exists = pages.some((page) => page.path === entry.path)
      if (!exists) {
        pages.push(entry)
      }
    }
  })
}
```

```vue
    </div>
```

```vue
      <div
        v-if="variant === 'pill'"
        class="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3"
      >
        <component
          :is="wrapperFor(card)"
          v-for="card in cards"
          :key="card.id"
          v-bind="wrapperPropsFor(card)"
          class="block"
        >
          <BlogCardsPill v-bind="card" />
        </component>
      </div>

      <div v-else class="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
        <component
          :is="wrapperFor(card)"
          v-for="card in cards"
          :key="card.id"
          v-bind="wrapperPropsFor(card)"
          class="block"
        >
          <BlogCardsCell v-bind="card" />
        </component>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div v-if="showDebug" class="pt-3">
      <DevJson
        :title="'Blog (JSON)'"
        :data="debugPayload"
        :default-open="false"
      />
    </div>
  </UCard>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import { useBlogInterface } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/blog/utils/view/useBlogInterface';
import type { BlogPost } from '../../../../../models/blogPost.model';

const props = defineProps<{ collection?: BlogPost[] }>()

const collection = computed(() => props.collection ?? [])
const { card: makeCard } = useBlogInterface()
type BlogCardShape = NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof makeCard>>
const cards = computed(() =>
  collection.value
    .map((blog) => makeCard(blog))
    .filter((c): c is NonNullable<typeof c> => Boolean(c))
)
const showDebug = import.meta.dev
const debugPayload = computed(() => ({
  totalPosts: collection.value.length,
  posts: collection.value,
}))

type Variant = 'pill' | 'cell'
const variant = ref<Variant>('cell')
const toggleVariant = () => {
  variant.value = variant.value === 'pill' ? 'cell' : 'pill'
}

const wrapperFor = (card: BlogCardShape) => (card.to ? 'NuxtLink' : 'div')
const wrapperPropsFor = (card: BlogCardShape) => (card.to ? { to: card.to } : {})
</script>
```

```vue
<!-- Blog Image Upload Component -->
<template>
  <div class="images-system">
    <div class="image-card featured">
      <div class="card-header">
        <div class="card-title">Wordmark</div>
        <div class="card-hint">Wide feature image</div>
      </div>
      <MoleculesFormsStateImagePicker
        ref="featuredImageRef"
        label="Wordmark"
        :state-key="FEATURED_IMAGE_KEY"
      />
    </div>

    <div class="image-card social">
      <div class="card-header">
        <div class="card-title">Logo</div>
        <div class="card-hint">Square social image</div>
      </div>
      <MoleculesFormsStateImagePicker
        ref="socialImageRef"
        label="Logo"
        :state-key="SOCIAL_IMAGE_KEY"
      />
    </div>

    <!-- Upload Progress Display -->
    <div v-if="showProgress" class="upload-progress">
      <h4>Uploading Images...</h4>
      <div class="uploading-spinner">
        <UIcon name="i-lucide-loader-2" class="animate-spin" />
        <span>Processing images...</span>
      </div>

      <!-- Error Display -->
      <div v-if="Object.keys(uploadErrors).length" class="upload-errors">
        <div v-for="(error, key) in uploadErrors" :key="key" class="error-item">
          <UIcon name="i-lucide-alert-circle" />
          <span>{{ key }}: {{ error }}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed } from 'vue'
import { useImageStorage } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firebase/useImageStorage.ts'

// Base keys for image slots
const FEATURED_IMAGE_KEY = 'createBlogFeaturedImage'
const SOCIAL_IMAGE_KEY = 'createBlogSocialImage'

// Component refs
const featuredImageRef = ref()
const socialImageRef = ref()

// Upload state
const uploading = ref(false)
const uploadErrors = ref<Record<string, string>>({})

// Show progress when uploading
const showProgress = computed(() => uploading.value)

// Get upload service
const { uploadImage } = useImageStorage()

// Expose methods for parent component
defineExpose({
  async uploadImages(blogId: string) {
    try {
      uploading.value = true
      uploadErrors.value = {}

      const results: { featuredImage: string; socialImage: string } = {
        featuredImage: '',
        socialImage: '',
      }

      // Upload featured image if available
      const featuredFile = featuredImageRef.value?.getFile()
      if (featuredFile) {
        try {
          results.featuredImage = await uploadImage(
            featuredFile,
            `blogs/${blogId}/featured.jpg`
          )
        } catch (error) {
          uploadErrors.value.featured =
            error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Upload failed'
        }
      }

      // Upload social image if available
      const socialFile = socialImageRef.value?.getFile()
      if (socialFile) {
        try {
          results.socialImage = await uploadImage(
            socialFile,
            `blogs/${blogId}/social.jpg`
          )
        } catch (error) {
          uploadErrors.value.social =
            error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Upload failed'
        }
      }

      return results
    } finally {
      uploading.value = false
    }
  },

  getImageFiles() {
    return {
      featured: featuredImageRef.value?.getFile(),
      social: socialImageRef.value?.getFile(),
    }
  },

  clearImages() {
    featuredImageRef.value?.clear()
    socialImageRef.value?.clear()
    uploadErrors.value = {}
  },
})
</script>

<style scoped>
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onMounted, ref } from 'vue'
import DOMPurify from 'dompurify'
import { useBlogDraftState } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/blogs/post/state/useBlogDraftState'

// Use the centralized state management
const { blogPost, featuredImageData, socialImageData } = useBlogDraftState()

// Avoid hydration drift by using a stable date label
const createdAtLabel = computed(() => {
  const timestamps = blogPost.value as unknown as Partial<{
    created_at: string
    updated_at: string
  }>

  return timestamps.created_at || timestamps.updated_at || 'Draft'
})

// Sanitize the HTML before injecting (client-only to prevent SSR mismatch)
const isClient = ref(false)
onMounted(() => {
  isClient.value = true
})

const sanitizedContent = computed(() => {
  const html = blogPost.value.content || ''
  return isClient.value ? DOMPurify.sanitize(html) : html
})

// Prefer uploaded previews, fall back to current blog post images.
const featuredImageSrc = computed(
  () => featuredImageData.value || blogPost.value.featuredImage || ''
)
const socialImageSrc = computed(
  () => socialImageData.value || blogPost.value.socialImage || ''
)

const author = computed(() => ({
  name:
    blogPost.value.author?.display_name ||
    blogPost.value.author?.handle ||
    'Author',
  avatar: blogPost.value.author?.avatar || undefined,
  handle: blogPost.value.author?.handle || undefined,
}))

const fallbackWordmark = '/img/app/wordmark-dark.png'
const fallbackLogo = '/img/app/logo.png'
</script>
```
