import { useRouter } from '#imports'
import { useBlogDraftState } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/blogs/post/state/useBlogDraftState'
import { useBlogCreateSubmit } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/blogs/post/state/useBlogCreateSubmit'

const { blogPost, resetCreateBlogPostState } = useBlogDraftState()
const { submit } = useBlogCreateSubmit()
const isCreating = ref(false)
const router = useRouter()

async function handleCreate() {
  isCreating.value = true

  try {
    const slug = await submit()

    if (toast) {
      toast.add({
        title: 'Published',
        description: 'Blog post published successfully',
        icon: 'i-heroicons-check-circle',
        color: 'green',
      })
    }

    handleClear()
    await router.push('/blog')
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('❌ Blog post creation failed:', error)
    if (toast) {
      toast.add({
        title: 'Publish failed',
        description: error?.message || 'Unknown error',
        icon: 'i-heroicons-x-circle',
        color: 'red',
      })
    }
  } finally {
    isCreating.value = false
  }
}

function handleClear() {
  resetCreateBlogPostState()
  blogPost.value.slug = ''
}
</script>

            >

              variant="ghost"

              :disabled="!can('redo')"
            >
              Redo
            </UButton>
          </div>
          <EditorContent :editor="editor" class="tiptap-content" />
        </div>
        <div v-else class="text-sm text-gray-500">Loading editor…</div>
      </ClientOnly>
    </div>

    <BlogCreateAdvanced />
    <BlogCreateImages />
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import {
  onMounted,
  onBeforeUnmount,
  watch,
  defineAsyncComponent,
  shallowRef,
} from 'vue'
import { useBlogDraftState } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/blogs/post/state/useBlogDraftState'
import { useBlog } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/blog/useBlog'

const EditorContent = defineAsyncComponent(async () => {
  const mod = await import('@tiptap/vue-3')
  return mod.EditorContent
})

const editor = shallowRef<any>(null)

const { utils } = useBlog()
const { blogPost } = useBlogDraftState()
const { generateSlug, computeReadingTime } = utils

onMounted(async () => {
  const [{ Editor }, { default: StarterKit }] = await Promise.all([
    import('@tiptap/vue-3'),
    import('@tiptap/starter-kit'),
  ])

  editor.value = new Editor({
    content: blogPost.value.content || '',
    extensions: [StarterKit],
    onUpdate: ({ editor }) => {
      blogPost.value.content = editor.getHTML()
      blogPost.value.readingTime = computeReadingTime(
        blogPost.value.content || ''
      )
    },
  })

  // Ensure slug exists when a title was prefilled before mount.
  if (!blogPost.value.slug && blogPost.value.title) {
    blogPost.value.slug = generateSlug(blogPost.value.title)
  }
})

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  editor.value?.destroy()
})

// Watch for title changes to auto-generate slug
watch(
  () => blogPost.value.title,
  (title: string) => {
    blogPost.value.slug = title ? generateSlug(title) : ''
  }
)

// Watch for content changes to auto-compute reading time
watch(
  () => blogPost.value.content,
  (content: string) => {
    blogPost.value.readingTime = computeReadingTime(content || '')
  }
)

const run = (
  action:
    | 'bold'
    | 'italic'
    | 'heading2'
    | 'bullet'
    | 'ordered'
    | 'undo'
    | 'redo'
) => {
  if (!editor.value) return
  const chain = editor.value.chain().focus()
  switch (action) {
    case 'bold':
      chain.toggleBold().run()
      break
    case 'italic':
      chain.toggleItalic().run()
      break
    case 'heading2':
      chain.toggleHeading({ level: 2 }).run()
      break
    case 'bullet':
      chain.toggleBulletList().run()
      break
    case 'ordered':
      chain.toggleOrderedList().run()
      break
    case 'undo':
      editor.value.commands.undo()
      break
    case 'redo':
      editor.value.commands.redo()
      break
  }
}

const isActive = (name: string, attrs?: Record<string, any>) =>
  editor.value?.isActive(name, attrs) ?? false

const can = (action: 'undo' | 'redo') => {
  if (!editor.value) return false
  return action === 'undo'
    ? editor.value.can().undo()
    : editor.value.can().redo()
}
</script>

  gap: var(--space-6); /* Increased from 1.5rem to match product system */
}

.editor-shell {
  border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
  border-radius: 0.5rem;

import { useBlogDraftState } from './useBlogDraftState'
import { useBlog } from '../../../objects/blog/useBlog'

export function useBlogCreateSubmit() {
  const { getBlogPostPayload } = useBlogDraftState()
  const { createBlogPost, utils } = useBlog()

  const submit = async () => {
    const payload = getBlogPostPayload()
    const slug = payload.slug || utils.generateSlug(payload.title || '')
    if (!slug) throw new Error('Slug is required to publish a blog post')

    await createBlogPost(payload, slug)
    return slug
  }

  return { submit }
}

### packages/extensions/fireux-blogs/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/blogs/post/state/useBlogDraftState.ts

```ts
import { useStorage } from '@vueuse/core'
import { onMounted } from 'vue'
import { useFireUXConfig } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/app/FireUXConfig'
import { useBlogUtils } from '../../../objects/blog/utils/useBlogUtils'
import type { BlogPostEntry } from '../../../../../../models/blogPost.model'

type BlogPostPayload = BlogPostEntry & {
  created_at: string
  updated_at: string
  appId: string
}

const defaultBlogPost: BlogPostEntry = {
  title: '',
  content: '',
  metaDescription: '',
  slug: '',
  author: {
    id: '',
    display_name: '',
    avatar: '',
  },
  keywords: [],
  tags: [],
  canonicalUrl: '',
  featuredImage: '',
  socialImage: '',
  readingTime: '',
  cta_link: '',
  cta_text: '',
  type: 'article',
  product_id: undefined,
}

/**
 * Manages local draft state for the blog post authoring flow.
 */
export function useBlogDraftState() {
  const { appId: tenantId } = useFireUXConfig()
  const { getAuthor, getDefaultImages } = useBlogUtils()

  const blogPost = useStorage<BlogPostEntry>('createBlogPost', defaultBlogPost)
  const featuredImageData = useStorage<string>(
    'createBlogFeaturedImageData',
    ''
  )
  const socialImageData = useStorage<string>('createBlogSocialImageData', '')

  onMounted(async () => {
    if (!blogPost.value.author.id) {
      blogPost.value.author = await getAuthor()
    }

    const defaults = getDefaultImages()
    // Backfill stored images to app-branded defaults.
    if (!blogPost.value.featuredImage) {
      blogPost.value.featuredImage = defaults.featuredImage
    }
    if (!blogPost.value.socialImage) {
      blogPost.value.socialImage = defaults.socialImage
    }

    // Ensure previews show defaults when nothing uploaded yet.
    if (!featuredImageData.value) {
      featuredImageData.value = defaults.featuredImage
    }
    if (!socialImageData.value) {
      socialImageData.value = defaults.socialImage
    }
  })

  function resetCreateBlogPostState() {
    const defaults = getDefaultImages()

    blogPost.value = {
      title: '',
      content: '',
      metaDescription: '',
      slug: '',
      author: blogPost.value.author,
      keywords: [],
      tags: [],
      canonicalUrl: '',
      featuredImage: defaults.featuredImage,
      socialImage: defaults.socialImage,
      readingTime: '',
      cta_link: '',
      cta_text: '',
      type: 'article',
      product_id: undefined,
    }

    featuredImageData.value = ''
    socialImageData.value = ''
  }

  function getBlogPostPayload(): BlogPostPayload {
    const now = new Date().toISOString()
    return {
      ...blogPost.value,
      created_at: now,
      updated_at: now,
      appId: tenantId,
    }
  }

  return {
    blogPost,
    featuredImageData,
    socialImageData,
    resetCreateBlogPostState,
    getBlogPostPayload,
  }
}

```

### packages/extensions/fireux-blogs/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/blog/fetch/useBlogFetch.ts

```ts
import { computed, type Ref } from 'vue'
import { useFirestoreRead } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreRead.ts'
import type { BlogPost } from '../../../../../../models/blogPost.model'

/**
 * Fetch helpers for blog posts (list + single).
 */
export function useBlogFetch() {
  const { firestoreFetchCollection, firestoreFetchDoc } = useFirestoreRead()

  const collection = firestoreFetchCollection<BlogPost>('blogs')

  const items = computed(() => {
    const posts = collection.value
    if (!posts) return posts
    return posts.slice().sort((a, b) => {
      const createdA = new Date(a.created_at ?? '').getTime()
      const createdB = new Date(b.created_at ?? '').getTime()
      return createdB - createdA
    })
  })

  const fetchBySlug = async (
    slug: string
  ): Promise<Ref<BlogPost | null | undefined>> => {
    if (!slug) {
      throw new Error('Blog post slug is required')
    }
    return firestoreFetchDoc<BlogPost>('blogs', slug) as Ref<
      BlogPost | null | undefined
    >
  }

  return { items, fetchBySlug }
}

```

### packages/extensions/fireux-blogs/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/blog/mutations/useBlogCreate.ts

```ts
import { doc, getDoc } from 'firebase/firestore'
import { useFireUXConfig } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/app/FireUXConfig'
import { useFirestoreCreate } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreCreate'
import { useFirestore } from 'vuefire'
import type { BlogPost, BlogPostEntry } from '../../../../../../models/blogPost.model'

export const BlogPayload = {
  id: '',
  slug: '',
  title: '',
  content: '',
  metaDescription: '',
  author: {
    id: '',
    display_name: '',
    avatar: '',
    handle: '',
    email: '',
  },
  keywords: [] as string[],
  tags: [] as string[],
  canonicalUrl: '',
  featuredImage: '',
  socialImage: '',
  readingTime: '',
  cta_link: '',
  cta_text: '',
  type: '',
  product_id: '',
  appId: '',
}

export const BlogStampOptions = {
  creator: true,
} as const

export function useBlogCreate() {
  const db = useFirestore()
  const { setDocument } = useFirestoreCreate()

  async function createBlogPost(
    payload: BlogPostEntry,
    slug: string
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    if (!slug) {
      throw new Error('Blog post slug is required')
    }

    const ref = doc(db, 'blogs', slug)
    const snap = await getDoc(ref)

    if (snap.exists()) {
      return false
    }

    const fireux = useFireUXConfig()
    const data = {
      ...payload,
      id: slug,
      slug,
      appId: payload.appId || fireux.appId,
    } satisfies Omit<BlogPost, 'created_at' | 'updated_at' | 'creator_id'>

    await setDocument<BlogPost>('blogs', slug, data as BlogPost, {
      creator: true,
    })

    return true
  }

  return { createBlogPost }
}

  const { deleteDocument } = useFirestoreManager()

    }

  return { deleteBlogPost }

```ts
import { serverTimestamp } from 'firebase/firestore'
import { useFirestoreUpdate } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreUpdate.ts'
import type { BlogPost } from '../../../../../../models/blogPost.model'

export function useBlogUpdate() {
  const { updateDocument } = useFirestoreUpdate()

  async function updateBlogPost(
    postId: string,
    updates: Partial<BlogPost>
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    if (!postId) {
      throw new Error('No blog post ID provided.')
    }

    if (!updates || typeof updates !== 'object') {
      throw new Error('Invalid update payload. Must be an object.')
    }

    const updateData = {
      ...updates,
      updated_at: serverTimestamp(),
    }

    await updateDocument('blogs', postId, updateData)
    if (import.meta.dev) {
      console.log(`✅ Blog post updated successfully: ${postId}`)
    }
    return true
  }

  return { updateBlogPost }
}

import { useBlogCreate } from './mutations/useBlogCreate.ts'

### packages/extensions/fireux-blogs/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/blog/utils/useBlogUtils.ts

```ts
import type { Author, BlogPost } from '../../../../../../models/blogPost.model'

function generateSlug(title: string): string {
  let out = title.toLowerCase().replaceAll(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
  out = out.replaceAll(/^-+/g, '')
  out = out.replaceAll(/-+$/g, '')
  return out
}

function computeReadingTime(content: string): string {
  const text = content?.replaceAll(/<[^>]*>/g, '').trim() || ''
  const minutes = Math.ceil((text.split(/\s+/).length || 0) / 200)
  return `${minutes} min`
}

async function getAuthor(): Promise<Author> {
  const { useUser } = await import(
    'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/useUser.ts'
  )
  const { currentUser } = useUser()
  const user = currentUser.value
  return {
    id: user?.id || '',
    display_name: user?.display_name || user?.email || '',
    handle: user?.handle || '',
    avatar: user?.avatar || '/img/core/defaults/default-thumbnail.png',
    email: user?.email || '',
  }
}

function getDefaultImages(): Pick<BlogPost, 'featuredImage' | 'socialImage'> {
  return {
    featuredImage: '/img/app/wordmark-dark.png',
    socialImage: '/img/app/logo.png',
  }
}

/**
 * Helper utilities shared across blog authoring flows.
 */
export function useBlogUtils() {
  return {
    generateSlug,
    computeReadingTime,
    getAuthor,
    getDefaultImages,
  }
}

```

### packages/extensions/fireux-blogs/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/blog/utils/view/useBlogInterface.ts

```ts
import type { BlogPost } from '../../../../../../../models/blogPost.model'

export namespace BlogCard {
  export type Card = {
    id: string
    to: string

    // Media (empty string means unset)
    avatarUrl: string

    // Primary display fields
    subtitle: string

    title: string
    excerpt: string
    author: string

    // Secondary media (empty string means unset)
    imageUrl: string

    // Status/label chips
    badges: string[]
  }
}

function stripHtml(input: string): string {
  return input.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()
}

function ellipsis(text: string, limit = 180): string {
  return text.length > limit ? `${text.slice(0, limit)}…` : text
}

export function useBlogInterface() {
  function map(post: BlogPost): BlogCard.Card {
    const excerpt = ellipsis(stripHtml(post.content), 180)

    const author = post.author.display_name
    const imageUrl = post.featuredImage || post.socialImage

    return {
      id: post.slug,
      to: `/blog/${post.slug}`,

      avatarUrl: imageUrl,
      subtitle: author,

      title: post.title,
      excerpt,
      author,

      imageUrl,
      badges: [],
    }
  }

  function card(target?: BlogPost | null | undefined): BlogCard.Card | null {
    return target ? map(target) : null
  }

  function searchText(post: BlogPost): string {
    return `${post.title} ${post.slug} ${post.author.display_name}`.toLowerCase()
  }

  return { card, searchText }
}

```

// FILE: packages/extensions/fireux-blogs/src/runtime/models/blogPost.model.ts

import type { FireuxStamped } from 'fireux-core/runtime/models/core/meta.model'
import type { FirebaseTimestamp } from 'fireux-core/types/firebase'

/**
 * BlogPost Firestore doc (extension)
 * Collection: blogs/{slug}
 *
 * Canon rules:
 * - id is slug (string)
 * - Uses FireuxStamped for created/updated (+ optional creator_id)
 */

export type BlogPostType = 'article' | 'product'

export type BlogAuthor = {
	id: string
	display_name: string
	avatar: string
	handle: string
	email: string
}

export const BlogPost = {
	// Identity
	id: '', // == slug

	// Core content
	title: '',
	content: '',
	metaDescription: '',
	slug: '',

	// Author snapshot
	author: {
		id: '',
		display_name: '',
		avatar: '',
		handle: '',
		email: '',
	} as BlogAuthor,

	// SEO
	keywords: [] as string[],
	tags: [] as string[],
	canonicalUrl: '',

	// Media
	featuredImage: '',
	socialImage: '',

	// Meta
	readingTime: '',
	cta_link: '',
	cta_text: '',

	// Type + optional product link
	type: 'article' as BlogPostType,
	product_id: '',

	// Scope
	appId: '',

	// Stamps
	creator_id: undefined as FireuxStamped['creator_id'],
	created_at: {} as FirebaseTimestamp,
	updated_at: {} as FirebaseTimestamp,
} as const

export type BlogPost = {
	[K in keyof typeof BlogPost]: (typeof BlogPost)[K]
}

export type BlogPostEntry = Omit<
	BlogPost,
	'created_at' | 'updated_at' | 'creator_id'
>

```

### packages/extensions/fireux-blogs/src/runtime/pages/blog/create.vue

```vue
<!-- FILE: packages/extensions/fireux-blogs/src/runtime/pages/blog/create.vue -->
<template>
  <UPage>
    <UPageHeader
      title="Create Blog Post"
      description="Draft and publish a new post for this runtime."
    />

    <UPageBody class="pagebody">
      <UAlert
        v-if="!canPublishBlog"
        color="amber"
        title="Admins only"
        description="Only admins can publish blog posts for this runtime."
      />

      <MoleculesCreateShell
        v-else
        :loading="isCreating"
        submit-label="Publish"
        @submit="handleCreate"
        @clear="handleClear"
      >
        <template #write>
          <BlogCreateWrite />
        </template>
        <template #preview>
          <BlogCreatePreview />
        </template>
      </MoleculesCreateShell>
    </UPageBody>
  </UPage>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { useHead, useRouter } from '#imports'
import { useBlogPermissions } from '../../composables/useBlogPermissions'
// Nuxt UI provides useToast via auto-import in app context; fall back if unavailable
const useToastFn = (globalThis as any).useToast as undefined | (() => any)
const toast = useToastFn ? useToastFn() : undefined
import { useBlogDraftState } from '../../composables/fireux/firestore/blogs/post/state/useBlogDraftState'
import { useBlogCreateSubmit } from '../../composables/fireux/firestore/blogs/post/state/useBlogCreateSubmit'

definePageMeta({
  layout: 'default',
  nav: {
    key: 'blog-create',
    label: 'Create blog post',
    icon: 'i-lucide-plus',
    order: 31,
    desktop: false,
    mobile: false,
    layouts: ['default'],
  },
  title: 'Create Blog Post',
})

const { canPublishBlog } = useBlogPermissions()

useHead({ title: 'Create Blog Post' })

const { blogPost, resetCreateBlogPostState } = useBlogDraftState()
const { submit } = useBlogCreateSubmit()
const isCreating = ref(false)
const router = useRouter()

async function handleCreate() {
  isCreating.value = true

  try {
    const slug = await submit()

    if (toast) {
      toast.add({
        title: 'Published',
        description: 'Blog post published successfully',
        icon: 'i-heroicons-check-circle',
        color: 'green',
      })
    }

    handleClear()
    await router.push('/blog')
  } catch (error: any) {
    if (toast) {
      toast.add({
        title: 'Publish failed',
        description: error?.message || 'Unknown error',
        icon: 'i-heroicons-x-circle',
        color: 'red',
      })
    }
  } finally {
    isCreating.value = false
  }
}

function handleClear() {
  resetCreateBlogPostState()
  blogPost.value.slug = ''
}
</script>

```

        />

      <UCard>
        <template #header>
          <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
            <div class="space-y-3">
              <p class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100">
                Blogs collection
              </p>
              <p class="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                Browse blog posts resolved for this runtime and filter by model drift.
              </p>
              <DevDriftToolbar
                :drift-kind="blogsDriftKind"
                :selected-field="blogsSelectedField"
                :filter-options="blogsFilterOptions"
                :copy-label="'Copy drift · Blogs'"
                :copy-payload="blogsDriftCopyPayload"
                @update:drift-kind="setBlogsDriftKind"
                @update:selected-field="updateBlogsSelectedField"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </template>

        <template #footer>
          <DevJson
            :title="'Blogs (JSON)'"
            :data="allBlogsJsonPayload"
            :default-open="false"
          />
        </template>

        <BlogCollectionManager :collection="filteredBlogs" />
      </UCard>
    </UPageBody>
  </UPage>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDevDriftFilter } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/dev/useDevDriftFilter'
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { useBlogFetch } from '../../composables/fireux/firestore/blog/fetch/useBlogFetch'
import type { BlogPost } from '../../models/blogPost.model'
import { BlogPost as BlogPostModelRuntime } from '../../models/blogPost.model'

definePageMeta({
  layout: 'dev',
  nav: {
    key: 'dev-ext-blogs',
    label: 'Blogs (Ext)',
    icon: 'i-lucide-newspaper',
    desktop: true,
    group: 'ext',
    layouts: ['dev'],
  },
})

const blogPostModelRuntime = BlogPostModelRuntime

const { items } = useBlogFetch()

const blogsCollection = computed<Array<BlogPost & { id: string }>>(() =>
  (items.value ?? []).map((post) => ({ ...post, id: post.slug }))
)

const {
  driftKind: blogsDriftKind,
  setDriftKind: setBlogsDriftKind,
  selectedField: blogsSelectedField,
  driftById: blogsDriftById,
  filterOptions: blogsFilterOptions,
  filteredCollection: filteredBlogs,
} = useDevDriftFilter<BlogPost & { id: string }>({
  collection: blogsCollection,
  runtimeModel: blogPostModelRuntime,
})

const allBlogsJsonPayload = computed(() => ({
  totalBlogs: blogsCollection.value.length,
  blogs: blogsCollection.value,
}))

const filteredBlogsDriftPayload = computed(() =>
  filteredBlogs.value.map((post) => {
    const drift = blogsDriftById.value.get(post.id) ?? { missing: [], extra: [] }
    return {
      id: post.id,
      title: post.title,
      drift,
    }
  })
)

const blogsDriftCopyPayload = computed(() => ({
  modelPath: 'packages/extensions/fireux-blogs/src/runtime/models/blogPost.model.ts',
  driftKind: blogsDriftKind.value,
  selectedField: blogsSelectedField.value || null,
  totalBlogs: filteredBlogs.value.length,
  blogs: filteredBlogsDriftPayload.value,
}))

const updateBlogsSelectedField = (value: string) => {
  blogsSelectedField.value = value
}
</script>

### packages/extensions/fireux-companies/src/module.ts

```ts
import { addImportsDir, createResolver, defineNuxtModule } from '@nuxt/kit'
import type { Nuxt, NuxtModule } from '@nuxt/schema'
import {
    ensureRuntimeConfigBuckets,
    ensureRuntimeLayerFromPath,
    exposeRuntimeAlias,
} from 'fireux-core/config/module/runtime-layer'
import { configureComponents } from './config/module/components-config'
import { configureComposables } from './config/module/composables-config'
import { configureLayouts } from './config/module/layouts-config'
import { configureModels } from './config/module/models-config'
import { configurePages } from './config/module/pages-config'
import { configurePlugins } from './config/module/plugins-config'
import { configureRuntime } from './config/module/runtime-config'
import { configureServer } from './config/module/server-config'

export interface ModuleOptions {
  prefix?: string
}

const module: NuxtModule<ModuleOptions> = defineNuxtModule<ModuleOptions>({
  meta: {
    name: 'fireux-companies',
    version: '2.0.0',
    configKey: 'fireuxCompanies',
  },
  defaults: { prefix: 'Fire' },
  async setup(_options, nuxt) {
    const resolver = createResolver(import.meta.url)
    const runtimeDir = resolver.resolve('./runtime')

    ensureRuntimeConfigBuckets(nuxt, 'companies')
    configureRuntime(nuxt, 'companies')
    configurePlugins(resolver)
    configureComposables(resolver)

    addImportsDir(resolver.resolve('./runtime/composables'))

    configureComponents(resolver)
    configureLayouts(resolver, nuxt)
    configureModels(resolver)
    configurePages(resolver, nuxt)
    configureServer(resolver)

    exposeRuntimeAlias(nuxt, '#fireux-companies', runtimeDir)
    registerCompanyPages(nuxt, resolver, runtimeDir)

    nuxt.hook('ready', () => {
      console.log('fireux-companies: module configured')
    })
  },
})

export default module

function registerCompanyPages(nuxt: Nuxt, resolver: any, runtimeDir: string) {
  ensureRuntimeLayerFromPath(nuxt, runtimeDir)

  const pagesToInject = [
    {
      name: 'fireux-companies-index',
      path: '/companies',
      file: resolver.resolve('./runtime/pages/companies/index.vue'),
    },
    {
      name: 'fireux-companies-create',
      path: '/companies/create',
      file: resolver.resolve('./runtime/pages/companies/create.vue'),
    },
    {
      name: 'fireux-companies-edit',
      path: '/companies/edit/:id',
      file: resolver.resolve('./runtime/pages/companies/edit/[id].vue'),
    },
    {
      name: 'fireux-companies-learn-more',
      path: '/companies/learn-more',
      file: resolver.resolve('./runtime/pages/companies/learn-more.vue'),
    },
    {
      name: 'fireux-companies-id',
      path: '/companies/:id',
      file: resolver.resolve('./runtime/pages/companies/[id].vue'),
    },
    {
      name: 'dev-fireux-companies',
      path: '/dev/fireux-companies',
      file: resolver.resolve('./runtime/pages/dev/fireux-companies.vue'),
    },
  ]

  nuxt.hook('pages:extend', (pages: any[]) => {
    for (const entry of pagesToInject) {
      const exists = pages.some((page) => page.path === entry.path)
      if (!exists) pages.push(entry)
    }
  })
}

```

  showBadges?: boolean

  avatarUrl: '',
  prop: '',
  showSubtitle: true,
  showBadges: true,
  showTagline: true,

  card: null,
  avatar: null,
})

// Allow passing either structured props or a legacy `card` object.

const name = props.name || props.card?.name || ''
const website = props.website || props.card?.website || ''
const badges = props.badges.length ? props.badges : props.card?.badges || []

### packages/extensions/fireux-companies/src/runtime/components/organisms/Company/Create/System.vue

```vue
<template>
  <section class="space-y-4">
    <UCard :ui="{ body: 'space-y-4' }">
      <template #header>
        <div class="space-y-1">
          <div class="font-medium">Select a place</div>
          <div class="text-sm text-dimmed">
            We’ll use the existing company if it exists, or create the overlay if it doesn’t.
          </div>
        </div>
      </template>

      <PlaceSearchSection
        collection="companies"
        normalized-field="search_term_normalized"
        :local-fallback="true"
        :extra-collections="['places']"
        :allow-google="true"
        @confirmed="onPlaceConfirmed"
      />

      <div v-if="successId" class="text-sm text-green-600">
        Company created: {{ successId }}
      </div>
      <div v-else-if="existingId" class="space-y-2 text-sm text-amber-600">
        <div>Company already exists: {{ existingId }}</div>
        <UButton
          size="xs"
          variant="soft"
          color="neutral"
          :to="`/companies/${encodeURIComponent(existingId)}`"
        >
          Inspect company
        </UButton>
      </div>
      <div v-if="error" class="text-sm text-red-600">
        {{ error }}
      </div>
    </UCard>
  </section>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { doc, getDoc } from 'firebase/firestore'
import type { PlaceUpsertInput } from 'fireux-places/runtime/models/place.model'
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { useFirestore } from 'vuefire'
import { useCompanyCreate } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/company/mutations/useCompanyCreate'
import { useCompanyUpdate } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/company/mutations/useCompanyUpdate'

const { createCompany } = useCompanyCreate()
const { updateCompany } = useCompanyUpdate()
const db = useFirestore()

const error = ref<string | null>(null)
const successId = ref<string | null>(null)
const existingId = ref<string | null>(null)

const normalizeSearchTerm = (value: string) =>
  value
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .toLowerCase()
    .trim()

async function onPlaceConfirmed(payload: { placeId: string; place: PlaceUpsertInput }) {
  error.value = null
  successId.value = null
  existingId.value = null

  try {
    const id = payload.placeId
    const place = payload.place

    const existingSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'companies', id))
    if (existingSnap.exists()) {
      existingId.value = id
      const existing = existingSnap.data() as Record<string, any>
      const searchTerm = `${place.name} ${place.formatted_address ?? ''}`
        .toLowerCase()
        .trim()
      const searchTermNormalized = normalizeSearchTerm(searchTerm)
      if (!existing.search_term || !existing.search_term_normalized) {
        await updateCompany(id, {
          search_term: existing.search_term || searchTerm,
          search_term_normalized: existing.search_term_normalized || searchTermNormalized,
        } as any)
      }
      return
    }

    const createdId = await createCompany({
      id,
      place,
      name: place.name,
      formatted_address: place.formatted_address ?? '',
      lat: place.lat ?? 0,
      lng: place.lng ?? 0,
      place_image: place.place_image ?? '',
      website: '',
      search_term: `${place.name} ${place.formatted_address ?? ''}`
        .toLowerCase()
        .trim(),
      search_term_normalized: normalizeSearchTerm(
        `${place.name} ${place.formatted_address ?? ''}`
      ),
    })

    successId.value = createdId
  } catch (e) {
    error.value = e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Unable to create company'
  }
}
</script>

```

<template>
  <section class="space-y-3">

          />

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useToastify } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/app/ui/useToastify'
import { useImageStorage } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firebase/useImageStorage'
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import { useCompanyUpdate } from '../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/company/mutations/useCompanyUpdate'
import type { Company } from '../../../../models/company.model'

const props = defineProps<{ company: Company | null }>()
const company = computed(() => props.company)
const companyId = computed(() => company.value?.id ?? '')

const avatarInitials = computed(() => {
  const name = company.value?.name || 'C'
  const trimmed = name.trim()
  if (!trimmed) return 'C'
  return trimmed
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0]?.toUpperCase())
    .join('')
})

const avatarUploading = ref(false)
const { uploadImage } = useImageStorage()
const { updateCompany } = useCompanyUpdate()
const toast = useToastify()

const sanitize = (value: string) => value.trim()
const buildSearchTerm = (name?: string, address?: string) =>
  `${name ?? ''} ${address ?? ''}`.toLowerCase().trim()
const normalizeSearchTerm = (value: string) =>
  value
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .toLowerCase()
    .trim()

async function handleAvatarUpload(file: File) {
  if (!companyId.value) return
  avatarUploading.value = true
  try {
    const url = await uploadImage(`companies/${companyId.value}/avatar`, file)
    await updateCompany(companyId.value, { place_image: url } as any)
    toast.success('Image updated')
  } catch (error) {
    const msg = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Please try again.'
    toast.error(`Failed to update image: ${msg}`)
    throw error
  } finally {
    avatarUploading.value = false
  }
}

async function handleUpdateName(value: string) {
  if (!companyId.value) return
  try {
    const name = sanitize(value) || 'Untitled Company'
    const address = company.value?.formatted_address ?? ''
    const searchTerm = buildSearchTerm(name, address)
    await updateCompany(companyId.value, {
      name,
      search_term: searchTerm,
      search_term_normalized: normalizeSearchTerm(searchTerm),
    })
    toast.success('Name updated')
  } catch (error) {
    const msg = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Please try again.'
    toast.error(`Failed to update name: ${msg}`)
    throw error
  }
}

async function handleUpdateWebsite(value: string) {
  if (!companyId.value) return
  try {
    await updateCompany(companyId.value, { website: sanitize(value) })
    toast.success('Website updated')
  } catch (error) {
    const msg = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Please try again.'
    toast.error(`Failed to update website: ${msg}`)
    throw error
  }
}

async function handleUpdateAddress(value: string) {
  if (!companyId.value) return
  try {
    const address = sanitize(value)
    const name = company.value?.name ?? ''
    const searchTerm = buildSearchTerm(name, address)
    await updateCompany(companyId.value, {
      formatted_address: address,
      search_term: searchTerm,
      search_term_normalized: normalizeSearchTerm(searchTerm),
    } as any)
    toast.success('Address updated')
  } catch (error) {
    const msg = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Please try again.'
    toast.error(`Failed to update address: ${msg}`)
    throw error
  }
}
</script>

### packages/extensions/fireux-companies/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/company/fetch/useCompanyCollection.ts

```ts
import { useFirestoreManager } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreManager'
import type { Ref, ShallowRef } from 'vue'
import { computed, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue'

export function useCompanyCollection<
  T extends Record<string, any> = Record<string, any>,
>(collectionPath = 'companies') {
  const { firestoreFetchCollection } = useFirestoreManager()

  const path = computed(() => collectionPath)

  const collectionRef = shallowRef(null) as ShallowRef<
    Ref<T[] | undefined> | null
  >
  watch(
    path,
    (nextPath: string) => {
      collectionRef.value = firestoreFetchCollection<T>(nextPath)
    },
    { immediate: true }
  )

  const collection = computed(() => collectionRef.value?.value)
  const count = computed(() => (collection.value ?? []).length)

  return { collectionPath: path, collection, count }
}
```

```ts
import { useFirestoreRead } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreRead'
import { computed } from 'vue'
import type { Company } from '../../../../../../models/company.model'

const COLLECTION_PATH = 'companies'

/**
 * Canon fetch helpers for Company (collection + single doc).
 * Canon: overlay collection `companies/{placeId}`.
 */
export function useCompanyFetch() {
  const { firestoreFetchCollection, firestoreFetchDoc } = useFirestoreRead()

  const source = firestoreFetchCollection<Company>(COLLECTION_PATH)
  const companies = computed(() => source.value ?? [])

  const company = (id: string) => firestoreFetchDoc<Company>(COLLECTION_PATH, id)

  return {
    companies,
    company,
  }
}

import { useFirestoreCreate } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreCreate'
import type { PlaceUpsertInput } from 'fireux-places/runtime/models/place.model'
import type { Company, CompanyCreateInput } from '../../../../../../models/company.model'

export const CompanyPayload = {
  id: '',
  name: '',
  formatted_address: '',
  lat: 0,
  lng: 0,
  place_image: '',
  website: '',
}

export const CompanyStampOptions = {
  creator: true,
} as const

export function useCompanyCreate() {
  const { setDocument } = useFirestoreCreate()

  async function createCompany(
    input: CompanyCreateInput & { place?: PlaceUpsertInput }
  ): Promise<string> {
    if (!input?.id) {
      throw new Error('Company id is required')
    }

    const { place, ...payload } = input
    void place

    await setDocument<Company>('companies', payload.id, payload as Company, {
      creator: true,
    })

    return payload.id
  }

  return { createCompany }
}

### packages/extensions/fireux-companies/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/company/mutations/useCompanyUpdate.ts

```ts
import { useFirestoreManager } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreManager'
import type { Company, CompanyUpdateInput } from '../../../../../../models/company.model'

const COLLECTION_PATH = 'companies'

export function useCompanyUpdate() {
  const { updateDocument } = useFirestoreManager()

  const updateCompany = async (companyId: string, patch: CompanyUpdateInput) => {
    const id = String(companyId ?? '').trim()
    if (!id) throw new Error('[useCompanyUpdate] companyId is required')

    const next: CompanyUpdateInput = { ...patch }
    if (typeof next.name === 'string') next.name = next.name.trim()
    if (typeof next.website === 'string') next.website = next.website.trim()
    if (typeof (next as any).place_image === 'string') (next as any).place_image = (next as any).place_image.trim()
    if (typeof (next as any).formatted_address === 'string') (next as any).formatted_address = (next as any).formatted_address.trim()

    await updateDocument<Company>(COLLECTION_PATH, id, next)
  }

  return { updateCompany }
}

```

}

>(options: UseCompaniesOptions = {}) {

```ts
import type { Company } from '../../../../../../../models/company.model'

export namespace CompanyCard {
  export type Card = {
    id: string
    to: string

    // Media (empty string means unset)
    avatarUrl: string

    // Primary display fields
    title: string
    subtitle: string

    name: string
    website: string

    // Status/label chips
    badges: string[]
  }
}

export function useCompanyInterface() {
  function map(company: Company): CompanyCard.Card {
    return {
      id: company.id,
      to: `/companies/${company.id}`,

      avatarUrl: company.place_image,
      title: company.name,
      subtitle: company.website,

      name: company.name,
      website: company.website,

      badges: [],
    }
  }

  function card(target?: Company | null | undefined): CompanyCard.Card | null {
    return target ? map(target) : null
  }

  function searchText(company: Company): string {
    return `${company.name} ${company.website} ${company.id}`.toLowerCase()
  }

  return { card, searchText }
}

```ts
// FILE: packages/extensions/fireux-companies/src/runtime/models/company.model.ts

import type { FireuxStamped } from 'fireux-core/runtime/models/core/meta.model'
import type { FirebaseTimestamp } from 'fireux-core/types/firebase'

/**
 * Company overlay (Place-bound)
 * Firestore: companies/{placeId}
 * - Document ID is the canonical Place ID.
 * - This is an overlay on top of an existing Place.
 *
 * Canon strategy:
 * - Runtime object is the single source of truth
 * - TypeScript derives types from it
 * - Drift is detected by comparing data ↔ model shape
 */

// 🔑 Runtime + canonical shape (source of truth)
export const Company = {
  /** Canonical Place ID (also the Firestore document ID). */
  id: '',

  name: '',
  formatted_address: '',

  /** Canonical location snapshot */
  lat: 0,
  lng: 0,
  place_image: '',

  /** Search helpers */
  search_term: '',
  search_term_normalized: '',

  /** Optional company-specific details (empty string means unset) */
  website: '',

  // Authored (FireuxStamped)
  creator_id: undefined as FireuxStamped['creator_id'],
  created_at: {} as FirebaseTimestamp,
  updated_at: {} as FirebaseTimestamp,
} as const

export type Company = {
  [K in keyof typeof Company]: (typeof Company)[K]
}

export type CompanyCreateInput = Omit<Company, 'created_at' | 'updated_at' | 'creator_id'>
export type CompanyUpdateInput = Partial<Omit<CompanyCreateInput, 'id'>>

          />
        </template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useHead, useRoute } from '#imports'
import LayoutsConsoleProfileEdit from 'fireux-core/runtime/components/layouts/console/ProfileEdit.vue'
import { useFireUXConfig } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/app/FireUXConfig'
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { useCompanyFetch } from '../../../composables/fireux/firestore/company/fetch/useCompanyFetch'
import type { Company } from '../../../models/company.model'

definePageMeta({
  layout: 'default',
  title: 'Edit Company',
  description: 'Edit a saved company.',
  head: { title: 'Edit Company' },
  name: 'CompaniesEditPage',
})

const { appName } = useFireUXConfig()
useHead({ title: `${appName} | Edit Company` })

const route = useRoute()
const raw = route.params.id
const companyId = Array.isArray(raw) ? String(raw[0] ?? '') : String(raw ?? '')

const { company: fetchCompany } = useCompanyFetch()
const docRef = companyId ? fetchCompany(companyId) : null

const company = computed<Company | null>(() => docRef?.value ?? null)
const loading = computed(() => Boolean(companyId) && docRef?.value === undefined)
const pageTitle = computed(() => company.value?.name || 'Edit company')
const pageSubtitle = computed(() =>
  companyId ? `Company: ${companyId}` : 'Edit a company'
)
</script>

### packages/extensions/fireux-companies/src/runtime/pages/companies/index.vue

```vue
<template>
  <UPage>
    <UPageHeader :title="pageTitle" :description="pageDescription" />

    <UPageBody class="pagebody">
      <CompanyCTA />
      <CompanyCollectionManager :collection="collection" />
    </UPageBody>
  </UPage>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useHead } from '#imports'
import { useFireUXConfig } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/app/FireUXConfig'
import { usePlaces } from 'fireux-places/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/place/usePlaces'
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { useCompanyFetch } from '../../composables/fireux/firestore/company/fetch/useCompanyFetch'

definePageMeta({
  layout: 'default',
  title: 'Companies',
  description: 'Company overlays resolved for this runtime.',
  nav: {
    key: 'companies',
    label: 'Companies',
    icon: 'i-lucide-building-2',
    order: 55,
    desktop: true,
    mobile: true,
    layouts: ['default'],
  },
  name: 'CompaniesIndexPage',
})

const pageTitle = 'Companies'
const pageDescription =
  'Create a company and browse all companies available to this runtime.'

const { appName } = useFireUXConfig()
useHead({ title: `${appName} | ${pageTitle}` })

const { companies } = useCompanyFetch()
const { collection: placesCollection } = usePlaces<Record<string, any>>()

const placesById = computed(() => {
  const map = new Map<string, Record<string, any>>()
  for (const place of placesCollection.value ?? []) {
    if (place?.id) map.set(String(place.id), place)
  }
  return map
})

const mergedCompanies = computed(() =>
  (companies.value ?? []).map((company) => {
    const place = placesById.value.get(String(company.id))
    if (!place) return company
    const name = company.name || place.name || ''
    const formattedAddress = company.formatted_address || place.formatted_address || ''
    const searchTerm = company.search_term || `${name} ${formattedAddress}`.toLowerCase().trim()
    const searchTermNormalized =
      company.search_term_normalized || searchTerm
        .normalize('NFD')
        .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
        .toLowerCase()
        .trim()
    return {
      ...place,
      ...company,
      id: company.id,
      name,
      formatted_address: formattedAddress,
      lat: Number.isFinite(company.lat)
        ? company.lat
        : Number.isFinite(place.lat)
          ? place.lat
          : 0,
      lng: Number.isFinite(company.lng)
        ? company.lng
        : Number.isFinite(place.lng)
          ? place.lng
          : 0,
      place_image: company.place_image || place.place_image || '',
      website: company.website || '',
      search_term: searchTerm,
      search_term_normalized: searchTermNormalized,
    }
  })
)

const collection = computed(() => mergedCompanies.value)

</script>

```

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDevDriftFilter } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/dev/useDevDriftFilter'
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { useCompanyFetch } from '../../composables/fireux/firestore/company/fetch/useCompanyFetch'
import { Company as CompanyModelRuntime } from '../../models/company.model'

definePageMeta({
  layout: 'dev',
  nav: {
    key: 'dev-ext-companies',
    label: 'Companies (Ext)',
    icon: 'i-lucide-building-2',
    desktop: true,
    group: 'ext',
    layouts: ['dev'],
  },
})

const companyModelRuntime = CompanyModelRuntime

const { companies } = useCompanyFetch()

const companiesCollection = computed(() => companies.value ?? [])

const {
  driftKind: companiesDriftKind,
  setDriftKind: setCompaniesDriftKind,
  selectedField: companiesSelectedField,
  driftById: companiesDriftById,
  filterOptions: companiesFilterOptions,
  filteredCollection: filteredCompanies,
} = useDevDriftFilter({
  collection: companiesCollection,
  runtimeModel: companyModelRuntime,
})

const allCompaniesJsonPayload = computed(() => ({
  totalCompanies: companiesCollection.value.length,
  companies: companiesCollection.value,
}))

const filteredCompaniesDriftPayload = computed(() =>
  filteredCompanies.value.map((company) => {
    const drift = companiesDriftById.value.get(company.id) ?? { missing: [], extra: [] }
    return {
      id: company.id,
      name: company.name,
      drift,
    }
  })
)

const companiesDriftCopyPayload = computed(() => ({
  modelPath: 'packages/extensions/fireux-companies/src/runtime/models/company.model.ts',
  driftKind: companiesDriftKind.value,
  selectedField: companiesSelectedField.value || null,
  totalCompanies: filteredCompanies.value.length,
  companies: filteredCompaniesDriftPayload.value,
}))

const updateCompaniesSelectedField = (value: string) => {
  companiesSelectedField.value = value
}
</script>

# Drop

Owned by fireux.

Describe what this module ships, its guardrails, and how consumers should enable it.

## Quick start

1. Enable in your Nuxt app:
   ```ts
   export default defineNuxtConfig({
     modules: ['fireux-drop'],
   })
   ```
2. Update `registry.json` before committing (name, team, runtime notes).
3. Publish to FireUX registry:
   ```bash
   pnpm registry:register packages/extensions/fireux-drop/registry.json
   ```

### packages/extensions/fireux-drop/src/module.ts

```ts
import { ensureRuntimeConfigBuckets, exposeRuntimeAlias } from 'fireux-core/config/module/runtime-layer'
import { addImportsDir, createResolver, defineNuxtModule } from 'nuxt/kit'
import type { } from 'nuxt/schema'

declare module 'nuxt/schema' {
  interface NuxtConfig { drop?: Partial<typeof defaults> }
  interface NuxtOptions { drop?: Partial<typeof defaults> }
}

const defaults = {
  enabled: true,
}

export default defineNuxtModule({
  meta: {
    name: 'fireux-drop',
    configKey: 'drop',
    compatibility: { nuxt: '^4.0.0' },
  },
  defaults,
  setup(_options, nuxt) {
    const resolver = createResolver(import.meta.url)

    // Ensure runtime config buckets exist
    ensureRuntimeConfigBuckets(nuxt as any, 'drop')

    // Auto-import runtime composables directory (create files as needed)
    addImportsDir(resolver.resolve('./runtime/composables'))

    // Example: expose runtime directory via alias for server routes/plugins
    exposeRuntimeAlias(nuxt as any, '#fireux-drop', resolver.resolve('./runtime'))
  },
})

```

import { createResolver, defineNuxtModule } from '@nuxt/kit'
import type { NuxtModule } from '@nuxt/schema'
import { configureComponents } from './config/module/components-config'
import { configureComposables } from './config/module/composables-config'
import { configureLayouts } from './config/module/layouts-config'
import { configurePages } from './config/module/pages-config'
import { configurePlugins } from './config/module/plugins-config'
import { configureRuntime } from './config/module/runtime-config'

export interface ModuleOptions {
  prefix?: string
}

const module: NuxtModule<ModuleOptions> = defineNuxtModule<ModuleOptions>({
  meta: {
    name: 'fireux-jobs',
    version: '1.0.0',
    configKey: 'fireuxJobs',
  },
  defaults: { prefix: 'Fire' },
  async setup(_options, nuxt) {
    const resolver = createResolver(import.meta.url)
    configureRuntime(nuxt, 'jobs')
    configurePlugins(resolver)
    configureComponents(resolver)
    configureComposables(resolver)
    configureLayouts(resolver, nuxt)
    configurePages(resolver, nuxt)
    // configureServer(resolver) // toggle as needed

    nuxt.hook('ready', () => {
      console.log('fireux-jobs: module configured')
    })
  },
})

export default module

```

```vue
<template>
  <div class="space-y-6">
    <!-- Agent can post jobs -->
    <UPageCTA
      v-if="hasAgentProfile"
      title="Post a job"
      :description="agentCtaDescription"
      variant="naked"
    >
      <template #default>
        <JobCreateSystem />

        <!-- DEV sanity output -->
        <pre
          v-if="showCheck"
          class="text-xs text-slate-500 whitespace-pre-wrap"
        >{{ JSON.stringify(check, null, 2) }}</pre>
      </template>
    </UPageCTA>

    <!-- Professional-only path -->
    <OrganismsProfilesProfessionalCTA v-else-if="hasProfessionalProfile" />

    <!-- No profiles yet -->
    <div v-else class="space-y-6">
      <OrganismsProfilesProfessionalCTA />
      <OrganismsProfilesAgentCTA />
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { useFireUXConfig } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/app/FireUXConfig'
import { useUser } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/useUser.ts'
import { useAgent } from '../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Agent/useAgent'

const { appName, ecosystem, isTenant } = useFireUXConfig()
const { hasProfile } = useUser()
const { coreProfile } = useAgent()

const hasAgentProfile = computed(() => hasProfile('agent'))
const hasProfessionalProfile = computed(() => hasProfile('professional'))

const agentCtaScopeLabel = computed(() => (isTenant ? appName : ecosystem))
const agentCtaDescription = computed(
  () => `Create a job posting to reach professionals across ${agentCtaScopeLabel.value}.`
)

const showCheck = import.meta.dev

/**
 * DEV sanity check (temporary)
 */
const check = computed(() => {
  if (!hasAgentProfile.value) {
    return { status: 'no-agent-profile' }
  }

  if (!coreProfile.value) {
    return { status: 'agent-profile-missing' }
  }

  const agent = coreProfile.value

  const missing: string[] = []

  if (!agent.title) missing.push('title')
  if (!agent.contact_email) missing.push('contact_email')
  if (!agent.website_url) missing.push('website_url')
  if (!agent.bio_short) missing.push('bio_short')

  return {
    status: missing.length ? 'incomplete' : 'ready',
    agentId: agent.id ?? null,
    missing,
  }
})
</script>
```

        <component
          :is="wrapperFor(card)"
          v-for="card in cards"
          :key="card.id"

import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import { useJobInterface } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/jobs/utils/view/useJobInterface';
import type { Job } from '../../../../../models/job.model';

const props = defineProps<{ collection?: Job[] }>()

const collection = computed(() => props.collection ?? [])
const { card: makeCard } = useJobInterface()
type JobCardShape = NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof makeCard>>
const cards = computed(() =>
  collection.value
    .map((job) => makeCard(job))
    .filter((c): c is NonNullable<typeof c> => Boolean(c))
)
const showDebug = import.meta.dev
const debugPayload = computed(() => ({
  totalJobs: collection.value.length,
  jobs: collection.value,
}))

type Variant = 'pill' | 'cell'
const variant = ref<Variant>('cell')
const toggleVariant = () => {
  variant.value = variant.value === 'pill' ? 'cell' : 'pill'
}

const wrapperFor = (card: JobCardShape) => (card.to ? 'NuxtLink' : 'div')
const wrapperPropsFor = (card: JobCardShape) => (card.to ? { to: card.to } : {})
</script>

### packages/extensions/fireux-jobs/src/runtime/components/organisms/Job/Create/System.vue

```vue
<template>
  <div class="space-y-3">
    <MoleculesCreateShell
      :loading="submitting"
      submit-label="Create"
      @clear="onReset"
      @submit="onSubmit"
    >
      <template #write>
        <JobCreateWrite v-model:form="form" />
      </template>

      <template #preview>
        <JobCreatePreview :form="form" />
      </template>
    </MoleculesCreateShell>

    <!-- DEV scaffold check (temporary) -->
    <pre
      v-if="showCheck"
      class="text-xs text-slate-500 whitespace-pre-wrap"
    >{{ JSON.stringify(check, null, 2) }}</pre>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import { useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { useJobCreate } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/jobs/mutations/useJobCreate.ts'

const router = useRouter()
const { form, reset, submit } = useJobCreate()

const submitting = ref(false)

function onReset() {
  reset()
}

async function onSubmit() {
  if (submitting.value) return
  submitting.value = true
  try {
    const id = await submit()
    reset()
    router.push(`/jobs/${id}`)
  } finally {
    submitting.value = false
  }
}

const showCheck = import.meta.dev
const check = computed(() => {
  const missing: string[] = []

  if (!String(form.value.title ?? '').trim()) missing.push('title')
  if (!String(form.value.description ?? '').trim()) missing.push('description')

  const desc = String(form.value.description ?? '')
  const hasTbd = /\bTBD\b/i.test(desc)
  if (hasTbd) missing.push('description: replace TBD sections')

  return {
    status: missing.length ? 'incomplete' : 'ready',
    missing,
    notCapturedYet: ['company/place/kitchen links', 'schedule fields', 'compensation fields'],
  }
})
</script>


```

    <template v-else>

          <UCard>
            <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
              <div class="space-y-1">
                <h3 class="font-semibold leading-tight">{{ job.title }}</h3>
                <p class="text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-400">
                  {{ job.app_id || 'App unknown' }}
                </p>
              </div>
              <div class="flex flex-col items-end gap-2">
                <UBadge
                  size="xs"
                  :color="badgeColor(job.status)"
                  variant="soft"
                >
                  {{ job.status || 'open' }}
                </UBadge>
                <UButton
                  variant="ghost"
                  icon="i-lucide-arrow-right"
                  :to="`/jobs/${job.id}`"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </UCard>
        </li>
      </ul>

      <p v-else class="text-sm opacity-70">
        You have not created any jobs yet.
      </p>

  </UCard>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { useJobCollection } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/jobs/fetch/useJobCollection.ts'
import { useUser } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/useUser'
import { useAuth } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firebase/useAuth'
import type { Job } from '../../../../../models/job.model'

const { jobs: allJobs, pending: isPending } = useJobCollection()
const { coreUser } = useUser()
const { uid: authUid } = useAuth()

const jobs = computed<Job[]>(() => {
  const ownerId = coreUser.value?.id ?? authUid.value ?? null
  if (!ownerId) return []
  return (allJobs.value ?? []).filter((job) => job.created_by === ownerId)
})

const pending = computed<boolean>(() => isPending.value)
const total = computed(() => jobs.value.length)

const badgeColor = (status?: Job['status']) => {
  if (status === 'open') return 'success'
  return 'neutral'
}
</script>

    description="Add an agent profile to your FireUX portfolio so talent knows who is hiring."
    variant="naked"
  >
    <template #default>
      <div v-if="!hasAgentProfile" class="space-y-2">
        <OrganismsProfilesAgentCreateSystem />
      </div>

      <div v-else-if="!profileCard" class="space-y-2">
        <OrganismsProfilesAgentCreateSystem />
      </div>

      <div v-else class="space-y-4">
        <div class="flex justify-end">
          <UButton v-if="canToggle" size="xs" variant="ghost" @click="toggleView">
            {{ view === 'preview' ? 'Profile' : 'Preview' }}
          </UButton>
        </div>

        <div class="space-y-4">
          <OrganismsProfilesAgentCardsPreview
            v-if="view === 'preview' && profileCard"
            :card="profileCard"
          />
          <OrganismsProfilesAgentCardsProfile
            v-else-if="profileCard"
            :card="profileCard"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      <pre v-if="showDebug" class="text-xs text-muted">{{ debugPayload }}</pre>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAuth } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firebase/useAuth.ts'
import { useUser } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/useUser.ts'
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue'
import { useAgent } from '../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Agent/useAgent.ts'

const { coreProfile, card } = useAgent()
const { uid } = useAuth()
const { user, coreUser, hasProfile } = useUser()

const hasAgentProfile = computed(() => hasProfile('agent'))

const profileCard = computed(() => (coreProfile.value ? card(coreProfile.value) : null))

const canToggle = computed(() => Boolean(profileCard.value))
type View = 'preview' | 'profile'
const view = ref<View>('preview')

const toggleView = () => {
  if (!canToggle.value) return
  view.value = view.value === 'preview' ? 'profile' : 'preview'
}

watch(canToggle, (enabled: boolean) => {
  if (!enabled) view.value = 'preview'
})

const showDebug = import.meta.dev
const debugPayload = computed(() => {
  return {
    authUid: uid.value ?? null,
    userId: user.value?.id ?? null,
    profiles: coreUser.value?.profiles ?? null,
    hasAgentProfile: hasAgentProfile.value,
    hasProfileCard: Boolean(profileCard.value),
    view: view.value,
  }
})
</script>

<template>
  <UCard class="section">
    <template #header>
      <div class="section__header">
        <div class="section__copy">
          <h2 class="text-base font-semibold">Agents</h2>
          <p class="text-xs text-gray-500">Browse agents available to this runtime.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
          <UInput v-model="query" size="xs" placeholder="Search agents…" class="w-44" />

          <UButton size="xs" variant="ghost" @click="toggleVariant">
            {{ variant === 'pill' ? 'Cells' : 'Pills' }}
          </UButton>

          <UBadge variant="soft">{{ visibleCount }} / {{ totalCount }}</UBadge>
        </div>
      </div>
    </template>

    <OrganismsProfilesAgentCollectionList
      v-if="cardsFiltered.length"
      :cards="cardsFiltered"
      :variant="variant"
    />

    <p v-else class="section__empty">No agents found.</p>

    <div v-if="showDebug" class="pt-3">
      <DevJson
        :title="'Agents (JSON)'"
        :data="debugPayload"
        :default-open="false"
      />
    </div>
  </UCard>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useCollectionSearch } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/shared/useCollectionSearch';
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { useAgentsInterface, type AgentDirectoryEntry } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Agent/utils/view/useAgentsInterface';

const props = defineProps<{ collection?: AgentDirectoryEntry[] }>()

const collection = computed(() => props.collection ?? [])
const { card: makeCard, searchText } = useAgentsInterface()
const { query, variant, toggleVariant, cards: cardsFiltered, visibleCount } =
  useCollectionSearch<AgentDirectoryEntry, ReturnType<typeof makeCard>>({
    items: collection,
    searchText: (entry) => searchText(entry),
    makeCard: (entry) => makeCard(entry),
  })

const totalCount = computed(() => collection.value.length)
const showDebug = import.meta.dev
const debugPayload = computed(() => ({
  totalAgents: collection.value.length,
  agents: collection.value,
}))
</script>

<template>
  <div class="agent-create-container">
    <UCard class="agent-create-card">
      <template #header>
        <div class="create-header">
          <h2 class="create-title">Create Agent Profile</h2>
          <p class="create-description">
            Set up your company profile to start posting jobs and connecting
            with professionals
          </p>
        </div>
      </template>

      <div class="create-content">
        <div class="user-info-section">
          <h3 class="section-title">Your Information</h3>
          <div class="user-details" v-if="appUser">
            <div class="user-field">
              <span class="field-label">Name:</span>
              <span class="field-value">{{ accountDisplayName }}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="form-section">
          <h3 class="section-title">Agency Information</h3>
          <form @submit.prevent="onCreateAgent" class="create-form">
            <div class="form-grid">
              <div class="form-group full-width">
                <p class="form-label">
                  Agency Name <span class="form-required">*</span>
                </p>
                <UInput
                  v-model="formData.companyName"
                  placeholder="Enter your agency name"
                  required
                />
              </div>

              <div class="form-group">
                <p class="form-label">Contact Email</p>
                <UInput
                  v-model="formData.contactEmail"
                  type="email"
                  placeholder="Company contact email"
                />
              </div>

              <div class="form-group">
                <p class="form-label">Website</p>
                <UInput
                  v-model="formData.website"
                  placeholder="yourcompany.com"
                />
              </div>

              <div class="form-group full-width">
                <p class="form-label">Agency Description</p>
                <UTextarea
                  v-model="formData.description"
                  placeholder="Tell us about your agency..."
                  :rows="4"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="form-actions">
              <UButton
                type="submit"
                :loading="isSubmitting"
                :disabled="!isFormValid || isSubmitting"
                size="lg"
                color="primary"
                class="create-button"
              >
                Create Agent Profile
              </UButton>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      </div>
    </UCard>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed, onMounted, type Ref } from 'vue'
import { useAuth } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firebase/useAuth'
import { useAgent } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Agent/useAgent'

type AccountUser = {
  full_name?: string | null
  displayName?: string | null
  handle?: string | null
  uid?: string | null
  id?: string | null
  email?: string | null
}

// Get current user data
const { currentUser } = useAuth()
const appUser = currentUser as Ref<AccountUser | null | undefined>

const accountDisplayName = computed(() => {
  const user = appUser.value
  if (!user) return 'Your account'

  return (
    user.full_name ||
    user.displayName ||
    user.handle ||
    user.uid ||
    user.id ||
    'Your account'
  )
})

// Initialize agent composable helpers
const { createAgent } = useAgent()

// Form state
const formData = ref({
  companyName: '',
  contactEmail: '',
  website: '',
  description: '',
})

// Form validation
const isFormValid = computed(() => {
  return formData.value.companyName.trim()
})

const isSubmitting = ref(false)

async function onCreateAgent() {
  if (!isFormValid.value || isSubmitting.value) return

  try {
    isSubmitting.value = true
    await createAgent()

    // Success feedback
    console.log('Agent profile created successfully!')

    // The page should automatically refresh to show the new profile
    // thanks to the reactivity in the parent component
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Failed to create agent profile:', err)
    // You might want to show a toast or error message here
  } finally {
    isSubmitting.value = false
  }
}

// Initialize form with user data
onMounted(() => {
  if (appUser.value) {
    formData.value.contactEmail = appUser.value.email || ''
  }
})
</script>

}

  margin: 0;
}

  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-6);

    </section>
  </ClientOnly>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import { useAgent } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Agent/useAgent.ts'

const { coreProfile, pending, card } = useAgent()

const previewCard = computed(() => (coreProfile.value ? card(coreProfile.value) : null))
const isLoading = computed(() => Boolean(pending.value))
const hasPreview = computed(() => Boolean(previewCard.value))

const canToggle = computed(() => Boolean(previewCard.value))
const showCellView = ref(false)
const showCellCard = computed(() => canToggle.value && showCellView.value)

const toggleView = () => {
  if (!canToggle.value) return
  showCellView.value = !showCellView.value
}

const wrapperFor = (card: ReturnType<typeof card> | null) => (card?.to ? 'NuxtLink' : 'div')
const wrapperPropsFor = (card: ReturnType<typeof card> | null) => (card?.to ? { to: card.to } : {})
</script>

### packages/extensions/fireux-jobs/src/runtime/components/organisms/profiles/Professional/CTA.vue

```vue
<template>
  <UPageCTA
    title="Professional profile"
    description="Add a professional profile to your FireUX portfolio so agents can discover you more easily."
    variant="naked"
  >
    <template #default>
      <div v-if="!hasProfessionalProfile" class="space-y-2">
        <OrganismsProfilesProfessionalCreateSystem />
      </div>

      <div v-else-if="!profileCard" class="space-y-2">
        <OrganismsProfilesProfessionalCreateSystem />
      </div>

      <div v-else class="space-y-4">
        <div class="flex justify-end">
          <UButton v-if="canToggle" size="xs" variant="ghost" @click="toggleView">
            {{ view === 'preview' ? 'Profile' : 'Preview' }}
          </UButton>
        </div>

        <div class="space-y-4">
          <OrganismsProfilesProfessionalCardsPreview
            v-if="view === 'preview' && profileCard"
            :card="profileCard"
          />
          <OrganismsProfilesProfessionalCardsProfile
            v-else-if="profileCard"
            :card="profileCard"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      <pre v-if="showDebug" class="text-xs text-muted">{{ debugPayload }}</pre>
    </template>
  </UPageCTA>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAuth } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firebase/useAuth.ts'
import { useUser } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/useUser'
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue'
import { useProfessional } from '../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Professional/useProfessional'

const { coreProfile, card } = useProfessional()
const { uid } = useAuth()
const { user, coreUser, hasProfile } = useUser()

const hasProfessionalProfile = computed(() => hasProfile('professional'))

const profileCard = computed(() =>
  coreProfile.value ? card(coreProfile.value) : null
)

const canToggle = computed(() => Boolean(profileCard.value))
type View = 'preview' | 'profile'
const view = ref<View>('preview')
const toggleView = () => {
  if (!canToggle.value) return
  view.value = view.value === 'preview' ? 'profile' : 'preview'
}

watch(canToggle, (enabled: boolean) => {
  if (!enabled) view.value = 'preview'
})

const showDebug = import.meta.dev
const debugPayload = computed(() => {
  return {
    authUid: uid.value ?? null,
    userId: user.value?.id ?? null,
    profiles: coreUser.value?.profiles ?? null,
    hasProfessionalProfile: hasProfessionalProfile.value,
    hasProfileCard: Boolean(profileCard.value),
    view: view.value,
  }
})
</script>

<template>
  <UCard class="section">
    <template #header>
      <div class="section__header">
        <div class="section__copy">
          <h2 class="text-base font-semibold">Professionals</h2>
          <p class="text-xs text-gray-500">Browse professionals available to this runtime.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
          <UInput v-model="query" size="xs" placeholder="Search professionals…" class="w-44" />

          <UButton size="xs" variant="ghost" @click="toggleVariant">
            {{ variant === 'pill' ? 'Cells' : 'Pills' }}
          </UButton>

          <UBadge variant="soft">{{ visibleCount }} / {{ totalCount }}</UBadge>
        </div>
      </div>
    </template>

    <OrganismsProfilesProfessionalCollectionList
      v-if="cardsFiltered.length"
      :cards="cardsFiltered"
      :variant="variant"
    />

    <p v-else class="section__empty">No professionals found.</p>

    <div v-if="showDebug" class="pt-3">
      <DevJson
        :title="'Professionals (JSON)'"
        :data="debugPayload"
        :default-open="false"
      />
    </div>
  </UCard>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useCollectionSearch } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/shared/useCollectionSearch';
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { useProfessional } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Professional/useProfessional';
import type { ProfessionalCore } from '../../../../../models/profiles/Professional/Professional.model';

type ProfessionalEntry = ProfessionalCore & { user?: unknown }

const props = defineProps<{ collection?: ProfessionalEntry[] }>()

const collection = computed(() => props.collection ?? [])
const { card: makeCard } = useProfessional()
const searchTextFor = (entry: ProfessionalEntry) => {
  const displayName = (entry as any)?.user?.display_name ?? ''
  const title = (entry as any)?.title ?? ''
  const tagline = (entry as any)?.tagline ?? ''
  return `${displayName} ${title} ${tagline} ${entry.id ?? ''}`
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
}
const { query, variant, toggleVariant, cards: cardsFiltered, visibleCount } =
  useCollectionSearch<ProfessionalEntry, ReturnType<typeof makeCard>>({
    items: collection,
    searchText: (entry) => searchTextFor(entry),
    makeCard: (entry) => makeCard(entry as ProfessionalCore, (entry as any)?.user ?? null),
  })

const totalCount = computed(() => collection.value.length)
const showDebug = import.meta.dev
const debugPayload = computed(() => ({
  totalProfessionals: collection.value.length,
  professionals: collection.value,
}))
</script>

```vue
<template>
  <section class="professional-create-system">
    <UCard class="create-card">
      <template #header>
        <div class="header">
          <div>
            <p class="eyebrow">Professional profile</p>
            <h2>Create your showcase</h2>
          </div>
          <p class="lede">
            Launch a discoverable profile with your experience, credentials, and
            specialties. You can edit the details right after creating it.
          </p>
        </div>
      </template>

      <div class="body">
        <ul class="benefits">
          <li>
            <UIcon name="i-lucide-badge-check" />
            <span>Verified listing used across FireUX apps</span>
          </li>
          <li>
            <UIcon name="i-lucide-briefcase" />
            <span>Attach curated experience, certifications, and projects</span>
          </li>
          <li>
            <UIcon name="i-lucide-sparkles" />
            <span>Unlock invites from agents and chefs in the marketplace</span>
          </li>
        </ul>

        <div class="actions">
          <UButton
            color="primary"
            size="lg"
            class="create-button"
            :loading="isCreating"
            :disabled="isCreating"
            @click="handleCreate"
          >
            {{
              isCreating ? 'Creating profile…' : 'Create professional profile'
            }}
          </UButton>
          <p v-if="errorMessage" class="error">{{ errorMessage }}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </UCard>
  </section>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { useProfessionalCreate } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Professional/main/useProfessionalCreate'

const props = defineProps<{ create?: () => Promise<unknown> }>()

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'created', payload: unknown): void
  (e: 'error', error: unknown): void
}>()

const { createProfessional } = useProfessionalCreate()

const isCreating = ref(false)
const errorMessage = ref<string | null>(null)

const handleCreate = async () => {
  if (isCreating.value) return

  const create = props.create ?? createProfessional
  isCreating.value = true
  errorMessage.value = null

  try {
    const result = await create()
    emit('created', result)
  } catch (error) {
    const message =
      error instanceof Error
        ? error.message
        : 'Unable to create a professional profile right now.'
    errorMessage.value = message
    emit('error', error)
  } finally {
    isCreating.value = false
  }
}
</script>

### packages/extensions/fireux-jobs/src/runtime/components/organisms/profiles/Professional/Edit/Core.vue

```vue
<template>
  <ClientOnly>
    <div v-if="professional" class="space-y-6">
      <UCard>
        <MoleculesFormsFirestoreSimpleField
          label="Tagline"
          :firebase-value="tagline"
          placeholder="Ex: Private chef, pastry specialist"
          :update-function="onUpdateTagline"
        />

        <MoleculesFormsFirestoreSimpleField
          label="Short Bio"
          type="textarea"
          :rows="3"
          :maxlength="200"
          :firebase-value="bioShort"
          placeholder="Share a quick intro for listings"
          :update-function="onUpdateBioShort"
        />
      </UCard>

      <OrganismsProfilesProfessionalFieldsExperienceSection
        label="Relevant Experience"
        :items="professional.relevant_experience || []"
        :onSave="onSaveRelevantExperience"
      />

      <OrganismsProfilesProfessionalFieldsExperienceSection
        label="Other Experience"
        :items="professional.other_experience || []"
        :onSave="onSaveOtherExperience"
      />
    </div>

    <MoleculesStateCard
      v-else
      entity="professional profile"
      kind="document"
      loading
    />
  </ClientOnly>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { useProfessionalUpdate } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Professional/main/useProfessionalUpdate.ts'
import type {
  ProfessionalCoreProfile,
  RelevantExperienceItem,
  OtherExperienceItem,
} from '../../../../../models/profiles/Professional/Professional.model.ts'

const props = defineProps<{
  professional: ProfessionalCoreProfile | null
}>()

const {
  setRelevantExperience,
  setOtherExperience,
  updateTagline,
  updateBioShort,
} = useProfessionalUpdate()

const useToastFn = (globalThis as any).useToast as undefined | (() => any)
const toast = useToastFn ? useToastFn() : undefined

const tagline = computed(
  () =>
    props.professional?.tagline ??
    (props.professional as { subtitle?: string | null } | null)?.subtitle ??
    ''
)

const bioShort = computed(() => props.professional?.bio_short ?? '')

const onUpdateTagline = async (value: string) => {
  try {
    await updateTagline(value, { id: props.professional?.id ?? null })
    toast?.add({
      title: 'Tagline updated',
      icon: 'i-heroicons-check-circle',
    })
  } catch (error) {
    const description =
      error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Please try again.'
    toast?.add({
      title: 'Failed to update tagline',
      description,
      color: 'amber',
      icon: 'i-heroicons-exclamation-triangle',
    })
    throw error
  }
}

const onUpdateBioShort = async (value: string) => {
  try {
    await updateBioShort(value, { id: props.professional?.id ?? null })
    toast?.add({
      title: 'Short bio updated',
      icon: 'i-heroicons-check-circle',
    })
  } catch (error) {
    const description =
      error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Please try again.'
    toast?.add({
      title: 'Failed to update short bio',
      description,
      color: 'amber',
      icon: 'i-heroicons-exclamation-triangle',
    })
    throw error
  }
}

const onSaveRelevantExperience = async (items: RelevantExperienceItem[]) => {
  try {
    await setRelevantExperience(items, { id: props.professional?.id ?? null })
    toast?.add({
      title: 'Relevant experience updated',
      icon: 'i-heroicons-check-circle',
    })
  } catch (error) {
    const description =
      error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Please try again.'
    toast?.add({
      title: 'Failed to update experience',
      description,
      color: 'amber',
      icon: 'i-heroicons-exclamation-triangle',
    })
    throw error
  }
}

const onSaveOtherExperience = async (items: OtherExperienceItem[]) => {
  try {
    await setOtherExperience(items, { id: props.professional?.id ?? null })
    toast?.add({
      title: 'Other experience updated',
      icon: 'i-heroicons-check-circle',
    })
  } catch (error) {
    const description =
      error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Please try again.'
    toast?.add({
      title: 'Failed to update experience',
      description,
      color: 'amber',
      icon: 'i-heroicons-exclamation-triangle',
    })
    throw error
  }
}
</script>

const previewCard = computed(() => (coreProfile.value ? card(coreProfile.value) : null))
const isLoading = computed(() => Boolean(pending.value))
const hasPreview = computed(() => Boolean(previewCard.value))

const canToggle = computed(() => Boolean(previewCard.value))
const showCellView = ref(false)
const showCellCard = computed(() => canToggle.value && showCellView.value)

const toggleView = () => {
  if (!canToggle.value) return
  showCellView.value = !showCellView.value
}

const wrapperFor = (card: ReturnType<typeof card> | null) => (card?.to ? 'NuxtLink' : 'div')
const wrapperPropsFor = (card: ReturnType<typeof card> | null) => (card?.to ? { to: card.to } : {})
</script>

import type { RouteLink } from './useJobRoutes'

// Console-only job profile routes (no public discovery links)

export function getJobConsoleRoutes(
  hasProfile: (profileType: string) => boolean
) {
  const jobProfileRoutes: RouteLink[] = []

  if (hasProfile('agent')) {
    jobProfileRoutes.push({
      id: 'agent-profile',
      label: 'Agent Profile',
      icon: 'i-lucide-building-2',
      to: '/console/agent/profile',
    })
  }

  if (hasProfile('professional')) {
    jobProfileRoutes.push({
      id: 'professional-profile',
      label: 'Professional Profile',
      icon: 'i-lucide-users',
      to: '/console/professional/profile',
    })
  }

  return {
    // Sidebar/mobile within console should only show profile editors
    jobProfileRoutes,
    jobMobileRoutes: jobProfileRoutes,
  }
}
