```ts
// Export for public job routes
// Local RouteLink type to avoid cross-package deep imports
export interface RouteLink {
  id: string
  label: string
  icon?: string
  to?: string
  children?: RouteLink[]
}

export function getJobRoutes(hasProfile: (profileType: string) => boolean) {
  const jobRoutes: RouteLink[] = [
    {
      id: 'jobs',
      label: 'Jobs',
      icon: 'i-lucide-briefcase',
      to: '/jobs',
    },
    {
      id: 'agents',
      label: 'Agents',
      icon: 'i-lucide-building-2',
      to: '/agents',
    },
    {
      id: 'professionals',
      label: 'Professionals',
      icon: 'i-lucide-users',
      to: '/professionals',
    },
  ]

  const jobProfileRoutes: RouteLink[] = []

  // Do not conditionally hide public routes; UI handles active state/UX.
  const jobMobileRoutes = jobRoutes

  if (hasProfile('agent')) {
    jobProfileRoutes.push({
      id: 'agent-profile',
      label: 'Agent Profile',
      icon: 'i-lucide-building-2',
      to: '/console/agent/profile',
    })
  }

  if (hasProfile('professional')) {
    jobProfileRoutes.push({
      id: 'professional-profile',
      label: 'Professional Profile',
      icon: 'i-lucide-users',
      to: '/console/professional/profile',
    })
  }

  return {
    jobRoutes: jobRoutes,
    jobProfileRoutes: jobProfileRoutes,
    jobMobileRoutes: jobMobileRoutes,
  }
}
```

### packages/extensions/fireux-jobs/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/jobs/fetch/useJobCollection.ts

```ts
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { useFireUXConfig } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/app/FireUXConfig'
import { useFirestoreRead } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreRead'
import type { Job } from '../../../../../models/job.model'

export function useJobCollection() {
  const fireUXConfig = useFireUXConfig()
  const { firestoreFetchCollection } = useFirestoreRead()

  const jobs = firestoreFetchCollection<Job>('jobs')
  const pending = computed(() => jobs.value === undefined)
  const appJobs = computed(() => {
    const allJobs = jobs.value ?? []
    if (!fireUXConfig.isTenant || !fireUXConfig.appId) {
      return allJobs
    }
    return allJobs.filter((job) => job.app_id === fireUXConfig.appId)
  })

  return {
    jobs,
    appJobs,
    pending,
  }
}

```

### packages/extensions/fireux-jobs/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/jobs/fetch/useJobFetch.ts

```ts
import { doc } from 'firebase/firestore'
import { computed, isRef, type Ref } from 'vue'
import { useDocument, useFirestore } from 'vuefire'
import type { Job } from '../../../../../models/job.model'

export function useJobFetch(
  id: string | null | undefined | Ref<string | null | undefined>
) {
  const db = useFirestore()

  const jobId = computed(() => (isRef(id) ? id.value : id) ?? null)

  const docRef = computed(() =>
    jobId.value ? (doc(db, 'jobs', jobId.value) as any) : null
  )

  const { data, pending, error } = useDocument<Job | undefined>(docRef as any)

  const job = computed<Job | null>(() => data.value ?? null)
  const isPending = computed(() => Boolean(pending.value))

  return { job, pending: isPending, error }
}

export type JobFetchRefs = ReturnType<typeof useJobFetch>

```

### packages/extensions/fireux-jobs/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/jobs/mutations/useJobCreate.ts

```ts
import { useFirestoreCreate } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreCreate'
import { ref } from 'vue'
import type { JobStatus } from '../../../../../models/job.model'

export const JobPayload = {
  company_id: '',
  place_id: '',
  title: '',
  status: 'open' as JobStatus,
  description: '',
}

export const JobStampOptions = {
  creator: true,
} as const

export type JobCreateForm = {
  company_id: string
  place_id: string
  title: string
  status: JobStatus
  description: string
}

type JobCreateInput = JobCreateForm

const DEFAULT_FORM: JobCreateForm = {
  ...JobPayload,
}

export function useJobCreate() {
  const { createDocument } = useFirestoreCreate()
  const form = ref<JobCreateForm>({ ...DEFAULT_FORM })

  const reset = () => {
    form.value = { ...DEFAULT_FORM }
  }

  async function createJob(payload: JobCreateInput): Promise<{ created: boolean; id: string }> {
    const data = {
      ...payload,
    } satisfies JobCreateInput

    const id = await createDocument<JobCreateInput>('jobs', data, {
      app: true,
      creator: true,
    })
    

    return { created: true, id }
  }

  const submit = async (): Promise<string> => {
    const title = String(form.value.title ?? '').trim()
    const description = String(form.value.description ?? '').trim()
    const placeId = String(form.value.place_id ?? '').trim()

    if (!placeId) throw new Error('Place is required')
    if (!title) throw new Error('Title is required')
    if (!description) throw new Error('Description is required')

    const payload: JobCreateInput = {
      ...form.value,
      title,
      description,
      place_id: placeId,
      company_id: String(form.value.company_id ?? '').trim(),
      status: form.value.status ?? 'open',
    }

    const result = await createJob(payload)
    return result.id
  }

  return { form, reset, submit, createJob }
}

```

```ts
export function useJobDelete() {
  const { deleteDocument } = useFirestoreManager()

  const deleteJob = async (jobId: string) => {
    const id = String(jobId ?? '').trim()
    if (!id) {
```

```ts
import { useState } from '#imports'

export type JobDraft = {
  title: string
  description: string
}

const DEFAULT_DRAFT: JobDraft = {
  title: 'Job Title',
  description: 'Job Description',
}

export function useJobState() {
  const preview = useState<JobDraft>('job-create-preview', () => ({
    ...DEFAULT_DRAFT,
  }))

  const commit = () => {
    const trim = (v: string) => v.trim()
    return {
      title: trim(preview.value.title) || 'Untitled Job',
      description: trim(preview.value.description),
    }
  }

  const reset = () => {
    preview.value = { ...DEFAULT_DRAFT }
  }

  return {
    preview,
    commit,
    reset,
  }
}
```

### packages/extensions/fireux-jobs/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/jobs/useJob.ts

```ts
import type { Ref } from 'vue'
import { useJobFetch } from './fetch/useJobFetch'
import { useJobComputed } from './utils/view/useJobComputed'
import { useJobInterface } from './utils/view/useJobInterface'
import { useJobState } from './state/useJobState'
import { useJobCreate } from './mutations/useJobCreate'
import { useJobUpdate } from './mutations/useJobUpdate'
import { useJobDelete } from './mutations/useJobDelete'

export type { Job } from '../../../../models/job.model'

/**
 * useJob (canon)
 * - Fetches and manages a single Job document
 * - Takes an explicit jobId (string or Ref); there is no implicit default
 * - For collections, call useJobCollection() directly from its own composable
 *
 * Responsibilities:
 * - Fetch: useJobFetch(jobId) → { job, pending }
 * - Computed: useJobComputed(job, pending) → derived flags (status, ownership, etc.)
 * - Interface: useJobInterface(job) → card/pill props for UI
 * - Mutations: useJobCreate / useJobUpdate / useJobDelete
 * - State: useJobState() → local draft state for create/edit flows
 */
export function useJob(jobId: string | Ref<string | null | undefined>) {
  const { job, pending } = useJobFetch(jobId)

  return {
    job,
    pending,
    ...useJobComputed(job, pending),
    ...useJobInterface(),
    ...useJobState(),
    ...useJobCreate(),
    ...useJobUpdate(),
    ...useJobDelete(),
  }
}

```

### packages/extensions/fireux-jobs/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/jobs/utils/view/useJobInterface.ts

```ts
import type { Job } from '../../../../../../models/job.model'

export namespace JobCard {
  export type Card = {
    id: string
    to: string

    // Media (empty string means unset)
    avatarUrl: string

    // Primary display fields
    subtitle: string

    title: string
    status: Job['status']
    description: string

    // Status/label chips
    badges: string[]
  }
}

export function useJobInterface() {
  function map(job: Job): JobCard.Card {
    return {
      id: job.id,
      to: `/jobs/${job.id}`,

      avatarUrl: '',
      subtitle: String(job.status ?? ''),

      title: job.title,
      status: job.status,
      description: job.description ?? '',

      badges: [],
    }
  }

  function card(target?: Job | null | undefined): JobCard.Card | null {
    return target ? map(target) : null
  }

  function searchText(job: Job): string {
    // keep it simple; add company/place names later once jobs are hydrated
    return `${job.title} ${job.status} ${job.id}`.toLowerCase()
  }

  return { card, searchText }
```

```ts
// Action: ENSURE · Phases: 1–4
// Sketch: Agent create (core + app, conditional)
// One doc, one action, one name. No wiring yet.

import { doc, getDoc } from 'firebase/firestore'
import { useFireUXConfig } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/app/FireUXConfig'
import { useFirestoreCreate } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreCreate'
import { requireUid } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/utils/useEnsureCommon'
import { useFirestore } from 'vuefire'
import type { AgentApp, AgentCore } from '../../../../../../models/profiles/Agent/Agent.model'
import { agentConfig } from '../../../../../../models/profiles/Agent/Agent.model'

export function useAgentCreate() {
  const db = useFirestore()
  const { setDocument } = useFirestoreCreate()

  async function ensureAgent(): Promise<{
    createdCore: boolean
    createdApp: boolean
    id: string
  }> {
    const { uid } = await requireUid()
    const { appId, isTenant } = useFireUXConfig()

    let createdCore = false
    let createdApp = false

    const coreRef = doc(db, agentConfig.collectionName, uid)
    const coreSnap = await getDoc(coreRef)
    if (!coreSnap.exists()) {
      const payload = {
        id: uid,
        title: '',
        subtitle: '',
        tagline: '',
        tags: [],
        bio_short: '',
        contact_email: '',
        contact_phone: '',
        website_url: '',
      } satisfies Omit<AgentCore, 'created_at' | 'updated_at' | 'creator_id'>

      await setDocument<AgentCore>(agentConfig.collectionName, uid, payload as AgentCore, {
        creator: 'require',
      })
      createdCore = true
    }

    if (isTenant && appId) {
      const appCollection = `apps/${appId}/${agentConfig.collectionName}`
      const appRef = doc(db, 'apps', appId, agentConfig.collectionName, uid)
      const appSnap = await getDoc(appRef)
      if (!appSnap.exists()) {
        const payload = {
          id: uid,
        } satisfies Omit<AgentApp, 'created_at' | 'updated_at' | 'creator_id'>

        await setDocument<AgentApp>(appCollection, uid, payload as AgentApp, {
          creator: 'require',
        })
        createdApp = true
      }
    }

    return { createdCore, createdApp, id: uid }
  }

  return { ensureAgent }
}
```

### packages/extensions/fireux-jobs/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Agent/main/useAgentDelete.ts

```ts
import { useFirestore } from 'vuefire'
import { deleteDoc, doc } from 'firebase/firestore'
import { useFireUXConfig } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/app/FireUXConfig'
import { useRequireUser } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firebase/useRequireUser'
import type { ProfileRefs } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/profile/fetch/useProfileFetch'
import type { AgentCore } from '../../../../../../models/profiles/Agent/Agent.model'

type DeleteScope = 'auto' | 'core' | 'app' | 'both'

export function useAgentDelete(_profile: ProfileRefs<AgentCore>) {
  const db = useFirestore()
  const { role, appId } = useFireUXConfig()
  const isTenant = role === 'tenant' && !!appId

  const resolveUid = async (explicitId?: string) => {
    if (explicitId) return explicitId
    const u = await useRequireUser()
    if (!u?.uid) throw new Error('Not authenticated')
    return u.uid
  }

  const deleteAtPath = async (collection: string, id: string) => {
    await deleteDoc(doc(db, collection, id))
  }

  const deleteAgent = async (options?: {
    scope?: DeleteScope
    id?: string
  }) => {
    const scope = options?.scope ?? 'auto'
    const id = await resolveUid(options?.id)

    if (
      scope === 'core' ||
      scope === 'both' ||
      (!isTenant && scope === 'auto')
    ) {
      await deleteAtPath('agents', id)
    }

    const deleteAppScope =
      scope === 'app' || scope === 'both' || (isTenant && scope === 'auto')

    if (deleteAppScope) {
      if (!appId) throw new Error('Missing appId for tenant-scoped delete')
      await deleteAtPath(`apps/${appId}/agents`, id)
    }

    let effectiveScope: DeleteScope = scope
    if (scope === 'auto') {
      effectiveScope = isTenant ? 'app' : 'core'
    }

    return { id, scope: effectiveScope }
  }

  return { deleteAgent }
}
```

### packages/extensions/fireux-jobs/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Agent/main/useAgentUpdate.ts

```ts
import { useFirestoreUpdate } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreUpdate'
import { useFireUXConfig } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/app/FireUXConfig'
import { useRequireUser } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firebase/useRequireUser'
import type { ProfileRefs } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/profile/fetch/useProfileFetch'
import type { AgentCore } from '../../../../../../models/profiles/Agent/Agent.model'

/**
 * useAgentUpdate
 * - Split update surface:
 *   - updateCoreProfile: global Agent profile
 *   - updateAppProfile: tenant-scoped Agent profile
 *
 * For now:
 * - accepts only refs (no user cascading)
 * - both implementations are stubs until Firestore integration
 */
export function useAgentUpdate(profile?: ProfileRefs<AgentCore> | null) {
  const { updateDocument } = useFirestoreUpdate()
  const { appId, role } = useFireUXConfig()
  const isTenant = role === 'tenant' && Boolean(appId)

  const resolveUid = async (): Promise<string> => {
    const fromRefs =
      profile?.coreProfile?.value?.id ?? profile?.appProfile?.value?.id ?? null
    if (fromRefs?.trim()) return fromRefs.trim()

    const user = await useRequireUser()
    if (!user?.uid) {
      throw new Error('[useAgentUpdate] Unable to resolve agent id')
    }
    return user.uid
  }

  const pruneUndefined = <T extends Record<string, any>>(payload: T) => {
    const entries = Object.entries(payload).filter(
      ([, value]) => value !== undefined
    )
    return Object.fromEntries(entries) as Partial<T>
  }

  /**
   * Update the CORE Agent profile
   * - global document (e.g. agents/{uid})
   */
  const updateCoreProfile = async (
    patch: Partial<AgentCore>
  ): Promise<void> => {
    const uid = await resolveUid()
    await updateDocument<AgentCore>('agents', uid, pruneUndefined(patch))
  }

  /**
   * Update the APP (tenant) Agent profile
   * - app-specific document (e.g. apps/{appId}/agents/{uid})
   */
  const updateAppProfile = async (
    patch: Partial<AgentCore>
  ): Promise<void> => {
    if (!isTenant || !appId) {
      throw new Error(
        '[useAgentUpdate] Tenant context required for app profile updates'
      )
    }

    const uid = await resolveUid()
    await updateDocument<AgentCore>(
      `apps/${appId}/agents`,
      uid,
      pruneUndefined(patch)
    )
  }

  const updateCore = async (
    patch: Partial<AgentCore>,
    _id?: string | null
  ): Promise<'success'> => {
    await updateCoreProfile(patch)
    return 'success'
  }

  const updateApp = async (
    patch: Partial<AgentCore>,
    _id?: string | null
  ): Promise<'success'> => {
    await updateAppProfile(patch)
    return 'success'
  }

  const cleanString = (value: string | null | undefined) => {
    const normalized = typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim() : ''
    return normalized.length ? normalized : null
  }

  const updateAgencyName = async (value: string) => {
    const normalized = cleanString(value)
    if (!normalized) {
      console.warn('[useAgentUpdate] Empty agency name ignored')
      return
    }

    await updateCoreProfile({
      title: normalized,
    })
  }

  const updateDisplayName = async (value: string) => {
    console.warn('[useAgentUpdate] updateDisplayName stub called with:', value)
  }

  const updateTagline = async (value: string) => {
    const normalized = cleanString(value)
    await updateCoreProfile({ tagline: normalized ?? undefined })
  }

  const updateBioShort = async (value: string) => {
    const normalized = cleanString(value)
    await updateCoreProfile({ bio_short: normalized ?? undefined })
  }

  const updateContactEmail = async (value: string) => {
    const normalized = cleanString(value)
    await updateCoreProfile({ contact_email: normalized ?? undefined })
  }

  const updateContactPhone = async (value: string) => {
    const normalized = cleanString(value)
    await updateCoreProfile({ contact_phone: normalized ?? undefined })
  }

  const setContactEmailFromProfile = async (enabled: boolean) => {
    // TODO: cascade update info
    // If enabled and the user's profile email changes, propagate it to any
    // derived/contact surfaces that rely on this agent contact.
    await updateCoreProfile({
      ...(enabled ? { contact_email: '' } : {}),
    })
  }

  const setContactPhoneFromProfile = async (enabled: boolean) => {
    // TODO: cascade update info
    await updateCoreProfile({
      ...(enabled ? { contact_phone: '' } : {}),
    })
  }

  const updateWebsiteUrl = async (value: string) => {
    const normalized = cleanString(value)
    await updateCoreProfile({ website_url: normalized ?? undefined })
  }

  const updateBadges = async (value: string) => {
    const normalized = (value || '').trim()
    if (!normalized.length) {
      await updateCoreProfile({ tags: [] })
      return
    }

    const badges = Array.from(
      new Set(
        normalized
          .split(',')
          .map((item) => item.trim())
          .filter(Boolean)
      )
    )

    await updateCoreProfile({ tags: badges })
  }

  return {
    updateCoreProfile,
    updateAppProfile,
    updateCore,
    updateApp,
    updateDisplayName,
    updateAgencyName,
    updateTagline,
    updateBioShort,
    updateContactEmail,
    updateContactPhone,
    setContactEmailFromProfile,
    setContactPhoneFromProfile,
    updateWebsiteUrl,
    updateBadges,
  }
}
```

```ts
// FILE: packages/extensions/fireux-jobs/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Agent/useAgent.ts

import { computed } from 'vue'
import { useProfile } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/profile/useProfile'
import { useUser } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/useUser'
import {
  agentConfig,
  type AgentCore,
} from '../../../../../models/profiles/Agent/Agent.model'
import { useAgentComputed } from './main/useAgentComputed'
import { useAgentInterface, type AgentCard } from './utils/view/useAgentInterface'
import { useAgentUpdate } from './main/useAgentUpdate'
import { useAgentCreate } from './main/useAgentCreate'

export type Agent = {
  user: unknown | null
  core: AgentCore | null
  app: Partial<AgentCore> | null
}

export type { AgentCore as AgentProfile, AgentCard }

export function useAgent() {
  const { profile: refs, pending } = useProfile<AgentCore>(agentConfig)
  const { coreProfile, appProfile } = refs

  // canonical user for UI layer
  const { coreUser } = useUser()

  const agent = computed<Agent>(() => ({
    user: (coreUser.value ?? null) as unknown,
    core: coreProfile.value ?? null,
    app: appProfile.value ?? null,
  }))

  const agentComputed = useAgentComputed(refs, pending)
  const ui = useAgentInterface(refs, coreUser)
  const update = useAgentUpdate(refs)
  const create = useAgentCreate()

  return {
    profile: refs,
    coreProfile,
    appProfile,
    agent,
    pending,

    ...agentComputed,
    ...ui,
    ...update,
    ...create,
  }
}
```

```ts
export function useAgentFormatting() {
  const formatBusinessType = (type: string): string => {
    const typeMap: Record<string, string> = {
      restaurant: 'Restaurant',
      hotel: 'Hotel',
      catering: 'Catering Company',
      food_service: 'Food Service',
      retail: 'Retail',
      other: 'Other',
    }
    return typeMap[type] || type
  }

  const formatEmployeeCount = (count: number): string => {
    if (count === 1) return '1 employee'
    if (count < 50) return `${count} employees`
    if (count < 100) return `${count} employees`
    if (count < 500) return `${count} employees`
    if (count < 1000) return `${count} employees`
    return `${Math.round(count / 100) * 100}+ employees`
  }

  const formatYearsEstablished = (years: number): string => {
    if (years === 1) return '1 year in business'
    if (years < 5) return `${years} years in business`
    if (years < 10) return `${years} years established`
    if (years < 25) return `${years} years established`
    if (years < 50) return `${years}+ years established`
    return `${years}+ years of heritage`
  }

  const formatAnnualRevenue = (revenue: string): string => {
    const revenueMap: Record<string, string> = {
      under_100k: 'Under CHF 100K',
      '100k_500k': 'CHF 100K - 500K',
      '500k_1m': 'CHF 500K - 1M',
      '1m_5m': 'CHF 1M - 5M',
      '5m_10m': 'CHF 5M - 10M',
      over_10m: 'Over CHF 10M',
      undisclosed: 'Revenue undisclosed',
    }
    return revenueMap[revenue] || revenue
  }

  const formatCoversPerService = (covers: number): string => {
    if (covers < 50) return `${covers} covers per service`
    if (covers < 100) return `${covers} covers per service`
    if (covers < 200) return `${covers} covers per service`
    if (covers < 500) return `${covers} covers per service`
    return `${covers}+ covers per service`
  }

  const formatSpecialties = (specialties: string[]): string => {
    if (!specialties || specialties.length === 0) return 'No specialties listed'
    if (specialties.length === 1) return specialties[0] || ''
    if (specialties.length === 2) return specialties.join(' & ')
    if (specialties.length <= 4) return specialties.join(', ')
    return `${specialties.slice(0, 3).join(', ')} & ${
      specialties.length - 3
    } more`
  }

  const formatCuisineTypes = (cuisines: string[]): string => {
    if (!cuisines || cuisines.length === 0) return 'All cuisines'
    if (cuisines.length === 1) return cuisines[0] || ''
    if (cuisines.length === 2) return cuisines.join(' & ')
    if (cuisines.length <= 3) return cuisines.join(', ')
    return `${cuisines.slice(0, 2).join(', ')} & ${cuisines.length - 2} more`
  }

  const formatEstablishmentTypes = (types: string[]): string => {
    if (!types || types.length === 0) return 'Multi-service establishment'
    if (types.length === 1) return types[0] || ''
    if (types.length === 2) return types.join(' & ')
    return `${types.slice(0, 2).join(' & ')} & more`
  }

  const formatCompanyName = (name: string): string => {
    if (!name || name.trim().length === 0) return 'Company Name Not Set'
    return name.trim()
  }

  const formatContactPerson = (name: string, title?: string): string => {
    if (!name || name.trim().length === 0) return 'Contact not specified'
    if (title && title.trim().length > 0) {
      return `${name.trim()}, ${title.trim()}`
    }
    return name.trim()
  }

  const formatBioShort = (bio: string, maxLength: number = 120): string => {
    if (!bio || bio.trim().length === 0) return 'No description available'
    if (bio.length <= maxLength) return bio
    return bio.substring(0, maxLength - 3).trim() + '...'
  }

  const formatWebsite = (url: string): string => {
    if (!url || url.trim().length === 0) return 'No website'
    try {
      const urlObj = new URL(url)
      return urlObj.hostname.replace('www.', '')
    } catch {
      return url
    }
  }

  const formatVerificationStatus = (verified: boolean): string => {
    if (verified) {
      return 'Verified Company'
    }
    return 'Pending Verification'
  }

  return {
    formatBusinessType,
    formatEmployeeCount,
    formatYearsEstablished,
    formatAnnualRevenue,
    formatCoversPerService,
    formatSpecialties,
    formatCuisineTypes,
    formatEstablishmentTypes,
    formatCompanyName,
    formatContactPerson,
    formatBioShort,
    formatWebsite,
    formatVerificationStatus,
  }
}
```

```ts
import type { ProfileRefs } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/profile/fetch/useProfileFetch'
import type { User } from 'fireux-core/runtime/models/core/user.model'
import type { Ref } from 'vue'
import { agentConfig, type AgentCore } from '../../../../../../../models/profiles/Agent/Agent.model'

type UserLike = Pick<User, 'display_name' | 'avatar'> &
  Partial<Pick<User, 'id' | 'handle' | 'email'>>

export namespace AgentCard {
  export type Card = {
    id: string
    to: string

    // Media (empty string means unset)
    avatarUrl: string

    // Primary display fields
    displayName: string
    tagline: string

    // Status/label chips
    badges: string[]

    // Short bio shown in lists
    bioShort: string

    // IMPORTANT: only render contactEmail on authorized UI surfaces.
    contactEmail: string
    contactPhone: string
    websiteUrl: string
  }
}

export function useAgentInterface(
  profile: ProfileRefs<AgentCore>,
  userRef?: Ref<User | null | undefined>
) {
  function map(p: AgentCore, u?: UserLike | null): AgentCard.Card {
    const title = p.title
    const subtitle = p.subtitle
    const tagline = p.tagline
    const tags = p.tags

    return {
      id: p.id,
      to: `/${agentConfig.collectionName}/${p.id}`,

      avatarUrl: u?.avatar ?? '',

      // Canonical: agent pills are user-hydrated; no profile-title fallback for display name.
      displayName: u?.display_name ?? '',

      // Prefer tagline; fall back to title/subtitle so pills stay useful.
      tagline: tagline || title || subtitle,
      badges: tags,

      bioShort: p.bio_short,

      contactEmail: p.contact_email.trim(),
      contactPhone: p.contact_phone.trim(),
      websiteUrl: p.website_url,
    }
  }

  function card(
    target?: AgentCore | null | undefined,
    userOverride?: UserLike | null
  ): AgentCard.Card | null {
    const p = target ?? profile.coreProfile.value ?? null
    if (!p) return null
    const u = userOverride ?? userRef?.value ?? null
    return map(p, u)
  }

  function searchText(target?: AgentCore | null | undefined): string {
    const p = target ?? profile.coreProfile.value ?? null
    if (!p) return ''
    const u = userRef?.value ?? null
    const displayName = u?.display_name ?? ''
    return `${displayName} ${p.title} ${p.tagline} ${p.id}`.trim().toLowerCase()
  }

  return { card, searchText }
}
```

```ts
// FILE: packages/extensions/fireux-jobs/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Agent/utils/view/useAgentsInterface.ts

import type { User } from 'fireux-core/runtime/models/core/user.model'
import { agentConfig, type AgentCore } from '../../../../../../../models/profiles/Agent/Agent.model'
import type { AgentCard } from './useAgentInterface'

type UserSummary = Pick<User, 'id' | 'display_name' | 'avatar'> &
  Partial<Pick<User, 'handle' | 'email'>>

export type AgentDirectoryEntry = AgentCore & { user?: User | UserSummary }

export function useAgentsInterface() {
  function safeArray<T>(input: unknown): T[] {
    return Array.isArray(input) ? (input as T[]) : []
  }

  function safeString(input: unknown): string {
    return typeof input === 'string' ? input : ''
  }

  function resolveBadges(currentProfile: AgentCore): string[] {
    const tags = safeArray<unknown>((currentProfile as any)?.tags)
      .filter((x) => typeof x === 'string') as string[]
    if (tags.length) return tags

    const legacy = safeArray<unknown>((currentProfile as any)?.badges)
      .filter((x) => typeof x === 'string') as string[]
    return legacy
  }

  function card(entry: AgentDirectoryEntry): AgentCard.Card {
    const title = safeString((entry as any)?.title)
    const subtitle = safeString((entry as any)?.subtitle)
    const tagline = safeString((entry as any)?.tagline)

    // Canonical: directory cards are user-hydrated; no title fallback for display name.
    const displayName = safeString((entry.user as any)?.display_name)

    return {
      id: entry.id,
      to: `/${agentConfig.collectionName}/${entry.id}`,

      avatarUrl: safeString((entry.user as any)?.avatar),

      displayName,
      tagline: tagline || title || subtitle,
      badges: resolveBadges(entry),

      bioShort: safeString((entry as any)?.bio_short),

      // IMPORTANT: only render contactEmail on authorized UI surfaces.
      contactEmail: safeString((entry as any)?.contact_email).trim(),
      contactPhone: safeString((entry as any)?.contact_phone).trim(),
      websiteUrl: safeString((entry as any)?.website_url),
    }
  }

  function searchText(entry: AgentDirectoryEntry): string {
    const displayName = safeString((entry.user as any)?.display_name)
    const title = safeString((entry as any)?.title)
    const tagline = safeString((entry as any)?.tagline)
    return `${displayName} ${title} ${tagline} ${entry.id}`.trim().toLowerCase()
  }

  return { card, searchText }
}
```

```ts
// Action: ENSURE · Phases: 1–4
// Sketch: Professional create (core + app, conditional)
// One doc, one action, one name. No wiring yet.

import { doc, getDoc } from 'firebase/firestore'
import { useFireUXConfig } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/app/FireUXConfig'
import { useFirestoreCreate } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreCreate'
import { requireUid } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/utils/useEnsureCommon'
import { useFirestore } from 'vuefire'
import type { ProfessionalApp, ProfessionalCore } from '../../../../../../models/profiles/Professional/Professional.model'
import { professionalConfig } from '../../../../../../models/profiles/Professional/Professional.model'

export function useProfessionalCreate() {
  const db = useFirestore()
  const { setDocument } = useFirestoreCreate()

  async function ensureProfessional(): Promise<{
    createdCore: boolean
    createdApp: boolean
    id: string
  }> {
    const { uid } = await requireUid()
    const { appId, isTenant } = useFireUXConfig()

    let createdCore = false
    let createdApp = false

    const coreRef = doc(db, professionalConfig.collectionName, uid)
    const coreSnap = await getDoc(coreRef)
    if (!coreSnap.exists()) {
      const payload = {
        id: uid,
        title: '',
        subtitle: '',
        tagline: '',
        tags: [],
        health_certifications: [],
        bio_short: '',
        bio_long: '',
        specialties: [],
        locations: [],
        relevant_experience: [],
        other_experience: [],
      } satisfies Omit<ProfessionalCore, 'created_at' | 'updated_at' | 'creator_id'>

      await setDocument<ProfessionalCore>(professionalConfig.collectionName, uid, payload as ProfessionalCore, {
        creator: 'require',
      })
      createdCore = true
    }

    if (isTenant && appId) {
      const appCollection = `apps/${appId}/${professionalConfig.collectionName}`
      const appRef = doc(db, 'apps', appId, professionalConfig.collectionName, uid)
      const appSnap = await getDoc(appRef)
      if (!appSnap.exists()) {
        const payload = {
          id: uid,
        } satisfies Omit<ProfessionalApp, 'created_at' | 'updated_at' | 'creator_id'>

        await setDocument<ProfessionalApp>(appCollection, uid, payload as ProfessionalApp, {
          creator: 'require',
        })
        createdApp = true
      }
    }

    return { createdCore, createdApp, id: uid }
  }

  return { ensureProfessional }
}
```

### packages/extensions/fireux-jobs/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Professional/main/useProfessionalDelete.ts

```ts
import { deleteDoc, doc } from 'firebase/firestore'
import { useFireUXConfig } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/app/FireUXConfig'
import { useRequireUser } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firebase/useRequireUser'
import type { ProfileRefs } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/profile/fetch/useProfileFetch'
import { useFirestore } from 'vuefire'
import type { ProfessionalCore } from '../../../../../../models/profiles/Professional/Professional.model'

type DeleteScope = 'auto' | 'core' | 'app' | 'both'

export function useProfessionalDelete(
  _profile: ProfileRefs<ProfessionalCore>
) {
  const db = useFirestore()
  const { role, appId } = useFireUXConfig()
  const isTenant = role === 'tenant' && !!appId

  const resolveUid = async (explicitId?: string) => {
    if (explicitId) return explicitId
    const u = await useRequireUser()
    if (!u?.uid) throw new Error('Not authenticated')
    return u.uid
  }

  const deleteAtPath = async (collection: string, id: string) => {
    await deleteDoc(doc(db, collection, id))
  }

  const deleteProfessional = async (options?: {
    scope?: DeleteScope
    id?: string
  }) => {
    const scope = options?.scope ?? 'auto'
    const id = await resolveUid(options?.id)

    if (
      scope === 'core' ||
      scope === 'both' ||
      (!isTenant && scope === 'auto')
    ) {
      await deleteAtPath('professionals', id)
    }

    const deleteAppScope =
      scope === 'app' || scope === 'both' || (isTenant && scope === 'auto')

    if (deleteAppScope) {
      if (!appId) throw new Error('Missing appId for tenant-scoped delete')
      await deleteAtPath(`apps/${appId}/professionals`, id)
    }

    let effectiveScope: DeleteScope = scope
    if (scope === 'auto') {
      effectiveScope = isTenant ? 'app' : 'core'
    }

    return { id, scope: effectiveScope }
  }

  return { deleteProfessional }
}
```

### packages/extensions/fireux-jobs/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Professional/main/useProfessionalUpdate.ts

```ts
import { arrayRemove, arrayUnion, doc, getDoc } from 'firebase/firestore'
import { useFireUXConfig } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/app/FireUXConfig'
import { useRequireUser } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firebase/useRequireUser'
import type { ProfileRefs } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/profile/fetch/useProfileFetch'
import { useFirestoreUpdate } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreUpdate'
import { canonicalPlaceId } from 'fireux-places/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/place/fetch/google/usePlacesGoogle'
import { usePlaceSave } from 'fireux-places/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/place/mutations/usePlaceSave'
import type { PlaceUpsertInput } from 'fireux-places/runtime/models/place.model'
import { useFirestore } from 'vuefire'
import type { ProfessionalCore } from '../../../../../../models/profiles/Professional/Professional.model'
import type {
    OtherExperienceItem,
    RelevantExperienceItem,
} from '../../../../../../models/profiles/Professional/supporting'

const COLLECTION = 'professionals'

type UpdateOptions = { id?: string | null; scope?: 'core' | 'app' }

const pruneUndefined = <T extends Record<string, any>>(payload: T) => {
  const entries = Object.entries(payload).filter(
    ([, value]) => value !== undefined
  )
  return Object.fromEntries(entries) as Partial<T>
}

export function useProfessionalUpdate(
  profile?: ProfileRefs<ProfessionalCore>
) {
  const { updateDocument } = useFirestoreUpdate()
  const { ensurePlaceExists } = usePlaceSave()
  const db = useFirestore()
  const { appId, role } = useFireUXConfig()
  const isTenant = role === 'tenant' && Boolean(appId)

  const commitUpdate = async (
    patch: Partial<ProfessionalCore>,
    options: UpdateOptions = {}
  ): Promise<void> => {
    const scope = options.scope ?? 'core'

    if (scope === 'app') {
      await updateAppProfile(patch, options)
      return
    }

    await updateCoreProfile(patch, options)
  }

  const resolveUid = async (explicit?: string | null): Promise<string> => {
    const trimmed = explicit?.trim()
    if (trimmed) return trimmed

    const fromRefs =
      profile?.coreProfile?.value?.id ?? profile?.appProfile?.value?.id ?? null
    if (fromRefs?.trim()) return fromRefs.trim()

    const user = await useRequireUser()
    if (!user?.uid) {
      throw new Error(
        '[useProfessionalUpdate] Unable to resolve professional id'
      )
    }
    return user.uid
  }

  const updateCoreProfile = async (
    patch: Partial<ProfessionalCore>,
    options: UpdateOptions = {}
  ): Promise<void> => {
    const uid = await resolveUid(options.id)
    await updateDocument<ProfessionalCore>(
      COLLECTION,
      uid,
      pruneUndefined(patch)
    )
  }

  const updateAppProfile = async (
    patch: Partial<ProfessionalCore>,
    options: UpdateOptions = {}
  ): Promise<void> => {
    if (!isTenant || !appId) {
      throw new Error(
        '[useProfessionalUpdate] Tenant context required for app profile updates'
      )
    }

    const uid = await resolveUid(options.id)
    await updateDocument<ProfessionalCore>(
      `apps/${appId}/${COLLECTION}`,
      uid,
      pruneUndefined(patch)
    )
  }

  const setRelevantExperience = async (
    items: RelevantExperienceItem[] = [],
    options: UpdateOptions = {}
  ): Promise<void> => {
    const uid = await resolveUid(options.id)

    const professionalRef = doc(db, COLLECTION, uid)
    const snapshot = await getDoc(professionalRef)
    const previousItems = Array.isArray(snapshot.data()?.relevant_experience)
      ? (snapshot.data()?.relevant_experience as RelevantExperienceItem[])
      : []

    const previousPlaceIds = new Set(
      previousItems
        .map((item) => canonicalPlaceId(item?.place_id ?? undefined))
        .filter((id): id is string => typeof id === 'string' && id.length > 0)
    )

    const sanitized: RelevantExperienceItem[] = []
    const roster = new Map<string, boolean>()

    for (const item of items) {
      const placeId = canonicalPlaceId(item?.place_id ?? undefined)
      if (!placeId) continue

      const normalized: RelevantExperienceItem = {
        ...item,
        place_id: placeId,
        ongoing: item?.ongoing === true,
      }

      sanitized.push(normalized)

      if (roster.get(placeId) === true) continue
      roster.set(placeId, normalized.ongoing === true)
    }

    const newPlaceIds = new Set(roster.keys())

    const removalTargets = [...previousPlaceIds].filter(
      (placeId) => !newPlaceIds.has(placeId)
    )

    const placeTasks: Promise<void>[] = []

    for (const [placeId, isCurrent] of roster) {
      const placeholder: PlaceUpsertInput = {
        id: placeId,
        name: '(unknown)',
        formatted_address: '',
        lat: 0,
        lng: 0,
        place_image: '',
        source: 'firebase',
        search_term: placeId,
      }

      await ensurePlaceExists(placeholder)

      placeTasks.push(
        updateDocument('places', placeId, {
          professionals_current: isCurrent ? arrayUnion(uid) : arrayRemove(uid),
          professionals_alumni: isCurrent ? arrayRemove(uid) : arrayUnion(uid),
        })
      )
    }

    for (const placeId of removalTargets) {
      placeTasks.push(
        updateDocument('places', placeId, {
          professionals_current: arrayRemove(uid),
          professionals_alumni: arrayRemove(uid),
        })
      )
    }

    await Promise.all(placeTasks)

    await commitUpdate(
      {
        relevant_experience: sanitized,
      },
      { ...options, id: uid }
    )
  }

  const setOtherExperience = async (
    items: OtherExperienceItem[] = [],
    options: UpdateOptions = {}
  ): Promise<void> => {
    const uid = await resolveUid(options.id)

    const normalized: OtherExperienceItem[] = items
      .map((item) => {
        const placeId = canonicalPlaceId(item.place_id) ?? ''
        return { ...item, place_id: placeId }
      })
      .filter((item) => Boolean(item.place_id))

    await commitUpdate(
      {
        other_experience: normalized,
      },
      { ...options, id: uid }
```

```ts
// FILE: packages/extensions/fireux-jobs/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Professional/useProfessional.ts

import { useProfile } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/profile/useProfile'
import { useUser } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/useUser'

import {
  professionalConfig,
  type ProfessionalCore,
} from '../../../../../models/profiles/Professional/Professional.model'

import { useProfessionalComputed } from './main/useProfessionalComputed'
import { useProfessionalCreate } from './main/useProfessionalCreate'
import { useProfessionalUpdate } from './main/useProfessionalUpdate'
import { useProfessionalInterface, type ProfessionalCard } from './utils/view/useProfessionalInterface'

export type { ProfessionalCard, ProfessionalCore as ProfessionalProfile }

/**
 * useProfessional
 * - Runtime facade for Professional profiles
 * - Exposes:
 *   - raw refs: profile, coreProfile, appProfile, pending
 *   - computed helpers
 *   - UI helpers (pill, cell, profileCore, profileApp)
 *   - update helpers
 */
export function useProfessional() {
  const { profile: refs, pending } =
    useProfile<ProfessionalCore>(professionalConfig)

  const { coreProfile, appProfile } = refs

  // canonical user for UI layer
  const { coreUser } = useUser()

  const computed = useProfessionalComputed(refs, pending)
  const ui = useProfessionalInterface(refs, coreUser)
  const update = useProfessionalUpdate(refs)
  const create = useProfessionalCreate()

  return {
    profile: refs,
    coreProfile,
    appProfile,
    pending,

    ...computed,
    ...ui,
    ...update,
    ...create,
  }
}
```

```ts
export function useProfessionalFormatting() {
  const formatProfessionalName = (name: string): string => {
    if (!name || name.trim().length === 0) return 'Professional Name Not Set'
    return name.trim()
  }

  const formatTitle = (title: string): string => {
    if (!title || title.trim().length === 0) return 'Title not specified'
    return title.trim()
  }

  const formatLanguages = (languages: any[]): string => {
    if (!languages || languages.length === 0) return 'No languages specified'

    const formattedLangs = languages.map((lang) => {
      if (lang.proficiency && lang.proficiency !== 'Unknown') {
        return `${lang.language} (${lang.proficiency})`
      }
      return lang.language
    })

    if (formattedLangs.length === 1) return formattedLangs[0]
    if (formattedLangs.length === 2) return formattedLangs.join(' & ')
    if (formattedLangs.length <= 4) return formattedLangs.join(', ')
    return `${formattedLangs.slice(0, 3).join(', ')} & ${
      formattedLangs.length - 3
    } more`
  }

  const formatExperienceDuration = (experience: any): string => {
    if (!experience.from_year) return 'Duration unknown'

    if (experience.ongoing) {
      return `${experience.from_month} ${experience.from_year} - Present`
    }

    if (experience.to_year && experience.to_month) {
      return `${experience.from_month} ${experience.from_year} - ${experience.to_month} ${experience.to_year}`
    }

    return `${experience.from_month} ${experience.from_year}`
  }

  const formatKitchenExperience = (experience: any[]): string => {
    if (!experience || experience.length === 0)
      return 'No kitchen experience listed'

    const totalPositions = experience.length
    const currentPosition = experience.find((exp) => exp.ongoing)

    if (currentPosition) {
      return `${currentPosition.role} at ${currentPosition.name} (Current) + ${
        totalPositions - 1
      } previous`
    }

    const mostRecent = experience[0]
    if (mostRecent) {
      return `${mostRecent.role} at ${mostRecent.name} + ${
        totalPositions - 1
      } more`
    }

    return `${totalPositions} kitchen positions`
  }

  const formatEducation = (education: any[]): string => {
    if (!education || education.length === 0)
      return 'No formal education listed'

    if (education.length === 1) {
      const edu = education[0]
      return `${edu.degree} from ${edu.institution}`
    }

    return `${education.length} qualifications including ${education[0].degree}`
  }

  const formatCertifications = (certifications: any[]): string => {
    if (!certifications || certifications.length === 0)
      return 'No certifications listed'

    if (certifications.length === 1) return certifications[0].name
    if (certifications.length === 2)
      return `${certifications[0].name} & ${certifications[1].name}`
    return `${certifications[0].name} & ${
      certifications.length - 1
    } more certifications`
  }

  const formatProjects = (projects: any[]): string => {
    if (!projects || projects.length === 0) return 'No projects listed'

    if (projects.length === 1) return projects[0].name
    return `${projects.length} projects including ${projects[0].name}`
  }

  const formatBioShort = (bio: string, maxLength: number = 120): string => {
    if (!bio || bio.trim().length === 0) return 'No description available'
    if (bio.length <= maxLength) return bio
    return bio.substring(0, maxLength - 3).trim() + '...'
  }

  const calculateYearsOfExperience = (kitchenExperience: any[]): string => {
    if (!kitchenExperience || kitchenExperience.length === 0) return '0 years'

    let totalMonths = 0

    kitchenExperience.forEach((exp) => {
      if (exp.from_year) {
        const startYear = parseInt(exp.from_year)
        const startMonth = getMonthNumber(exp.from_month)

        let endYear: number
        let endMonth: number

        if (exp.ongoing) {
          const now = new Date()
          endYear = now.getFullYear()
          endMonth = now.getMonth() + 1
        } else if (exp.to_year && exp.to_month) {
          endYear = parseInt(exp.to_year)
          endMonth = getMonthNumber(exp.to_month)
        } else {
          return
        }

        const months = (endYear - startYear) * 12 + (endMonth - startMonth)
        totalMonths += Math.max(0, months)
      }
    })

    const years = Math.floor(totalMonths / 12)
    const remainingMonths = totalMonths % 12

    if (years === 0) {
      return remainingMonths === 1 ? '1 month' : `${remainingMonths} months`
    }

    if (remainingMonths === 0) {
      return years === 1 ? '1 year' : `${years} years`
    }

    return `${years} years, ${remainingMonths} months`
  }

  const getMonthNumber = (monthName: string): number => {
    const months = {
      January: 1,
      February: 2,
      March: 3,
      April: 4,
      May: 5,
      June: 6,
      July: 7,
      August: 8,
      September: 9,
      October: 10,
      November: 11,
      December: 12,
    }
    return months[monthName as keyof typeof months] || 1
  }

  const formatLocations = (locations: any[]): string => {
    if (!locations || locations.length === 0) return 'Location not specified'

    const locationNames = locations.map((loc) => {
      if (loc.formatted_address) {
        const parts = loc.formatted_address.split(',')
        return parts[0]?.trim() || loc.formatted_address
      }
      return 'Location'
    })

    if (locationNames.length === 1) return locationNames[0]
    if (locationNames.length === 2) return locationNames.join(' & ')
    return `${locationNames[0]} & ${locationNames.length - 1} more locations`
  }

  return {
    formatProfessionalName,
    formatTitle,
    formatLanguages,
    formatExperienceDuration,
    formatKitchenExperience,
    formatEducation,
    formatCertifications,
    formatProjects,
    formatBioShort,
    calculateYearsOfExperience,
    formatLocations,
  }
}

export function useProfessionalFormattingAndValidation() {
  return {
    ...useProfessionalFormatting(),
  }
}
```

```ts
import type { ProfileRefs } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/profile/fetch/useProfileFetch'
import type { User } from 'fireux-core/runtime/models/core/user.model'
import type { Ref } from 'vue'
import { professionalConfig, type ProfessionalCore } from '../../../../../../../models/profiles/Professional/Professional.model'

type UserLike = Pick<User, 'display_name' | 'avatar'> &
  Partial<Pick<User, 'id' | 'handle' | 'email'>>

export namespace ProfessionalCard {
  export type Card = {
    id: string
    to: string

    // Media (empty string means unset)
    avatarUrl: string

    // Primary display fields
    displayName: string
    tagline: string

    // Status/label chips
    badges: string[]

    // Summary fields for list views
    bioShort: string
    specialtiesCsv: string
    locationsCsv: string
  }
}

export function useProfessionalInterface(
  profile: ProfileRefs<ProfessionalCore>,
  userRef?: Ref<User | null | undefined>
) {
  function map(p: ProfessionalCore, u?: UserLike | null): ProfessionalCard.Card {
    const title = p.title
    const subtitle = p.subtitle
    const tagline = p.tagline
    const tags = p.tags

    return {
      id: p.id,
      to: `/${professionalConfig.collectionName}/${p.id}`,

      avatarUrl: u?.avatar ?? '',

      // Canonical: professional pills are user-hydrated; no profile-title fallback for display name.
      displayName: u?.display_name ?? '',
      tagline: tagline || title || subtitle,
      badges: tags,

      bioShort: p.bio_short,
      specialtiesCsv: p.specialties.join(', '),
      locationsCsv: p.locations.join(', '),
    }
  }

  function card(
    target?: ProfessionalCore | null | undefined,
    userOverride?: UserLike | null
  ): ProfessionalCard.Card | null {
    const p = target ?? profile.coreProfile.value ?? null
    if (!p) return null
    const u = userOverride ?? userRef?.value ?? null
    return map(p, u)
  }

  function searchText(target?: ProfessionalCore | null | undefined): string {
    const p = target ?? profile.coreProfile.value ?? null
    if (!p) return ''
    const u = userRef?.value ?? null
    const displayName = u?.display_name ?? ''
    return `${displayName} ${p.title} ${p.tagline} ${p.id}`.trim().toLowerCase()
  }

  return { card, searchText }
}
```

```ts
  created_at: {} as FirebaseTimestamp,
  updated_at: {} as FirebaseTimestamp,
} as const

export type Job = {
  [K in keyof typeof Job]: (typeof Job)[K]
} & FireuxStamped

  Job,
  'app_id' | 'created_at' | 'updated_at' | 'creator_id'
>
```

```ts
// FILE: packages/extensions/fireux-jobs/src/runtime/models/profiles/Professional/supporting.ts

/**
 * Domain-level supporting structures for Professional profiles.
 * These stay separate from the UI-facing ProfessionalCard namespace
 * to keep the domain clean and future-proof.
 */

/* ---------------------------------- *
 * Experience Base Types
 * ---------------------------------- */

/** Minimal shared structure for any experience entry */
export interface ExperienceBase {
  role: string
  from_month: string
  from_year: string
  to_month: string
  to_year: string
  ongoing: boolean
  responsibilities: string
}

/**
 * Experience linked to a canonical Place in Firestore.
 * places/{place_id}
 */
export interface RelevantExperienceItem extends ExperienceBase {
  place_id: string
}

/**
 * Experience referencing an external place snapshot.
 * Self-contained. Useful when the place isn't in Firestore yet.
 */
export interface OtherExperienceItem extends ExperienceBase {
  place_id: string
  name: string
  formatted_address: string
  short_address: string
  image_url: string
}

/** Combined union if needed elsewhere */
export type ExperienceItem = RelevantExperienceItem | OtherExperienceItem

/* ---------------------------------- *
 * Professional Profile Config
 * ---------------------------------- */

import type { ProfileConfig } from 'fireux-core/runtime/models/core/profile.model'

/**
 * Runtime config consumed by useProfile()
 * Profiles live under: professionals/{uid}
 */
export const professionalConfig: ProfileConfig = {
  id: 'professional',
  collectionName: 'professionals',
  profileType: 'Professional',
  cta: 'Create your Professional profile to appear in listings.',
  navLabel: 'Professional',
  navIcon: 'i-lucide-user-star',
} as const
```

```vue
    <UPageHeader :title="pageTitle" :description="pageDescription" />
    <UPageBody class="pagebody">
      <div v-if="pending" class="py-10 text-sm opacity-70">Loading profile…</div>

        <NuxtLink to="/agents" class="text-primary hover:underline">← Back</NuxtLink>
      </div>

      <div v-else class="space-y-4">
        <div v-if="canEdit">
          <UButton
            icon="i-lucide-pencil"
            size="md"
            color="primary"
            variant="solid"
            @click="navigateTo('/console/agent/profile')"
          >
            Edit Profile
          </UButton>
        </div>

        <OrganismsProfilesAgentCardsProfile v-if="agentCard" :card="agentCard" />
      </div>
    </UPageBody>
  </UPage>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { agentConfig } from '../../models/profiles/Agent/Agent.model'
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { navigateTo, useHead, useRoute } from '#imports'
import { useProfileFetch } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/profile/fetch/useProfileFetch'
import { useUser } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/useUser'
import { useAgentInterface } from '../../composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Agent/utils/view/useAgentInterface'
import type { AgentCore } from '../../models/profiles/Agent/Agent.model'

const route = useRoute()
const agentId = computed(() => {
  const raw = Array.isArray(route.params.id) ? route.params.id[0] : route.params.id
  return String(raw ?? '').trim() || null
})

const { profile, pending } = useProfileFetch<AgentCore>(agentId, agentConfig)
const agentProfile = computed(() => profile.coreProfile.value ?? null)

const { coreUser, appUser } = useUser()
const { card } = useAgentInterface(profile, coreUser)
const agentCard = computed(() => card())

const resolveName = (p: any) =>
  p?.display_name ||
  p?.name ||
  p?.title ||
  p?.agency_name ||
  p?.company_name ||
  p?.business_name ||
  p?.professional_name ||
  'Profile'

useHead({
  title: computed(() =>
    agentProfile.value
      ? `${resolveName(agentProfile.value)} · Agent Profile`
      : 'Agent Profile'
  ),
})

const displayName = computed(() => (agentProfile.value ? resolveName(agentProfile.value) : null))
const pageTitle = computed(() => displayName.value ?? 'Agent Profile')
const pageDescription = computed(() =>
  displayName.value
    ? `Inspect ${displayName.value} and their public details.`
    : 'Inspect the selected agent profile.'
)

const canEdit = computed(
  () =>
    !!(
      appUser.value?.id &&
      agentProfile.value?.id &&
      appUser.value.id === agentProfile.value.id
    )
)
</script>
```

```vue
<template>
  <UDashboardPanel id="console-agent-home">
    <template #header>
      <UDashboardNavbar title="Agent">
        <template #leading>
          <UDashboardSidebarCollapse />
        </template>
      </UDashboardNavbar>
    </template>

    <template #body>
      <div class="px-0 py-0 sm:px-4 sm:py-4 lg:px-6 space-y-6">
        <UCard>
          <div class="space-y-4">
            <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
              <div class="min-w-0">
                <p class="text-sm font-medium">Hi {{ greetingName }}</p>
                <p class="text-sm text-dimmed">
                  Agent overview — this is the identity that posts jobs.
                </p>
              </div>

              <UButton
                to="/console/agent/profile"
                label="Build agent profile"
                color="neutral"
                size="sm"
              />
            </div>

            <div v-if="showProfileCompletedness" class="space-y-2">
              <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                <span class="text-sm text-dimmed">Profile completedness</span>
                <UBadge color="neutral" variant="soft">
                  {{ profileLabel }}
                </UBadge>
              </div>

              <UProgress
                :model-value="profileComplete ?? 0"
                :max="100"
                :ui="{ indicator: 'transition-none duration-0' }"
              />
            </div>

            <div class="text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap">
Thank you so much for your message. It's lovely that you're thinking of us 😊

You are welcome to advertise our "unsolicited applications" as job openings:

Cook/Chef https://jobs.huettenzauber.ch/publication/koch-huettenzauber/fk5batbzlnlfcengdagdj5vlk5tiyhbzp17sck3ghwl43i67mm0phm53e27kentq
Service staff https://jobs.huettenzauber.ch/publication/servicemitarbeitende-huettenzauber/ixodqfuayt8hyz10ummbub6k2ichvbjoczqodleob0tqv1yjkxt8hxzwjzaqorye

Do you need any further information from us?

Good evening and happy holidays

Miriam
            </div>
          </div>
        </UCard>
      </div>
    </template>
  </UDashboardPanel>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { useUser } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/useUser'
import { useAgent } from '../../../composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Agent/useAgent'

definePageMeta({
  layout: 'console',
  nav: {
    key: 'console-agent-home',
    label: 'Agent',
    icon: 'i-lucide-shield-user',
    desktop: false,
    mobile: false,
    group: 'profiles',
    profileId: 'agent',
  },
  requiresAuth: true,
})

const { currentUser } = useUser()
const greetingName = computed(() => {
  const user = currentUser.value
  return user?.display_name?.trim() || user?.email?.trim() || 'there'
})

const { coreProfile } = useAgent()

const profileComplete = computed<number | null>(() => {
  if (coreProfile.value === undefined) return null
  const profile = coreProfile.value ?? null
  if (!profile) return 0

  const isFilledString = (value?: string | null) => Boolean(value?.trim())
  const isFilledArray = (value?: unknown[] | null) =>
    Array.isArray(value) && value.length > 0

  const checks: boolean[] = [
    isFilledString(profile.title ?? null),
    isFilledString(profile.tagline ?? null),
    isFilledString(profile.bio_short ?? null),
    isFilledString(profile.contact_email ?? null),
    isFilledString(profile.website_url ?? null),
    isFilledArray((profile as any).tags ?? (profile as any).badges ?? null),
  ]

  const complete = checks.filter(Boolean).length
  const total = checks.length
  return Math.round((complete / total) * 100)
})

const showProfileCompletedness = computed(() => {
  return profileComplete.value == null || profileComplete.value < 100
})

const profileLabel = computed(() => {
  if (profileComplete.value == null) return '—'
  return `${profileComplete.value}%`
})
</script>
```

```vue
<!-- FILE: packages/extensions/fireux-jobs/src/runtime/pages/console/agent/profile.vue -->
<template>
  <UDashboardPanel id="console-agent-profile">
    <template #header>
      <LayoutsConsoleNavbar :title="navTitle" />
    </template>

    <template #body>
      <div class="fx-panels-stack">
        <!-- Header pills -->
        <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <component
            :is="wrapperFor(appCard)"
            v-if="appCard"
            v-bind="wrapperPropsFor(appCard)"
            class="block"
          >
            <OrganismsAppCardsPill v-bind="appCard" :show-subtitle="false" />
          </component>

          <component
            :is="wrapperFor(userCard)"
            v-if="userCard"
            v-bind="wrapperPropsFor(userCard)"
            class="block"
          >
            <OrganismsUserCardsPill v-bind="userCard" :show-subtitle="false" />
          </component>
        </div>

        <!-- Loading -->
        <UPageCard v-if="isProfileLoading" variant="subtle">
          <p class="text-sm text-dimmed">Loading profile…</p>
        </UPageCard>

        <!-- Missing profile -->
        <UPageCard
          v-else-if="!resolvedCoreProfile"
          title="Agent profile not available"
          description="Your agent profile hasn’t been created yet."
          variant="subtle"
        >
          <UButton
            :label="agentConfig.cta || 'Create Agent profile'"
            color="neutral"
            :loading="isCreating"
            @click="createProfile"
          />

          <p v-if="createError" class="mt-3 text-sm text-dimmed">
            {{ createError }}
          </p>
        </UPageCard>

        <!-- Main panels -->
        <ClientOnly v-else>
          <LayoutsConsoleProfileEdit class="fx-panels-masonry">
            <template #preview>
              <OrganismsProfilesAgentEditPreviewPanel />
            </template>

            <template #core>
              <OrganismsProfilesAgentEditCore :agent="resolvedCoreProfile" />
            </template>

            <template v-if="resolvedAppProfile" #app>
              <OrganismsProfilesAgentEditApp :agent="resolvedAppProfile" />
            </template>
          </LayoutsConsoleProfileEdit>
        </ClientOnly>
      </div>
    </template>
  </UDashboardPanel>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import LayoutsConsoleProfileEdit from 'fireux-core/runtime/components/layouts/console/ProfileEdit.vue'
import { useApp } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/app/useApp'
import { useProfileEnsure } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/profile/mutations/useProfileEnsure'
import { useUser } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/useUser'
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import { useAgent } from '../../../composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Agent/useAgent'
import { agentConfig } from '../../../models/profiles/Agent/Agent.model'

const navLabel = agentConfig.navLabel ?? `${agentConfig.profileType} Profile`
const navIcon = agentConfig.navIcon ?? 'i-lucide-user'
const navTitle = navLabel

definePageMeta({
  layout: 'console',
  nav: {
    key: 'console-agent-profile',
    label: navLabel,
    icon: navIcon,
    desktop: true,
    layouts: ['console'],
    group: 'profiles',
    profileId: 'agent',
  },
  requiresAuth: true,
})

const { coreProfile, appProfile } = useAgent()
const { app, card: appToCard } = useApp()
const { user, card: userToCard } = useUser()

const { ensure } = useProfileEnsure(agentConfig)
const isCreating = ref(false)
const createError = ref<string | null>(null)

const createProfile = async () => {
  if (isCreating.value) return
  isCreating.value = true
  createError.value = null

  try {
    await ensure()
  } catch (error) {
    createError.value = (error as Error)?.message || 'Failed to create profile.'
  } finally {
    isCreating.value = false
  }
}

const isProfileLoading = computed(() => coreProfile.value === undefined)
const resolvedCoreProfile = computed(() => coreProfile.value ?? null)
const resolvedAppProfile = computed(() => appProfile.value ?? null)

const userCard = computed(() => userToCard(user.value))
const appCard = computed(() => appToCard(app.value))

const wrapperFor = (card: { to?: string | null } | null) => (card?.to ? 'NuxtLink' : 'div')
const wrapperPropsFor = (card: { to?: string | null } | null) => (card?.to ? { to: card.to } : {})
</script>

```

```vue
import { useProfessional } from '../../../composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Professional/useProfessional.ts'
import { useProfileEnsure } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/profile/mutations/useProfileEnsure'
import { professionalConfig } from '../../../models/profiles/Professional/supporting'

const profileKey = professionalConfig.id ?? 'professional'
const navLabel =
  professionalConfig.navLabel ?? `${professionalConfig.profileType} Profile`
const navIcon = professionalConfig.navIcon ?? 'i-lucide-user'
const navTitle = navLabel

definePageMeta({
  layout: 'console',
  nav: {
    key: 'console-professional-profile',
    label: navLabel,
    icon: navIcon,
    desktop: true,
    layouts: ['console'],
    group: 'profiles',
    profileId: profileKey,
  },
  requiresAuth: true,
})

const { coreProfile, appProfile } = useProfessional()

const { ensure } = useProfileEnsure(professionalConfig)
const isCreating = ref(false)
const createError = ref<string | null>(null)

const createProfile = async () => {
  if (isCreating.value) return
  isCreating.value = true
  createError.value = null

  try {
    await ensure()
  } catch (error) {
    createError.value = (error as Error)?.message || 'Failed to create profile.'
  } finally {
    isCreating.value = false
  }
}

const isProfileLoading = computed(() => coreProfile.value === undefined)
const resolvedCoreProfile = computed(() => coreProfile.value ?? null)
const resolvedAppProfile = computed(() => appProfile.value ?? null)
</script>
```

```vue
)

const allJobsJsonPayload = computed(() => ({
  totalJobs: jobsCollection.value.length,
  jobs: jobsCollection.value,
}))

const filteredJobsDriftPayload = computed(() =>
  jobCards.value.map((card) => {
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, watchEffect } from 'vue'
import { useRoute } from 'vue-router'
import { useHead } from 'nuxt/app'
import type { JobStatus } from '../../models/job.model'
import { useToastify } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/app/ui/useToastify'
import { useJobFetch } from '../../composables/fireux/firestore/jobs/fetch/useJobFetch'
import { useJobUpdate } from '../../composables/fireux/firestore/jobs/mutations/useJobUpdate'

const route = useRoute()
const paramId = route.params.id
const jobId = computed(() =>
  Array.isArray(paramId)
    ? paramId[0]?.toString() ?? null
    : paramId?.toString() ?? null
)

const { job } = useJobFetch(jobId)
const { updateJob } = useJobUpdate()
const { withToast } = useToastify()

const jobTitle = computed(() => job.value?.title || 'Job Details')
const jobSubtitle = computed(() =>
  job.value?.status ? `Status: ${job.value.status}` : 'Job pipeline entry'
)
const statusColor = computed(() =>
  job.value?.status === 'open' ? 'success' : 'neutral'
)

const statusOptions = [
  { label: 'Open', value: 'open' },
  { label: 'Closed', value: 'closed' },
] as const

const statusLocal = ref<JobStatus>('open')
watchEffect(() => {
  statusLocal.value = (job.value?.status as JobStatus) ?? 'open'
})

const saving = ref(false)
const saveStatus = withToast(
  async () => {
    const current = job.value
    if (!current?.id) {
      throw new Error('Job not ready to update')
    }
    saving.value = true
    try {
      await updateJob(current.id, { status: statusLocal.value })
    } finally {
      saving.value = false
    }
  },
  { ok: 'Status updated', fail: 'Failed to update status' }
)

definePageMeta({
  layout: 'default',
})

useHead(() => ({ title: jobTitle.value }))
</script>
```

```vue
// FILE: packages/extensions/fireux-jobs/src/runtime/pages/jobs/create.vue
// NOTE for Copilot:
// - This page is the ONLY entry point for creating jobs.
// - It delegates ALL form state + submission to useJobCreate().
// - The create flow is fake for now (no Firestore) but the UI and pipeline are real.
// - When wiring persistence, update useJobCreate.submit() only.

<template>
  <UPage>
    <UPageHeader
      title="Create Job"
      description="Draft a new job posting to share with professionals."
    />

    <UPageBody class="pagebody">
      <!-- Gate on agent profile (must be an agent to create jobs) -->
      <div v-if="isChecking" class="space-y-3">
        <USkeleton v-for="n in 3" :key="n" class="h-20" />
      </div>

      <OrganismsProfilesAgentCTA v-else-if="!canPostJob" />

      <!-- Main create shell: write + preview -->
      <MoleculesCreateShell
        v-else
        :loading="submitting"
        submit-label="Create"
        @clear="onReset"
        @submit="onSubmit"
      >
        <template #write>
          <JobCreateWrite v-model:form="form" />
        </template>

        <template #preview>
          <JobCreatePreview :form="form" />
        </template>
      </MoleculesCreateShell>
    </UPageBody>
  </UPage>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import { useHead, useRouter } from 'nuxt/app'
import { useAgent } from '../../composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Agent/useAgent.ts'
import { useJobPermissions } from '../../composables/useJobPermissions.ts'
import { useToastify } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/app/ui/useToastify.ts'
import { useJobCreate } from '../../composables/fireux/firestore/jobs/mutations/useJobCreate.ts'

definePageMeta({
  layout: 'default',
  nav: {
    key: 'jobs-create',
    label: 'Create job',
    icon: 'i-lucide-plus',
    order: 61,
    desktop: false,
    mobile: false,
    layouts: ['default'],
  },
  title: 'Create Job',
})

useHead({ title: 'Create Job' })

// Gate on agent profile (same rule as /jobs index)
const { agent, pending } = useAgent()
const { canPostJob } = useJobPermissions(agent)
const isChecking = computed(() => Boolean(pending?.value))

// Create flow: state + fake submit
const { form, reset, submit } = useJobCreate()

const router = useRouter()
const { withToast } = useToastify()
const submitting = ref(false)
const errorMessage = ref('')

function onReset() {
  reset()
  errorMessage.value = ''
}

const onSubmit = withToast(
  async () => {
    submitting.value = true
    errorMessage.value = ''

    try {
      const id = await submit()
      onReset()
      router.push(`/jobs/${id}`)
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof Error) {
        errorMessage.value = err.message
      }
      throw err
    } finally {
      submitting.value = false
    }
  },
  { ok: 'Job created', fail: 'Unable to create job' }
)
</script>
```

```vue
<template>
  <UPage>
    <UPageHeader :title="pageTitle" :description="pageSubtitle">
      <template #ctas>
        <UButton
          size="xs"
          variant="ghost"
          icon="i-lucide-arrow-left"
          :to="jobId ? `/jobs/${jobId}` : '/jobs'"
        >
          Back to details
        </UButton>
      </template>
    </UPageHeader>

    <UPageBody class="pagebody">
      <div v-if="pending" class="space-y-3">
        <USkeleton class="h-14 rounded-xl" />
        <USkeleton class="h-40 rounded-xl" />
      </div>

      <UAlert
        v-else-if="!job"
        color="error"
        variant="soft"
        title="Job not found"
        description="We could not find this job. Return to the jobs list and try again."
      />

      <form v-else class="space-y-6" @submit.prevent="onSave">
        <UFormGroup label="Job title" required>
          <UInput v-model="form.title" placeholder="e.g. Chef de Partie" />
        </UFormGroup>

        <UFormGroup label="Status" required>
          <USelect v-model="form.status" :options="statusOptions" />
        </UFormGroup>

        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
          <span class="text-sm text-gray-500">Update the title or lane.</span>
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
            <UButton
              variant="ghost"
              :disabled="saving || !isDirty"
              @click="onReset"
            >
              Reset changes
            </UButton>
            <UButton
              color="primary"
              :loading="saving"
              :disabled="!isDirty"
              type="submit"
            >
              Save changes
            </UButton>
          </div>
        </div>
      </form>
    </UPageBody>
  </UPage>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, reactive, ref, watchEffect } from 'vue'
import { useRoute } from 'vue-router'
import { useHead } from 'nuxt/app'
import { useToastify } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/app/ui/useToastify'
import type { Job, JobStatus } from '../../../models/job.model'
import { useJobFetch } from '../../../composables/fireux/firestore/jobs/fetch/useJobFetch'
import { useJobUpdate } from '../../../composables/fireux/firestore/jobs/mutations/useJobUpdate'

definePageMeta({
  layout: 'default',
})

useHead({ title: 'Edit Job' })

const route = useRoute()
const { withToast } = useToastify()
const { updateJob } = useJobUpdate()

const routeParam = route.params.id
const jobId = computed(() =>
  Array.isArray(routeParam)
    ? routeParam[0]?.toString() ?? null
    : routeParam?.toString() ?? null
)

const { job: jobRef, pending } = useJobFetch(jobId)

const job = computed<Job | null>(() => jobRef.value)

const form = reactive({
  title: '',
  status: 'open' as JobStatus,
})

const statusOptions = [
  { label: 'Open', value: 'open' },
  { label: 'Closed', value: 'closed' },
] as const

const saving = ref(false)

watchEffect(() => {
  if (!job.value) return
  form.title = job.value.title ?? ''
  form.status = (job.value.status as JobStatus) ?? 'open'
})

const sanitize = (value: string) => value.trim()

const isDirty = computed(() => {
  if (!job.value) return false
  const baseTitle = job.value.title ?? ''
  const baseStatus = (job.value.status as JobStatus) ?? 'open'

  return (
    sanitize(form.title) !== baseTitle.trim() ||
    form.status !== baseStatus
  )
})

function onReset() {
  if (!job.value) return
  form.title = job.value.title ?? ''
  form.status = (job.value.status as JobStatus) ?? 'open'
}

const onSave = withToast(
  async () => {
    if (!job.value || !jobId.value || !isDirty.value) return
    saving.value = true
    const title = sanitize(form.title) || 'Untitled Job'

    try {
      await updateJob(jobId.value, {
        title,
        status: form.status,
      })
    } finally {
      saving.value = false
    }
  },
  { ok: 'Job updated', fail: 'Failed to update job' }
)

const pageTitle = computed(() => form.title || 'Edit job')
const pageSubtitle = computed(() =>
  form.status === 'open' ? 'Open job' : 'Closed job'
)
</script>

```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { professionalConfig } from '../../models/profiles/Professional/Professional.model.ts'
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { navigateTo, useHead, useRoute } from '#imports'
import { useProfileFetch } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/profile/fetch/useProfileFetch'
import { useUser } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/useUser'
import { useProfessionalInterface } from '../../composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Professional/utils/view/useProfessionalInterface'
import type { ProfessionalProfile } from '../../composables/fireux/firestore/profiles/Professional/useProfessional'

const route = useRoute()
const professionalId = computed(() => {
  const raw = Array.isArray(route.params.id) ? route.params.id[0] : route.params.id
  return String(raw ?? '').trim() || null
})

const { profile, pending } = useProfileFetch<ProfessionalProfile>(
  professionalId,
  professionalConfig
)

const professionalProfile = computed(() => profile.coreProfile.value ?? null)

const { appUser } = useUser()

const { card } = useProfessionalInterface(profile)
const professionalCard = computed(() => card())

const resolveName = (p: any) =>
  p?.display_name ||
  p?.name ||
  p?.title ||
  p?.agency_name ||
  p?.company_name ||
  p?.business_name ||
  p?.professional_name ||
  'Profile'

useHead({
  title: computed(() =>
    professionalProfile.value
      ? `${resolveName(professionalProfile.value)} · Professional Profile`
      : 'Professional Profile'
  ),
})

const displayName = computed(() =>
  professionalProfile.value ? resolveName(professionalProfile.value) : null
)
const pageTitle = computed(() => displayName.value ?? 'Professional Profile')
const pageDescription = computed(() =>
  displayName.value
    ? `Inspect ${displayName.value} and their public details.`
    : 'Inspect the selected professional profile.'
)

const canEdit = computed(
  () =>
    !!(
      appUser.value?.id &&
      professionalProfile.value?.id &&
      appUser.value.id === professionalProfile.value.id
    )
)
</script>
```

### packages/extensions/fireux-kitchens/src/module.ts

```ts
import { createResolver, defineNuxtModule } from '@nuxt/kit'
import type { NuxtModule } from '@nuxt/schema'
import { configureComponents } from './config/module/components-config'
import { configureComposables } from './config/module/composables-config'
import { configureLayouts } from './config/module/layouts-config'
import { configureModels } from './config/module/models-config'
import { configurePages } from './config/module/pages-config'
import { configurePlugins } from './config/module/plugins-config'
import { configureRuntime } from './config/module/runtime-config'
import { configureServer } from './config/module/server-config'

export interface ModuleOptions {
  prefix?: string
}

const module: NuxtModule<ModuleOptions> = defineNuxtModule<ModuleOptions>({
  meta: {
    name: 'fireux-kitchens',
    version: '0.1.0',
    configKey: 'fireuxKitchens',
  },
  defaults: {
    prefix: 'Fire',
  },
  async setup(_options, nuxt) {
    const resolver = createResolver(import.meta.url)

    configureRuntime(nuxt, 'kitchens')
    configurePlugins(resolver)
    configureComposables(resolver)
    configureComponents(resolver)
    configureLayouts(resolver, nuxt)
    configureModels(resolver)
    configurePages(resolver, nuxt)
    configureServer(resolver)
  },
})

export default module
```

```vue
import type { KitchenCard } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/kitchen/utils/view/useKitchenInterface'

  prop?: string
  avatarUrl?: string
  showSubtitle?: boolean
  showBadges?: boolean
  showTagline?: boolean

  // Back-compat with older callsites
  card?: Partial<KitchenCard.Card> | null
  avatar?: string | null
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  avatarUrl: '',
  prop: '',
  showSubtitle: true,
  showBadges: true,
  showTagline: true,

  card: null,
  avatar: null,
})

// Allow passing either structured props or a legacy `card` object.
const to = props.to || props.card?.to || ''
const name = props.name || props.card?.name || ''
const website = props.website || props.card?.website || ''
const badges = props.badges.length ? props.badges : props.card?.badges || []
const avatarUrl = props.avatarUrl || props.card?.avatarUrl || props.avatar || ''
</script>
```

```vue
  <UCard :ui="{ body: 'space-y-4' }">
    <template #header>
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between">

    </div>

    <div v-else>
```
