```vue
        v-if="variant === 'pill'"
        class="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3"
      >
        <component
          :is="wrapperFor(card)"
          v-for="card in cards"
          :key="card.id"
          v-bind="wrapperPropsFor(card)"
          class="block"
        >
          <KitchenCardsPill v-bind="card" />
        </component>
      </div>

      <div v-else class="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
        <component
          :is="wrapperFor(card)"
          v-for="card in cards"
          :key="card.id"
          v-bind="wrapperPropsFor(card)"
          class="block"
        >
          <KitchenCardsCell v-bind="card" />
        </component>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div v-if="showDebug" class="pt-3">
      <DevJson
        :title="'Kitchens (JSON)'"
        :data="debugPayload"
        :default-open="false"
      />
    </div>
  </UCard>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import { useKitchenInterface } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/kitchen/utils/view/useKitchenInterface';
import type { Kitchen } from '../../../../../models/kitchen.model';

const props = defineProps<{ collection?: Kitchen[] }>()

const collection = computed(() => props.collection ?? [])
const { card: makeCard } = useKitchenInterface()
type KitchenCardShape = NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof makeCard>>
const cards = computed(() =>
  collection.value
    .map((kitchen) => makeCard(kitchen))
    .filter((c): c is NonNullable<typeof c> => Boolean(c))
)
const showDebug = import.meta.dev
const debugPayload = computed(() => ({
  totalKitchens: collection.value.length,
  kitchens: collection.value,
}))

type Variant = 'pill' | 'cell'
const variant = ref<Variant>('cell')
const toggleVariant = () => {
  variant.value = variant.value === 'pill' ? 'cell' : 'pill'
}

const wrapperFor = (card: KitchenCardShape) => (card.to ? 'NuxtLink' : 'div')
const wrapperPropsFor = (card: KitchenCardShape) => (card.to ? { to: card.to } : {})
</script>

```

### packages/extensions/fireux-kitchens/src/runtime/components/organisms/Kitchen/Create/System.vue

```vue
<template>
  <section class="space-y-4">
    <UCard :ui="{ body: 'space-y-4' }">
      <template #header>
        <div class="space-y-1">
          <div class="font-medium">Select a place</div>
          <div class="text-sm text-dimmed">
            We’ll use the existing kitchen if it exists, or create the overlay if it doesn’t.
          </div>
        </div>
      </template>

      <PlaceSearchSection
        collection="kitchens"
        normalized-field="search_term_normalized"
        :local-fallback="true"
        :extra-collections="['places']"
        :allow-google="true"
        @confirmed="onPlaceConfirmed"
      />

      <div v-if="successId" class="text-sm text-green-600">
        Kitchen created: {{ successId }}
      </div>
      <div v-else-if="existingId" class="space-y-2 text-sm text-amber-600">
        <div>Kitchen already exists: {{ existingId }}</div>
        <UButton
          size="xs"
          variant="soft"
          color="neutral"
          :to="`/kitchens/${encodeURIComponent(existingId)}`"
        >
          Inspect kitchen
        </UButton>
      </div>
      <div v-if="error" class="text-sm text-red-600">
        {{ error }}
      </div>
    </UCard>
  </section>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { doc, getDoc } from 'firebase/firestore'
import type { PlaceUpsertInput } from 'fireux-places/runtime/models/place.model'
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { useFirestore } from 'vuefire'
import { useKitchenCreate } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/kitchen/mutations/useKitchenCreate'
import { useKitchenUpdate } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/kitchen/mutations/useKitchenUpdate'

const { createKitchen } = useKitchenCreate()
const { updateKitchen } = useKitchenUpdate()
const db = useFirestore()

const error = ref<string | null>(null)
const successId = ref<string | null>(null)
const existingId = ref<string | null>(null)

const normalizeSearchTerm = (value: string) =>
  value
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .toLowerCase()
    .trim()

async function onPlaceConfirmed(payload: { placeId: string; place: PlaceUpsertInput }) {
  error.value = null
  successId.value = null
  existingId.value = null

  try {
    const id = payload.placeId
    const place = payload.place

    const existingSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'kitchens', id))
    if (existingSnap.exists()) {
      existingId.value = id
      const existing = existingSnap.data() as Record<string, any>
      const searchTerm = `${place.name} ${place.formatted_address ?? ''}`
        .toLowerCase()
        .trim()
      const searchTermNormalized = normalizeSearchTerm(searchTerm)
      if (!existing.search_term || !existing.search_term_normalized) {
        await updateKitchen(id, {
          search_term: existing.search_term || searchTerm,
          search_term_normalized:
            existing.search_term_normalized || searchTermNormalized,
        } as any)
      }
      return
    }

    const createdId = await createKitchen({
      id,
      place,
      name: place.name,
      formatted_address: place.formatted_address ?? '',
      lat: place.lat ?? 0,
      lng: place.lng ?? 0,
      place_image: place.place_image ?? '',
      website: '',
      search_term: `${place.name} ${place.formatted_address ?? ''}`
        .toLowerCase()
        .trim(),
      search_term_normalized: normalizeSearchTerm(
        `${place.name} ${place.formatted_address ?? ''}`
      ),
    })

    successId.value = createdId
  } catch (e) {
    error.value = e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Unable to create kitchen'
  }
}
</script>
```

```vue
<template>
  <section class="space-y-3">
    <ClientOnly>
      <UCard v-if="!kitchen" variant="subtle">

            />

              Uploading image…
            </p>
          </div>
        </UCard>

        <UCard>
          <MoleculesFormsFirestoreSimpleField
            label="Kitchen name"
            :firebase-value="kitchen.name"
            placeholder="e.g. Misebox Kitchen"
            :maxlength="120"
            :update-function="handleUpdateName"
          />
        </UCard>

        <UCard>
          <MoleculesFormsFirestoreSimpleField
            label="Website"
            :firebase-value="kitchen.website"
            placeholder="https://…"
            :maxlength="200"
            :update-function="handleUpdateWebsite"
          />
        </UCard>

        <UCard>
          <MoleculesFormsFirestoreSimpleField
            label="Formatted address"
            :firebase-value="kitchen.formatted_address"
            placeholder="Gutenbrunnenstrasse 6, 3775 Lenk, Switzerland"
            :maxlength="200"
            :update-function="handleUpdateAddress"
          />
        </UCard>
      </div>
    </ClientOnly>
  </section>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useToastify } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/app/ui/useToastify'
import { useImageStorage } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firebase/useImageStorage'
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import { useKitchenUpdate } from '../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/kitchen/mutations/useKitchenUpdate'
import type { Kitchen } from '../../../../models/kitchen.model'

const props = defineProps<{ kitchen: Kitchen | null }>()
const kitchen = computed(() => props.kitchen)
const kitchenId = computed(() => kitchen.value?.id ?? '')

const avatarInitials = computed(() => {
  const name = kitchen.value?.name || 'K'
  const trimmed = name.trim()
  if (!trimmed) return 'K'
  return trimmed
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0]?.toUpperCase())
    .join('')
})

const avatarUploading = ref(false)
const { uploadImage } = useImageStorage()
const { updateKitchen } = useKitchenUpdate()
const toast = useToastify()

const sanitize = (value: string) => value.trim()
const buildSearchTerm = (name?: string, address?: string) =>
  `${name ?? ''} ${address ?? ''}`.toLowerCase().trim()
const normalizeSearchTerm = (value: string) =>
  value
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .toLowerCase()
    .trim()

async function handleAvatarUpload(file: File) {
  if (!kitchenId.value) return
  avatarUploading.value = true
  try {
    const url = await uploadImage(`kitchens/${kitchenId.value}/avatar`, file)
    await updateKitchen(kitchenId.value, { place_image: url } as any)
    toast.success('Image updated')
  } catch (error) {
    const msg = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Please try again.'
    toast.error(`Failed to update image: ${msg}`)
    throw error
  } finally {
    avatarUploading.value = false
  }
}

async function handleUpdateName(value: string) {
  if (!kitchenId.value) return
  try {
    const name = sanitize(value) || 'Untitled Kitchen'
    const address = kitchen.value?.formatted_address ?? ''
    const searchTerm = buildSearchTerm(name, address)
    await updateKitchen(kitchenId.value, {
      name,
      search_term: searchTerm,
      search_term_normalized: normalizeSearchTerm(searchTerm),
    })
    toast.success('Name updated')
  } catch (error) {
    const msg = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Please try again.'
    toast.error(`Failed to update name: ${msg}`)
    throw error
  }
}

async function handleUpdateWebsite(value: string) {
  if (!kitchenId.value) return
  try {
    await updateKitchen(kitchenId.value, { website: sanitize(value) })
    toast.success('Website updated')
  } catch (error) {
    const msg = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Please try again.'
    toast.error(`Failed to update website: ${msg}`)
    throw error
  }
}

async function handleUpdateAddress(value: string) {
  if (!kitchenId.value) return
  try {
    const address = sanitize(value)
    const name = kitchen.value?.name ?? ''
    const searchTerm = buildSearchTerm(name, address)
    await updateKitchen(kitchenId.value, {
      formatted_address: address,
      search_term: searchTerm,
      search_term_normalized: normalizeSearchTerm(searchTerm),
    } as any)
    toast.success('Address updated')
  } catch (error) {
    const msg = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Please try again.'
    toast.error(`Failed to update address: ${msg}`)
    throw error
  }
}
</script>

```

### packages/extensions/fireux-kitchens/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/kitchen/fetch/useKitchenCollection.ts

```ts
import { useFirestoreManager } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreManager'
import type { Ref, ShallowRef } from 'vue'
import { computed, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue'

export function useKitchenCollection<
  T extends Record<string, any> = Record<string, any>,
>(collectionPath = 'kitchens') {
  const { firestoreFetchCollection } = useFirestoreManager()

  const path = computed(() => collectionPath)

  const collectionRef = shallowRef(null) as ShallowRef<
    Ref<T[] | undefined> | null
  >
  watch(
    path,
    (nextPath: string) => {
      collectionRef.value = firestoreFetchCollection<T>(nextPath)
    },
    { immediate: true }
  )

  const collection = computed(() => collectionRef.value?.value)
  const count = computed(() => (collection.value ?? []).length)

  return { collectionPath: path, collection, count }
}

```

### packages/extensions/fireux-kitchens/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/kitchen/fetch/useKitchenFetch.ts

```ts
import { useFirestoreRead } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreRead'
import { computed } from 'vue'
import type { Kitchen } from '../../../../../../models/kitchen.model'

const COLLECTION_PATH = 'kitchens'

/**
 * Canon fetch helpers for Kitchen (collection + single doc).
 * Canon: overlay collection `kitchens/{placeId}`.
 */
export function useKitchenFetch() {
  const { firestoreFetchCollection, firestoreFetchDoc } = useFirestoreRead()

  const source = firestoreFetchCollection<Kitchen>(COLLECTION_PATH)
  const kitchens = computed(() => source.value ?? [])

  const kitchen = (id: string) => firestoreFetchDoc<Kitchen>(COLLECTION_PATH, id)

  return {
    kitchens,
    kitchen,
  }
}
```

```ts
import { useFirestoreCreate } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreCreate'
import type { PlaceUpsertInput } from 'fireux-places/runtime/models/place.model'
import type { Kitchen, KitchenCreateInput } from '../../../../../../models/kitchen.model'

export const KitchenPayload = {
  id: '',
  name: '',
  formatted_address: '',
  lat: 0,
  lng: 0,
  place_image: '',
  website: '',
}

export const KitchenStampOptions = {
  creator: true,
} as const

export function useKitchenCreate() {
  const { setDocument } = useFirestoreCreate()

  async function createKitchen(
    input: KitchenCreateInput & { place?: PlaceUpsertInput }
  ): Promise<string> {
    if (!input?.id) {
      throw new Error('Kitchen id is required')
    }

    const { place, ...payload } = input
    void place

    await setDocument<Kitchen>('kitchens', payload.id, payload as Kitchen, {
      creator: true,
    })

    return payload.id
  }

  return { createKitchen }
}
```

### packages/extensions/fireux-kitchens/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/kitchen/mutations/useKitchenUpdate.ts

```ts
import { useFirestoreManager } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreManager'
import type { Kitchen, KitchenUpdateInput } from '../../../../../../models/kitchen.model'

const COLLECTION_PATH = 'kitchens'

export function useKitchenUpdate() {
  const { updateDocument } = useFirestoreManager()

  const updateKitchen = async (kitchenId: string, patch: KitchenUpdateInput) => {
    const id = String(kitchenId ?? '').trim()
    if (!id) throw new Error('[useKitchenUpdate] kitchenId is required')

    const next: KitchenUpdateInput = { ...patch }
    if (typeof next.name === 'string') next.name = next.name.trim()
    if (typeof next.website === 'string') next.website = next.website.trim()
    if (typeof (next as any).place_image === 'string') (next as any).place_image = (next as any).place_image.trim()
    if (typeof (next as any).formatted_address === 'string') (next as any).formatted_address = (next as any).formatted_address.trim()

    await updateDocument<Kitchen>(COLLECTION_PATH, id, next)
  }

  return { updateKitchen }
}
```

```ts
import { useKitchenCollection } from './fetch/useKitchenCollection'

export interface UseKitchensOptions {
  collectionPath?: string
}

export function useKitchens<
  T extends Record<string, any> = Record<string, any>,
>(options: UseKitchensOptions = {}) {
  const { collectionPath, collection, count } = useKitchenCollection<T>(
    options.collectionPath ?? 'kitchens'
  )

  return { collectionPath, collection, count }
}
```

```ts
import type { Kitchen } from '../../../../../../../models/kitchen.model'

export namespace KitchenCard {
  export type Card = {
    id: string
    to: string

    // Media (empty string means unset)
    avatarUrl: string

    // Primary display fields
    title: string
    subtitle: string

    name: string
    website: string

    // Status/label chips
    badges: string[]
  }
}

export function useKitchenInterface() {
  function map(kitchen: Kitchen): KitchenCard.Card {
    return {
      id: kitchen.id,
      to: `/kitchens/${kitchen.id}`,

      avatarUrl: kitchen.place_image,
      title: kitchen.name,
      subtitle: kitchen.website,

      name: kitchen.name,
      website: kitchen.website,

      badges: [],
    }
  }

  function card(target?: Kitchen | null | undefined): KitchenCard.Card | null {
    return target ? map(target) : null
  }

  function searchText(kitchen: Kitchen): string {
    return `${kitchen.name} ${kitchen.website} ${kitchen.id}`.toLowerCase()
  }

  return { card, searchText }
}
```

```ts
// FILE: packages/extensions/fireux-kitchens/src/runtime/models/kitchen.model.ts

import type { FireuxStamped } from 'fireux-core/runtime/models/core/meta.model'
import type { FirebaseTimestamp } from 'fireux-core/types/firebase'

/**
 * Kitchen overlay (Place-bound)
 * Firestore: kitchens/{placeId}
 * - Document ID is the canonical Place ID.
 * - This is an overlay on top of an existing Place.
 *
 * Canon strategy:
 * - Runtime object is the single source of truth
 * - TypeScript derives types from it
 * - Drift is detected by comparing data ↔ model shape
 */

// 🔑 Runtime + canonical shape (source of truth)
export const Kitchen = {
  /** Canonical Place ID (also the Firestore document ID). */
  id: '',

  name: '',
  formatted_address: '',

  /** Canonical location snapshot */
  lat: 0,
  lng: 0,
  place_image: '',

  /** Search helpers */
  search_term: '',
  search_term_normalized: '',

  /** Optional kitchen-specific details (empty string means unset) */
  website: '',

  // Authored (FireuxStamped)
  creator_id: undefined as FireuxStamped['creator_id'],
  created_at: {} as FirebaseTimestamp,
  updated_at: {} as FirebaseTimestamp,
} as const

export type Kitchen = {
  [K in keyof typeof Kitchen]: (typeof Kitchen)[K]
}

export type KitchenCreateInput = Omit<Kitchen, 'created_at' | 'updated_at' | 'creator_id'>
export type KitchenUpdateInput = Partial<Omit<KitchenCreateInput, 'id'>>
```

```vue
    key: 'kitchens',
    label: 'Kitchens',
    icon: 'i-lucide-chef-hat',
    order: 55,
    desktop: true,
    mobile: true,
    layouts: ['default'],
  },
  title: 'Kitchens',
  description: 'Kitchen overlays resolved for this runtime.',
  layout: 'default',
  name: 'KitchensIndexPage',
})

const pageTitle = 'Kitchens'
const pageDescription =
  'Create a kitchen and browse all kitchens available to this runtime.'

const { appName } = useFireUXConfig()
useHead({ title: `${appName} | ${pageTitle}` })

const { kitchens } = useKitchenFetch()
const { collection: placesCollection } = usePlaces<Record<string, any>>()

const placesById = computed(() => {
  const map = new Map<string, Record<string, any>>()
  for (const place of placesCollection.value ?? []) {
    if (place?.id) map.set(String(place.id), place)
  }
  return map
})

const mergedKitchens = computed(() =>
  (kitchens.value ?? []).map((kitchen) => {
    const place = placesById.value.get(String(kitchen.id))
    if (!place) return kitchen
    const name = kitchen.name || place.name || ''
    const formattedAddress = kitchen.formatted_address || place.formatted_address || ''
    const searchTerm = kitchen.search_term || `${name} ${formattedAddress}`.toLowerCase().trim()
    const searchTermNormalized =
      kitchen.search_term_normalized || searchTerm
        .normalize('NFD')
        .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
        .toLowerCase()
        .trim()
    return {
      ...place,
      ...kitchen,
      id: kitchen.id,
      name,
      formatted_address: formattedAddress,
      lat: Number.isFinite(kitchen.lat)
        ? kitchen.lat
        : Number.isFinite(place.lat)
          ? place.lat
          : 0,
      lng: Number.isFinite(kitchen.lng)
        ? kitchen.lng
        : Number.isFinite(place.lng)
          ? place.lng
          : 0,
      place_image: kitchen.place_image || place.place_image || '',
      website: kitchen.website || '',
      search_term: searchTerm,
      search_term_normalized: searchTermNormalized,
    }
  })
)

const collection = computed(() => mergedKitchens.value)
</script>

```

### packages/extensions/fireux-places/src/config/module/server-config.ts

```ts
import { addServerHandler, type Resolver } from '@nuxt/kit'
import { existsSync } from 'node:fs'

export function configureServer(resolver: Resolver) {
  // Register only actively used server routes to keep the surface minimal
  const base = resolver.resolve('./runtime/server/api')

  function register(route: string, filename: string) {
    const candidates = [
      `${base}/${filename}.ts`,
      `${base}/${filename}.mjs`,
      `${base}/${filename}.js`,
      `${base}/${filename}.cjs`,
    ]
    const handler = candidates.find((path) => existsSync(path))
    if (handler) {
      addServerHandler({ route, handler })
    }
  }

  register('/api/places/autocomplete', 'places/autocomplete.get')
  register('/api/places/details', 'places/details.get')
  register('/api/places/logo', 'places/logo.get')
}
```

### packages/extensions/fireux-places/src/module.ts

```ts
import { createResolver, defineNuxtModule } from '@nuxt/kit'
import type { NuxtModule } from '@nuxt/schema'
import { configureComponents } from './config/module/components-config'
import { configureComposables } from './config/module/composables-config'
import { configureLayouts } from './config/module/layouts-config'
import { configureModels } from './config/module/models-config'
import { configurePages } from './config/module/pages-config'
import { configurePlugins } from './config/module/plugins-config'
import { configureRuntime } from './config/module/runtime-config'
import { configureServer } from './config/module/server-config'

export interface ModuleOptions {
  prefix?: string
  types?: string[]
  /** Optional filter map for Google Autocomplete prediction types by context type.
   *  Example: { kitchen: ['restaurant','cafe','food_truck'] }
   */
  googleAutocompleteTypeFilters?: Record<string, string[]>
}

const module: NuxtModule<ModuleOptions> = defineNuxtModule<ModuleOptions>({
  meta: {
    name: 'fireux-places',
    version: '0.1.0',
    configKey: 'fireuxPlaces',
  },
  defaults: {
    prefix: 'Fire',
    types: [],
    googleAutocompleteTypeFilters: {},
  },
  async setup(options, nuxt) {
    const resolver = createResolver(import.meta.url)

    configureRuntime(nuxt, 'places', {
      enabled: true,
      types: options.types || [],
      googleAutocompleteTypeFilters: options.googleAutocompleteTypeFilters || {},
    })
    configurePlugins(resolver)
    configureComponents(resolver)
    configureComposables(resolver, options)
    configureLayouts(resolver, nuxt)
    configureModels(resolver)
    configurePages(resolver, nuxt)
    configureServer(resolver)
  },
})

export default module

```

```vue
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { usePlaceLogoState } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/place/utils/view/usePlaceLogos'
import type { PlaceCard } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/place/utils/view/usePlacesInterface'

type Props = Pick<PlaceCard.Card, 'id' | 'to' | 'name' | 'formattedAddress' | 'imageUrl'> & {
  formatted_address?: string
  source?: 'google' | 'fireux' | 'manual'
  prop?: string
  showSubtitle?: boolean
  showSource?: boolean
  showTagline?: boolean
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  source: 'fireux',
  prop: '',
  showSubtitle: true,
  showSource: false,
  showTagline: false,
})

const resolvedAddress = computed(
  () => props.formattedAddress || props.formatted_address || ''
)

const placeRef = computed(() => ({
  id: props.id,
  name: props.name,
  formatted_address: resolvedAddress.value,
  imageUrl: props.imageUrl,
  source: props.source,
}))

const { avatar } = usePlaceLogoState(placeRef)

const resolvedImageUrl = computed(
  () => props.imageUrl || avatar.value || ''
)

const sourceLabel = computed(() =>
  props.source === 'fireux'
    ? 'FireUX'
    : props.source === 'manual'
      ? 'Manual'
      : props.source === 'google'
        ? 'Google'
        : ''
)
</script>
```

```vue
          </NuxtLink>
          <div v-else class="block">
            <PlaceCardsPill v-bind="card" />
          </div>
        </template>
      </div>

      <div v-else class="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
        <template v-for="card in cards" :key="card.id">
          <NuxtLink v-if="card.to" :to="card.to" class="block">
            <PlaceCardsCell v-bind="card" />
          </NuxtLink>
          <div v-else class="block">
            <PlaceCardsCell v-bind="card" />
          </div>
        </template>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div v-if="showDebug" class="pt-3">
      <DevJson
        :title="'Places (JSON)'"
        :data="debugPayload"
        :default-open="false"

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import { usePlacesInterface } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/place/utils/view/usePlacesInterface';
import type { BasePlace } from '../../../../../models/place.model';

const props = defineProps<{ collection?: BasePlace[] }>()

const collection = computed(() => props.collection ?? [])
const { card: makeCard } = usePlacesInterface()
const cards = computed(() =>
  collection.value
    .map((place) => makeCard(place))
    .filter((c): c is NonNullable<typeof c> => Boolean(c))
)
const showDebug = import.meta.dev
const debugPayload = computed(() => ({
  totalPlaces: collection.value.length,
  places: collection.value,
}))

type Variant = 'pill' | 'cell'
const variant = ref<Variant>('cell')
const toggleVariant = () => {
  variant.value = variant.value === 'pill' ? 'cell' : 'pill'
}

</script>
```

```vue
import { useToastify } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/app/ui/useToastify'
import { useImageStorage } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firebase/useImageStorage'
import { useUserFetch } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/fetch/useUserFetch'
import { useUser } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/useUser'
import { useUserInterface } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/utils/view/useUserInterface'
import { useFirestoreUpdate } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreUpdate'
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import { usePlaceClaim } from '../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/place/mutations/usePlaceClaim'
import type { Place } from '../../../../models/place.model'

const props = defineProps<{ place: Place | null }>()
const place = computed(() => props.place)
const placeId = computed(() => place.value?.id ?? '')
const { currentUser, isAdmin } = useUser()
const isManual = computed(() => place.value?.source === 'manual')

const claimedUserId = computed(() => place.value?.claimed_by || '')
const { user: claimedUser } = useUserFetch(claimedUserId)
const { card: userCard } = useUserInterface(claimedUser)
const claimedUserPill = computed(() => userCard(claimedUser.value))

const wrapperFor = (card: { to?: string | null } | null) => (card?.to ? 'NuxtLink' : 'div')
const wrapperPropsFor = (card: { to?: string | null } | null) => (card?.to ? { to: card.to } : {})

const hasImage = computed(() => !!place.value?.place_image)
const isClaimedByUser = computed(() => {
	const claimedBy = place.value?.claimed_by
	if (!claimedBy) return false
	return currentUser.value?.id === claimedBy
})
const canEditImage = computed(
	() => !hasImage.value || isAdmin.value || isClaimedByUser.value
)
const canNormalizeImage = computed(
	() => hasImage.value && canEditImage.value
)

const avatarInitials = computed(() => {
	const name = place.value?.name || 'P'
	const trimmed = name.trim()
	if (!trimmed) return 'P'
	return trimmed
		.split(/\s+/)
		.filter(Boolean)
		.slice(0, 2)
		.map((part) => part[0]?.toUpperCase())
		.join('')
})

const avatarUploading = ref(false)
const isNormalizingImage = ref(false)
const isClaiming = ref(false)
const { uploadImage } = useImageStorage()
const { updateDocument } = useFirestoreUpdate()
const toast = useToastify()
const { claimPlace } = usePlaceClaim()

const canClaim = computed(() => !place.value?.claimed_by)
const sanitize = (value: string) => value.trim()
const parseNumber = (value: string | number) => {
	const n = typeof value === 'number' ? value : Number(String(value).trim())
	return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : null
}
```

```vue
  const uploadSource =
    sanitizeAvatar((preview as any).place_image) ?? sanitizeAvatar((draft as any).place_image)
```

```vue
})

  if (!isExisting.value) return 'Confirm'

})

  if (selectedCollection.value === 'companies') {

  if (selectedCollection.value === 'places') {

  return 'Confirm will use the existing record — no duplicate will be created.'
})
```

### packages/extensions/fireux-places/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/place/fetch/google/usePlacesGoogle.ts

```ts
import type { GooglePlace, PlaceUpsertInput } from '../../../../../../../models/place.model'
import type { PlaceCard } from '../../utils/view/usePlacesInterface'

const GOOGLE_AUTOCOMPLETE_ENDPOINT = '/api/places/autocomplete'

export type PlacesAutocompleteDebug = {
  query: string
  url: string
  ok: boolean
  httpStatus: number | null
  error: string | null
  upstreamStatus: string | null
  predictionsCount: number
  timeMs: number
  at: string
}

let lastAutocompleteDebug: PlacesAutocompleteDebug | null = null
export function getLastPlacesAutocompleteDebug(): PlacesAutocompleteDebug | null {
  return lastAutocompleteDebug
}

const log = (...args: unknown[]) => {
  if (import.meta.dev) {
    console.info('[places][logos]', ...args)
  }
}

/** Normalize any incoming place_id:
 *  - trim
 *  - remove surrounding quotes
 *  - remove accidental `places/` prefix
 *  - return null if empty after normalization
 */
export const canonicalPlaceId = (id?: string | null): string | null =>
  (id ?? '')
    .trim()
    .replace(/^"+/, '')
    .replace(/"+$/, '')
    .replace(/^places\//, '') || null

/** Type for Google Autocomplete prediction */
interface GooglePrediction {
  place_id: string
  description?: string
  structured_formatting?: {
    main_text?: string
    secondary_text?: string
  }
  types?: string[]
  terms?: { value: string }[]
}

/**
 * Calls `/api/places/autocomplete?q=...` and returns normalized cells.
 * `excludeIds` should contain canonicalized place_ids to filter dupes.
 */
export async function fetchGoogle(
  query: string,
  excludeIds: Set<string>,
  limit: number,
  options?: { type?: string | null }
): Promise<PlaceCard.Card[]> {
  if (limit <= 0 || typeof window === 'undefined') return []

  const start = Date.now()
  try {
    const url = new URL(GOOGLE_AUTOCOMPLETE_ENDPOINT, window.location.origin)
    url.searchParams.set('q', query)
    if (options?.type) {
      url.searchParams.set('type', String(options.type))
    }

    const res = await fetch(url.toString(), {
      headers: { accept: 'application/json' },
    })
    if (!res.ok) {
      if (import.meta.dev) {
        lastAutocompleteDebug = {
          query,
          url: url.toString(),
          ok: false,
          httpStatus: res.status,
          error: 'http_error',
          upstreamStatus: null,
          predictionsCount: 0,
          timeMs: Date.now() - start,
          at: new Date().toISOString(),
        }
      }
      return []
    }

    const json = await res.json()

    if (import.meta.dev) {
      const preds = Array.isArray(json?.predictions) ? json.predictions : []
      lastAutocompleteDebug = {
        query,
        url: url.toString(),
        ok: true,
        httpStatus: res.status,
        error: (json?.error as string | undefined) ?? null,
        upstreamStatus: (json?.upstreamStatus as string | undefined) ?? null,
        predictionsCount: preds.length,
        timeMs: Date.now() - start,
        at: new Date().toISOString(),
      }
    }

    if (import.meta.dev && json?.error) {
      console.warn('[places] autocomplete error', {
        query,
        error: json.error,
        upstreamStatus: json.upstreamStatus ?? null,
      })
    }
    const preds: GooglePrediction[] = Array.isArray(json?.predictions)
      ? json.predictions
      : []

    const cells: PlaceCard.Card[] = preds
      .filter((p) => {
        const id = canonicalPlaceId(p?.place_id)
        return id && !excludeIds.has(id)
      })
      .slice(0, limit)
      .map((p): PlaceCard.Card => {
        const id = canonicalPlaceId(p.place_id) as string
        const main = p.structured_formatting?.main_text
        const secondary = p.structured_formatting?.secondary_text
        const desc = p.description
        const formattedAddress = secondary || desc || ''
        return {
          id,
          to: `/places/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`,

          avatarUrl: '',
          title: main || desc || 'Unknown place',
          subtitle: formattedAddress,
          badges: [],

          name: main || desc || 'Unknown place',
          formattedAddress,

          imageUrl: '',
          source: 'google',
        }
      })

    log('autocomplete cells resolved', {
      query,
      total: cells.length,
      immediateLogoIds: cells
        .filter((cell) => Boolean(cell.imageUrl))
        .map((cell) => cell.id),
      pendingCount: cells.filter((cell) => !cell.imageUrl).length,
    })

    if (import.meta.dev) {
      console.log('[places] google supplement results', {
        query,
        requested: limit,
        count: cells.length,
        ids: cells.map((c) => c.id),
      })
    }

    return cells
  } catch (err) {
    if (import.meta.dev) {
      try {
        const url = new URL(GOOGLE_AUTOCOMPLETE_ENDPOINT, window.location.origin)
        url.searchParams.set('q', query)
        lastAutocompleteDebug = {
          query,
          url: url.toString(),
          ok: false,
          httpStatus: null,
          error: 'exception',
          upstreamStatus: null,
          predictionsCount: 0,
          timeMs: Date.now() - start,
          at: new Date().toISOString(),
        }
      } catch {
        // ignore
      }
    }
    if (import.meta.dev) console.error('[places] google supplement failed', err)
    return []
  }
}

function toStoredPlace(g: GooglePlace): PlaceUpsertInput {
  const search_term = `${g.name} ${g.formatted_address}`.toLowerCase()
  return {
    id: g.id,
    name: g.name,
    formatted_address: g.formatted_address,
```

```ts
import { useFirestoreRead } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreRead'
import { useFirestoreSearch } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreSearch'
import { ref, watch } from 'vue'
import type { BasePlace } from '../../../../../../../models/place.model'
import type { PlaceCard } from '../../utils/view/usePlacesInterface'
import {
  canonicalPlaceId,
  fetchGoogle,
  fetchPlaceDetails,
  getLastPlacesAutocompleteDebug,
  type PlaceDetailsResult,
} from '../google/usePlacesGoogle'

const sanitize = (url?: string | null) =>
  url && !/mapfiles\/place_api\/icons/i.test(url) ? url : null

type PlaceSearchRow = {
  id?: string
  place_id?: string
  name: string
  formatted_address?: string
  place_image?: string | null
  image_url?: string | null
  search_term: string
  search_term_normalized?: string
  source?: string
  claimed_by?: string
}

// in-memory cache for logos by id
const logoCache = new Map<string, string | null>()
const pendingLogos = new Map<string, Promise<string | null>>()

async function resolveLogo(
  details: PlaceDetailsResult
): Promise<string | null> {
  if (!globalThis.window) {
    return null
  }

  const params = new URLSearchParams()
  if (details.google.website) {
    params.set('website', details.google.website)
  } else if (details.raw?.url) {
    try {
      params.set('domain', new URL(details.raw.url).hostname)
    } catch {
      /* ignore */
    }
  } else {
    params.set('q', details.google.name || 'place')
  }

  try {
    const origin = globalThis.window.location.origin
    const url = new URL('/api/places/logo', origin)
    url.search = params.toString()
    const res = await fetch(url.toString(), {
      headers: { accept: 'application/json' },
    })
    if (!res.ok) return null
    const { url: candidate } = (await res.json()) as { url?: string | null }
    return sanitize(candidate ?? null)
  } catch (e) {
    console.debug('[places][logo] detector failed', e)
    return null
  }
}

export function usePlacesSearch(options?: {
  type?: string | null
  collection?: string
  normalizedField?: keyof PlaceSearchRow & string
  localFallback?: boolean
  extraCollections?: string[]
  allowGoogle?: boolean
}) {
  const { prefixSearch } = useFirestoreSearch()
  const { firestoreFetchCollection } = useFirestoreRead()

  const collectionName = options?.collection || 'places'
  const extraCollections = options?.extraCollections ?? []
  const allowGoogle = options?.allowGoogle ?? collectionName === 'places'
  const localCollection = options?.localFallback
    ? firestoreFetchCollection<Record<string, any>>(collectionName)
    : null
  const extraLocalCollections = options?.localFallback
    ? extraCollections.map((name) => ({
        name,
        data: firestoreFetchCollection<Record<string, any>>(name),
      }))
    : []

  const query = ref('')
  const results = ref<PlaceCard.Card[]>([])
  const selected = ref<BasePlace | null>(null)
  const isSearching = ref(false)

  const debug = ref<Record<string, unknown> | null>(null)

  async function searchPlaces(q: string) {
    const term = q.trim().toLowerCase()
    const termNormalized = term
      ? term.normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
      : ''
    if (!term) {
      results.value = []
      if (import.meta.dev) {
        debug.value = {
          term: null,
          stage: 'idle',
        }
      }
      return
    }

    const mapToCard = (p: any, collectionOverride?: string): PlaceCard.Card => {
      const id = canonicalPlaceId(p?.place_id ?? p?.id) ?? ''
      const sourceRaw = typeof p?.source === 'string' ? p.source : 'fireux'
      const safeSource =
        sourceRaw === 'google'
          ? 'google'
          : sourceRaw === 'manual'
            ? 'manual'
            : 'fireux'

      const placeImageRaw = p?.place_image ?? p?.image_url
      const place_image = typeof placeImageRaw === 'string' ? placeImageRaw : ''
      const formattedAddress =
        typeof p?.formatted_address === 'string' ? p.formatted_address : ''

      return {
        id,
        to: `/places/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`,

        avatarUrl: place_image,
        title: String(p?.name ?? ''),
        subtitle: formattedAddress,
        badges: [],

        name: String(p?.name ?? ''),
        formattedAddress,

        imageUrl: place_image,
        source: safeSource as any,

        collection: collectionOverride ?? p?.collection ?? undefined,

        claimedBy: typeof p?.claimed_by === 'string' ? p.claimed_by : '',
      }
    }

    isSearching.value = true
    try {
      let firestoreFailed = false
      let firestoreError: unknown = null
      let fx: PlaceSearchRow[] = []

      try {
        fx = await prefixSearch<PlaceSearchRow>({
          collection: collectionName,
          field: 'search_term',
          query: term,
          limit: 5,
        })

        if (!fx.length && termNormalized && termNormalized !== term && options?.normalizedField) {
          fx = await prefixSearch<PlaceSearchRow>({
            collection: collectionName,
            field: options.normalizedField as keyof PlaceSearchRow & string,
            query: termNormalized,
            limit: 5,
          })
        }
      } catch (err) {
        firestoreFailed = true
        firestoreError = err
        if (import.meta.dev) {
          console.warn('[places][search] firestore prefixSearch failed', err)
        }
      }

      if (fx.length) {
        results.value = fx.map((row) => mapToCard(row, collectionName))
        if (import.meta.dev) {
          debug.value = {
            term,
            termNormalized,
            stage: 'firebase',
            field:
              fx.length && options?.normalizedField && termNormalized !== term
                ? options.normalizedField
                : 'search_term',
            firestoreCount: fx.length,
            firestoreCollections: [collectionName],
            firestoreFailed,
            firestoreError:
              firestoreFailed && firestoreError
                ? firestoreError instanceof Error
                  ? firestoreError.message
```

### packages/extensions/fireux-places/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/place/fetch/usePlaceCollection.ts

```ts
import { useFirestoreManager } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreManager'
import type { Ref, ShallowRef } from 'vue'
import { computed, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue'
import { toPlaceCollectionPath, usePlaceTypesConfig } from '../utils/placeCollections'

export interface UsePlaceCollectionOptions {
  keyword?: string | null | undefined | Ref<string | null | undefined>
  type?: string | null | undefined | Ref<string | null | undefined>
  types?: string[]
}

export function usePlaceCollection<T extends Record<string, any> = Record<string, any>>(
  options: UsePlaceCollectionOptions = {}
) {
  const { firestoreFetchCollection } = useFirestoreManager()
  const configuredTypes = usePlaceTypesConfig()

  const types = computed<string[]>(() => options.types ?? configuredTypes)

  const collectionPath = computed(() => toPlaceCollectionPath(null, types.value))

  const collectionRef = shallowRef(null) as ShallowRef<Ref<T[] | undefined> | null>
  watch(
    collectionPath,
    (path: string) => {
      collectionRef.value = firestoreFetchCollection<T>(path)
    },
    { immediate: true }
  )

  const collection = computed(() => collectionRef.value?.value)
  const count = computed(() => (collection.value ?? []).length)

  return { collectionPath, collection, count }
}
```

```ts
import { useFirestoreManager } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreManager'
import { requireUid } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/utils/useEnsureCommon'
import type { Place } from '../../../../../../models/place.model'
import { toPlaceCollectionPath, usePlaceTypesConfig } from '../utils/placeCollections'

export interface UsePlaceClaimOptions {
  type?: string | null
  types?: string[]
}

export function usePlaceClaim(options: UsePlaceClaimOptions = {}) {
  const { updateDocument } = useFirestoreManager()
  const configuredTypes = usePlaceTypesConfig()

  async function claimPlace(placeId: string): Promise<{ claimedBy: string }> {
    if (!placeId) {
      throw new Error('Place id is required')
    }

    const { uid } = await requireUid()
    const types = options.types ?? configuredTypes
    const collectionPath = toPlaceCollectionPath(options.type, types)

    await updateDocument<Place>(collectionPath, placeId, {
      claimed_by: uid,
    } as Partial<Place>)

    return { claimedBy: uid }
  }

  return { claimPlace }
}
```

```ts
import { doc, getDoc } from 'firebase/firestore'
import { useFirestoreManager } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreManager'
import { useFirestore } from 'vuefire'
import type { Place, PlaceUpsertInput } from '../../../../../../models/place.model'
import { canonicalPlaceId } from '../fetch/google/usePlacesGoogle'
import { toPlaceCollectionPath, usePlaceTypesConfig } from '../utils/placeCollections'

export const PlacePayload = {
  id: '',
  name: '',
  formatted_address: '',
  lat: 0,
  lng: 0,
  place_image: '',
  claimed_by: '',
  source: '',
  search_term: '',
}

export const PlaceStampOptions = {
  creator: true,
} as const

export interface UsePlaceCreateOptions {
  types?: string[]
}

export function usePlaceCreate(options: UsePlaceCreateOptions = {}) {
  const db = useFirestore()
  const { setDocument } = useFirestoreManager()
  const configuredTypes = usePlaceTypesConfig()

  async function createPlace(
    payload: Partial<PlaceUpsertInput> & { id?: string }
  ): Promise<{ created: boolean; id: string }> {
    const id = canonicalPlaceId((payload as any)?.id ?? (payload as any)?.place_id)
    if (!id) {
      throw new Error('Place id is required')
    }

    const types = options.types ?? configuredTypes
    const collectionPath = toPlaceCollectionPath(undefined, types)

    const ref = doc(db, collectionPath, id)
    const snap = await getDoc(ref)
    if (snap.exists()) {
      return { created: false, id }
    }

    const data = {
      ...PlacePayload,
      ...payload,
      id,
    } satisfies Omit<Place, 'created_at' | 'updated_at' | 'creator_id'>

    await setDocument<Place>(collectionPath, id, data as Place, {
      creator: true,
    })

    return { created: true, id }
  }

  return { createPlace }
}

```

### packages/extensions/fireux-places/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/place/mutations/usePlaceSave.ts

```ts
import { doc, getDoc } from 'firebase/firestore'
import { useFirestoreManager } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreManager'
import { useFirestore } from 'vuefire'
import type { PlaceUpsertInput } from '../../../../../../models/place.model'
import { canonicalPlaceId } from '../fetch/google/usePlacesGoogle'
import { toPlaceCollectionPath, usePlaceTypesConfig } from '../utils/placeCollections'

export interface UsePlaceSaveOptions {
  type?: string | null | undefined
  types?: string[]
}

export function usePlaceSave(options: UsePlaceSaveOptions = {}) {
  const { setDocument } = useFirestoreManager()
  const db = useFirestore()
  const configuredTypes = usePlaceTypesConfig()

  /** Ensure a place document exists in Firestore. */
  async function ensurePlaceExists(place: Partial<PlaceUpsertInput> & { id?: string }): Promise<boolean> {
    const id = canonicalPlaceId((place as any)?.id ?? (place as any)?.place_id)
    if (!id) return false

    const types = options.types ?? configuredTypes
    const collectionPath = toPlaceCollectionPath(options.type, types)

    const ref = doc(db, collectionPath, id)
    const snapshot = await getDoc(ref)

    if (snapshot.exists()) {
      if (import.meta.dev)
        console.log(`[fireux-places] Place already exists: ${id}`)
      return true
    }

    const name = typeof (place as any)?.name === 'string' ? String((place as any).name) : ''
    const formatted =
      typeof (place as any)?.formatted_address === 'string'
        ? String((place as any).formatted_address)
        : ''
    const placeImageRaw =
      (place as any)?.place_image ?? (place as any)?.image_url
    const place_image = typeof placeImageRaw === 'string' ? placeImageRaw : ''
    const lat = Number.isFinite(Number((place as any)?.lat)) ? Number((place as any).lat) : 0
    const lng = Number.isFinite(Number((place as any)?.lng)) ? Number((place as any).lng) : 0
    const search_term_raw = (place as any)?.search_term
    const search_term =
      typeof search_term_raw === 'string' && search_term_raw.trim().length
        ? search_term_raw.trim()
        : `${name} ${formatted}`.toLowerCase().trim()

    const payload = {
      id,
      source: 'fireux',
      name,
      formatted_address: formatted,
      place_image,
      lat,
      lng,
      search_term,
    } as any as PlaceUpsertInput

    await setDocument(collectionPath, id, payload)

    if (import.meta.dev) console.log(`[fireux-places] Created new place: ${id}`)

    return true
  }

  return { ensurePlaceExists }
}


```

```ts
import { usePlaceCollection } from './fetch/usePlaceCollection'
import { usePlacesSearch } from './fetch/search/usePlacesSearch'
import { usePlaceCreate } from './mutations/usePlaceCreate'
import { usePlaceSave } from './mutations/usePlaceSave'
import type { Ref } from 'vue'
import { unref } from 'vue'

export interface UsePlacesOptions {
  keyword?: string | null | undefined | Ref<string | null | undefined>
  type?: string | null | undefined | Ref<string | null | undefined>
  types?: string[]
}

export function usePlaces<T extends Record<string, any> = Record<string, any>>(
  options: UsePlacesOptions = {}
) {
  const type = unref(options.type)

  return {
    ...usePlaceCollection<T>(options),
    ...usePlacesSearch({ type }),
    ...usePlaceCreate({ types: options.types }),
    ...usePlaceSave({ type, types: options.types }),
  }
}
```

```ts
import { useRuntimeConfig } from '#imports'

export type PlaceType = string

export function usePlaceTypesConfig(): string[] {
  const runtimeConfig = useRuntimeConfig()
  const types = (runtimeConfig.public as any)?.fireux?.places?.types
  return Array.isArray(types) ? (types as string[]) : []
}

export function toPlaceCollectionPath(_type: string | null | undefined, _types: string[]): string {
  // Canon: places are neutral and always stored under /places.
  // `type` and `types` are only used for UI/search filtering.
  return 'places'
}

export function normalizePlaceType(raw: unknown): string | null {
  if (raw == null) return null
  if (Array.isArray(raw)) return normalizePlaceType(raw[0])
  const value = String(raw).trim()
  return value ? value : null
}
```

```ts
import type { BasePlace, PlaceSource } from '../../../../../../../models/place.model'

export namespace PlaceCard {
  export type Card = {
    id: string
    to: string

    // Media (empty string means unset)
    avatarUrl: string

    // Primary display fields
    title: string
    subtitle: string

    // Status/label chips
    badges: string[]

    name: string
    formattedAddress: string

    // Secondary media (empty string means unset)
    imageUrl: string

    // Source metadata
    source?: PlaceSource

    // Search collection (optional)
    collection?: string

    // Ownership
    claimedBy?: string
  }
}

export function usePlacesInterface() {
  function map(place: BasePlace): PlaceCard.Card {
    return {
      id: place.id,
      to: `/places/${encodeURIComponent(place.id)}`,

      avatarUrl: place.place_image,
      title: place.name,
      subtitle: place.formatted_address,
      badges: [],

      name: place.name,
      formattedAddress: place.formatted_address,

      imageUrl: place.place_image,

      source: place.source,

      claimedBy: place.claimed_by || '',
    }
  }

  function card(target?: BasePlace | null | undefined): PlaceCard.Card | null {
    return target ? map(target) : null
  }

  function searchText(place: BasePlace): string {
    return `${place.name} ${place.formatted_address} ${place.id}`.toLowerCase()
  }

  return { card, searchText }
}
```

```ts
// FILE: packages/extensions/fireux-places/src/runtime/models/place.model.ts

import type { FireuxStamped } from 'fireux-core/runtime/models/core/meta.model'
import type { FirebaseTimestamp } from 'fireux-core/types/firebase'

/**
 * Place (canonical location)
 * Firestore: places/{id}
 *
 * Canon rules:
 * - id is Google place_id when sourced from Google
 * - manual places also use id as doc id (not google)
 */

/** Canonical sources: google (provider), fireux (stored), manual (user-entered). */
export type PlaceSource = 'google' | 'fireux' | 'manual'

// 🔑 Runtime + canonical shape for the STORED Firestore Place
export const Place = {
	id: '' as string,

	name: '' as string,
	formatted_address: '' as string,
	lat: 0,
	lng: 0,

	place_image: '' as string,

	/** Claimed owner (uid); empty string means unclaimed. */
	claimed_by: '' as string,

	source: 'enum:google|fireux|manual' as unknown as PlaceSource,

	/** “How we found this place” (kept for UX + duplicate avoidance). */
	search_term: '' as string,

	// Stamps
	creator_id: undefined as FireuxStamped['creator_id'],
	created_at: {} as FirebaseTimestamp,
	updated_at: {} as FirebaseTimestamp,
} as const

export type Place = {
	[K in keyof typeof Place]: (typeof Place)[K]
}

/** Base (shared by Google & Firestore). */
export type BasePlace = Pick<
	Place,
	'id'
	| 'name'
	| 'formatted_address'
	| 'lat'
	| 'lng'
	| 'place_image'
	| 'claimed_by'
	| 'source'
>

/** Google Place (transient/provider). */
export type GooglePlace = BasePlace & {
	source: 'google'

	/** Useful to confirm identity before saving. */
	website: string
	phone: string
	rating: number
	user_ratings_total: number
}

/** Payload used before Firestore stamping is applied. */
export type PlaceUpsertInput = Omit<Place, 'created_at' | 'updated_at' | 'creator_id'>
```

```vue
  totalPlaces: filteredCollection.value.length,
  places: filteredDriftPayload.value,
}))
```

```vue
import { useFirestoreRead } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreRead'
import { computed } from 'vue'
import type { Place } from '../../../models/place.model'

definePageMeta({
  layout: 'default',
  title: 'Edit Place',
  description: 'Edit a saved place.',
  head: { title: 'Edit Place' },
  name: 'PlacesEditPage',
})

const { appName } = useFireUXConfig()
useHead({ title: `${appName} | Edit Place` })

const route = useRoute()

const raw = route.params.id
const placeId = Array.isArray(raw) ? String(raw[0] ?? '') : String(raw ?? '')

const { firestoreFetchDoc } = useFirestoreRead()
const docRef = placeId ? firestoreFetchDoc<Place>('places', placeId) : null

const place = computed<Place | null>(() => docRef?.value ?? null)
const loading = computed(() => Boolean(placeId) && docRef?.value === undefined)
const showDebug = import.meta.dev

const pageSubtitle = computed(() => (placeId ? `Place: ${placeId}` : 'Edit a place'))

const json = computed(() => {
  const v = place.value
  if (!v) return ''
  const seen = new WeakSet()
  try {
    return JSON.stringify(v, function (_, value) {
      if (typeof value === 'object' && value !== null) {
        if (seen.has(value)) return '[Circular]'
        seen.add(value)
      }
      return value
    }, 2)
  } catch (e) {
    try {
      // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-var-requires
      const { toRaw } = require('vue')
      return JSON.stringify(toRaw(v), null, 2)
    } catch (e2) {
      return String(e)
    }
  }
})
</script>
```

```ts
import {
  defineEventHandler,
  getQuery,
  getRequestHeader,
  getRequestIP,
  setResponseStatus,
} from 'h3'
import { useRuntimeConfig } from '#imports'
import { resolvePlacesApiKey } from '../../utils/places-api-key'

// Lightweight in-memory rate limiter (per IP). Not production-grade; replace with durable store if needed.
const rlWindowMs = 60_000 // 1 minute window
const rlMax = 120 // max requests per window per IP
const rlStore: Map<string, { count: number; windowStart: number }> = new Map()

function rateLimit(ip: string): {
  allowed: boolean
  retryAfter?: number
  diagnostics?: {
    count: number
    windowStart: number
    now: number
    windowMs: number
    max: number
  }
} {
  const now = Date.now()
  let entry = rlStore.get(ip)
  if (!entry) {
    entry = { count: 1, windowStart: now }
    rlStore.set(ip, entry)
    return {
      allowed: true,
      diagnostics: {
        count: entry.count,
        windowStart: entry.windowStart,
        now,
        windowMs: rlWindowMs,
        max: rlMax,
      },
    }
  }
  if (now - entry.windowStart > rlWindowMs) {
    entry.count = 1
    entry.windowStart = now
    return {
      allowed: true,
      diagnostics: {
        count: entry.count,
        windowStart: entry.windowStart,
        now,
        windowMs: rlWindowMs,
        max: rlMax,
      },
    }
  }
  entry.count++
  if (entry.count > rlMax) {
    return {
      allowed: false,
      retryAfter: rlWindowMs - (now - entry.windowStart),
      diagnostics: {
        count: entry.count,
        windowStart: entry.windowStart,
        now,
        windowMs: rlWindowMs,
        max: rlMax,
      },
    }
  }
  return {
    allowed: true,
    diagnostics: {
      count: entry.count,
      windowStart: entry.windowStart,
      now,
      windowMs: rlWindowMs,
      max: rlMax,
    },
  }
}

export default defineEventHandler(async (event: any) => {
  const dev = import.meta.dev
  const reqId = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)
  const runtimeConfig = useRuntimeConfig(event) as any
  const filterMap =
    (runtimeConfig?.public as any)?.fireux?.places
      ?.googleAutocompleteTypeFilters || {}
  const queryParams = getQuery(event)
  const q = queryParams.q as string | undefined
  const contextType = (queryParams.type as string | undefined)?.trim() || null
  const DEFAULT_FALLBACK = '46.9480,7.4474'
  const location = (queryParams.location as string) || DEFAULT_FALLBACK
  const radius = (queryParams.radius as string) || '30000'
  const query = String(q || '')
  if (!query) {
    if (dev) {
      console.info('[places][autocomplete]', { reqId, stage: 'empty_query' })
    }
    return { predictions: [] }
  }

  // Basic rate limit
  const ip =
    getRequestHeader(event, 'x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0]?.trim() ||
    getRequestIP(event) ||
    'anon'
  const rl = rateLimit(ip)
  if (!rl.allowed) {
    if (dev) {
      console.warn('[places][autocomplete]', {
        reqId,
        stage: 'rate_limited',
        ip,
        query,
        retryAfterMs: rl.retryAfter ?? null,
      })
    }
    setResponseStatus(event, 429)
    return {
      predictions: [],
      error: 'rate_limited',
      retryAfterMs: rl.retryAfter ?? null,
    }
  }

  const key = resolvePlacesApiKey(event)
  if (!key) {
    if (dev) {
      console.error('[places][autocomplete]', {
        reqId,
        stage: 'missing_api_key',
        ip,
        query,
      })
    }
    setResponseStatus(event, 500)
    return { predictions: [], error: 'missing_api_key' }
  }

  if (dev) {
    console.info('[places][autocomplete]', {
      reqId,
      stage: 'request',
      ip,
      query,
      type: contextType,
      location,
      radius,
    })
  }

  const url = new URL(
    'https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/place/autocomplete/json'
  )
  url.searchParams.set('input', query)
  url.searchParams.set('key', key)
  url.searchParams.set('location', location)
  url.searchParams.set('radius', radius)

  try {
    const safeUrl = new URL(url.toString())
    safeUrl.searchParams.set('key', '[redacted]')

    const start = Date.now()
    const res = await fetch(url.toString())
    const data = await res.json()

    if (dev) {
      console.info('[places][autocomplete]', {
        reqId,
        stage: 'upstream_response',
        httpStatus: res.status,
        upstreamStatus: data?.status ?? null,
        timeMs: Date.now() - start,
        url: safeUrl.toString(),
      })
    }
    if (data.status !== 'OK') {
      if (dev) {
        console.warn('[places][autocomplete]', {
          reqId,
          stage: 'upstream_not_ok',
          upstreamStatus: data?.status ?? null,
          errorMessage: data?.error_message ?? null,
        })
      }
      return {
        predictions: [],
        error: 'upstream_not_ok',
        upstreamStatus: import.meta.dev ? (data.status ?? null) : null,
      }
    }
    const predictions = (data.predictions || []).slice(0, 4).map((p: any) => ({
```

```ts
import { defineEventHandler, getQuery, setResponseStatus } from 'h3'
import { resolvePlacesApiKey } from '../../utils/places-api-key'

export default defineEventHandler(async (event: any) => {
  const dev = import.meta.dev
  const reqId = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)
  const queryParams = getQuery(event)
  const placeId = queryParams.place_id as string | undefined
  if (!placeId) {
    if (dev) {
      console.warn('[places][details]', { reqId, stage: 'missing_place_id' })
    }
    return { result: null, error: 'missing_place_id' }
  }

  if (dev) {
    console.info('[places][details]', { reqId, stage: 'request', placeId })
  }

  const key = resolvePlacesApiKey(event)
  if (!key) {
    if (dev) {
      console.error('[places][details]', {
        reqId,
        stage: 'missing_api_key',
        placeId,
      })
    }
    setResponseStatus(event, 500)
    return { result: null, error: 'missing_api_key' }
  }

  const url = new URL('https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/place/details/json')
  url.searchParams.set('place_id', placeId)
  url.searchParams.set('key', key)

  try {
    const safeUrl = new URL(url.toString())
    safeUrl.searchParams.set('key', '[redacted]')

    const start = Date.now()
    const res = await fetch(url.toString())
    const data = await res.json()

    if (dev) {
      console.info('[places][details]', {
        reqId,
        stage: 'upstream_response',
        httpStatus: res.status,
        upstreamStatus: data?.status ?? null,
        timeMs: Date.now() - start,
        url: safeUrl.toString(),
      })
    }
    if (data.status !== 'OK') {
      if (dev) {
        console.warn('[places][details]', {
          reqId,
          stage: 'upstream_not_ok',
          placeId,
          upstreamStatus: data?.status ?? null,
          errorMessage: data?.error_message ?? null,
        })
      }
      return {
        result: null,
        error: 'upstream_not_ok',
        upstreamStatus: import.meta.dev ? (data.status ?? null) : null,
      }
    }

    if (dev) {
      console.info('[places][details]', { reqId, stage: 'ok', placeId })
    }
    return { result: data.result }
  } catch (error) {
    if (dev) {
      console.error('[places][details]', {
        reqId,
        stage: 'upstream_error',
        placeId,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
      })
    }
    setResponseStatus(event, 502)
    return { result: null, error: 'upstream_error' }
  }
})
```

### packages/extensions/fireux-places/src/runtime/server/api/places/logo.get.ts

```ts
import { defineEventHandler, getQuery } from 'h3'

const log = (...args: unknown[]) => console.info('[places-logo]', ...args)
const logWarn = (...args: unknown[]) => console.warn('[places-logo]', ...args)
const logError = (...args: unknown[]) => console.error('[places-logo]', ...args)

const HOMEPAGE_TIMEOUT_MS = 4500
const PROBE_CONCURRENCY = 4
const CLEARBIT_SIZE = 256

/**
 * Best-effort logo resolver.
 * Priority:
 *   1) <link rel="icon" ...> on homepage (SVG/PNG preferred)
 *   2) Common logo paths (/logo.svg|png|webp, /images/logo.*, etc.)
 *   3) Social meta images (og:image, twitter:image)
 *   4) Unavatar (site avatar) → Google S2 favicon
 *   5) Picsum placeholder
 *
 * Pass the business website or domain if possible:
 *   /api/places/logo?website=https://yellow-velo.ch
 *   /api/places/logo?domain=yellow-velo.ch
 * Fallback (name only) will still return a placeholder chain.
 */
export default defineEventHandler(async (event) => {
  const q = getQuery(event)
  const websiteParam = (q.website as string | undefined)?.trim()
  const domainParam = (q.domain as string | undefined)?.trim()
  const nameParam = (q.q as string | undefined)?.trim() // optional, for placeholder seed

  log('incoming request', {
    website: websiteParam,
    domain: domainParam,
    nameSeed: nameParam,
  })

  // Resolve a base URL to crawl (homepage). Prefer website → domain.
  const baseUrl = resolveBaseUrl(websiteParam, domainParam)
  if (!baseUrl) {
    // No site info: jump directly to avatar fallbacks & placeholder.
    logWarn('no base url resolved, jumping to fallbacks')
    const url = await fallbackChain('', nameParam)
    log('fallback result (no base)', { url })
    return { url }
  }

  log('resolved base url', { baseUrl })

  try {
    // 1) Fetch homepage HTML (GET, follow redirects).
    const homepageController = new AbortController()
    const homepageTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
      if (!homepageController.signal.aborted) {
        homepageController.abort()
      }
    }, HOMEPAGE_TIMEOUT_MS)

    let htmlRes: Response | null = null
    let homepageError: unknown = null
    try {
      htmlRes = await fetch(baseUrl, {
        redirect: 'follow',
        signal: homepageController.signal,
        headers: {
          'user-agent': 'FireUX-LogoFetcher/1.0',
          accept:
            'text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8',
        },
      })
    } catch (error) {
      homepageError = error
    } finally {
      clearTimeout(homepageTimeout)
    }
    if (!htmlRes?.ok) {
      const status = htmlRes?.status ?? null
      const aborted = homepageError && isAbortError(homepageError)
      logWarn('homepage fetch failed', {
        baseUrl,
        status,
        aborted,
        error: aborted ? undefined : homepageError,
      })
      const url = await fallbackChain(baseUrl, nameParam)
      log('fallback result (fetch not ok)', { url })
      return { url }
    }
    const html = await htmlRes.text()

    // Prepare an absolute URL helper using the *final* URL (after redirects).
    const finalHome = htmlRes.url || baseUrl
    log('fetched homepage html', { finalHome })
    const makeAbs = (u: string) => toAbsolute(finalHome, u)

    // 2) Collect icon link candidates.
    const iconLinks = extractIconLinks(html).map(makeAbs)

    // 3) Collect social meta images.
    const socialImgs = extractSocialImages(html).map(makeAbs)

    // 4) Collect inline <img> logos (class/id/alt contains logo/brand/mark).
    const inlineImgs = extractInlineLogoImages(html).map(makeAbs)

    // 5) Common logo paths (HEAD probe first).
    const commonPaths = [
      '/logo.svg',
      '/logo.png',
      '/logo.webp',
      '/assets/logo.svg',
      '/assets/logo.png',
      '/img/logo.svg',
      '/img/logo.png',
      '/images/logo.svg',
      '/images/logo.png',
      '/static/logo.svg',
      '/static/logo.png',
    ].map((p) => new URL(p, finalHome).toString())

    // 6) Validate candidates with lightweight HEAD/GET and score.
    const allCandidates = dedupe([
      ...iconLinks,
      ...inlineImgs,
      ...commonPaths,
      ...socialImgs,
    ])

    log('candidate counts', {
      iconLinks: iconLinks.length,
      inlineImgs: inlineImgs.length,
      commonPaths: commonPaths.length,
      socialImgs: socialImgs.length,
      total: allCandidates.length,
    })

    const scored = await probeCandidates(allCandidates)

    // 6) Pick best or fallback chain.
    if (scored.length) {
      scored.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)
      const winner = scored[0]
      log('selected candidate', winner)
      return { url: winner.url }
    }

    const url = await fallbackChain(finalHome, nameParam)
    log('fallback result (no candidates)', { url })
    return { url }
  } catch (error) {
    logError('unexpected error during resolution', error)
    const url = await fallbackChain(baseUrl, nameParam)
    log('fallback result (error)', { url })
    return { url }
  }
})

/* ───────────────── helpers ───────────────── */

function resolveBaseUrl(website?: string, domain?: string): string | null {
  if (website) {
    try {
      const u = new URL(website)
      if (!u.protocol) return `https://${website}`
      return u.toString()
    } catch {
      return `https://${website}`
    }
  }
  if (domain) {
    try {
      const u = new URL(`https://${domain}`)
      return u.toString()
    } catch {
      return null
    }
  }
  return null
}

function toAbsolute(base: string, maybe: string): string {
  try {
    const u = new URL(maybe, base)
    return u.toString()
  } catch {
    return maybe
  }
}

// Naive attribute parsing (good enough for link/meta scanning without a DOM lib)
function getAttr(tag: string, name: string): string | null {
  const re = new RegExp(`${name}\\s*=\\s*("([^"]+)"|'([^']+)'|([^\\s>]+))`, 'i')
  const m = re.exec(tag)
  if (!m) return null
  return (m[2] || m[3] || m[4] || '').trim()
}

function extractIconLinks(html: string): string[] {
  const links = html.match(/<link\b[^>]*>/gi) || []
  const out: string[] = []
  for (const link of links) {
    const rel = getAttr(link, 'rel')?.toLowerCase() || ''
```

### packages/extensions/fireux-places/src/runtime/server/utils/places-api-key.ts

```ts
import type { H3Event } from 'h3'
import { useRuntimeConfig } from '#imports'

export function resolvePlacesApiKey(event: H3Event): string | null {
  const rc = useRuntimeConfig(event) as any

  const candidates = [
    // Prefer server-only runtime config if present
    rc?.googlePlacesApiKey,
    rc?.fireux?.googlePlacesApiKey,

    // Fallback to public runtime config (matches docs, but less ideal)
    rc?.public?.googlePlacesApiKey,
    rc?.public?.fireux?.googlePlacesApiKey,

    // Environment fallbacks (Nuxt auto-injects NUXT_* into runtimeConfig)
    process.env.GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY,
    process.env.NUXT_GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY,
    process.env.NUXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY,
  ]

  const key = candidates.find(
    (v) => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length > 0
  ) as string | undefined

  return key?.trim() ?? null
}
```

Owned by fireux.

### packages/extensions/fireux-products/src/module.ts

```ts
import {
    ensureRuntimeConfigBuckets,
    ensureRuntimeLayerFromPath,
    exposeRuntimeAlias,
} from 'fireux-core/config/module/runtime-layer'
import {
    addImportsDir,
    createResolver,
    defineNuxtModule,
} from 'nuxt/kit'
import type { Nuxt } from 'nuxt/schema'
import { configureComponents } from './config/module/components-config'
import { configureComposables } from './config/module/composables-config'
import { configureLayouts } from './config/module/layouts-config'
import { configureModels } from './config/module/models-config'
import { configurePages } from './config/module/pages-config'
import { configurePlugins } from './config/module/plugins-config'
import { configureRuntime } from './config/module/runtime-config'
import { configureServer } from './config/module/server-config'

declare module 'nuxt/schema' {
  interface NuxtConfig {
    products?: Partial<typeof defaults>
  }
  interface NuxtOptions {
    products?: Partial<typeof defaults>
  }
}

const defaults = {
  enabled: true,
}

export default defineNuxtModule({
  meta: {
    name: 'fireux-products',
    configKey: 'products',
    compatibility: { nuxt: '^4.0.0' },
  },
  defaults,
  setup(_options, nuxt) {
    const resolver = createResolver(import.meta.url)
    const runtimeDir = resolver.resolve('./runtime')

    ensureRuntimeConfigBuckets(nuxt, 'products')
    configureRuntime(nuxt, 'products')
    configurePlugins(resolver)
    configureComposables(resolver)

    // Auto-import runtime composables directory (create files as needed)
    addImportsDir(resolver.resolve('./runtime/composables'))

    configureComponents(resolver)
    configureLayouts(resolver, nuxt)
    configureModels(resolver)
    configurePages(resolver, nuxt)

    exposeRuntimeAlias(nuxt, '#fireux-products', runtimeDir)

    configureServer(resolver)
    registerProductPages(nuxt, resolver, runtimeDir)
  },
})

function registerProductPages(nuxt: Nuxt, resolver: any, runtimeDir: string) {
  ensureRuntimeLayerFromPath(nuxt, runtimeDir)

  const pagesToInject = [
    {
      name: 'fireux-products-index',
      path: '/products',
      file: resolver.resolve('./runtime/pages/products/index.vue'),
    },
    {
      name: 'fireux-products-slug',
      path: '/products/:slug',
      file: resolver.resolve('./runtime/pages/products/[slug].vue'),
    },
  ]

  nuxt.hook('pages:extend', (pages: any[]) => {
    for (const entry of pagesToInject) {
      const exists = pages.some((page) => page.path === entry.path)
      if (!exists) {
        pages.push(entry)
      }
    }
  })
}
```

```vue
<template>
  <UCard :ui="{ body: 'space-y-4' }">
    <template #header>
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div class="font-medium">Products</div>

        <div class="flex items-center gap-2">

          </UButton>

        </div>
      </div>
    </template>

    <div v-if="!cards.length" class="text-sm text-dimmed">
      No products yet.
    </div>

    <div v-else>
      <div
        v-if="variant === 'pill'"
        class="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3"
      >
        <component
          :is="wrapperFor(card)"
          v-for="card in cards"
          :key="card.id"
          v-bind="wrapperPropsFor(card)"
          class="block"
        >
          <ProductCardsPill v-bind="card" />
        </component>
      </div>

      <div v-else class="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
        <component
          :is="wrapperFor(card)"
          v-for="card in cards"
          :key="card.id"
          v-bind="wrapperPropsFor(card)"
          class="block"
        >
          <ProductCardsCell v-bind="card" />
        </component>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div v-if="showDebug" class="pt-3">
      <DevJson
        :title="'Products (JSON)'"
        :data="debugPayload"
        :default-open="false"
      />
    </div>
  </UCard>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import { useProductInterface } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/product/utils/view/useProductInterface';
import type { FirebaseProduct } from '../../../../../models/product.model';

const props = defineProps<{ collection?: FirebaseProduct[] }>()

const collection = computed(() => props.collection ?? [])
const { card: makeCard } = useProductInterface()
type ProductCardShape = NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof makeCard>>
const cards = computed(() =>
  collection.value
    .map((product) => makeCard(product))
    .filter((c): c is NonNullable<typeof c> => Boolean(c))
)
const showDebug = import.meta.dev
const debugPayload = computed(() => ({
  totalProducts: collection.value.length,
  products: collection.value,
}))

type Variant = 'pill' | 'cell'
const variant = ref<Variant>('cell')
const toggleVariant = () => {
  variant.value = variant.value === 'pill' ? 'cell' : 'pill'
}

const wrapperFor = (card: ProductCardShape) => (card.to ? 'NuxtLink' : 'div')
const wrapperPropsFor = (card: ProductCardShape) => (card.to ? { to: card.to } : {})
</script>
```

```vue
import { useStorage } from '@vueuse/core'
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { useCreateProductState } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/product/state/useCreateProductState'
import { useCreatePricesState } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/product/Prices/useCreatePricesState'
import type { FirebaseProduct } from '../../../../../models/product.model'

const { product } = await useCreateProductState()
const { prices, defaultPrice } = useCreatePricesState()

// Fix: Use the same key that ImagePicker uses (with "Data" suffix)
const mainImageData = useStorage('createProductMainImageData', '')

const previewProduct = computed(
  () =>
    ({
      ...product.value,
      // Fix: Connect the prices from useCreatePricesState to the product
      prices: prices.value,
      // Use main_image field from FirebaseProduct model
      main_image: mainImageData.value || '/img/placeholder-product.png',
      default_price: defaultPrice.value,
    } as Partial<FirebaseProduct>)
)
</script>
```

```vue
<template>
  <div class="price-entry">
    <div class="input-row">
      <UInput v-model="price.currency" readonly class="currency-display w-20" />
      <UInputNumber
        v-model="price.unit_amount"
        :format-options="{
          style: 'decimal',
          minimumFractionDigits: 2,
          maximumFractionDigits: 2,
        }"
        placeholder="0.00"
        :min="0"
        class="price-input"
      />
    </div>

    <div v-if="showBillingFrequency" class="billing-frequency">
      <URadioGroup v-model="uiFrequency" :items="billingFrequencyOptions" />
    </div>

    <div v-if="showRemove" class="remove-button">
      <UButton
        icon="i-lucide-x"
        color="warning"
        variant="subtle"
        size="xs"
        @click="emit('remove')"
      >
        Remove
      </UButton>
    </div>

    <div
      v-if="prices.length > 1 && prices[0] !== price"
      class="set-default-button"
    >
      <UButton
        icon="i-lucide-arrow-up"
        color="primary"
        variant="soft"
        size="xs"
        @click="movePriceToTop(props.index)"
      >
        Move to First
      </UButton>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue'
import type { RadioGroupItem, RadioGroupValue } from '@nuxt/ui'
import { useCreatePricesState } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/product/Prices/useCreatePricesState'
import { useCreateProductState } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/product/state/useCreateProductState'
import { useProducts } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/product/useProducts'

const props = defineProps<{
  index: number
  showRemove: boolean
}>()

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'remove'): void
}>()

function movePriceToTop(index: number) {
  if (index > 0) {
    const [item] = prices.value.splice(index, 1)
    if (item) prices.value.unshift(item)
  }
}

const { prices } = useCreatePricesState()
const { product } = await useCreateProductState()
const defaultCurrency = 'EUR'

const isService = computed(() => product.value.product_type === 'service')
const showBillingFrequency = computed(() => isService.value)

const price = computed(() => {
  const base = prices.value[props.index]
  if (!base) {
    return {
      currency: defaultCurrency,
      unit_amount: 0,
      type: 'one_time',
      interval: undefined,
      interval_count: undefined,
    }
  }

  // Enforce one_time for non-service and non-subscription
  if (!isService.value) {
    base.type = 'one_time'
    base.interval = undefined
    base.interval_count = undefined
  }

  // Services can be recurring; leave as-is unless explicitly set elsewhere

  return base
})

// UI options for billing frequency
const billingFrequencyOptions: RadioGroupItem[] = [
  { label: 'Once', value: 'once' },
  { label: 'Monthly', value: 'monthly' },
  { label: 'Yearly', value: 'yearly' },
]

// Computed value that maps to Stripe fields
const uiFrequency = computed<RadioGroupValue>({
  get: () => {
    if (price.value.type === 'one_time') return 'once'
    if (price.value.interval === 'month') return 'monthly'
    if (price.value.interval === 'year') return 'yearly'
    return 'once'
  },
  set: (val) => {
    if (val === 'once') {
      price.value.type = 'one_time'
      price.value.interval = undefined
      price.value.interval_count = undefined
    } else {
      price.value.type = 'recurring'
      price.value.interval = val === 'monthly' ? 'month' : 'year'
      price.value.interval_count = 1
    }
  },
})
</script>

<style scoped>
.price-entry {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-4); /* Uses design system spacing */
  background-color: var(--ui-bg-muted); /* Uses existing design system color */
  padding: var(--space-6); /* Uses design system padding */
  border-radius: var(--radius-md); /* Uses design system border radius */
}

  align-items: center;
}

  flex-grow: 1;
}

  display: flex;

}
</style>
```
