```vue
    <!-- Stock management for Physical products (always required) -->
    <template v-if="product.product_type === 'physical'">
      <UInputNumber
        v-model="product.stock"
        placeholder="Enter quantity"
        label="Inventory Stock"
        description="Number of physical units available for sale"
        :min="0"
      />
      <!-- Physical products always track stock -->
    </template>

    <!-- Stock management for Digital products (optional) -->
    <template v-else-if="product.product_type === 'digital'">
      <UFormField label="License Management">
        <USwitch
          v-model="product.track_stock"
          label="Limit available licenses/downloads"
        />
      </UFormField>

      <UInputNumber
        v-if="product.track_stock"
        v-model="product.stock"
        placeholder="Enter limit"
        label="Available Licenses"
        description="Maximum number of licenses or downloads allowed"
        :min="1"
      />
    </template>

    <!-- Stock management for Service products (optional) -->
    <template v-else-if="product.product_type === 'service'">
      <UFormField label="Capacity Management">
        <USwitch v-model="product.track_stock" label="Limit service capacity" />
      </UFormField>

      <UInputNumber
        v-if="product.track_stock"
        v-model="product.stock"
        placeholder="Enter capacity"
        label="Service Capacity"
        description="Maximum number of service slots available (e.g., consultations, sessions)"
        :min="1"
      />
    </template>

    <!-- Subscription products typically don't need stock management -->
    <template v-else-if="product.product_type === 'subscription'">
      <UFormField label="Membership Limits">
        <USwitch
          v-model="product.track_stock"
          label="Limit total memberships"
        />
      </UFormField>

      <UInputNumber
        v-if="product.track_stock"
        v-model="product.stock"
        placeholder="Enter limit"
        label="Membership Limit"
        description="Maximum number of active subscriptions allowed"
        :min="1"
      />
    </template>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { watch } from 'vue'
import { useCreateProductState } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/product/state/useCreateProductState'

const { product } = await useCreateProductState()

// Automatically handle stock tracking based on product type
watch(
  () => product.value.product_type,
  (newType: typeof product.value.product_type) => {
    if (newType === 'physical') {
      // Physical products always track stock
      product.value.track_stock = true
    } else if (
      newType === 'digital' ||
      newType === 'service' ||
      newType === 'subscription'
    ) {
      // Other types default to not tracking stock
      product.value.track_stock = false
      product.value.stock = null
    }
  },
  { immediate: true }
)

// When track_stock is disabled, reset stock to null
watch(
  () => product.value.track_stock,
  (tracking: boolean | undefined) => {
    if (!tracking && product.value.product_type !== 'physical') {
      product.value.stock = null
    }
  }
)
</script>

<style scoped>
.stock-fields {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-4);
}
</style>
```

```vue
<template>
  <MoleculesCreateShell
    :loading="isCreating"
    submit-label="Create"
    @submit="handleCreate"
    @clear="handleClear"
  >
    <template #write>
      <ProductCreateWrite />
    </template>
    <template #preview>
      <ProductCreatePreview />
    </template>
  </MoleculesCreateShell>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
// Use Nuxt UI toast if available (auto-imported in app)
const useToastFn = (globalThis as any).useToast as undefined | (() => any)
const toast = useToastFn ? useToastFn() : undefined
import { useCreatePricesState } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/product/Prices/useCreatePricesState'
import { useCreateProductState } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/product/state/useCreateProductState'
import { useProductCreate } from '../../../../../composables/fireux/firestore/product/useProductCreate'

const { product, resetCreateProductState } = await useCreateProductState()

const { resetCreatePricesState } = useCreatePricesState()

const { createProduct } = await useProductCreate()

const isCreating = ref(false)

async function handleCreate() {
  // Validate required fields
  if (!product.value?.name?.trim()) {
    if (toast)
      toast.add({
        title: 'Missing name',
        description: 'Product name is required',
        icon: 'i-heroicons-exclamation-circle',
        color: 'amber',
      })
    return
  }

  isCreating.value = true

  const response = await createProduct()

  if (!response.success) {
    if (toast)
      toast.add({
        title: 'Create failed',
        description: String(response.error || 'Unknown error'),
        icon: 'i-heroicons-x-circle',
        color: 'red',
      })
    isCreating.value = false
    return
  }

  // Success! Clear the form and show success message
  if (toast)
    toast.add({
      title: 'Created',
      description: 'Product created successfully',
      icon: 'i-heroicons-check-circle',
      color: 'green',
    })
  resetCreateProductState()
  resetCreatePricesState()
  isCreating.value = false
}

function handleClear() {
  if (confirm('Are you sure you want to clear the form?')) {
    resetCreateProductState()
    resetCreatePricesState()
  }
}
</script>
```

### packages/extensions/fireux-products/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/product/Prices/useCreatePricesState.ts

```ts
import { useStorage } from '@vueuse/core'
import { computed } from 'vue'
import type {
	DefaultPrice,
	Price,
	StripePriceInput,
} from '../../../../../../models/product.model'

export function useCreatePricesState() {
	const prices = useStorage<Partial<Price>[]>('createProductPrices', [
		{
			unit_amount: 0,
			currency: 'eur',
		},
	])

	function addPrice() {
		prices.value.push({
			unit_amount: 0,
			currency: 'eur',
		})
	}

	function removePrice(index: number) {
		prices.value.splice(index, 1)
	}

	function resetPrices() {
		prices.value = [
			{
				unit_amount: 0,
				currency: 'eur',
			},
		]
	}

	function resetCreatePricesState() {
		resetPrices()
	}

	const pricesPayload = computed<StripePriceInput[]>(() => {
		if (!prices.value.length) {
			throw new Error('At least one price is required')
		}

		return prices.value.map((price, index) => {
			if (!price.unit_amount || price.unit_amount <= 0) {
				throw new Error(`Price ${index + 1} must have a value greater than 0`)
			}
			if (!price.currency) {
				throw new Error(`Price ${index + 1} requires a currency`)
			}

			const isRecurring = price.type === 'recurring'

			return {
				billing_scheme: price.billing_scheme ?? 'per_unit',
				currency: price.currency,
				unit_amount: price.unit_amount,
				type: price.type ?? 'one_time',
				interval: isRecurring ? price.interval ?? 'month' : undefined,
				interval_count: isRecurring ? price.interval_count ?? 1 : undefined,
				metadata: price.metadata ?? {},
			}
		})
	})

	const defaultUnitPrice = computed(() => prices.value[0]?.unit_amount ?? 0)

	const defaultPrice = computed<DefaultPrice | undefined>(() => {
		const price = prices.value[0]
		if (!price) return undefined
		return {
			id: price.id ?? '',
			unit_amount: price.unit_amount ?? 0,
			interval: price.interval,
		}
	})

	return {
		prices,
		addPrice,
		removePrice,
		resetPrices,
		resetCreatePricesState,
		pricesPayload,
		defaultUnitPrice,
		defaultPrice,
	}
}


```

### packages/extensions/fireux-products/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/product/fetch/useProductBySlug.ts

```ts
import type { FirebaseProduct } from '#fireux-products/models/product.model'
import { useFirestoreManager } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreManager'

/** Lookup a product by slug (server-side friendly). */
export function useProductBySlug() {
  const { firestoreQueryOneByField } = useFirestoreManager()

  const fetchProductBySlug = (slug: string) =>
    firestoreQueryOneByField<FirebaseProduct>('products', 'slug', slug, true)

  return { fetchProductBySlug }
}
```

```ts
import { computed } from 'vue'
import type { FirebaseProduct } from '#fireux-products/models/product.model'
import { useFirestoreManager } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreManager'

/** Fetches the products collection for the current runtime scope. */
export function useProductCollection() {
  const { firestoreFetchCollection, getCollectionPath } = useFirestoreManager()
  const collectionPath = getCollectionPath('products')
  const products = firestoreFetchCollection<FirebaseProduct>(collectionPath)
  const pending = computed(() => products.value === undefined)
  return { products, pending }
}
```

```ts
import type { Price } from '#fireux-products/models/product.model'
import { useFirestoreManager } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreManager'

/** Fetch subcollection prices for a given product. */
export function useProductPrices() {
  const { firestoreFetchSubcollection, getCollectionPath } =
    useFirestoreManager()

  const fetchProductPrices = async (productId: string): Promise<Price[]> => {
    if (!productId) return []
    const collectionName = getCollectionPath('products')
    return firestoreFetchSubcollection<Price>(
      collectionName,
      productId,
      'prices'
    )
  }

  return { fetchProductPrices }
}
```

### packages/extensions/fireux-products/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/product/state/useCreateProductState.ts

```ts
import { useStorage } from '@vueuse/core'
import { onMounted, ref, watch } from 'vue'
import { useCurrentUser } from 'vuefire'
import { useFirestoreManager } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreManager'
import { useFireUXConfig } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/app/FireUXConfig'
import type { FirebaseProduct } from '../../../../../../models/product.model'

type ProductDraft = Partial<FirebaseProduct> & {
  main_image?: string
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'createProduct'
const IMAGE_KEY = 'createProductMainImageData'

export function useCreateProductState() {
  const currentUser = useCurrentUser()
  const { appId: tenantId } = useFireUXConfig()
  const { checkUnique } = useFirestoreManager()

  const product = useStorage<ProductDraft>(STORAGE_KEY, {
    id: '',
    name: '',
    description: '',
    active: true,
    slug: '',
    appId: tenantId,
    creator_id: currentUser.value?.uid || '',
    created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  })

  const mainImageData = useStorage<string>(IMAGE_KEY, '')
  const isSlugTaken = ref(false)

  watch(
    () => product.value.name,
    async (newName: string | undefined) => {
      if (!newName) {
        product.value.slug = ''
        isSlugTaken.value = false
        return
      }

      const base = newName
        .toLowerCase()
        .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
        .replace(/(^-|-$)/g, '')
      const slug = tenantId ? `${tenantId}-${base}` : base
      product.value.slug = slug

      try {
        const slugAvailable = await checkUnique('products', 'slug', slug, true)
        isSlugTaken.value = !slugAvailable
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('[fireux] failed to validate product slug', error)
        isSlugTaken.value = false
      }
    }
  )

  onMounted(() => {
    if (currentUser.value?.uid) {
      product.value.creator_id = currentUser.value.uid
    }
    if (tenantId) {
      product.value.appId = tenantId
    }
  })

  function resetCreateProductState() {
    product.value = {
      id: '',
      name: '',
      description: '',
      active: true,
      slug: '',
      appId: tenantId,
      creator_id: currentUser.value?.uid || '',
      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    }
    mainImageData.value = ''
    isSlugTaken.value = false
  }

  function getProductPayload(): ProductDraft {
    if (!product.value.name?.trim()) {
      throw new Error('Product name is required')
    }
    if (!product.value.slug?.trim()) {
      throw new Error('Product slug is required')
    }
    if (isSlugTaken.value) {
      throw new Error('Product slug must be unique')
    }

    return {
      ...product.value,
      main_image: mainImageData.value,
    }
  }

  return {
    product,
    mainImageData,
    isSlugTaken,
    resetCreateProductState,
    getProductPayload,
  }
}

```

```ts
import { useCreateProductState } from './useCreateProductState'
import { useProductCreate } from '../useProductCreate'

export function useProductCreateSubmit() {
  const { product } = useCreateProductState()
  const { createProduct } = useProductCreate()

  const submit = async () => {
    const name = product.value?.name?.trim()
    if (!name) throw new Error('Product name is required')

    const result = await createProduct()
    if (!result.success) {
      throw new Error(result.error || 'Failed to create product')
    }

    return result.id || null
  }

  return { submit }
}
```

### packages/extensions/fireux-products/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/product/useProductCreate.ts

```ts
import { doc, getDoc } from 'firebase/firestore'
import { useFireUXConfig } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/app/FireUXConfig'
import { useFirestoreManager } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreManager'
import { useFirestore } from 'vuefire'
import type { FirebaseProduct } from '../../../../../models/product.model'
import { useCreateProductState } from './state/useCreateProductState'

export const ProductPayload = {
  id: '',
  name: '',
  description: '',
  content: '',
  slug: '',
  active: false,
  main_image: '',
  images: [] as Array<Record<string, any>>,
  features: [] as Array<Record<string, any>>,
  prices: [] as Array<Record<string, any>>,
  default_price: {
    id: '',
    unit_amount: 0,
    interval: '',
  },
  product_type: '',
  track_stock: false,
  stock: 0 as number | null,
  appId: '',
  metadata: {} as Record<string, any>,
}

export const ProductStampOptions = {
  creator: true,
} as const

export function useProductCreate() {
  const db = useFirestore()
  const { setDocument, getCollectionPath } = useFirestoreManager()
  const { getProductPayload } = useCreateProductState()

  async function createProduct(): Promise<{
    success: boolean
    id?: string
    error?: string
  }> {
    try {
      const fireux = useFireUXConfig()
      const payload = getProductPayload()
      const slug = payload.slug || payload.id

      if (!slug) {
        throw new Error('Product slug is required')
      }

      const collectionPath = getCollectionPath('products')
      const ref = doc(db, collectionPath, slug)
      const snap = await getDoc(ref)
      if (snap.exists()) {
        return { success: false, id: slug, error: 'Product already exists' }
      }

      const data = {
        ...payload,
        id: slug,
        appId: payload.appId || fireux.appId,
      } as Omit<FirebaseProduct, 'created_at' | 'updated_at' | 'creator_id'>

      await setDocument<FirebaseProduct>(collectionPath, slug, data as FirebaseProduct, {
        creator: true,
      })

      return { success: true, id: slug }
    } catch (error) {
      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
      if (import.meta.dev) {
        console.error('[fireux-products] createProduct failed', error)
      }
      return { success: false, error: message }
    }
  }

  return { createProduct }
}

```

```ts
import { useImageStorage } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firebase/useImageStorage'
import { useFirestoreManager } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreManager'

export function useProductUtils() {
  const { uploadImage } = useImageStorage()
  const { checkUnique } = useFirestoreManager()

  async function buildSlugIfUnique(
    title: string,
    collectionName: string,
    tenantId?: string
  ): Promise<
    { success: true; slug: string } | { success: false; message: string }
  > {
    const base = title
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
      .replace(/(^-|-$)/g, '')
    const slug = tenantId ? `${tenantId}-${base}` : base

    const slugAvailable = await checkUnique(collectionName, 'slug', slug, true)
    if (!slugAvailable) {
      return { success: false, message: 'Slug taken' }
    }

    return { success: true, slug }
  }

  async function uploadMainImage(
    data: File | string,
    collectionName: string,
    id: string
  ): Promise<string> {
    const path = `${collectionName}/${id}/main.jpg`
    const url = await uploadImage(path, data)
    return url || ''
  }

  return {
    buildSlugIfUnique,
    uploadMainImage,
  }
}
```

### packages/extensions/fireux-products/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/product/useProducts.ts

```ts
import type {
  FirebaseProduct,
  Price,
} from '../../../../../models/product.model'
import { useFirestoreManager } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreManager'
import { useProductCreate } from './useProductCreate.ts'
import { useProductUpdate } from './useProductUpdate.ts'
import { useProductDelete } from './useProductDelete.ts'

export function useProducts() {
  const {
    firestoreFetchCollection,
    firestoreFetchDoc,
    firestoreQueryOneByField,
    getCollectionPath,
    firestoreFetchSubcollection,
  } = useFirestoreManager()

  const collectionPath = getCollectionPath('products')
  const productsCollection =
    firestoreFetchCollection<FirebaseProduct>(collectionPath)

  const fetchProduct = (id: string) =>
    firestoreFetchDoc<FirebaseProduct>(collectionPath, id)

  const fetchProductBySlug = (slug: string) =>
    firestoreQueryOneByField<FirebaseProduct>('products', 'slug', slug, true)

  const fetchProductPrices = async (productId: string): Promise<Price[]> => {
    if (!productId) return []
    const collectionName = getCollectionPath('products')
    return firestoreFetchSubcollection<Price>(
      collectionName,
      productId,
      'prices'
    )
  }

  const formatPrice = ({
    unit_amount,
    currency,
  }: {
    unit_amount: number
    currency?: string
  }): string => {
    const amount = Number(unit_amount ?? 0)
    const iso = (currency || 'USD').toUpperCase()
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
      style: 'currency',
      currency: iso,
    }).format(amount / 100)
  }

  const productCreate = useProductCreate()
  const productUpdate = useProductUpdate()
  const productDelete = useProductDelete()

  return {
    productsCollection,
    fetchProduct,
    fetchProductBySlug,
    fetchProductPrices,
    formatPrice,
    ...productCreate,
    ...productUpdate,
    ...productDelete,
  }
}

```

### packages/extensions/fireux-products/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/product/utils/useProductFormatting.ts

```ts
import type {
  FirebaseProduct,
  Price,
} from '#fireux-products/models/product.model'
import { useImageStorage } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firebase/useImageStorage'
import { useFirestoreManager } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/operations/useFirestoreManager'

export function useProductFormatting() {
  const { uploadImage } = useImageStorage()
  const { checkUnique } = useFirestoreManager()

  function formatSlug(slug: string): string {
    return slug
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9-]/g, '')
      .replace(/--+/g, '-')
      .replace(/(^-|-$)/g, '')
  }

  function formatProductData(
    product: Partial<FirebaseProduct>
  ): Partial<FirebaseProduct> {
    const formatted: Partial<FirebaseProduct> = { ...product }

    if (formatted.name) formatted.name = formatted.name.trim()
    if (formatted.description)
      formatted.description = formatted.description.trim()
    if (formatted.slug) formatted.slug = formatSlug(formatted.slug)

    if (formatted.features) {
      formatted.features = formatGenericArray(formatted.features as any[])
    }
    if (formatted.images) {
      formatted.images = (formatted.images as any[]).filter((image: any) => {
        if (typeof image === 'string') return image.trim().length > 0
        return (
          image && typeof image.url === 'string' && image.url.trim().length > 0
        )
      }) as any
    }

    return formatted
  }

  async function buildSlugIfUnique(
    title: string,
    collectionName: string,
    tenantId?: string
  ): Promise<
    { success: true; slug: string } | { success: false; message: string }
  > {
    const base = title
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
      .replace(/(^-|-$)/g, '')

    const slug = tenantId ? `${tenantId}-${base}` : base
    const slugAvailable = await checkUnique(collectionName, 'slug', slug, true)
    if (!slugAvailable) {
      return { success: false, message: `Slug "${slug}" is already taken.` }
    }
    return { success: true, slug }
  }

  function formatProductName(product: FirebaseProduct): string {
    return product.name || 'Unnamed Product'
  }

  function formatProductExcerpt(
    product: FirebaseProduct,
    maxLength = 150
  ): string {
    const description = product.description || ''
    if (description.length <= maxLength) return description
    return description.substring(0, maxLength).replace(/\s+\S*$/, '') + '...'
  }

  function formatPrice(price: Price): string {
    const currency = price.currency?.toUpperCase() || 'USD'
    const symbol = getCurrencySymbol(currency)
    const amount = (price.unit_amount / 100).toFixed(2)
    return `${symbol}${amount}`
  }

  function formatPriceRange(product: FirebaseProduct): string {
    if (!product.prices || product.prices.length === 0)
      return 'Price not available'
    if (product.prices.length === 1) {
      const onlyPrice = product.prices[0]
      return onlyPrice ? formatPrice(onlyPrice) : 'Price not available'
    }

    const amounts = product.prices
      .map((price: Price | undefined) =>
        price ? price.unit_amount : undefined
      )
      .filter((value: unknown): value is number => typeof value === 'number')
      .sort((a: number, b: number) => a - b)

    const minPrice = amounts[0]
    const maxPrice = amounts[amounts.length - 1]
    const currency = product.prices[0]?.currency?.toUpperCase() || 'USD'
    const symbol = getCurrencySymbol(currency)

    if (minPrice === undefined || maxPrice === undefined) {
      return 'Price not available'
    }

    return `${symbol}${(minPrice / 100).toFixed(2)} - ${symbol}${(
      maxPrice / 100
    ).toFixed(2)}`
  }

  function formatAvailabilityStatus(product: FirebaseProduct): string {
    if (product.active === false) return 'Unavailable'
    if ((product as any).metadata?.stock_quantity) {
      const stock = parseInt((product as any).metadata.stock_quantity)
      if (stock <= 0) return 'Out of Stock'
      if (stock <= 5) return 'Limited Stock'
    }
    return 'Available'
  }

  function formatFeatures(product: FirebaseProduct): string[] {
    const features: any[] = (product.features as any[]) || []
    return features
      .map((feature: any) =>
        typeof feature === 'string' ? feature : feature?.label
      )
      .filter((label: any) => typeof label === 'string' && label.trim().length)
  }

  async function uploadProductImage(
    file: File,
    productSlug: string
  ): Promise<string | null> {
    try {
      const timestamp = Date.now()
      const path = `products/${productSlug}/${timestamp}-${file.name}`
      return await uploadImage(path, file)
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[fireux] failed to upload product image', error)
      return null
    }
  }

  function getCurrencySymbol(currency: string): string {
    const symbols: Record<string, string> = {
      USD: '$',
      EUR: '€',
      GBP: '£',
      JPY: '¥',
      CAD: 'C$',
      AUD: 'A$',
    }
    return symbols[currency] || `${currency} `
  }

  function formatGenericArray(arr: any[]): any[] {
    if (!Array.isArray(arr) || arr.length === 0) return []
    if (typeof arr[0] === 'string') {
      return [
        ...new Set(
          arr
            .filter((value: string) => value?.trim())
            .map((value: string) => value.trim())
        ),
      ]
    }
    if (arr[0] && typeof arr[0].label === 'string') {
      const seen = new Set<string>()
      const output: any[] = []
      for (const item of arr) {
        const label = String(item.label || '').trim()
        if (!label || seen.has(label)) continue
        seen.add(label)
        output.push({ ...item, label })
      }
      return output
    }
    return arr
  }

  return {
    formatProductData,
    buildSlugIfUnique,
    formatSlug,
    formatProductName,
    formatProductExcerpt,
    formatPrice,
    formatPriceRange,
    formatAvailabilityStatus,
    formatFeatures,
    uploadProductImage,
    getCurrencySymbol,
  }
}

```

### packages/extensions/fireux-products/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/product/utils/useProductValidation.ts

```ts
import type { FirebaseProduct } from '#fireux-products/models/product.model'

export function useProductValidation() {
  function validateProduct(product: Partial<FirebaseProduct>) {
    const errors: string[] = []

    if (!product.name?.trim()) {
      errors.push('Product name is required')
    }

    if (!product.description?.trim()) {
      errors.push('Product description is required')
    }

    if (!product.slug?.trim()) {
      errors.push('Product slug is required')
    }

    if (product.name && product.name.length > 200) {
      errors.push('Product name must be 200 characters or less')
    }

    if (product.description && product.description.length > 1000) {
      errors.push('Product description must be 1000 characters or less')
    }

    if (product.slug && !isValidSlug(product.slug)) {
      errors.push(
        'Slug must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens'
      )
    }

    if (product.prices && product.prices.length === 0) {
      errors.push('At least one price is required')
    }

    if (product.images) {
      for (const image of product.images) {
        const url = typeof image === 'string' ? image : image.url
        if (!isValidUrl(url)) {
          errors.push('All product images must be valid URLs')
          break
        }
      }
    }

    if (product.features && product.features.length > 20) {
      errors.push('Maximum 20 features allowed')
    }

    if (product.metadata && typeof product.metadata !== 'object') {
      errors.push('Metadata must be an object')
    }

    return {
      isValid: errors.length === 0,
      errors,
    }
  }

  function isValidSlug(slug: string): boolean {
    const slugRegex = /^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/
    return slugRegex.test(slug)
  }

  function isValidUrl(url: string): boolean {
    try {
      new URL(url)
      return true
    } catch {
      return false
    }
  }

  function isValidPrice(price: number): boolean {
    return typeof price === 'number' && price >= 0 && price < 999_999_999
  }

  function isValidProductType(type: string): boolean {
    const validTypes = ['physical', 'digital', 'service', 'subscription']
    return validTypes.includes(type)
  }

  return {
    validateProduct,
    isValidSlug,
    isValidUrl,
    isValidPrice,
    isValidProductType,
  }
}

```

### packages/extensions/fireux-products/src/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/product/utils/view/useProductInterface.ts

```ts
import type { FirebaseProduct } from '../../../../../../../models/product.model'

export namespace ProductCard {
  export type Card = {
    id: string
    to: string

    // Media (empty string means unset)
    avatarUrl: string

    // Primary display fields
    title: string
    subtitle: string

    name: string
    description: string

    // Secondary media (empty string means unset)
    imageUrl: string

    // Status/label chips
    badges: string[]
  }
}

export function useProductInterface() {
  function map(product: FirebaseProduct): ProductCard.Card {
    const imageUrl =
      product.main_image ||
      product.images?.[0]?.url ||
      ''

    return {
      id: product.id,
      to: `/products/${product.id}`,

      avatarUrl: imageUrl,
      title: product.name,
      subtitle: product.description || '',

      name: product.name,
      description: product.description || '',

      imageUrl,
      badges: [],
    }
  }

  function card(target?: FirebaseProduct | null | undefined): ProductCard.Card | null {
    return target ? map(target) : null
  }

  function searchText(product: FirebaseProduct): string {
    return `${product.name} ${product.id}`.toLowerCase()
  }

  return { card, searchText }
}
```

### packages/extensions/fireux-products/src/runtime/composables/useProductPermissions.ts

```ts
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { useUser } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/fireux/firestore/core/user/useUser'

import '../models/core/user.ext'

export function useProductPermissions() {
  const { isAdmin, appUser, pending } = useUser()

  // Allow global/tenant admin or appUser flag
  const canManageProducts = computed(() => {
    return isAdmin.value === true || appUser.value?.canManageProducts === true
  })

  // Alias to mirror blog permissions shape
  const canPublishProduct = computed(() => canManageProducts.value)

  // Expose pending to match the blog permissions chain
  return { canManageProducts, canPublishProduct, pending }
}
```

```ts
// FILE: packages/extensions/fireux-products/src/runtime/models/product.model.ts

/**
 * Product models (Firestore-shape oriented).
 * Firestore (typical): products/{id} (implementation may vary by tenant/app)
 *
 * Notes:
 * - Keep this file free of UI/view models.
 * - Some input/helper shapes here are used by services and admin surfaces.
 */

import type { FireuxStamped } from 'fireux-core/runtime/models/core/meta.model'
import type { FirebaseTimestamp } from 'fireux-core/types/firebase'

export interface ProductFeature {
  title: string
  description?: string
  available: boolean
}

export interface ProductImage {
  url: string
  alt?: string
  order?: number
}

export interface Price {
  id?: string
  currency: string
  unit_amount: number
  interval?: 'day' | 'week' | 'month' | 'year'
  interval_count?: number
  type?: 'one_time' | 'recurring'
  billing_scheme?: 'per_unit' | 'tiered'
  metadata?: Record<string, any>
}

export interface DefaultPrice {
  id: string
  unit_amount: number
  interval?: 'day' | 'week' | 'month' | 'year'
}

export interface StripePriceInput {
  currency: string
  unit_amount: number
  type?: 'one_time' | 'recurring'
  interval?: 'day' | 'week' | 'month' | 'year'
  interval_count?: number
  billing_scheme?: 'per_unit' | 'tiered'
  metadata?: Record<string, any>
}

export type ProductType = 'physical' | 'digital' | 'service' | 'subscription'

/**
 * Canon Firestore Product doc for FireUX apps.
 * (This is what UI + dev drift should target.)
 */
export const FirebaseProduct = {
  id: '',

  name: '',
  description: '',
  content: '',

  slug: '',
  active: false,

  // Media
  main_image: '',
  images: [] as ProductImage[],

  // Optional structured content
  features: [] as ProductFeature[],

  // Commerce
  prices: [] as Price[],
  default_price: {
    id: '',
    unit_amount: 0,
    interval: 'enum:day|week|month|year' as unknown as DefaultPrice['interval'],
  } as DefaultPrice,
  product_type: 'enum:physical|digital|service|subscription' as unknown as ProductType,
  track_stock: false,
  stock: 0 as number | null,

  // Scope
  appId: '',

  // Meta bag
  metadata: {} as Record<string, any>,

  // Stamps
  creator_id: undefined as FireuxStamped['creator_id'],
  created_at: {} as FirebaseTimestamp,
  updated_at: {} as FirebaseTimestamp,
} as const

export type FirebaseProduct = {
  [K in keyof typeof FirebaseProduct]: (typeof FirebaseProduct)[K]
}

export type ProductCreationInput = Omit<
  FirebaseProduct,
  'id' | 'created_at' | 'updated_at' | 'creator_id'
>

export type ProductUpdateInput = Partial<Omit<ProductCreationInput, 'appId'>>

```

```vue
<template>
  <UPage>
    <UPageHeader
      title="Dev · Products (Ext)"
      description="Model shape for Products collection."
    />

    <UPageBody class="space-y-6">
      <UCard>
        <DevModel
          :title="'Products · Model'"
          :model="productModelRuntime"
        />
      </UCard>

      <UCard>
        <template #header>
          <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
            <div class="space-y-3">
              <p class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100">
                Products collection
              </p>
              <p class="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                Browse products resolved for this runtime and filter by model drift.
              </p>
              <DevDriftToolbar
                :drift-kind="productsDriftKind"
                :selected-field="productsSelectedField"
                :filter-options="productsFilterOptions"
                :copy-label="'Copy drift · Products'"
                :copy-payload="productsDriftCopyPayload"
                @update:drift-kind="setProductsDriftKind"
                @update:selected-field="updateProductsSelectedField"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </template>

        <template #footer>
          <DevJson
            :title="'Products (JSON)'"
            :data="allProductsJsonPayload"
            :default-open="false"
          />
        </template>

        <ProductCollectionManager :collection="filteredProducts" />
      </UCard>
    </UPageBody>
  </UPage>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useDevDriftFilter } from 'fireux-core/runtime/composables/dev/useDevDriftFilter'
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { useProductCollection } from '../../composables/fireux/firestore/product/fetch/useProductCollection'
import { FirebaseProduct as ProductModelRuntime } from '../../models/product.model'

definePageMeta({
  layout: 'dev',
  nav: {
    key: 'dev-ext-products',
    label: 'Products (Ext)',
    icon: 'i-lucide-package',
    desktop: true,
    group: 'ext',
    layouts: ['dev'],
  },
})

const productModelRuntime = ProductModelRuntime

const { products } = useProductCollection()

const productsCollection = computed(() => products.value ?? [])

const {
  driftKind: productsDriftKind,
  setDriftKind: setProductsDriftKind,
  selectedField: productsSelectedField,
  driftById: productsDriftById,
  filterOptions: productsFilterOptions,
  filteredCollection: filteredProducts,
} = useDevDriftFilter({
  collection: productsCollection,
  runtimeModel: productModelRuntime,
})

const allProductsJsonPayload = computed(() => ({
  totalProducts: productsCollection.value.length,
  products: productsCollection.value,
}))

const filteredProductsDriftPayload = computed(() =>
  filteredProducts.value.map((product) => {
    const drift = productsDriftById.value.get(product.id) ?? { missing: [], extra: [] }
    return {
      id: product.id,
      name: product.name,
      drift,
    }
  })
)

const productsDriftCopyPayload = computed(() => ({
  modelPath: 'packages/extensions/fireux-products/src/runtime/models/product.model.ts',
  driftKind: productsDriftKind.value,
  selectedField: productsSelectedField.value || null,
  totalProducts: filteredProducts.value.length,
  products: filteredProductsDriftPayload.value,
}))

const updateProductsSelectedField = (value: string) => {
  productsSelectedField.value = value
}
</script>

```

```vue
<template>
  <UPage>
    <UPageHeader
      title="Create Product"
      description="Add a new product to the catalog for this runtime."
    />

    <UPageBody class="pagebody">
      <div v-if="permissionsPending?.value" class="space-y-3">
        <USkeleton v-for="n in 3" :key="n" class="h-20" />
      </div>

      <UAlert
        v-else-if="!canPublishProduct"
        color="amber"
        title="Admins only"
        description="Only admins can publish products for this runtime."
      />

      <MoleculesCreateShell
        v-else
        :loading="isCreating"
        submit-label="Create"
        @submit="handleCreate"
        @clear="handleClear"
      >
        <template #write>
          <ProductCreateWrite />
        </template>
        <template #preview>
          <ProductCreatePreview />
        </template>
      </MoleculesCreateShell>
    </UPageBody>
  </UPage>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { useHead } from '#imports'
import { useProductPermissions } from '../../composables/useProductPermissions'
// Use Nuxt UI toast if available (auto-imported in app)
const useToastFn = (globalThis as any).useToast as undefined | (() => any)
const toast = useToastFn ? useToastFn() : undefined
import {
  useCreateProductState,
  useCreatePricesState,
  useProductCreateSubmit,
} from '../../composables/fireux/firestore/product/useProduct'

definePageMeta({
  layout: 'default',
  nav: {
    key: 'products-create',
    label: 'Create product',
    icon: 'i-lucide-plus',
    order: 21,
    desktop: false,
    mobile: false,
    layouts: ['default'],
  },
  title: 'Create Product',
})

const { canPublishProduct, pending: permissionsPending } =
  useProductPermissions()

useHead({ title: 'Create Product' })

const isCreating = ref(false)
const { product, resetCreateProductState } = await useCreateProductState()
const { resetCreatePricesState } = useCreatePricesState()
const { submit } = useProductCreateSubmit()

async function handleCreate() {
  isCreating.value = true
  try {
    await submit()

    if (toast)
      toast.add({
        title: 'Created',
        description: 'Product created successfully',
        icon: 'i-heroicons-check-circle',
        color: 'green',
      })
    resetCreateProductState()
    resetCreatePricesState()
  } catch (error) {
    if (toast)
      toast.add({
        title: 'Create failed',
        description:
          error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unable to create product',
        icon: 'i-heroicons-x-circle',
        color: 'red',
      })
    return
  } finally {
    isCreating.value = false
  }
}

function handleClear() {
  if (confirm('Are you sure you want to clear the form?')) {
    resetCreateProductState()
    resetCreatePricesState()
  }
}
</script>
```

### packages/extensions/fireux-products/src/runtime/server/api/stripe/create-product.post.ts

```ts
// ~/server/api/stripe/create-product.post.ts
import { defineEventHandler, readBody, createError, type H3Event } from 'h3'
import { createRequire } from 'node:module'
import { STRIPE_API_VERSION } from '../../stripe/version'

export default defineEventHandler(async (event: H3Event) => {
  try {
    // Quick guard: if no secret key, return 501 (not configured) instead of crashing
    const secret = process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
    if (!secret) {
      throw createError({
        statusCode: 501,
        statusMessage: 'Stripe not configured (missing STRIPE_SECRET_KEY)',
      })
    }

    // Lazy import Stripe so dev without the package/env won’t crash at load time
    const require = createRequire(import.meta.url)
    let Stripe: any = null
    try {
      Stripe = require('stripe')
      if (Stripe?.default) Stripe = Stripe.default
    } catch {
      Stripe = null
    }

    if (!Stripe) {
      throw createError({
        statusCode: 501,
        statusMessage: 'Stripe SDK not installed',
      })
    }

    const stripe = new Stripe(secret, { apiVersion: STRIPE_API_VERSION })
    const body = await readBody(event)
    const { product, ping } = body

    if (!product) {
      throw createError({
        statusCode: 400,
        statusMessage: 'Product data is required',
      })
    }

    console.log('🔄 [create-product] Creating Stripe product:', product.name)
    if (ping) {
      console.log('🏓 [create-product] Ping received:', ping)
    }

    // Create product in Stripe
    const stripeProduct = await stripe.products.create({
      name: product.name,
      description: product.description || '',
      metadata: {
        appId: product.appId || '',
        slug: product.slug || '',
      },
    })

    console.log('✅ [create-product] Stripe product created:', stripeProduct.id)

    // Create prices if provided
    const stripePrices = []
    if (product.prices && product.prices.length > 0) {
      for (const price of product.prices) {
        const stripePrice = await stripe.prices.create({
          product: stripeProduct.id,
          unit_amount: price.unit_amount,
          currency: price.currency || 'eur',
          recurring:
            price.type === 'recurring'
              ? {
                  interval: price.interval,
                  interval_count: price.interval_count || 1,
                }
              : undefined,
        })
        stripePrices.push(stripePrice)
        console.log('✅ [create-product] Stripe price created:', stripePrice.id)
      }
    }

    // Call Firestore update endpoint if product creation was successful
    let firestoreResult = null
    if (stripeProduct.id) {
      try {
        console.log('📝 [create-product] Calling Firestore update endpoint...')
        firestoreResult = await fetch('/api/stripe/update-firestore', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            stripeProductId: stripeProduct.id,
            product: product,
            stripePrices: stripePrices,
            pong: ping === 'ping' ? 'pong' : undefined,
          }),
        })
        console.log('✅ [create-product] Firestore update completed')
      } catch (firestoreError) {
        console.warn(
          '⚠️ [create-product] Firestore update failed:',
          firestoreError
        )
      }
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      id: stripeProduct.id,
      stripe_prices: stripePrices.map((p) => p.id),
      message: `Product '${product.name}' created successfully in Stripe`,
      pong: ping === 'ping' ? 'pong' : undefined,
      firestore: firestoreResult ? 'updated' : 'skipped',
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('❌ [create-product] Error:', error)

    const errorMessage =
      error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error occurred'

    throw createError({
      statusCode: 500,
      statusMessage: `Failed to create product: ${errorMessage}`,
    })
  }
})
```

```vue
<template>
  <div ref="root" class="fx-bubbles" aria-hidden="true">
    <div v-for="n in count" :key="n" class="bubble" />
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref } from 'vue'
import { useBubbles } from '../../composables/useBubbles'

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{ count?: number }>(), { count: 28 })
const count = props.count

const root = ref<HTMLElement | null>(null)
const { initializeBubbles, cleanup } = useBubbles()

onMounted(() => {
  if (root.value) initializeBubbles(root.value)
})

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  cleanup()
})
</script>
```

```vue
<template>
  <div class="space-y-6">
    <div class="space-y-2">
      <h1 class="hero-title">

      </h1>
    </div>

    <div class="space-y-4">
      <p
        class="text-base lg:text-xl leading-relaxed max-w-prose"
        v-html="paragraph"
      ></p>

      <div v-if="badges?.length" class="flex items-center gap-6 pt-2">
        <img
          v-for="badge in badges"
          :key="badge.alt"
          :src="badge.src"
          :alt="badge.alt"
          class="h-10 opacity-80"
        />
      </div>

      <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-4 pt-6">
        <UButton variant="solid" size="lg" :to="primary.to">
          {{ primary.label }}
        </UButton>
        <UButton
          variant="outline"
          size="lg"
          :to="secondary.to"
          trailing-icon="i-heroicons-arrow-right"
        >
          {{ secondary.label }}
        </UButton>
        <UButton v-if="tertiary" variant="ghost" size="lg" :to="tertiary.to">
          {{ tertiary.label }}
        </UButton>
      </div>
    </div>

    <ul class="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 pt-4">
      <li
        v-for="(bullet, index) in bullets"
        :key="index"
        class="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm"
      >
        <UIcon :name="bullet.icon" class="shrink-0" />
        <span v-html="bullet.text" />
      </li>
    </ul>

    <slot name="extra" />
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue'

export interface LandingHeroProps {
  title?: string
  accent?: string
  titleMain?: string
  titlePrefix?: string
  titleAccent?: string
  paragraph: string
  badges?: Array<{ src: string; alt: string }>
  primary: { label: string; to: string }
  secondary: { label: string; to: string }
  tertiary?: { label: string; to: string }
  bullets: Array<{ icon: string; text: string }>
}

const props = defineProps<LandingHeroProps>()

const titleText = computed(() => {
  if (props.title) return props.title
  const segments = [props.titleMain, props.titlePrefix]
    .filter((value): value is string => Boolean(value && value.trim()))
    .map((value) => value.trim())
  return segments.join(' ').trim()
})

const accentText = computed(() => props.accent ?? props.titleAccent ?? '')
</script>

<style scoped>
.hero-title {
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-black);
  font-size: clamp(2.75rem, 6vw, 4.5rem);
  line-height: 1.15;
  color: var(--ui-text);
}
.hero-title strong {
  font-weight: inherit;
}
.hero-title--accent {
  color: var(--color-primary-500);
}
</style>
```

### projects/cleanbox/cleanbox-app/app/composables/useBubbles.ts

```ts
const isClient = typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' && 'window' in globalThis

const randomInRange = (min: number, max: number) =>
  Math.random() * (max - min) + min

type Cleanup = () => void

const applyFromDataset = (el: HTMLElement, reducedMotion: boolean) => {
  const riseSeconds = Number.parseFloat(el.dataset.bubbleRiseSeconds ?? '22')
  const pulseSeconds = Number.parseFloat(el.dataset.bubblePulseSeconds ?? '6')
  const delaySeconds = Number.parseFloat(el.dataset.bubbleDelaySeconds ?? '0')

  el.style.setProperty(
    '--bubble-rise',
    reducedMotion ? '0s' : `${riseSeconds.toFixed(2)}s`
  )
  el.style.setProperty(
    '--bubble-pulse',
    reducedMotion ? '0s' : `${pulseSeconds.toFixed(2)}s`
  )
  el.style.animationDelay = reducedMotion
    ? '0s, 0s'
    : `${delaySeconds.toFixed(2)}s, ${(delaySeconds * 0.5).toFixed(2)}s`
}

export const useBubbles = () => {
  const cleanups: Cleanup[] = []

  const cleanup = () => {
    while (cleanups.length) {
      const dispose = cleanups.pop()
      if (dispose) dispose()
    }
  }

  const initializeBubbles = (root: HTMLElement) => {
    cleanup()

    if (!isClient) return

    const bubbles = Array.from(root.children).filter(
      (node): node is HTMLElement => node instanceof HTMLElement
    )

    const mediaQuery = globalThis.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)')
    const initialReduced = mediaQuery.matches

    for (const el of bubbles) {
      const riseSeconds = randomInRange(18, 28)
      const pulseSeconds = randomInRange(5, 9)
      const size = randomInRange(16, 42)
      const drift = randomInRange(18, 54) * (Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1)
      const scaleBase = randomInRange(0.85, 1.3)
      const scalePeak = scaleBase * 1.08
      const opacity = randomInRange(0.28, 0.6)
      const offsetRatio = Math.random()
      const delaySeconds = -riseSeconds * offsetRatio
      const xOffset = randomInRange(-45, 45)

      el.dataset.bubbleRiseSeconds = riseSeconds.toFixed(2)
      el.dataset.bubblePulseSeconds = pulseSeconds.toFixed(2)
      el.dataset.bubbleDelaySeconds = delaySeconds.toFixed(2)

      el.style.setProperty('--x', `${xOffset.toFixed(2)}vw`)
      el.style.setProperty('--drift', `${drift.toFixed(2)}px`)
      el.style.setProperty('--bubble-scale-start', scaleBase.toFixed(2))
      el.style.setProperty('--bubble-scale-peak', scalePeak.toFixed(2))
      el.style.setProperty('--bubble-scale-end', scaleBase.toFixed(2))
      el.style.setProperty('--bubble-opacity', opacity.toFixed(2))

      el.style.width = `${size.toFixed(2)}px`
      el.style.height = `${size.toFixed(2)}px`

      applyFromDataset(el, initialReduced)
    }

    const handleChange = () => {
      const reduced = mediaQuery.matches
      for (const el of bubbles) {
        applyFromDataset(el, reduced)
      }
    }

    mediaQuery.addEventListener('change', handleChange)

    cleanups.push(
      () => {
        mediaQuery.removeEventListener('change', handleChange)
      },
      () => {
        for (const el of bubbles) {
          el.removeAttribute('style')
          delete el.dataset.bubbleRiseSeconds
          delete el.dataset.bubblePulseSeconds
          delete el.dataset.bubbleDelaySeconds
        }
      }
    )
  }

  return { initializeBubbles, cleanup }
}

```

### projects/cleanbox/cleanbox-app/docs/gap.md

```md
# Gap Analysis

This file is generated by Copilot comparing `liturature.md` to the actual code.

---

## 1. Missing Features

- Real-time scheduling and crew assignment tools are absent; the runtime only exposes the marketing landing page (`app/pages/index.vue`) with no operational consoles or scheduling composables.
- QA checklist, photo upload, and timestamp workflows promised in the literature do not exist; there are no QA components or storage integrations under `app/components` or `app/composables`.
- Client consoles and proof-of-work sharing are missing; no client data models or routes are implemented.
- Stripe invoicing and payment tracking are not configured; there are no billing pages, server routes, or Stripe composables in the app.
- Certification/compliance tracking per crew member is not implemented; no components or data structures address training/incident records.
- Chat and feedback tools between management and staff are absent; no messaging UI or realtime services are present.
- Analytics consoles for productivity and satisfaction are missing; no reporting pages or data pipelines exist.
- PWA/mobile crew experience is not set up; there is no manifest, offline support, or mobile-specific UI beyond the landing page.

## 2. Missing Routes or Components

- Promised routes `/get-started`, `/console`, `/crews`, `/qa`, `/billing`, `/clients`, `/reports` are not implemented; `app/pages/` contains only `index.vue`.
- Landing CTAs reference `/get-started`, `/crews`, `/console`, `/sales`, `/scheduling`, `/qa`, `/compliance`, `/billing`, `/clients`, and `/reports`, none of which exist.

## 3. Mismatched or Renamed Items

- The literature advertises real-time operational tooling, but the current implementation is purely marketing content; even the theme configuration (`app/app.config.ts`) remains a generic blue/gray palette without production branding assets.

## 4. Notes

- The app installs the `fireux-cleanbox` module via `createFireuxConfig`, providing a foundation to build on, but no tenant-specific data or UI has been wired in yet.

```

### projects/cleanbox/cleanbox-app/docs/liturature.md

```md
# Cleanbox App

The live SaaS platform for cleaning companies to manage teams, schedules, quality checks, and billing — built on the FireUX framework.

---

## Audience

Cleaning business owners, operations managers, and team leaders who want to digitize and automate their daily workflows.

---

## Purpose

The Cleanbox App is the production tenant of FireUX Cleanbox.
It transforms field operations into a structured system with clear accountability, client proof, and automated billing — all accessible through desktop or mobile.

---

## Key Features

- Real-time job scheduling and crew assignments
- QA checklists with photo uploads and timestamps
- Client consoles showing proof of work
- Stripe-powered invoicing and payment tracking
- Certification and compliance tracking per crew member
- Chat and feedback tools between management and staff
- Analytics console for productivity and client satisfaction
- PWA-ready mobile access for crews on the go

---

## Main Pages / Routes

- `/` – marketing homepage
- `/get-started` – onboarding for new companies
- `/console` – operational overview for managers
- `/crews` – list of team members and shift assignments
- `/qa` – quality assurance and proof uploads
- `/billing` – invoices, payments, and exports
- `/clients` – client overview and report access
- `/reports` – analytics and performance summaries

---

## Next Steps

- Complete client login portal for shared QA reports
- Improve mobile-first PWA experience for field crews
- Add supervisor approval flow for QA submissions
- Automate invoice generation after job completion
- Connect to FireUX analytics for multi-tenant reporting
- Launch demo environment for potential clients

---

## Summary

The Cleanbox App is where the FireUX system becomes a real business tool.
It helps cleaning teams operate like modern SaaS-driven companies — transparent, efficient, and client-ready from day one.

```

### projects/cleanbox/cleanbox-app/docs/mission.md

```md
# Cleanbox Global Shell

## Mission

Demonstrate the Cleanbox ecosystem in action: auth, scheduling glimpses, and tenant hand-off, while keeping industry specifics modular.

## Purpose

- Present the Cleanbox brand story and navigation.
- Exercise core flows (sign-in, onboarding, location selection) with hospitality-agnostic defaults.
- Showcase Cleanbox service listings without fixing the underlying data schemes.
- Provide a stable home for shared pages (marketing, help, account) that every Cleanbox tenant can rely on.

```

### projects/cleanbox/cleanbox-app/docs/roadmap.md

```md
# Cleanbox App Roadmap

Status legend: ✅ completed · ⚙️ in progress · ❌ missing · 🧩 planned (blocked on shared work)

## ✅ Completed

- Marketing landing experience (`app/pages/index.vue`) with hero, quick peek, and solutions sections
- Core wiring via `createFireuxConfig` to load the `fireux-cleanbox` module and shared layouts

## ⚙️ In Progress

- Nothing identified

## ❌ Missing

- Operational console with real-time crew scheduling, coverage alerts, and daily metrics
- Crew workspace for assignments, attendance, and mobile-ready check-ins
- QA workflow: checklist builder, photo uploads, approvals, and audit trails
- Client portal/consoles exposing proof of work, reports, and feedback channels
- Stripe-integrated billing engine (plans, invoices, payments, exports)
- Certification/compliance management for staff (training records, incident logging)
- In-app chat/feedback or notifications between management and field teams
- Analytics and reporting surfaces (KPIs, trends, multi-tenant summaries)
- PWA enhancements (manifest, offline caching, push) for crew devices

## 🧩 Planned / Cross-Package Dependencies

- Scheduling and workforce data should align with shared models in `fireux-cleanbox` and `fireux-core`; confirm data contracts before building UI
- QA photo capture will depend on Firestore/Storage patterns and possibly `fireux-cleanbox` extensions—coordinate to avoid duplicate upload logic
- Billing requires Stripe integration conventions from FireUX core; reuse shared services for customer and invoice management
- Chat/notifications may leverage a future messaging extension; align on transport (Firestore, Pub/Sub) before implementation
- Analytics consoles likely need a shared reporting pipeline; coordinate with platform analytics ADRs before building tenant views

## Next Actions

- [ ] Scaffold promised routes (`/get-started`, `/console`, `/crews`, `/qa`, `/billing`, `/clients`, `/reports`) with placeholder layouts
- [ ] Implement scheduling data layer and UI (shifts, crews, coverage alerts)
- [ ] Build QA module supporting checklist creation, photo uploads, and supervisor approvals
- [ ] Deliver client portal pages with report summaries, media galleries, and feedback capture
- [ ] Integrate Stripe billing (products, invoices, payment sync) following core patterns
- [ ] Add compliance tooling for certifications and incident tracking tied to crew profiles
- [ ] Introduce chat/notification channels or integrate with planned messaging extension
- [ ] Stand up analytics consoles and connect to FireUX analytics services
- [ ] Configure PWA support (manifest, offline caching, push notifications) for field crews

```

### projects/cleanbox/richies-reinigung/app/composables/useBubbles.ts

```ts
// Cleanbox bubble effect composable
export function useBubbles() {
  const initializeBubbles = () => {
    const bubbles = document.querySelectorAll('.bubble')

    bubbles.forEach((bubble) => {
      const bubbleElement = bubble as HTMLElement

      // Random horizontal position
      bubbleElement.style.left = `${Math.random() * 100}%`

      // Start at random positions in the animation cycle
      const startingPoint = Math.random() * 100
      bubbleElement.style.top = `${startingPoint}%`

      // Initial transform to sync animation
      const initialYPos = 100 - startingPoint
      bubbleElement.style.transform = `translateY(${initialYPos}vh)`

      // Random size for variety
      const size = Math.random() * 20 + 10 // 10-30px
      bubbleElement.style.width = `${size}px`
      bubbleElement.style.height = `${size}px`

      // Random initial opacity
      const initialOpacity = Math.random() * 0.3 + 0.1
      bubbleElement.style.opacity = initialOpacity.toString()

      // Random durations for natural movement
      const floatDuration = Math.random() * 5 + 8 // 8-13 seconds
      const popDuration = Math.random() * 2 + 2 // 2-4 seconds
      const sway = Math.random() * 3 + 2 // 2-5 seconds

      // Use negative delay to start at different animation points
      const floatDelay = -(floatDuration * (startingPoint / 100))
      const popDelay = Math.random() * 3
      const swayDelay = Math.random() * 2

      bubbleElement.style.animationDelay = `${popDelay}s, ${floatDelay}s, ${swayDelay}s`
      bubbleElement.style.animationDuration = `${popDuration}s, ${floatDuration}s, ${sway}s`

      // Listen for animation end and reset bubble position
      bubbleElement.addEventListener('animationiteration', () => {
        bubbleElement.style.top = '100%' // Move back to bottom
        bubbleElement.style.transform = `translateY(-100vh)` // Start floating up again
      })
    })
  }

  return {
    initializeBubbles,
  }
}

```

### projects/cleanbox/richies-reinigung/docs/gap.md

```md
# Gap Analysis

This file is generated by Copilot comparing `liturature.md` to the actual code.

---

## 1. Missing Features

- Crew console, shift assignment tooling, and attendance tracking are absent; the app exposes only a marketing-style landing page (`app/pages/index.vue`) with no operational views.
- QA/photo verification flows with uploads and timestamped proof do not exist; there are no components or composables handling inspections or media capture under `app/components` or `app/composables`.
- Client reporting, job summaries, and visual verification features are missing; there is no data layer or UI for client/job records.
- Stripe billing integration is not configured; no Stripe composables, server routes, or billing pages are present.
- Compliance resources for Swiss safety standards are not implemented; no dedicated content or routes exist.
- Analytics overviews for hours worked or completion rates are missing; there are no consoles or metrics modules.

## 2. Missing Routes or Components

- Promised routes `/console`, `/crews`, `/qa`, `/clients`, `/billing` are not implemented; the `app/pages/` directory only contains `index.vue`.
- Landing CTAs link to `/cleaners` and `/services`, but these routes and supporting components are absent.

## 3. Mismatched or Renamed Items

- The literature advertises a “branded UI with Richie’s Reinigung colors and logo,” yet `app/app.config.ts` only sets a generic blue/gray theme and no logo assets or layout overrides are provided.

## 4. Notes

- The project currently installs `fireux-cleanbox` but relies on shared layouts; tenant-specific configuration and data seeding will be required before operations can launch.

```

### projects/cleanbox/richies-reinigung/docs/liturature.md

```md
# Richie’s Reinigung

A branded Cleanbox deployment for Richie’s Reinigung — a Swiss cleaning company using FireUX technology to manage daily operations, staff, and clients.

---

## Audience

Richie’s Reinigung management team, on-site crew members, and administrative staff.

---

## Purpose

This project demonstrates how FireUX Cleanbox can be fully customized for a single business.
It keeps the power of Cleanbox but adapts the visuals, copy, and data structure to fit Richie’s Reinigung’s real workflows, team sizes, and client expectations.

---

## Key Features

- Branded UI with Richie’s Reinigung colors and logo
- Crew console for shift assignments and attendance
- QA module with photo uploads and timestamped proof
- Client reports with job summaries and visual verification
- Integrated Stripe billing under Richie’s own account
- Custom compliance section for Swiss safety standards
- Analytics overview for hours worked and job completion rates

---

## Main Pages / Routes

- `/` – company homepage
- `/console` – manager view of daily operations
- `/crews` – active staff list and shift schedules
- `/qa` – photo verification and checklists
- `/clients` – client database and job reports
- `/billing` – invoices and payment records

---

## Next Steps

- Automate recurring client schedules (weekly/monthly jobs)
- Add bilingual interface (German/English)
- Expand analytics console for cost per site
- Integrate custom report exports for Swiss compliance forms
- Connect with Cleanbox central analytics via FireUX Core

---

## Summary

Richie’s Reinigung is proof of how FireUX apps can be tailored for real businesses.
Built on Cleanbox, it shows the white-label power of FireUX — giving companies a professional, branded platform with all the efficiency of a shared ecosystem.

```

### projects/cleanbox/richies-reinigung/docs/mission.md

```md
# Richie's Reinigung Tenant

## Mission

Deliver the Cleanbox experience tailored for Richie's Reinigung: German-language cleaning services, rota management, and field staff tooling that still honor FIReUX's modular contract.

## Purpose

- Localize the Cleanbox global shell for Richie's markets and service tiers.
- Wire the tenant to the specific service catalogue, pricing rules, and checklist formats Richie's adopts.
- Offer ops teams rota, route, and crew oversight while leaving integrations pluggable.
- Validate that the Cleanbox ecosystem can support multilingual, high-frequency cleaning operations without deviating from FIReUX guardrails.

```

```md
## ⚙️ In Progress

- Nothing identified

## ❌ Missing

- Console experience for managers covering shift assignments, attendance, and daily operations
- Crew directory with scheduling tools and mobile-friendly check-in flows
- QA verification module with photo uploads, timestamps, and checklist management
- Client database with job history, reports, and visual proof exports
- Billing workspace powered by Stripe (products, invoices, payment status)
- Compliance knowledge base for Swiss safety standards, including exportable forms
- Analytics consoles tracking hours worked, job completion rates, and cost per site
- Localization/bilingual interface support (DE/EN) across routes and content

## 🧩 Planned / Cross-Package Dependencies

- Shift scheduling and attendance should build on shared Cleanbox workforce models (confirm availability in `fireux-cleanbox` or extend core)
- QA photo storage may rely on Firestore/Storage conventions defined in `fireux-core`; align before implementing uploads
- Billing flows depend on Stripe integration patterns from Cleanbox core; coordinate with core owners to avoid duplicate logic
- Compliance exports likely require shared reporting utilities; consider adding to `fireux-cleanbox` or a new extension

## Next Actions

- [ ] Design navigation and scaffold the promised routes (`/console`, `/crews`, `/qa`, `/clients`, `/billing`) with placeholder layouts
- [ ] Implement crew scheduling and attendance tracking atop Cleanbox workforce data
- [ ] Build QA module supporting photo capture, checklist completion, and audit trails
- [ ] Ship client reporting views with job summaries, media galleries, and export options
- [ ] Integrate Stripe for billing (customer sync, invoices, payment reconciliation)
- [ ] Create compliance section with configurable Swiss safety checklists and downloadable reports
- [ ] Add analytics consoles aggregating hours worked, completion rates, and cost metrics
- [ ] Introduce bilingual content strategy (i18n tooling, locale switcher, translated copy)
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useNuxtApp } from 'nuxt/app'
import { computed } from 'vue'

const nuxtApp = useNuxtApp()
const colorMode = nuxtApp.$colorMode as { value: string } | undefined
const isDark = computed(() => colorMode?.value === 'dark')

const logos = {
  nuxt: {
    light: '/img/stack/nuxt-black.png',
    dark: '/img/stack/nuxt-white.png',
  },
  firebase: {
    light: '/img/stack/firebase-black.png',
    dark: '/img/stack/firebase-white.png',
  },
  stripe: {
    light: '/img/stack/stripe-black.png',
    dark: '/img/stack/stripe-white.png',
  },
}

const nuxtSrc = computed(() =>
  isDark.value ? logos.nuxt.dark : logos.nuxt.light
)
const firebaseSrc = computed(() =>
  isDark.value ? logos.firebase.dark : logos.firebase.light
)
const stripeSrc = computed(() =>
  isDark.value ? logos.stripe.dark : logos.stripe.light
)
</script>
```

```vue
        <img
          v-for="badge in badges"
          :key="badge.alt"
          :src="badge.src"
          :alt="badge.alt"
          class="h-10 opacity-80"
        />
      </div>

      <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-4 pt-6">
        <UButton variant="solid" size="lg" :to="primary.to">
          {{ primary.label }}
        </UButton>
        <UButton
          variant="outline"
          size="lg"
          :to="secondary.to"
          trailing-icon="i-heroicons-arrow-right"
        >
          {{ secondary.label }}
        </UButton>
        <UButton v-if="tertiary" variant="ghost" size="lg" :to="tertiary.to">
          {{ tertiary.label }}
        </UButton>
      </div>
    </div>

    <ul class="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 pt-4">
      <li
        v-for="(bullet, index) in bullets"
        :key="index"
        class="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm"
      >
        <UIcon :name="bullet.icon" class="shrink-0" />
        <span v-html="bullet.text" />
      </li>
    </ul>

    <slot name="extra" />
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue'

export interface LandingHeroProps {
  title?: string
  accent?: string
  titleMain?: string
  titlePrefix?: string
  titleAccent?: string
  paragraph: string
  badges?: Array<{ src: string; alt: string }>
  primary: { label: string; to: string }
  secondary: { label: string; to: string }
  tertiary?: { label: string; to: string }
  bullets: Array<{ icon: string; text: string }>
}

const props = defineProps<LandingHeroProps>()

const titleText = computed(() => {
  if (props.title) return props.title
  const segments = [props.titleMain, props.titlePrefix]
    .filter((value): value is string => Boolean(value && value.trim()))
    .map((value) => value.trim())
  return segments.join(' ').trim()
})

const accentText = computed(() => props.accent ?? props.titleAccent ?? '')
</script>

<style scoped>

  font-size: clamp(2.75rem, 6vw, 4.5rem);
  line-height: 1.15;
  color: var(--ui-text);
}

  font-weight: inherit;
}
.hero-title--accent {

}
</style>
```

```vue
      >
        <template #header>
          <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
            <img
              v-if="app.logo"
              :src="app.logo"
              :alt="app.title"
              class="h-6 opacity-80"
            />
            <h3 class="font-semibold">{{ app.title }}</h3>
          </div>
        </template>

        <p class="text-sm text-[color:var(--ui-text-muted)]">
          {{ app.description }}
        </p>

        <template #footer>
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
            <UBadge :color="normalizeBadgeColor(app.tagColor)" variant="soft">{{
              app.tag || 'App'

            <UButton size="sm" variant="soft" :to="app.to">Open</UButton>
          </div>
        </template>

<script setup lang="ts">
type ProductItem = {
  title: string
  description: string
  to: string
  logo?: string
  tag?: string
  tagColor?: 'primary' | 'neutral' | 'sky' | 'violet' | 'amber'
}

defineProps<{ items?: ProductItem[] }>()

const normalizeBadgeColor = (value?: ProductItem['tagColor']) => {
  switch (value) {
    case 'neutral':
      return 'neutral'
    case 'sky':
      return 'info'
    case 'violet':
      return 'secondary'
    case 'amber':
      return 'warning'
    case 'primary':
    default:
      return 'primary'
  }
}
</script>
```

### projects/fireux/fireux-app/app/composables/useStarfield.ts

```ts
// COMMENT: app/composables/app/effects/useStarfield.ts
export function useStarfield() {
  const initializeStars = () => {
    const stars = document.querySelectorAll('.star')

    stars.forEach((star) => {
      const starElement = star as HTMLElement

      // ✅ Random horizontal position only
      starElement.style.left = `${Math.random() * 100}%`

      // ✅ Start at random positions in the animation cycle
      const startingPoint = Math.random() * 100
      starElement.style.top = `${startingPoint}%`

      // ✅ Initial transform to sync animation
      const initialYPos = 100 - startingPoint
      starElement.style.transform = `translateY(${initialYPos}vh)`

      // ✅ Random size
      const size = Math.random() * 1.5 + 1
      starElement.style.width = `${size}px`
      starElement.style.height = `${size}px`

      // ✅ Random initial opacity (0.1 to 0.5)
      const initialOpacity = Math.random() * 0.4 + 0.1
      starElement.style.opacity = initialOpacity.toString()

      // ✅ Random durations
      const twinkleDuration = Math.random() * 3 + 3
      const moveDuration = Math.random() * 340 + 340 // ⭐ Controls speed of movement upwards

      // ✅ Use negative delay to start at different animation points
      const moveDelay = -(moveDuration * (startingPoint / 100))
      const twinkleDelay = Math.random() * 2

      starElement.style.animationDelay = `${twinkleDelay}s, ${moveDelay}s`
      starElement.style.animationDuration = `${twinkleDuration}s, ${moveDuration}s`

      // ✅ Listen for animation end and reset star position
      starElement.addEventListener('animationiteration', () => {
        starElement.style.top = '100%'
        starElement.style.transform = `translateY(-100vh)`
      })
    })
  }

  return {
    initializeStars,
  }
}
```

### projects/fireux/fireux-app/app/error.vue

```vue
<template>
  <main class="mx-auto flex min-h-screen max-w-3xl items-center px-6 py-16">
    <div class="w-full space-y-6">
      <header class="space-y-2">
        <p class="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-primary/70">
          FireUX Platform
        </p>
        <h1 class="text-3xl font-semibold text-primary-foreground">
          {{ title }}
        </h1>
        <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          {{ description }}
        </p>
      </header>

      <section v-if="isFirebaseAdminCredentialError" class="space-y-3">
        <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          This usually means <code>GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS</code> points
          to a JSON file that is not a Firebase service account (it’s missing
          <code>private_key</code>).
        </p>

        <div class="space-y-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          <p class="font-medium text-primary-foreground">Fix options</p>
          <ul class="list-disc space-y-1 pl-5">
            <li>
              Point <code>GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS</code> to a Firebase
              service-account JSON file.
            </li>
            <li>
              Or set <code>FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID</code>,
              <code>FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL</code>, and
              <code>FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY</code>.
            </li>
          </ul>
        </div>

        <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
          <NuxtLink class="link" to="/getting-started">Getting started →</NuxtLink>
          <button class="link" type="button" @click="reload">Reload</button>
        </div>
      </section>

      <details v-if="error?.message" class="rounded-xl border border-border/70 bg-card p-4">
        <summary class="cursor-pointer text-sm font-medium text-primary-foreground">
          Technical details
        </summary>
        <pre class="mt-3 overflow-auto text-xs text-muted-foreground">{{ error.message }}</pre>
      </details>

      <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
        <NuxtLink class="link" to="/">Home</NuxtLink>
        <button class="link" type="button" @click="clearError({ redirect: '/' })">
          Dismiss
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </main>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { clearError, type NuxtError } from 'nuxt/app';
import { computed } from 'vue';

const props = defineProps<{ error: NuxtError }>()

const title = computed(() => {
  const statusCode = props.error?.statusCode
  if (statusCode === 404) return 'Page not found'
  return 'Something went wrong'
})

const description = computed(() => {
  const statusCode = props.error?.statusCode
  if (statusCode === 404) return 'The page you requested does not exist.'
  return 'A server error occurred while rendering this page.'
})

const isFirebaseAdminCredentialError = computed(() => {
  const message = String(props.error?.message ?? '')
  return (
    message.includes('Service account object must contain a string "private_key"') ||
    message.includes('private_key is missing in GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS') ||
    message.includes('Failed to parse service account')
  )
})

const reload = () => {
  if (import.meta.client) window.location.reload()
}
</script>

```

```vue
<!-- COMMENT: app/pages/design/atoms/colors.vue -->
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, onMounted } from 'vue'

definePageMeta({ layout: 'design' })

const colorGroups = {
  brandColors: ['--ui-primary', '--ui-secondary'],
  statusColors: ['--ui-info', '--ui-success', '--ui-warning', '--ui-error'],
  uiColors: [
    '--ui-bg',
    '--ui-bg-muted',
    '--ui-bg-elevated',
    '--ui-border',
    '--ui-border-muted',
    '--ui-border-accented',
  ],
}

type ColorItem = { group: string; name: string }

const colorValues = ref<ColorItem[]>([])

onMounted(() => {
  const colors: ColorItem[] = []

  Object.entries(colorGroups).forEach(([group, vars]) => {
    ;(vars as string[]).forEach((varName: string) => {
      colors.push({ group, name: varName })
    })
  })

  colorValues.value = colors
})
</script>

<template>
  <div class="design">
    <div class="grid">
      <div v-for="color in colorValues" :key="color.name" class="color-item">
        <div
          class="color-block"
          :style="{ backgroundColor: `var(${color.name})` }"
        />
        <div class="color-header">{{ color.name }}</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```
