### projects/fireux/fireux-app/app/pages/dev/registry.vue

```vue
<template>
  <UPage>
    <UPageHeader
      title="Dev · Registry Snapshot"
      description="Copy modules, apps, and ecosystems directly from the Firestore registry collections."
    />

    <UPageBody>
      <UCard>
        <template #header>
          <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div>
              <p
                class="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400"
              >
                Registry utilities
              </p>
              <h2
                class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100"
              >
                Copy JSON from Firestore
              </h2>
            </div>
            <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <UButton
                size="sm"
                variant="soft"
                icon="i-lucide-refresh-ccw"
                :loading="pending"
                @click="refresh"
              >
                Refresh
              </UButton>
              <UButton
                size="sm"
                color="primary"
                icon="i-lucide-copy"
                :disabled="pending || !jsonString"
                @click="copyJson"
              >
                {{ copied ? 'Copied' : 'Copy JSON' }}
              </UButton>
            </div>
          </div>
        </template>

        <p class="text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
          Uses the <code>/api/registry</code> endpoint that powers scripts like
          <code>pnpm registry:backfill</code>. Need documentation instead of
          payloads? Visit
          <NuxtLink
            class="text-primary-500 hover:underline"
            to="/developer/registry"
          >
            Developer · Registry Docs
          </NuxtLink>
          for the narrative workflow.
        </p>

        <div
          v-if="error"
          class="mt-4 rounded-lg border border-red-500/40 bg-red-500/10 p-4 text-sm text-red-200"
        >
          <p class="font-semibold text-red-100">
            Unable to load registry data.
          </p>
          <p v-text="errorMessage"></p>
        </div>
        <div
          v-else-if="pending"
          class="mt-4 flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border border-dashed border-gray-200 p-4 text-sm text-gray-500 dark:border-gray-800 dark:text-gray-400"
        >
          <Icon
            name="eos-icons:bubble-loading"
            class="text-lg text-primary-500"
            aria-hidden="true"
          />
          <span>Loading registry snapshot…</span>
        </div>
        <DevJsonPanel
          v-else-if="snapshot"
          class="mt-4"
          title="Registry JSON"
          :data="snapshot"
          :default-open="true"
        />
        <p v-else class="mt-4 text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
          No registry data available. Run
          <code>pnpm registry:backfill</code>
          or
          <code>pnpm registry:register</code>
          to seed Firestore.
        </p>

        <template #footer>
          <div class="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
            <span>Last generated:</span>
            <span
              v-if="generatedAtText"
              class="ml-1"
              v-text="generatedAtText"
            ></span>
            <span v-else class="ml-1">unknown</span>
          </div>
        </template>
      </UCard>
    </UPageBody>
  </UPage>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useFetch } from 'nuxt/app'
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue'

type RegistryResponse = {
  ok: boolean
  generatedAt: string | null
  modules: unknown[]
  apps: unknown[]
  ecosystems: unknown[]
}

const { data, pending, error, refresh } = await useFetch<RegistryResponse>(
  '/api/registry',
  {
  server: true,
  default: () => ({
    ok: false,
    generatedAt: null,
    modules: [],
    apps: [],
    ecosystems: [],
  }),
  }
)

const copied = ref(false)

const snapshot = computed(() =>
  data.value && data.value.ok ? data.value : null
)

const jsonString = computed(() => {
  if (!snapshot.value) return ''
  return JSON.stringify(snapshot.value, null, 2)
})

const generatedAt = computed(() => snapshot.value?.generatedAt ?? null)

const generatedAtText = computed(() => {
  if (!generatedAt.value) return null
  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, {
      dateStyle: 'medium',
      timeStyle: 'short',
    }).format(new Date(generatedAt.value))
  } catch {
    return generatedAt.value
  }
})

const errorMessage = computed(() => {
  const message = error.value?.message
  if (typeof message === 'string' && message.trim().length > 0) {
    return message
  }
  return 'Check server logs for details.'
})

watch(
  () => jsonString.value,
  () => {
    copied.value = false
  }
)

async function copyJson() {
  if (!jsonString.value) return
  try {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(jsonString.value)
    copied.value = true
    setTimeout(() => {
      copied.value = false
    }, 2000)
  } catch (clipboardError) {
    console.error('clipboard write failed', clipboardError)
  }
}

useSeoMeta({
  title: 'FireUX Registry Snapshot',
  description:
    'Copy every registry document (apps, modules, ecosystems) as JSON.',
})

definePageMeta({
  layout: 'dev',
  title: 'Dev · Registry',
  nav: {
    key: 'dev-fireux-registry',
```

  | Partial<Record<AppKey, string>>
  | undefined

  const ports: Record<AppKey, number> = {
    fireux: 3000,
    misebox: 3001,
    cleanbox: 3002,
    niederhorn: 3003,
    richies: 3004,
    tenant: 3005,
  }
  return `http://localhost:${ports[key]}`
}

const baseUrlFor = (key: AppKey) => {
  if (import.meta.dev) return devBaseUrl(key)
  const raw = publicApps?.[key]

  if (trimmed.startsWith('/') && base) return `${base}${trimmed}`

}

# Gap Analysis

This file is generated by Copilot comparing `liturature.md` to the actual code.

---

## 1. Missing Features

- Developer onboarding/documentation portal is not implemented; aside from a placeholder `app/pages/getting-started.vue`, there is no structured content, guide navigation, or docs delivery.

### projects/fireux/fireux-app/docs/liturature.md

```md
# FireUX App

The public-facing application for the FireUX ecosystem — where developers, businesses, and creators explore, build, and connect through FireUX-powered apps.

---

## Audience

Developers, partners, and potential clients who want to build or subscribe to SaaS solutions using the FireUX platform.

---

## Purpose

The FireUX App acts as the main hub of the FireUX network.
It introduces the core framework, showcases active tenant apps (like Misebox and Cleanbox), and provides tools for new developers to get started with FireUX.

---

## Key Features

- Developer onboarding and documentation portal
- App showcase highlighting tenants and templates
- Access to starter projects and templates (Cleanbox, Misebox)
- Account system linked to all FireUX tenants
- Subscription management and billing
- News and updates about FireUX ecosystem growth
- Contact and partner inquiry forms

---

## Main Pages / Routes

- `/` – home / hero landing page
- `/get-started` – developer onboarding
- `/projects` – showcase of FireUX-powered apps
- `/developers` – technical documentation and guides
- `/pricing` – FireUX subscription tiers
- `/contact` – partner and support inquiries

---

## Next Steps

- Publish developer documentation for cloning and setup
- Add automated signup flow for managed subscriptions
- Launch the FireUX Partner Program for agencies and builders
- Integrate GitHub sign-in for developer onboarding
- Implement analytics console showing ecosystem growth
- Build "FireUX Shop" for templates and extensions

---

## Summary

The FireUX App is the gateway to the entire ecosystem.
It’s where new developers discover what FireUX can do, subscribe to managed hosting, or partner to create new tenant apps — all connected through one platform.

```

### projects/fireux/fireux-app/server/api/docs-manifest.get.ts

```ts
import { defineEventHandler } from 'h3'
import { dirname, resolve } from 'node:path'
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
import { readFile, stat } from 'node:fs/promises'

type DocsEntry = {
  heading: string
  label: string
  path: string
  canonical: boolean
}

const headingPrefix = '### '
const itemPrefix = '- ['

function normalizeHeading(rawHeading: string): string {
  const trimmed = rawHeading.trim()
  const [title] = trimmed.split(' — ')
  return title.trim()
}

function parseEntry(line: string, heading: string): DocsEntry | null {
  const match = line.match(/^- \[(.+?)\]\((.+?)\)(.*)$/)
  if (!match) {
    return null
  }

  const [, label, linkTarget, suffix] = match
  const canonical = suffix.includes('✅')

  return {
    heading,
    label,
    path: linkTarget,
    canonical,
  }
}

function parseManifest(raw: string): DocsEntry[] {
  const entries: DocsEntry[] = []
  let currentHeading: string | null = null

  for (const line of raw.split('\n')) {
    if (line.startsWith(headingPrefix)) {
      const heading = normalizeHeading(line.slice(headingPrefix.length))
      currentHeading = heading
      continue
    }

    if (!currentHeading) continue
    if (!line.startsWith(itemPrefix)) continue

    const entry = parseEntry(line, currentHeading)
    if (entry) entries.push(entry)
  }

  return entries
}

async function readDocsManifest(): Promise<DocsEntry[]> {
  const currentDir = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))
  const manifestPath = resolve(currentDir, '../../docs/_manifest.md')

  const fileStat = await stat(manifestPath)
  if (!fileStat.isFile()) {
    throw new Error(`Documentation manifest is not a file: ${manifestPath}`)
  }

  const raw = await readFile(manifestPath, 'utf-8')
  return parseManifest(raw)
}

export default defineEventHandler(async () => {
  return readDocsManifest()
})

```

### projects/fireux/fireux-app/server/api/firebase-admin.ts

```ts
import {
  cert,
  getApps,
  initializeApp,
  type App,
  type ServiceAccount,
} from 'firebase-admin/app'
import { getFirestore, type Firestore } from 'firebase-admin/firestore'
import { promises as fs } from 'node:fs'
import { isAbsolute, resolve } from 'node:path'

let cachedApp: App | null = null

async function loadServiceAccount(): Promise<ServiceAccount> {
  const inline = process.env.FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT
  if (inline) {
    return JSON.parse(inline)
  }

  const credentialsPath = process.env.GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  if (!credentialsPath) {
    throw new Error(
      'GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS must point to a Firebase service-account JSON'
    )
  }

  const absolutePath = isAbsolute(credentialsPath)
    ? credentialsPath
    : resolve(process.cwd(), credentialsPath)
  const file = await fs.readFile(absolutePath, 'utf-8')
  return JSON.parse(file) as ServiceAccount
}

export async function getFirebaseAdminApp(): Promise<App> {
  if (cachedApp) return cachedApp

  const existing = getApps()
  if (existing.length) {
    cachedApp = existing[0]
    return cachedApp
  }

  const serviceAccount = await loadServiceAccount()
  cachedApp = initializeApp({ credential: cert(serviceAccount) })
  return cachedApp
}

export async function getFirestoreDb(databaseId?: string): Promise<Firestore> {
  const app = await getFirebaseAdminApp()
  return databaseId ? getFirestore(app, databaseId) : getFirestore(app)
}

```

### projects/fireux/fireux-app/server/api/registry.get.ts

```ts
import { defineEventHandler, createError } from 'h3'
import type { Firestore } from 'firebase-admin/firestore'
import { getFirestoreDb } from './firebase-admin'

type RegistryDocument = Record<string, unknown> & { id?: string }

async function fetchCollection(db: Firestore, collection: string) {
  const snapshot = await db.collection(collection).get()
  return snapshot.docs
    .map((doc) => ({ id: doc.id, ...doc.data() }))
    .sort((a, b) => (a.id > b.id ? 1 : a.id < b.id ? -1 : 0))
}

export default defineEventHandler(async () => {
  try {
    const db = await getFirestoreDb('registry')
    const [modules, apps, rawEcosystems] = await Promise.all([
      fetchCollection(db, 'modules'),
      fetchCollection(db, 'apps'),
      fetchCollection(db, 'ecosystems'),
    ])

    return {
      ok: true,
      generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      modules,
      apps,
      ecosystems: rawEcosystems as RegistryDocument[],
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[registry.get]', error)
    throw createError({
      statusCode: 500,
      statusMessage: 'Unable to read registry data.',
    })
  }
})

```

### projects/fireux/fireux-app/server/api/registry.post.ts

```ts
import { defineEventHandler, readBody, createError } from 'h3'
import { FieldValue } from 'firebase-admin/firestore'
import { getFirestoreDb } from './firebase-admin'

type RegistryType = 'module' | 'app' | 'ecosystem'

const COLLECTION_SEGMENTS: Record<RegistryType, string> = {
  module: 'modules',
  app: 'apps',
  ecosystem: 'ecosystems',
}

type RegistryPayload = {
  id?: string
  name?: string
  team?: string
  type?: RegistryType
  ecosystem?: string
}

function toSlug(value: string) {
  return value
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9-]+/g, '-')
    .replace(/-{2,}/g, '-')
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')
}

export default defineEventHandler(async (event) => {
  const body = await readBody<{
    type?: RegistryType
    payload?: RegistryPayload
  }>(event)

  const payload = body?.payload
  const type = body?.type || payload?.type

  if (!type || !(type in COLLECTION_SEGMENTS)) {
    throw createError({
      statusCode: 400,
      statusMessage:
        'Body must include a valid "type" (module, app, ecosystem).',
    })
  }

  if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') {
    throw createError({
      statusCode: 400,
      statusMessage: 'Body must include a "payload" object.',
    })
  }

  const { id, name, team } = payload

  if (!id) {
    throw createError({
      statusCode: 400,
      statusMessage: 'Payload must include an "id" field.',
    })
  }

  if (!name) {
    throw createError({
      statusCode: 400,
      statusMessage: 'Payload must include a "name" field.',
    })
  }

  if (!team) {
    throw createError({
      statusCode: 400,
      statusMessage: 'Payload must include a "team" field.',
    })
  }

  const requiresEcosystem = type === 'app'
  if (requiresEcosystem && !payload.ecosystem) {
    throw createError({
      statusCode: 400,
      statusMessage: 'App payloads must include an "ecosystem" field.',
    })
  }

  const collection = COLLECTION_SEGMENTS[type]
  const normalizedId = id.toLowerCase()
  const normalizedName = name.toLowerCase()
  const normalizedTeam = team.toLowerCase()

  const normalizedEcosystem = requiresEcosystem
    ? toSlug(payload.ecosystem as string)
    : undefined

  if (requiresEcosystem && !normalizedEcosystem) {
    throw createError({
      statusCode: 400,
      statusMessage:
        'App payloads must provide a valid ecosystem slug (letters, numbers, dashes).',
    })
  }

  const path = `${collection}/${normalizedId}`
  const db = await getFirestoreDb('registry')

  const docData: Record<string, string> = {
    name: normalizedName,
    team: normalizedTeam,
  }

  if (normalizedEcosystem) {
    docData.ecosystem = normalizedEcosystem
  }

  await db.doc(path).set(docData, { merge: true })

  if (requiresEcosystem && normalizedEcosystem) {
    await db
      .doc(`${COLLECTION_SEGMENTS.ecosystem}/${normalizedEcosystem}`)
      .set({ apps: FieldValue.arrayUnion(normalizedId) }, { merge: true })
  }

  return {
    ok: true,
    path,
    id: normalizedId,
    ecosystem: normalizedEcosystem,
  }
})

```

### projects/fireux/tenant/docs/gap.md

```md
# Gap Analysis

This file is generated by Copilot comparing `liturature.md` to the actual code.

---

## 1. Missing Features

- Multi-tenant configuration system is absent; there is no Firestore-backed config or runtime composable exposing tenant theme/domain settings beyond the stub in `app/app.config.ts`.
- Shared authentication/session handling is not implemented; the app does not ship `/auth` flows or Firebase auth providers—only the landing page exists.
- Stripe billing integration is missing; no server routes, composables, or configuration reference Stripe APIs despite the literature promise.
- Automatic Firebase deployment presets, environment templates, and CLI tooling are not provided; the repo only includes the default `firebase.json` generated by tooling with no tenant automation scripts.
- Theme variables/logo overrides, PWA, analytics, and legal page content are not present; there are no assets or configuration to support branded overrides or shared error/legal pages.

## 2. Missing Routes or Components

- Promised routes `/auth`, `/console`, `/settings`, `/about`, `/legal` are not implemented; `app/pages/` only contains `index.vue`.
- Landing components such as `LandingHero`/`LandingSolutions` are imported but no tenant-specific variants exist; there is no evidence of legal, settings, or auth components in `app/components`.

## 3. Mismatched or Renamed Items

- The project advertises a “shared runtime environment” with operational infrastructure, but the actual implementation is marketing-only and delegates layouts directly to `FireuxDefault`.
- Literature references CLI commands to generate tenant shells, yet the project contains no scripts beyond the default package scripts.

## 4. Notes

- The Nuxt app is wired via `createFireuxConfig` to load `fireux-fireux`, providing a base to extend once tenant infrastructure is implemented.

```

### projects/fireux/tenant/docs/liturature.md

```md
# FireUX Tenant

A shared runtime environment for hosted FireUX applications.
Each tenant (like Misebox or Cleanbox) runs on this structure, ensuring consistent authentication, theming, and deployment across the ecosystem.

---

## Audience

Developers and businesses hosting apps through the FireUX platform.

---

## Purpose

The FireUX Tenant project provides a standardized Nuxt + Firebase + Stripe setup that all tenants inherit.
It handles user sessions, tenant configuration, and environment variables while keeping every brand distinct through white-label overrides.

---

## Key Features

- Multi-tenant configuration system (theme, domain, branding)
- Shared authentication and cross-tenant user sessions
- Stripe integration for per-tenant billing
- Automatic Firebase deployment presets
- Theme variables and logo overrides for each tenant
- PWA and CI/CD ready out of the box
- Shared error handling, analytics, and legal pages

---

## Main Pages / Routes

- `/auth` – login, register, reset password
- `/console` – default tenant home page
- `/settings` – account and subscription management
- `/about` – tenant-specific info page
- `/legal` – privacy, terms, and cookie policy

---

## Next Steps

- Improve tenant configuration via Firestore (theme + copy)
- Add multi-language support for global tenants
- Create a CLI command to generate new tenant shells
- Finalize automated billing through Stripe subscriptions
- Write full documentation for tenant developers

---

## Summary

The FireUX Tenant project is the bridge between FireUX Core and each hosted brand.
It ensures every app — from Misebox to Cleanbox — runs securely, efficiently, and with its own visual identity, all powered by one centralized system.

```

### projects/fireux/tenant/docs/mission.md

```md
# Tenant Sandbox

## Mission

Be the unbranded, zero-domain tenant used purely to test tenant loading, isolation, and theming, without any opinionated entities or profiles.

## Purpose

- Act as the lab rat for tenant mechanics.
- Remain intentionally plain and disposable.
- Avoid ecosystem features to keep focus on infrastructure.
- Answer the question: "does the tenant system work?" with a clear yes or no.

```

### projects/fireux/tenant/docs/roadmap.md

```md
# FireUX Tenant Roadmap

Status legend: ✅ completed · ⚙️ in progress · ❌ missing · 🧩 planned (blocked on shared work)

## ✅ Completed

- Landing page scaffolding (`app/pages/index.vue`) with shared FireUX marketing components
- Base Nuxt wiring via `createFireuxConfig` to load the `fireux-fireux` module and shared layouts

## ⚙️ In Progress

- Nothing identified

## ❌ Missing

- Multi-tenant configuration layer (Firestore schema, composables, admin UI) for theme, domain, and copy overrides
- Authentication and session flows (`/auth` routes, Firebase providers, cross-tenant cookies)
- Default console/settings/about/legal pages with shared layout wiring and tenant-aware data
- Stripe subscription and billing integration (customers, plans, webhooks, UI)
- Deployment automation (CLI to bootstrap tenants, Firebase presets, CI/CD templates)
- Theme/logos asset management plus PWA setup (manifest, icons, offline strategies)
- Analytics/error handling plumbing and shared legal content distributions

## 🧩 Planned / Cross-Package Dependencies

- Tenant config should reuse `fireux-core` configuration interfaces; align schemas before implementing Firestore collections
- Auth and billing rely on shared services/extensions; coordinate with platform teams on Stripe + Firebase auth conventions
- Deployment tooling must integrate with FireUX repo scripts (`scripts/`); collaborate before adding new CLIs
- Analytics/legal content may depend on upcoming platform documentation; verify ADRs prior to implementation

## Next Actions

- [ ] Design tenant configuration schema and composables; expose management UI under `/settings`
- [ ] Implement auth routes (login/register/reset) using cross-tenant session helpers
- [ ] Scaffold console, settings, about, and legal pages with placeholder content linked to config
- [ ] Integrate Stripe billing (subscription creation, webhook handling, invoice display)
- [ ] Create CLI or scripts to generate tenant shells and prepopulate Firebase environments
- [ ] Add theme/logo asset pipelines and PWA manifest/icon support
- [ ] Wire analytics/error pages and populate legal content templates

```

  );

### projects/misebox/misebox-app/app/composables/useSteam.ts

```ts
const isClient = typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' && 'window' in globalThis

const randomInRange = (min: number, max: number) =>
  Math.random() * (max - min) + min

type Cleanup = () => void

type SteamDataset = HTMLElement['dataset'] & {
  steamRiseSeconds?: string
  steamFadeSeconds?: string
  steamDelaySeconds?: string
}

const applyFromDataset = (el: HTMLElement, reducedMotion: boolean) => {
  const dataset = el.dataset as SteamDataset
  const riseSeconds = Number.parseFloat(dataset.steamRiseSeconds ?? '24')
  const fadeSeconds = Number.parseFloat(dataset.steamFadeSeconds ?? '8')
  const delaySeconds = Number.parseFloat(dataset.steamDelaySeconds ?? '0')

  el.style.setProperty(
    '--steam-rise',
    reducedMotion ? '0s' : `${riseSeconds.toFixed(2)}s`
  )
  el.style.setProperty(
    '--steam-fade',
    reducedMotion ? '0s' : `${fadeSeconds.toFixed(2)}s`
  )
  el.style.animationDelay = reducedMotion
    ? '0s, 0s'
    : `${delaySeconds.toFixed(2)}s, ${(delaySeconds * 0.35).toFixed(2)}s`
}

export const useSteam = () => {
  const cleanups: Cleanup[] = []

  const cleanup = () => {
    while (cleanups.length) {
      const dispose = cleanups.pop()
      if (dispose) dispose()
    }
  }

  const initializeSteam = (root: HTMLElement) => {
    cleanup()

    if (!isClient) return

    const puffs = Array.from(root.children).filter(
      (node): node is HTMLElement => node instanceof HTMLElement
    )

    const mediaQuery = globalThis.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)')
    const initialReduced = mediaQuery.matches

    for (const el of puffs) {
      const riseSeconds = randomInRange(22, 32)
      const fadeSeconds = randomInRange(6, 11)
      const size = randomInRange(48, 96)
      const drift = randomInRange(12, 42) * (Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1)
      const scaleBase = randomInRange(0.95, 1.35)
      const scalePeak = scaleBase * 1.22
      const scaleEnd = scaleBase * 1.08
      const opacity = randomInRange(0.26, 0.55)
      const blur = randomInRange(2.5, 5.5)
      const xOffset = randomInRange(-26, 26)
      const offsetRatio = Math.random()
      const delaySeconds = -riseSeconds * offsetRatio

      const dataset = el.dataset as SteamDataset
      dataset.steamRiseSeconds = riseSeconds.toFixed(2)
      dataset.steamFadeSeconds = fadeSeconds.toFixed(2)
      dataset.steamDelaySeconds = delaySeconds.toFixed(2)

      el.style.setProperty('--x', `${xOffset.toFixed(2)}vw`)
      el.style.setProperty('--drift', `${drift.toFixed(2)}px`)
      el.style.setProperty('--steam-scale-start', scaleBase.toFixed(2))
      el.style.setProperty('--steam-scale-peak', scalePeak.toFixed(2))
      el.style.setProperty('--steam-scale-end', scaleEnd.toFixed(2))
      el.style.setProperty('--steam-opacity', opacity.toFixed(2))
      el.style.setProperty('--steam-blur', `${blur.toFixed(2)}px`)

      el.style.width = `${size.toFixed(2)}px`
      el.style.height = `${size.toFixed(2)}px`

      applyFromDataset(el, initialReduced)
    }

    const handleChange = () => {
      const reduced = mediaQuery.matches
      for (const el of puffs) {
        applyFromDataset(el, reduced)
      }
    }

    mediaQuery.addEventListener('change', handleChange)

    cleanups.push(
      () => {
        mediaQuery.removeEventListener('change', handleChange)
      },
      () => {
        for (const el of puffs) {
          el.removeAttribute('style')
          const dataset = el.dataset as SteamDataset
          delete dataset.steamRiseSeconds
          delete dataset.steamFadeSeconds
          delete dataset.steamDelaySeconds
        }
      }
    )
  }

  return { initializeSteam, cleanup }
}

```

<template>
  <main class="mx-auto flex min-h-screen max-w-3xl items-center px-6 py-16">
    <div class="w-full space-y-6">
      <header class="space-y-2">
        <p class="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-primary/70">
          Misebox
        </p>
        <h1 class="text-3xl font-semibold text-primary-foreground">
          {{ title }}
        </h1>
        <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          {{ description }}
        </p>
      </header>

      <details v-if="error?.message" class="rounded-xl border border-border/70 bg-card p-4">
        <summary class="cursor-pointer text-sm font-medium text-primary-foreground">
          Technical details
        </summary>
        <pre class="mt-3 overflow-auto text-xs text-muted-foreground">{{ error.message }}</pre>
      </details>

      <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
        <NuxtLink class="link" to="/">Home</NuxtLink>
        <button class="link" type="button" @click="clearError({ redirect: '/' })">
          Dismiss
        </button>
        <button class="link" type="button" @click="reload">Reload</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </main>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { clearError, type NuxtError } from 'nuxt/app';
import { computed } from 'vue';

const props = defineProps<{ error: NuxtError }>()

const title = computed(() => {
  const statusCode = props.error?.statusCode
  if (statusCode === 404) return 'Page not found'
  return 'Something went wrong'
})

const description = computed(() => {
  const statusCode = props.error?.statusCode
  if (statusCode === 404) return 'The page you requested does not exist.'
  return 'A server error occurred while rendering this page.'
})

const reload = () => {
  if (import.meta.client) window.location.reload()
}
</script>

### projects/misebox/misebox-app/docs/gap.md

```md
# Gap Analysis

Comparison between the promises in `liturature.md` and the current Misebox app codebase (`projects/misebox/misebox-app`).

---

## 1. Features

- [❌] Professional chef profiles (creation, viewing, sharing) — no profile data models, pages, or components.
- [❌] Verified work history with references/reviews — no storage or UI for references.
- [❌] Recipe management (cost, scaling, portion control) — no recipe-related logic or interfaces.
- [❌] Kitchen prep planning tools — no prep-plan data structures or UI flows.
- [❌] Supplier integration / inventory re-ordering — no supplier or inventory management implementation.
- [❌] Job search / temporary placement system — no jobs modules, routes, or API usage.
- [❌] QR portfolio sharing — no QR generation or profile sharing utilities.
- [❌] Analytics consoles for kitchens/professionals — no analytics collection or display.

## 2. Routes / Pages

- [✅] `/` — implemented as marketing landing page (`pages/index.vue`).
- [❌] `/get-started`
- [❌] `/professional`
- [❌] `/jobs`
- [❌] `/kitchens`
- [❌] `/recipes`
- [❌] `/suppliers`
- [❌] `/prep-plans`

## 3. Components

- [✅] Landing components (`LandingHero`, `LandingQuickPeek`, `LandingSolutions`, etc.) — exist and render marketing copy only.
- [❌] Profile forms / consoles — absent.
- [❌] Recipe editors, ingredient tables, costing widgets — absent.
- [❌] Prep-plan boards or scheduler components — absent.
- [❌] Supplier management UIs — absent.
- [❌] Jobs listing/application components — absent.
- [❌] Analytics charts / KPI widgets — absent.

## 4. Notes

- The current app is purely a marketing landing experience. All operational functionality (profiles, recipes, suppliers, jobs, analytics) must be implemented, likely drawing on shared logic from `fireux-core`, `fireux-misebox`, and related extensions.
- Before building tenant-specific UI here, shared data models and composables for recipes, suppliers, jobs, and analytics should live in `packages/ecosystem/fireux-misebox` or `packages/core/fireux-core` so other Misebox tenants can reuse them.

```

### projects/misebox/misebox-app/docs/liturature.md

```md
# Misebox App

The live platform for culinary professionals to build digital profiles, manage recipes, and connect with kitchens, suppliers, and recruiters — powered by FireUX Core.

---

## Audience

Chefs, cooks, recruiters, and hospitality managers across restaurants, hotels, and catering services.

---

## Purpose

The Misebox App is the operational version of the Misebox tenant.
It brings together professional profiles, kitchen tools, and job systems to modernize how the culinary industry manages careers, recipes, and operations — all from one app.

---

## Key Features

- Create and share professional chef profiles
- Verified work history with references and reviews
- Recipe management with cost, scaling, and portion control
- Kitchen prep planning tools for stations and teams
- Supplier integration for inventory and re-ordering
- Job search and temporary placement system
- QR-code portfolio sharing for quick access
- Analytics console for kitchens and professionals

---

## Main Pages / Routes

- `/` – marketing homepage
- `/get-started` – onboard as chef or recruiter
- `/professional` – manage your career profile
- `/jobs` – browse or post open positions
- `/kitchens` – kitchen consoles and tools
- `/recipes` – create and manage recipes
- `/suppliers` – connect to and manage ingredient sources
- `/prep-plans` – organize daily production schedules

---

## Next Steps

- Launch verified references and agent confirmations
- Add portfolio “snapshot” PDF export for traditional job applications
- Improve public chef search for recruiters
- Expand recipe module with nutritional and allergen data
- Integrate chat between professionals, kitchens, and suppliers
- Connect Misebox analytics to FireUX ecosystem metrics

---

## Summary

The Misebox App is the digital workspace for the modern chef.
It unites career growth, operational tools, and creative sharing — helping professionals and kitchens stay connected, verified, and ready for opportunity.

```

### projects/misebox/misebox-app/docs/mission.md

```md
# Misebox App (Global)

## Mission

Be the global entry point for the Misebox ecosystem where hospitality professionals sign up, discover jobs, and trial the platform before upgrading to their own private tenant.

## Purpose

- Act as the front door for Misebox.
- Let chefs and professionals create Misebox profiles.
- Allow agents to post roles and manage pipelines.
- Offer suppliers a future integration surface.
- Encourage upgrades into dedicated tenants (e.g. Niederhorn) or paid tiers by gating advanced features.

```

### projects/misebox/misebox-app/docs/roadmap.md

```md
# Misebox App Roadmap

Status legend: ✅ completed · ⚙️ in progress · ❌ missing · 🧩 planned (blocked on shared work)

## ✅ Completed

-- Marketing landing page (`/`) with hero, quick peek, and solutions sections
-- Visual polish elements (steam effect, Nuxt UI theming)

## ⚙️ In Progress

-- None detected

## ❌ Missing

-- Chef profile management (create, edit, share) with QR export
-- Verified work history and references workflow
-- Recipe management: cost, scaling, nutritional/allergen data
-- Kitchen prep planning tools and station scheduling
-- Supplier and inventory integration with reorder tracking
-- Job search and temporary placement system
-- Analytics consoles for kitchens and professionals
-- Dedicated pages/routes: `/get-started`, `/professional`, `/jobs`, `/kitchens`, `/recipes`, `/suppliers`, `/prep-plans`

## 🧩 Planned / Cross-Package Dependencies

-- Shared Misebox data models (profiles, recipes, suppliers, prep plans) should originate in `packages/ecosystem/fireux-misebox` or `fireux-core` to support multiple tenants.
-- Job workflows may depend on `packages/extensions/fireux-jobs` once built out.
-- Analytics foundation likely belongs in `fireux-core` (events, summaries) before tenant consoles can consume it.

## Next Actions

- [ ] Align with core/Misebox package owners on data schemas and composables for profiles, recipes, suppliers, prep plans, and analytics.
- [ ] Scaffold placeholder routes and navigation for the promised pages to unblock incremental development.
- [ ] Implement MVP flows for profile creation, recipe management, supplier lists, and prep planning.
- [ ] Integrate job features (posting, search) using shared extension work once available.
- [ ] Add analytics event capture and consoles for kitchens and professionals.
- [ ] Reconcile `liturature.md` once key modules ship to ensure marketing copy matches functionality.

```

### projects/misebox/niederhorn/app/components/effects/Stars.vue

```vue
<template>
  <div ref="canvas" class="stars" />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { onMounted, onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue'

const canvas = ref<HTMLDivElement | null>(null)
let animation: number | null = null

const makeStar = () => {
  const star = document.createElement('span')
  const size = Math.random() * 2 + 1
  const duration = Math.random() * 3 + 3
  const delay = Math.random() * 4
  star.className = 'stars__item'
  star.style.width = `${size}px`
  star.style.height = `${size}px`
  star.style.left = `${Math.random() * 100}%`
  star.style.animationDuration = `${duration}s`
  star.style.animationDelay = `${delay}s`
  return star
}

const populate = () => {
  if (!canvas.value) return
  const count = 36
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
    canvas.value.appendChild(makeStar())
  }
}

const tick = () => {
  animation = globalThis.requestAnimationFrame(tick)
}

onMounted(() => {
  populate()
  tick()
})

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  if (animation) {
    globalThis.cancelAnimationFrame(animation)
    animation = null
  }
  canvas.value?.replaceChildren()
})

defineOptions({ name: 'NiederhornStarsEffect' })
</script>

<style scoped>
.stars {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.stars__item {
  position: absolute;
  top: -10%;
  background: rgba(244, 250, 255, 0.85);
  border-radius: 999px;
  animation: fall linear infinite;
  opacity: 0;
}

@keyframes fall {
  0% {
    transform: translateY(0);
    opacity: 0;
  }

  10% {
    opacity: 1;
  }

  100% {
    transform: translateY(120vh);
    opacity: 0;
  }
}
</style>

```

# Gap Analysis

Comparison between the promises in `liturature.md` and the current Niederhorn codebase (`projects/misebox/niederhorn`).

---

## 1. Features

- [⚙️] Branded interface with Niederhorn theme — primary/neutral colors are set via `app.config.ts`, but no dedicated logo assets or typography overrides are present yet.
- [❌] Recipe cards with cost/scaling per menu item — no recipe data structures, components, or Firestore integrations exist.
- [❌] Prep plan board by kitchen station — no routes, components, or composables implement prep workflows.
- [❌] Supplier database with ingredient tracking — no supplier models, storage, or UI beyond a placeholder CTA.
- [❌] Team training modules for onboarding — no pages or components for training content or progress tracking.
- [❌] Internal notes/feedback system — no messaging or comment storage implemented.
- [❌] Analytics on ingredient usage/prep efficiency — no analytics consoles or data collection utilities.
- [❌] Link to Misebox Pro profiles — no navigation or integration referencing Misebox-wide professional profiles.

## 2. Routes / Pages

- [✅] `/` — implemented as the landing/console (`pages/index.vue`).
- [❌] `/recipes` — not present.
- [❌] `/prep-plans` — not present.
- [❌] `/suppliers` — not present.
- [❌] `/team` — not present.
- [❌] `/analytics` — not present.

## 3. Components

- [❌] Recipe listing/detail components — none found under `app/components` (directory absent).
- [❌] Prep plan board / Kanban components — not implemented.
- [❌] Supplier management components — not implemented.
- [❌] Training module views or reusable sections — not implemented.
- [❌] Analytics widgets or charts — not implemented.

## 4. Notes

- The Niederhorn app currently ships only a single landing page with CTAs pointing to nonexistent routes. Substantial feature work is needed across recipes, suppliers, prep planning, training, and analytics to meet the literature promises.
- Shared foundations (data models, Firestore access, composables) likely belong in `packages/ecosystem/fireux-misebox` or `packages/core/fireux-core` before tenant-specific UI is layered here.

```

### projects/misebox/niederhorn/docs/liturature.md

```md
# Niederhorn

A branded Misebox deployment for Restaurant Niederhorn — a Swiss kitchen using FireUX technology to manage its recipes, prep workflows, and chef training.

---

## Audience

Head chefs, sous chefs, and kitchen managers at Restaurant Niederhorn.

---

## Purpose

This project demonstrates how Misebox can be customized for a real kitchen environment.
It combines recipe management, supplier coordination, and team training in one connected console — tailored specifically to Niederhorn’s daily operations.

---

## Key Features

- Branded interface with Niederhorn logo and theme
- Recipe cards with cost and scaling for each menu item
- Prep plan board organized by kitchen station
- Supplier database with linked ingredient tracking
- Team training modules for onboarding new staff
- Internal notes and feedback system between chefs
- Analytics on ingredient usage and prep time efficiency
- Optional link to Misebox Pro for chef career profiles

---

## Main Pages / Routes

- `/` – kitchen home console
- `/recipes` – list and manage restaurant recipes
- `/prep-plans` – schedule mise en place and daily production
- `/suppliers` – manage ingredient providers and stock levels
- `/team` – chef roster and training modules
- `/analytics` – overview of costs, prep times, and waste

---

## Next Steps

- Connect recipes to Misebox’s public professional profiles
- Add QR export for recipe display in the kitchen
- Implement live supplier ordering via API
- Expand training module to include video lessons
- Sync data with FireUX analytics for cross-kitchen insights

---

## Summary

Niederhorn shows what happens when Misebox goes from platform to plate.
It’s a real restaurant running on FireUX — proof that Misebox can serve not just chefs, but entire kitchens seeking modern, efficient, and data-driven operations.

```

### scripts/_lib/args.mjs

```mjs
// FILE: scripts/_lib/args.mjs

/**
 * Tiny CLI arg parser for repo scripts.
 *
 * Supports:
 * - --flag
 * - --key value
 * - --key=value
 *
 * Returns an object of parsed keys -> string|boolean.
 */
export function parseArgs(argv) {
  const args = {}

  for (let i = 0; i < argv.length; i += 1) {
    const token = argv[i]
    if (!token || !token.startsWith('--')) continue

    const [rawKey, rawValue] = token.split('=')
    const key = rawKey.slice(2)
    if (!key) continue

    if (rawValue !== undefined) {
      args[key] = rawValue
      continue
    }

    const next = argv[i + 1]
    if (!next || next.startsWith('--')) {
      args[key] = true
      continue
    }

    args[key] = next
    i += 1
  }

  return args
}

```

// FILE: scripts/_lib/firebase-storage.mjs

/**
 * Firebase Storage helpers for admin scripts.
 */

export async function listBucketObjects(bucket, prefix) {
  const results = []
  let nextPageToken = undefined

  do {
    const [files, , apiResponse] = await bucket.getFiles({
      prefix,
      autoPaginate: false,
      maxResults: 1000,
      pageToken: nextPageToken,
    })

    for (const file of files) results.push(file.name)
    nextPageToken = apiResponse?.nextPageToken
  } while (nextPageToken)

  return results
}

### scripts/audit-app-media.mjs

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node

import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import process from 'node:process'

import { initializeApp, cert } from 'firebase-admin/app'
import { getFirestore } from 'firebase-admin/firestore'
import { getStorage } from 'firebase-admin/storage'

import { parseArgs } from './_lib/args.mjs'

function repoRoot() {
  return process.cwd()
}

function tryReadText(filePath) {
  try {
    return fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8')
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

function extractFirst(text, regex) {
  const match = text.match(regex)
  return match?.[1] ?? null
}

function discoverEcosystemFirebaseConfigs() {
  const base = path.join(repoRoot(), 'packages', 'ecosystem')
  let dirs = []
  try {
    dirs = fs
      .readdirSync(base, { withFileTypes: true })
      .filter((d) => d.isDirectory())
      .map((d) => d.name)
  } catch {
    return []
  }

  const results = []
  for (const dir of dirs) {
    const filePath = path.join(
      base,
      dir,
      'src',
      'config',
      'firebase',
      'ecosystem.config.ts'
    )
    const text = tryReadText(filePath)
    if (!text) continue

    const serviceAccountPath = path.join(path.dirname(filePath), 'service-account.json')

    const id =
      extractFirst(text, /\bid\s*:\s*'([^']+)'/) ??
      extractFirst(text, /\bid\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"/)
    const projectId =
      extractFirst(text, /\bprojectId\s*:\s*'([^']+)'/) ??
      extractFirst(text, /\bprojectId\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"/)
    const storageBucket =
      extractFirst(text, /\bstorageBucket\s*:\s*'([^']+)'/) ??
      extractFirst(text, /\bstorageBucket\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"/)
    const name =
      extractFirst(text, /\bname\s*:\s*'([^']+)'/) ??
      extractFirst(text, /\bname\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"/)

    if (!id || !projectId || !storageBucket) continue

    results.push({
      ecosystemId: id,
      ecosystemName: name || id,
      projectId,
      storageBucket,
      serviceAccountPath: fs.existsSync(serviceAccountPath)
        ? serviceAccountPath
        : null,
      sourceFile: path.relative(repoRoot(), filePath),
    })
  }

  return results
}

function readJsonFile(filePath) {
  const raw = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8')
  return JSON.parse(raw)
}

function resolveServiceAccount(args) {
  if (args['service-account']) {
    const filePath = path.resolve(String(args['service-account']))
    return readJsonFile(filePath)
  }

  if (process.env.FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_FILE) {
    const filePath = path.resolve(String(process.env.FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_FILE))
    return readJsonFile(filePath)
  }

  if (process.env.FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT) {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(process.env.FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT)
    } catch {
      throw new Error('FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT is set but not valid JSON')
    }
  }

  const projectId = process.env.FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID
  const clientEmail = process.env.FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL
  const privateKey = process.env.FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY
  if (projectId && clientEmail && privateKey) {
    return {
      project_id: projectId,
      client_email: clientEmail,
      private_key: privateKey.replace(/\\n/g, '\n'),
    }
  }

  throw new Error(
    'Missing Firebase Admin credentials. Provide --service-account path/to/service-account.json or set FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT(_FILE) or FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID/FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL/FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY.'
  )
}

function normaliseKeySegment(value) {
  return String(value)
    .trim()
    .toUpperCase()
    .replace(/[^A-Z0-9]+/g, '_')
}

function resolveServiceAccountForProject(args, projectId, ecosystemId) {
  // First: if the caller passed an explicit service account file, always use it.
  if (args['service-account']) return resolveServiceAccount(args)

  const candidates = []
  if (ecosystemId) candidates.push(normaliseKeySegment(ecosystemId))
  if (projectId) candidates.push(normaliseKeySegment(projectId))

  for (const segment of candidates) {
    const fileKey = `FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_FILE__${segment}`
    const jsonKey = `FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT__${segment}`

    if (process.env[fileKey]) {
      const filePath = path.resolve(String(process.env[fileKey]))
      return readJsonFile(filePath)
    }
    if (process.env[jsonKey]) {
      try {
        return JSON.parse(String(process.env[jsonKey]))
      } catch {
        throw new Error(`${jsonKey} is set but not valid JSON`)
      }
    }
  }

  return resolveServiceAccount(args)
}

function resolveServiceAccountForTarget(args, target) {
  // Canon convention in this repo: service account json next to ecosystem.config.ts
  if (!args['service-account'] && target?.serviceAccountPath) {
    return readJsonFile(target.serviceAccountPath)
  }

  return resolveServiceAccountForProject(args, target?.projectId, target?.ecosystemId)
}

function defaultBucketFromProjectId(projectId) {
  if (!projectId) return ''
  return `${projectId}.appspot.com`
}

function urlIncludesEncodedPath(url, objectPath) {
  if (!url) return false
  try {
    const encoded = encodeURIComponent(objectPath)
    return url.includes(encoded)
  } catch {
    return false
  }
}

async function main() {
  const args = parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2))

  if (args.help) {
    console.log(`Usage: pnpm audit:app-media [--service-account ./service-account.json] [--bucket <bucket>] [--out <path>] [--list]

Reads apps from Firestore collection 'apps' and checks Firebase Storage objects for:
- apps/{appId}/media/thumbnail
- apps/{appId}/media/logo
- apps/{appId}/media/wordmark-light
- apps/{appId}/media/wordmark-dark

Also validates Firestore URL fields match the expected object path.

Env options (alternatives to --service-account):
```

### scripts/backfill-creator-id.mjs

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
import fs from 'fs'
import path from 'path'
import admin from 'firebase-admin'

function parseArgs() {
  const args = {}
  for (const arg of process.argv.slice(2)) {
    const [k, v] = arg.split('=')
    const key = k.replace(/^--/, '')
    args[key] = v ?? true
  }
  return args
}

async function main() {
  const args = parseArgs()
  const projectId = args.project
  const keyPath = args.key || args.keyfile || args.keyFile
  const collection = args.collection
  const creatorId = args.creatorId || args.creator_id || ''
  const commit = !!args.commit

  if (!projectId) {
    console.error('Missing --project=PROJECT_ID')
    process.exit(2)
  }
  if (!keyPath) {
    console.error('Missing --key=path/to/service-account.json')
    process.exit(2)
  }
  if (!collection) {
    console.error('Missing --collection=COLLECTION_NAME')
    process.exit(2)
  }

  const absoluteKey = path.isAbsolute(keyPath) ? keyPath : path.resolve(process.cwd(), keyPath)
  if (!fs.existsSync(absoluteKey)) {
    console.error('Service account key file not found:', absoluteKey)
    process.exit(2)
  }

  admin.initializeApp({
    credential: admin.credential.cert(require(absoluteKey)),
    projectId,
  })

  const db = admin.firestore()
  console.log(`[backfill] Scanning collection: ${collection}`)

  const colRef = db.collection(collection)
  const docRefs = await colRef.listDocuments()
  console.log(`[backfill] Found ${docRefs.length} documents (iterating)`)

  let processed = 0
  let updated = 0

  for (const docRef of docRefs) {
    processed++
    const snap = await docRef.get()
    if (!snap.exists) continue
    const data = snap.data() || {}
    if (data.creator_id) continue

    console.log(`[backfill] Missing creator_id in ${collection}/${docRef.id}`)
    if (commit) {
      await docRef.update({ creator_id: creatorId })
      updated++
    }
  }

  console.log(`[backfill] done processed=${processed} updated=${updated} commit=${commit}`)
  process.exit(0)
}

main().catch((err) => {
  console.error(err)
  process.exit(1)
})

```

### scripts/clean.mjs

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * scripts/clean.mjs
 *
 * FireUX Clean Script
 *
 * Purpose:
 * - Remove build artifacts (dist/.nuxt/.output/.data/etc)
 * - Ensure repo is in a clean, guard-safe state
 * - Designed to be run before `pnpm guard` or `gitsave`
 *
 * This script is intentionally destructive to build output.
 * It MUST NOT delete authored source files.
 */

import { existsSync, readdirSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'

const repoRoot = process.cwd()

const argv = new Set(process.argv.slice(2))
const deep = argv.has('--deep') || argv.has('--all')

const ALWAYS_REMOVE_DIRS = new Set(['dist', '.output', '.nitro', '.cache', '.data'])
const DEEP_REMOVE_DIRS = new Set(['.nuxt'])
const ALWAYS_REMOVE_FILES = new Set(['tsconfig.tsbuildinfo'])

let removedCount = 0
let removedNuxtArtifacts = false

function removeIfExists(fullPath, kind) {
  if (!existsSync(fullPath)) return false
  rmSync(fullPath, { recursive: kind === 'dir', force: true })
  console.log(`[clean] removed ${path.relative(repoRoot, fullPath)}`)
  removedCount += 1
  return true
}

function listChildDirs(parentDir) {
  if (!existsSync(parentDir)) return []
  return readdirSync(parentDir, { withFileTypes: true })
    .filter((e) => e.isDirectory() && !e.name.startsWith('.'))
    .map((e) => e.name)
}

function cleanPackageGroup(groupRoot) {
  const names = listChildDirs(groupRoot)
  for (const name of names) {
    const root = path.join(groupRoot, name)
    for (const d of ALWAYS_REMOVE_DIRS) {
      if (removeIfExists(path.join(root, d), 'dir')) {
        if (d === '.data' || d === '.output' || d === '.nitro') removedNuxtArtifacts = true
      }
    }
    for (const f of ALWAYS_REMOVE_FILES) removeIfExists(path.join(root, f), 'file')
    if (deep) {
      for (const d of DEEP_REMOVE_DIRS) {
        if (removeIfExists(path.join(root, d), 'dir')) removedNuxtArtifacts = true
      }
      removeIfExists(path.join(root, 'node_modules'), 'dir')
    }
  }
}

function cleanProjects() {
  const projectsRoot = path.join(repoRoot, 'projects')
  const ecosystems = listChildDirs(projectsRoot)
  for (const eco of ecosystems) {
    const ecoRoot = path.join(projectsRoot, eco)
    const apps = listChildDirs(ecoRoot)
    for (const app of apps) {
      const root = path.join(ecoRoot, app)
      for (const d of ALWAYS_REMOVE_DIRS) {
        if (removeIfExists(path.join(root, d), 'dir')) {
          if (d === '.data' || d === '.output' || d === '.nitro') removedNuxtArtifacts = true
        }
      }
      for (const f of ALWAYS_REMOVE_FILES) removeIfExists(path.join(root, f), 'file')
      if (deep) {
        for (const d of DEEP_REMOVE_DIRS) {
          if (removeIfExists(path.join(root, d), 'dir')) removedNuxtArtifacts = true
        }
        removeIfExists(path.join(root, 'node_modules'), 'dir')
      }
    }
  }
}

function cleanRepoRootFiles() {
  for (const f of ALWAYS_REMOVE_FILES) removeIfExists(path.join(repoRoot, f), 'file')
  if (deep) removeIfExists(path.join(repoRoot, 'node_modules'), 'dir')
}

console.log(
  deep
    ? '[clean] Cleaning build artifacts (deep, including node_modules)...'
    : '[clean] Cleaning build artifacts (preserving node_modules)...'
)

cleanPackageGroup(path.join(repoRoot, 'packages', 'core'))
cleanPackageGroup(path.join(repoRoot, 'packages', 'ecosystem'))
cleanPackageGroup(path.join(repoRoot, 'packages', 'extensions'))
cleanProjects()
cleanRepoRootFiles()

if (removedCount === 0) {
  console.log('[clean] Nothing to clean')
} else {
  console.log(`[clean] Removed ${removedCount} item(s)`) 
}

if (removedNuxtArtifacts) {
  console.log('[clean] If a Nuxt dev server was running, restart it (clean removed generated build files).')
}
```

#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * Clears one or more fields on a Firestore apps/{appId} doc.
 * Uses the per-ecosystem service account from temp/app-media-audit.json.
 *
 * Example:
 *   pnpm clear:app-fields -- --ecosystem fireux --app fireux-app --fields wordmark_url
 *   pnpm clear:app-fields -- --ecosystem fireux --app fireux-app --fields wordmark_url --delete
 */

import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import process from 'node:process'
import admin from 'firebase-admin'

const workspaceRoot = process.cwd()
const auditPath = path.join(workspaceRoot, 'temp', 'app-media-audit.json')

const argv = process.argv.slice(2)
const flagValue = (name) => {
  const idx = argv.indexOf(name)
  if (idx === -1) return null
  return argv[idx + 1] ?? null
}

const ecosystemId = flagValue('--ecosystem')
const appId = flagValue('--app')
const fieldsRaw = flagValue('--fields')
const shouldDelete = argv.includes('--delete')

if (!ecosystemId || !appId || !fieldsRaw) {
  console.error('Usage: --ecosystem <id> --app <appId> --fields <comma-separated>')
  process.exit(1)
}

if (!fs.existsSync(auditPath)) {
  console.error(`Missing ${auditPath}. Run pnpm audit:app-media first.`)
  process.exit(1)
}

const audit = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(auditPath, 'utf8'))
const eco = audit?.ecosystems?.[ecosystemId]
if (!eco) {
  console.error(`Unknown ecosystem ${ecosystemId} in ${path.relative(workspaceRoot, auditPath)}`)
  process.exit(1)
}

const projectId = eco.projectId
const serviceAccountRel = eco.serviceAccount
if (!projectId || !serviceAccountRel) {
  console.error(`Ecosystem ${ecosystemId} missing projectId/serviceAccount in audit report.`)
  process.exit(1)
}

const serviceAccountPath = path.join(workspaceRoot, serviceAccountRel)
if (!fs.existsSync(serviceAccountPath)) {
  console.error(`Missing service account: ${serviceAccountRel}`)
  process.exit(1)
}

const fields = fieldsRaw
  .split(',')
  .map((s) => s.trim())
  .filter(Boolean)

const app = admin.initializeApp(
  {
    credential: admin.credential.cert(
      JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(serviceAccountPath, 'utf8'))
    ),
    projectId,
  },
  `clear-${ecosystemId}-${appId}`
)

const firestore = app.firestore()

const patch = {}
for (const f of fields) {
  patch[f] = shouldDelete ? admin.firestore.FieldValue.delete() : ''
}

await firestore.collection('apps').doc(appId).set(patch, { merge: true })

console.log(
  `Updated apps/${appId} in ${ecosystemId}: ${shouldDelete ? 'deleted' : 'cleared'} ${fields.join(', ')}`
)

### scripts/delete-app-media-folders.mjs

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * Deletes ALL Firebase Storage objects under apps/{appId}/media/**
 * for each app found in temp/app-media-audit.json.
 *
 * This is intentionally destructive. Defaults to dry-run.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   pnpm delete:app-media-folders
 *   pnpm delete:app-media-folders -- --apply
 *   pnpm delete:app-media-folders -- --ecosystem fireux --apply
 *   pnpm delete:app-media-folders -- --ecosystem fireux --app fireux-app --apply
 */

import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import process from 'node:process'
import admin from 'firebase-admin'

import { parseArgs } from './_lib/args.mjs'
import { listBucketObjects } from './_lib/firebase-storage.mjs'

const workspaceRoot = process.cwd()
const auditPath = path.join(workspaceRoot, 'temp', 'app-media-audit.json')

async function main() {
  const args = parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2))

  if (args.help) {
    console.log(`Usage: pnpm delete:app-media-folders -- [--ecosystem <id>] [--app <appId>] [--apply]

Deletes ALL objects under apps/{appId}/media/** for each audited app.

By default this is a dry-run. Pass --apply to actually delete.
`)
    process.exit(0)
  }

  if (!fs.existsSync(auditPath)) {
    console.error(`Missing ${auditPath}. Run pnpm audit:app-media first.`)
    process.exit(1)
  }

  const audit = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(auditPath, 'utf8'))
  const requestedEcosystem = args.ecosystem ? String(args.ecosystem) : null
  const requestedAppId = args.app ? String(args.app) : null
  const apply = Boolean(args.apply)

  const ecosystems = audit?.ecosystems ?? {}
  const ecosystemIds = Object.keys(ecosystems)
    .filter((id) => (requestedEcosystem ? id === requestedEcosystem : true))
    .sort()

  if (!ecosystemIds.length) {
    console.error(
      requestedEcosystem
        ? `No matching ecosystem ${requestedEcosystem} in ${path.relative(workspaceRoot, auditPath)}`
        : `No ecosystems found in ${path.relative(workspaceRoot, auditPath)}`
    )
    process.exit(1)
  }

  const plan = []

  for (const ecoId of ecosystemIds) {
    const eco = ecosystems[ecoId]
    const projectId = eco?.projectId
    const bucketName = eco?.bucket
    const serviceAccountRel = eco?.serviceAccount

    if (!projectId || !bucketName || !serviceAccountRel) {
      console.warn(`[skip] ${ecoId}: missing projectId/bucket/serviceAccount in audit report`)
      continue
    }

    const serviceAccountPath = path.join(workspaceRoot, serviceAccountRel)
    if (!fs.existsSync(serviceAccountPath)) {
      console.warn(`[skip] ${ecoId}: missing service account at ${serviceAccountRel}`)
      continue
    }

    const appIds = Object.keys(eco?.apps ?? {})
      .filter((id) => (requestedAppId ? id === requestedAppId : true))
      .sort()

    if (!appIds.length) {
      console.warn(`[skip] ${ecoId}: no matching apps`)
      continue
    }

    const app = admin.initializeApp(
      {
        credential: admin.credential.cert(
          JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(serviceAccountPath, 'utf8'))
        ),
        projectId,
        storageBucket: bucketName,
      },
      `delete-media-${ecoId}`
    )

    const bucket = app.storage().bucket()

    for (const appId of appIds) {
      const prefix = `apps/${appId}/media/`
      const objects = await listBucketObjects(bucket, prefix)
      objects.sort()

      plan.push({
        ecosystemId: ecoId,
        projectId,
        bucket: bucketName,
        appId,
        prefix,
        count: objects.length,
        objects,
      })

      if (!apply) continue

      for (const name of objects) {
        await bucket.file(name).delete({ ignoreNotFound: true })
      }
    }
  }

  // Print a concise summary
  let total = 0
  for (const entry of plan) total += entry.count

  const mode = apply ? 'APPLY (deleted)' : 'DRY RUN (no deletes)'
  console.log(`[delete:app-media-folders] ${mode}`)
  console.log(`Targets: ${plan.length} app(s)`)
  console.log(`Total objects under apps/*/media/: ${total}`)

  // Print per-app counts, and sample first few names when present
  for (const entry of plan) {
    console.log(
      `- ${entry.ecosystemId}/${entry.appId}: ${entry.count} object(s) under ${entry.prefix}`
    )
    if (entry.count) {
      const sample = entry.objects.slice(0, 5)
      for (const name of sample) console.log(`  - ${name}`)
      if (entry.count > sample.length) console.log(`  - … (+${entry.count - sample.length} more)`)
    }
  }

  if (!apply) {
    console.log('Run again with --apply to perform deletions.')
  }
}

main().catch((err) => {
  console.error(err)
  process.exit(1)
})

```

### scripts/delete-app-media-trash.mjs

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * Deletes non-canonical app media objects listed in temp/app-media-trash.json.
 *
 * Safety:
 * - Dry-run by default (prints what would be deleted)
 * - Refuses to delete any object whose path is still referenced by Firestore app url fields
 *   unless --force is provided.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   pnpm delete:app-media-trash -- --ecosystem fireux            (dry-run)
 *   pnpm delete:app-media-trash -- --ecosystem fireux --apply    (delete)
 *   pnpm delete:app-media-trash -- --all --apply                (delete all ecosystems)
 *   pnpm delete:app-media-trash -- --ecosystem fireux --apply --force
 */

import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import process from 'node:process'
import admin from 'firebase-admin'

const workspaceRoot = process.cwd()
const trashPath = path.join(workspaceRoot, 'temp', 'app-media-trash.json')

if (!fs.existsSync(trashPath)) {
  console.error(`Missing ${trashPath}. Run pnpm list:app-media-trash first.`)
  process.exit(1)
}

const data = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(trashPath, 'utf8'))

const argv = process.argv.slice(2)
const hasFlag = (f) => argv.includes(f)
const flagValue = (name) => {
  const idx = argv.indexOf(name)
  if (idx === -1) return null
  return argv[idx + 1] ?? null
}

const targetEco = flagValue('--ecosystem')
const targetApp = flagValue('--app')
const apply = hasFlag('--apply')
const force = hasFlag('--force')
const all = hasFlag('--all')

if (!all && !targetEco) {
  console.error('Provide --ecosystem <id> or --all')
  process.exit(1)
}

function decodeObjectPathFromUrl(url) {
  try {
    const u = new URL(url)
    const match = u.pathname.match(/\/o\/(.+)$/)
    if (!match) return null
    return decodeURIComponent(match[1])
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

async function referencedTrashPathsForAppDoc(firestore, appId) {
  const snap = await firestore.collection('apps').doc(appId).get()
  const doc = snap.exists ? snap.data() : null
  if (!doc) return new Set()

  const fields = [
    'avatar_url',
    'logo_url',
    'wordmark_url',
    'wordmark_light_url',
    'wordmark_dark_url',
  ]

  const referenced = new Set()
  for (const f of fields) {
    const raw = doc[f]
    if (typeof raw !== 'string' || !raw) continue
    const obj = decodeObjectPathFromUrl(raw)
    if (obj) referenced.add(obj)
  }

  return referenced
}

async function deleteObjects(bucket, names) {
  // Delete sequentially to keep logs readable and avoid hammering.
  for (const name of names) {
    await bucket.file(name).delete({ ignoreNotFound: true })
  }
}

async function main() {
  const ecosystems = data.ecosystems ?? {}
  const ecoIds = all ? Object.keys(ecosystems) : [targetEco]

  let planned = 0
  let deleted = 0
  let skippedReferenced = 0

  for (const ecoId of ecoIds) {
    const eco = ecosystems[ecoId]
    if (!eco) {
      console.warn(`[skip] unknown ecosystem: ${ecoId}`)
      continue
    }

    const projectId = eco.projectId
    const bucketName = eco.bucket
    const saRel = eco.serviceAccountPath

    if (!projectId || !bucketName || !saRel) {
      console.warn(`[skip] ${ecoId}: missing projectId/bucket/serviceAccountPath in temp/app-media-trash.json`)
      continue
    }

    const saPath = path.join(workspaceRoot, saRel)
    if (!fs.existsSync(saPath)) {
      console.warn(`[skip] ${ecoId}: missing service account at ${saRel}`)
      continue
    }

    const app = admin.initializeApp(
      {
        credential: admin.credential.cert(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(saPath, 'utf8'))),
        projectId,
        storageBucket: bucketName,
      },
      `delete-trash-${ecoId}`
    )

    const bucket = app.storage().bucket()
    const firestore = app.firestore()

    const apps = eco.apps ?? {}
    const appIds = targetApp ? [targetApp] : Object.keys(apps)

    console.log(`\n== ${ecoId} (${projectId}) bucket=${bucketName}`)

    for (const appId of appIds) {
      const entry = apps[appId]
      if (!entry) {
        console.warn(`- [skip] ${appId}: not present in temp/app-media-trash.json`)
        continue
      }

      const trash = Array.isArray(entry.trash) ? entry.trash : []
      if (!trash.length) {
        console.log(`- ${appId}: nothing to delete`)
        continue
      }

      const referenced = await referencedTrashPathsForAppDoc(firestore, appId)

      const toDelete = []
      const blocked = []
      for (const obj of trash) {
        if (!force && referenced.has(obj)) blocked.push(obj)
        else toDelete.push(obj)
      }

      planned += toDelete.length
      skippedReferenced += blocked.length

      console.log(`- ${appId}: will delete=${toDelete.length} blocked=${blocked.length}${apply ? '' : ' (dry-run)'}`)
      if (blocked.length) {
        console.log(`  blocked (still referenced by Firestore app URLs):`)
        for (const b of blocked) console.log(`  - ${b}`)
      }
      if (toDelete.length) {
        console.log(`  ${apply ? 'deleting' : 'would delete'}:`)
        for (const d of toDelete) console.log(`  - ${d}`)
      }

      if (apply && toDelete.length) {
        await deleteObjects(bucket, toDelete)
        deleted += toDelete.length
      }
    }
  }

  console.log(`\nSummary: planned=${planned} deleted=${deleted} blockedReferenced=${skippedReferenced} mode=${apply ? 'APPLY' : 'DRY-RUN'}${force ? ' force=true' : ''}`)
  if (!apply) {
    console.log('Re-run with --apply to actually delete.')
  }
}

main().catch((err) => {
  console.error(err)
  process.exit(1)
})

```

### scripts/free-port.mjs

```mjs
import { execSync } from 'node:child_process'

function usage() {
  console.error('Usage: node scripts/free-port.mjs <port>')
}

const rawPort = process.argv[2]
const port = Number(rawPort)
if (!rawPort || !Number.isInteger(port) || port <= 0) {
  usage()
  process.exit(2)
}

// Best-effort, macOS/Linux.
// If anything fails, we do NOT crash the dev script.
try {
  const cmd = `lsof -ti tcp:${port} -sTCP:LISTEN`
  const out = execSync(cmd, { stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'ignore'] })
    .toString()
    .trim()

  if (!out) process.exit(0)

  const pids = out
    .split(/\s+/)
    .map((s) => s.trim())
    .filter(Boolean)

  for (const pid of pids) {
    try {
      process.kill(Number(pid), 'SIGTERM')
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  }

  // Give processes a moment to exit.
  Atomics.wait(new Int32Array(new SharedArrayBuffer(4)), 0, 0, 300)

  for (const pid of pids) {
    try {
      process.kill(Number(pid), 0)
      process.kill(Number(pid), 'SIGKILL')
    } catch {
      // already gone
    }
  }
} catch {
  // lsof not available or no perms; ignore.
}

### scripts/generate-cta-innards.mjs

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// FILE: scripts/generate-cta-innards.mjs
//
// Generates: temp/temp-cta.md
// Repo-truth snapshot (runtime only): CTA innards (raw file contents).

import { readdirSync, readFileSync, statSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'

const repoRoot = process.cwd()

const SKIP_DIRS = new Set([
  'node_modules',
  'dist',
  '.nuxt',
  '.output',
  '.git',
  '.turbo',
  '.next',
  '.pnpm',
])

function isDirectory(p) {
  try {
    return statSync(p).isDirectory()
  } catch {
    return false
  }
}

function walkFiles(rootDir, predicate) {
  const out = []
  const stack = [rootDir]

  while (stack.length) {
    const current = stack.pop()
    if (!current) continue

    let entries = []
    try {
      entries = readdirSync(current, { withFileTypes: true })
    } catch {
      continue
    }

    for (const entry of entries) {
      if (entry.name === '.DS_Store') continue

      const fullPath = path.join(current, entry.name)

      if (entry.isDirectory()) {
        if (!SKIP_DIRS.has(entry.name)) stack.push(fullPath)
        continue
      }

      if (!entry.isFile()) continue
      if (predicate(fullPath)) out.push(fullPath)
    }
  }

  return out
}

function toRepoRelative(absPath) {
  return path.relative(repoRoot, absPath).replaceAll(path.sep, '/')
}

function readText(absPath) {
  try {
    return readFileSync(absPath, 'utf8')
  } catch {
    return ''
  }
}

function parseSectionAndEntity(absFile) {
  const rel = toRepoRelative(absFile)
  const parts = rel.split('/')

  let section = 'Other'
  if (parts[0] === 'packages' && parts.length >= 3) {
    if (parts[1] === 'core') section = 'Core'
    else if (parts[1] === 'ecosystem') section = 'Ecosystem'
    else if (parts[1] === 'extensions') section = 'Extensions'
    else section = 'Packages'
  }

  const orgIdx = parts.lastIndexOf('organisms')
  let entity = path.basename(absFile, '.vue')

  if (orgIdx !== -1) {
    const after = parts.slice(orgIdx + 1)

    if (after[0] === 'profiles' && after[1]) entity = after[1]
    else if (after[0] === 'objects' && after[1]) entity = after[1]
    else if (after[0]) entity = after[0]
  }

  return { section, entity }
}

function sortKeyFor(absFile) {
  const rel = toRepoRelative(absFile)
  const { section, entity } = parseSectionAndEntity(absFile)

  const sectionOrder = new Map([
    ['Core', 0],
    ['Ecosystem', 1],
    ['Extensions', 2],
    ['Packages', 3],
    ['Other', 4],
  ])

  const entityOrder = new Map([
    // Core
    ['App', 0],
    ['User', 1],

    // Ecosystem
    ['Chef', 10],
    ['Supplier', 11],

    // Extensions
    ['Blog', 20],
    ['Job', 21],
    ['Agent', 22],
    ['Professional', 23],
    ['Product', 24],
  ])

  const s = sectionOrder.get(section) ?? 999
  const e = entityOrder.get(entity) ?? 999

  return `${String(s).padStart(3, '0')}:${String(e).padStart(3, '0')}:${rel}`
}

function findCtaVueFiles() {
  const packagesRoot = path.join(repoRoot, 'packages')
  if (!isDirectory(packagesRoot)) return []

  const abs = walkFiles(packagesRoot, (p) => {
    const rel = toRepoRelative(p)
    if (!rel.includes('/src/runtime/components/organisms/')) return false
    if (!rel.endsWith('/CTA.vue')) return false
    return true
  })

  abs.sort((a, b) => sortKeyFor(a).localeCompare(sortKeyFor(b)))
  return abs
}

function buildMarkdown({ ctaFiles }) {

  const lines = []
  lines.push('# CTA Innards (Runtime)')
  lines.push('')
  lines.push('Repo-truth snapshot (runtime only). Auto-generated.')
  lines.push('')
  lines.push(`- Included \`CTA.vue\` files: ${ctaFiles.length}`)
  lines.push('')
  lines.push('---')

  for (const absFile of ctaFiles) {
    const rel = toRepoRelative(absFile)
    const { section, entity } = parseSectionAndEntity(absFile)

    lines.push('')
    lines.push(`## ${section} — ${entity} CTA`)
    lines.push('')
    lines.push(`Path: \`${rel}\``)
    lines.push('')
    lines.push('```vue')
    lines.push(readText(absFile).trimEnd())
    lines.push('```')
  }

  return lines.join('\n')
}

function main() {
  const outDir = path.join(repoRoot, 'temp')
  const outFile = path.join(outDir, 'temp-cta.md')

  const ctaFiles = findCtaVueFiles()
  const md = buildMarkdown({ ctaFiles })

  mkdirSync(outDir, { recursive: true })
  writeFileSync(outFile, md, 'utf8')

  console.log(`[gen:cta-innards] Wrote ${toRepoRelative(outFile)} (${ctaFiles.length} CTA.vue files)`)
}

main()

```

### scripts/generate-cta-parent-trees.mjs

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// FILE: scripts/generate-cta-parent-trees.mjs
//
// Generates: temp/temp-cta-trees.md
// Repo-truth snapshot (runtime only): CTA parent trees (full recursion).

import { readdirSync, readFileSync, statSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'

const repoRoot = process.cwd()

const SKIP_DIRS = new Set([
  'node_modules',
  'dist',
  '.nuxt',
  '.output',
  '.git',
  '.turbo',
  '.next',
  '.pnpm',
])

function isDirectory(p) {
  try {
    return statSync(p).isDirectory()
  } catch {
    return false
  }
}

function isFile(p) {
  try {
    return statSync(p).isFile()
  } catch {
    return false
  }
}

function walkFiles(rootDir, predicate) {
  const out = []
  const stack = [rootDir]

  while (stack.length) {
    const current = stack.pop()
    if (!current) continue

    let entries = []
    try {
      entries = readdirSync(current, { withFileTypes: true })
    } catch {
      continue
    }

    for (const entry of entries) {
      if (entry.name === '.DS_Store') continue

      const fullPath = path.join(current, entry.name)

      if (entry.isDirectory()) {
        if (!SKIP_DIRS.has(entry.name)) stack.push(fullPath)
        continue
      }

      if (!entry.isFile()) continue
      if (predicate(fullPath)) out.push(fullPath)
    }
  }

  return out
}

function toRepoRelative(absPath) {
  return path.relative(repoRoot, absPath).replaceAll(path.sep, '/')
}

function readText(absPath) {
  try {
    return readFileSync(absPath, 'utf8')
  } catch {
    return ''
  }
}

function treeLines(rootDir) {
  // Full recursion tree rooted at '.'
  const lines = ['.']

  function listDir(dir) {
    let entries = []
    try {
      entries = readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })
    } catch {
      return []
    }

    const filtered = entries
      .filter((e) => e.name !== '.DS_Store')
      .filter((e) => !SKIP_DIRS.has(e.name))

    // directories first, then files; alpha within each
    filtered.sort((a, b) => {
      if (a.isDirectory() && !b.isDirectory()) return -1
      if (!a.isDirectory() && b.isDirectory()) return 1
      return a.name.localeCompare(b.name)
    })

    return filtered
  }

  function walk(dir, prefix) {
    const entries = listDir(dir)

    entries.forEach((entry, index) => {
      const isLast = index === entries.length - 1
      const branch = isLast ? '└── ' : '├── '
      const nextPrefix = prefix + (isLast ? '    ' : '│   ')

      if (entry.isDirectory()) {
        lines.push(prefix + branch + entry.name + '/')
        walk(path.join(dir, entry.name), nextPrefix)
        return
      }

      lines.push(prefix + branch + entry.name)
    })
  }

  walk(rootDir, '')
  return lines
}

function parseEntityLabel(ctaLikeFile, parentDir) {
  // Prefer a clean label like “Profile: Chef” or “Object: Blog” or “User/App”.
  const parts = parentDir.split('/').filter(Boolean)
  const idx = parts.lastIndexOf('organisms')
  if (idx === -1) return path.basename(parentDir)

  const after = parts.slice(idx + 1)
  // organisms/profiles/<Domain>
  if (after[0] === 'profiles' && after[1]) return `Profile: ${after[1]}`
  // organisms/objects/<Object>
  if (after[0] === 'objects' && after[1]) return `Object: ${after[1]}`

  // organisms/<Entity>
  if (after[0]) return after[0]

  return path.basename(ctaLikeFile)
}

function groupKeyFor(absFile) {
  const rel = toRepoRelative(absFile)
  const parts = rel.split('/')

  // packages/<group>/<package>/...
  if (parts[0] === 'packages' && parts.length >= 3) {
    const group = parts[1]
    const pkg = parts[2]

    if (group === 'core') return { section: 'Core', sub: pkg }
    if (group === 'ecosystem') return { section: 'Ecosystem', sub: pkg }
    if (group === 'extensions') return { section: 'Extensions', sub: pkg }

    return { section: 'Packages', sub: `${group}/${pkg}` }
  }

  return { section: 'Other', sub: parts[0] ?? 'unknown' }
}

function findCtaLikeFiles() {
  const packagesRoot = path.join(repoRoot, 'packages')
  const projectsRoot = path.join(repoRoot, 'projects')

  const roots = [packagesRoot, projectsRoot].filter(isDirectory)

  // 1) All CTA.vue
  const ctaVueFiles = roots.flatMap((r) =>
    walkFiles(r, (p) => p.endsWith(`${path.sep}CTA.vue`))
  )

  // 2) Any runtime component using UPageCTA
  const runtimeComponents = roots.flatMap((r) =>
    walkFiles(r, (p) => p.includes(`${path.sep}src${path.sep}runtime${path.sep}components${path.sep}`) && p.endsWith('.vue'))
  )

  const uPageCtaFiles = runtimeComponents.filter((p) => {
    const raw = readText(p)
    return raw.includes('UPageCTA')
  })

  const all = new Set([...ctaVueFiles, ...uPageCtaFiles])
  return Array.from(all).sort((a, b) => toRepoRelative(a).localeCompare(toRepoRelative(b)))
}

function buildMarkdown(ctaLikeFiles) {
  const header = [
    '# CTA Parent Trees (Full)',
    '',
    'Repo-truth snapshot (runtime only). Auto-generated.',
    '',
    `- Included CTA-like files: ${ctaLikeFiles.length}`,
