### scripts/go.mjs

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * scripts/go.mjs
 *
 * "go" = git save + (auto) clean when needed.
 *
 * - Detects dirty files via `git status --porcelain`.
 * - If dirty files include build artifacts, runs `pnpm -s clean` first.
 * - Then runs `bash scripts/gitsave.sh` passing through args.
 */

import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'

function run(cmd, args, options = {}) {
  const result = spawnSync(cmd, args, {
    stdio: 'inherit',
    ...options,
  })
  if (result.status !== 0) process.exit(result.status ?? 1)
}

function capture(cmd, args) {
  const result = spawnSync(cmd, args, {
    encoding: 'utf8',
    stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
  })
  if (result.status !== 0) {
    process.stderr.write(result.stderr || '')
    process.exit(result.status ?? 1)
  }
  return result.stdout || ''
}

function parsePorcelain(stdout) {
  // v1 porcelain: `XY path` (and for renames: `XY old -> new`)
  // We only need paths.
  return stdout
    .split(/\r?\n/)
    .map((l) => l.trimEnd())
    .filter(Boolean)
    .map((line) => line.slice(3))
    .map((pathPart) => {
      const arrow = ' -> '
      if (pathPart.includes(arrow)) return pathPart.split(arrow).pop()
      return pathPart
    })
    .filter(Boolean)
}

function shouldCleanForPath(p) {
  const s = `/${p}`.replaceAll('\\', '/')

  // Note: keep this conservative; we only want to auto-clean for generated output.
  const generatedSegments = [
    '/dist/',
    '/.output/',
    '/.nitro/',
    '/.cache/',
    '/.data/',
    '/.nuxt/',
    '/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo',
  ]

  return generatedSegments.some((seg) => s.includes(seg) || s.endsWith(seg))
}

const argv = process.argv.slice(2)
const hasCleanFlag = argv.includes('--clean')
const hasNoCleanFlag = argv.includes('--no-clean')

const porcelain = capture('git', ['status', '--porcelain'])
const dirtyPaths = parsePorcelain(porcelain)

if (dirtyPaths.length === 0) {
  // If there are no local changes, we may still be ahead of upstream.
  // In that case, run gitsave so it can push.
  let aheadCount = 0
  try {
    const hasUpstream = spawnSync('git', ['rev-parse', '--abbrev-ref', '--symbolic-full-name', '@{u}'], {
      stdio: 'ignore',
    }).status === 0

    if (hasUpstream) {
      const aheadRaw = capture('git', ['rev-list', '--count', '@{u}..HEAD']).trim()
      aheadCount = Number.parseInt(aheadRaw, 10) || 0
    }
  } catch {
    aheadCount = 0
  }

  if (aheadCount > 0) {
    console.log(`[go] Working tree clean, but branch is ahead by ${aheadCount}; pushing via gitsave`)
    run('bash', ['scripts/gitsave.sh', ...argv])
    process.exit(0)
  }

  console.log('[go] Working tree clean; nothing to save')
  process.exit(0)
}

const autoCleanNeeded = dirtyPaths.some(shouldCleanForPath)
const willClean = hasCleanFlag ? true : hasNoCleanFlag ? false : autoCleanNeeded

if (willClean) {
  console.log('[go] Detected build artifacts; running clean')
  run('pnpm', ['-s', 'clean'])
}

console.log('[go] Running gitsave')
run('bash', ['scripts/gitsave.sh', ...argv, ...(willClean && !hasCleanFlag ? ['--clean'] : [])])

```

### scripts/guard.mjs

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// FILE: scripts/guard.mjs
//
// FireUX Guard — single entrypoint
// Collects ALL violations across all guard groups, then exits once.
//
// IMPORTANT:
// - Individual guards MUST NOT call process.exit(1).
// - Individual guards SHOULD throw Error (with a helpful message) when they fail.
// - This runner catches, aggregates, prints, then exits with code 1.

console.log('[guard] 🔎 Running FireUX guard checks...')

import process from 'node:process'

import { run as runRoot } from './guards/root.mjs'
import { run as runCanon } from './guards/canon.mjs'
import { run as runCore } from './guards/core.mjs'
import { run as runEcosystem } from './guards/ecosystem.mjs'
import { run as runExtensions } from './guards/extensions.mjs'
import { run as runProjects } from './guards/projects.mjs'

const repoRoot = process.cwd()

const guards = [
  { key: 'root', run: runRoot },
  { key: 'canon', run: runCanon },
  { key: 'core', run: runCore },
  { key: 'ecosystem', run: runEcosystem },
  { key: 'extensions', run: runExtensions },
  { key: 'projects', run: runProjects },
]

const errors = []

for (const g of guards) {
  try {
    await g.run({ repoRoot })
  } catch (err) {
    const message =
      err instanceof Error
        ? err.message
        : typeof err === 'string'
          ? err
          : JSON.stringify(err, null, 2)

    errors.push({ guard: g.key, message })
  }
}

if (errors.length) {
  console.error('\n[guard] ❌ Guard violations detected:\n')

  for (const e of errors) {
    console.error(`--- ${e.guard.toUpperCase()} ---`)
    console.error(e.message.trimEnd())
    console.error('')
  }

  console.error(`[guard] Fix the violations above, then re-run:\n  pnpm guard\n`)
  process.exit(1)
}

console.log('[guard] ✅ All guards passed')
console.log('[guard] 🎯 Guard completed successfully')
```

### scripts/guards/canon.mjs

```mjs
// FILE: scripts/guards/canon.mjs
// FireUX Canon Guard
//
// Enforces repo-wide FireUX canon rules that prevent drift:
// - No legacy/back-compat shims
// - No legacy composable paths (e.g. firestore/products/product)
// - Firestore object folders are lowercase (objects/<thing>)
//
// Called by scripts/guard.mjs.
// MUST NOT be run directly.

import { readdirSync, readFileSync, statSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'

const SKIP_DIRS = new Set([
  'node_modules',
  'dist',
  '.nuxt',
  '.output',
  '.git',
  '.turbo',
  '.next',
  '.pnpm',
])

const SCAN_EXTS = new Set([
  '.ts',
  '.tsx',
  '.js',
  '.mjs',
  '.cjs',
  '.d.ts',
  '.vue',
])

function isDirectory(p) {
  try {
    return statSync(p).isDirectory()
  } catch {
    return false
  }
}

function walkFiles(rootDir) {
  const out = []
  const stack = [rootDir]

  while (stack.length) {
    const current = stack.pop()
    if (!current) continue

    let entries = []
    try {
      entries = readdirSync(current, { withFileTypes: true })
    } catch {
      continue
    }

    for (const entry of entries) {
      if (entry.name === '.DS_Store') continue

      const fullPath = path.join(current, entry.name)

      if (entry.isDirectory()) {
        if (!SKIP_DIRS.has(entry.name)) stack.push(fullPath)
        continue
      }

      if (!entry.isFile()) continue

      const ext = path.extname(entry.name)
      if (!SCAN_EXTS.has(ext)) continue

      out.push(fullPath)
    }
  }

  return out
}

function findAllMatches(text, re) {
  const matches = []
  let m
  // eslint-disable-next-line no-cond-assign
  while ((m = re.exec(text))) {
    matches.push({ index: m.index, match: m[0] })
  }
  return matches
}

function lineInfo(text, index) {
  const upTo = text.slice(0, index)
  const line = upTo.split('\n').length
  return { line }
}

function toRepoRelative(repoRoot, absPath) {
  return path.relative(repoRoot, absPath)
}

function checkObjectFolderCasing(repoRoot) {
  const violations = []

  const packagesRoot = path.join(repoRoot, 'packages')
  if (!existsSync(packagesRoot)) return violations

  const pkgGroups = readdirSync(packagesRoot, { withFileTypes: true })
    .filter((d) => d.isDirectory() && !d.name.startsWith('.'))
    .map((d) => d.name)

  for (const group of pkgGroups) {
    const groupDir = path.join(packagesRoot, group)
    const pkgs = readdirSync(groupDir, { withFileTypes: true })
      .filter((d) => d.isDirectory() && !d.name.startsWith('.'))
      .map((d) => path.join(groupDir, d.name))

    for (const pkgPath of pkgs) {
      const objectsDir = path.join(
        pkgPath,
        'src',
        'runtime',
        'composables',
        'fireux',
        'firestore',
        'objects'
      )

      if (!isDirectory(objectsDir)) continue

      const children = readdirSync(objectsDir, { withFileTypes: true })
        .filter((d) => d.isDirectory())
        .map((d) => d.name)

      for (const name of children) {
        const first = name[0]
        if (first && first.toUpperCase() === first && first.toLowerCase() !== first) {
          violations.push(
            `- Uppercase object folder: ${toRepoRelative(
              repoRoot,
              path.join(objectsDir, name)
            )}`
          )
        }
      }

      const legacyProductsDir = path.join(
        pkgPath,
        'src',
        'runtime',
        'composables',
        'fireux',
        'firestore',
        'products',
        'product'
      )

      if (isDirectory(legacyProductsDir)) {
        violations.push(
          `- Legacy product composables dir exists: ${toRepoRelative(
            repoRoot,
            legacyProductsDir
          )}`
        )
      }
    }
  }

  return violations
}

export async function run(ctx) {
  const repoRoot = ctx?.repoRoot ?? process.cwd()

  const violations = []

  // 1) Structural checks (directories)
  violations.push(...checkObjectFolderCasing(repoRoot))

  // 2) Content checks (imports/markers)
  const scanRoots = [path.join(repoRoot, 'packages'), path.join(repoRoot, 'projects')]
    .filter((p) => existsSync(p))

  const files = scanRoots.flatMap((p) => walkFiles(p))

  const reBackCompat = /Back-compat shim/gi
  const reLegacyProductPath = /firestore\/products\/product/gi
  const reUppercaseObjectImport = /firestore\/objects\/[A-Z]/g

  for (const file of files) {
    let raw = ''
    try {
      raw = readFileSync(file, 'utf8')
    } catch {
      continue
    }

    for (const hit of findAllMatches(raw, reBackCompat)) {
      const { line } = lineInfo(raw, hit.index)
      violations.push(
        `- Back-compat shim marker in ${toRepoRelative(repoRoot, file)}:${line}`
```

### scripts/guards/core.mjs

```mjs
// FILE: scripts/guards/core.mjs
import { readdirSync, existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'

const REQUIRED_L1 = [
  'package.json',
  'registry.json',
  'README.md',
  'src',
  'tsconfig.json',
]

const ALLOWED_NOISE = ['node_modules', 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo', '.DS_Store']

export async function run(ctx) {
  const repoRoot = ctx?.repoRoot ?? process.cwd()
  const coreRoot = path.join(repoRoot, 'packages', 'core')

  if (!existsSync(coreRoot)) {
    console.warn('[guard] ⚠️  packages/core not found, skipping core guard')
    return
  }

  const corePackages = readdirSync(coreRoot, { withFileTypes: true })
    .filter((d) => d.isDirectory() && !d.name.startsWith('.'))
    .map((d) => d.name)

  const violations = []

  for (const pkgName of corePackages) {
    const pkgPath = path.join(coreRoot, pkgName)
    const v = checkCorePackage(pkgPath)
    if (v) violations.push(v)
  }

  if (violations.length) throw new Error(violations.join('\n\n'))

  console.log('[guard] ✅ core packages valid')
}

function checkCorePackage(pkgPath) {
  const entries = readdirSync(pkgPath).filter((n) => n !== '.DS_Store')

  const missing = REQUIRED_L1.filter((r) => !entries.includes(r))
  const unexpected = entries.filter(
    (e) => !REQUIRED_L1.includes(e) && !ALLOWED_NOISE.includes(e)
  )

  const exportViolations = checkPackageExports(pkgPath)

  if (!missing.length && !unexpected.length && !exportViolations.length) return null

  const lines = [
    '[guard] ❌ core package shape violation:',
    `  Path: ${pkgPath}`,
  ]

  if (missing.length) {
    lines.push('  Missing required:')
    missing.forEach((m) => lines.push(`    - ${m}`))
  }

  if (unexpected.length) {
    lines.push('  Unexpected:')
    unexpected
      .slice()
      .sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))
      .forEach((u) => lines.push(`    - ${u}`))
  }

  if (exportViolations.length) {
    lines.push('  Exports invalid:')
    exportViolations.forEach((m) => lines.push(`    - ${m}`))
  }

  lines.push(
    '',
    '[guard] Fix:',
    `- Core packages MUST match L1 exactly: ${REQUIRED_L1.join(', ')}`,
    '- Move implementation into /src',
    '- Delete build output (dist) and other junk before committing'
  )

  return lines.join('\n')
}

function checkPackageExports(pkgPath) {
  const violations = []

  const pkgJsonPath = path.join(pkgPath, 'package.json')
  if (!existsSync(pkgJsonPath)) return violations

  let pkgJson = null
  try {
    pkgJson = JSON.parse(readFileSync(pkgJsonPath, 'utf8'))
  } catch {
    violations.push('package.json is not valid JSON')
    return violations
  }

  const exportsMap = pkgJson?.exports

  // Core packages should not expose a synthetic ./runtime index.
  // Prefer subpath exports via ./runtime/* and direct file imports.
  if (exportsMap && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(exportsMap, './runtime')) {
    violations.push("exports['./runtime'] is forbidden (use './runtime/*' subpath exports only)")
  }

  const runtimeIndexPath = path.join(pkgPath, 'src', 'runtime', 'index.ts')
  if (existsSync(runtimeIndexPath)) {
    violations.push('src/runtime/index.ts is forbidden in core packages')
  }

  return violations
}
```

### scripts/guards/ecosystem.mjs

```mjs
// FILE: scripts/guards/ecosystem.mjs
import { readdirSync, existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'

const REQUIRED_L1 = [
  'package.json',
  'registry.json',
  'README.md',
  'src',
  'tsconfig.json',
  'docs',
  '.firebaserc',
]

const ALLOWED_NOISE = ['node_modules', 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo', '.DS_Store']

// Ecosystem config contract (inside each ecosystem package)
const REQUIRED_CONFIG_DIR = path.join('src', 'config')
const REQUIRED_CONFIG_DIRS = ['firebase']
const ALLOWED_CONFIG_FILES = ['module']
const CONFIG_ALLOWED_NOISE = ['.DS_Store']

// Firebase config contract (inside each ecosystem package)
const REQUIRED_FIREBASE_DIR = path.join('src', 'config', 'firebase')
const REQUIRED_FIREBASE_FILES = ['ecosystem.config.ts', 'service-account.json']
const FIREBASE_ALLOWED_NOISE = ['.DS_Store']

// Ecosystem runtime contract
const REQUIRED_RUNTIME_PUBLIC_DIR = path.join('src', 'runtime', 'public')


export async function run(ctx) {
  const repoRoot = ctx?.repoRoot ?? process.cwd()
  const ecoRoot = path.join(repoRoot, 'packages', 'ecosystem')

  if (!existsSync(ecoRoot)) {
    console.warn(
      '[guard] ⚠️  packages/ecosystem not found, skipping ecosystem guard'
    )
    return
  }

  const ecosystemPackages = readdirSync(ecoRoot, { withFileTypes: true })
    .filter((d) => d.isDirectory() && !d.name.startsWith('.'))
    .map((d) => d.name)

  const violations = []

  for (const pkgName of ecosystemPackages) {
    const pkgPath = path.join(ecoRoot, pkgName)
    const v = checkEcosystemPackage(pkgPath)
    if (v) violations.push(v)
  }

  if (violations.length) throw new Error(violations.join('\n\n'))

  console.log('[guard] ✅ ecosystem packages valid')
}

function checkEcosystemPackage(pkgPath) {
  const entries = readdirSync(pkgPath).filter((n) => n !== '.DS_Store')

  const missing = REQUIRED_L1.filter((r) => !entries.includes(r))
  const unexpected = entries.filter(
    (e) => !REQUIRED_L1.includes(e) && !ALLOWED_NOISE.includes(e)
  )

  const configViolations = checkConfigShape(pkgPath)
  const firebaseShapeViolations = checkFirebaseShape(pkgPath)
  const firebaseConfigViolations = checkFirebaseConfig(pkgPath)
  const runtimePublicViolations = checkRuntimePublicShape(pkgPath)

  if (
    !missing.length &&
    !unexpected.length &&
    !runtimePublicViolations &&
    !configViolations &&
    !firebaseShapeViolations &&
    !firebaseConfigViolations
  )
    return null

  const lines = [
    '[guard] ❌ ecosystem package shape violation:',
    `  Path: ${pkgPath}`,
  ]

  if (missing.length) {
    lines.push('  Missing required (L1):')
    missing.forEach((m) => lines.push(`    - ${m}`))
  }

  if (unexpected.length) {
    lines.push('  Unexpected (L1):')
    unexpected
      .slice()
      .sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))
      .forEach((u) => lines.push(`    - ${u}`))
  }

  if (firebaseShapeViolations) {
    lines.push('', ...firebaseShapeViolations.split('\n'))
  }

  if (runtimePublicViolations) {
    lines.push('', ...runtimePublicViolations.split('\n'))
  }

  if (configViolations) {
    lines.push('', ...configViolations.split('\n'))
  }


  if (firebaseConfigViolations) {
    lines.push('', ...firebaseConfigViolations.split('\n'))
  }

  lines.push(
    '',
    '[guard] Fix:',
    `- Ecosystem packages MUST match L1 exactly: ${REQUIRED_L1.join(', ')}`,
    '- Move implementation into /src (including ecosystem config + secrets wiring)',
    '- docs/ is required for ecosystems (this is where the canonical docs live)',
    '- .firebaserc is required for ecosystems (this is where Firebase project binding lives)',
    `- Ecosystems MUST ship runtime public assets at /${REQUIRED_RUNTIME_PUBLIC_DIR}`,
    `- Config MUST live at /${REQUIRED_CONFIG_DIR} and include /firebase (and optional /module)`,
    `- Firebase MUST live at /${REQUIRED_FIREBASE_DIR} with exactly: ${REQUIRED_FIREBASE_FILES.join(
      ', '
    )} (no index files)`
  )

  return lines.join('\n')
}

function checkRuntimePublicShape(pkgPath) {
  const publicDir = path.join(pkgPath, REQUIRED_RUNTIME_PUBLIC_DIR)
  if (!existsSync(publicDir)) {
    return [
      '  Runtime public assets violation:',
      `    Missing required directory: ${publicDir}`,
    ].join('\n')
  }

  return null
}

function checkConfigShape(pkgPath) {
  const configDir = path.join(pkgPath, REQUIRED_CONFIG_DIR)
  if (!existsSync(configDir)) {
    return [
      '  Config shape violation:',
      `    Missing required config directory: ${configDir}`,
    ].join('\n')
  }

  const entries = readdirSync(configDir).filter((n) => n !== '.DS_Store')

  const missingDirs = REQUIRED_CONFIG_DIRS.filter((d) => !entries.includes(d))

  const allowedEntries = new Set([...ALLOWED_CONFIG_FILES, ...REQUIRED_CONFIG_DIRS])
  const isAllowedConfigEntry = (entry) => {
    if (allowedEntries.has(entry)) return true
    if (CONFIG_ALLOWED_NOISE.includes(entry)) return true
    return entry.endsWith('-config.ts')
  }
  const unexpected = entries.filter((e) => !isAllowedConfigEntry(e))

  if (!missingDirs.length && !unexpected.length) return null

  const lines = ['  Config shape violation:', `    Dir: ${configDir}`]
  if (missingDirs.length) {
    lines.push('    Missing required directories:')
    missingDirs.forEach((d) => lines.push(`      - ${d}`))
  }
  if (unexpected.length) {
    lines.push('    Unexpected config entries (only allow specific files/dirs):')
    unexpected
      .slice()
      .sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))
      .forEach((u) => lines.push(`      - ${u}`))
  }
  return lines.join('\n')
}

function checkFirebaseConfig(pkgPath) {
  const firebaseDir = path.join(pkgPath, REQUIRED_FIREBASE_DIR)
  const configPath = path.join(firebaseDir, 'ecosystem.config.ts')

  if (!existsSync(configPath)) return null

  let raw = ''
  try {
    raw = readFileSync(configPath, 'utf8')
  } catch {
    return [
      '  Firebase config violation:',
      `    File: ${configPath}`,
      '    - Cannot read ecosystem.config.ts',
    ].join('\n')
  }
```

```mjs
// FILE: scripts/guards/extensions.mjs
// FireUX Extensions Packages Guard
//
// Enforces the canonical Level-1 shape for packages/extensions/*
//
// Called by scripts/guard.mjs.
// MUST NOT be run directly.

import { readdirSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'

/**
 * Canonical Level-1 shape for ALL FireUX extensions.
 * Opinionated + strict.
 *
 * NOTE:
 * - dist is NOT allowed (delete before commit)
 * - node_modules + tsconfig.tsbuildinfo are tolerated local noise
 */
const REQUIRED_L1 = [
  'package.json',
  'registry.json',
  'README.md',
  'src',
  'tsconfig.json',
]

const ALLOWED_NOISE = ['node_modules', 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo', '.DS_Store']

export async function run(ctx) {
  const repoRoot = ctx?.repoRoot ?? process.cwd()
  const extRoot = path.join(repoRoot, 'packages', 'extensions')

  if (!existsSync(extRoot)) {
    console.warn('[guard] ⚠️  packages/extensions not found, skipping extensions guard')
    return
  }

  const extensionPackages = readdirSync(extRoot, { withFileTypes: true })
    .filter((d) => d.isDirectory() && !d.name.startsWith('.'))
    .map((d) => d.name)

  const violations = []

  for (const pkgName of extensionPackages) {
    const pkgPath = path.join(extRoot, pkgName)
    const v = checkExtensionPackage(pkgPath)
    if (v) violations.push(v)
  }

  if (violations.length) {
    throw new Error(violations.join('\n\n'))
  }

  console.log('[guard] ✅ extension packages valid')
}

function checkExtensionPackage(pkgPath) {
  const entries = readdirSync(pkgPath).filter((n) => n !== '.DS_Store')

  const missing = REQUIRED_L1.filter((r) => !entries.includes(r))
  const unexpected = entries.filter(
    (e) => !REQUIRED_L1.includes(e) && !ALLOWED_NOISE.includes(e)
  )

  if (!missing.length && !unexpected.length) return null

  const lines = [
    '[guard] ❌ extension package shape violation:',
    `  Path: ${pkgPath}`,
  ]

  if (missing.length) {
    lines.push('  Missing required:')
    missing.forEach((m) => lines.push(`    - ${m}`))
  }

  if (unexpected.length) {
    lines.push('  Unexpected:')
    unexpected
      .slice()
      .sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))
      .forEach((u) => lines.push(`    - ${u}`))
  }

  lines.push(
    '',
    '[guard] Fix:',
    `- Extension packages MUST expose exactly: ${REQUIRED_L1.join(', ')}`,
    '- Move implementation details into /src',
    '- Delete dist/ and other build output before committing'
  )

  return lines.join('\n')
}
```

```mjs
// FireUX Projects (Apps) Guard
//
// Enforces the canonical Level-1 shape for projects/*/* apps.
//
// Called by scripts/guard.mjs.
// MUST NOT be run directly.

import { readdirSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'

const REQUIRED_L1 = [

// Explicitly allowed, but never required.
const ALLOWED_L1 = ['docs', 'content.config.ts']

// Allowed dotfiles at app root.
// (We allow per-app env files; other dotfiles stay disallowed by default.)
const ALLOWED_DOTFILES = new Set(['.env'])
function isAllowedDotfile(name) {
  if (ALLOWED_DOTFILES.has(name)) return true
  if (name.startsWith('.env.')) return true
  return false
}

const FORBIDDEN_L1 = [
  'dist',
  '.nuxt',
  '.output',
  '.nitro',
  '.cache',
  '.data',
  'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo',
  '.firebase',
  '.firebaserc',
]

// pnpm workspaces create per-app node_modules. We allow them locally,
// but they should never be committed (gitignored).
const ALLOWED_NOISE_L1 = ['node_modules']

// Public image library baseline expected in every app.
// Extras are allowed (e.g. fireux-app has additional `img/app/stack/*`).
const REQUIRED_PUBLIC_ASSETS = [
  'img/app/cover.png',
  'img/app/thumbnail.png',
  'img/app/logo.png',
  'img/app/favicon.ico',
  'img/app/wordmark.png',
  'img/app/wordmark.svg',
  'img/app/wordmark-light.png',
  'img/app/wordmark-light.svg',
  'img/app/wordmark-dark.png',
  'img/app/pwa/icon-192.png',
  'img/app/pwa/icon-512.png',
]

export async function run(ctx) {
  const repoRoot = ctx?.repoRoot ?? process.cwd()
  const projectsRoot = path.join(repoRoot, 'projects')

  if (!existsSync(projectsRoot)) {
    console.warn('[guard] ⚠️  /projects not found, skipping projects guard')
    return
  }

  const ecosystems = readdirSync(projectsRoot, { withFileTypes: true })
    .filter((d) => d.isDirectory() && !d.name.startsWith('.'))
    .map((d) => d.name)

  const violations = []

  for (const eco of ecosystems) {
    const ecoPath = path.join(projectsRoot, eco)

    const apps = readdirSync(ecoPath, { withFileTypes: true })
      .filter((d) => d.isDirectory() && !d.name.startsWith('.'))
      .map((d) => d.name)

    for (const appName of apps) {
      const appPath = path.join(ecoPath, appName)
      const shapeViolation = checkProjectApp(appPath)
      if (shapeViolation) {
        violations.push(shapeViolation)
        continue
      }

      const publicViolation = checkProjectPublicImageLibrary(appPath)
      if (publicViolation) violations.push(publicViolation)
    }
  }

  if (violations.length) {
    throw new Error(violations.join('\n\n'))
  }

  console.log('[guard] ✅ project apps valid')
}

function checkProjectApp(appPath) {
  const entries = readdirSync(appPath, { withFileTypes: true })
    .filter((e) => e.name !== '.DS_Store')
    .map((e) => e.name)

  const missing = REQUIRED_L1.filter((r) => !entries.includes(r))
  const forbiddenFound = entries.filter((e) => FORBIDDEN_L1.includes(e))

  const allowed = new Set([...REQUIRED_L1, ...ALLOWED_L1])
  const unexpected = entries.filter((e) => {
    if (FORBIDDEN_L1.includes(e)) return false
    if (allowed.has(e)) return false
    if (ALLOWED_NOISE_L1.includes(e)) return false
    if (e.startsWith('.') && isAllowedDotfile(e)) return false
    return true
  })

  if (!missing.length && !forbiddenFound.length && !unexpected.length) return null

  const lines = ['[guard] ❌ project app shape violation:', `  Path: ${appPath}`]

  if (missing.length) {
    lines.push('  Missing required:')
    missing.forEach((m) => lines.push(`    - ${m}`))
  }

  if (forbiddenFound.length) {
    lines.push('  Forbidden (must not exist at L1):')
    forbiddenFound
      .slice()
      .sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))
      .forEach((f) => lines.push(`    - ${f}`))
  }

  if (unexpected.length) {
    lines.push('  Unexpected:')
    unexpected
      .slice()
      .sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))
      .forEach((u) => lines.push(`    - ${u}`))
  }

  lines.push(
    '',
    '[guard] Fix:',
    `- Apps MUST expose only this L1 shape:`,
    `  Required: ${REQUIRED_L1.join(', ')}`,
    `  Allowed: ${ALLOWED_L1.join(', ') || '(none)'}`,
    `  Allowed dotfiles: .env, .env.*`,
    `- Delete build output (.nuxt/.output/dist/etc) before saving`,
    `- Move implementation details into /app or /server`,
    `- Do NOT commit Firebase CLI artifacts (.firebase) or app-level project selectors (.firebaserc)`
  )

  return lines.join('\n')
}

function checkProjectPublicImageLibrary(appPath) {
  const publicDir = path.join(appPath, 'public')
  const missing = []

  for (const rel of REQUIRED_PUBLIC_ASSETS) {
    const full = path.join(publicDir, rel)
    if (!existsSync(full)) missing.push(rel)
  }

  if (!missing.length) return null

  const lines = [
    '[guard] ❌ project public image library violation:',
    `  Path: ${appPath}`,
    `  Missing required public assets:`
  ]
  missing
    .slice()
    .sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))
    .forEach((m) => lines.push(`    - public/${m}`))

  lines.push(
    '',
    '[guard] Fix:',
    '- Ensure every app includes the canonical public image library tree:',
    '  public/img/app/* and public/img/app/pwa/*',
    '- Extras are allowed; missing baseline assets are not'
  )

  return lines.join('\n')
}
```

```mjs
// FILE: scripts/guards/root.mjs
import { existsSync, readdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'

const ALLOWED_ROOT_DIRS = new Set([
  // VCS / tooling
  '.git',
  '.github',
  '.vscode',
  '.specify', // Specify is a DIRECTORY, not a dotfile

  // Documentation & external assets
  'docs',
  'figma-export', // external design-system export (explicitly allowed)

  // Core repo structure
  'packages',
  'projects',
  'scripts', // guard / clean / gitsave live here
  'templates',
  'tools',
  'types',
  'temp',

  // Mirror (tracked README + list file; symlink outputs are gitignored)
  'mirror',

  // Local-only (ignored, but tolerated)
  'node_modules',
])

const ALLOWED_ROOT_FILES = new Set([
  // Governance
  'AGENTS.md',
  'README.md',

  // Build / deploy policy
  'fireux-deploy-ignore',

  // Package management
  'package.json',
  'pnpm-lock.yaml',
  'pnpm-workspace.yaml',

  // TypeScript config
  'tsconfig.base.json',
  'tsconfig.json',
  'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo',

  // Linting
  'eslint.config.js',
])

const ALLOWED_ROOT_DOTFILES = new Set([
  '.copilotignore',
  '.editorconfig',
  '.gitignore',
  '.npmrc',
  '.prettierignore',
  '.prettierrc',
])

function isDirentDirectory(repoRoot, dirent) {
  if (dirent.isDirectory()) return true

  // Symlinks: resolve via statSync, so symlink-to-dir counts as a dir
  if (dirent.isSymbolicLink()) {
    try {
      return statSync(path.join(repoRoot, dirent.name)).isDirectory()
    } catch {
      return false
    }
  }

  return false
}

export async function run(ctx) {
  const repoRoot = ctx?.repoRoot ?? process.cwd()
  const entries = readdirSync(repoRoot, { withFileTypes: true })

  const unexpected = []

  for (const e of entries) {
    const name = e.name
    if (name === '.DS_Store') continue

    // dotfiles (FILES only)
    if (!isDirentDirectory(repoRoot, e) && ALLOWED_ROOT_DOTFILES.has(name)) continue

    // directories (including symlink-to-dir)
    if (isDirentDirectory(repoRoot, e) && ALLOWED_ROOT_DIRS.has(name)) continue

    // files
    if (e.isFile() && ALLOWED_ROOT_FILES.has(name)) continue

    unexpected.push(name)
  }

  if (unexpected.length) {
    const lines = [
      '[guard] ❌ Repo root drift detected:',
      ...unexpected.sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b)).map((n) => `  - ${n}`),
      '',
      '[guard] Fix:',
      '- Move files into /scripts, /tools, /docs, /temp, or /projects/*',
      '- Or explicitly allow them in scripts/guards/root.mjs',
    ]
    throw new Error(lines.join('\n'))
  }

  const mirrorReadmePath = path.join(repoRoot, 'mirror', 'README.md')
  if (!existsSync(mirrorReadmePath)) {
    throw new Error(
      [
        '[guard] ❌ mirror/README.md is required',
        '',
        '[guard] Fix:',
        '- Restore mirror/README.md (tracked) and re-run.',
      ].join('\n')
    )
  }

  console.log('[guard] ✅ Repo root is clean')
}
```

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// FILE: scripts/lint-envs.mjs
//
// Minimal env presence check.
//
// Local dev expects per-app `.env` files (gitignored). CI should be permissive.
// In CI, workflows set `ALLOW_INCOMPLETE_ENVS=1`.

import { existsSync, readdirSync } from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'

const repoRoot = process.cwd()
const allowIncomplete = process.env.ALLOW_INCOMPLETE_ENVS === '1'

const projectsRoot = path.join(repoRoot, 'projects')

if (!existsSync(projectsRoot)) {
  console.log('[envs] projects/ not found; nothing to check')
  process.exit(0)
}

const missing = []

const orgs = readdirSync(projectsRoot, { withFileTypes: true })
  .filter((d) => d.isDirectory() && !d.name.startsWith('.'))
  .map((d) => d.name)

for (const org of orgs) {
  const orgPath = path.join(projectsRoot, org)
  const apps = readdirSync(orgPath, { withFileTypes: true })
    .filter((d) => d.isDirectory() && !d.name.startsWith('.'))
    .map((d) => d.name)

  for (const app of apps) {
    const appRoot = path.join(orgPath, app)
    const envPath = path.join(appRoot, '.env')

    // Only check directories that look like apps (guard-required L1 files).
    const hasNuxtConfig = existsSync(path.join(appRoot, 'nuxt.config.ts'))
    const hasPkgJson = existsSync(path.join(appRoot, 'package.json'))
    if (!hasNuxtConfig || !hasPkgJson) continue

    if (!existsSync(envPath)) {
      missing.push(path.relative(repoRoot, envPath))
    }
  }
}

if (!missing.length) {
  console.log('[envs] ✅ .env files present for all apps')
  process.exit(0)
}

if (allowIncomplete) {
  console.log('[envs] ⚠️  Missing .env files (allowed in CI):')
  missing.forEach((p) => console.log(`  - ${p}`))
  process.exit(0)
}

console.error('[envs] ❌ Missing required .env files:')
missing.forEach((p) => console.error(`  - ${p}`))
console.error('')
console.error('[envs] Fix:')
console.error('- Create .env files for each app under projects/*/*/.env')
console.error("- Or run with ALLOW_INCOMPLETE_ENVS=1 to skip (CI mode)")
process.exit(1)
```

### scripts/list-app-media-trash.mjs

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * Lists Firebase Storage objects that are NOT part of the canonical app media layout.
 *
 * Canonical objects (keep):
 * - apps/{appId}/media/thumbnail
 * - apps/{appId}/media/logo
 * - apps/{appId}/media/wordmark-light
 * - apps/{appId}/media/wordmark-dark
 *
 * Everything else under apps/{appId}/brand/** and apps/{appId}/media/** is considered "trash".
 */

import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import process from 'node:process'

import admin from 'firebase-admin'

const workspaceRoot = process.cwd()
const reportPath = path.join(workspaceRoot, 'temp', 'app-media-audit.json')
if (!fs.existsSync(reportPath)) {
  console.error(`Missing ${reportPath}. Run pnpm audit:app-media first.`)
  process.exit(1)
}

const report = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(reportPath, 'utf8'))

function stableJson(value) {
  return JSON.stringify(value, null, 2) + '\n'
}

async function listBucketObjects(bucket, prefix) {
  const results = []
  let nextPageToken = undefined

  do {
    const [files, , apiResponse] = await bucket.getFiles({
      prefix,
      autoPaginate: false,
      maxResults: 1000,
      pageToken: nextPageToken,
    })

    for (const f of files) results.push(f.name)
    nextPageToken = apiResponse?.nextPageToken
  } while (nextPageToken)

  return results
}

function canonicalPathsForApp(appId) {
  return new Set([
    `apps/${appId}/media/thumbnail`,
    `apps/${appId}/media/logo`,
    `apps/${appId}/media/wordmark-light`,
    `apps/${appId}/media/wordmark-dark`,
  ])
}

function classify(appId, objectNames) {
  const canonical = canonicalPathsForApp(appId)

  const keep = []
  const trash = []

  for (const name of objectNames) {
    // Only operate on media/brand; ignore other app-owned objects (if any exist).
    const inBrand = name.startsWith(`apps/${appId}/brand/`)
    const inMedia = name.startsWith(`apps/${appId}/media/`)
    if (!inBrand && !inMedia) continue

    if (canonical.has(name)) keep.push(name)
    else trash.push(name)
  }

  keep.sort()
  trash.sort()

  return { keep, trash }
}

async function main() {
  const out = {
    generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    sourceAudit: path.relative(workspaceRoot, reportPath),
    ecosystems: {},
  }

  for (const [ecoId, eco] of Object.entries(report.ecosystems ?? {})) {
    const projectId = eco?.projectId
    const bucketName = eco?.bucket
    const ecosystemConfigPath = eco?.sourceFile
    const serviceAccountPath = eco?.serviceAccount

    if (!projectId || !bucketName || !serviceAccountPath) {
      console.warn(`[skip] ${ecoId}: missing projectId/bucket/serviceAccount in audit report`)
      continue
    }

    const saPath = path.join(workspaceRoot, serviceAccountPath)
    if (!fs.existsSync(saPath)) {
      console.warn(`[skip] ${ecoId}: missing service account at ${serviceAccountPath}`)
      continue
    }

    const app = admin.initializeApp(
      {
        credential: admin.credential.cert(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(saPath, 'utf8'))),
        projectId,
        storageBucket: bucketName,
      },
      `trash-${ecoId}`
    )

    const bucket = app.storage().bucket()

    const ecoOut = {
      projectId,
      bucket: bucketName,
      sourceFile: ecosystemConfigPath ?? null,
      serviceAccountPath: path.relative(workspaceRoot, saPath),
      apps: {},
    }

    const appIds = Object.keys(eco?.apps ?? {})
    for (const appId of appIds) {
      const prefix = `apps/${appId}/`
      const objectNames = await listBucketObjects(bucket, prefix)
      const { keep, trash } = classify(appId, objectNames)

      ecoOut.apps[appId] = {
        keep,
        trash,
        totals: { keep: keep.length, trash: trash.length, scanned: objectNames.length },
      }
    }

    out.ecosystems[ecoId] = ecoOut
  }

  const outPath = path.join(workspaceRoot, 'temp', 'app-media-trash.json')
  fs.writeFileSync(outPath, stableJson(out))

  let totalTrash = 0
  for (const eco of Object.values(out.ecosystems)) {
    for (const app of Object.values(eco.apps)) totalTrash += app.totals.trash
  }

  console.log(`Wrote: ${path.relative(workspaceRoot, outPath)}`)
  console.log(`Total trash objects: ${totalTrash}`)
}

main().catch((err) => {
  console.error(err)
  process.exit(1)
})

```

### scripts/migrate-app-media-flatten.mjs

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
/*
  Firestore migration: flatten App media fields

  - Reads all docs from collection: /apps
  - Moves nested media.* fields into flat top-level fields
  - Removes media object to eliminate drift

  Safety:
  - Default mode is DRY RUN (no writes).
  - Use --commit to apply writes.

  Auth:
  - Uses Firebase Admin SDK with Application Default Credentials.
  - Set GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS to a service account JSON, or use gcloud ADC.

  Examples:
    node scripts/migrate-app-media-flatten.mjs --project your-project-id
    node scripts/migrate-app-media-flatten.mjs --project your-project-id --commit
    node scripts/migrate-app-media-flatten.mjs --project your-project-id --app misebox-app --commit
*/

import { applicationDefault, cert, initializeApp } from 'firebase-admin/app'
import { FieldPath, FieldValue, getFirestore } from 'firebase-admin/firestore'
import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises'
import { parseArgs } from './_lib/args.mjs'

function asString(value, fallback = '') {
  if (typeof value === 'string') return value
  if (value == null) return fallback
  return String(value)
}

const args = parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2))
const help = Boolean(args.help || args.h)
const projectId = args.project || process.env.FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID || process.env.GCLOUD_PROJECT
const commit = Boolean(args.commit)
const pageSize = Math.min(Number(args.pageSize || 250), 500)
const limit = args.limit ? Number(args.limit) : null
const targetAppId = typeof args.app === 'string' ? args.app : null

if (help) {
  console.log(`\nFirestore migration: apps media flatten (media.* -> flat fields)\n`)
  console.log('Usage:')
  console.log('  node scripts/migrate-app-media-flatten.mjs --project <projectId> [--commit] [--app <appId>] [--limit N] [--pageSize N]')
  console.log('\nAuth (one required):')
  console.log('  - GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS (path to JSON)')
  console.log('  - FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT (JSON string)')
  console.log('  - Or Google ADC (gcloud): application-default login')
  process.exit(0)
}

if (!projectId) {
  console.error('Missing --project (or FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID / GCLOUD_PROJECT).')
  process.exit(1)
}

async function resolveCredential() {
  if (process.env.FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT) {
    const json = JSON.parse(process.env.FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT)
    return cert(json)
  }

  const saPath = process.env.GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  if (saPath) {
    const raw = await readFile(saPath, 'utf8')
    return cert(JSON.parse(raw))
  }

  return applicationDefault()
}

initializeApp({ credential: await resolveCredential(), projectId })
const db = getFirestore()

const mediaFields = [
  'thumbnail_url',
  'logo_url',
  'wordmark_light_url',
  'wordmark_dark_url',
]

console.log('[migrate-app-media-flatten] start', {
  projectId,
  commit,
  pageSize,
  limit,
  app: targetAppId,
})

let processed = 0
let updated = 0
let skipped = 0

let lastDoc = null

while (true) {
  if (limit && processed >= limit) break

  let q = db.collection('apps').orderBy(FieldPath.documentId()).limit(pageSize)
  if (lastDoc) q = q.startAfter(lastDoc)
  if (targetAppId) q = db.collection('apps').where(FieldPath.documentId(), '==', targetAppId)

  const snap = await q.get()
  if (snap.empty) break

  let batch = db.batch()
  let batchOps = 0

  for (const docSnap of snap.docs) {
    if (limit && processed >= limit) break

    processed += 1
    const data = docSnap.data() || {}

    const patch = {}
    let needs = false

    const media = (data.media && typeof data.media === 'object') ? data.media : null

    const next = {
      thumbnail_url: asString(data.thumbnail_url, '') || asString(media?.thumbnail_url, ''),
      logo_url: asString(data.logo_url, '') || asString(media?.logo_url, ''),
      wordmark_light_url: asString(data.wordmark_light_url, '') || asString(media?.wordmark_light_url, ''),
      wordmark_dark_url: asString(data.wordmark_dark_url, '') || asString(media?.wordmark_dark_url, ''),
    }

    for (const field of mediaFields) {
      if (next[field] !== asString(data[field], '')) {
        patch[field] = next[field]
        needs = true
      }
    }

    if (media) {
      patch.media = FieldValue.delete()
      needs = true
    }

    if (!needs) {
      skipped += 1
      continue
    }

    updated += 1

    if (commit) {
      batch.update(docSnap.ref, patch)
      batchOps += 1
    } else {
      console.log('[dry-run]', docSnap.ref.path, patch)
    }

    if (commit && batchOps >= 400) {
      await batch.commit()
      batch = db.batch()
      batchOps = 0
    }
  }

  if (commit && batchOps > 0) {
    await batch.commit()
  }

  lastDoc = snap.docs[snap.docs.length - 1]

  if (targetAppId) break
}

console.log('[migrate-app-media-flatten] done', { processed, updated, skipped, commit })

```

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
/*
  Firestore migration: backfill App.media + required fields

  - Reads all docs from collection: /apps
  - Moves legacy flat media fields into `media.*`
  - Removes legacy flat fields to eliminate drift
  - Backfills missing required fields with safe defaults

  Safety:
  - Default mode is DRY RUN (no writes).
  - Use --commit to apply writes.

  Auth:
  - Uses Firebase Admin SDK with Application Default Credentials.
  - Set GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS to a service account JSON, or use gcloud ADC.

  Examples:

    node scripts/migrate-app-media-nesting.mjs --project your-project-id --commit
    node scripts/migrate-app-media-nesting.mjs --project your-project-id --app misebox-app --commit

import { applicationDefault, cert, initializeApp } from 'firebase-admin/app'

import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises'

  if (value == null) return fallback

function nonEmptyText(value) {

  return text
}

}

}

const args = parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2))
const help = Boolean(args.help || args.h)
const projectId = args.project || process.env.FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID || process.env.GCLOUD_PROJECT
const commit = Boolean(args.commit)
const pageSize = Math.min(Number(args.pageSize || 250), 500)
const limit = args.limit ? Number(args.limit) : null
const targetAppId = typeof args.app === 'string' ? args.app : null

if (help) {
  console.log(`\nFirestore migration: apps media nesting + backfill required fields\n`)
  console.log('Usage:')
  console.log('  node scripts/migrate-app-media-nesting.mjs --project <projectId> [--commit] [--app <appId>] [--limit N] [--pageSize N]')
  console.log('\nAuth (one required):')
  console.log('  - GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS (path to JSON)')
  console.log('  - FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT (JSON string)')
  console.log('  - Or Google ADC (gcloud): application-default login')
  process.exit(0)
}

if (!projectId) {
  console.error('Missing --project (or FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID / GCLOUD_PROJECT).')
  process.exit(1)
}

async function resolveCredential() {

  return applicationDefault()

initializeApp({ credential: await resolveCredential(), projectId })
const db = getFirestore()

const legacyMediaFields = [
  'thumbnail_url',
  'logo_url',
  'wordmark_light_url',
  'wordmark_dark_url',
]

const requiredStringFields = [
  'app_short_name',
  'tagline',
  'short_bio',
  'long_bio',
```

### scripts/migrate-fireux-tenant-id-fix.mjs

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
/*
  One-time Firestore migration:
  - apps/fireux-tennant -> apps/fireux-tenant
  - apps/<id>/users subcollection copied
  - users/<uid>.adminOf + users/<uid>.userOf updated

  Usage (run from repo root):
    pnpm --filter ./projects/fireux/fireux-app exec node scripts/migrate-fireux-tenant-id-fix.mjs

  Auth:
    - FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT (JSON string) OR
    - GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS (path to JSON)
*/

import { applicationDefault, cert, getApps, initializeApp } from 'firebase-admin/app'
import { getFirestore } from 'firebase-admin/firestore'
import { promises as fs } from 'node:fs'
import { isAbsolute, resolve } from 'node:path'

const OLD_APP_ID = 'fireux-tennant'
const NEW_APP_ID = 'fireux-tenant'

const args = new Set(process.argv.slice(2))
const help = args.has('--help') || args.has('-h')
const keepOld = args.has('--keep-old')
const force = args.has('--force')
const dryRun = args.has('--dry-run')

function printHelp() {
  // Keep this minimal and copy-pastable.
  console.log(`\nFirestore migration: ${OLD_APP_ID} -> ${NEW_APP_ID}\n`)
  console.log('Usage:')
  console.log(
    '  pnpm --filter ./projects/fireux/fireux-app exec node scripts/migrate-fireux-tenant-id-fix.mjs [--dry-run] [--force] [--keep-old]'
  )
  console.log('\nAuth (one required):')
  console.log('  - FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT            (JSON string)')
  console.log('  - GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS      (path to JSON)')
  console.log('  - OR Google ADC (gcloud): application-default login')
  console.log('\nFlags:')
  console.log('  --dry-run     Print actions; do not write or delete')
  console.log('  --force       Overwrite apps/fireux-tenant if it exists')
  console.log('  --keep-old    Keep apps/fireux-tennant after copying')
  console.log('  --help, -h    Show this help')
  console.log('')
}

async function loadServiceAccount() {
  const inline = process.env.FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT
  if (inline) return JSON.parse(inline)

  const credentialsPath = process.env.GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  if (!credentialsPath) {
    throw new Error(
      'Missing credentials: set FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT or GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS'
    )
  }

  const absolutePath = isAbsolute(credentialsPath)
    ? credentialsPath
    : resolve(process.cwd(), credentialsPath)
  const raw = await fs.readFile(absolutePath, 'utf-8')
  return JSON.parse(raw)
}

async function getDb() {
  if (getApps().length === 0) {
    const hasExplicitCreds = Boolean(
      process.env.FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT || process.env.GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
    )

    if (hasExplicitCreds) {
      const serviceAccount = await loadServiceAccount()
      initializeApp({ credential: cert(serviceAccount) })
    } else {
      // Falls back to Google Application Default Credentials (ADC), e.g.:
      //   gcloud auth application-default login
      initializeApp({ credential: applicationDefault() })
    }
  }
  return getFirestore()
}

function replaceAppIdInList(list, fromId, toId) {
  if (!Array.isArray(list)) return list
  const next = list
    .map((v) => (typeof v === 'string' ? v.trim() : ''))
    .filter(Boolean)
    .map((v) => (v === fromId ? toId : v))
  return Array.from(new Set(next))
}

async function main() {
  if (help) {
    printHelp()
    return
  }

  const db = await getDb()

  const oldRef = db.collection('apps').doc(OLD_APP_ID)
  const newRef = db.collection('apps').doc(NEW_APP_ID)

  const [oldSnap, newSnap] = await Promise.all([oldRef.get(), newRef.get()])
  if (!oldSnap.exists) {
    console.log(`Nothing to migrate: apps/${OLD_APP_ID} does not exist.`)
    return
  }
  const newExists = newSnap.exists

  const oldData = oldSnap.data() || {}
  const nextAppDoc = {
    ...oldData,
    id: NEW_APP_ID,
  }

  // Optional light copy fixes (safe): adjust names if they contain the misspelling.
  if (typeof nextAppDoc.app_name === 'string') {
    nextAppDoc.app_name = nextAppDoc.app_name.replace(/tennant/gi, 'tenant')
  }
  if (typeof nextAppDoc.app_short_name === 'string') {
    nextAppDoc.app_short_name = nextAppDoc.app_short_name.replace(/tennant/gi, 'tenant')
  }
  if (typeof nextAppDoc.slug === 'string') {
    nextAppDoc.slug = nextAppDoc.slug.replace(/tennant/gi, 'tenant')
  }

  console.log(`Copying app doc: apps/${OLD_APP_ID} -> apps/${NEW_APP_ID}`)
  if (newExists && !force) {
    console.log(`- apps/${NEW_APP_ID} already exists; leaving app doc as-is (use --force to overwrite)`)
  } else if (!dryRun) {
    await newRef.set(nextAppDoc, { merge: false })
  }

  console.log(`Copying subcollection: apps/${OLD_APP_ID}/users -> apps/${NEW_APP_ID}/users`)
  const oldUsers = await oldRef.collection('users').get()
  const userIds = []
  let batch = db.batch()
  let ops = 0
  const commitBatch = async () => {
    if (ops === 0) return
    if (!dryRun) await batch.commit()
    batch = db.batch()
    ops = 0
  }

  const mergeUserDocs = newExists && !force

  for (const docSnap of oldUsers.docs) {
    const uid = docSnap.id
    userIds.push(uid)
    const dest = newRef.collection('users').doc(uid)
    batch.set(dest, docSnap.data(), { merge: mergeUserDocs })
    ops++
    if (ops >= 400) await commitBatch()
  }
  await commitBatch()

  // Update core user mirrors for every member/admin found in the app users subcollection.
  console.log(`Updating users/<uid> mirrors for ${userIds.length} user(s)`)
  for (const uid of userIds) {
    const userRef = db.collection('users').doc(uid)
    const userSnap = await userRef.get()
    if (!userSnap.exists) continue
    const u = userSnap.data() || {}

    const nextAdminOf = replaceAppIdInList(u.adminOf, OLD_APP_ID, NEW_APP_ID)
    const nextUserOf = replaceAppIdInList(u.userOf, OLD_APP_ID, NEW_APP_ID)

    // Only update if needed to minimize writes.
    const adminChanged = JSON.stringify(nextAdminOf) !== JSON.stringify(u.adminOf || [])
    const userChanged = JSON.stringify(nextUserOf) !== JSON.stringify(u.userOf || [])
    if (!adminChanged && !userChanged) continue

    if (!dryRun) {
      await userRef.update({
        ...(adminChanged ? { adminOf: nextAdminOf } : {}),
        ...(userChanged ? { userOf: nextUserOf } : {}),
      })
    }
  }

  if (!keepOld) {
    console.log(`Deleting old data: apps/${OLD_APP_ID}`)
    // Delete subcollection docs first.
    const oldUsersAgain = await oldRef.collection('users').get()
    batch = db.batch()
    ops = 0
    for (const docSnap of oldUsersAgain.docs) {
      batch.delete(docSnap.ref)
      ops++
      if (ops >= 400) await commitBatch()
    }
    await commitBatch()

    if (!dryRun) {
      await oldRef.delete()
    }
  }
```

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
/*
  Firestore migration (Misebox): mirror ALL core users into the app user overlay.

  Goal:
    - Keep core users in /users (unchanged)
    - Ensure every /users/{uid} also has an app-scoped overlay:
        /apps/<appId>/users/{uid}
      so Misebox can assign roles, list members, etc.
    - Ensure core users include the app in userOf[]
    - Set apps/<appId>.user_count to the resulting overlay size

  Usage (run from repo root):
    pnpm --filter ./projects/misebox/misebox-app exec node scripts/migrate-misebox-app-users.mjs [--app misebox-app] [--dry-run]

  Auth (one required):
    - FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT (JSON string) OR
    - GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS (path to JSON) OR
    - Google ADC (gcloud): gcloud auth application-default login

  Flags:
    --app <id>     Target app id (default: misebox-app)
    --dry-run      Print actions; do not write
    --limit <n>    Limit number of core users processed (debug)
    --help, -h     Show help
*/

import { createRequire } from 'node:module'
import { promises as fs } from 'node:fs'
import { isAbsolute, resolve } from 'node:path'
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto'

const requireFromCwd = createRequire(resolve(process.cwd(), 'package.json'))

async function loadFirebaseAdmin() {
  const adminApp = await import(requireFromCwd.resolve('firebase-admin/app'))
  const adminFirestore = await import(
    requireFromCwd.resolve('firebase-admin/firestore')
  )

  return {
    applicationDefault: adminApp.applicationDefault,
    cert: adminApp.cert,
    getApps: adminApp.getApps,
    initializeApp: adminApp.initializeApp,
    FieldPath: adminFirestore.FieldPath,
    FieldValue: adminFirestore.FieldValue,
    getFirestore: adminFirestore.getFirestore,
  }
}

const args = new Set(process.argv.slice(2))
const help = args.has('--help') || args.has('-h')
const dryRun = args.has('--dry-run')

function getArgValue(flag) {
  const list = process.argv.slice(2)
  const idx = list.indexOf(flag)
  if (idx === -1) return undefined
  const next = list[idx + 1]
  if (!next || next.startsWith('--')) return undefined
  return next
}

function printHelp() {
  console.log('\nFirestore migration: mirror /users -> /apps/<appId>/users\n')
  console.log('Usage:')
  console.log(
    '  pnpm --filter ./projects/misebox/misebox-app exec node scripts/migrate-misebox-app-users.mjs [--app misebox-app] [--dry-run]'
  )
  console.log('\nAuth (one required):')
  console.log('  - FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT            (JSON string)')
  console.log('  - GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS      (path to JSON)')
  console.log('  - OR Google ADC (gcloud): application-default login')
  console.log('\nFlags:')
  console.log('  --app <id>     Target app id (default: misebox-app)')
  console.log('  --dry-run      Print actions; do not write')
  console.log('  --limit <n>    Limit number of core users processed (debug)')
  console.log('  --help, -h     Show this help')
  console.log('')
}

async function loadServiceAccount() {
  const inline = process.env.FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT
  if (inline) return JSON.parse(inline)

  const credentialsPath = process.env.GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  if (!credentialsPath) {
    throw new Error(
      'Missing credentials: set FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT or GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS'
    )
  }

  const absolutePath = isAbsolute(credentialsPath)
    ? credentialsPath
    : resolve(process.cwd(), credentialsPath)
  const raw = await fs.readFile(absolutePath, 'utf-8')
  return JSON.parse(raw)
}

async function getDb() {
  const { applicationDefault, cert, getApps, initializeApp, getFirestore } =
    await loadFirebaseAdmin()

  if (getApps().length === 0) {
    const hasExplicitCreds = Boolean(

function asPositiveInt(value) {

  const n = Number(value)
  if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n <= 0) return undefined

}

async function main() {
```

### scripts/migrate-places-canonical.mjs

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
/*
  Canonical Place migration (idempotent)

  - Reads all docs from collection: /places
  - Writes back to the SAME document id
  - Ensures canonical fields exist (defaults: '' or 0)
  - Migrates legacy: source 'firestore'/'firebase' -> 'fireux'
  - Deletes legacy fields if present:
      - place_id
      - professionals_current
      - professionals_alumni

  Safety:
  - Default mode is DRY RUN (no writes).
  - Use --commit to apply writes.

  Auth:
  - Uses Firebase Admin SDK with Application Default Credentials.
  - Set GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS to a service account JSON, or use gcloud ADC.

  Examples:
    node scripts/migrate-places-canonical.mjs --project your-project-id
    node scripts/migrate-places-canonical.mjs --project your-project-id --commit
    node scripts/migrate-places-canonical.mjs --project your-project-id --commit --limit 500
*/

import { applicationDefault, cert, initializeApp } from 'firebase-admin/app'
import { FieldPath, FieldValue, getFirestore } from 'firebase-admin/firestore'
import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises'

function parseArgs(argv) {
  const args = {
    commit: false,
    project: process.env.FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID || process.env.GCLOUD_PROJECT || '',
    credentials: process.env.GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS || '',
    limit: 0,
    pageSize: 300,
  }

  for (let i = 2; i < argv.length; i++) {
    const a = argv[i]
    if (a === '--commit') args.commit = true
    else if (a === '--dry-run') args.commit = false
    else if (a === '--project') args.project = String(argv[++i] || '')
    else if (a === '--credentials') args.credentials = String(argv[++i] || '')
    else if (a === '--limit') args.limit = Number(argv[++i] || 0)
    else if (a === '--page-size') args.pageSize = Number(argv[++i] || 300)
    else if (a === '-h' || a === '--help') {
      console.log('Usage: migrate-places-canonical [--project <id>] [--credentials <service-account.json>] [--commit] [--limit <n>] [--page-size <n>]')
      process.exit(0)
    }
  }

  if (!Number.isFinite(args.pageSize) || args.pageSize <= 0) args.pageSize = 300
  if (!Number.isFinite(args.limit) || args.limit < 0) args.limit = 0

  return args
}

function asString(value, fallback = '') {
  return typeof value === 'string' ? value : fallback
}

function asNumber(value, fallback = 0) {
  const n = Number(value)
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : fallback
}

function normalizeSearchTerm(name, formattedAddress) {
  return `${asString(name)} ${asString(formattedAddress)}`.toLowerCase().trim()
}

const args = parseArgs(process.argv)

if (!args.project) {
  console.error('Missing --project (or FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID / GCLOUD_PROJECT).')
  process.exit(1)
}

async function resolveCredential() {
  if (args.credentials && args.credentials.trim()) {
    const path = args.credentials.trim()
    const raw = await readFile(path, 'utf8')
    const json = JSON.parse(raw)
    return cert(json)
  }
  return applicationDefault()
}

initializeApp({ credential: await resolveCredential(), projectId: args.project })

const db = getFirestore()

const collectionName = 'places'

console.log('[migrate-places] start', {
  project: args.project,
  commit: args.commit,
  limit: args.limit || null,
  pageSize: args.pageSize,
})

let processed = 0
let updated = 0
let skipped = 0
let missingPlaceImagesFixed = 0

let lastDoc = null

while (true) {
  let q = db
    .collection(collectionName)
    .orderBy(FieldPath.documentId())
    .limit(args.pageSize)

  if (lastDoc) q = q.startAfter(lastDoc)

  const snap = await q.get()
  if (snap.empty) break

  const batch = db.batch()
  let batchOps = 0

  for (const docSnap of snap.docs) {
    const data = docSnap.data() || {}

    const docId = docSnap.id
    const legacyPlaceId = asString(data.place_id || '')
    const id = docId || asString(data.id || legacyPlaceId || docId)

    // Canon: stored docs are always fireux.
    const sourceRaw = asString(data.source || '')
    const source = sourceRaw === 'firebase' || sourceRaw === 'firestore' ? 'fireux' : sourceRaw || 'fireux'

    const name = asString(data.name)
    const formatted_address = asString(data.formatted_address)
    const placeImageNullish = data.place_image == null
    const place_image = asString(data.place_image || data.avatar || data.image_url)
    const lat = asNumber(data.lat)
    const lng = asNumber(data.lng)

    const search_term = asString(data.search_term) || normalizeSearchTerm(name, formatted_address)

    const creator_id = asString(data.creator_id)

    const patch = {
      id,
      source,
      name,
      formatted_address,

      place_image,
      lat,
      lng,
      search_term,
      creator_id,

      // Legacy deletions
      place_id: FieldValue.delete(),
      professionals_current: FieldValue.delete(),
      professionals_alumni: FieldValue.delete(),
    }

    // Only add timestamps if missing.
    if (!data.created_at) patch.created_at = FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
    if (!data.updated_at) patch.updated_at = FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

    // Determine whether anything actually needs changing.
    const needs =
      asString(data.id || '') !== id ||
      asString(data.source || '') !== source ||
      'place_id' in data ||
      'professionals_current' in data ||
      'professionals_alumni' in data ||
      placeImageNullish ||
      !('place_image' in data) ||
      !('search_term' in data) ||
      !('creator_id' in data) ||
      !data.created_at ||
      !data.updated_at

    processed++

    if (!needs) {
      skipped++
    } else {
      updated++
      if (placeImageNullish) missingPlaceImagesFixed++
      if (args.commit) {
        batch.set(docSnap.ref, patch, { merge: true })
        batchOps++
      }
    }

    if (args.limit && processed >= args.limit) break
  }

  lastDoc = snap.docs[snap.docs.length - 1]
```

```mjs
    else if (a === '--dry-run') args.commit = false
    else if (a === '--delete-avatar') args.deleteAvatar = true
    else if (a === '--delete-image-url') args.deleteImageUrl = true
    else if (a === '--project') args.project = String(argv[++i] || '')
    else if (a === '--credentials') args.credentials = String(argv[++i] || '')
    else if (a === '--limit') args.limit = Number(argv[++i] || 0)
    else if (a === '--page-size') args.pageSize = Number(argv[++i] || 300)
    else if (a === '-h' || a === '--help') {
      console.log(

      )
      process.exit(0)
    }
  }

  if (!Number.isFinite(args.pageSize) || args.pageSize <= 0) args.pageSize = 300
  if (!Number.isFinite(args.limit) || args.limit < 0) args.limit = 0

  return args
}

  pageSize: args.pageSize,

let backfilled = 0

    if (args.deleteImageUrl && 'image_url' in data) {

      skipped++
    } else {
      updated++

        batch.set(docSnap.ref, patch, { merge: true })
        batchOps++
      }
```

```mjs
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'

const repoRoot = path.resolve(new URL('..', import.meta.url).pathname)
const mirrorDir = path.join(repoRoot, 'mirror')
const listPath = path.join(mirrorDir, 'mirror.txt')

function isKeepFile(baseName) {
  return baseName === 'README.md' || baseName === 'mirror.txt'
}

function linkNameFromRelPath(relPath) {
  // Flat mirror: build a readable name from key path segments.
  // Examples:
  // - packages/core/fireux-core/.../organisms/App/Edit/Admin.vue
  //   -> core-App-Edit-Admin.vue
  // - packages/extensions/fireux-jobs/.../organisms/profiles/Agent/Cards/Cell.vue
  //   -> jobs-profiles-Agent-Cards-Cell.vue
  // - packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/components/dev/HealthPanel.vue
  //   -> core-dev-HealthPanel.vue
  // - packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/pages/dev/index.vue
  //   -> core-dev-index.vue
  // - packages/core/fireux-core/src/runtime/server/api/dev/images.get.ts
  //   -> core-api-dev-images.get.ts

  function normalizeModelTail(modelParts) {
    // Human-friendly: chef-model.ts, supplier-model.ts, app-interface.ts, user-interface.ts, etc.
    if (!Array.isArray(modelParts) || modelParts.length === 0) return modelParts

    // Look for Chef/Supplier/App/User and model/interface in the path
    const last = modelParts[modelParts.length - 1]
    const prev = modelParts.length >= 2 ? modelParts[modelParts.length - 2] : ''
    const lcLast = last.toLowerCase()
    const lcPrev = prev.toLowerCase()

    // Model files: Chef.model.ts, Supplier.model.ts, etc.
    if (lcLast.endsWith('.model.ts')) {
      const entity = lcPrev || lcLast.replace('.model.ts', '')
      return [`${entity}-model.ts`]
    }
    // Interface files: useChefInterface.ts, useSupplierInterface.ts, etc.
    if (lcLast.startsWith('use') && lcLast.endsWith('interface.ts')) {
      // useChefInterface.ts -> chef-interface.ts
      const entity = lcLast.replace(/^use/i, '').replace(/interface\.ts$/i, '')
      return [`${entity}-interface.ts`]
    }
    // Fallback: just use the last segment, lowercased
    return [lcLast]
  }

  const parts = relPath.split('/').filter(Boolean)
  const packagesIndex = parts.indexOf('packages')

  let pkgSlug = 'repo'
  let tail = parts

  if (packagesIndex !== -1 && parts.length > packagesIndex + 2) {
    const scope = parts[packagesIndex + 1]
    const pkgName = parts[packagesIndex + 2]
    pkgSlug =
      pkgName === 'fireux-core'
        ? 'core'
        : pkgName.startsWith('fireux-')
          ? pkgName.slice('fireux-'.length)
          : `${scope}-${pkgName}`

    const organismsIndex = parts.indexOf('organisms')
    if (organismsIndex !== -1) {
      tail = parts.slice(organismsIndex + 1)
    } else {
      // Use stable anchors to keep names short and human-readable.
      // Prefer the closest semantic segment under src/runtime.
      const runtimeIndex = parts.indexOf('runtime')

      const componentsIndex = parts.indexOf('components')
      const layoutsIndex = parts.indexOf('layouts')
      const pagesIndex = parts.indexOf('pages')
      const composablesIndex = parts.indexOf('composables')
      const modelsIndex = parts.indexOf('models')
      const apiIndex = parts.indexOf('api')

      if (layoutsIndex !== -1 && componentsIndex !== -1) {
        // Keep the "layouts" context to avoid collisions (e.g. layouts/dev/Nav.vue).
        tail = parts.slice(layoutsIndex)
      } else if (componentsIndex !== -1) {
        tail = parts.slice(componentsIndex + 1)
      } else if (pagesIndex !== -1) {
        tail = parts.slice(pagesIndex + 1)
      } else if (composablesIndex !== -1) {
        tail = parts.slice(composablesIndex + 1)
      } else if (modelsIndex !== -1) {
        tail = normalizeModelTail(parts.slice(modelsIndex + 1))
      } else if (apiIndex !== -1) {
        tail = ['api', ...parts.slice(apiIndex + 1)]
      } else if (runtimeIndex !== -1) {
        // Fallback: everything after runtime.
        tail = parts.slice(runtimeIndex + 1)
      } else {
        // Last resort fallback.
        tail = parts.slice(-4)
      }
    }
  }

  const cleaned = tail
    .map((seg) => seg.replace(/\.(vue|ts|js|mjs)$/i, (m) => m))
    .map((seg) => seg.replaceAll(' ', '-'))
    .map((seg) => seg.replaceAll('_', '-'))
    .map((seg) => seg.toLowerCase())

  // For model/interface files, just use the cleaned name (no pkgSlug prefix)
  if (cleaned.length === 1 && (cleaned[0].endsWith('-model.ts') || cleaned[0].endsWith('-interface.ts'))) {
    return cleaned[0]
  }

  // Prefer simplified names: drop the package prefix and use the cleaned tail segments.
  // This produces short, human-friendly names like `kitchens-index.vue` or `companies-create.vue`.
  return cleaned.join('-')
}

function readMirrorList(filePath) {
  const raw = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8')

    .split(/\r?\n/)
    .map((line) => line.trim())
    .filter((line) => line && !line.startsWith('#'))
```
